tcz: Pathen mite chu kipal lhu'uva chule kithoudoh theilouva umden diu hiya hitam? Chuti theiponte! Amaho seingailou ahinau chu Pathen in chidang namdang ho huhhing'a aum sahna dingu ahi. Hichehin, Amite chun thangthip pehna ahin nei uva amaho ding tah-a ahin kilethum theina dingu adeipehjeh ahijoi.
en: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
text:
ROM 11:11
Thadou: Pathen mite chu kipal lhu'uva chule kithoudoh theilouva umden diu hiya hitam? Chuti theiponte! Amaho seingailou ahinau chu Pathen in chidang namdang ho huhhing'a aum sahna dingu ahi. Hichehin, Amite chun thangthip pehna ahin nei uva amaho ding tah-a ahin kilethum theina dingu adeipehjeh ahijoi.
English: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

tcz: Tua hi chidang namdang ho ahaosatnau hi Israel miten Pathen in Huhhingna apeh-u imacha a aselou jeh-u ahin, chea kona hi amahon achaina pena ahin kisan tenguleh vannoiyin gamchenga phattheina amube chehna diu chu alung ngaito ahi.
en: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
text:
ROM 11:12
Thadou: Tua hi chidang namdang ho ahaosatnau hi Israel miten Pathen in Huhhingna apeh-u imacha a aselou jeh-u ahin, chea kona hi amahon achaina pena ahin kisan tenguleh vannoiyin gamchenga phattheina amube chehna diu chu alung ngaito ahi.
English: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

tcz: Keiman hiche kasei jouse hi nangho Gentile ho dinga ahi. Pathen in keima hi Gentile ho lah a dinga solchah a eilhen ahi thudol kasei khohten ahi.
en: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,
text:
ROM 11:13
Thadou: Keiman hiche kasei jouse hi nangho Gentile ho dinga ahi. Pathen in keima hi Gentile ho lah a dinga solchah a eilhen ahi thudol kasei khohten ahi.
English: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman chidang namdang nanghon naneiyu huhhingna hi Israel miten nahin thangset peh theina dingu kangaitoa kagelkhoh hi amaho themkhat beh kahuh doh theina ding kati ahi.
en: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
text:
ROM 11:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman chidang namdang nanghon naneiyu huhhingna hi Israel miten nahin thangset peh theina dingu kangaitoa kagelkhoh hi amaho themkhat beh kahuh doh theina ding kati ahi.
English: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

tcz: Ajehchu amahon akisan nomlou uva pat Pathen in huhhingna hi vannoi mundang jousea dinga aphaldoh ahin, amahon ahin kisanthei tenguleh kidang jocheh ding ahi. Athiho dinga hinna hung hiding ahitai.
en: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
text:
ROM 11:15
Thadou: Ajehchu amahon akisan nomlou uva pat Pathen in huhhingna hi vannoi mundang jousea dinga aphaldoh ahin, amahon ahin kisanthei tenguleh kidang jocheh ding ahi. Athiho dinga hinna hung hiding ahitai.
English: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

tcz: Chule Abraham le ipului hou adangse chu athigam'un, amaho chilhah ho theng diu ahi. Ajehchu changbong chu atheng ahi banga maicham'a dinga kikheng doh jong chu atheng ahi. Ajehchu thingbul chu athenleh abah jong chu theng ding ahiye.
en: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
text:
ROM 11:16
Thadou: Chule Abraham le ipului hou adangse chu athigam'un, amaho chilhah ho theng diu ahi. Ajehchu changbong chu atheng ahi banga maicham'a dinga kikheng doh jong chu atheng ahi. Ajehchu thingbul chu athenleh abah jong chu theng ding ahiye.
English: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

tcz: Hinlah Abraham chilhah phabep chu tanboh in aumuve. Chule nangho chidang namdangte, gam Olive thingphung bah hoa kon nahiuvin, kijopmat tha bou nahiuve. Hijeh chun tun, nanghon jong Pathen'a kona phattheina Abraham le achilhahte kithutepsa chu changa nahi tauvin, Pathen deilhen Olive thinga haona lhingset phattheina chu chang'a nahi tauve.
en: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,
text:
ROM 11:17
Thadou: Hinlah Abraham chilhah phabep chu tanboh in aumuve. Chule nangho chidang namdangte, gam Olive thingphung bah hoa kon nahiuvin, kijopmat tha bou nahiuve. Hijeh chun tun, nanghon jong Pathen'a kona phattheina Abraham le achilhahte kithutepsa chu changa nahi tauvin, Pathen deilhen Olive thinga haona lhingset phattheina chu chang'a nahi tauve.
English: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

tcz: Hinlah akisubong'ah abah hoa kijopmat nahijeh un nahoithouva nakiletsah lou dingu ahi. Nangma abah maimai nahi, aphung chu nahipoi.
en: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
text:
ROM 11:18
Thadou: Hinlah akisubong'ah abah hoa kijopmat nahijeh un nahoithouva nakiletsah lou dingu ahi. Nangma abah maimai nahi, aphung chu nahipoi.
English: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

tcz: Nangman, “Aphai, hiche abahho kisubong chu keima to kijopmatna theiding ahi” tia nasei thei ahi.
en: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
text:
ROM 11:19
Thadou: Nangman, “Aphai, hiche abahho kisubong chu keima to kijopmatna theiding ahi” tia nasei thei ahi.
English: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

tcz: Ahinai, hijongleh geldoh in: chuche abahho akisuhboh nau ajehchu amahon Christa atahsan lou jeh-u ahi, chule nangman natahsan jeh-a naum ahi. Hijehchun, kichoisang hih in, ahin ipi sohthei ding ahi thua kichajon.
en: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

tcz: ajehchu Pathen in abahho bon chu ahinghoi louva ahileh, nangma jeng jong nahing hoi ponte.
en: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
text:
ROM 11:21
Thadou: ajehchu Pathen in abahho bon chu ahinghoi louva ahileh, nangma jeng jong nahing hoi ponte.
English: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

tcz: Pathen hi lungset them ahidan le akhoh je hedoh in. Athu ngailou ho dinga chu lungkhoh a ahi, hinla athua nungho dinga lungset them ahi, amilungsetna natahsan jom jingu ahitah leh, hinlah tahsan nangah ule nangho jong kisat lha ding nahiuve.
en: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
text:
ROM 11:22
Thadou: Pathen hi lungset them ahidan le akhoh je hedoh in. Athu ngailou ho dinga chu lungkhoh a ahi, hinla athua nungho dinga lungset them ahi, amilungsetna natahsan jom jingu ahitah leh, hinlah tahsan nangah ule nangho jong kisat lha ding nahiuve.
English: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

tcz: Chule Israel mi chun atahsanlou nauva alungu ahin heiyuva ahileh, amaho chu kijop mat kit thei ahi, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu aphunga chu ahinjop mat kittheiyu ahi.
en: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
text:
ROM 11:23
Thadou: Chule Israel mi chun atahsanlou nauva alungu ahin heiyuva ahileh, amaho chu kijop mat kit thei ahi, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu aphunga chu ahinjop mat kittheiyu ahi.
English: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

tcz: Nangho angai monga gam Olive thingbah kisatlha nahiuve. Hitia chu Pathen in angaiya kon hilou Olive thingtoh najop mat'u ahin, atil'a pat abahho chu Olive phung chutoh ajopmat kit ding chu kijopmat cheh ding ahi.
en: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
text:
ROM 11:24
Thadou: Nangho angai monga gam Olive thingbah kisatlha nahiuve. Hitia chu Pathen in angaiya kon hilou Olive thingtoh najop mat'u ahin, atil'a pat abahho chu Olive phung chutoh ajopmat kit ding chu kijopmat cheh ding ahi.
English: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, hiche thuguh hi kahet chetsah noma, hichu nakimoh letsah louna dingu kati ahi. Israel mi phabep'in lungtahna aneiyu hi chidang namdang ho Christa a ahung nadingu amijat bulhin loulai jeh bou ahitai.
en: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
text:
ROM 11:25
Thadou: Kasopi deitah teho, hiche thuguh hi kahet chetsah noma, hichu nakimoh letsah louna dingu kati ahi. Israel mi phabep'in lungtahna aneiyu hi chidang namdang ho Christa a ahung nadingu amijat bulhin loulai jeh bou ahitai.
English: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

tcz: Chule hitia chu Israel jouse huhhing hidiu ahi. Pathen lekhabun aseiye, “Jerusalem'a kona huhhing dingpa chu hung ding ahi, chule aman Israel mite chu Pathen ngaisah louna'a kona alehei ding ahi.
en: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
text:
ROM 11:26
Thadou: Chule hitia chu Israel jouse huhhing hidiu ahi. Pathen lekhabun aseiye, “Jerusalem'a kona huhhing dingpa chu hung ding ahi, chule aman Israel mite chu Pathen ngaisah louna'a kona alehei ding ahi.
English: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

tcz: Chule hiche hi ama hoto kitepna hiding ahi, Keiman amaho chonsetna kalah mang ding ahi.”
en: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
text:
ROM 11:27
Thadou: Chule hiche hi ama hoto kitepna hiding ahi, Keiman amaho chonsetna kalah mang ding ahi.”
English: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

tcz: Israel mi tampihi Kipana Thupha melma'a pang'ah ahiuvin, chule hiche hin chidang namdang nangho phatchomna napeh-u ahi. Hijeng jongleh amaho angailut mite ahiuve, ajehchu aman apuluiyu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob alhendoh ahi.
en: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
text:
ROM 11:28
Thadou: Israel mi tampihi Kipana Thupha melma'a pang'ah ahiuvin, chule hiche hin chidang namdang nangho phatchomna napeh-u ahi. Hijeng jongleh amaho angailut mite ahiuve, ajehchu aman apuluiyu Abraham, Isaac chule Jacob alhendoh ahi.
English: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen thilpeh hole Aman akou ho chu kikhelkit talou dingu ahi.
en: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
text:
ROM 11:29
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen thilpeh hole Aman akou ho chu kikhelkit talou dingu ahi.
English: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

tcz: Khatvei chu chidang namdang hon Pathen ana douvu ahi, hinla Israel miten Ama adouvu chun Pathen in nangho nalungset joh-u ahitai.
en: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
text:
ROM 11:30
Thadou: Khatvei chu chidang namdang hon Pathen ana douvu ahi, hinla Israel miten Ama adouvu chun Pathen in nangho nalungset joh-u ahitai.
English: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

tcz: Tun amaho doulung pua ahiuvin, Pathen mihepina chu nahengu hung lhung ahi, hitia chu amaho jong Pathen mihepina chu achan theina dingu ahi.
en: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
text:
ROM 11:31
Thadou: Tun amaho doulung pua ahiuvin, Pathen mihepina chu nahengu hung lhung ahi, hitia chu amaho jong Pathen mihepina chu achan theina dingu ahi.
English: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

tcz: Pathen in amichang cheh lungsetna achan theina dinguva ami changcheh chu seingai louva akhumchah ahitai.
en: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
text:
ROM 11:32
Thadou: Pathen in amichang cheh lungsetna achan theina dinguva ami changcheh chu seingai louva akhumchah ahitai.
English: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

tcz: O Pathen haona le chihna chule hetna hohi iti kidan hitam! Alampi ho le alunggel ngaito hetphah jouding ahipoi.
en: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
text:
ROM 11:33
Thadou: O Pathen haona le chihna chule hetna hohi iti kidan hitam! Alampi ho le alunggel ngaito hetphah jouding ahipoi.
English: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

tcz: Ajehchu koiham Pakai lunggel hedoh joujai dinga? Ama thumop themna geiya hea koi umem?
en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
text:
ROM 11:34
Thadou: Ajehchu koiham Pakai lunggel hedoh joujai dinga? Ama thumop themna geiya hea koi umem?
English: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

tcz: Chule koiham apeh tamval behseh jeh a lepeh kit dinga chu?
en: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
text:
ROM 11:35
Thadou: Chule koiham apeh tamval behseh jeh a lepeh kit dinga chu?
English: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

tcz: Ajehchu imajouse hi Ama'a kona hunga chule ijakai hi Ama thahatna'a uma, chule hichu ama loupina dinga gon ahije. Loupina jouse tonsot'in Ama a hijing hen! Amen.
en: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
text:
ROM 11:36
Thadou: Ajehchu imajouse hi Ama'a kona hunga chule ijakai hi Ama thahatna'a uma, chule hichu ama loupina dinga gon ahije. Loupina jouse tonsot'in Ama a hijing hen! Amen.
English: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

tcz: Chule hiti chun sopi deitahte, kahin ngeh nahiuve, Pathen in ijakai nabolpehtah jeh uvin Amadin natahsau chu peuvin. Hichu ahing chule athengsel kilhaina–Pathen santhei dol tah hihen. Hiche hi adihlam'a Ama houtheina chu ahi.
en: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
text:
ROM 12:1
Thadou: Chule hiti chun sopi deitahte, kahin ngeh nahiuve, Pathen in ijakai nabolpehtah jeh uvin Amadin natahsau chu peuvin. Hichu ahing chule athengsel kilhaina–Pathen santhei dol tah hihen. Hiche hi adihlam'a Ama houtheina chu ahi.
English: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

tcz: Nanghon tulai vannoi chonna le umchan khosahna ho jom hih-un, ahin Pathen'in mithah hina lungthah napeu henlang nalunggel ngaitonau khel hen. Chutengleh Pathen in nangho dinga apha le lunglhaina chule chamkimna nagonpeh-u chu nahin het ding'u ahi.
en: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
text:
ROM 12:2
Thadou: Nanghon tulai vannoi chonna le umchan khosahna ho jom hih-un, ahin Pathen'in mithah hina lungthah napeu henlang nalunggel ngaitonau khel hen. Chutengleh Pathen in nangho dinga apha le lunglhaina chule chamkimna nagonpeh-u chu nahin het ding'u ahi.
English: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

tcz: Pathen in chanpha le thuneina eipeh jal a hiche thua hi kahilchah nahiuve: Nangho nahina tahbeh-u kalval'in phajon kigel hih-un. Nangho tah nakigel nauva Pathen in tahsan eipeh dung juiyun ahibepchan kigel'un.
en: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.
text:
ROM 12:3
Thadou: Pathen in chanpha le thuneina eipeh jal a hiche thua hi kahilchah nahiuve: Nangho nahina tahbeh-u kalval'in phajon kigel hih-un. Nangho tah nakigel nauva Pathen in tahsan eipeh dung juiyun ahibepchan kigel'un.
English: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

tcz: Itahsauvin tibah tampi anei cheh in chule tibah khatcheh in panna aneicheh-un ahi.
en: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,
text:
ROM 12:4
Thadou: Itahsauvin tibah tampi anei cheh in chule tibah khatcheh in panna aneicheh-un ahi.
English: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

tcz: Hitobangma chun Christa tipum jong chutima ahi. Eiho tipum khat chung'a tibah tampi ihiu ahin, chule eiho ibonchauva khat cheh hi khat tibah ihiu ahi.
en: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,
text:
ROM 12:5
Thadou: Hitobangma chun Christa tipum jong chutima ahi. Eiho tipum khat chung'a tibah tampi ihiu ahin, chule eiho ibonchauva khat cheh hi khat tibah ihiu ahi.
English: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

tcz: Alungsetna'a Pathen in thilpeh jatchom chom cheh eipeh-u ahin, hichu phatah a iboltheina dingu ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen in gao thusei theina napeh a ahileh, Pathen in napeh tahsan nanei dungjuiyin seijin.
en: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh nachan chu midang kithopina dinga ahileh, phatah in kithopinan bol'in. Nangma mihil'a napanleh, phatah in hil'in.
en: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh nachan chu midang tilkhouna ahileh, tilkhouvin; hongphalna lama thilpeh nachan ahileh hongphal tah in pedoh in. Pathen in lamkai hina boltheina napeh leh, namopohna chu gelkhohna neijin. Chule nangma milungset themna thilpeh nachan'a ahileh kipah tah in bol'in.
en: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
text:
ROM 12:8
Thadou: Lhagao thilpeh nachan chu midang tilkhouna ahileh, tilkhouvin; hongphalna lama thilpeh nachan ahileh hongphal tah in pedoh in. Pathen in lamkai hina boltheina napeh leh, namopohna chu gelkhohna neijin. Chule nangma milungset themna thilpeh nachan'a ahileh kipah tah in bol'in.
English: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

tcz: Midang chu angailu tobang bep'in umhih'un, ngailutahbeh uvin. Adihlou chu thetbol'un, thutah chu kolchah kheh-un.
en: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
text:
ROM 12:9
Thadou: Midang chu angailu tobang bep'in umhih'un, ngailutahbeh uvin. Adihlou chu thetbol'un, thutah chu kolchah kheh-un.
English: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

tcz: Nangho khat le khat kingailutna dihtah in kihepito them'un, chule khat le khat kijabolna thanop piuvin.
en: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,
text:
ROM 12:10
Thadou: Nangho khat le khat kingailutna dihtah in kihepito them'un, chule khat le khat kijabolna thanop piuvin.
English: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

tcz: Thase hihbeh un, ahin natoh ponthouvin chule Pakai kinbol chu thanopnan neiyun.
en: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,
text:
ROM 12:11
Thadou: Thase hihbeh un, ahin natoh ponthouvin chule Pakai kinbol chu thanopnan neiyun.
English: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

tcz: Ama a ikinepnauva kipah thanom'un. Hahsatna a thoh hat-un, chule taojom jing'un.
en: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
text:
ROM 12:12
Thadou: Ama a ikinepnauva kipah thanom'un. Hahsatna a thoh hat-un, chule taojom jing'un.
English: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

tcz: Pathen mite ngaichatna a kithopina neiyun. Jindot them dan kichuh jinguvin.
en: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.
text:
ROM 12:13
Thadou: Pathen mite ngaichatna a kithopina neiyun. Jindot them dan kichuh jinguvin.
English: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

tcz: Nabolse teu chu phattheiboh un. Amaho chu gaosap hih un, Pathen in phatthei abohna dingin taopeh un.
en: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
text:
ROM 12:14
Thadou: Nabolse teu chu phattheiboh un. Amaho chu gaosap hih un, Pathen in phatthei abohna dingin taopeh un.
English: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

tcz: Akipahho kipapiuvin, chule akap ho kapiuvin.
en: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
text:
ROM 12:15
Thadou: Akipahho kipapiuvin, chule akap ho kapiuvin.
English: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

tcz: Khat le khat kitoh del'in cheng khomun. Milham hotoh kiloikhomna neina dinga kiletsah hoitho bolhih un. Chule ijakai hesoh keiyin kigel hih un.
en: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.
text:
ROM 12:16
Thadou: Khat le khat kitoh del'in cheng khomun. Milham hotoh kiloikhomna neina dinga kiletsah hoitho bolhih un. Chule ijakai hesoh keiyin kigel hih un.
English: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

tcz: Miphalou chu aphalou cheh a lethuh hih un, nangho ja umtah nahiu chu mijousen amuna dingin bolun.
en: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.
text:
ROM 12:17
Thadou: Miphalou chu aphalou cheh a lethuh hih un, nangho ja umtah nahiu chu mijousen amuna dingin bolun.
English: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

tcz: Nabol jouseu chu amichang cheh to kichamna dingin bol'un.
en: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
text:
ROM 12:18
Thadou: Nabol jouseu chu amichang cheh to kichamna dingin bol'un.
English: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

tcz: Gol lepaite, phuba lah bol hih'un, Pathen dihtah lung hanna chu otdoh jouvin. Ajehchu Pathen thubu in, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu lethuh nange” ati.
en: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”
text:
ROM 12:19
Thadou: Gol lepaite, phuba lah bol hih'un, Pathen dihtah lung hanna chu otdoh jouvin. Ajehchu Pathen thubu in, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman amaho chu lethuh nange” ati.
English: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

tcz: Chusangin, “Namelmateu chu agil akelleh vahva set-un, amaho adang'u achah leh adon ding peuvin. Hitia chu naboluva ahileh alujanguva mei-am setkhompeh nahi dingu ahi.”
en: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”
text:
ROM 12:20
Thadou: Chusangin, “Namelmateu chu agil akelleh vahva set-un, amaho adang'u achah leh adon ding peuvin. Hitia chu naboluva ahileh alujanguva mei-am setkhompeh nahi dingu ahi.”
English: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

tcz: Setna chun najou hih uhen, hinla setna chu thilpha in jou jouvin.
en: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
text:
ROM 12:21
Thadou: Setna chun najou hih uhen, hinla setna chu thilpha in jou jouvin.
English: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

tcz: Amitakip thunei vaipo ho thua nungtei diudol ahi. Ajehchu thuneina jouse hi Pathen'a kon ahin, chule thuneina panmun hoa Pathen'in amaho apansah ahi.
en: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.
text:
ROM 13:1
Thadou: Amitakip thunei vaipo ho thua nungtei diudol ahi. Ajehchu thuneina jouse hi Pathen'a kon ahin, chule thuneina panmun hoa Pathen'in amaho apansah ahi.
English: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

tcz: Hijeh a chu koi hijongleh athuneiho douva chu Pathen tohgonsa douva ahiuvin, chutia chu gimbolna ama hon akimu dingu ahi.
en: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.
text:
ROM 13:2
Thadou: Hijeh a chu koi hijongleh athuneiho douva chu Pathen tohgonsa douva ahiuvin, chutia chu gimbolna ama hon akimu dingu ahi.
English: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

tcz: Ajehchu thuneiho khu thilpha bolho dinga kichat ding hilou ahiuve, hinla thilse bolho chunga ding bou ahi. Thuneiho kichalouva na-umnom em? Adih chu bol'in, chuteng amahon najabol dingu ahi.
en: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,
text:
ROM 13:3
Thadou: Ajehchu thuneiho khu thilpha bolho dinga kichat ding hilou ahiuve, hinla thilse bolho chunga ding bou ahi. Thuneiho kichalouva na-umnom em? Adih chu bol'in, chuteng amahon najabol dingu ahi.
English: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

tcz: Thuneiho khu thilpha bol dinga kisol doh Pathen sohte ahiuve. Hinla aphalou nabol'a ahileh kichatna neijon, ajehchu amahon gimbol theina thaneina aneiyu ahi. Amaho chu thilphalou bolho gimbol dinga Pathen in asol ahiuve.
en: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.
text:
ROM 13:4
Thadou: Thuneiho khu thilpha bol dinga kisol doh Pathen sohte ahiuve. Hinla aphalou nabol'a ahileh kichatna neijon, ajehchu amahon gimbol theina thaneina aneiyu ahi. Amaho chu thilphalou bolho gimbol dinga Pathen in asol ahiuve.
English: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

tcz: Hijeh a chu nangho amaho thuneina noija nakipehlut dingu ahi, na-engbollouna ding'u jengseh a bou hilouva, se-le-pha hetna lunggel neitheina dinga jong ahi.
en: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.
text:
ROM 13:5
Thadou: Hijeh a chu nangho amaho thuneina noija nakipehlut dingu ahi, na-engbollouna ding'u jengseh a bou hilouva, se-le-pha hetna lunggel neitheina dinga jong ahi.
English: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

tcz: Hiche jehchun kaisum peuvin, ajehchu Solkal natong ho chun lhalo amudiu dol ahi. Amaho chu atoh nau lamdol'a Pathen lhacha natong hiuva ahi.
en: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.
text:
ROM 13:6
Thadou: Hiche jehchun kaisum peuvin, ajehchu Solkal natong ho chun lhalo amudiu dol ahi. Amaho chu atoh nau lamdol'a Pathen lhacha natong hiuva ahi.
English: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

tcz: Nangman bat nanei chu sadoh in. Nanghon Solkal kaisum dongho peuvin, chule thunei vaihom ho jabolna peuvin.
en: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
text:
ROM 13:7
Thadou: Nangman bat nanei chu sadoh in. Nanghon Solkal kaisum dongho peuvin, chule thunei vaihom ho jabolna peuvin.
English: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

tcz: Khat le khat kingailut tona tailouvin koimacha koma bat neihih un. Nangman naheng nakom chu nangailut a ahileh Pathen Dan thupeh in angeh chu nasuh bulhit ding ahi.
en: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
text:
ROM 13:8
Thadou: Khat le khat kingailut tona tailouvin koimacha koma bat neihih un. Nangman naheng nakom chu nangailut a ahileh Pathen Dan thupeh in angeh chu nasuh bulhit ding ahi.
English: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

tcz: Ajehchu thupeh chun, “Nanghon jou sei hih un, nang hon tolthat hih un, nangho gucha hih un, nanghon mi nei thangset bol hih'un” ati ahi. Hichengse chule hitobang adangho chu hiche thupeh khat, “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun” ti hin akaigom soh'e.
en: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
text:
ROM 13:9
Thadou: Ajehchu thupeh chun, “Nanghon jou sei hih un, nang hon tolthat hih un, nangho gucha hih un, nanghon mi nei thangset bol hih'un” ati ahi. Hichengse chule hitobang adangho chu hiche thupeh khat, “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun” ti hin akaigom soh'e.
English: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

tcz: Ngailutna hin midang alam louvin abolpoi, hijeh chun ngailut hi Pathen Danthu suhbulhitna ahi.
en: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.
text:
ROM 13:10
Thadou: Ngailutna hin midang alam louvin abolpoi, hijeh chun ngailut hi Pathen Danthu suhbulhitna ahi.
English: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

tcz: Ajehchu nanghon ichangeiya, phat bei dingkon kinona ding phat hitam ti naheuve. Khangun, ajehchu itahsan masatlai sanguvin tuhin huhhing ichanna dingu ahung naitai.
en: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.
text:
ROM 13:11
Thadou: Ajehchu nanghon ichangeiya, phat bei dingkon kinona ding phat hitam ti naheuve. Khangun, ajehchu itahsan masatlai sanguvin tuhin huhhing ichanna dingu ahung naitai.
English: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

tcz: Jan hi kichai ding kon ahitai, huhdoh a iumna dingu chu hunglhung ding ahitai. Hijehchun, muthim natoh ponsenen tobang chu paidoh un. Chule chonphatna hinkho, khovah galvon chonphatna galvon vah-emsel chu kivon un.
en: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.
text:
ROM 13:12
Thadou: Jan hi kichai ding kon ahitai, huhdoh a iumna dingu chu hunglhung ding ahitai. Hijehchun, muthim natoh ponsenen tobang chu paidoh un. Chule chonphatna hinkho, khovah galvon chonphatna galvon vah-emsel chu kivon un.
English: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho sunlai mi ihiuvin, mi jousen eimu theina dinguva kitup keicha hinkho iman dingu ahije. Muthim natohna ngolpithei kikhop khomna hoa jaolouvin, chule jukham jonthanhoina hinkho ahilouleh kinahna le kimit thipna hoa jaohih-un.
en: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.
text:
ROM 13:13
Thadou: Ajehchu eiho sunlai mi ihiuvin, mi jousen eimu theina dinguva kitup keicha hinkho iman dingu ahije. Muthim natohna ngolpithei kikhop khomna hoa jaolouvin, chule jukham jonthanhoina hinkho ahilouleh kinahna le kimit thipna hoa jaohih-un.
English: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

tcz: Chusangin, Pakai Yeshua Christa to hinkho mankhomna chu kivon'un. Chule nangho tahsa ngaichat suhbulhit nomna lunggel phalou ho a chun kipelut hih-un.
en: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
text:
ROM 13:14
Thadou: Chusangin, Pakai Yeshua Christa to hinkho mankhomna chu kivon'un. Chule nangho tahsa ngaichat suhbulhit nomna lunggel phalou ho a chun kipelut hih-un.
English: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

tcz: Tahsanna'a lhasam midang tahsan chanpi khat chu sanguvin, chule alunggel dih hen, dih hih jongleh kinelpi hih un.
en: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
text:
ROM 14:1
Thadou: Tahsanna'a lhasam midang tahsan chanpi khat chu sanguvin, chule alunggel dih hen, dih hih jongleh kinelpi hih un.
English: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

tcz: Vetsahnan, mikhat'in ipi hijongleh nehthei ahi tin gel'in te. Hinla tahsan cha adang khat chun se le pha hetna alunggel thua anun jeh chun anche hing bou nen te.
en: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
text:
ROM 14:2
Thadou: Vetsahnan, mikhat'in ipi hijongleh nehthei ahi tin gel'in te. Hinla tahsan cha adang khat chun se le pha hetna alunggel thua anun jeh chun anche hing bou nen te.
English: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

tcz: Ipi hita jongleh nehthei ahi tiho chun anelou ho chu musit dauhen, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu alah cheh-u ahiye.
en: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.
text:
ROM 14:3
Thadou: Ipi hita jongleh nehthei ahi tiho chun anelou ho chu musit dauhen, ajehchu Pathen in amaho chu alah cheh-u ahiye.
English: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

tcz: Nang koi nahi a midang sohho themmo nachan thei ding ham? Amaho apakai pauvin adindohna diu hihen, alhuhkamna diu hijongleh athu hintan nante. Chule Pakai panpina jal'a, amaho dingdet uva chule apachatna changdiu ahi.
en: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.
text:
ROM 14:4
Thadou: Nang koi nahi a midang sohho themmo nachan thei ding ham? Amaho apakai pauvin adindohna diu hihen, alhuhkamna diu hijongleh athu hintan nante. Chule Pakai panpina jal'a, amaho dingdet uva chule apachatna changdiu ahi.
English: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

tcz: Chutima chun, mi koihamkhat chun nikho khat chu nikho dang sanga theng jon koiyintin, michom dang ho vang'in nikho jouse kibang in gelunte. Nangho khat cheh in ipi nikho hijongleh nalhen'u chu lahthei ding dol hijeng ah ahi.
en: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
text:
ROM 14:5
Thadou: Chutima chun, mi koihamkhat chun nikho khat chu nikho dang sanga theng jon koiyintin, michom dang ho vang'in nikho jouse kibang in gelunte. Nangho khat cheh in ipi nikho hijongleh nalhen'u chu lahthei ding dol hijeng ah ahi.
English: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

tcz: Nikho jatchom beh khat Pakai houna a mangho chun Ama jana a achutiman'u ahi. Ipipen anneh hijongleh nea chun Pakai jabolna'a aneh ahi, ajehchu amahon aneh masanguva Pathen athangvah-u ahitai. Chule abangloi khat chun anneh anehlou loi umsah unte; ahin amaho jong chun Pakai alunglhai nomjeh uva abol'u ahin, Pathen athangvah nau ahi.
en: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.
text:
ROM 14:6
Thadou: Nikho jatchom beh khat Pakai houna a mangho chun Ama jana a achutiman'u ahi. Ipipen anneh hijongleh nea chun Pakai jabolna'a aneh ahi, ajehchu amahon aneh masanguva Pathen athangvah-u ahitai. Chule abangloi khat chun anneh anehlou loi umsah unte; ahin amaho jong chun Pakai alunglhai nomjeh uva abol'u ahin, Pathen athangvah nau ahi.
English: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho eima ho chang dinga hinga ihi pouvin, ahilouleh eiho chang dinga thi ding ihipouve.
en: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
text:
ROM 14:7
Thadou: Ajehchu eiho eima ho chang dinga hinga ihi pouvin, ahilouleh eiho chang dinga thi ding ihipouve.
English: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

tcz: Ahin, ihinuleh Pakai jabolna'a hin ding, chule ithi uva ahi jongleh Pakai jabolna a thi ding ahi. Hijeh chun eiho hingu hitin, ahilouleh thi jongleu hen, Pakaiya ihiuve.
en: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
text:
ROM 14:8
Thadou: Ahin, ihinuleh Pakai jabolna'a hin ding, chule ithi uva ahi jongleh Pakai jabolna a thi ding ahi. Hijeh chun eiho hingu hitin, ahilouleh thi jongleu hen, Pakaiya ihiuve.
English: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Christa chu ahing nalaiho leh athisaho Pakai ahi theina dinga khatvei ana thia chule thoudoh kit ahi.
en: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
text:
ROM 14:9
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Christa chu ahing nalaiho leh athisaho Pakai ahi theina dinga khatvei ana thia chule thoudoh kit ahi.
English: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

tcz: Hijehchun, ipi atileh nangman tahsanna neimikhat chu themmo nachan thei ham? Ipi jeh a tahsanna nei mikhat chu namusit ham? Eiho ibonchauva Pathen thutanna anga ding ding ihicheh uve tihi geldoh in.
en: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
text:
ROM 14:10
Thadou: Hijehchun, ipi atileh nangman tahsanna neimikhat chu themmo nachan thei ham? Ipi jeh a tahsanna nei mikhat chu namusit ham? Eiho ibonchauva Pathen thutanna anga ding ding ihicheh uve tihi geldoh in.
English: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Pakaiyin kahinna a kahahsel ahi. Khup jouse Ka-angsunga hung dilsu cheh dingu, chule lei jousen Pakai aphondoh uva chule avahchoi dingu ahi,” ati.
en: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”
text:
ROM 14:11
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Pakaiyin kahinna a kahahsel ahi. Khup jouse Ka-angsunga hung dilsu cheh dingu, chule lei jousen Pakai aphondoh uva chule avahchoi dingu ahi,” ati.
English: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

tcz: Henge, eiho khatcheh in eima chung chang thu Pathen koma iphon cheh dingu ahi.
en: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.
text:
ROM 14:12
Thadou: Henge, eiho khatcheh in eima chung chang thu Pathen koma iphon cheh dingu ahi.
English: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

tcz: Hijeh chun khat le khat ki-oimotona neitapou hite. Hisang chun tahsan kibahpi michomkhat kipalna le lhuhna neisah pouhite.
en: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.
text:
ROM 14:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun khat le khat ki-oimotona neitapou hite. Hisang chun tahsan kibahpi michomkhat kipalna le lhuhna neisah pouhite.
English: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

tcz: Keiman Pakai Yeshua thuneina le hetkhenna kanei jal'in ipi hitaleh hiche neh ding dol chu neh aphatmona kaum sahpoi. Hinlah mikhat touvin hichu aphapoi ti atahsan'a ahileh ama dinga chu phamoa ahi.
en: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
text:
ROM 14:14
Thadou: Keiman Pakai Yeshua thuneina le hetkhenna kanei jal'in ipi hitaleh hiche neh ding dol chu neh aphatmona kaum sahpoi. Hinlah mikhat touvin hichu aphapoi ti atahsan'a ahileh ama dinga chu phamoa ahi.
English: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

tcz: Chule sopi khat chu nangma anneh jeh a alunglhah a, hichu nangman naneh teitei leh, ngailutna neiya chon nahilou ahitai. Nathil neh jeh chun a-dinga Christa thisa khat chu sumang go hih in.
en: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.
text:
ROM 14:15
Thadou: Chule sopi khat chu nangma anneh jeh a alunglhah a, hichu nangman naneh teitei leh, ngailutna neiya chon nahilou ahitai. Nathil neh jeh chun a-dinga Christa thisa khat chu sumang go hih in.
English: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

tcz: Chujongleh nangman pha dinga natahsan chung changa koiman nagel hoimo taponte.
en: Then don’t let your good be slandered,
text:
ROM 14:16
Thadou: Chujongleh nangman pha dinga natahsan chung changa koiman nagel hoimo taponte.
English: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu neh le don thujengbou hipontin, chusang a phatna le cham-lungmonna, chule Lhagaothenga kipana hinkho man'a joh hiding ahi.
en: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
text:
ROM 14:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen Lenggam chu neh le don thujengbou hipontin, chusang a phatna le cham-lungmonna, chule Lhagaothenga kipana hinkho man'a joh hiding ahi.
English: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Hitia lung ngaitoa Christa lhachana toh'a, Pathen lunglhai ding, chule midangin nanatoh chu aphatna aphondoh dingu ahi.
en: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
text:
ROM 14:18
Thadou: Hitia lung ngaitoa Christa lhachana toh'a, Pathen lunglhai ding, chule midangin nanatoh chu aphatna aphondoh dingu ahi.
English: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, houbung sunga kilung hetthemna le khatle khat kisadohtoa umna ding lunggut uhite.
en: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
text:
ROM 14:19
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, houbung sunga kilung hetthemna le khatle khat kisadohtoa umna ding lunggut uhite.
English: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

tcz: Naneh jaljeh in Pathen natoh chu suse hih-un. Geldoh un, an jouse hi nehthei cheh ahi, hinla tahsannei midang khat kipalna ding ahileh, hichu dihlou ahi.
en: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
text:
ROM 14:20
Thadou: Naneh jaljeh in Pathen natoh chu suse hih-un. Geldoh un, an jouse hi nehthei cheh ahi, hinla tahsannei midang khat kipalna ding ahileh, hichu dihlou ahi.
English: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

tcz: Saneh ahilouleh judon ahilouleh imadang bol chun atahsan khat akipalsah ding'a ahileh bollou chu phajoa ahi.
en: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
text:
ROM 14:21
Thadou: Saneh ahilouleh judon ahilouleh imadang bol chun atahsan khat akipalsah ding'a ahileh bollou chu phajoa ahi.
English: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

tcz: Nangman ipi nabol thudol'a ima asetna aumpoi tin tahsan'innate, hinla hichu nangma tahle Pathen kikah thua koiyin. Koi hileh aphai tiagela abolna chunga ki-oimona lungthim neilouho chu anunnom ahiuve.
en: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.
text:
ROM 14:22
Thadou: Nangman ipi nabol thudol'a ima asetna aumpoi tin tahsan'innate, hinla hichu nangma tahle Pathen kikah thua koiyin. Koi hileh aphai tiagela abolna chunga ki-oimona lungthim neilouho chu anunnom ahiuve.
English: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

tcz: Hinlah nangman thilkhat chu nehding ham, hilou ham ti thudol'a lungsa-ihna naneiya, hichun aneh teitei a ahileh achonsea nahitai. Ajehchu nangman natahsan chu najuilou ahi tai. Hijehchun, nangman adihpoi tia nagelkhat chu nabol'a ahileh achonsea nahitai.
en: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
text:
ROM 14:23
Thadou: Hinlah nangman thilkhat chu nehding ham, hilou ham ti thudol'a lungsa-ihna naneiya, hichun aneh teitei a ahileh achonsea nahitai. Ajehchu nangman natahsan chu najuilou ahi tai. Hijehchun, nangman adihpoi tia nagelkhat chu nabol'a ahileh achonsea nahitai.
English: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

tcz: Eiho ahat chengse hin, chang kilung lhaiding hollouva, hicheng thua lunggel lhahsamna neiho chu ikhohsah ding'u ahi.
en: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
text:
ROM 15:1
Thadou: Eiho ahat chengse hin, chang kilung lhaiding hollouva, hicheng thua lunggel lhahsamna neiho chu ikhohsah ding'u ahi.
English: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

tcz: Eiho hin midangho chu adih boldinga ikithopiuva chule amaho chu Pakaiya ikisahdoh sah dingu ahi.
en: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
text:
ROM 15:2
Thadou: Eiho hin midangho chu adih boldinga ikithopiuva chule amaho chu Pakaiya ikisahdoh sah dingu ahi.
English: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa jeng jong ama leh ama kilunglhai ding ana gelkhoh poi. Pathen thubu in asei dungjuiyin, “Vo Pathen, nangma najumso ho jumna chu kachunga ahung chutai,” ati.
en: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
text:
ROM 15:3
Thadou: Ajehchu Christa jeng jong ama leh ama kilunglhai ding ana gelkhoh poi. Pathen thubu in asei dungjuiyin, “Vo Pathen, nangma najumso ho jumna chu kachunga ahung chutai,” ati.
English: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

tcz: Chutobang thuchengho chu Pathen lekhabua ikihilna dinguva masang peh a ana kijihsa ahi. Chule Pathen thubun kinepna eipeuvin chule Pathen thutep ho guilhunna dinga thoh hattah angah dinga ei-tilkhou'u ahi.
en: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
text:
ROM 15:4
Thadou: Chutobang thuchengho chu Pathen lekhabua ikihilna dinguva masang peh a ana kijihsa ahi. Chule Pathen thubun kinepna eipeuvin chule Pathen thutep ho guilhunna dinga thoh hattah angah dinga ei-tilkhou'u ahi.
English: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

tcz: Hiche thohhat le tilkhouna hi, Christa Yeshua nungjui hina ding doltah ahi jal'in, Pathen in nangho khat le khat kilungtona hinkho mangkhom ding'in napanhu tauhen.
en: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,
text:
ROM 15:5
Thadou: Hiche thohhat le tilkhouna hi, Christa Yeshua nungjui hina ding doltah ahi jal'in, Pathen in nangho khat le khat kilungtona hinkho mangkhom ding'in napanhu tauhen.
English: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

tcz: Chutengleh nangho nabon chauva aw khat'a i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chu vahchoiya chule loupina Pathen napeh thei dingu ahi.
en: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
ROM 15:6
Thadou: Chutengleh nangho nabon chauva aw khat'a i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chu vahchoiya chule loupina Pathen napeh thei dingu ahi.
English: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen loupina pehtheina dingin Christan nangho nasan banguvin, nangho jong khatle khat kisangtouvin.
en: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
text:
ROM 15:7
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, Pathen loupina pehtheina dingin Christan nangho nasan banguvin, nangho jong khatle khat kisangtouvin.
English: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

tcz: Christa chu Judah mite henga soh a ahung chu Pathen in apu apateu henga ana thutepsa akitahna chu vetsahna dinga hung ahi, ti geldoh un.
en: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
text:
ROM 15:8
Thadou: Christa chu Judah mite henga soh a ahung chu Pathen in apu apateu henga ana thutepsa akitahna chu vetsahna dinga hung ahi, ti geldoh un.
English: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

tcz: Chidang namdang hon Pathen loupina apeh uva, akhotona chu achunguva alhunna dinga Ama jong hung'ah ahi. Hiche hi Labol pan jong hiti hin anajih-e: “Hiche jeh a hi Keiman nangma chidang namdang ho masanga kavahchoi ding; Namin Vahchoina La ho kasah ding ahi.”
en: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”
text:
ROM 15:9
Thadou: Chidang namdang hon Pathen loupina apeh uva, akhotona chu achunguva alhunna dinga Ama jong hung'ah ahi. Hiche hi Labol pan jong hiti hin anajih-e: “Hiche jeh a hi Keiman nangma chidang namdang ho masanga kavahchoi ding; Namin Vahchoina La ho kasah ding ahi.”
English: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

tcz: Chule munchom khat'a jong hitin akisun e, “Nangho chidang namdang ho, Amitetoh kipah thanom'un.”
en: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”
text:
ROM 15:10
Thadou: Chule munchom khat'a jong hitin akisun e, “Nangho chidang namdang ho, Amitetoh kipah thanom'un.”
English: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

tcz: Chukit jongleh, “Chidang namdang nanghon nabon chauvin Pakai chu vahchoiyun. Nangho vannoi mite jousen Ama vahchoiyun.”
en: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
text:
ROM 15:11
Thadou: Chukit jongleh, “Chidang namdang nanghon nabon chauvin Pakai chu vahchoiyun. Nangho vannoi mite jousen Ama vahchoiyun.”
English: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

tcz: Chule munchom khat'a Isaiah in aseiyin, “David Laltouna a toudingpa chu hung ding chule Aman chidang namdang ho lah a vai apoh ding, amahon Achunga akinepnau angaplhah dingu ahi,” ati.
en: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”
text:
ROM 15:12
Thadou: Chule munchom khat'a Isaiah in aseiyin, “David Laltouna a toudingpa chu hung ding chule Aman chidang namdang ho lah a vai apoh ding, amahon Achunga akinepnau angaplhah dingu ahi,” ati.
English: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

tcz: Keima kataona hi nangho Ama natahsan jal uva, Kinepna Bulpi Pathen chun, kipana le cham-lungmonna kimkeiya nadip dimna dingu hi ahi. Chutengleh nangho Lhagaotheng thahatna jal'a kinepna neiya lung ngamnan nalung'u alodim theina ding kati ahi.
en: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
text:
ROM 15:13
Thadou: Keima kataona hi nangho Ama natahsan jal uva, Kinepna Bulpi Pathen chun, kipana le cham-lungmonna kimkeiya nadip dimna dingu hi ahi. Chutengleh nangho Lhagaotheng thahatna jal'a kinepna neiya lung ngamnan nalung'u alodim theina ding kati ahi.
English: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, nangho phatnaa dimset nahiuve ti kichentah in kahe'e. Nanghon hiche thudol hohi phatah a nahet'u ahitan, nangho khat le khat kihilto theiyanahi tauve.
en: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
text:
ROM 15:14
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, nangho phatnaa dimset nahiuve ti kichentah in kahe'e. Nanghon hiche thudol hohi phatah a nahet'u ahitan, nangho khat le khat kihilto theiyanahi tauve.
English: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

tcz: Ahinah vang'in, hiche thudol phabep hi avel a nageldoh kit theina ding uva lungngam tah-a kahinjih ahi. Hiche hi Pathen mi-hepijal ahipen'e.
en: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,
text:
ROM 15:15
Thadou: Ahinah vang'in, hiche thudol phabep hi avel a nageldoh kit theina ding uva lungngam tah-a kahinjih ahi. Hiche hi Pathen mi-hepijal ahipen'e.
English: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

tcz: Keima hi chidang namdang nangho dinga Christa Yeshua a kona thupole ding'a achombeh-a ei-kilhengdoh ahi. Keiman Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh uhi nangho Pathen'a ding'a santhei doltah a kipetheng sel'a naum uva, Lhagaotheng jal'a suhtheng nahina ding'u ahi.
en: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
text:
ROM 15:16
Thadou: Keima hi chidang namdang nangho dinga Christa Yeshua a kona thupole ding'a achombeh-a ei-kilhengdoh ahi. Keiman Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh uhi nangho Pathen'a ding'a santhei doltah a kipetheng sel'a naum uva, Lhagaotheng jal'a suhtheng nahina ding'u ahi.
English: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Hijehchun keiman Pathen na katohna a Christa Yeshuan keima eimanchah-a aboldoh ho jouse kathanoppi theina hi ajeh uma ahi.
en: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
text:
ROM 15:17
Thadou: Hijehchun keiman Pathen na katohna a Christa Yeshuan keima eimanchah-a aboldoh ho jouse kathanoppi theina hi ajeh uma ahi.
English: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

tcz: Christa in keiya kon'a athil boldohho tilou kisonpi ding imadang kaneipoi, keiman chidang namdang ho henga kathupoh le alah uva kanatoh hi Pathen henga amaho puilut ding kati hi ahi.
en: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
text:
ROM 15:18
Thadou: Christa in keiya kon'a athil boldohho tilou kisonpi ding imadang kaneipoi, keiman chidang namdang ho henga kathupoh le alah uva kanatoh hi Pathen henga amaho puilut ding kati hi ahi.
English: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

tcz: Amaho melchihna le datmo kidangho chule Lhagaotheng thahatna chun alunguva nopna anei sah ahi. Hitia hi keiman Christa Kipana Thuphahi Jerusalema pat Illyricum lampi geiya kapehdoh soh ahitai.
en: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

tcz: Keima lungtup pipen hi midang in houbung aphudohnasa mun ho a che sang a Christa min kiphahpoh louna muna Kipana Thupha ga-seiphong ding hi ahi.
en: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.
text:
ROM 15:20
Thadou: Keima lungtup pipen hi midang in houbung aphudohnasa mun ho a che sang a Christa min kiphahpoh louna muna Kipana Thupha ga-seiphong ding hi ahi.
English: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

tcz: Keiman Pathen thubu'a kisei kahin juipeh chu hitia thu kiseina mun'a, “Ama chung chang thu kiseilouna hon amu diu, chule Ama chung chang thu jakha louhon ahetdoh dingu hi ahi.”
en: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”
text:
ROM 15:21
Thadou: Keiman Pathen thubu'a kisei kahin juipeh chu hitia thu kiseina mun'a, “Ama chung chang thu kiseilouna hon amu diu, chule Ama chung chang thu jakha louhon ahetdoh dingu hi ahi.”
English: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

tcz: Tahbeh mong'in, nangho kavilna dingu khongaisot a kaum hi hiche mun hoa thuseiphonga kana kalson jing jeh ahi.
en: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
text:
ROM 15:22
Thadou: Tahbeh mong'in, nangho kavilna dingu khongaisot a kaum hi hiche mun hoa thuseiphonga kana kalson jing jeh ahi.
English: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

tcz: Hinlah tun, hiche gamkai hoa kon'a hi nangho kahung vilnom ahiye.
en: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
text:
ROM 15:23
Thadou: Hinlah tun, hiche gamkai hoa kon'a hi nangho kahung vilnom ahiye.
English: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

tcz: Keiman Spain kagavil nom'in, kagavil phat le Rome a kahung kibanpa ding ahi. Chule nangho toh kipah tah-a ikiloikhom jouvu phat chomkhat jou tengleh nanghon kakholjinna a ding neigon peh thei ding'u ahi.
en: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
text:
ROM 15:24
Thadou: Keiman Spain kagavil nom'in, kagavil phat le Rome a kahung kibanpa ding ahi. Chule nangho toh kipah tah-a ikiloikhom jouvu phat chomkhat jou tengleh nanghon kakholjinna a ding neigon peh thei ding'u ahi.
English: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

tcz: Hinlah kahung masang'a Jerusalem'a kagachetei ding, chuche mun'achu atahsan ho thilpeh kagapeh ding ahi.
en: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
text:
ROM 15:25
Thadou: Hinlah kahung masang'a Jerusalem'a kagachetei ding, chuche mun'achu atahsan ho thilpeh kagapeh ding ahi.
English: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

tcz: Ajeh chu Mecedonia le Achaia gamhoa um tahsanhon Jerusalem'a tahsan holah-a avaichaho ding neitokhomna lung gutten'a aneiyu ahi ti namu uve.
en: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.
text:
ROM 15:26
Thadou: Ajeh chu Mecedonia le Achaia gamhoa um tahsanhon Jerusalem'a tahsan holah-a avaichaho ding neitokhomna lung gutten'a aneiyu ahi ti namu uve.
English: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

tcz: Amahon hiche abol jeh uhin akipahlheh uve, ajehchu achung'uva bat lentah neiya kigel'u ahi. Chidang namdang hon Kipana Thupha thu'a Lhagao vangbohna hi Jerusalem'a um tahsan hoa kon'a ana kisan'u ahijeh'in, amahon sum-le-pai a akithopi uhi abolthei sun'u dan'in agel uve.
en: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
text:
ROM 15:27
Thadou: Amahon hiche abol jeh uhin akipahlheh uve, ajehchu achung'uva bat lentah neiya kigel'u ahi. Chidang namdang hon Kipana Thupha thu'a Lhagao vangbohna hi Jerusalem'a um tahsan hoa kon'a ana kisan'u ahijeh'in, amahon sum-le-pai a akithopi uhi abolthei sun'u dan'in agel uve.
English: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

tcz: Keiman hiche sum hi kagapeh doh a chule amaho thilphabol hi kaga suh-bulhit teng, keiman Spain lampia kon'a nangho kahung vil ding'u ahi.
en: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
text:
ROM 15:28
Thadou: Keiman hiche sum hi kagapeh doh a chule amaho thilphabol hi kaga suh-bulhit teng, keiman Spain lampia kon'a nangho kahung vil ding'u ahi.
English: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

tcz: Chule keima kahung tengleh Christa in phattheina lhingset chanvou eichansah diu hi kichentah in katahsan'e.
en: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.
text:
ROM 15:29
Thadou: Chule keima kahung tengleh Christa in phattheina lhingset chanvou eichansah diu hi kichentah in katahsan'e.
English: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa min'a kangeh nahiuve, keima toh Pathen heng'a taonaa kithokhom'u hite, chule keima ding in neitaopeh un kati ahi. Hiche hi keima nei-ngailut jaluvin Lhagao Thengthilpeh chun bol'un.
en: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
text:
ROM 15:30
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa min'a kangeh nahiuve, keima toh Pathen heng'a taonaa kithokhom'u hite, chule keima ding in neitaopeh un kati ahi. Hiche hi keima nei-ngailut jaluvin Lhagao Thengthilpeh chun bol'un.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

tcz: Pathen sei ngailou ho Judea gam'a umhoa kon'a huhdoh a kaumna dingin neitaopeh un. Chuche mun'a tahsan neihon sumkitoh khom kapoh hi asan nomna dingun jong taovun.
en: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
text:
ROM 15:31
Thadou: Pathen sei ngailou ho Judea gam'a umhoa kon'a huhdoh a kaumna dingin neitaopeh un. Chuche mun'a tahsan neihon sumkitoh khom kapoh hi asan nomna dingun jong taovun.
English: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

tcz: Chutah le, Pathen lunggot lam ahia kipah thanom tah a naheng'u kahung'a iki tilkhou to theina dingu kati ahi.
en: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
text:
ROM 15:32
Thadou: Chutah le, Pathen lunggot lam ahia kipah thanom tah a naheng'u kahung'a iki tilkhou to theina dingu kati ahi.
English: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

tcz: Chule tuhin chamna leh lungmonna eipeuva Pathen chun nangho jouse na umpi jing tauhen. Amen.
en: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
text:
ROM 15:33
Thadou: Chule tuhin chamna leh lungmonna eipeuva Pathen chun nangho jouse na umpi jing tauhen. Amen.
English: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Keiman Cenchrea Houbunga lhacha natonga pang isopinu-u, Phoebe, seiphatna kapeh ahi.
en: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,
text:
ROM 16:1
Thadou: Keiman Cenchrea Houbunga lhacha natonga pang isopinu-u, Phoebe, seiphatna kapeh ahi.
English: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

tcz: Pathen mite lah a jabol'a kilom in amanu hi ana lemun. Aman ngaichatna aneichan'in kithopina anapeuvin, ajehchu amahi mitampi ana kithopijia, chule adeh'a keima eikithopia ana pang jing ahi.
en: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
text:
ROM 16:2
Thadou: Pathen mite lah a jabol'a kilom in amanu hi ana lemun. Aman ngaichatna aneichan'in kithopina anapeuvin, ajehchu amahi mitampi ana kithopijia, chule adeh'a keima eikithopia ana pang jing ahi.
English: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a lhachana katoh khompi teni Priscilla le Aquila chibai kahinbol e.
en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
text:
ROM 16:3
Thadou: Christa Yeshua a lhachana katoh khompi teni Priscilla le Aquila chibai kahinbol e.
English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

tcz: Tahbeh mongin keima pan huna'a ahinkho lhona hahsatna atolhon ahin, amani chunga hin keigoh hilouvin chidang namdang houbungho jong akipahlheh uve.
en: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
text:
ROM 16:4
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin keima pan huna'a ahinkho lhona hahsatna atolhon ahin, amani chunga hin keigoh hilouvin chidang namdang houbungho jong akipahlheh uve.
English: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

tcz: Chujongleh a-in lhon'a kikhom houbung jong chu chibai kabol'in ahi. Ka golngaitah Epenetus chibaiyun: Ama hi Asia gamkaiya Christa nungjui amasapen ahi.
en: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
text:
ROM 16:5
Thadou: Chujongleh a-in lhon'a kikhom houbung jong chu chibai kabol'in ahi. Ka golngaitah Epenetus chibaiyun: Ama hi Asia gamkaiya Christa nungjui amasapen ahi.
English: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

tcz: Nangho phatchomna dinga natong gima Mary chu kachibai anapeuvin.
en: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
text:
ROM 16:6
Thadou: Nangho phatchomna dinga natong gima Mary chu kachibai anapeuvin.
English: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

tcz: Andronicus le Junia Judah nam mi ka chankhompi, keitoh songkul kalut khompi ho chibai bolun. Amaho hi solchah ho lah a jana sangtah changa ahiuvin, chule keima masanga Christa nung juiya anapang masa ahiuve.
en: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
text:
ROM 16:7
Thadou: Andronicus le Junia Judah nam mi ka chankhompi, keitoh songkul kalut khompi ho chibai bolun. Amaho hi solchah ho lah a jana sangtah changa ahiuvin, chule keima masanga Christa nung juiya anapang masa ahiuve.
English: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

tcz: Ampliatus Pakaiya kagol ngai chibaiyun.
en: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
text:
ROM 16:8
Thadou: Ampliatus Pakaiya kagol ngai chibaiyun.
English: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

tcz: Urbanas Christaa katoh khompiu le kagolngai Starkis chibaiyun.
en: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
text:
ROM 16:9
Thadou: Urbanas Christaa katoh khompiu le kagolngai Starkis chibaiyun.
English: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

tcz: Christa seiphat chang miphatah Apelles chibaiyun chule Aristobulus insung mite kachibai anabolun.
en: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
text:
ROM 16:10
Thadou: Christa seiphat chang miphatah Apelles chibaiyun chule Aristobulus insung mite kachibai anabolun.
English: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

tcz: Herodion, ka Judah chanpi chibai anabolun. Narcissus insung pumpia kona Pakai mite chibaiyun.
en: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
text:
ROM 16:11
Thadou: Herodion, ka Judah chanpi chibai anabolun. Narcissus insung pumpia kona Pakai mite chibaiyun.
English: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

tcz: Tryphena le Tryphosa Pakai natong teni hile Persis amaho Pakaiya dinga tong gimtah a kiseh ho jong hi chibaiyun.
en: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
text:
ROM 16:12
Thadou: Tryphena le Tryphosa Pakai natong teni hile Persis amaho Pakaiya dinga tong gimtah a kiseh ho jong hi chibaiyun.
English: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

tcz: Pakaiyin Amaa dinga achoma alhendoh Rufus chule anu ngaitah, keima dinga jong nua pang chu chibaiyun.
en: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
text:
ROM 16:13
Thadou: Pakaiyin Amaa dinga achoma alhendoh Rufus chule anu ngaitah, keima dinga jong nua pang chu chibaiyun.
English: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

tcz: Asyncritus, Philegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas chule sopite ho amahoto kimuto chengse chibai anapeuvin.
en: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
text:
ROM 16:14
Thadou: Asyncritus, Philegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas chule sopite ho amahoto kimuto chengse chibai anapeuvin.
English: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

tcz: Philologus, Julia, Nareus le asopinu, Olympas chule aumpi mithengte jouse kachibai anapeuvin.
en: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
text:
ROM 16:15
Thadou: Philologus, Julia, Nareus le asopinu, Olympas chule aumpi mithengte jouse kachibai anapeuvin.
English: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

tcz: Christian kingailutna a khat le khat kichibaiyun. Christa Houbung ho jousen chibai nahin boluve.
en: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
text:
ROM 16:16
Thadou: Christian kingailutna a khat le khat kichibaiyun. Christa Houbung ho jousen chibai nahin boluve.
English: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

tcz: Chule tun keiman kangehbe nomu chu, ka sopi deitah teho, kibung khenna le miho tahsan lhahdaisah nangho thu nakihilu akaleh a hilhoa kon'in kichih theiyun. Amahoa kon chun kikangseuvin.
en: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
text:
ROM 16:17
Thadou: Chule tun keiman kangehbe nomu chu, ka sopi deitah teho, kibung khenna le miho tahsan lhahdaisah nangho thu nakihilu akaleh a hilhoa kon'in kichih theiyun. Amahoa kon chun kikangseuvin.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

tcz: Hitobang miho chu Christa lhacha natong hilouva amaho lung deiya natong ahiuve. Thusei them le kam ngeiyin dohan themmona neilou ho alhemlhauvin ahi.
en: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
text:
ROM 16:18
Thadou: Hitobang miho chu Christa lhacha natong hilouva amaho lung deiya natong ahiuve. Thusei them le kam ngeiyin dohan themmona neilou ho alhemlhauvin ahi.
English: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

tcz: Hinlah amitin'in nangho Pakaiya seingai nahiu aheuve. Hiche hin eikipasah lheh e. Keiman nangho thilpha bolnaa nachih uva chule adihlou poupouva kona na kikangse dingu kadeipeh nahiuve.
en: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
text:
ROM 16:19
Thadou: Hinlah amitin'in nangho Pakaiya seingai nahiu aheuve. Hiche hin eikipasah lheh e. Keiman nangho thilpha bolnaa nachih uva chule adihlou poupouva kona na kikangse dingu kadeipeh nahiuve.
English: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

tcz: Pathen'a kon cham-lungmonna chun: Satan hi nakengto noiyuva akoivah ding ahitai. I Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen!
en: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
text:
ROM 16:20
Thadou: Pathen'a kon cham-lungmonna chun: Satan hi nakengto noiyuva akoivah ding ahitai. I Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen!
English: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

tcz: Katoh khompi Timothy in chibai nahinpe uve; chutima chun Lucius, Jason, chule Sosipater, Judah nam mi kachan khompi hon jong chibai nahin boluve.
en: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
text:
ROM 16:21
Thadou: Katoh khompi Timothy in chibai nahinpe uve; chutima chun Lucius, Jason, chule Sosipater, Judah nam mi kachan khompi hon jong chibai nahin boluve.
English: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

tcz: Keima Tertius, hiche lekhathot Paul thalhenga ajih a pang hin, Pakai nungjuiho lah a khat hinan chibai kahin boluve.
en: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
text:
ROM 16:22
Thadou: Keima Tertius, hiche lekhathot Paul thalhenga ajih a pang hin, Pakai nungjuiho lah a khat hinan chibai kahin boluve.
English: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

tcz: Gaius hin chibai nahin peuve. Ama kalhunna pa ahin, chule Houbung pumpi vailhun'a pang ahi. Erastus kiti khopi sumchingpa hin chibai nahin boluve, chule isopiu Quartus in jong chibai naboluve.
en: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.
text:
ROM 16:23
Thadou: Gaius hin chibai nahin peuve. Ama kalhunna pa ahin, chule Houbung pumpi vailhun'a pang ahi. Erastus kiti khopi sumchingpa hin chibai nahin boluve, chule isopiu Quartus in jong chibai naboluve.
English: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa milungsetna chun nabon Chauvin umpiuvin. Amen.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
text:
ROM 16:24
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa milungsetna chun nabon Chauvin umpiuvin. Amen.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen lung cham'a kilhengdoh Yeshua Christa solchah Paul le isopiu Sosthenes a kon ahi.
en: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,
text:
1CO 1:1
