Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen lung cham'a kilhengdoh Yeshua Christa solchah Paul le isopiu Sosthenes a kon ahi.
English: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

tcz: Keiman Pathen houbung Corinth a um nangho Pathen in amithengte hiding a akouho henga kahin sut ahi. Aman Christa Yeshua jal'a athenga nasemu ahi, munjousea Christian ho jouse, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa, amaho le eiho dinga Pakai, min hinkou ho jouse abolna banga.
en: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
text:
1CO 1:2
Thadou: Keiman Pathen houbung Corinth a um nangho Pathen in amithengte hiding a akouho henga kahin sut ahi. Aman Christa Yeshua jal'a athenga nasemu ahi, munjousea Christian ho jouse, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa, amaho le eiho dinga Pakai, min hinkou ho jouse abolna banga.
English: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungset le cham lungmon napeuhen.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
1CO 1:3
Thadou: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungset le cham lungmon napeuhen.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Nangho tua hi Christa Yeshua a nahi jalun chule lungsetna thilpeh napeh jalun keiman ka Pathen chu kathangvah jingin ahi.
en: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,
text:
1CO 1:4
Thadou: Nangho tua hi Christa Yeshua a nahi jalun chule lungsetna thilpeh napeh jalun keiman ka Pathen chu kathangvah jingin ahi.
English: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

tcz: Ama a kona na houbungu hi Pathen in imalam jousea nahaosah u ahin, thusei thepna le hetthemna jouse hi naneiyu ahi.
en: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—
text:
1CO 1:5
Thadou: Ama a kona na houbungu hi Pathen in imalam jousea nahaosah u ahin, thusei thepna le hetthemna jouse hi naneiyu ahi.
English: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

tcz: Hiche hin keiman Christa chung thu kaseipeh uhi adih e ti aphotchen ahi.
en: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—
text:
1CO 1:6
Thadou: Hiche hin keiman Christa chung thu kaseipeh uhi adih e ti aphotchen ahi.
English: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

tcz: Nanghon tua lhagao thilpeh tintang nangaichat hou chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa hungkitna ding kinem'a ngah a nahi jeh uva naneiyu ahitai.
en: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
1CO 1:7
Thadou: Nanghon tua lhagao thilpeh tintang nangaichat hou chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa hungkitna ding kinem'a ngah a nahi jeh uva naneiyu ahitai.
English: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Aman achaina geiya nahatsah uva, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung niteng nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu ahi.
en: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
1CO 1:8
Thadou: Aman achaina geiya nahatsah uva, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung niteng nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu ahi.
English: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Pathen hi tahsan umtah ahina jal'a Aman aboldinga asei chu thonlou hela ahinbol ding ahin, chule Ama chun Achapa Pakai Yeshua a chan neikhom dinga nangeh u ahitai.
en: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
text:
1CO 1:9
Thadou: Pathen hi tahsan umtah ahina jal'a Aman aboldinga asei chu thonlou hela ahinbol ding ahin, chule Ama chun Achapa Pakai Yeshua a chan neikhom dinga nangeh u ahitai.
English: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thuneina'a kangeh nom nau chu nangho khat le khat kilungtoh tah in umun. Houbunga kibung khenna umhih hen. Chusang in lungkhat kisauvin, lunggel le lungtup kithakhat hiuvin.
en: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
text:
1CO 1:10
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thuneina'a kangeh nom nau chu nangho khat le khat kilungtoh tah in umun. Houbunga kibung khenna umhih hen. Chusang in lungkhat kisauvin, lunggel le lungtup kithakhat hiuvin.
English: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

tcz: Ajeh chu kasopi deitahte, Chloe insung mite phabep in kitohmoa naum u thu chu kajah a ahung seiyuve.
en: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.
text:
1CO 1:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu kasopi deitahte, Chloe insung mite phabep in kitohmoa naum u thu chu kajah a ahung seiyuve.
English: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

tcz: Nangho lah a mi phabep in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi,” abangkhat loiyin, “Apollos nung kajuiye,” ahilouleh, “Peter nungjui kahi,” ahilouleh “Christa bou kajui ahi,” natiuvin ahi.
en: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”
text:
1CO 1:12
Thadou: Nangho lah a mi phabep in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi,” abangkhat loiyin, “Apollos nung kajuiye,” ahilouleh, “Peter nungjui kahi,” ahilouleh “Christa bou kajui ahi,” natiuvin ahi.
English: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

tcz: Christa chu loituma achom cheh'a nakhen'u hitam? Keima Paul hi nangho dinga kikhenbeh a kahim? Nalah uva Paul mina baptize kibol naumuvem? Na um hihnauve!
en: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?
text:
1CO 1:13
Thadou: Christa chu loituma achom cheh'a nakhen'u hitam? Keima Paul hi nangho dinga kikhenbeh a kahim? Nalah uva Paul mina baptize kibol naumuvem? Na um hihnauve!
English: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

tcz: Nalah uva Crispus le Gaius tailou khatcha baptize kanabollou jeh in Pathen kathangvah e.
en: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,
text:
1CO 1:14
Thadou: Nalah uva Crispus le Gaius tailou khatcha baptize kanabollou jeh in Pathen kathangvah e.
English: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh tua hi koimachan kamin in baptize einabol'e eititheilou dingu ahitai.
en: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.
text:
1CO 1:15
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh tua hi koimachan kamin in baptize einabol'e eititheilou dingu ahitai.
English: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

tcz: (Oh ahinai, keiman Stephenas insung pumpi jong chu baptize kanabolnai, ahinlah koima dang baptize kabolbe kahepoi).
en: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
text:
1CO 1:16
Thadou: (Oh ahinai, keiman Stephenas insung pumpi jong chu baptize kanabolnai, ahinlah koima dang baptize kabolbe kahepoi).
English: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

tcz: Ajeh chu Christan keima baptize bol le dinga eisol ahipoi, Kipana Thupha seiphongle dinga bou eisol ahi. Christa thingpel chun athaneina aman louna dinga chihna thudol asei kahilou ahi.
en: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.
text:
1CO 1:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Christan keima baptize bol le dinga eisol ahipoi, Kipana Thupha seiphongle dinga bou eisol ahi. Christa thingpel chun athaneina aman louna dinga chihna thudol asei kahilou ahi.
English: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

tcz: Ajeh chu thingpel thuhi mahthahna lam manoho dinga ngol hoitah thu ahi. Hinlah eiho huhhingna chang ho dinga Pathen thahatna ahi.
en: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
text:
1CO 1:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu thingpel thuhi mahthahna lam manoho dinga ngol hoitah thu ahi. Hinlah eiho huhhingna chang ho dinga Pathen thahatna ahi.
English: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

tcz: Pathen Thubun aseima bangin, “Keiman miching ho chihna chu kasuhbei ding, chule milungching chihna chu imacha hilouva kakoi ding ahi” ati.
en: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
text:
1CO 1:19
Thadou: Pathen Thubun aseima bangin, “Keiman miching ho chihna chu kasuhbei ding, chule milungching chihna chu imacha hilouva kakoi ding ahi” ati.
English: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, chihgilna neiho, lekhathem ho, chule vannoi lungthim themnaa minelkal hat ho iti tauvintem? Pathen in hiche vannoi chihna chu angola amu ahibouve.
en: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
text:
1CO 1:20
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, chihgilna neiho, lekhathem ho, chule vannoi lungthim themnaa minelkal hat ho iti tauvintem? Pathen in hiche vannoi chihna chu angola amu ahibouve.
English: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

tcz: Pathen in Achihna a vannoiyin mihem chihnaa Ama ahetdoh lou dingu ahi ti amu jeh a, angol ho thusei banga kathuseiyu hin atahsan ho ahuhhing nadinga amanchah ahi.
en: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.
text:
1CO 1:21
Thadou: Pathen in Achihna a vannoiyin mihem chihnaa Ama ahetdoh lou dingu ahi ti amu jeh a, angol ho thusei banga kathuseiyu hin atahsan ho ahuhhing nadinga amanchah ahi.
English: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

tcz: Van'a kona melchihna thum Judah nam mite dinga hichu ngolthu ahin, chule Greek mite, mihem chihna hol ho, dinga jong ngol thu ahi.
en: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,
text:
1CO 1:22
Thadou: Van'a kona melchihna thum Judah nam mite dinga hichu ngolthu ahin, chule Greek mite, mihem chihna hol ho, dinga jong ngol thu ahi.
English: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

tcz: Hitia hi keihon Christa kikhetbeh thu kaseiyu hi Judah nam mite lunghan kondohna ahunghin chule chidang namdang hon pannabei thu kisei ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
en: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,
text:
1CO 1:23
Thadou: Hitia hi keihon Christa kikhetbeh thu kaseiyu hi Judah nam mite lunghan kondohna ahunghin chule chidang namdang hon pannabei thu kisei ahibouve, atiuvin ahi.
English: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in huhhing dinga akou ho dingin vang, Judah mi hihen chidang namdang hijong leh, Christa chu Pathen thahatna le Pathen chihna ahigel e.
en: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

tcz: Hiche Pathen in ngol tah a tohgon anei hi mihem achingpen tohgon sangin jong achingjon chule Pathen thalhahsamna chu mihem thahatpen sangin jong ahatjo nalaiye.
en: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
text:
1CO 1:25
Thadou: Hiche Pathen in ngol tah a tohgon anei hi mihem achingpen tohgon sangin jong achingjon chule Pathen thalhahsamna chu mihem thahatpen sangin jong ahatjo nalaiye.
English: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho geldohtemun, Pathen in nanakou pet'u chun hiche vannoi lamdol a aching'ah ahilouleh athaneiyah ahilouleh ahaovah naum pouve.
en: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

tcz: Chusangin, vannoiyin angol'a agel ho'u chu Pathen in ching kisaho jachatsahna dinga alhendoh ahi. Chule Aman thaneilou ho jong chu thaneitah a kigel ho jachatsahna'a alhendoh ahi.
en: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
text:
1CO 1:27
Thadou: Chusangin, vannoiyin angol'a agel ho'u chu Pathen in ching kisaho jachatsahna dinga alhendoh ahi. Chule Aman thaneilou ho jong chu thaneitah a kigel ho jachatsahna'a alhendoh ahi.
English: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

tcz: Pathen in hiche vannoiyin anahsahmo ho, imacha louva agel ho, chu alhendoh a, vannoiyin thupitah a agelho imacha hilou sosah dinga manchah dinga alhendoh ahi.
en: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
text:
1CO 1:28
Thadou: Pathen in hiche vannoiyin anahsahmo ho, imacha louva agel ho, chu alhendoh a, vannoiyin thupitah a agelho imacha hilou sosah dinga manchah dinga alhendoh ahi.
English: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

tcz: Akhonna keiya, koimacha Pathen angsunga akiletsah hoitho umlouna ding ahi.
en: that no flesh should boast before God.
text:
1CO 1:29
Thadou: Akhonna keiya, koimacha Pathen angsunga akiletsah hoitho umlouna ding ahi.
English: that no flesh should boast before God.

tcz: Pathen in Christa Yeshua toh nagop khomu ahitai. Iphatchompina ding uva Pathen in chihna tahbeh chu Ama ahisah ahitai. Christan eiho Pathen toh isuhchamu ahitah jeh in, Aman eiho athenga chule athengsel a eisem uva, chule chonset'a kona eilha ongtholu ahitai.
en: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
text:
1CO 1:30
Thadou: Pathen in Christa Yeshua toh nagop khomu ahitai. Iphatchompina ding uva Pathen in chihna tahbeh chu Ama ahisah ahitai. Christan eiho Pathen toh isuhchamu ahitah jeh in, Aman eiho athenga chule athengsel a eisem uva, chule chonset'a kona eilha ongtholu ahitai.
English: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh Pakai chungthua bou kisongin,” ati ahi.
en: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
text:
1CO 1:31
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh Pakai chungthua bou kisongin,” ati ahi.
English: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

tcz: Sopite ho, keima nahenguva kahung masat chun Pathen in guhthima athilgon kasei phongna dingah thugiltah ho le ngainom nom chihguh thusei naho kamangchapoi.
en: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.
text:
1CO 2:1
Thadou: Sopite ho, keima nahenguva kahung masat chun Pathen in guhthima athilgon kasei phongna dingah thugiltah ho le ngainom nom chihguh thusei naho kamangchapoi.
English: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh keima nangho toh kana umkhom pet chun, thildang jouse suhmila, thingpela kikhenbeh Yeshua Christa thubou chu kagel dinga kalunggon ahitai.
en: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
text:
1CO 2:2
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh keima nangho toh kana umkhom pet chun, thildang jouse suhmila, thingpela kikhenbeh Yeshua Christa thubou chu kagel dinga kalunggon ahitai.
English: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

tcz: Thalhomtah in naheng uvah kichageu le kithing pumin kana hungin ahi.
en: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
text:
1CO 2:3
Thadou: Thalhomtah in naheng uvah kichageu le kithing pumin kana hungin ahi.
English: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

tcz: Chule kathupoh le kathu seiphong chu hetbai lamtah ahi. Chingkeo leh ngehtuntun'a thuseina neilouvin Lhagao Theng thahatna bou kana songin ahi.
en: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,
text:
1CO 2:4
Thadou: Chule kathupoh le kathu seiphong chu hetbai lamtah ahi. Chingkeo leh ngehtuntun'a thuseina neilouvin Lhagao Theng thahatna bou kana songin ahi.
English: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

tcz: Hiche kabol hi nanghon mihem chihna chu tahsan louva Pathen thahatna natahsan johna ding'uva kabol ahi.
en: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
text:
1CO 2:5
Thadou: Hiche kabol hi nanghon mihem chihna chu tahsan louva Pathen thahatna natahsan johna ding'uva kabol ahi.
English: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

tcz: Hijongleh keima apilhingsa tahsan ho lah a kaum tengleh, keiman chihna thu panin kaseiyin, hiche vannoiya chihna tobang ahilouleh chomkah louva kisumilji vannoi vaipohoa tobang'in kaseipoi.
en: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
text:
1CO 2:6
Thadou: Hijongleh keima apilhingsa tahsan ho lah a kaum tengleh, keiman chihna thu panin kaseiyin, hiche vannoiya chihna tobang ahilouleh chomkah louva kisumilji vannoi vaipohoa tobang'in kaseipoi.
English: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

tcz: Ahipoi, keihon chihna thu kaseiyu hi Pathen thuguh ana kiselguh chu ahi–akiselguh atil a kiphongdoh khaloulai, vannoi kibulphudoh masanga eiho iloupina diuva atohgon ana umsa chu ahi.
en: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
text:
1CO 2:7
Thadou: Ahipoi, keihon chihna thu kaseiyu hi Pathen thuguh ana kiselguh chu ahi–akiselguh atil a kiphongdoh khaloulai, vannoi kibulphudoh masanga eiho iloupina diuva atohgon ana umsa chu ahi.
English: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

tcz: Hinlah hiche vannoi vaipoten ahethei hihbeh uve, hetaveleu, amahon loupi Pakai chu thingpel a akhetbeh louhel dingu ahi.
en: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
text:
1CO 2:8
Thadou: Hinlah hiche vannoi vaipoten ahethei hihbeh uve, hetaveleu, amahon loupi Pakai chu thingpel a akhetbeh louhel dingu ahi.
English: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

tcz: Hiche chu ahi Pathen lekhabun, “Koima mit nin amulou le koima nakolin ajah khahlou chule koima lunga jong kondoh khalou Pathen in Ama ngailu ho dinga agonsa ahi” tia asei chu.
en: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
text:
1CO 2:9
Thadou: Hiche chu ahi Pathen lekhabun, “Koima mit nin amulou le koima nakolin ajah khahlou chule koima lunga jong kondoh khalou Pathen in Ama ngailu ho dinga agonsa ahi” tia asei chu.
English: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

tcz: Hinlah eiho hengah Pathen in hicheho chu a-Lhagaovin eihil tauvin ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Lhagaovin ijakai akholdoh a chule Pathen thuguhho chu eivetsah u ahitai.
en: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.
text:
1CO 2:10
Thadou: Hinlah eiho hengah Pathen in hicheho chu a-Lhagaovin eihil tauvin ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Lhagaovin ijakai akholdoh a chule Pathen thuguhho chu eivetsah u ahitai.
English: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

tcz: Koiman mikhat lunggel ahepoi, amipa lhagao bouvin akihet ahi, chule koiman Pathen lunggel ahepoi, Pathen Lhagao bouvin ahet ahi.
en: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.
text:
1CO 2:11
Thadou: Koiman mikhat lunggel ahepoi, amipa lhagao bouvin akihet ahi, chule koiman Pathen lunggel ahepoi, Pathen Lhagao bouvin ahet ahi.
English: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

tcz: Chule eihon Pathen Lhagao ikisan tauve (vannoi lhagao ahipoi), hijeh a chu Pathen in manbeiya eipeh u thil kidangtah ho chu ihet theiyu ahi.
en: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.
text:
1CO 2:12
Thadou: Chule eihon Pathen Lhagao ikisan tauve (vannoi lhagao ahipoi), hijeh a chu Pathen in manbeiya eipeh u thil kidangtah ho chu ihet theiyu ahi.
English: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

tcz: Keihon hiche ho kaseipeh uhi, mihem chihna thuchengho mang'ah kahi pouve. Chusangin, Lhagaovin eipeh u thucheng kamang chauve, Lhagao thutah ho chu Lhagao thuchenga kahilchet jiu ahi.
en: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
text:
1CO 2:13
Thadou: Keihon hiche ho kaseipeh uhi, mihem chihna thuchengho mang'ah kahi pouve. Chusangin, Lhagaovin eipeh u thucheng kamang chauve, Lhagao thutah ho chu Lhagao thuchenga kahilchet jiu ahi.
English: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

tcz: Hinlah Lhagao lam gellou ho chun Pathen Lhagaova kona thudih ho chu asangthei pouve. Amahon ngolthua agel jeh uvin ahethei hihbeh uve, ijeh inem itileh lhagao lam gelkhoh ho bouvin Lhagao sei chu ahe theiye.
en: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
text:
1CO 2:14
Thadou: Hinlah Lhagao lam gellou ho chun Pathen Lhagaova kona thudih ho chu asangthei pouve. Amahon ngolthua agel jeh uvin ahethei hihbeh uve, ijeh inem itileh lhagao lam gelkhoh ho bouvin Lhagao sei chu ahe theiye.
English: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

tcz: Lhagao lam gel hon imajouse aman lutdan ageldoh theiyun, hinlah amaho tah chu koiman amanlut dan'u geldohna aneithei pouve.
en: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
text:
1CO 2:15
Thadou: Lhagao lam gel hon imajouse aman lutdan ageldoh theiyun, hinlah amaho tah chu koiman amanlut dan'u geldohna aneithei pouve.
English: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh, “Koiham Pakai lung ngaito hea, koiham Ama hiltheina geiya hetna neiya chu?” Hinlah eihon hicheho jouse hi ihe tauve, ajehchu eihon Christa lunggel chu ihetauve.
en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
text:
1CO 2:16
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh, “Koiham Pakai lung ngaito hea, koiham Ama hiltheina geiya hetna neiya chu?” Hinlah eihon hicheho jouse hi ihe tauve, ajehchu eihon Christa lunggel chu ihetauve.
English: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

tcz: Sopite, keima nangho toh kaum khom pet'in Lhagao miho lah a thusei tobang'in naheng uva thu kasei theipoi. Keiman nangho jah a vannoi mite tobanga thusei ding in ahilouleh Christian hinkhoa chapang neocha ho lah a thuseiya kasei dingin naum uve.
en: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
text:
1CO 3:1
Thadou: Sopite, keima nangho toh kaum khom pet'in Lhagao miho lah a thusei tobang'in naheng uva thu kasei theipoi. Keiman nangho jah a vannoi mite tobanga thusei ding in ahilouleh Christian hinkhoa chapang neocha ho lah a thuseiya kasei dingin naum uve.
English: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

tcz: Keiman nangho bongnoiya kavah uva, an-ham'a kavah lou ding nahiuve, ajehchu nangho ahamjep nehna dingin nahi thei hihlaiyuve.
en: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
text:
1CO 3:2
Thadou: Keiman nangho bongnoiya kavah uva, an-ham'a kavah lou ding nahiuve, ajehchu nangho ahamjep nehna dingin nahi thei hihlaiyuve.
English: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh nangho nachonset nomnau lunggel in nathujo nalaiyuve. Nangho naki thangsetto nalaiyun chule khatle khat kinahle kisaovin naumuve. Hichun nangho nachonset nau lungchangin nathunun nahlaiyu aphotchet hilou ham? Nangho vannoi mite hin'a hingnalai nahi lou u ham?
en: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?
text:
1CO 3:3
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh nangho nachonset nomnau lunggel in nathujo nalaiyuve. Nangho naki thangsetto nalaiyun chule khatle khat kinahle kisaovin naumuve. Hichun nangho nachonset nau lungchangin nathunun nahlaiyu aphotchet hilou ham? Nangho vannoi mite hin'a hingnalai nahi lou u ham?
English: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

tcz: Nangho lah a khat in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi”, atia chule achom dang khat'in, “Keiman Apollos nung kajui ahi” atileh nangho vannoi mite chon'a chon'ah nahiu hilou ham?
en: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?
text:
1CO 3:4
Thadou: Nangho lah a khat in, “Keima Paul nungjui kahi”, atia chule achom dang khat'in, “Keiman Apollos nung kajui ahi” atileh nangho vannoi mite chon'a chon'ah nahiu hilou ham?
English: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

tcz: Adih a sei dingin, Apollos chu koihiya, Paul chu koi ham? Keini hi Kipana Thupha natahsanna ding uva Pathen lhacha natong kahi lhonin, Pakaiyin eingansena lhon toh kitoh a kahil lhon ahi.
en: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
text:
1CO 3:5
Thadou: Adih a sei dingin, Apollos chu koihiya, Paul chu koi ham? Keini hi Kipana Thupha natahsanna ding uva Pathen lhacha natong kahi lhonin, Pakaiyin eingansena lhon toh kitoh a kahil lhon ahi.
English: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

tcz: Keiman nalungsung uva muchi katulut ahin, Apollos chun atwi achap a chule Pathen chu akhansah a pang ahibouve.
en: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
text:
1CO 3:6
Thadou: Keiman nalungsung uva muchi katulut ahin, Apollos chun atwi achap a chule Pathen chu akhansah a pang ahibouve.
English: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

tcz: Koichu aphut'a panga, ahilouleh atwichap koiham ti chu akhohjo dehpoi. Akhohjopen chu Pathen akhansahpa chu ahi.
en: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
text:
1CO 3:7
Thadou: Koichu aphut'a panga, ahilouleh atwichap koiham ti chu akhohjo dehpoi. Akhohjopen chu Pathen akhansahpa chu ahi.
English: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

tcz: Aphut a panga le atwichap'a panga chun lunggon thakhat aneigel lhon ahi. Chule anatoh gut jal lhon'a chu kipaman amu lhon ding ahi.
en: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
text:
1CO 3:8
Thadou: Aphut a panga le atwichap'a panga chun lunggon thakhat aneigel lhon ahi. Chule anatoh gut jal lhon'a chu kipaman amu lhon ding ahi.
English: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh keini Pathen natong kahi lhonin chule nangho Pathen lou nahiuvin, Pathen in nahiuve.
en: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.
text:
1CO 3:9
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh keini Pathen natong kahi lhonin chule nangho Pathen lou nahiuvin, Pathen in nahiuve.
English: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

tcz: Pathen lungsetna kachan jal'a keiman insa themtah tobanga abul kaphudoh ahitai. Tua hi midangin achunga chu asah u ahi. Hinlah hiche khombul chunga sadoh a pangho chun ching theitah a asah dingu ahi.
en: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.
text:
1CO 3:10
Thadou: Pathen lungsetna kachan jal'a keiman insa themtah tobanga abul kaphudoh ahitai. Tua hi midangin achunga chu asah u ahi. Hinlah hiche khombul chunga sadoh a pangho chun ching theitah a asah dingu ahi.
English: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

tcz: Keihon abul kaphudohsau kalval koiman adang phut theilou ding ahiuve, hiche abul chu Yeshua Christa ahi.
en: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.
text:
1CO 3:11
Thadou: Keihon abul kaphudohsau kalval koiman adang phut theilou ding ahiuve, hiche abul chu Yeshua Christa ahi.
English: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche abula saachun amanchah nom nom amanchah thei ahi-Sana, dangka, songmantam, thing, bi ahilouleh pol amanchah thei ahi.
en: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
text:
1CO 3:12
Thadou: Koi hijongleh hiche abula saachun amanchah nom nom amanchah thei ahi-Sana, dangka, songmantam, thing, bi ahilouleh pol amanchah thei ahi.
English: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

tcz: Hinlah thutan nikho lechun itobanga in asah ahi kipatep ding ahi. Mikhat natoh chu ichan'a luaham ti avetsah ding ahi.
en: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.
text:
1CO 3:13
Thadou: Hinlah thutan nikho lechun itobanga in asah ahi kipatep ding ahi. Mikhat natoh chu ichan'a luaham ti avetsah ding ahi.
English: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

tcz: Natoh chu aumdena ahileh, hiche insa achun tohphat man akisan ding ahi.
en: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
text:
1CO 3:14
Thadou: Natoh chu aumdena ahileh, hiche insa achun tohphat man akisan ding ahi.
English: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

tcz: Hinlah natoh chu meiyin akahvam'a ahileh insa'a pang chu haman'a mang ding ahitai. A insa'a chu huhhing hinantin, ahin ama chu meikahna a kona hungsohcha tobang bep hiding ahi.
en: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
text:
1CO 3:15
Thadou: Hinlah natoh chu meiyin akahvam'a ahileh insa'a pang chu haman'a mang ding ahitai. A insa'a chu huhhing hinantin, ahin ama chu meikahna a kona hungsohcha tobang bep hiding ahi.
English: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

tcz: Nangho nabonchauva kigoma Pathen hou-in nahiuva chule Pathen Lhagao chu nanghoa chenga ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
en: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
text:
1CO 3:16
Thadou: Nangho nabonchauva kigoma Pathen hou-in nahiuva chule Pathen Lhagao chu nanghoa chenga ahi chu helou nahiuvem?
English: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

tcz: Koi hileh hiche hou-in sumanga chu Pathen in asuhmang ding ahi. Ajehchu Pathen hou-in chu thenga ahin, chule nangho hiche hou-in chu nahiuve.
en: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.
text:
1CO 3:17
Thadou: Koi hileh hiche hou-in sumanga chu Pathen in asuhmang ding ahi. Ajehchu Pathen hou-in chu thenga ahin, chule nangho hiche hou-in chu nahiuve.
English: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

tcz: Nanghon kijoulhepna kingahdoh uvin. Nangho tulai vannoi leiset lamdola chinga kigel'a nahiuleh chingtah beh nahina ding uva angol nahiu angaiye.
en: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
text:
1CO 3:18
Thadou: Nanghon kijoulhepna kingahdoh uvin. Nangho tulai vannoi leiset lamdola chinga kigel'a nahiuleh chingtah beh nahina ding uva angol nahiu angaiye.
English: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathena dinga angol ahi. Pathen lekhabu thun asei dungjuiya, “Aman michingho chu achihnau thangkol'a a-osah in,”
en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”
text:
1CO 3:19
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh hiche vannoi chihna hi Pathena dinga angol ahi. Pathen lekhabu thun asei dungjuiya, “Aman michingho chu achihnau thangkol'a a-osah in,”
English: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

tcz: chule “Pakaiyin miching ho lunggel ahen, imacha phatchomna umlou ahi ahei” kiti ahi.
en: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”
text:
1CO 3:20
Thadou: chule “Pakaiyin miching ho lunggel ahen, imacha phatchomna umlou ahi ahei” kiti ahi.
English: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

tcz: “Hiti ahijeh chun lamkai mihem khat juijeh in hoitho hih in. Ijeh inem itileh ijakai nanghoa ahi.
en: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,
text:
1CO 3:21
Thadou: “Hiti ahijeh chun lamkai mihem khat juijeh in hoitho hih in. Ijeh inem itileh ijakai nanghoa ahi.
English: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

tcz: Paul ahilouleh Apollos ahilouleh Peter ahilouleh vannoi ahilouleh hinna le thina tua le khonunga ding hijongleh, aboncha nanghoa ahi,
en: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,
text:
1CO 3:22
Thadou: Paul ahilouleh Apollos ahilouleh Peter ahilouleh vannoi ahilouleh hinna le thina tua le khonunga ding hijongleh, aboncha nanghoa ahi,
English: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

tcz: chule nangho Christaa nahiuvin, chule Christa chu Pathena ahi.”
en: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.
text:
1CO 3:23
Thadou: chule nangho Christaa nahiuvin, chule Christa chu Pathena ahi.”
English: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

tcz: Hijeh chun Apollos le keima hi, Pakai lhacha Pathen thuki-imho phongdoh a ngansena changa kahi lhon bouve tin neigel jouvin.
en: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.
text:
1CO 4:1
Thadou: Hijeh chun Apollos le keima hi, Pakai lhacha Pathen thuki-imho phongdoh a ngansena changa kahi lhon bouve tin neigel jouvin.
English: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

tcz: Hichea avetup a ngansena chang michu tahsan umtah mi ahi angaiye.
en: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
text:
1CO 4:2
Thadou: Hichea avetup a ngansena chang michu tahsan umtah mi ahi angaiye.
English: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

tcz: Hinlah keima dingin nanghon ahilouleh mi koiham khat touvin eikholtoh ding chu thilthupin kagelpoi. Keima chung chang thua kakikhol ding jong ahipoi.
en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.
text:
1CO 4:3
Thadou: Hinlah keima dingin nanghon ahilouleh mi koiham khat touvin eikholtoh ding chu thilthupin kagelpoi. Keima chung chang thua kakikhol ding jong ahipoi.
English: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

tcz: Keiman ase le apha kahetna thu akicheh in, hinlah hichu keima kadih monge tina ahipoi. Keima chung thu kholtoh ding le gellhahna nei dinga chu Pakai Amatah ahi.
en: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.
text:
1CO 4:4
Thadou: Keiman ase le apha kahetna thu akicheh in, hinlah hichu keima kadih monge tina ahipoi. Keima chung thu kholtoh ding le gellhahna nei dinga chu Pakai Amatah ahi.
English: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun Pakai ahung phat masangin koima chung thu tanlhah jeng na neihih un. Ajeh chu Aman guhthima muthim lah a ibol jouseu chu vah'a akilahdoh sah ding chule ichan cheh diu ilunggon hou chu ahintah lang ding ahiye. Chuphat leh Pathen in amichang cheh a vahchoina dinga lom ahinauva apehcheh dingu ahi.
en: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.
text:
1CO 4:5
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun Pakai ahung phat masangin koima chung thu tanlhah jeng na neihih un. Ajeh chu Aman guhthima muthim lah a ibol jouseu chu vah'a akilahdoh sah ding chule ichan cheh diu ilunggon hou chu ahintah lang ding ahiye. Chuphat leh Pathen in amichang cheh a vahchoina dinga lom ahinauva apehcheh dingu ahi.
English: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, keiman kaseisa thua hin avetsahnan, keimatah le Apollos to kani lhonin kana hil tauvin ahi. Keiman Pathen Thubua kona kalahdoh a kahinsei chu phatah in lunga ngaitona neileu chun midang mosahna dinga nalam kaiyu khat kiletsah hoithopia naum louhel dingu ahi.
en: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
text:
1CO 4:6
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, keiman kaseisa thua hin avetsahnan, keimatah le Apollos to kani lhonin kana hil tauvin ahi. Keiman Pathen Thubua kona kalahdoh a kahinsei chu phatah in lunga ngaitona neileu chun midang mosahna dinga nalam kaiyu khat kiletsah hoithopia naum louhel dingu ahi.
English: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

tcz: Hitobang loma dinga chu kon thutan theina napeh u hintem? Pathen pehlou ipi naneiyu umem? Chule nanei jouseu chu Pathena kon ahi, iti dana thilpeh chang hilou tobanga kiletsah hoithona neiya nahiu ham?
en: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
text:
1CO 4:7
Thadou: Hitobang loma dinga chu kon thutan theina napeh u hintem? Pathen pehlou ipi naneiyu umem? Chule nanei jouseu chu Pathena kon ahi, iti dana thilpeh chang hilou tobanga kiletsah hoithona neiya nahiu ham?
English: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

tcz: Nanghon na ngaichat chan neiyin nakigelun ahi. Nangho aning lhingin nakigelun ahi. Keiho pang louva Pathen lenggama vaipopa nahiuve! Vaipoa pang hitaleu chun kati lheh in ahi, chutihen lang hileh nangho toh vaipo khom kahi diu ahitai.
en: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
text:
1CO 4:8
Thadou: Nanghon na ngaichat chan neiyin nakigelun ahi. Nangho aning lhingin nakigelun ahi. Keiho pang louva Pathen lenggama vaipopa nahiuve! Vaipoa pang hitaleu chun kati lheh in ahi, chutihen lang hileh nangho toh vaipo khom kahi diu ahitai.
English: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

tcz: Chusangin, Pathen in keiho hi vannoi pumpia miho le vantil ho vetnom hiding a galjo nunga sohchang gal hinga kikai, tha dinga gonsa tobang bep'a solchah a eikoiyu hiding in kagel in ahi.
en: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
text:
1CO 4:9
Thadou: Chusangin, Pathen in keiho hi vannoi pumpia miho le vantil ho vetnom hiding a galjo nunga sohchang gal hinga kikai, tha dinga gonsa tobang bep'a solchah a eikoiyu hiding in kagel in ahi.
English: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

tcz: Christaa kaki lhandoh nau hi angola toh kabang uve, hinlah nangho hi Christa a chingtah in naki seiyun ahi! Keiho hi kalhasamun, hinlah nangho nathanei lheh jengun ahi! Nangho jabol nachang uvin, hinlah keiho hi isahlou tah in eikibol uvin ahi.
en: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.
text:
1CO 4:10
Thadou: Christaa kaki lhandoh nau hi angola toh kabang uve, hinlah nangho hi Christa a chingtah in naki seiyun ahi! Keiho hi kalhasamun, hinlah nangho nathanei lheh jengun ahi! Nangho jabol nachang uvin, hinlah keiho hi isahlou tah in eikibol uvin ahi.
English: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

tcz: Tujeng jong hin keiho gilkel le dangchah thoh in kavahleuvin, chule kitomlumna ding pon jong kanei pouve. Keiho hi eikivo lhoiyun, chule gena in kanei pouve.
en: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
text:
1CO 4:11
Thadou: Tujeng jong hin keiho gilkel le dangchah thoh in kavahleuvin, chule kitomlumna ding pon jong kanei pouve. Keiho hi eikivo lhoiyun, chule gena in kanei pouve.
English: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

tcz: Keihon thachol tah'in kakihinsona ding uvin kakhut tah'un na katong gimun ahi. Eigaosap hou phatthei kaboh uve. Alam louva eibol nauva kakido hat'un ahi.
en: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.
text:
1CO 4:12
Thadou: Keihon thachol tah'in kakihinsona ding uvin kakhut tah'un na katong gimun ahi. Eigaosap hou phatthei kaboh uve. Alam louva eibol nauva kakido hat'un ahi.
English: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

tcz: Keiho chungthua thuse aseinauva lungneng tah'in kataotho uvin ahi. Ahivangin keiho hi vannoiya deimon kaumun, tugei hin paiyin kaum nalaiyui.
en: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
text:
1CO 4:13
Thadou: Keiho chungthua thuse aseinauva lungneng tah'in kataotho uvin ahi. Ahivangin keiho hi vannoiya deimon kaumun, tugei hin paiyin kaum nalaiyui.
English: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

tcz: Keiman hiche kajih hi nangho jachat sahna ding kagon ahipon, ka-it tah chate hina a kahil chah joh'u nahibou uve.
en: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
text:
1CO 4:14
Thadou: Keiman hiche kajih hi nangho jachat sahna ding kagon ahipon, ka-it tah chate hina a kahil chah joh'u nahibou uve.
English: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon Christa thu nahil thei uvah mi sang som nei jongleu chun, nanghon Lhagao lama pa khatbou naneiyu ahi. Ajehchu keiman nangho henga Kipana Thupha kahung seiphong ahitah jeh in nangho dinga keima hi Christa Yeshua a napau kahung hi ahitai.
en: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.
text:
1CO 4:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghon Christa thu nahil thei uvah mi sang som nei jongleu chun, nanghon Lhagao lama pa khatbou naneiyu ahi. Ajehchu keiman nangho henga Kipana Thupha kahung seiphong ahitah jeh in nangho dinga keima hi Christa Yeshua a napau kahung hi ahitai.
English: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun keima umchan thouvin kati ahi.
en: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
text:
1CO 4:16
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun keima umchan thouvin kati ahi.
English: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

tcz: Chule keiman Pakaiya kacha ngaitah le tahsan umtah Timothy hi kahinsol ahitai. Amahin keiman Christa Yeshua chu iti kajui ahi; houbung kachena jouse ho kahilna banga chu nangho avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahiye.
en: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.
text:
1CO 4:17
Thadou: Chule keiman Pakaiya kacha ngaitah le tahsan umtah Timothy hi kahinsol ahitai. Amahin keiman Christa Yeshua chu iti kajui ahi; houbung kachena jouse ho kahilna banga chu nangho avela nagel dohsah kit dingu ahiye.
English: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

tcz: Keiman kahung vil kit tahlou ding gel'a na umjeh uvin, mi phabep nalah uva alouchal naum tauve.
en: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.
text:
1CO 4:18
Thadou: Keiman kahung vil kit tahlou ding gel'a na umjeh uvin, mi phabep nalah uva alouchal naum tauve.
English: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

tcz: Hinlah keima kahunga chule gangtah a Pakaiyin eiphalpeh ahileh hiche kihi sahtah'a thuseiya um hohi atho thu'u hiya ham ahilouleh Pathen thahat nei hiuvem ti kholdoh nange.
en: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
text:
1CO 4:19
Thadou: Hinlah keima kahunga chule gangtah a Pakaiyin eiphalpeh ahileh hiche kihi sahtah'a thuseiya um hohi atho thu'u hiya ham ahilouleh Pathen thahat nei hiuvem ti kholdoh nange.
English: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen lenggam hi thua seitho seh seh chu ahipoi, hichu Pathen thahatna'a hinjoh chu ahiye.
en: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
text:
1CO 4:20
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen lenggam hi thua seitho seh seh chu ahipoi, hichu Pathen thahatna'a hinjoh chu ahiye.
English: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

tcz: Hoijoh nakilhen dingu ham? Keima mol kichoiya gotna pedinga naheng uva kahung ding ham? Ahilouleh ngailutna le lungnenga kahung ding ham?
en: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
text:
1CO 4:21
Thadou: Hoijoh nakilhen dingu ham? Keima mol kichoiya gotna pedinga naheng uva kahung ding ham? Ahilouleh ngailutna le lungnenga kahung ding ham?
English: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

tcz: Nalah uva jon thanhoi bola aume tithu kajah vang'in katahsan tahbeh thei poi. Hitobang hi milim houho jengin jong abolji pouve. Na houbung sung uvah mikhat in anuno toh chonsetna hinkho amanglhon'e ti eikiseipeh in ahi.
en: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.
text:
1CO 5:1
Thadou: Nalah uva jon thanhoi bola aume tithu kajah vang'in katahsan tahbeh thei poi. Hitobang hi milim houho jengin jong abolji pouve. Na houbung sung uvah mikhat in anuno toh chonsetna hinkho amanglhon'e ti eikiseipeh in ahi.
English: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

tcz: Nangho tah nakiletsah uvin, hinlah nangho hi lungkham le jahchatah'a lunghem ding joh nahiuve. Chule hiche mipa chu nakiloikhom nauva kona napaidoh jeng dingu ahi.
en: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.
text:
1CO 5:2
Thadou: Nangho tah nakiletsah uvin, hinlah nangho hi lungkham le jahchatah'a lunghem ding joh nahiuve. Chule hiche mipa chu nakiloikhom nauva kona napaidoh jeng dingu ahi.
English: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

tcz: Keima tah in nangho na umpi hih'u jongleng, Lhagaova keiman kaumpi nahiuve. Chule aum tobang'in, hiche mipa chu achungthu keiman,
en: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.
text:
1CO 5:3
Thadou: Keima tah in nangho na umpi hih'u jongleng, Lhagaova keiman kaumpi nahiuve. Chule aum tobang'in, hiche mipa chu achungthu keiman,
English: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua min'in katanchai tai. Nangho houbung mipi chu nakihou dingu ahi. Keima nangho toh lhagaova kauma chule hitia chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thaneina hiding ahi.
en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
1CO 5:4
Thadou: Pakai Yeshua min'in katanchai tai. Nangho houbung mipi chu nakihou dingu ahi. Keima nangho toh lhagaova kauma chule hitia chu I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thaneina hiding ahi.
English: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Hiche mipa chu nanodoh uva chule atahsa lungngaichat chonna chu suhmanga aumna dinga Satan khut'a napeh doh dingu ahi chule ama chu Pakai hungkile nikho teng huhdoh a aumna ding ahi.
en: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
text:
1CO 5:5
Thadou: Hiche mipa chu nanodoh uva chule atahsa lungngaichat chonna chu suhmanga aumna dinga Satan khut'a napeh doh dingu ahi chule ama chu Pakai hungkile nikho teng huhdoh a aumna ding ahi.
English: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

tcz: Hichung chang thua nahoithonau hi hoisetah ahi. Hiche chonsetna hi chol themcha khat'in changbong kidekot apumchanga amonsah soh tobang hilou ham?
en: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
text:
1CO 5:6
Thadou: Hichung chang thua nahoithonau hi hoisetah ahi. Hiche chonsetna hi chol themcha khat'in changbong kidekot apumchanga amonsah soh tobang hilou ham?
English: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

tcz: Nalah uva konin hiche migiloupa chol tobang chu paidoh un. Chutengleh nangho nahinau monga chu changbong lumthah chol kisolou tobang chu nahi dingu ahi. Christa Kalchuh Kut satha khel'a eiho dinga hung kikatdoh a ahitai.
en: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
text:
1CO 5:7
Thadou: Nalah uva konin hiche migiloupa chol tobang chu paidoh un. Chutengleh nangho nahinau monga chu changbong lumthah chol kisolou tobang chu nahi dingu ahi. Christa Kalchuh Kut satha khel'a eiho dinga hung kikatdoh a ahitai.
English: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

tcz: Hitichun, eihon changlhahlui gitlouna le phatlouna pumin Kut chu bollouvin, ahin changlhah thah mangchan lungdihpun chule thutah'in Golnop chu bolu hite.
en: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
text:
1CO 5:8
Thadou: Hitichun, eihon changlhahlui gitlouna le phatlouna pumin Kut chu bollouvin, ahin changlhah thah mangchan lungdihpun chule thutah'in Golnop chu bolu hite.
English: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

tcz: Masanga nakom uva dinga lekha kahinjih a chu nangho jon lungpua chonse nomjing ho toh kivop hih un tia kanasei peh nahiu ahitai.
en: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

tcz: Hinlah keiman atahsanlouho jonlungpua chonse nom jingho, ahilouleh michipse, ahilouleh miho lhemlha a, semthu milimho hou ho thudol kasei ahipoi. Achuti louva ahileh hiche vannoiya hitobang miho a kona kikangse dia vannoi hi nadalhah diu ngaikha ding ahi.
en: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
text:
1CO 5:10
Thadou: Hinlah keiman atahsanlouho jonlungpua chonse nom jingho, ahilouleh michipse, ahilouleh miho lhemlha a, semthu milimho hou ho thudol kasei ahipoi. Achuti louva ahileh hiche vannoiya hitobang miho a kona kikangse dia vannoi hi nadalhah diu ngaikha ding ahi.
English: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

tcz: Ken kasei hi tahsan cha kahi tia ahia jonlungpua chonse nom jinga, ahilouleh michipse hia, ahilouleh semthu milimho hou ahia, ahilouleh miseisehat ahia, ahilouleh julop ahia, mi dohabol ahia ahileh, hitobanga chon hotoh kivop hih un. Hitobang miho tochun anjong nekhom hih un katina ahi.
en: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.
text:
1CO 5:11
Thadou: Ken kasei hi tahsan cha kahi tia ahia jonlungpua chonse nom jinga, ahilouleh michipse hia, ahilouleh semthu milimho hou ahia, ahilouleh miseisehat ahia, ahilouleh julop ahia, mi dohabol ahia ahileh, hitobanga chon hotoh kivop hih un. Hitobang miho tochun anjong nekhom hih un katina ahi.
English: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

tcz: Polama mi thutan ding kakin ahipoi, hinla houbung sunga uma chonset bol ho chung thu natan diu nakinu ahi.
en: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?
text:
1CO 5:12
Thadou: Polama mi thutan ding kakin ahipoi, hinla houbung sunga uma chonset bol ho chung thu natan diu nakinu ahi.
English: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

tcz: Pathen in polama ho thu atan ding ahi, hinla Pathen thubun aseibangin, “Nalah uva migilou chu paidoh un,” ati.
en: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
text:
1CO 5:13
Thadou: Pathen in polama ho thu atan ding ahi, hinla Pathen thubun aseibangin, “Nalah uva migilou chu paidoh un,” ati.
English: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

tcz: Nangho lah a atahsan khat'in michom atahsan khattoh kinahna aneiya ahileh, itiloma ngam nahiuva atahsan dangho koma suhchet ding golouva, leilam kihehna muna gakiheh a nahiu vem?
en: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
text:
1CO 6:1
Thadou: Nangho lah a atahsan khat'in michom atahsan khattoh kinahna aneiya ahileh, itiloma ngam nahiuva atahsan dangho koma suhchet ding golouva, leilam kihehna muna gakiheh a nahiu vem?
English: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

tcz: Nikhatle vannoi thutan'a ihung pan dingu geldoh louva nahiu vem? Chule vannoi thutan'a napan dingu ahileh, hiche thil neocha hoa hi nangma ho tah in gellhahna naneithei lou u ham?
en: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
text:
1CO 6:2
Thadou: Nikhatle vannoi thutan'a ihung pan dingu geldoh louva nahiu vem? Chule vannoi thutan'a napan dingu ahileh, hiche thil neocha hoa hi nangma ho tah in gellhahna naneithei lou u ham?
English: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

tcz: Vantil ho thu ihintan dingu geldoh loubeh a nahiu vem? Hitia hi nangho tah in tuhinkhoa kinahna chu suhchamna ding nagelthei diu adoltah ahije.
en: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
text:
1CO 6:3
Thadou: Vantil ho thu ihintan dingu geldoh loubeh a nahiu vem? Hitia hi nangho tah in tuhinkhoa kinahna chu suhchamna ding nagelthei diu adoltah ahije.
English: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

tcz: Hitobang thudola dan dung juiya kinahna naneiyuva ahileh itidan'a houbungin ija agelloubeh polam mi thutanho koma chea nahiu vem?
en: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
text:
1CO 6:4
Thadou: Hitobang thudola dan dung juiya kinahna naneiyuva ahileh itidan'a houbungin ija agelloubeh polam mi thutanho koma chea nahiu vem?
English: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

tcz: Hiche keiman kaseihi nangho jachatsahna dinga kati ahi. Hiche chung changa lung gellhah theina pea houbungho jouse lah a jong koima naum lou u hitam?
en: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
text:
1CO 6:5
Thadou: Hiche keiman kaseihi nangho jachatsahna dinga kati ahi. Hiche chung changa lung gellhah theina pea houbungho jouse lah a jong koima naum lou u hitam?
English: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

tcz: Hinlah chutia bollouva, atahsan khat in atahsan michom khat–atahsanlouho masangtah a aheh thei jenghi!
en: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
text:
1CO 6:6
Thadou: Hinlah chutia bollouva, atahsan khat in atahsan michom khat–atahsanlouho masangtah a aheh thei jenghi!
English: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

tcz: Hitobang chan geiya khat'in khat dan pan'a kihehna naneiyuhi nangho kijumsoa nahiuve. Athem moa kahitai tia nanoplhah uva chule hitia chu na ngahdoh jengleu itia ham? Nangmatah chu doha kibol khum joh nahimo uham?
en: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?
text:
1CO 6:7
Thadou: Hitobang chan geiya khat'in khat dan pan'a kihehna naneiyuhi nangho kijumsoa nahiuve. Athem moa kahitai tia nanoplhah uva chule hitia chu na ngahdoh jengleu itia ham? Nangmatah chu doha kibol khum joh nahimo uham?
English: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

tcz: Chusangin, nangho tah thil dihlou bol in napang uvin chule natahsan kibahpiho najoulhep uve.
en: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
text:
1CO 6:8
Thadou: Chusangin, nangho tah thil dihlou bol in napang uvin chule natahsan kibahpiho najoulhep uve.
English: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

tcz: Thil dihlou bol ho chun Pathen Lenggam alo lou dingu ahi ti hi nahetdoh lou u ham? Nangho tah kingolbol hih uvin. Ahinlah jonlungpua chonsenom jing ho, ahilouleh pasal kijoh ho, ahilouleh pasal leh pasal jongho,
en: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
text:
1CO 6:9
Thadou: Thil dihlou bol ho chun Pathen Lenggam alo lou dingu ahi ti hi nahetdoh lou u ham? Nangho tah kingolbol hih uvin. Ahinlah jonlungpua chonsenom jing ho, ahilouleh pasal kijoh ho, ahilouleh pasal leh pasal jongho,
English: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

tcz: ahilouleh aguchaho, ahilouleh michipseho, ahilouleh jukhamho, miseiseho, ahilouleh miduhabol ho hitobang bol michu khatcha jong Pathen Lenggama lutlouhel dingu ahi.
en: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
text:
1CO 6:10
Thadou: ahilouleh aguchaho, ahilouleh michipseho, ahilouleh jukhamho, miseiseho, ahilouleh miduhabol ho hitobang bol michu khatcha jong Pathen Lenggama lutlouhel dingu ahi.
English: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Nangho lah a phabep hitobang chu nana hiuve. Hinla tua hi nangho angima nahi tauvin, athenga kisem nahi tauvin, Pakai Yeshua Christa min pan'a chule Lhagao Theng jal'a Pathen to kilunglhaiya nahi tauve.
en: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.
text:
1CO 6:11
Thadou: Nangho lah a phabep hitobang chu nana hiuve. Hinla tua hi nangho angima nahi tauvin, athenga kisem nahi tauvin, Pakai Yeshua Christa min pan'a chule Lhagao Theng jal'a Pathen to kilunglhaiya nahi tauve.
English: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

tcz: Nanghon, “Keiman ipi hijongleh kabol theina dinga eiki phatsah peh ahi,” natiuve-hinlah nangho dingin imajouse aphadeh a ahipoi. Chule ipi hijongleh keiman kabol thei dingin eikiphatsah jongleh imacha soh in pang hih inge.
en: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
text:
1CO 6:12
Thadou: Nanghon, “Keiman ipi hijongleh kabol theina dinga eiki phatsah peh ahi,” natiuve-hinlah nangho dingin imajouse aphadeh a ahipoi. Chule ipi hijongleh keiman kabol thei dingin eikiphatsah jongleh imacha soh in pang hih inge.
English: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

tcz: Nanghon, “Anhi gilpi dinga chule gilpi hi an dinga kisema ahi,” natiuve. (Hichu adih e, hinla Pathen in nikhat leh ania ahin suhmang ding ahi). Hinla nang hon, itahsau hi ihinau jonna le thenlouna dinga kisema ahi nati thei pouve. Akopgoma Pakai dinga kisema ahin, chule Pakaiyin itahsa dingu agelkhoh e.
en: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.
text:
1CO 6:13
Thadou: Nanghon, “Anhi gilpi dinga chule gilpi hi an dinga kisema ahi,” natiuve. (Hichu adih e, hinla Pathen in nikhat leh ania ahin suhmang ding ahi). Hinla nang hon, itahsau hi ihinau jonna le thenlouna dinga kisema ahi nati thei pouve. Akopgoma Pakai dinga kisema ahin, chule Pakaiyin itahsa dingu agelkhoh e.
English: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

tcz: Chule Pathen in athaneina a I Pakaiyu thinaa kona akaithou tobanga itahsau hi akaithou ding ahi.
en: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
text:
1CO 6:14
Thadou: Chule Pathen in athaneina a I Pakaiyu thinaa kona akaithou tobanga itahsau hi akaithou ding ahi.
English: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

tcz: Natahsau chu Christa tibah hitha'a ahitai ti hetahbehlou nahiu vem? Mikhat'in atahsa, Christa tibah chu alah a chule noti toh agop khomtha ding chu angai ham? Angai ahipoi.
en: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!
text:
1CO 6:15
Thadou: Natahsau chu Christa tibah hitha'a ahitai ti hetahbehlou nahiu vem? Mikhat'in atahsa, Christa tibah chu alah a chule noti toh agop khomtha ding chu angai ham? Angai ahipoi.
English: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

tcz: Chule pasal khat chu notinu toh kijopmat henlang hileh, amanu chuto amapa chu tipum khat hitalou ding ham? Ajeh iham itileh Pathen lekhabun, “Anilhon'a chu tipum khat'a kigoma ahitai” ati.
en: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”
text:
1CO 6:16
Thadou: Chule pasal khat chu notinu toh kijopmat henlang hileh, amanu chuto amapa chu tipum khat hitalou ding ham? Ajeh iham itileh Pathen lekhabun, “Anilhon'a chu tipum khat'a kigoma ahitai” ati.
English: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

tcz: Hinlah Pakaiya kijopmat mi chu Ama chutoh lhagao khat ahitai.
en: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.
text:
1CO 6:17
Thadou: Hinlah Pakaiya kijopmat mi chu Ama chutoh lhagao khat ahitai.
English: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

tcz: Jon lungputna chonsetna a konin jamdoh un! Hitobang loma atahsa sukha chonset dang aumpoi. Ajeh iham itileh jon thanhoi lungput hi natahsa douna chonset ahi.
en: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
text:
1CO 6:18
Thadou: Jon lungputna chonsetna a konin jamdoh un! Hitobang loma atahsa sukha chonset dang aumpoi. Ajeh iham itileh jon thanhoi lungput hi natahsa douna chonset ahi.
English: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

tcz: Nasung uva chenga chule Pathen in nangho napeh u natahsau hi Pathen Lhagao Theng chenna Hou-In ahi ti heloubeh nahiu ham? Nangho nangho chang tuma nahi pouve.
en: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
text:
1CO 6:19
Thadou: Nasung uva chenga chule Pathen in nangho napeh u natahsau hi Pathen Lhagao Theng chenna Hou-In ahi ti heloubeh nahiu ham? Nangho nangho chang tuma nahi pouve.
English: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in nangho man tampi apeh a nachoh dohsau ahitai. Hiti ahijeh hin nanghon natahsau Pathen jabolnan peuvin.
en: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
text:
1CO 6:20
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in nangho man tampi apeh a nachoh dohsau ahitai. Hiti ahijeh hin nanghon natahsau Pathen jabolnan peuvin.
English: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

tcz: Tun nalekhathot uva neihin thudoh u thudola, henge, jon thanhoiya kon'a kikangse hi thilpha ahi.
en: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
text:
1CO 7:1
Thadou: Tun nalekhathot uva neihin thudoh u thudola, henge, jon thanhoiya kon'a kikangse hi thilpha ahi.
English: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

tcz: Hinlah hitilom'a jon thanhoina ahat tah jeh hin, pasal in ama amaji kinei cheh henlang, chule numeiyin jong ama ama pasal jin nei cheh uhen.
en: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
text:
1CO 7:2
Thadou: Hinlah hitilom'a jon thanhoina ahat tah jeh hin, pasal in ama amaji kinei cheh henlang, chule numeiyin jong ama ama pasal jin nei cheh uhen.
English: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

tcz: Jipa chun ajinun pasala ngaichat anei chu bulhit peh hen, chule jinu jong chun numeiya ajipa lung ngaichat chu bulhitpeh hen.
en: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
text:
1CO 7:3
Thadou: Jipa chun ajinun pasala ngaichat anei chu bulhit peh hen, chule jinu jong chun numeiya ajipa lung ngaichat chu bulhitpeh hen.
English: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

tcz: Ajinu chun atahsa chunga thuneina chu ajipa pehen, chule ajipa jong chun ajinu chu atahsa chunga thuneina chu pehen.
en: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
text:
1CO 7:4
Thadou: Ajinu chun atahsa chunga thuneina chu ajipa pehen, chule ajipa jong chun ajinu chu atahsa chunga thuneina chu pehen.
English: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

tcz: Nangho naniuva kigel lhahna naneiyuva, nupa hina a kitimat louva uma taona'a kipeh theina dinga khatle khat kingaichat tona phat chomkhat khongai ding tina ahingal louva ahileh, nupa kilung ngaichat tona jahda bol hih un. Nangho kitimlelna neijeh a Satan in nalhep lhah louna dinguva chomkhat jouleh nahung umkhom kittheina dingu kati ahi.
en: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text:
1CO 7:5
Thadou: Nangho naniuva kigel lhahna naneiyuva, nupa hina a kitimat louva uma taona'a kipeh theina dinga khatle khat kingaichat tona phat chomkhat khongai ding tina ahingal louva ahileh, nupa kilung ngaichat tona jahda bol hih un. Nangho kitimlelna neijeh a Satan in nalhep lhah louna dinguva chomkhat jouleh nahung umkhom kittheina dingu kati ahi.
English: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

tcz: Hiche kaseihi gelkhohpehna jeh a bou ahin, thupeh kapeh nahi pouve.
en: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
text:
1CO 7:6
Thadou: Hiche kaseihi gelkhohpehna jeh a bou ahin, thupeh kapeh nahi pouve.
English: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

tcz: Hinlah amichang cheh hi kei tobang'in achangin umcheh leu kati. Hinla amichang cheh hi Pathena kon thilpeh changcheh a ahin, khat ahilouleh achom changa ahiuve.
en: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
text:
1CO 7:7
Thadou: Hinlah amichang cheh hi kei tobang'in achangin umcheh leu kati. Hinla amichang cheh hi Pathena kon thilpeh changcheh a ahin, khat ahilouleh achom changa ahiuve.
English: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

tcz: Hitia hi keiman jineilou laiho le meithai ho jah a kasei ahi-keima tobanga jinei louva umhi phajoa ahi.
en: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
text:
1CO 7:8
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman jineilou laiho le meithai ho jah a kasei ahi-keima tobanga jinei louva umhi phajoa ahi.
English: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

tcz: Hinlah amaho tah akitim joulou diuva ahileh jineijo dingu ahi. Angaicha gunset'a um sanga jinei chu phajoa ahitai.
en: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.
text:
1CO 7:9
Thadou: Hinlah amaho tah akitim joulou diuva ahileh jineijo dingu ahi. Angaicha gunset'a um sanga jinei chu phajoa ahitai.
English: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

tcz: Ahin ajineisaho dingin, keiman thupeh keiya kona hilou Pakaiya kona thupeh chu kaneiye: Jinu khat chun ajipa adalhah lou ding ahiye.
en: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
text:
1CO 7:10
Thadou: Ahin ajineisaho dingin, keiman thupeh keiya kona hilou Pakaiya kona thupeh chu kaneiye: Jinu khat chun ajipa adalhah lou ding ahiye.
English: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

tcz: Hinlah aman ajipa chu adalhah tah a ahileh, amanu chu achangin umjeng hen ahilouleh amapa chuto kihoucham kit hen. Chule ajipa chun ajinu adalhah lou ding ahi.
en: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
text:
1CO 7:11
Thadou: Hinlah aman ajipa chu adalhah tah a ahileh, amanu chu achangin umjeng hen ahilouleh amapa chuto kihoucham kit hen. Chule ajipa chun ajinu adalhah lou ding ahi.
English: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

tcz: Tun nangho adang chengse henga Pakaiya kon hilouvin keiman nakomuva hinsei inge. Christian pasal khat'in atahsanlou numei khat ji-a aneiya chule amanu chu aumdena achenkhompi noma ahileh, apasal chun ajinu chu adalhah lou ding ahi.
en: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
text:
1CO 7:12
Thadou: Tun nangho adang chengse henga Pakaiya kon hilouvin keiman nakomuva hinsei inge. Christian pasal khat'in atahsanlou numei khat ji-a aneiya chule amanu chu aumdena achenkhompi noma ahileh, apasal chun ajinu chu adalhah lou ding ahi.
English: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

tcz: Chule Christian numei khat chun jipa atahsanlou neihenlang chule amapa chun ajinu chu umdenpi nom taleh, amanu chun apasal chu adalhah lou ding ahi.
en: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
text:
1CO 7:13
Thadou: Chule Christian numei khat chun jipa atahsanlou neihenlang chule amapa chun ajinu chu umdenpi nom taleh, amanu chun apasal chu adalhah lou ding ahi.
English: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

tcz: Ajehchu Christian jinua pang chun ajineina chu atheng ahisah ahitai, chule Christian jipa a pang chun ajineina chu atheng ahisah ahitai. Chutilou hileh nachateu chu thenglou diu ahin, hinla tun amaho atheng uve.
en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
text:
1CO 7:14
Thadou: Ajehchu Christian jinua pang chun ajineina chu atheng ahisah ahitai, chule Christian jipa a pang chun ajineina chu atheng ahisah ahitai. Chutilou hileh nachateu chu thenglou diu ahin, hinla tun amaho atheng uve.
English: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

tcz: (Hinlah jipa ahilouleh jinu chu atahsanlou ahia adalhah teitei got leh sol jengin. Hitobang thua hin, Christian ajipa ahilouleh ajinu hijongleh khatjoh chunga amopo tapoi, ajeh chu Pathen in lungmonga khosa dinga nakouvu ahi).
en: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
text:
1CO 7:15
Thadou: (Hinlah jipa ahilouleh jinu chu atahsanlou ahia adalhah teitei got leh sol jengin. Hitobang thua hin, Christian ajipa ahilouleh ajinu hijongleh khatjoh chunga amopo tapoi, ajeh chu Pathen in lungmonga khosa dinga nakouvu ahi).
