English: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

tcz: Numeihon nageldoh diu chu nangho jal'a najipa teu chu huhhing'a naumsah dingu, chule pasal hon jong nangho jal'a najiteu chu huhhing'a naum sahdiu ahi geldoh un.
en: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
text:
1CO 7:16
Thadou: Numeihon nageldoh diu chu nangho jal'a najipa teu chu huhhing'a naumsah dingu, chule pasal hon jong nangho jal'a najiteu chu huhhing'a naum sahdiu ahi geldoh un.
English: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

tcz: Nangho khat cheh hi Pakaiyin nakoinau bangtah a naum dingu ahi, chule Pathen in nakouna masah a chun umcheh un. Hiche hi houbung jouse henga kadan sempeh ahiye.
en: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
text:
1CO 7:17
Thadou: Nangho khat cheh hi Pakaiyin nakoinau bangtah a naum dingu ahi, chule Pathen in nakouna masah a chun umcheh un. Hiche hi houbung jouse henga kadan sempeh ahiye.
English: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

tcz: Avetsahnan, mikhat chu atahsan masanga chep kitan chu akalea heiding ahidehpoi. Chule mikhat chu atahsan pet'a chep kitanlou ahile tununga chep atan ngailou ahi.
en: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
text:
1CO 7:18
Thadou: Avetsahnan, mikhat chu atahsan masanga chep kitan chu akalea heiding ahidehpoi. Chule mikhat chu atahsan pet'a chep kitanlou ahile tununga chep atan ngailou ahi.
English: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

tcz: Ajehchu mikhat chu cheptan hen, tan hih jongleh hiche hin ima ajatchom sahna aumpoi. Athupi pen chu Pathen Thupeh ho jui hi ahi.
en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.
text:
1CO 7:19
Thadou: Ajehchu mikhat chu cheptan hen, tan hih jongleh hiche hin ima ajatchom sahna aumpoi. Athupi pen chu Pathen Thupeh ho jui hi ahi.
English: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

tcz: Ahimongin, nangho khat cheh hi Pathen in nakoupet uva nahi nauva chu naum dingu ahi.
en: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
text:
1CO 7:20
Thadou: Ahimongin, nangho khat cheh hi Pathen in nakoupet uva nahi nauva chu naum dingu ahi.
English: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

tcz: Nangho soh a um nahiuvem? Hichun nalung himosah dauhen, hinlah nanghon ontholna ding phat kijen naneiyuleh, hichu kilah un.
en: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
text:
1CO 7:21
Thadou: Nangho soh a um nahiuvem? Hichun nalung himosah dauhen, hinlah nanghon ontholna ding phat kijen naneiyuleh, hichu kilah un.
English: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

tcz: Chule geldoh un, Pakaiyin nakou pet uva chu soh a um nahiuleh, tua hi Pakaiya chamlhat nahiu ahitai. Chule Pakaiyin nakoupet uva chu chamlhat nahiu leh tua hi Christa a soh nahiu ahitai.
en: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
text:
1CO 7:22
Thadou: Chule geldoh un, Pakaiyin nakou pet uva chu soh a um nahiuleh, tua hi Pakaiya chamlhat nahiu ahitai. Chule Pakaiyin nakoupet uva chu chamlhat nahiu leh tua hi Christa a soh nahiu ahitai.
English: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

tcz: Pathen in nangho dia amantampi apeh ahitai, hijeh chun vannoiyin nasoh chan sah dauhen.
en: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
text:
1CO 7:23
Thadou: Pathen in nangho dia amantampi apeh ahitai, hijeh chun vannoiyin nasoh chan sah dauhen.
English: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

tcz: Sopite nangho khat cheh hi Pathen in nakou masahpet uva nahi nauva chu naum cheh dingu ahi.
en: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
text:
1CO 7:24
Thadou: Sopite nangho khat cheh hi Pathen in nakou masahpet uva nahi nauva chu naum cheh dingu ahi.
English: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

tcz: Tun numei khang dong jineiloulai ho thua neidoh u hi, amaho dingin Pakaiya konin thupeh kamupoi. Hinla Pakaiyin ami lungsetna a tahsan theiya kilom chihna chu eipen, chule hiche nangho toh chan kanei khompi ding nahiuve.
en: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
text:
1CO 7:25
Thadou: Tun numei khang dong jineiloulai ho thua neidoh u hi, amaho dingin Pakaiya konin thupeh kamupoi. Hinla Pakaiyin ami lungsetna a tahsan theiya kilom chihna chu eipen, chule hiche nangho toh chan kanei khompi ding nahiuve.
English: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

tcz: Tupet hahsatna jal'a hi, nahina bang uva naum dingu phapen in kagel'e.
en: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
text:
1CO 7:26
Thadou: Tupet hahsatna jal'a hi, nahina bang uva naum dingu phapen in kagel'e.
English: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

tcz: Nangman jinu nanei leh kikhenpi ding lunggel neihih in. Jinei loulaiya naum leh, jineitei dingin hol hih'in.
en: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
text:
1CO 7:27
Thadou: Nangman jinu nanei leh kikhenpi ding lunggel neihih in. Jinei loulaiya naum leh, jineitei dingin hol hih'in.
English: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

tcz: Hinlah nangin ji chu naneiya ahileh, hichu chonset ahipoi. Chule numei khangdong chun ji aneiya ahileh, hichu chonse ahipoi. Hijeng jongleh, tuphat'a hi jineiho chun boina ato dingu ahi, chule keiman hiche boina thua hi ka ontholsah got nahiuve.
en: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
text:
1CO 7:28
Thadou: Hinlah nangin ji chu naneiya ahileh, hichu chonset ahipoi. Chule numei khangdong chun ji aneiya ahileh, hichu chonse ahipoi. Hijeng jongleh, tuphat'a hi jineiho chun boina ato dingu ahi, chule keiman hiche boina thua hi ka ontholsah got nahiuve.
English: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

tcz: Tun sopite ho, hiche hi kahinsei nome: Phat aumbe nalai hi achom behseh e. Hijeh hin, jinei pasal hon ajineiyu hi akisahboi nau pipen hisah dauhen.
en: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

tcz: Akap ho ahilouleh akipah ho ahilouleh thilcho ho chu akanao ahilouleh akipanau ahilouleh athil neiyuva kipum phumlut dauhen.
en: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

tcz: Vannoi thil mangcha ho chu, chehoa chun kipum ngaplhah dauhen. Ajeh iham itileh hiche vannoi thil hohi ihetma bang uva, hung mangthah ding ahiye.
en: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
text:
1CO 7:31
Thadou: Vannoi thil mangcha ho chu, chehoa chun kipum ngaplhah dauhen. Ajeh iham itileh hiche vannoi thil hohi ihetma bang uva, hung mangthah ding ahiye.
English: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

tcz: Keiman hiche hinkho gelkhohna a kona hi naon thol dingu kadei ahi. Jineilou pasal chun aphat le alunggel chu Pakai iti lunglhaiya, ana iti atoh ding angaito ahi.
en: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

tcz: Hinlah jinei pasal chun leiset'a amopohnaho iti asuhbulhit a chule ajinu iti alunglhai ding ham ti agel ahi.
en: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
text:
1CO 7:33
Thadou: Hinlah jinei pasal chun leiset'a amopohnaho iti asuhbulhit a chule ajinu iti alunglhai ding ham ti agel ahi.
English: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

tcz: Alunglutna kihomkhen'a ahitai. Hitobangma chu jinei talou numei ahilouleh jinei khalou nu chu Pakaiya kipedoh a atahsa le alhagao thengsel'a akoithei ahi. Hinla jineisa numei chu leiset lamdola amopohna agelkhoh a chule ajipa alunglhai got ding ahi.
en: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
text:
1CO 7:34
Thadou: Alunglutna kihomkhen'a ahitai. Hitobangma chu jinei talou numei ahilouleh jinei khalou nu chu Pakaiya kipedoh a atahsa le alhagao thengsel'a akoithei ahi. Hinla jineisa numei chu leiset lamdola amopohna agelkhoh a chule ajipa alunglhai got ding ahi.
English: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

tcz: Hiche kasei hi naphatchomna dingu kati ahin, nangho imacha a jahdana kaneina aumpoi.
en: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
text:
1CO 7:35
Thadou: Hiche kasei hi naphatchomna dingu kati ahin, nangho imacha a jahdana kaneina aumpoi.
English: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

tcz: Hinlah pasal khat'in numei khat kichenpi dinga akiteppia alamlouva bola akigela chule atahsa lung ngaichat'in athujo beh tah a ahileh, aman agon bangin kichenpi jenghen. Hichu chonset ahipoi.
en: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
text:
1CO 7:36
Thadou: Hinlah pasal khat'in numei khat kichenpi dinga akiteppia alamlouva bola akigela chule atahsa lung ngaichat'in athujo beh tah a ahileh, aman agon bangin kichenpi jenghen. Hichu chonset ahipoi.
English: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

tcz: Hinlah ama dettah a apan'a jineilou dinga akigellhah a chule jineina dinga kinona aumdeh louva, chule ama kitim jou dinga akigela ahileh, jinei louva aum nahlai chu apha ahi.
en: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.
text:
1CO 7:37
Thadou: Hinlah ama dettah a apan'a jineilou dinga akigellhah a chule jineina dinga kinona aumdeh louva, chule ama kitim jou dinga akigela ahileh, jinei louva aum nahlai chu apha ahi.
English: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

tcz: Hitichun ajihol kichenpia chun thilpha abol ahi, chule ajinei pailou chun abol phat cheh ahije.
en: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
text:
1CO 7:38
Thadou: Hitichun ajihol kichenpia chun thilpha abol ahi, chule ajinei pailou chun abol phat cheh ahije.
English: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

tcz: Jinu chu ajipa hin laisea ajipa thunoiya uma ahi. Ahin ajipa athia ahileh, aman akichenpi nom nomto kicheng thei ahi, hinla hichu Pakai ngailutna jal hiding ahi.
en: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
text:
1CO 7:39
Thadou: Jinu chu ajipa hin laisea ajipa thunoiya uma ahi. Ahin ajipa athia ahileh, aman akichenpi nom nomto kicheng thei ahi, hinla hichu Pakai ngailutna jal hiding ahi.
English: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

tcz: Hinlah ama dinga jineilouva aum chu phajo ding ahi, chule keiman hiche thu kahinsei hi Pathen Lhagao thumop'a kona seiyin kakigelin ahi.
en: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
text:
1CO 7:40
Thadou: Hinlah ama dinga jineilouva aum chu phajo ding ahi, chule keiman hiche thu kahinsei hi Pathen Lhagao thumop'a kona seiyin kakigelin ahi.
English: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

tcz: Tun milim houna'a kikatdoh anneh thudol seikhom ute. Nanghon nahet nau chamkimtah chu mijousen napompeh diuvin nagel'uve. Hinla hetna hin eiho kihithei sahna eipeh laiyun, ngailutna joh hin Houbung asahdoh ahibouve.
en: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
text:
1CO 8:1
Thadou: Tun milim houna'a kikatdoh anneh thudol seikhom ute. Nanghon nahet nau chamkimtah chu mijousen napompeh diuvin nagel'uve. Hinla hetna hin eiho kihithei sahna eipeh laiyun, ngailutna joh hin Houbung asahdoh ahibouve.
English: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

tcz: Ijakai donbutna hea kingaitoa chun hetna tahbeh aneilou ahi.
en: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
text:
1CO 8:2
Thadou: Ijakai donbutna hea kingaitoa chun hetna tahbeh aneilou ahi.
English: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen ngailu mi chu Pathen in ahetpeh mi hi ahi.
en: But anyone who loves God is known by him.
text:
1CO 8:3
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen ngailu mi chu Pathen in ahetpeh mi hi ahi.
English: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

tcz: Hiti chu ahileh, milim houna'a kikatdoh saneh thu ahil'a itin tem? Aphai, eiho jousen milim hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi, chule Pathen khatseh bou aume ti iheuve.
en: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.
text:
1CO 8:4
Thadou: Hiti chu ahileh, milim houna'a kikatdoh saneh thu ahil'a itin tem? Aphai, eiho jousen milim hi pathen tahbeh ahipoi, chule Pathen khatseh bou aume ti iheuve.
English: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

tcz: Van sunga le lei chunga pathen ho tia kouthei ding uminte, chule mi phabep hon pathen tampi le pakai tampi hou tahbeh uvinte.
en: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—
text:
1CO 8:5
Thadou: Van sunga le lei chunga pathen ho tia kouthei ding uminte, chule mi phabep hon pathen tampi le pakai tampi hou tahbeh uvinte.
English: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

tcz: Hinlah eihon Pa chu Pathen khatseh, ijakai sempa ahin, chule eiho Ama dinga hinga ihiuve ti iheuve. Chule Pakai khatseh bou Yeshua Christa chu ahin, Ama jal'a Pathen in ijakai asema chule Ama jal'a eiho hinna eipeh u ahi.
en: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.
text:
1CO 8:6
Thadou: Hinlah eihon Pa chu Pathen khatseh, ijakai sempa ahin, chule eiho Ama dinga hinga ihiuve ti iheuve. Chule Pakai khatseh bou Yeshua Christa chu ahin, Ama jal'a Pathen in ijakai asema chule Ama jal'a eiho hinna eipeh u ahi.
English: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

tcz: Ahinlah atahsan jousen chehi ahetsoh keiyu ahipoi. Mi phabep chun lim semthu pathen chu atahbeh a angaitouva, hitia chu limsemthu pathena lhatdohsa thil chu aneh tenguleh, pathen tahbeh hou dan'a kigeljiu ahi, chule se le pha ahetkhen nau chu asuboiyin ahi.
en: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.
text:
1CO 8:7
Thadou: Ahinlah atahsan jousen chehi ahetsoh keiyu ahipoi. Mi phabep chun lim semthu pathen chu atahbeh a angaitouva, hitia chu limsemthu pathena lhatdohsa thil chu aneh tenguleh, pathen tahbeh hou dan'a kigeljiu ahi, chule se le pha ahetkhen nau chu asuboiyin ahi.
English: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

tcz: Eihon ithilneh u chun, Pathen lunglhaina sodohsah ponte, ti hi adih e ti iheuve. Hichu inehlouva ahileh ima imansah u aumpon, chule ineh ujongleh ima aphachom imupouve.
en: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.
text:
1CO 8:8
Thadou: Eihon ithilneh u chun, Pathen lunglhaina sodohsah ponte, ti hi adih e ti iheuve. Hichu inehlouva ahileh ima imansah u aumpon, chule ineh ujongleh ima aphachom imupouve.
English: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

tcz: Hinlah eiho ikichihtheina dingu chu, eiho ichamlhat nau chun ase le apha hetna lhasam khat'in kipalna a aneikhah louna ding hi ahi.
en: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.
text:
1CO 8:9
Thadou: Hinlah eiho ikichihtheina dingu chu, eiho ichamlhat nau chun ase le apha hetna lhasam khat'in kipalna a aneikhah louna ding hi ahi.
English: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh midangin nangman hetna sangjo nanei jeh a milim houna in'a naneh chu hung muhenlang hileh, hichun amaho se-le-pha hetna aneiyu chu anahsahmo bola, milim houna a lhatdoh anneh chu aneh tahlou dingu ham?
en: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?
text:
1CO 8:10
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh midangin nangman hetna sangjo nanei jeh a milim houna in'a naneh chu hung muhenlang hileh, hichun amaho se-le-pha hetna aneiyu chu anahsahmo bola, milim houna a lhatdoh anneh chu aneh tahlou dingu ham?
English: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

tcz: Hitia chu nangman hetna chungnungjo nanei jeh a, Christian alhasam khat, ajeh a Christa thi, chu nasuhmang ding ahitai.
en: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
text:
1CO 8:11
Thadou: Hitia chu nangman hetna chungnungjo nanei jeh a, Christian alhasam khat, ajeh a Christa thi, chu nasuhmang ding ahitai.
English: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

tcz: Chule nangman atahsan midang chun adihpoi, tia alung uva atahsan uchu abol ding uva natil khouva ahileh, nangma Christa dounaa chonsea nahitai.
en: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.
text:
1CO 8:12
Thadou: Chule nangman atahsan midang chun adihpoi, tia alung uva atahsan uchu abol ding uva natil khouva ahileh, nangma Christa dounaa chonsea nahitai.
English: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

tcz: Hitia hi keiman ipi ham chu kaneh jeh a atahsan midangin chonsetnaa aneileh, keiman kahin laisen sa kiti neponge, ajeh chu keiman atahsan midang khat chu kakipalsah nompon ahi.
en: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
text:
1CO 8:13
Thadou: Hitia hi keiman ipi ham chu kaneh jeh a atahsan midangin chonsetnaa aneileh, keiman kahin laisen sa kiti neponge, ajeh chu keiman atahsan midang khat chu kakipalsah nompon ahi.
English: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

tcz: Keima midang ho tobanga ongthol hilouva kahim? Keima solchah hilouva kahim? I-Pakaiyu Yeshua chu keiman kamit tah a mulouva kahim? Keima natohnaa kona nangho Pakaiya hung hia nahi lou u ham?
en: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?
text:
1CO 9:1
Thadou: Keima midang ho tobanga ongthol hilouva kahim? Keima solchah hilouva kahim? I-Pakaiyu Yeshua chu keiman kamit tah a mulouva kahim? Keima natohnaa kona nangho Pakaiya hung hia nahi lou u ham?
English: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

tcz: Midangin solchah a eigel louva ahi jongleh nangho ding beh a kahi ahi. Keima hi Pakai solchah kahi aphotchenna nangho nahiuve.
en: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
text:
1CO 9:2
Thadou: Midangin solchah a eigel louva ahi jongleh nangho ding beh a kahi ahi. Keima hi Pakai solchah kahi aphotchenna nangho nahiuve.
English: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

tcz: Kathuneina chung chang thua eidongho kadonbutna hiche hi ahi.
en: My defense to those who examine me is this:
text:
1CO 9:3
Thadou: Kathuneina chung chang thua eidongho kadonbutna hiche hi ahi.
English: My defense to those who examine me is this:

tcz: Keiho na-in uva kachen uva chule na-anneh nauva an kaneh mona diu ipi umem?
en: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
text:
1CO 9:4
Thadou: Keiho na-in uva kachen uva chule na-anneh nauva an kaneh mona diu ipi umem?
English: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

tcz: Solchah dangho tobanga, Pakai sopite ho le Peter in abol tobang uva Christian jinumei kakipui mona diu ipi umem?
en: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
text:
1CO 9:5
Thadou: Solchah dangho tobanga, Pakai sopite ho le Peter in abol tobang uva Christian jinumei kakipui mona diu ipi umem?
English: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

tcz: Ahilouleh Barnabas le keima bou hin kakihinso lhonna dinga na katoh lhon ngaiya ham?
en: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?
text:
1CO 9:6
Thadou: Ahilouleh Barnabas le keima bou hin kakihinso lhonna dinga na katoh lhon ngaiya ham?
English: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

tcz: Ipi sepaiyin ama manchah ding akilotho ngaiyem? Lengpilei bola pang koipen'in alengpiga phabep jong nehtheina ding tha neilouva koi umem? Kelngoi hon chinga panga akelngoi phabep neh ding jong kiphal pehlou koi umem?
en: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?
text:
1CO 9:7
Thadou: Ipi sepaiyin ama manchah ding akilotho ngaiyem? Lengpilei bola pang koipen'in alengpiga phabep jong nehtheina ding tha neilouva koi umem? Kelngoi hon chinga panga akelngoi phabep neh ding jong kiphal pehlou koi umem?
English: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

tcz: Chule hiche hi mihem ngaidan kiphongdoh maimai ahipoi. Pathen Dan in jong hitia chu asei hilou ham?
en: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?
text:
1CO 9:8
Thadou: Chule hiche hi mihem ngaidan kiphongdoh maimai ahipoi. Pathen Dan in jong hitia chu asei hilou ham?
English: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

tcz: Ajehchu Mose Dan in aseiye, “Bongchal'in chang achilpettah a chu anehthei louna dinga amuh nasomlou ding ahi” ati. Pathen in hiche thu aseipet'a chu bongchal ding bou agelkhoh a nagel ham?
en: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,
text:
1CO 9:9
Thadou: Ajehchu Mose Dan in aseiye, “Bongchal'in chang achilpettah a chu anehthei louna dinga amuh nasomlou ding ahi” ati. Pathen in hiche thu aseipet'a chu bongchal ding bou agelkhoh a nagel ham?
English: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

tcz: Aman eiho koma tahbeh a thu aseina hilou ham? Henge, eiho dinga kijih a ahi, hitia chu alou khoiya panga le chang chil'a panga chun, anigel lhona chang ki-atna a chu chan anei lhon ding kinem'a ahi.
en: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
text:
1CO 9:10
Thadou: Aman eiho koma tahbeh a thu aseina hilou ham? Henge, eiho dinga kijih a ahi, hitia chu alou khoiya panga le chang chil'a panga chun, anigel lhona chang ki-atna a chu chan anei lhon ding kinem'a ahi.
English: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

tcz: Kei hon Lhagao muchi nalah uva kahungtu u ahitah jeh chun, tahsalam dola neh le don thua aga kalo mona dingu umem?
en: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?
text:
1CO 9:11
Thadou: Kei hon Lhagao muchi nalah uva kahungtu u ahitah jeh chun, tahsalam dola neh le don thua aga kalo mona dingu umem?
English: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

tcz: Nangho henga thu seiphong ho nakitho piuva ahileh, amaho sanga chu keihon kithopina lenjo kamu diu hilou ham? Hinla keihon hiche chan ding chu kamangcha khapouve. Christa Kipana Thupha daltan'a aumlouna ding phot ahileh ipi hijongleh kapedoh jo uve.
en: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.
text:
1CO 9:12
Thadou: Nangho henga thu seiphong ho nakitho piuva ahileh, amaho sanga chu keihon kithopina lenjo kamu diu hilou ham? Hinla keihon hiche chan ding chu kamangcha khapouve. Christa Kipana Thupha daltan'a aumlouna ding phot ahileh ipi hijongleh kapedoh jo uve.
English: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

tcz: Hou-in'a natong ho khun hou-insunga hung kitohdoh hoa kona neh akimu jiu ahi geldohlou nahiuvem? Chule maichama tohna neiho khun maichama kipedoh thiltohoa khu chan aneiyu ahi.
en: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?
text:
1CO 9:13
Thadou: Hou-in'a natong ho khun hou-insunga hung kitohdoh hoa kona neh akimu jiu ahi geldohlou nahiuvem? Chule maichama tohna neiho khun maichama kipedoh thiltohoa khu chan aneiyu ahi.
English: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

tcz: Hitobangma chu, Kipana Thupha lhangsam ho chu aphatchompi hoa kona kithopina amu dingu ahi.
en: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.
text:
1CO 9:14
Thadou: Hitobangma chu, Kipana Thupha lhangsam ho chu aphatchompi hoa kona kithopina amu dingu ahi.
English: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in keiman hitiho thaneina hi khatcha kamang chapoi. Chule keiman hiche kajih hi tua pat'in keiman mangcha tange tia lunggon neiya kahipoi. Ahimongin, manbeiya Thu seiphongna a kakisonna kathuneina hi abei sangin, thi ding joh kanom'e.
en: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.
text:
1CO 9:15
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in keiman hitiho thaneina hi khatcha kamang chapoi. Chule keiman hiche kajih hi tua pat'in keiman mangcha tange tia lunggon neiya kahipoi. Ahimongin, manbeiya Thu seiphongna a kakisonna kathuneina hi abei sangin, thi ding joh kanom'e.
English: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in Kipana Thupha seiphonga pan hi kiletsahpi thei ahipoi: Pathen in hichehi kabol dinga kacham louva eisolna ahi. Kipana Thupha seiphong louva kaum ding chu keima dinga iti tijat um hitam?
en: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.
text:
1CO 9:16
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in Kipana Thupha seiphonga pan hi kiletsahpi thei ahipoi: Pathen in hichehi kabol dinga kacham louva eisolna ahi. Kipana Thupha seiphong louva kaum ding chu keima dinga iti tijat um hitam?
English: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

tcz: Keiman hiche hi ka kiham bolna a kona kabol ahileh, kalo ding lom muding kahi. Hinla keiman kilhen ding dan kahepoi, ajeh iham itileh Pathen in hiche guhthim ngansena hi eipeh ahije.
en: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.
text:
1CO 9:17
Thadou: Keiman hiche hi ka kiham bolna a kona kabol ahileh, kalo ding lom muding kahi. Hinla keiman kilhen ding dan kahepoi, ajeh iham itileh Pathen in hiche guhthim ngansena hi eipeh ahije.
English: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

tcz: Ahileh ipi ham kalo doh ding chu? Keiman koima imacha ngehlouva Kipana Thupha lhangsapna chanpha kachan hi hiya ahi. Hiti ahijeh a hi keiman kachan dinga lom jong ngeh louva Kipana Thupha kaseiphong ahi.
en: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.
text:
1CO 9:18
Thadou: Ahileh ipi ham kalo doh ding chu? Keiman koima imacha ngehlouva Kipana Thupha lhangsapna chanpha kachan hi hiya ahi. Hiti ahijeh a hi keiman kachan dinga lom jong ngeh louva Kipana Thupha kaseiphong ahi.
English: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

tcz: Keima hi chamlhatna chang koima noiya umhilou kahi jeng vang in, mi tampi Christaa kapuilut theina dinga mijouse soh a kapan ahi.
en: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
text:
1CO 9:19
Thadou: Keima hi chamlhatna chang koima noiya umhilou kahi jeng vang in, mi tampi Christaa kapuilut theina dinga mijouse soh a kapan ahi.
English: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

tcz: Keima Judah te toh kaum khom pet'in, Judah te chu Christa a kapuilut theina dingin, Judah te tobang'in danthu noiya hinkho kamangin ahi.
en: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

tcz: Keima chidang namdang ho, Judah mite chonna juilou hotoh ka umkhom tengleh, keima tah jong chuche dan'a chu hing talouva kaum hi keiman amaho chu Christa a kapuilut theina ding kati ahi. Ahin keima Pathen Danthu chu nahsahmoa kahipoi: Keiman Christa Danthu chu kajuiye.
en: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.
text:
1CO 9:21
Thadou: Keima chidang namdang ho, Judah mite chonna juilou hotoh ka umkhom tengleh, keima tah jong chuche dan'a chu hing talouva kaum hi keiman amaho chu Christa a kapuilut theina ding kati ahi. Ahin keima Pathen Danthu chu nahsahmoa kahipoi: Keiman Christa Danthu chu kajuiye.
English: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

tcz: Keima milhasam hoto kaum khomna a, keiman amaho lhahsamna chu chan kanei khompi ji e, ajeh chu keiman milhachom chu Christa a kapuilut nomin ahi. Henge, keiman mitin toh thakhat hina ding kahole, kajo chana phabep kahuhhing jou teina dinga kati ahi.
en: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
text:
1CO 9:22
Thadou: Keima milhasam hoto kaum khomna a, keiman amaho lhahsamna chu chan kanei khompi ji e, ajeh chu keiman milhachom chu Christa a kapuilut nomin ahi. Henge, keiman mitin toh thakhat hina ding kahole, kajo chana phabep kahuhhing jou teina dinga kati ahi.
English: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

tcz: Keiman kabol chasun hi Kipana Thupha the chan sohna ding kati ahi chule aphattheina kahop doh nom ahi.
en: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.
text:
1CO 9:23
Thadou: Keiman kabol chasun hi Kipana Thupha the chan sohna ding kati ahi chule aphattheina kahop doh nom ahi.
English: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

tcz: Kilhaitetna a khu mitin lhaijia ahi, hinla mi khat in bou kipaman asan ahi. Hiti chun, jona dingin lhaiyun.
en: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.
text:
1CO 9:24
Thadou: Kilhaitetna a khu mitin lhaijia ahi, hinla mi khat in bou kipaman asan ahi. Hiti chun, jona dingin lhaiyun.
English: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

tcz: Golseh a jao ho khu akithem chuh nauva phatah a kithunun na nei ahiuve. Amaho chun akem mangthei kipaman lona a abolu ahin, hinla eihon akem mang theilou ilojoh u ahi.
en: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
text:
1CO 9:25
Thadou: Golseh a jao ho khu akithem chuh nauva phatah a kithunun na nei ahiuve. Amaho chun akem mangthei kipaman lona a abolu ahin, hinla eihon akem mang theilou ilojoh u ahi.
English: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keima ka kalson nachan a hi doi neiya lhai kahin, ale chum'a kahipoi.
en: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,
text:
1CO 9:26
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keima ka kalson nachan a hi doi neiya lhai kahin, ale chum'a kahipoi.
English: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

tcz: Keiman golseh a lhaipa banga kabol ding dol kabol doh jou theina dinga katahsa hi kathunun ahi. Achuti louleh, midang koma thu kasei phong jouva keima tah alhinglou kahi khah ding ahi.
en: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
text:
1CO 9:27
Thadou: Keiman golseh a lhaipa banga kabol ding dol kabol doh jou theina dinga katahsa hi kathunun ahi. Achuti louleh, midang koma thu kasei phong jouva keima tah alhinglou kahi khah ding ahi.
English: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

tcz: Kasopiteho, nanghon masangpeh a gamthip a ipu ipateu anaumu thudol chu nasuhmil dingu kanompoi. Amaho jouse chu achunguva um meibolin apuiyun, chule abonchauvin Twipisan chu tolgolai jot in ajot jenguve.
en: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

tcz: Mose nungjui ahijaluvin meibol sunga le twipi sunga chun abonun baptize achangun ahi.
en: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

tcz: Amaho jouse chun lhagao an thakhat chu anecheh uvin,
en: and all ate the same spiritual food;

tcz: Chule amaho jouse chun Lhagao twi khatma chu adon khomun ahi. Ajeh chu amahon akilhonpiu Lhagao songpima a kipat'a chu adonu ahin, chule hiche songpi chu Christa ahi.
en: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
text:
1CO 10:4
Thadou: Chule amaho jouse chun Lhagao twi khatma chu adon khomun ahi. Ajeh chu amahon akilhonpiu Lhagao songpima a kipat'a chu adonu ahin, chule hiche songpi chu Christa ahi.
English: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

tcz: Hijongleh Pathen chu amaho atamjo chunga alunglhaipon, chule atahsau chu gamthip'ah athethang peh in ahi.
en: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
text:
1CO 10:5
Thadou: Hijongleh Pathen chu amaho atamjo chunga alunglhaipon, chule atahsau chu gamthip'ah athethang peh in ahi.
English: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

tcz: Hichengse anasodoh hi eiho dinga kichih theina ding ahi, hiche hi amaho tobanga thilse ngaichatna ineilouna dingu ahije.
en: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.
text:
1CO 10:6
Thadou: Hichengse anasodoh hi eiho dinga kichih theina ding ahi, hiche hi amaho tobanga thilse ngaichatna ineilouna dingu ahije.
English: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

tcz: Ahilouleh amaho lah a milim hou aum bang uva iumlouna dingu ahi. Pathen Thubun asei dungjuiyin, “Mipiho chun kivahva na golnop anneh le don abol'un, chule amaho chu milim houna a kipah in, akipah thanomun ahi.”
en: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
text:
1CO 10:7
Thadou: Ahilouleh amaho lah a milim hou aum bang uva iumlouna dingu ahi. Pathen Thubun asei dungjuiyin, “Mipiho chun kivahva na golnop anneh le don abol'un, chule amaho chu milim houna a kipah in, akipah thanomun ahi.”
English: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

tcz: Amaho phabep chun jon thanhoi abol jeh uva mi sang somni le sangthum chu nikhat a athilo tobangu chun jonthanhoi bolpou hite.
en: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
text:
1CO 10:8
Thadou: Amaho phabep chun jon thanhoi abol jeh uva mi sang somni le sangthum chu nikhat a athilo tobangu chun jonthanhoi bolpou hite.
English: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

tcz: Ahilou jongleh Christa chu patep pou hite, amaho lah a phabep in achutibol uvin chule gul in achulih uvin ahi.
en: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
text:
1CO 10:9
Thadou: Ahilou jongleh Christa chu patep pou hite, amaho lah a phabep in achutibol uvin chule gul in achulih uvin ahi.
English: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

tcz: Chule phunset bolpou hite, alah uva phabep aphunset jeh uvin, mithat vantil in amaho chu asuhmang louvin ahi.
en: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
text:
1CO 10:10
Thadou: Chule phunset bolpou hite, alah uva phabep aphunset jeh uvin, mithat vantil in amaho chu asuhmang louvin ahi.
English: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

tcz: Hichengse achunguva anasodoh chu eiho dinga vetsahna a soh a ahi. Amaho thudol kisun hi eiho khang kichai koma ho kichihtheina dinga ahi.
en: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
text:
1CO 10:11
Thadou: Hichengse achunguva anasodoh chu eiho dinga vetsahna a soh a ahi. Amaho thudol kisun hi eiho khang kichai koma ho kichihtheina dinga ahi.
English: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

tcz: Nangma adingdet a nakigela ahileh, nalhuh louna dingin ching theijin.
en: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
text:
1CO 10:12
Thadou: Nangma adingdet a nakigela ahileh, nalhuh louna dingin ching theijin.
English: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

tcz: Na hinkhoa lhepna nato hohi midangin atoho toh akikhehna aumdehpoi. Chule Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nangman nadinpi joulou ding kalval chu Aman nachunga achuh ding phal ponte. Nangman lhepna chu nato tengleh, Aman nathoh jouva naki huhdohna ding lampi nagonpeh ding ahi.
en: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
text:
1CO 10:13
Thadou: Na hinkhoa lhepna nato hohi midangin atoho toh akikhehna aumdehpoi. Chule Pathen tahsan umtah ahin, nangman nadinpi joulou ding kalval chu Aman nachunga achuh ding phal ponte. Nangman lhepna chu nato tengleh, Aman nathoh jouva naki huhdohna ding lampi nagonpeh ding ahi.
English: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

tcz: Hiti chun, kasopi deitahte, milim houna'a konin jamdoh un.
en: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
text:
1CO 10:14
Thadou: Hiti chun, kasopi deitahte, milim houna'a konin jamdoh un.
English: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

tcz: Nangho lung geltoh thei mi nahiuve. Keiman kasei hi adih ahi tia na tahsan uva ahileh nangho kigel phauvin.
en: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
text:
1CO 10:15
Thadou: Nangho lung geltoh thei mi nahiuve. Keiman kasei hi adih ahi tia na tahsan uva ahileh nangho kigel phauvin.
English: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

tcz: Eihon Pakai Anjon kibolna'a khon'a phatthei chu iboh tenguleh, eihon Christa thisana chu chan neiya ihilou uham?
en: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
text:
1CO 10:16
Thadou: Eihon Pakai Anjon kibolna'a khon'a phatthei chu iboh tenguleh, eihon Christa thisana chu chan neiya ihilou uham?
English: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

tcz: Chule eiho mitamtah ihivang uvin, eiho ibonchauva changlhah lum khat a chu nekhoma ihiuvin, hichun eiho tipum khat ihiuve ti vetsahna ahi.
en: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
text:
1CO 10:17
Thadou: Chule eiho mitamtah ihivang uvin, eiho ibonchauva changlhah lum khat a chu nekhoma ihiuvin, hichun eiho tipum khat ihiuve ti vetsahna ahi.
English: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

tcz: Israel mipite chu gelun, amaho chun maichama kikatdoh ho chu lungkhat tah a aneh khomjiu hilou ham?
en: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
text:
1CO 10:18
Thadou: Israel mipite chu gelun, amaho chun maichama kikatdoh ho chu lungkhat tah a aneh khomjiu hilou ham?
English: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

tcz: Ipi seinoma kahi dem? Keiman milim houna'a kikatdoh anneh chu ipi vetsahna ahi katina hintem? Ahilouleh milim kisem thu hohi pathen ho ahiuve katina ham?
en: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
text:
1CO 10:19
Thadou: Ipi seinoma kahi dem? Keiman milim houna'a kikatdoh anneh chu ipi vetsahna ahi katina hintem? Ahilouleh milim kisem thu hohi pathen ho ahiuve katina ham?
English: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

tcz: Ahipoi, hichu ahi naisaipoi. Hiche avetsahna thil kitoh ho hi lhagao boh ho koma kibol'a ahin, Pathena kikatdoh ahipoi. Chule nangho lhagao boh hotoh najao kop dingu kanompoi.
en: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
text:
1CO 10:20
Thadou: Ahipoi, hichu ahi naisaipoi. Hiche avetsahna thil kitoh ho hi lhagao boh ho koma kibol'a ahin, Pathena kikatdoh ahipoi. Chule nangho lhagao boh hotoh najao kop dingu kanompoi.
English: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

tcz: Nanghon Pakai khon'a le lhagaoboh ho khon'a chu nadon theidehlou dingu ahi. Pakai dokhang le lhagaoboh dokhanga nanehkop thei dehlou dingu ahi.
en: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.
text:
1CO 10:21
Thadou: Nanghon Pakai khon'a le lhagaoboh ho khon'a chu nadon theidehlou dingu ahi. Pakai dokhang le lhagaoboh dokhanga nanehkop thei dehlou dingu ahi.
English: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

tcz: Pakai chu thangthip sahna ikondohsah u hingap a ham? Ama sanga ihat joh uva nagelu hitam?
en: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
text:
1CO 10:22
Thadou: Pakai chu thangthip sahna ikondohsah u hingap a ham? Ama sanga ihat joh uva nagelu hitam?
English: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

tcz: Nangin “Keiman ipi hijongleh kabol ding phal ahi” nati, hinla ijakai nangma dinga phatchomna ahipoi. Nangin, “Ipi hijongleh kabol dia phatsah ahi” nati, hinla ima jouse aphachoma ahidehpoi.
en: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
text:
1CO 10:23
Thadou: Nangin “Keiman ipi hijongleh kabol ding phal ahi” nati, hinla ijakai nangma dinga phatchomna ahipoi. Nangin, “Ipi hijongleh kabol dia phatsah ahi” nati, hinla ima jouse aphachoma ahidehpoi.
English: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

tcz: Nangma dingseh a phatna ding chu gelkhoh hih in, hinla midang phatna ding gelkhoh un.
en: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
text:
1CO 10:24
Thadou: Nangma dingseh a phatna ding chu gelkhoh hih in, hinla midang phatna ding gelkhoh un.
English: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

tcz: Hitia chu se le pha hetna a thudoh bol louvin kailhanga sa kijoh tapou khu naneh thei ahi.
en: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
text:
1CO 10:25
Thadou: Hitia chu se le pha hetna a thudoh bol louvin kailhanga sa kijoh tapou khu naneh thei ahi.
English: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh leiset hi Pakaiya ahin, chule asunga umjouse jong hi Ama a ahi.
en: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
text:
1CO 10:26
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh leiset hi Pakaiya ahin, chule asunga umjouse jong hi Ama a ahi.
English: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

tcz: Atahsan lou koi ham khat'in in'a nilhah an nedinga nakouva ahileh temna namu chu nanop'a ahileh sanpeh jengin. Na angsunga aluichan chu se le pha hetna thua ima dohna neilouvin sa chu nejengin.
en: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
text:
1CO 10:27
Thadou: Atahsan lou koi ham khat'in in'a nilhah an nedinga nakouva ahileh temna namu chu nanop'a ahileh sanpeh jengin. Na angsunga aluichan chu se le pha hetna thua ima dohna neilouvin sa chu nejengin.
English: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

tcz: (Hinlah khat touvin, hiche sa hi milim houna'a kikatdoh a ahitai, atia ahileh na seipehpa se le pha hetna jal jeh chun nehdin gellhahna neihih in).
en: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”
text:
1CO 10:28
Thadou: (Hinlah khat touvin, hiche sa hi milim houna'a kikatdoh a ahitai, atia ahileh na seipehpa se le pha hetna jal jeh chun nehdin gellhahna neihih in).
English: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

tcz: Mi koiham khat'in agel ding jeh man a chu kachamlhatna imalou soh ding ham?
en: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
text:
1CO 10:29
Thadou: Mi koiham khat'in agel ding jeh man a chu kachamlhatna imalou soh ding ham?
English: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

tcz: Keiman anneh jeh a chu Pathen kathangvah theiya chule hichu kanopsahpia ahileh, ipi jeh a anneh mana keima eiki oimo ding ham?
en: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
text:
1CO 10:30
Thadou: Keiman anneh jeh a chu Pathen kathangvah theiya chule hichu kanopsahpia ahileh, ipi jeh a anneh mana keima eiki oimo ding ham?
English: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

tcz: Hijeh chun nanghon naneh u hihen nadon'u hijongleh, ahilouleh ipi nabol'u hijongleh, abonchan Pathen loupina dingin bol'un.
en: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
text:
1CO 10:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun nanghon naneh u hihen nadon'u hijongleh, ahilouleh ipi nabol'u hijongleh, abonchan Pathen loupina dingin bol'un.
English: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

tcz: Judah mite hihen lang, ahilouleh chidang namdang ho hijongleh, ahilouleh Pathen houbung hijongleh lungthoisah hih un.
en: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

tcz: Kei jengin jong kabollam jousea hi mitin lunglhaisahna ding kabol ahi. Keima dinga aphatpen mana kabol ahipoi, mitampi huhhing'a aum theina dinga midang dinga aphapen chu kabol joh ahi.
en: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
text:
1CO 10:33
Thadou: Kei jengin jong kabollam jousea hi mitin lunglhaisahna ding kabol ahi. Keima dinga aphatpen mana kabol ahipoi, mitampi huhhing'a aum theina dinga midang dinga aphapen chu kabol joh ahi.
English: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

tcz: Chule keima Christa dungsun kahi bangin, nangho jong keima dungsun hiuvin.
en: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
text:
1CO 11:1
Thadou: Chule keima Christa dungsun kahi bangin, nangho jong keima dungsun hiuvin.
English: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

tcz: Nanghon nalunguvah keima neigel jingun, chule naheng uva kathuhilu thu chu najuiyuve, ti kahet hin keima kakipah lheh in ahi.
en: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
text:
1CO 11:2
Thadou: Nanghon nalunguvah keima neigel jingun, chule naheng uva kathuhilu thu chu najuiyuve, ti kahet hin keima kakipah lheh in ahi.
English: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon thilkhat nahet dingu keiman kadei chu-Pasal chu Christa lama mopoa ahin, numei chu ajipa henga mopoa ahi, chule Christa chu Pathen henga mopoa ahi.
en: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
text:
1CO 11:3
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon thilkhat nahet dingu keiman kadei chu-Pasal chu Christa lama mopoa ahin, numei chu ajipa henga mopoa ahi, chule Christa chu Pathen henga mopoa ahi.
English: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

tcz: Pasal in ataopet ahilouleh lhagaothu aseipet a alu akhua ahileh Christa ajalou ahi.
en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
text:
1CO 11:4
Thadou: Pasal in ataopet ahilouleh lhagaothu aseipet a alu akhua ahileh Christa ajalou ahi.
English: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

tcz: Hinlah numeiyin alu khuh louva ataova, ahilouleh Lhagao thu aseidoh a ahileh ajipa chu ajalou ahin, hijeh a chu hiche hi alu kivoutol tobang ahitai.
en: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
text:
1CO 11:5
Thadou: Hinlah numeiyin alu khuh louva ataova, ahilouleh Lhagao thu aseidoh a ahileh ajipa chu ajalou ahin, hijeh a chu hiche hi alu kivoutol tobang ahitai.
English: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

tcz: Ahin amanu hin alu pon'a akhukhum nom louleh, aman asam jouse atan lhah ding dol ahitai! Ahin numei dinga asam tan lhah ahilouleh asam vomui chu jachat um ahijeh a, amanu chun ponlu khu chu akiken ding ahi.
en: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
text:
1CO 11:6
Thadou: Ahin amanu hin alu pon'a akhukhum nom louleh, aman asam jouse atan lhah ding dol ahitai! Ahin numei dinga asam tan lhah ahilouleh asam vomui chu jachat um ahijeh a, amanu chun ponlu khu chu akiken ding ahi.
English: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

tcz: Pasal in Pathen ahoupet a alua ima akoilou ding ahi, ajeh chu pasal chu Pathen lima kisema chule Pathen loupina sulanga ahi. Chule numeiyin Pasal loupina asuhlang hiya ahi.
en: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
text:
1CO 11:7
Thadou: Pasal in Pathen ahoupet a alua ima akoilou ding ahi, ajeh chu pasal chu Pathen lima kisema chule Pathen loupina sulanga ahi. Chule numeiyin Pasal loupina asuhlang hiya ahi.
English: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh mimasa chu numeiya kona ahipon, hinla numei masa chu pasala kon ahi.
en: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

tcz: Chule pasal chu numei dinga kisema ahipon, ahin numei chu pasal dinga kisema ahi.
en: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
text:
1CO 11:9
Thadou: Chule pasal chu numei dinga kisema ahipon, ahin numei chu pasal dinga kisema ahi.
English: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

tcz: Hijeh a chu numeiyin thuneina noiya um kahi ti vetsahna a, alua ponkhu akivon ding ahi, ajeh chu vantilte avet jingu ahi.
en: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
text:
1CO 11:10
Thadou: Hijeh a chu numeiyin thuneina noiya um kahi ti vetsahna a, alua ponkhu akivon ding ahi, ajeh chu vantilte avet jingu ahi.
English: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai mite lah a, numeiho chu pasala kona chamlhat ahilou tobang'in, pasal ho jong numeiya kona chamlhat ahipouve.
en: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
text:
1CO 11:11
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai mite lah a, numeiho chu pasala kona chamlhat ahilou tobang'in, pasal ho jong numeiya kona chamlhat ahipouve.
English: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh numei masa chu pasala kona hung uma ahijeng vang'in, pasal dang khat khat cheh hi numei khat a kona hung peng doh a ahi cheh uve.
en: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
text:
1CO 11:12
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh numei masa chu pasala kona hung uma ahijeng vang'in, pasal dang khat khat cheh hi numei khat a kona hung peng doh a ahi cheh uve.
English: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

tcz: Nangho cheh dingin thu kitanun. Numei hin alu pon kikhu louva mipi lah a Pathen henga atao ding chu dih a hinam?
en: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
text:
1CO 11:13
Thadou: Nangho cheh dingin thu kitanun. Numei hin alu pon kikhu louva mipi lah a Pathen henga atao ding chu dih a hinam?
English: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

tcz: Pasal in sam asaova aput ding chu ama dinga kilom louva hilou ham?
en: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
text:
1CO 11:14
Thadou: Pasal in sam asaova aput ding chu ama dinga kilom louva hilou ham?
English: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

tcz: Chule numei dinga asamsao hi akiletsahpi le athanoppi hilou ham? Ajeh chu hichu amanu dinga khukhum dinga kipea ahi.
en: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
text:
1CO 11:15
Thadou: Chule numei dinga asamsao hi akiletsahpi le athanoppi hilou ham? Ajeh chu hichu amanu dinga khukhum dinga kipea ahi.
English: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

tcz: Hinlah hiche thudola hi khattou anelkal nom aumleh, eihon hiche tailou hi chonna ding dang inei pouve, chule Pathen houbung danghon jong anei deh pouve, ti hi kaseidoh nom ahi.
en: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
text:
1CO 11:16
Thadou: Hinlah hiche thudola hi khattou anelkal nom aumleh, eihon hiche tailou hi chonna ding dang inei pouve, chule Pathen houbung danghon jong anei deh pouve, ti hi kaseidoh nom ahi.
English: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

tcz: Ahivangin tun anoiya kithuhilna hoa hin, nangho kapahcha theipouve. Ajeh chu nangho nakimuto tenguleh thilpha sanga aphalou ding joh boldoh a hileu chun akilouve.
en: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.
text:
1CO 11:17
Thadou: Ahivangin tun anoiya kithuhilna hoa hin, nangho kapahcha theipouve. Ajeh chu nangho nakimuto tenguleh thilpha sanga aphalou ding joh boldoh a hileu chun akilouve.
English: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

tcz: Amasan, houbunga nakikhop khom tenguleh nalah uva kibung khenna aume tithu kajan, chule hichu ichan hamin katahsanin ahi.
en: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
text:
1CO 11:18
Thadou: Amasan, houbunga nakikhop khom tenguleh nalah uva kibung khenna aume tithu kajan, chule hichu ichan hamin katahsanin ahi.
English: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

tcz: Hinlah, ahinai, nalah uva kibung khenna soh mong ding ahinai chutia chu nangho adih'a umho hetdoh'a naumna ding uva ahi!
en: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
text:
1CO 11:19
Thadou: Hinlah, ahinai, nalah uva kibung khenna soh mong ding ahinai chutia chu nangho adih'a umho hetdoh'a naumna ding uva ahi!
English: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

tcz: Nangho naki khop khom tenguleh, nangho Pakai Anjonna'ah nalunglut tahtah pouve.
en: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
text:
1CO 11:20
Thadou: Nangho naki khop khom tenguleh, nangho Pakai Anjonna'ah nalunglut tahtah pouve.
English: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh nalah uva mi phabep chu midang to nehkhom ding golouvin nangma an cheh nakineh pai jenguve. Hiti chun, abang khat gilkel in aum un, adang phabep akhamji tauve.
en: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
text:
1CO 11:21
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh nalah uva mi phabep chu midang to nehkhom ding golouvin nangma an cheh nakineh pai jenguve. Hiti chun, abang khat gilkel in aum un, adang phabep akhamji tauve.
English: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

tcz: Ipi ham? Nehna le donna dinga nangma nangma in cheh neiya nahi lou u ham? Ahilouleh nanghon Pathen houbung chu imacha hilou sosah ding goa chule avaichaho jachatsah goa nahiu vem? Keiman ipi kasei ding hitam? Nangho ka pachat diu nanop'u vem? Hichung chang thua hin napahcha hih uvinge!
en: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
text:
1CO 11:22
Thadou: Ipi ham? Nehna le donna dinga nangma nangma in cheh neiya nahi lou u ham? Ahilouleh nanghon Pathen houbung chu imacha hilou sosah ding goa chule avaichaho jachatsah goa nahiu vem? Keiman ipi kasei ding hitam? Nangho ka pachat diu nanop'u vem? Hichung chang thua hin napahcha hih uvinge!
English: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

tcz: Ajehchu, Pakai Amatah a kona kalahson chu nangho kapehson kit nahiuve. Pakai chu mat dinga pehdoh a aum jan chun, Pakai chun changlhah phabep ala in,
en: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
text:
1CO 11:23
Thadou: Ajehchu, Pakai Amatah a kona kalahson chu nangho kapehson kit nahiuve. Pakai chu mat dinga pehdoh a aum jan chun, Pakai chun changlhah phabep ala in,
English: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

tcz: Hiche a chun Pathen athangvah in ahi. Chuphat in Aman ahehbalbal'in chuin aseiyin, “Hiche hi nangho dinga kipedoh katahsa ahi. Keima neigeldoh jingna dingun hiche hi bol'un,” ati.
en: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
text:
1CO 11:24
Thadou: Hiche a chun Pathen athangvah in ahi. Chuphat in Aman ahehbalbal'in chuin aseiyin, “Hiche hi nangho dinga kipedoh katahsa ahi. Keima neigeldoh jingna dingun hiche hi bol'un,” ati.
English: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

tcz: Hitobangma chun an aneh jouvun, Aman khon'a lengpitwi chu ala in, aseiyin, “Hiche khon hi Pathen le Amite kitepna thah ahi–kathisan a kitepna suhdetna chu ahi. Hiche hi nadon laiseuvin keima geldohna in bol'un” ati.
en: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
text:
1CO 11:25
Thadou: Hitobangma chun an aneh jouvun, Aman khon'a lengpitwi chu ala in, aseiyin, “Hiche khon hi Pathen le Amite kitepna thah ahi–kathisan a kitepna suhdetna chu ahi. Hiche hi nadon laiseuvin keima geldohna in bol'un” ati.
English: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

tcz: Ajehchu nanghon hiche changlhah hi naneh chanseuva chule hiche khon'a hi nadonlai chanseuva nanghon Pakai thina chu ahung kahsea naphondoh u ahi.
en: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
text:
1CO 11:26
Thadou: Ajehchu nanghon hiche changlhah hi naneh chanseuva chule hiche khon'a hi nadonlai chanseuva nanghon Pakai thina chu ahung kahsea naphondoh u ahi.
English: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

tcz: Hiti chun, koi hijongleh lomlouhel'a hiche changlhah chu nea, ahilouleh hiche Pakai khon'a chu don'ah aumleh Pakai tahsa le thisana chu themmo chang ding ahi.
en: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
text:
1CO 11:27
Thadou: Hiti chun, koi hijongleh lomlouhel'a hiche changlhah chu nea, ahilouleh hiche Pakai khon'a chu don'ah aumleh Pakai tahsa le thisana chu themmo chang ding ahi.
English: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu changlhah chu naneh masangule khon'a chu nadon masanguva nangma tah kivetchilna nanei dingu ahiye.
en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.
text:
1CO 11:28
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu changlhah chu naneh masangule khon'a chu nadon masanguva nangma tah kivetchilna nanei dingu ahiye.
English: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa tahsa chu naneh masangu, ahilouleh nadon masang uva Christa tahsa chu najabol louva ahileh, naneh le nadon a chu Pathen thutanna nangma chung tah a nakilhut hiya ahi.
en: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
text:
1CO 11:29
Thadou: Ajehchu Christa tahsa chu naneh masangu, ahilouleh nadon masang uva Christa tahsa chu najabol louva ahileh, naneh le nadon a chu Pathen thutanna nangma chung tah a nakilhut hiya ahi.
English: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu nangho mitamtah thalhoma chule naa chule phabepset jong athia nahi tauve.
en: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
text:
1CO 11:30
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu nangho mitamtah thalhoma chule naa chule phabepset jong athia nahi tauve.
English: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

tcz: Hinlah eimaho tah kikholtoh a hileuhen, Pathen in hitia hi ichung uva thutanna aneilou ding ahi.
en: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
text:
1CO 11:31
Thadou: Hinlah eimaho tah kikholtoh a hileuhen, Pathen in hitia hi ichung uva thutanna aneilou ding ahi.
English: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

tcz: Amavang Pakaiyin ithu'u atan'a thununna noiya eikoiyu tengleh, vannoi toh themmo ichantha lou diu ahi.
en: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
text:
1CO 11:32
Thadou: Amavang Pakaiyin ithu'u atan'a thununna noiya eikoiyu tengleh, vannoi toh themmo ichantha lou diu ahi.
English: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

tcz: Hiti chun kasopite, nanghon Pakai Jan Anjon boldinga nakikhop ji tenguleh, khatle khat kingah touvin.
en: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
text:
1CO 11:33
Thadou: Hiti chun kasopite, nanghon Pakai Jan Anjon boldinga nakikhop ji tenguleh, khatle khat kingah touvin.
English: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

tcz: Agilkel tahbeh monga nahiuleh, in'ah kineh jengun, chuti henlang hileh nakikhop khom tenguleh nangma chunga thutanna chu nakiloilut lou ding ahi.
en: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
text:
1CO 11:34
Thadou: Agilkel tahbeh monga nahiuleh, in'ah kineh jengun, chuti henlang hileh nakikhop khom tenguleh nangma chunga thutanna chu nakiloilut lou ding ahi.
English: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

tcz: Tun, sopi deitahte, Lhagaovin thilboltheina jatchom beh eipehnau chung chang thua neihin dohnau thudol hi, nang hon nahet khel dingu keima kanompoi.
en: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
text:
1CO 12:1
Thadou: Tun, sopi deitahte, Lhagaovin thilboltheina jatchom beh eipehnau chung chang thua neihin dohnau thudol hi, nang hon nahet khel dingu keima kanompoi.
English: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

tcz: Nanghon Pathen nahet masangu chun, nangho hi lhagaova lamvaiya chule paotheilou lim semthu houna a puimanga um nahi tauvin ahi.
en: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
text:
1CO 12:2
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen nahet masangu chun, nangho hi lhagaova lamvaiya chule paotheilou lim semthu houna a puimanga um nahi tauvin ahi.
English: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

tcz: Hiti thua hi nang hon nahet dingu kadei chu, koima Pathen Lhagaova kona thusei chun Yeshua gaosap pontin, chule Lhagao Theng panna louvin Yeshua chu Pakai tithei ponte.
en: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
text:
1CO 12:3
Thadou: Hiti thua hi nang hon nahet dingu kadei chu, koima Pathen Lhagaova kona thusei chun Yeshua gaosap pontin, chule Lhagao Theng panna louvin Yeshua chu Pakai tithei ponte.
English: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Lhagao Thilpeh jat chom chom uma ahin, hinla Lhagao khat'a chu lhagao thilpeh jouse aboncha hung kipan ahi.
en: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
text:
1CO 12:4
Thadou: Lhagao Thilpeh jat chom chom uma ahin, hinla Lhagao khat'a chu lhagao thilpeh jouse aboncha hung kipan ahi.
English: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

tcz: Lhacha natohna jatchom chom aumin, hinla eihon Pakai khatma kin chu ibolu ahi.
en: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
text:
1CO 12:5
Thadou: Lhacha natohna jatchom chom aumin, hinla eihon Pakai khatma kin chu ibolu ahi.
English: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

tcz: Pathen in jatchom chomin na atongin, hinla Pathen katma chun eiho ibonchauva sunga na atongin ahi.
en: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.
text:
1CO 12:6
Thadou: Pathen in jatchom chomin na atongin, hinla Pathen katma chun eiho ibonchauva sunga na atongin ahi.
English: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

tcz: Lhagao thilpeh hi eiho khat cheh eikipeuva ahin, hiche jal'a chu eiho khat le khat ikihuto theiyu ahi.
en: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
text:
1CO 12:7
Thadou: Lhagao thilpeh hi eiho khat cheh eikipeuva ahin, hiche jal'a chu eiho khat le khat ikihuto theiyu ahi.
English: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

tcz: Lhagao chun mikhat a thumop themna apeh ahin, hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat chu thu hetkhen themna apen ahi.
en: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,
text:
1CO 12:8
Thadou: Lhagao chun mikhat a thumop themna apeh ahin, hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat chu thu hetkhen themna apen ahi.
English: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

tcz: Hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat tahsannaa hatna apen, chule michom dang khat chu Lhagao chun ana damlou damsah theina thilpeh apen ahi.
en: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,
text:
1CO 12:9
Thadou: Hiche Lhagaoma chun michom khat tahsannaa hatna apen, chule michom dang khat chu Lhagao chun ana damlou damsah theina thilpeh apen ahi.
English: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

tcz: Aman mikhat chu thil kidang dang ho boltheina thaneina apein, chule achom dang khat chu Pathen Thuseidohna apein ahi. Aman michom dang khat thu kiseidoh chu Pathen Lhagaova kon ahi ahiloule lhagao chom danga kon ahi phottohna apein ahi. Chukit jongleh michom dang khat chu hetlou paoho thotheina apen, chule achom dangma chu akisei chu ipiham ti ledoh theina apein ahi.
en: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.
text:
1CO 12:10
Thadou: Aman mikhat chu thil kidang dang ho boltheina thaneina apein, chule achom dang khat chu Pathen Thuseidohna apein ahi. Aman michom dang khat thu kiseidoh chu Pathen Lhagaova kon ahi ahiloule lhagao chom danga kon ahi phottohna apein ahi. Chukit jongleh michom dang khat chu hetlou paoho thotheina apen, chule achom dangma chu akisei chu ipiham ti ledoh theina apein ahi.
English: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

tcz: Hiche Lhagao Theng chu khat ahin, lhagao thilpeh jouse hompa chu ahiye. Ama bouvin itobang lhagao thilpeh chu koi chang ding ham tichu khat cheh dinga agellhuh ahi.
en: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
text:
1CO 12:11
Thadou: Hiche Lhagao Theng chu khat ahin, lhagao thilpeh jouse hompa chu ahiye. Ama bouvin itobang lhagao thilpeh chu koi chang ding ham tichu khat cheh dinga agellhuh ahi.
English: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

tcz: Mihem tahsa hin tibah tampi aneiye, hinla tibah tampi hin tipum chu ahin semdoh ahi. Chutobanga chu Christa tahsa jong uma ahi.
en: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
text:
1CO 12:12
Thadou: Mihem tahsa hin tibah tampi aneiye, hinla tibah tampi hin tipum chu ahin semdoh ahi. Chutobanga chu Christa tahsa jong uma ahi.
English: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

tcz: I-lah uva abang phabep Judah mi, phabepma chu chidang namdang ho, chule phabep chu chamlhat ahiuve. Hinla eiho jouse hi Lhagao khat'a chu baptize changa ihiuvin, chule eiho jouse Lhagao khatma a chu chan neikhoma ihiuve.
en: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
text:
1CO 12:13
Thadou: I-lah uva abang phabep Judah mi, phabepma chu chidang namdang ho, chule phabep chu chamlhat ahiuve. Hinla eiho jouse hi Lhagao khat'a chu baptize changa ihiuvin, chule eiho jouse Lhagao khatma a chu chan neikhoma ihiuve.
English: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

tcz: Ahinai, tipum hin tibah jatchom chom aneiyin, tibah khat bou ahipoi.
en: For the body is not one member, but many.
text:
1CO 12:14
Thadou: Ahinai, tipum hin tibah jatchom chom aneiyin, tibah khat bou ahipoi.
English: For the body is not one member, but many.

tcz: Keng chun, “Keima khut kahilou jeh in keima tipum'ah kajaopoi” tileh hichun tipuma chu ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
en: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
text:
1CO 12:15
Thadou: Keng chun, “Keima khut kahilou jeh in keima tipum'ah kajaopoi” tileh hichun tipuma chu ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
English: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

tcz: Chule bilkol chun, “Keima mit kahi loujeh in keima tipuma kajaopoi,” tileh hichun tipuma ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
en: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
text:
1CO 12:16
Thadou: Chule bilkol chun, “Keima mit kahi loujeh in keima tipuma kajaopoi,” tileh hichun tipuma ahisah deh lou ding ahipoi.
English: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
