tcz: Tipum jouse chu mit hitahen lang hileh, iti kho najah ding hitam? Ahilouleh nati pumpi chu nakol khat hitaleh, ipia anam najah thei ding hitam?
en: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
text:
1CO 12:17
Thadou: Tipum jouse chu mit hitahen lang hileh, iti kho najah ding hitam? Ahilouleh nati pumpi chu nakol khat hitaleh, ipia anam najah thei ding hitam?
English: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

tcz: Hinlah itahsau hin tibah tampi aneiyin, chule Pathen in khat khat cheh hi aphatsahna mun muna akoi cheh ahiye.
en: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
text:
1CO 12:18
Thadou: Hinlah itahsau hin tibah tampi aneiyin, chule Pathen in khat khat cheh hi aphatsahna mun muna akoi cheh ahiye.
English: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

tcz: Tahsa chun tibah khatseh neitahen lang hileh tipum khat chu iti datmo um hiding hitam?
en: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
text:
1CO 12:19
Thadou: Tahsa chun tibah khatseh neitahen lang hileh tipum khat chu iti datmo um hiding hitam?
English: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

tcz: Ahinai, tibah tampi aumin, hinla tipum khat bou ahi.
en: But now they are many members, but one body.
text:
1CO 12:20
Thadou: Ahinai, tibah tampi aumin, hinla tipum khat bou ahi.
English: But now they are many members, but one body.

tcz: Mit chun khut jah a, “Keiman nangma kangaichapoi” atithei louhel ding ahi. Luchang chun keng jah a, “Nangma kangaichapoi,” atitheilou hel ahi.
en: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
text:
1CO 12:21
Thadou: Mit chun khut jah a, “Keiman nangma kangaichapoi” atithei louhel ding ahi. Luchang chun keng jah a, “Nangma kangaichapoi,” atitheilou hel ahi.
English: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

tcz: Tahbeh in, tibah ho lah a athalhom pen le aphatchomna neibeh louva igel hou hi angai khoh pen joh ahinom jiuve.
en: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
text:
1CO 12:22
Thadou: Tahbeh in, tibah ho lah a athalhom pen le aphatchomna neibeh louva igel hou hi angai khoh pen joh ahinom jiuve.
English: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

tcz: Chule eihon igelkhoh beh lou u ijabol behlou hou hi eihon phatah a ivettup uva itom jiu ahiye. Hiti chun, eihon akimulou dingho hi phatechan ivesui jiuvin ahi.
en: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,
text:
1CO 12:23
Thadou: Chule eihon igelkhoh beh lou u ijabol behlou hou hi eihon phatah a ivettup uva itom jiu ahiye. Hiti chun, eihon akimulou dingho hi phatechan ivesui jiuvin ahi.
English: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

tcz: Ja ding dol tibah ho hi phatecha vetsui jong angai jipoi. Hitia hi Pathen in tipum hi akoikhoma agunchelou tibah ho hi jabolbena le vetsui jepna apeh ahi.
en: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
text:
1CO 12:24
Thadou: Ja ding dol tibah ho hi phatecha vetsui jong angai jipoi. Hitia hi Pathen in tipum hi akoikhoma agunchelou tibah ho hi jabolbena le vetsui jepna apeh ahi.
English: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

tcz: Hiche hin tibahho dinga kitona ahinsodoh theina dinga, tibah jouse khatle khat kikhohsah tona ahin umdohsah theina ding uva ahi.
en: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
text:
1CO 12:25
Thadou: Hiche hin tibahho dinga kitona ahinsodoh theina dinga, tibah jouse khatle khat kikhohsah tona ahin umdohsah theina ding uva ahi.
English: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

tcz: Tibah khat in athoh gima ahileh, tibah jousen hichu athoh gim piuvin, chule tibah khat chun jabolna akimua ahileh, tibah jouse chun akipa huvin ahi.
en: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
text:
1CO 12:26
Thadou: Tibah khat in athoh gima ahileh, tibah jousen hichu athoh gim piuvin, chule tibah khat chun jabolna akimua ahileh, tibah jouse chun akipa huvin ahi.
English: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

tcz: Nangho jouse hi nabon chauva Christa tipum nahiuvin, chule nangho khat khat cheh hi hiche tibah a chu panga nahiuve.
en: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
text:
1CO 12:27
Thadou: Nangho jouse hi nabon chauva Christa tipum nahiuvin, chule nangho khat khat cheh hi hiche tibah a chu panga nahiuve.
English: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

tcz: Hichea hin, Pathen in houbunga dinga tibah a alhendoh ho chu aume: Amasan solchah ho, abanin themgao ho, athumnan mihil ho, chubana melchihna kidang dang bol ho, adamlou damsah theina, midang panpi theina, lamkai hina lhagao thilpeh chang, hetlou pao hoa thusei theina.
en: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
text:
1CO 12:28
Thadou: Hichea hin, Pathen in houbunga dinga tibah a alhendoh ho chu aume: Amasan solchah ho, abanin themgao ho, athumnan mihil ho, chubana melchihna kidang dang bol ho, adamlou damsah theina, midang panpi theina, lamkai hina lhagao thilpeh chang, hetlou pao hoa thusei theina.
English: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

tcz: Eiho jouse solchah ihiuvem? Eiho jouse hi themgo ihiuvem? Melchihna kidang boldoh theina inei sohkei uvam?
en: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
text:
1CO 12:29
Thadou: Eiho jouse solchah ihiuvem? Eiho jouse hi themgo ihiuvem? Melchihna kidang boldoh theina inei sohkei uvam?
English: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

tcz: Adamlou damsah theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyuvam? Paochom tho theina thilpeh nanei mong hinam? Eiho jouse hetlou pao ledoh theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyu vem?
en: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
text:
1CO 12:30
Thadou: Adamlou damsah theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyuvam? Paochom tho theina thilpeh nanei mong hinam? Eiho jouse hetlou pao ledoh theina thilpeh ichansoh keiyu vem?
English: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

tcz: Hitia chu nanghon aphachom pen lhagao thilpeh ho chu nalung gut dingu ahi. Hijongleh tun keiman mijouse dinga aphapen hinna lampi chu navetsah uvinge.
en: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
text:
1CO 12:31
Thadou: Hitia chu nanghon aphachom pen lhagao thilpeh ho chu nalung gut dingu ahi. Hijongleh tun keiman mijouse dinga aphapen hinna lampi chu navetsah uvinge.
English: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

tcz: Keiman leiset chunga pao jouse le vantil ho paogeiyin thothei ingting, hinla midang ngailu louvin um taleng, keima chu sum-eng kivoging le khutbeh kibeng gin tobang bep kahi ding ahi.
en: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.
text:
1CO 13:1
Thadou: Keiman leiset chunga pao jouse le vantil ho paogeiyin thothei ingting, hinla midang ngailu louvin um taleng, keima chu sum-eng kivoging le khutbeh kibeng gin tobang bep kahi ding ahi.
English: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

tcz: Keiman Pathen Thu seitheina thilpeh nei ingting, chule Pathen in aguh a athilgon ho jouse hetkhenna neiyin chule mol ho jouse tolmangsoh theina tahsan chu nei nama jongleng, keiman midang chu kangailut louva ahileh, imacha kahilou hiding ahi.
en: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
text:
1CO 13:2
Thadou: Keiman Pathen Thu seitheina thilpeh nei ingting, chule Pathen in aguh a athilgon ho jouse hetkhenna neiyin chule mol ho jouse tolmangsoh theina tahsan chu nei nama jongleng, keiman midang chu kangailut louva ahileh, imacha kahilou hiding ahi.
English: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

tcz: Keiman kanei chasun chu mivaicha peingting chule kati pumpi hi pedoh leng, hichu kaki letsah pithei ahi, hinla keiman midang chu ngailu lou hitaleng, keiman imacha phatchomna kaneilou ding ahi.
en: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
text:
1CO 13:3
Thadou: Keiman kanei chasun chu mivaicha peingting chule kati pumpi hi pedoh leng, hichu kaki letsah pithei ahi, hinla keiman midang chu ngailu lou hitaleng, keiman imacha phatchomna kaneilou ding ahi.
English: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

tcz: Ngailut hi athohhat in chule hepina nei ahi. Ngailut hi athangthip poi ahilouleh aham hoithopoi ahilouleh akiletsahpoi,
en: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
text:
1CO 13:4
Thadou: Ngailut hi athohhat in chule hepina nei ahi. Ngailut hi athangthip poi ahilouleh aham hoithopoi ahilouleh akiletsahpoi,
English: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

tcz: ahilouleh a-engsepoi. Ama dei bou angeh gunsetpoi. Lung himo pina aneipon, chule akibol phat louna ho aching denpoi.
en: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

tcz: Adih louva kibol akipapi pon, hinla thutah chun ajo tengleh akipahji.
en: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

tcz: Ngailutna hi amoh lung lhadai jipoi, atahsanna alhadai jipoi, aphat tinin akinem jin, chule itobang hahsatna hijongleh athohjouve.
en: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.
text:
1CO 13:7
Thadou: Ngailutna hi amoh lung lhadai jipoi, atahsanna alhadai jipoi, aphat tinin akinem jin, chule itobang hahsatna hijongleh athohjouve.
English: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

tcz: Pathen Thusei dohna le hetlou paoho a thusei naho chule hetkhenna kidang dehset neina jong apanna bei ahung hiphat umding ahi. Hinla ngailutna hi imatih chan'a um jing ding ahi!
en: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
text:
1CO 13:8
Thadou: Pathen Thusei dohna le hetlou paoho a thusei naho chule hetkhenna kidang dehset neina jong apanna bei ahung hiphat umding ahi. Hinla ngailutna hi imatih chan'a um jing ding ahi!
English: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

tcz: Tua ihetthei nau hi alhasamin chule akimpon ahi, chule Pathen Thusei dohna thilpeh geiya hi aboncha hijoulou kiphasam nalai ahije.
en: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

tcz: Chamkimna chu ahunglhun phat tengleh, abulhing lou sehi panna beisoh ding ahitai.
en: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
text:
1CO 13:10
Thadou: Chamkimna chu ahunglhun phat tengleh, abulhing lou sehi panna beisoh ding ahitai.
English: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

tcz: Keima chapang kanahi chun, thusei lunggel chule ngaitona chu chapang bangin kaumin ahi. Hinla keima khangdong kahung hichun, chapang ngol naho chu kajom tapoi.
en: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
text:
1CO 13:11
Thadou: Keima chapang kanahi chun, thusei lunggel chule ngaitona chu chapang bangin kaumin ahi. Hinla keima khangdong kahung hichun, chapang ngol naho chu kajom tapoi.
English: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

tcz: Tua thilho hi chamkim louva phatvet a kichenlouva ivet'u tobangbep ahin, chuphat teng vangleh ijakai thengsel'a chamkim keiya imu dingu ahitai. Tua kahet jouse hi akimpon chule abulhingpoi, chuteng vangleh ijakai chamkim keiya kahet ding ahitai, Pathen in eihet chamkim kei tobang hiding ahitai.
en: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
text:
1CO 13:12
Thadou: Tua thilho hi chamkim louva phatvet a kichenlouva ivet'u tobangbep ahin, chuphat teng vangleh ijakai thengsel'a chamkim keiya imu dingu ahitai. Tua kahet jouse hi akimpon chule abulhingpoi, chuteng vangleh ijakai chamkim keiya kahet ding ahitai, Pathen in eihet chamkim kei tobang hiding ahitai.
English: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

tcz: Thil thum hi aitih a umden ding ahi–tahsan, kinep chule ngailut-chule hiche ho lah a hin ngailut achungnung pen'e.
en: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
text:
1CO 13:13
Thadou: Thil thum hi aitih a umden ding ahi–tahsan, kinep chule ngailut-chule hiche ho lah a hin ngailut achungnung pen'e.
English: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

tcz: Ngailut hi nalungtup sangpen'u hihen. Hintin Lhagao thilpeh thilbol theina aphadehset chu-adehset'a Pathen Thuseidoh theina lhagao thilpeh chu nalunga na ngaichat'u hihen.
en: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
text:
1CO 14:1
Thadou: Ngailut hi nalungtup sangpen'u hihen. Hintin Lhagao thilpeh thilbol theina aphadehset chu-adehset'a Pathen Thuseidoh theina lhagao thilpeh chu nalunga na ngaichat'u hihen.
English: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

tcz: Ajehchu nangman pao chomchom thotheina thilpeh chu changin lang, miho chun na thusei heta hih ule, nangma Pathen tobou kihoulima nahi ding ahitai. Nangman Lhagao thahat'a thu nasei chu hinan natin, hijongleh hiche ho chu het hahsa hiding ahitai.
en: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
text:
1CO 14:2
Thadou: Ajehchu nangman pao chomchom thotheina thilpeh chu changin lang, miho chun na thusei heta hih ule, nangma Pathen tobou kihoulima nahi ding ahitai. Nangman Lhagao thahat'a thu nasei chu hinan natin, hijongleh hiche ho chu het hahsa hiding ahitai.
English: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thusei doh a vang chun midang ahatsah a, atilkhouva chule amaho chu alhamonsah ahi.
en: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
text:
1CO 14:3
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen Thusei doh a vang chun midang ahatsah a, atilkhouva chule amaho chu alhamonsah ahi.
English: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

tcz: Paochom chom thoa chu amatah kitil khouva ahin, hinla Pathen Thusei doh a chun Houbung apumpia athahatsah ahi.
en: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
text:
1CO 14:4
Thadou: Paochom chom thoa chu amatah kitil khouva ahin, hinla Pathen Thusei doh a chun Houbung apumpia athahatsah ahi.
English: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

tcz: Nabonchauva paochom chom nathotheiyu hileh katilheh in, hinla nabon chauva Pathen Thusei doh theina joh neileu chun kadeijoi. Ajeh chu Pathen Thusei doh chu houbung apumpia kitil khouna dinga pao chomchom tho sanga kiphamo joa ahi.
en: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
text:
1CO 14:5
Thadou: Nabonchauva paochom chom nathotheiyu hileh katilheh in, hinla nabon chauva Pathen Thusei doh theina joh neileu chun kadeijoi. Ajeh chu Pathen Thusei doh chu houbung apumpia kitil khouna dinga pao chomchom tho sanga kiphamo joa ahi.
English: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte ho, keima nakomuva hung ingting hetlou pao khat in thu seileng, hichu iti naphat chompi thei dingu ham? Hinla keiman thu kiphong doh a kona ahilouleh hetsahna jat chombeh a kona ahilouleh Pathen Thusei doh a kona ahilouleh thuhila kona naphat chomna dingu kahin pohpeh u hileh kati.
en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
text:
1CO 14:6
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte ho, keima nakomuva hung ingting hetlou pao khat in thu seileng, hichu iti naphat chompi thei dingu ham? Hinla keiman thu kiphong doh a kona ahilouleh hetsahna jat chombeh a kona ahilouleh Pathen Thusei doh a kona ahilouleh thuhila kona naphat chomna dingu kahin pohpeh u hileh kati.
English: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

tcz: Tumging manchah ho: theile ahilouleh selangdah ho jengjong hinna neilou ahivanga paocheng kicheh tah a thu kisei toh tekah thei ahiuve. Ajeh chu ahiding banga suhging ahilouleh koima chan agin ngei chu ahetdoh theilou dingu ahi.
en: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
text:
1CO 14:7
Thadou: Tumging manchah ho: theile ahilouleh selangdah ho jengjong hinna neilou ahivanga paocheng kicheh tah a thu kisei toh tekah thei ahiuve. Ajeh chu ahiding banga suhging ahilouleh koima chan agin ngei chu ahetdoh theilou dingu ahi.
English: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

tcz: Chule sumkon mutgin akicheh louleh, sepaiho chun galsatna a dinga kikou ahiu iti ahetdoh thei dingu ham?
en: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
text:
1CO 14:8
Thadou: Chule sumkon mutgin akicheh louleh, sepaiho chun galsatna a dinga kikou ahiu iti ahetdoh thei dingu ham?
English: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

tcz: Chutobang chu ahi nangho jong, nang hon miho chu ahetlou paovin gahou leu chun, nang hon ipi naseiyu chu amahon iti ahet dingu hitam? Mun onglaiya thusei tobang bep nahiu ahitai.
en: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
text:
1CO 14:9
Thadou: Chutobang chu ahi nangho jong, nang hon miho chu ahetlou paovin gahou leu chun, nang hon ipi naseiyu chu amahon iti ahet dingu hitam? Mun onglaiya thusei tobang bep nahiu ahitai.
English: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

tcz: Vannoiya hin paojat chom chom tampi aumin, chule pao kiti hin athuko aum cheh e.
en: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
text:
1CO 14:10
Thadou: Vannoiya hin paojat chom chom tampi aumin, chule pao kiti hin athuko aum cheh e.
English: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

tcz: Hinlah keiman paokhat chu hetahih leng, thuseipa dinga chu gamdang mi kahi ding, chule thuseipa chu keima dinga gamdang mi hiding ahitai.
en: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
text:
1CO 14:11
Thadou: Hinlah keiman paokhat chu hetahih leng, thuseipa dinga chu gamdang mi kahi ding, chule thuseipa chu keima dinga gamdang mi hiding ahitai.
English: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

tcz: Chule nangho dinga jong chutima chu ahi. Nangho Lhagaovin thilbol theina apeh thua hetnomna neneiyu ahin, houbung apumpia tilkhou theina ding chu hol'un.
en: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
text:
1CO 14:12
Thadou: Chule nangho dinga jong chutima chu ahi. Nangho Lhagaovin thilbol theina apeh thua hetnomna neneiyu ahin, houbung apumpia tilkhou theina ding chu hol'un.
English: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

tcz: Hitia chu paochom chom thoa chun akiseidoh ho chu ledoh theina dinga jong tao ding ahi.
en: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
text:
1CO 14:13
Thadou: Hitia chu paochom chom thoa chun akiseidoh ho chu ledoh theina dinga jong tao ding ahi.
English: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

tcz: Ajehchu keima paochom chom thoa kataova ahileh, kalhagao chu atao ahinan, hinla ipi kasei chu keiman kahepoi.
en: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
text:
1CO 14:14
Thadou: Ajehchu keima paochom chom thoa kataova ahileh, kalhagao chu atao ahinan, hinla ipi kasei chu keiman kahepoi.
English: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

tcz: Chuti ahileh ikatia pha ham? Keima Lhagaovin tao ingting, chule kahetna thuchenga jong tao vinge. Keiman Lhagaovin la sangting, chule kahet thei thuchenga la sang kate.
en: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
text:
1CO 14:15
Thadou: Chuti ahileh ikatia pha ham? Keima Lhagaovin tao ingting, chule kahetna thuchenga jong tao vinge. Keiman Lhagaovin la sangting, chule kahet thei thuchenga la sang kate.
English: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

tcz: Ajehchu nangman Pathen chu lhagao bouva na vahchoi ahileh, nangma nahe loubeh ho tochun Pathen chu iti navahchoi khom thei dingu ham? Nangman ipi nasei ahijong helou ho chu thangvahnaa iti nangma to pangkhom thei dingu ham?
en: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
text:
1CO 14:16
Thadou: Ajehchu nangman Pathen chu lhagao bouva na vahchoi ahileh, nangma nahe loubeh ho tochun Pathen chu iti navahchoi khom thei dingu ham? Nangman ipi nasei ahijong helou ho chu thangvahnaa iti nangma to pangkhom thei dingu ham?
English: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

tcz: Nangman thangvahna chu phatah in penan nate, hinla nangma thangvahna chun miho chu thahatsahna pechomdeh ponte.
en: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
text:
1CO 14:17
Thadou: Nangman thangvahna chu phatah in penan nate, hinla nangma thangvahna chun miho chu thahatsahna pechomdeh ponte.
English: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

tcz: Nangho chengse koipen sanga pao kaha thothei joh jal jeh hin Pathen kathangvah in ahi.
en: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
text:
1CO 14:18
Thadou: Nangho chengse koipen sanga pao kaha thothei joh jal jeh hin Pathen kathangvah in ahi.
English: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

tcz: Hinlah houbung kikhop khomna a keiman hettheiya thucheng nga seidoh ding chu hetlou paova thucheng sangsom seisang in kanomjoi.
en: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
text:
1CO 14:19
Thadou: Hinlah houbung kikhop khomna a keiman hettheiya thucheng nga seidoh ding chu hetlou paova thucheng sangsom seisang in kanomjoi.
English: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, hicheho hetkhenna a hin chapang ngol bang hih un. Aselam ahipouva ahileh khohelou chapang tobang hiuvin, hinla hetkhen themna lampang thua pilhing tah hiuvin.
en: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
text:
1CO 14:20
Thadou: Sopi deitah teho, hicheho hetkhenna a hin chapang ngol bang hih un. Aselam ahipouva ahileh khohelou chapang tobang hiuvin, hinla hetkhen themna lampang thua pilhing tah hiuvin.
English: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen Thubua akisun'e, “Keiman kamite ho jah a pao jahkhahlou ho kaman ding chule gamdang mi ho kamanchah ding ahi. Ahijeng vang'in, hiche jenga jong chu amaho kasei thua nunglou dingu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”
text:
1CO 14:21
Thadou: Hiche hi Pathen Thubua akisun'e, “Keiman kamite ho jah a pao jahkhahlou ho kaman ding chule gamdang mi ho kamanchah ding ahi. Ahijeng vang'in, hiche jenga jong chu amaho kasei thua nunglou dingu ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
English: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

tcz: Hitia hi nangman paochomchom tho hi atahsan ho dinga hilouva atahsan louho dinga amel chihna ahi ti nahetai. Pathen Thuseidoh vang hi atahsanlou hoa ding hilouva, atahsan hoa ding ahi.
en: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
text:
1CO 14:22
Thadou: Hitia hi nangman paochomchom tho hi atahsan ho dinga hilouva atahsan louho dinga amel chihna ahi ti nahetai. Pathen Thuseidoh vang hi atahsanlou hoa ding hilouva, atahsan hoa ding ahi.
English: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, hitiho hetna neilou ahilouleh atahsanlou ho hu'ah na-houbung uva hungu henlang, chule amichang cheh in hetlou paova thu kisei chu jataleu amaho chun angol uva ahitai tia agel dingu ahi.
en: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
text:
1CO 14:23
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, hitiho hetna neilou ahilouleh atahsanlou ho hu'ah na-houbung uva hungu henlang, chule amichang cheh in hetlou paova thu kisei chu jataleu amaho chun angol uva ahitai tia agel dingu ahi.
English: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

tcz: Hinlah nangho jousen Pathen Thu naseiyuva, atahsan lou khat ahilouleh miho hicheho hetna neilou nakikhop nauva hung uleh, amahon chonsetna kigeldoh uvintin chule nathuseiyu chun athu atan ding ahi.
en: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
text:
1CO 14:24
Thadou: Hinlah nangho jousen Pathen Thu naseiyuva, atahsan lou khat ahilouleh miho hicheho hetna neilou nakikhop nauva hung uleh, amahon chonsetna kigeldoh uvintin chule nathuseiyu chun athu atan ding ahi.
English: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

tcz: Amahon angaiyuva ahileh, aguhthim thu uchu kilangdoh intin, chule amaho chu akhup uva dilsu uvintin chule Pathen ahou uva, “Hikom'a nalah uva hin Pathen aume ati dingu ahi.”
en: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
text:
1CO 14:25
Thadou: Amahon angaiyuva ahileh, aguhthim thu uchu kilangdoh intin, chule amaho chu akhup uva dilsu uvintin chule Pathen ahou uva, “Hikom'a nalah uva hin Pathen aume ati dingu ahi.”
English: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

tcz: Aphai, kasopiteho, seichom leuhen, Nangho nakikhop khom teng uleh mi khat'in lasa hen, midang khat'in thuhil hen, achom dangma chun Pathen in ahenga gotchombeh a aphondoh chu sei hen, mikhat'in paochom chom tho henlang, chule michom khat in ipi kiseina ahi chu ledoh hen. Ahin akibol jouse chu nangho jouse tahsan hatsahna hihen.
en: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
text:
1CO 14:26
Thadou: Aphai, kasopiteho, seichom leuhen, Nangho nakikhop khom teng uleh mi khat'in lasa hen, midang khat'in thuhil hen, achom dangma chun Pathen in ahenga gotchombeh a aphondoh chu sei hen, mikhat'in paochom chom tho henlang, chule michom khat in ipi kiseina ahi chu ledoh hen. Ahin akibol jouse chu nangho jouse tahsan hatsahna hihen.
English: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

tcz: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum kalvalin paoho thoda hen. Amaho chun amasan khatbou seisah uhen, chule amahon aseiyu chu mikhat'in ipi asei chu ledoh peh pai hen.
en: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
text:
1CO 14:27
Thadou: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum kalvalin paoho thoda hen. Amaho chun amasan khatbou seisah uhen, chule amahon aseiyu chu mikhat'in ipi asei chu ledoh peh pai hen.
English: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

tcz: Hinlah koima alethei aumlouva ahileh, amaho chu nakikhop nauva chun thipbeh in touvu hen, chule achang uvin Pathen koma seijo uhen.
en: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.
text:
1CO 14:28
Thadou: Hinlah koima alethei aumlouva ahileh, amaho chu nakikhop nauva chun thipbeh in touvu hen, chule achang uvin Pathen koma seijo uhen.
English: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

tcz: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum'in gaothu seiyuhen, chule midangsen akiseidoh cheng chu datkhenna neiyuhen.
en: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.
text:
1CO 14:29
Thadou: Mi-ni ahilouleh mi-thum'in gaothu seiyuhen, chule midangsen akiseidoh cheng chu datkhenna neiyuhen.
English: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

tcz: Ahin koiham khat'in Pathen Thu aseiya chule michom dang khat in Pakaiya kona thuphondoh amu leh, Thuseipa chu thip jeng hen.
en: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
text:
1CO 14:30
Thadou: Ahin koiham khat'in Pathen Thu aseiya chule michom dang khat in Pakaiya kona thuphondoh amu leh, Thuseipa chu thip jeng hen.
English: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

tcz: Hitia hi Pathen Thusei hon thuseina phat banneicha anei cheh dingu, hitia hi amichang cheh in hetna anei dingu chule kitilkhou ding ahitauve.
en: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.
text:
1CO 14:31
Thadou: Hitia hi Pathen Thusei hon thuseina phat banneicha anei cheh dingu, hitia hi amichang cheh in hetna anei dingu chule kitilkhou ding ahitauve.
English: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

tcz: Pathen Thusei chun alhagaovu kithunun theina aneiyun, chule ama phat akinga theidiu ahiye.
en: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
text:
1CO 14:32
Thadou: Pathen Thusei chun alhagaovu kithunun theina aneiyun, chule ama phat akinga theidiu ahiye.
English: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi akisunohphah thei Pathen ahipoi hinla cham-lungmon Pathen hijoa ahi, Pathen mithengte ho kikhop khomna jouse ngai bangin.
en: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
text:
1CO 14:33
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen hi akisunohphah thei Pathen ahipoi hinla cham-lungmon Pathen hijoa ahi, Pathen mithengte ho kikhop khomna jouse ngai bangin.
English: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

tcz: Numeiho hi houbung kaikhomna a thipbeh ding ahiuve. Amaho dingin thusei chu alompoi. Amaho thunoiya um dingu, chonna danin asei tobang hidiu ahi.
en: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
text:
1CO 14:34
Thadou: Numeiho hi houbung kaikhomna a thipbeh ding ahiuve. Amaho dingin thusei chu alompoi. Amaho thunoiya um dingu, chonna danin asei tobang hidiu ahi.
English: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

tcz: Amahon thudoh nom aneiyuva ahileh ajipateu inmuna akidoh dingu ahi, ajeh chu numei ho dinga houbung kikhop khomna a thusei chu umdan dihlou ahi.
en: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
text:
1CO 14:35
Thadou: Amahon thudoh nom aneiyuva ahileh ajipateu inmuna akidoh dingu ahi, ajeh chu numei ho dinga houbung kikhop khomna a thusei chu umdan dihlou ahi.
English: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

tcz: Ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi nangho Corinth mite ho a pat'a hung kipan'ah ahi tia ngaitoa nahiuvem? Nangho kom bouva Thu hi kipedoh a nangaitou ham?
en: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
text:
1CO 14:36
Thadou: Ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi nangho Corinth mite ho a pat'a hung kipan'ah ahi tia ngaitoa nahiuvem? Nangho kom bouva Thu hi kipedoh a nangaitou ham?
English: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

tcz: Nangho themgaova nakigel uva ahilouleh lhagao mia kigel nahiuleh, keiman nangho kaseipeh hi Pakai Amatah a kona thupeh ahi.
en: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
text:
1CO 14:37
Thadou: Nangho themgaova nakigel uva ahilouleh lhagao mia kigel nahiuleh, keiman nangho kaseipeh hi Pakai Amatah a kona thupeh ahi.
English: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon hiche hi nahet dohlou uva ahileh, nangho tah jong hetdoh nahilou dingu ahi.
en: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
text:
1CO 14:38
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon hiche hi nahet dohlou uva ahileh, nangho tah jong hetdoh nahilou dingu ahi.
English: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

tcz: Hitihin, kasopi deitah teho, Pathen Thusei nomna neiyun, chule paochom chom tho jong jada hih un.
en: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
text:
1CO 14:39
Thadou: Hitihin, kasopi deitah teho, Pathen Thusei nomna neiyun, chule paochom chom tho jong jada hih un.
English: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

tcz: Hinlah imalam jouseah kitup tah le kisuhsela bola hiuvin.
en: Let all things be done decently and in order.
text:
1CO 14:40
Thadou: Hinlah imalam jouseah kitup tah le kisuhsela bola hiuvin.
English: Let all things be done decently and in order.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, tumasanga naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahung lhangsap thu chu keiman nahin geldoh sahkit uvinge. Chupet chun nasang uvin chule tugeiyin nading det jing nauvin ahi.
en: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
text:
1CO 15:1
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, tumasanga naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahung lhangsap thu chu keiman nahin geldoh sahkit uvinge. Chupet chun nasang uvin chule tugeiyin nading det jing nauvin ahi.
English: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

tcz: Keiman najah uva kaseipeh u thu chu natahsan jom jing uva ahileh hiche Kipana Thupha chun nahuhhingu ahi–apat a pat'a adihlou thu chu tahsana nahilou pouva ahileh.
en: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
text:
1CO 15:2
Thadou: Keiman najah uva kaseipeh u thu chu natahsan jom jing uva ahileh hiche Kipana Thupha chun nahuhhingu ahi–apat a pat'a adihlou thu chu tahsana nahilou pouva ahileh.
English: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

tcz: Keiman naheng uva akhohpen tah keima henga ana kipe chu kahin pehson nahiuve–Christa chu Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin ichonset jal'un athin ahi.
en: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
text:
1CO 15:3
Thadou: Keiman naheng uva akhohpen tah keima henga ana kipe chu kahin pehson nahiuve–Christa chu Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin ichonset jal'un athin ahi.
English: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

tcz: Ama chu akivuiyin, chule Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, ani-thum nin athoudohtai.
en: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
text:
1CO 15:4
Thadou: Ama chu akivuiyin, chule Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, ani-thum nin athoudohtai.
English: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

tcz: Ama chu Peter in amun chujouvin somle ni ho chun amu uve.
en: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
text:
1CO 15:5
Thadou: Ama chu Peter in amun chujouvin somle ni ho chun amu uve.
English: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

tcz: Chujouvin, khatveiyin anung jui mi janga val hon khatvei mun amuvin ahi, amaholah a atamjo ahing nalaiyun, hinla phabep chu athi tauve.
en: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
text:
1CO 15:6
Thadou: Chujouvin, khatveiyin anung jui mi janga val hon khatvei mun amuvin ahi, amaholah a atamjo ahing nalaiyun, hinla phabep chu athi tauve.
English: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

tcz: Chupet in Jacob in ama chu amun chujouvin solchah jousen amu uve.
en: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
text:
1CO 15:7
Thadou: Chupet in Jacob in ama chu amun chujouvin solchah jousen amu uve.
English: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

tcz: Achaina keiyin, aphat louva peng bangin, keiman jong Ama chu kamun ahi.
en: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
text:
1CO 15:8
Thadou: Achaina keiyin, aphat louva peng bangin, keiman jong Ama chu kamun ahi.
English: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

tcz: Ajehchu keima solchah ho jouse lah a imacha hiloupen kahi. Ahimongin Pathen houbung ana gimbol hesoh a kahi jeh hin solchah ti dinga jong kiloma kahipoi.
en: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
text:
1CO 15:9
Thadou: Ajehchu keima solchah ho jouse lah a imacha hiloupen kahi. Ahimongin Pathen houbung ana gimbol hesoh a kahi jeh hin solchah ti dinga jong kiloma kahipoi.
English: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

tcz: Hinlah tun ipi thu um jongleh kahi ahi, Pathen in alungsetna chu kachunga asunlhah ahitah jeh hin-chule hichu phatchomna bei ahidehpoi. Ajeh chu keiman solchah dangho sangin na kaha tohgimjon, hinla hichu keijoh hita louva Pathen in alungsetnaa keiya na atoh ahijo bouve.
en: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
text:
1CO 15:10
Thadou: Hinlah tun ipi thu um jongleh kahi ahi, Pathen in alungsetna chu kachunga asunlhah ahitah jeh hin-chule hichu phatchomna bei ahidehpoi. Ajeh chu keiman solchah dangho sangin na kaha tohgimjon, hinla hichu keijoh hita louva Pathen in alungsetnaa keiya na atoh ahijo bouve.
English: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

tcz: Hinlah hiche hi neiseipeh un-Christa chu thinaa konin athoutai katiu leh, itidan'a nalah uva phabep in athiho thokitna aumpoi tia nahiu ham?
en: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
text:
1CO 15:12
Thadou: Hinlah hiche hi neiseipeh un-Christa chu thinaa konin athoutai katiu leh, itidan'a nalah uva phabep in athiho thokitna aumpoi tia nahiu ham?
English: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

tcz: Ajehchu athiho thokitna aumlouva ahileh Christa jong chu kaithouva um dehlou hiding ahitai.
en: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
text:
1CO 15:13
Thadou: Ajehchu athiho thokitna aumlouva ahileh Christa jong chu kaithouva um dehlou hiding ahitai.
English: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

tcz: Chule Christa chu kaithoulou anahita leh, thu kaseiphong leu hi mohseh hita ding, chule natahsan'u jong chu mohseh hiding ahitai.
en: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.
text:
1CO 15:14
Thadou: Chule Christa chu kaithoulou anahita leh, thu kaseiphong leu hi mohseh hita ding, chule natahsan'u jong chu mohseh hiding ahitai.
English: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

tcz: Chule solchah keiho jouse jong hi Pathen lamdola jousei kahi dingu ahitai-ajeh chu keihon Christa chu Pathen in lhan'a konin akaithouve kana tiu ahi. Hinlah thokitna aumlouva ahileh hiche kisei chu dih theilou ding ahitai.
en: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.
text:
1CO 15:15
Thadou: Chule solchah keiho jouse jong hi Pathen lamdola jousei kahi dingu ahitai-ajeh chu keihon Christa chu Pathen in lhan'a konin akaithouve kana tiu ahi. Hinlah thokitna aumlouva ahileh hiche kisei chu dih theilou ding ahitai.
English: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

tcz: Chule athiho thokitna chu umlou hitaleh, Christa chu kaithou hilouding ahitai.
en: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
text:
1CO 15:16
Thadou: Chule athiho thokitna chu umlou hitaleh, Christa chu kaithou hilouding ahitai.
English: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

tcz: Chule Christa chu kaithou hilou anahi khah leh, natahsanu chu panna bei hiding chule nangho hi nachonset nauvin themmo nachanjing nahlai dingu ahiye.
en: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
text:
1CO 15:17
Thadou: Chule Christa chu kaithou hilou anahi khah leh, natahsanu chu panna bei hiding chule nangho hi nachonset nauvin themmo nachanjing nahlai dingu ahiye.
English: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

tcz: Hiche chung chang thua hi, Christa tahsana thiho jouse chu mang thah hidiu ahitai.
en: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
text:
1CO 15:18
Thadou: Hiche chung chang thua hi, Christa tahsana thiho jouse chu mang thah hidiu ahitai.
English: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

tcz: Chule Christa itahsanu hi tuhinkhoa ding bou hita leh, vannoiya midang jouse sanga khoto umpen ihi dingu ahitai.
en: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
text:
1CO 15:19
Thadou: Chule Christa itahsanu hi tuhinkhoa ding bou hita leh, vannoiya midang jouse sanga khoto umpen ihi dingu ahitai.
English: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

tcz: Hinlah, Christa chu athiho lah a konin kaithou ahitah behnai. Ama athiho jouse lah a aga masapen chu ahitai.
en: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.
text:
1CO 15:20
Thadou: Hinlah, Christa chu athiho lah a konin kaithou ahitah behnai. Ama athiho jouse lah a aga masapen chu ahitai.
English: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

tcz: Hitia hi mikhat jal'a vannoi a thina ahunglhun banga chu, athiho lah'a kona thokitna hi michom khat jal'a hiding ahi.
en: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
text:
1CO 15:21
Thadou: Hitia hi mikhat jal'a vannoi a thina ahunglhun banga chu, athiho lah'a kona thokitna hi michom khat jal'a hiding ahi.
English: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

tcz: Eiho ibonchauva Adama hungkon ihijeh uva ithi sohkei dingu ahi tobanga, Christaa hiho jouse chu hinkho thah kipe ding ahi.
en: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
text:
1CO 15:22
Thadou: Eiho ibonchauva Adama hungkon ihijeh uva ithi sohkei dingu ahi tobanga, Christaa hiho jouse chu hinkho thah kipe ding ahi.
English: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

tcz: Hinlah hiche thokitna thudol a hin akigontoh dol aume. Christa chu ga kiloh masapen ahi, abana Christaa thiho jouse chu Ama ahungkit tengleh kaithouva umding ahitai.
en: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.
text:
1CO 15:23
Thadou: Hinlah hiche thokitna thudol a hin akigontoh dol aume. Christa chu ga kiloh masapen ahi, abana Christaa thiho jouse chu Ama ahungkit tengleh kaithouva umding ahitai.
English: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

tcz: Aman vaipoho le athunei ho chule athanei ho chu asuhmang soh jou tengleh, Lenggam chu Pa Pathen koma apehdoh a chujou tah leh achaina hung hiding ahi.
en: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
text:
1CO 15:24
Thadou: Aman vaipoho le athunei ho chule athanei ho chu asuhmang soh jou tengleh, Lenggam chu Pa Pathen koma apehdoh a chujou tah leh achaina hung hiding ahi.
English: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

tcz: Ajehchu Christa hin Amelmate jouse chu akengto noiya akoi tokahsea vai ahom tei ding ahi.
en: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
text:
1CO 15:25
Thadou: Ajehchu Christa hin Amelmate jouse chu akengto noiya akoi tokahsea vai ahom tei ding ahi.
English: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

tcz: Chule melma anunungpen akisumang ding chu thina ahi.
en: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
text:
1CO 15:26
Thadou: Chule melma anunungpen akisumang ding chu thina ahi.
English: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Pathen in ijakai Ama thunoiya akoisohkei ahitai,” ati. *(Hichea, “ijakai Ama thuneina noiya akoi” kiti hin Pathen Ama akijaosah thapoi, Ama chun Christa hi Athuneina apehdoh joh ahibouve).
en: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
text:
1CO 15:27
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Pathen in ijakai Ama thunoiya akoisohkei ahitai,” ati. *(Hichea, “ijakai Ama thuneina noiya akoi” kiti hin Pathen Ama akijaosah thapoi, Ama chun Christa hi Athuneina apehdoh joh ahibouve).
English: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

tcz: Aman ijakai athunoiya akoisohkei tengleh, Chapa Amatah jong chu Pathen thunoiya kikhum lut intin, Pathen Achapa ijakai chunga thuneina pepa chu, ijakai a achungvuma imalam jousea athunei hiding ahitai.
en: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
text:
1CO 15:28
Thadou: Aman ijakai athunoiya akoisohkei tengleh, Chapa Amatah jong chu Pathen thunoiya kikhum lut intin, Pathen Achapa ijakai chunga thuneina pepa chu, ijakai a achungvuma imalam jousea athunei hiding ahitai.
English: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

tcz: Athisaho kaithouva umlou ding ahia ahileh, thi jal'a baptize chanlona ajeh ipiba hitantem? Athiho chu nikhat le kaithou ding ahilou leh ipi bol ngaiya ham?
en: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
text:
1CO 15:29
Thadou: Athisaho kaithouva umlou ding ahia ahileh, thi jal'a baptize chanlona ajeh ipiba hitantem? Athiho chu nikhat le kaithou ding ahilou leh ipi bol ngaiya ham?
English: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

tcz: Chule ipi dinga aphat phat a keiho hin kahinkhou hi hahsatna kathoh jiu hintem?
en: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
text:
1CO 15:30
Thadou: Chule ipi dinga aphat phat a keiho hin kahinkhou hi hahsatna kathoh jiu hintem?
English: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

tcz: Ajehchu kasopiteho, kihahselna theijin keiman anitinin thina kakimaitopi jinge. I Pakaiyu Christa Yeshuan nanghoa anatoh hi keima kakiletsahna tahbeh chu ahi.
en: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
text:
1CO 15:31
Thadou: Ajehchu kasopiteho, kihahselna theijin keiman anitinin thina kakimaitopi jinge. I Pakaiyu Christa Yeshuan nanghoa anatoh hi keima kakiletsahna tahbeh chu ahi.
English: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

tcz: Chule gamsaho toh (Ephesus khomite toh) kakidel lona ipi phatchomna hintem? Athisaho thokitna umlou ding ahia ahileh? Chule thokitna aum louva ahileh, “Eiho kivah'u hitin, donu hite, ajeh chu ajinga kithi tading chu!” itidiu ahitai.
en: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
text:
1CO 15:32
Thadou: Chule gamsaho toh (Ephesus khomite toh) kakidel lona ipi phatchomna hintem? Athisaho thokitna umlou ding ahia ahileh? Chule thokitna aum louva ahileh, “Eiho kivah'u hitin, donu hite, ajeh chu ajinga kithi tading chu!” itidiu ahitai.
English: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

tcz: Chutobanga thusei ho chu kingol bolsah hih un, ajeh chu, “kivoppi phalouvin chon chan phalou asoji,” kitia ahi.
en: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
text:
1CO 15:33
Thadou: Chutobanga thusei ho chu kingol bolsah hih un, ajeh chu, “kivoppi phalouvin chon chan phalou asoji,” kitia ahi.
English: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

tcz: Adih chu ipipen ahi geltoh uvin lang, chule chonse tahih un. Ajeh chu hiche hi naja chatna ding uva kasei doh ahi, nangho mi phabep Pathen he tahbeh lou nahiuve.
en: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
text:
1CO 15:34
Thadou: Adih chu ipipen ahi geltoh uvin lang, chule chonse tahih un. Ajeh chu hiche hi naja chatna ding uva kasei doh ahi, nangho mi phabep Pathen he tahbeh lou nahiuve.
English: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

tcz: Hinlah khat touvin, “Mithiho itobanga thoudoh dingu ham? Itobang tahsa pum anei dingu ham?” tin dongun te.
en: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
text:
1CO 15:35
Thadou: Hinlah khat touvin, “Mithiho itobanga thoudoh dingu ham? Itobang tahsa pum anei dingu ham?” tin dongun te.
English: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

tcz: Itobang ngol hoi thudoh hitam! Nangman muchi tol'a natu chu athi kahsen ahung kehdoh theipoi.
en: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
text:
1CO 15:36
Thadou: Itobang ngol hoi thudoh hitam! Nangman muchi tol'a natu chu athi kahsen ahung kehdoh theipoi.
English: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

tcz: Chule nangman leiset a nakoi chu suhlouchang mu hihen ipi pen chu natulut hita jongleh aphung ahung khang ding chu ahihih laiye.
en: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
text:
1CO 15:37
Thadou: Chule nangman leiset a nakoi chu suhlouchang mu hihen ipi pen chu natulut hita jongleh aphung ahung khang ding chu ahihih laiye.
English: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

tcz: Chutengleh Pathen in ahin hisahnom ding vouthah chu ahinpeh ding ahi. Muchi khat cheh a kona chu thingphung chom chom hung khang touva ahi.
en: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
text:
1CO 15:38
Thadou: Chutengleh Pathen in ahin hisahnom ding vouthah chu ahinpeh ding ahi. Muchi khat cheh a kona chu thingphung chom chom hung khang touva ahi.
English: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

tcz: Chutobangma a chu tahsa pum jong jatchom chom ahi, mihem tahsa pum le ganhingho tahsa pum, vacha ho tahsa pum, chule ajat chombeh nga tahsa pum geiya uma ahi.
en: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
text:
1CO 15:39
Thadou: Chutobangma a chu tahsa pum jong jatchom chom ahi, mihem tahsa pum le ganhingho tahsa pum, vacha ho tahsa pum, chule ajat chombeh nga tahsa pum geiya uma ahi.
English: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

tcz: Leiset a tipumho aum tobang'in, Van'a jong tipumho aumin ahi. Van'a tahsapum loupina chu leiset'a tahsapum loupina toh ajatchomin ahi.
en: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
text:
1CO 15:40
Thadou: Leiset a tipumho aum tobang'in, Van'a jong tipumho aumin ahi. Van'a tahsapum loupina chu leiset'a tahsapum loupina toh ajatchomin ahi.
English: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

tcz: Nisa hin loupina jatkhat aneiyin, lhale ahsi hon jong khat cheh hina ma anei cheh uve. Ahsiho jeng jong khat khat hi aloupinau ajatchom cheh in ahi.
en: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
text:
1CO 15:41
Thadou: Nisa hin loupina jatkhat aneiyin, lhale ahsi hon jong khat cheh hina ma anei cheh uve. Ahsiho jeng jong khat khat hi aloupinau ajatchom cheh in ahi.
English: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

tcz: Mithiho thokitna jong chutobangma chu ahi. Leiset a itahsau hi ithiteng uleh leinoiya iphumlut jiuvin, hinla aitih a hing jing dinga hung thoudoh ding ahiuve.
en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
text:
1CO 15:42
Thadou: Mithiho thokitna jong chutobangma chu ahi. Leiset a itahsau hi ithiteng uleh leinoiya iphumlut jiuvin, hinla aitih a hing jing dinga hung thoudoh ding ahiuve.
English: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

tcz: Itahsau hi abong abaija kiphumlut a ahin, hinla hicheho hi loupina a hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Amaho hi thanei louva kivuilut'ah ahin, hinla thahat'a hungthoudoh ding ahiuve.
en: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
text:
1CO 15:43
Thadou: Itahsau hi abong abaija kiphumlut a ahin, hinla hicheho hi loupina a hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Amaho hi thanei louva kivuilut'ah ahin, hinla thahat'a hungthoudoh ding ahiuve.
English: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

tcz: Amaho hi angaiya mihem vouphea kivuiya ahiuvin, hinla amaho hi lhagaolam vouphea hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu angaidol'a tahsa vouphe aum tobanga chu lhagaolam dola vouphe aumin ahi.
en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
text:
1CO 15:44
Thadou: Amaho hi angaiya mihem vouphea kivuiya ahiuvin, hinla amaho hi lhagaolam vouphea hung thoudoh ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu angaidol'a tahsa vouphe aum tobanga chu lhagaolam dola vouphe aumin ahi.
English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

tcz: Pathen Thubun, “Mimasa Adam chu hinna nei mihem ahunghi,” tin eiseipeh uvin ahi. Hinlah Adam nunungpa chu, Christa kiseina, hinna pea Lhagao ahi.
en: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
text:
1CO 15:45
Thadou: Pathen Thubun, “Mimasa Adam chu hinna nei mihem ahunghi,” tin eiseipeh uvin ahi. Hinlah Adam nunungpa chu, Christa kiseina, hinna pea Lhagao ahi.
English: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

tcz: Amasa tahsa tipumho hung um masaa chujouva lhagaova tipumho chu khonunga hung uma ahi.
en: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
text:
1CO 15:46
Thadou: Amasa tahsa tipumho hung um masaa chujouva lhagaova tipumho chu khonunga hung uma ahi.
English: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

tcz: Mimasa Adam chu leiset leivuiya kona kisema ahin, mihem aninapa Christa chu Vana kona hung'ah ahi.
en: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
text:
1CO 15:47
Thadou: Mimasa Adam chu leiset leivuiya kona kisema ahin, mihem aninapa Christa chu Vana kona hung'ah ahi.
English: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

tcz: Leiset mite hi leiset mihem chuto akilou uvin, chule van'a mite chu van'a hungkonpa tobang ahiuve.
en: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
text:
1CO 15:48
Thadou: Leiset mite hi leiset mihem chuto akilou uvin, chule van'a mite chu van'a hungkonpa tobang ahiuve.
English: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

tcz: Tua hi eiho leiset a mihempa tobang chu ihiuvin, phatkhatle vana hungkonpa tobang chu ihunghi dingu ahi.
en: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
text:
1CO 15:49
Thadou: Tua hi eiho leiset a mihempa tobang chu ihiuvin, phatkhatle vana hungkonpa tobang chu ihunghi dingu ahi.
English: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, keiman kaseihi, itahsapheu hin Pathen Lenggam alotheipoi. Hiche thithei tahsaphe hin tonsot'a umding gou alotheipoi.
en: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
text:
1CO 15:50
Thadou: Kasopi deitahteho, keiman kaseihi, itahsapheu hin Pathen Lenggam alotheipoi. Hiche thithei tahsaphe hin tonsot'a umding gou alotheipoi.
English: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

tcz: Hinlah keiman thuguh kidangtah naphondohpeh uvinge. Eiho jouse ibonchauva ithi sohkei dingu hilou, hinla ibonchauva vouso kikhel ding ihiuve.
en: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
text:
1CO 15:51
Thadou: Hinlah keiman thuguh kidangtah naphondohpeh uvinge. Eiho jouse ibonchauva ithi sohkei dingu hilou, hinla ibonchauva vouso kikhel ding ihiuve.
English: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

tcz: Hichu phulou helouva, mitphetkah sunga sumkon nunungpen chu hung kimutging ding ahi. Ajeh chu sumkon chu ahung kimut ging tengleh, Pakaiya anathisaho chu vou kikhel a thoudoh diu ahi. Chule eiho ahing chengse ivouvu kikhel ding tonsot'a hingding ihitauve.
en: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
text:
1CO 15:52
Thadou: Hichu phulou helouva, mitphetkah sunga sumkon nunungpen chu hung kimutging ding ahi. Ajeh chu sumkon chu ahung kimut ging tengleh, Pakaiya anathisaho chu vou kikhel a thoudoh diu ahi. Chule eiho ahing chengse ivouvu kikhel ding tonsot'a hingding ihitauve.
English: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

tcz: Ajehchu athi ding itahsau hi thilouhel ding tahsavouva kikhel ding, athithei itahsau hi athitheitalou tahsa voupua kikhel ding ahitai.
en: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
text:
1CO 15:53
Thadou: Ajehchu athi ding itahsau hi thilouhel ding tahsavouva kikhel ding, athithei itahsau hi athitheitalou tahsa voupua kikhel ding ahitai.
English: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

tcz: Chuteng, athiding tahsa ineihou hi athi talou ding tahsahoa ahung kikhel tengleh, hiche Pathen Thubu in asei, “Thina chu jonain avallhumtai”
en: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
text:
1CO 15:54
Thadou: Chuteng, athiding tahsa ineihou hi athi talou ding tahsahoa ahung kikhel tengleh, hiche Pathen Thubu in asei, “Thina chu jonain avallhumtai”
English: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

tcz: “Vo thina, hoibaham namijo na? Vo thina, hoibaham namide na?” kiti chu guilhung ding ahi.
en: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
text:
1CO 15:55
Thadou: “Vo thina, hoibaham namijo na? Vo thina, hoibaham namide na?” kiti chu guilhung ding ahi.
English: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

tcz: Ajehchu chonset hi thina a dinga midep'a panga ahi, chule Danthu hin chonset thaneina apeh ahi.
en: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
text:
1CO 15:56
Thadou: Ajehchu chonset hi thina a dinga midep'a panga ahi, chule Danthu hin chonset thaneina apeh ahi.
English: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman chonset le thina jo jou theina I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'in eipeuvin ahi.
en: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
1CO 15:57
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman chonset le thina jo jou theina I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal'in eipeuvin ahi.
English: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hijeh chun, kasopi deitah teho, hat'un chule suhlong theilouvin pangun. Pakaiya dingin thanomtah in tong jingun, ajeh chu nathil bolu chu Pakaiya dingin phatchomna bei imacha aumpoi ti naheuve.
en: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
text:
1CO 15:58
Thadou: Hijeh chun, kasopi deitah teho, hat'un chule suhlong theilouvin pangun. Pakaiya dingin thanomtah in tong jingun, ajeh chu nathil bolu chu Pakaiya dingin phatchomna bei imacha aumpoi ti naheuve.
English: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

tcz: Tun Jerusalema Pathen mite dinga neitokhomna sum thua neihin doh nauva hin, nang hon jong Galatia gamkai pumpia houbungho henga ajui dingu kapeh chu najui dinguva katem nahiuve.
en: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
text:
1CO 16:1
Thadou: Tun Jerusalema Pathen mite dinga neitokhomna sum thua neihin doh nauva hin, nang hon jong Galatia gamkai pumpia houbungho henga ajui dingu kapeh chu najui dinguva katem nahiuve.
English: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

tcz: Hapta seh a ni masapen nileh, nasum kilodoh uva kon chun atatoh kham bep anakoi doh uvin. Keima kahunglhuna khatvei lah a kahung lahkhom tokah ngah hih uvin.
en: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.
text:
1CO 16:2
Thadou: Hapta seh a ni masapen nileh, nasum kilodoh uva kon chun atatoh kham bep anakoi doh uvin. Keima kahunglhuna khatvei lah a kahung lahkhom tokah ngah hih uvin.
English: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

tcz: Keima kahung tengleh, nathilpeh u Jerusalema podinga nalhen doh hou dinga seiphatna lekhathot kajih ding ahi.
en: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
text:
1CO 16:3
Thadou: Keima kahung tengleh, nathilpeh u Jerusalema podinga nalhen doh hou dinga seiphatna lekhathot kajih ding ahi.
English: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

tcz: Chule keima dinga amaho toh lhon ding chu ahimona aum louva ahileh, keima tojong kaki lhon theiyu ahi.
en: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
text:
1CO 16:4
Thadou: Chule keima dinga amaho toh lhon ding chu ahimona aum louva ahileh, keima tojong kaki lhon theiyu ahi.
English: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

tcz: Keima Macedonia kache jou tengleh nangho vil dinga naheng uva kahung ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Macedonia a kona hung kholjin ding kalunggon ahi.
en: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
text:
1CO 16:5
Thadou: Keima Macedonia kache jou tengleh nangho vil dinga naheng uva kahung ding ahi, ajeh chu keima Macedonia a kona hung kholjin ding kalunggon ahi.
English: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

tcz: Ijem itileh phat chomkhat, phalbi sunga nangho to umkhom kanomin, chujou tengleh aban kachena ding alampi nei gonpeh uva neisol theiyu ahitai.
en: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
text:
1CO 16:6
Thadou: Ijem itileh phat chomkhat, phalbi sunga nangho to umkhom kanomin, chujou tengleh aban kachena ding alampi nei gonpeh uva neisol theiyu ahitai.
English: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

tcz: Tuchunga hi nangho chomcha hungvila chule aban chebe ding ti kagongpoi. Keima kahunga Pakaiyin eiphatsah ahileh chomkhat beh um ding kanop ahi.
en: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
text:
1CO 16:7
Thadou: Tuchunga hi nangho chomcha hungvila chule aban chebe ding ti kagongpoi. Keima kahunga Pakaiyin eiphatsah ahileh chomkhat beh um ding kanop ahi.
English: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

tcz: Tutadi hin, Pentecost Kut lhunkah a dingin Ephesus khopia hin um inge.
en: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
text:
1CO 16:8
Thadou: Tutadi hin, Pentecost Kut lhunkah a dingin Ephesus khopia hin um inge.
English: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

tcz: Hikoma natoh lentah tohna dingin kot lentah akihongin, hinla eidouva mi tamtah aumun ahi.
en: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
text:
1CO 16:9
Thadou: Hikoma natoh lentah tohna dingin kot lentah akihongin, hinla eidouva mi tamtah aumun ahi.
English: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

tcz: Timothy ahung tengleh, engbolna ima neihih un. Aman keima Pakai natoh katoh tobanga hi Pakai na chu atoh ahiye.
en: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
text:
1CO 16:10
Thadou: Timothy ahung tengleh, engbolna ima neihih un. Aman keima Pakai natoh katoh tobanga hi Pakai na chu atoh ahiye.
English: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

tcz: Koiman amahi hutum le gihna nei dauhen. Ama kaheng lama ahung kile tengleh na phatthei nau pumin hinsol un. Amahi atahsan midangto ahung kilhon ding kakinemin ahi.
en: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
text:
1CO 16:11
Thadou: Koiman amahi hutum le gihna nei dauhen. Ama kaheng lama ahung kile tengleh na phatthei nau pumin hinsol un. Amahi atahsan midangto ahung kilhon ding kakinemin ahi.
English: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

tcz: Tun isopiu Apollos chung changa hin–keiman ama chun atahsan sopi dang ho toh nahung vilna dingun katemin ahi, hinla tutadin ama achenom hih laiye. Aman phat kijen dom phat dang anei teng nahung vil dingu ahi.
en: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
text:
1CO 16:12
Thadou: Tun isopiu Apollos chung changa hin–keiman ama chun atahsan sopi dang ho toh nahung vilna dingun katemin ahi, hinla tutadin ama achenom hih laiye. Aman phat kijen dom phat dang anei teng nahung vil dingu ahi.
English: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

tcz: Kihong phauvin, Tahsanna'a chun dingdet'un, Lung ngam'un. Hat'un.
en: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
text:
1CO 16:13
Thadou: Kihong phauvin, Tahsanna'a chun dingdet'un, Lung ngam'un. Hat'un.
English: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

tcz: Chule nabol jouseu chu ngailutna in bol'un.
en: Let all that you do be done in love.
text:
1CO 16:14
Thadou: Chule nabol jouseu chu ngailutna in bol'un.
English: Let all that you do be done in love.

tcz: Stephanas le ain sung mite abonchauva Greece a aga masapen ahiuve ti nang hon naheuvin, chule amaho hin Pathen mite kin bolnaa ahinkhou aman jengu ahi. Kasopi deitah teho, kangeh nahiuve,
en: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
text:
1CO 16:15
Thadou: Stephanas le ain sung mite abonchauva Greece a aga masapen ahiuve ti nang hon naheuvin, chule amaho hin Pathen mite kin bolnaa ahinkhou aman jengu ahi. Kasopi deitah teho, kangeh nahiuve,
English: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

tcz: Amaho le midang ho kiphal thengtah le lunglut tah a natong ho thunoiya kipelut un.
en: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
text:
1CO 16:16
Thadou: Amaho le midang ho kiphal thengtah le lunglut tah a natong ho thunoiya kipelut un.
English: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

tcz: Stephanas, Fortunetas Chule Achaicus hikom mun ahungu hin eikipasah lheh jengin ahi. Nanghon hikoma kithopina neipeh theilou u chu amaho hin eikithopiu ahi'e.
en: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
text:
1CO 16:17
Thadou: Stephanas, Fortunetas Chule Achaicus hikom mun ahungu hin eikipasah lheh jengin ahi. Nanghon hikoma kithopina neipeh theilou u chu amaho hin eikithopiu ahi'e.
English: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

tcz: Amaho nangho dinga kitilkhouna phatah ahibang uvin, keima dingin jong ahiuve. Hitobang loma phatah a lhacha kinbol ho jouse chu nakipapi nau navetsah tei diudol ahi.
en: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
text:
1CO 16:18
Thadou: Amaho nangho dinga kitilkhouna phatah ahibang uvin, keima dingin jong ahiuve. Hitobang loma phatah a lhacha kinbol ho jouse chu nakipapi nau navetsah tei diudol ahi.
English: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

tcz: Asia gamkai sunga hilam a houbung um hon, Aquila le Priscilla chule ain'a kikhom houbung chun Pakaiya chibai nahin bol uve.
en: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
text:
1CO 16:19
Thadou: Asia gamkai sunga hilam a houbung um hon, Aquila le Priscilla chule ain'a kikhom houbung chun Pakaiya chibai nahin bol uve.
English: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

tcz: Sopite ho hikoma umho jousen chibai nahin thot uve. Khat le khat Christian kingailutnan chibai kibolun.
en: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
text:
1CO 16:20
Thadou: Sopite ho hikoma umho jousen chibai nahin thot uve. Khat le khat Christian kingailutnan chibai kibolun.
English: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

tcz: Hiche hi keima PAUL in kakhuttah a kajih kichibaina thucheng ahi.
en: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
text:
1CO 16:21
Thadou: Hiche hi keima PAUL in kakhuttah a kajih kichibaina thucheng ahi.
English: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

tcz: Koitobang Pakai ngailu lou auma ahileh, ama chu gaosap changa ahi. Ka Pakaiyu hungin!
en: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!
text:
1CO 16:22
Thadou: Koitobang Pakai ngailu lou auma ahileh, ama chu gaosap changa ahi. Ka Pakaiyu hungin!
English: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
text:
1CO 16:23
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua milungsetna chun naumpiu hen.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a kangailutna nabon chauva chunga umhen. Amen.
en: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
text:
1CO 16:24
Thadou: Christa Yeshua a kangailutna nabon chauva chunga umhen. Amen.
English: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen lunglama Christa Yeshua solchah a pang Paul le isopiu Timothy a kona Corinth a um Pathen houbung le Greece gamkol sungsea Pathen mithengte hodinga lekhathot ahi.
en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:
text:
2CO 1:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Pathen lunglama Christa Yeshua solchah a pang Paul le isopiu Timothy a kona Corinth a um Pathen houbung le Greece gamkol sungsea Pathen mithengte hodinga lekhathot ahi.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
2CO 1:2
Thadou: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun nangho lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
