tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa henga chun vahchoina jouse umhen. Pathen chu mi khoto them le lhamonna jouse hung konna Pa ahi.
en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,
text:
2CO 1:3
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa henga chun vahchoina jouse umhen. Pathen chu mi khoto them le lhamonna jouse hung konna Pa ahi.
English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

tcz: Aman kahahsat nau jousea eilhamonu ahin keihon jong midang kalhamon theina dingu ahi. Hahsatnan amaho aphah tenguleh, Pathen in keiho eilhamonu tobanga chu amaho jong kalhamon theina dingu ahi.
en: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
text:
2CO 1:4
Thadou: Aman kahahsat nau jousea eilhamonu ahin keihon jong midang kalhamon theina dingu ahi. Hahsatnan amaho aphah tenguleh, Pathen in keiho eilhamonu tobanga chu amaho jong kalhamon theina dingu ahi.
English: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh keiho Christa dinga kaha thohgim cheh uva ahileh, Pathen in atamjo cheh a alhamonna Christa jal'a eihin sunlhah peh be dingu ahi.
en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.
text:
2CO 1:5
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh keiho Christa dinga kaha thohgim cheh uva ahileh, Pathen in atamjo cheh a alhamonna Christa jal'a eihin sunlhah peh be dingu ahi.
English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

tcz: Keiho hahsatna hon eidelpha jengu jongleh hichu nangho lhamonna le huhhing nachanna dingu ahiye! Ijeh inem itileh keiho tah lhamonna kachan tenguleh, keihon nangho kalhamon tei ding'u nahiuve. Chuphat leh nanghon keiho thohsa chu thoh hattah a nathoh thei dingu ahitai.
en: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.
text:
2CO 1:6
Thadou: Keiho hahsatna hon eidelpha jengu jongleh hichu nangho lhamonna le huhhing nachanna dingu ahiye! Ijeh inem itileh keiho tah lhamonna kachan tenguleh, keihon nangho kalhamon tei ding'u nahiuve. Chuphat leh nanghon keiho thohsa chu thoh hattah a nathoh thei dingu ahitai.
English: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

tcz: Nanghon keiho thohhahsa thohna'a nathoh jal uva, Pathen in keiho eilhamon nauva chu nangho jong nalhamon dingu kakinemun ahi.
en: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
text:
2CO 1:7
Thadou: Nanghon keiho thohhahsa thohna'a nathoh jal uva, Pathen in keiho eilhamon nauva chu nangho jong nalhamon dingu kakinemun ahi.
English: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, keihon Asia gamkaiya hahsatna ichan geiya katou ahi thudol chu nahet ding uva lom ahi katiuve. Keihon kathohjou kalval'un engbol nale lungdonna katoh un, chule keiho chu ahing dingin kaki ging cha tapouve.
en: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.
text:
2CO 1:8
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, keihon Asia gamkaiya hahsatna ichan geiya katou ahi thudol chu nahet ding uva lom ahi katiuve. Keihon kathohjou kalval'un engbol nale lungdonna katoh un, chule keiho chu ahing dingin kaki ging cha tapouve.
English: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

tcz: Atahbeh in thi dingin kaki gingmo tauve. Hiti ahitah jeh chun keimaho a kingam talouvin, Pathen athiho kaithoupa a bou chun kalungu kangaijo tauve.
en: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,
text:
2CO 1:9
Thadou: Atahbeh in thi dingin kaki gingmo tauve. Hiti ahitah jeh chun keimaho a kingam talouvin, Pathen athiho kaithoupa a bou chun kalungu kangaijo tauve.
English: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

tcz: Chule Amachun tahsa thina thei vangsetnaa kona eihuhdoh u ahin, chule eihuhdoh kit dingu ahi. Keihon Amaa kakisonnau kangam lhauvin, Aman eipanhu uva eihuhdoh jom jing dingu ahi.
en: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,
text:
2CO 1:10
Thadou: Chule Amachun tahsa thina thei vangsetnaa kona eihuhdoh u ahin, chule eihuhdoh kit dingu ahi. Keihon Amaa kakisonnau kangam lhauvin, Aman eipanhu uva eihuhdoh jom jing dingu ahi.
English: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

tcz: Chule nangho keiho dinga nataonau chu neipanhu nau ahi. Chuphat leh mitamtah in thangvahna apeh dingu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Pathen in alungsetnaa eiho huhbit ichanna dinguva taona tamtah kimang chu asan ahitai.
en: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
text:
2CO 1:11
Thadou: Chule nangho keiho dinga nataonau chu neipanhu nau ahi. Chuphat leh mitamtah in thangvahna apeh dingu ahi, ijeh inem itileh Pathen in alungsetnaa eiho huhbit ichanna dinguva taona tamtah kimang chu asan ahitai.
English: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

tcz: Keihon lung ngamtah le selepha hetna thenga a kaseitheiyu chu Pathen peh thenna hinkho le nangho toh khosah khomna a lung dihtah pua kaumu hi ahi. Keiho kachihnauva kisonglouvin Pathen lungsetna a kakisongun ahi. Hiche hi keiho vannoi mite masanga, adehset'a nangho masanga kachonnau chu ahiye.
en: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.
text:
2CO 1:12
Thadou: Keihon lung ngamtah le selepha hetna thenga a kaseitheiyu chu Pathen peh thenna hinkho le nangho toh khosah khomna a lung dihtah pua kaumu hi ahi. Keiho kachihnauva kisonglouvin Pathen lungsetna a kakisongun ahi. Hiche hi keiho vannoi mite masanga, adehset'a nangho masanga kachonnau chu ahiye.
English: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

tcz: Kalekhathot'u hi aki ima beihela ahin, chule imacha nahet mo dinguva akijih doh a aumpoi. Nanghon neihin hetthemna dingu nikho ahunglhun ding kakinemin ahi.
en: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—
text:
2CO 1:13
Thadou: Kalekhathot'u hi aki ima beihela ahin, chule imacha nahet mo dinguva akijih doh a aumpoi. Nanghon neihin hetthemna dingu nikho ahunglhun ding kakinemin ahi.
English: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

tcz: Tun nanghon keiho nei hethem hih jong leuchun, I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung kit niteng le chun, keihon nangho kakisonpi tobanguva hi nanghon jong nei kisonpi dingu ahi.
en: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.
text:
2CO 1:14
Thadou: Tun nanghon keiho nei hethem hih jong leuchun, I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ahung kit niteng le chun, keihon nangho kakisonpi tobanguva hi nanghon jong nei kisonpi dingu ahi.
English: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

tcz: Keiman nangho hetkhen themna le tahsanna ka photchet nom bang uva hi, nangho aniveina a hungvil kit ding kati hi phattheina athop'a kachansah nom un ahi.
en: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
text:
2CO 1:15
Thadou: Keiman nangho hetkhen themna le tahsanna ka photchet nom bang uva hi, nangho aniveina a hungvil kit ding kati hi phattheina athop'a kachansah nom un ahi.
English: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

tcz: Hichu, amasaa Macedonia kachena lampia chule Macedonia a kona kahung kilena lama dinga jong kati ahi. Chujou phatleh nanghon keima Judea kachena a dinga neisolpai thei dingu ahi.
en: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.
text:
2CO 1:16
Thadou: Hichu, amasaa Macedonia kachena lampia chule Macedonia a kona kahung kilena lama dinga jong kati ahi. Chujou phatleh nanghon keima Judea kachena a dinga neisolpai thei dingu ahi.
English: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

tcz: Ipi iti lamdola katohgon kakhel ham ti thua neidoh nom dingu kagingchai. Katohgon chu phottohna umlouva gonga neigelu vem? Vannoi miten “Henge” atiu chu “kanompoi” tina a asei tobang uva sei hidinga neigelu ham?
en: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”
text:
2CO 1:17
Thadou: Ipi iti lamdola katohgon kakhel ham ti thua neidoh nom dingu kagingchai. Katohgon chu phottohna umlouva gonga neigelu vem? Vannoi miten “Henge” atiu chu “kanompoi” tina a asei tobang uva sei hidinga neigelu ham?
English: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

tcz: Pathen tahsan umtah ahi tobanga chu, keihon nangho koma kathuseiyu hi “Henge” ahilouleh “Kanompoi” tia kheltolea kahi pouve.
en: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”
text:
2CO 1:18
Thadou: Pathen tahsan umtah ahi tobanga chu, keihon nangho koma kathuseiyu hi “Henge” ahilouleh “Kanompoi” tia kheltolea kahi pouve.
English: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen Chapa Yeshua Christa chu “Henge” tileh “Ka nompoi” ti thuchenga lunggel kichiah ding ahipoi. Silas, Timothy chule keihon naheng uva kaseiphongu chu ama ahi, chule Ama hi Pathen in “Ahi” tia asei–anamdetna chu ahi.
en: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”
text:
2CO 1:19
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen Chapa Yeshua Christa chu “Henge” tileh “Ka nompoi” ti thuchenga lunggel kichiah ding ahipoi. Silas, Timothy chule keihon naheng uva kaseiphongu chu ama ahi, chule Ama hi Pathen in “Ahi” tia asei–anamdetna chu ahi.
English: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen thutep jouse chu Christaa avela “Henge” tia hungvel gindoh kit'ah ahi. Chule Christa jal'a chu eihon, “Amen” itiu (hichu “Henge”) awcheng hi aloupina dinga Pathen kom geiya gingdoh a ahitai.
en: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.
text:
2CO 1:20
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen thutep jouse chu Christaa avela “Henge” tia hungvel gindoh kit'ah ahi. Chule Christa jal'a chu eihon, “Amen” itiu (hichu “Henge”) awcheng hi aloupina dinga Pathen kom geiya gingdoh a ahitai.
English: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

tcz: Pathen chun nangho toh Christaa dingdet hikhom dinga eigon uva chule einganseu ahitai.
en: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,
text:
2CO 1:21
Thadou: Pathen chun nangho toh Christaa dingdet hikhom dinga eigon uva chule einganseu ahitai.
English: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

tcz: Aman eiho ijakai Ama a hidinga eithutep u aphotchetna masa hinan ilungsung uva Lhagao Theng akhumin Ama hinna eichan tha tauve.
en: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
text:
2CO 1:22
Thadou: Aman eiho ijakai Ama a hidinga eithutep u aphotchetna masa hinan ilungsung uva Lhagao Theng akhumin Ama hinna eichan tha tauve.
English: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

tcz: Keiman thutah sei kahi photchetna a Pathen hi keima chung chang thua ahetoh hidinga kakou ahi. Corinth a kahung kilekitlou chu kahaphosal louna dingu kagel jeh ahi.
en: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.
text:
2CO 1:23
Thadou: Keiman thutah sei kahi photchetna a Pathen hi keima chung chang thua ahetoh hidinga kakou ahi. Corinth a kahung kilekitlou chu kahaphosal louna dingu kagel jeh ahi.
English: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

tcz: Hinlah keihon natahsan nau chu natoh'a iti pohdoh ding ham tithua kahil got'u hi nachung uva vaihom kanopjeh u ahipoi. Nangho natahsan nauva nadindet'u ahi jal'a, nangho kipana na dimsetna ding uva nangho toh tohkhom kanop'u ahi.
en: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
text:
2CO 1:24
Thadou: Hinlah keihon natahsan nau chu natoh'a iti pohdoh ding ham tithua kahil got'u hi nachung uva vaihom kanopjeh u ahipoi. Nangho natahsan nauva nadindet'u ahi jal'a, nangho kipana na dimsetna ding uva nangho toh tohkhom kanop'u ahi.
English: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

tcz: Hiti chun keiman nangho hungvil kit'a nagimnau kibelapna ding chu boltah lou dinga kagel lhah ahitai.
en: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
text:
2CO 2:1
Thadou: Hiti chun keiman nangho hungvil kit'a nagimnau kibelapna ding chu boltah lou dinga kagel lhah ahitai.
English: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

tcz: Ajeh chu, keiman nangho lunghem sah taleuveng, kon eikipasah ding hitam? Atahbeh in koima dang hilou kalung hemsah ho joh chu hung hiding nahiuve.
en: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?
text:
2CO 2:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu, keiman nangho lunghem sah taleuveng, kon eikipasah ding hitam? Atahbeh in koima dang hilou kalung hemsah ho joh chu hung hiding nahiuve.
English: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a naheng uva dinga kajih ngai banga kahin jih hi keima kahung tengleh, kipana sangpen eipe ding ho chun eilung natsah louna dingu kati ahi. Nangho nakipa jal uva ka kipana hung umdoh theibou ahi ti hi nabon chauva nahet'u ahi.
en: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.
text:
2CO 2:3
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh a naheng uva dinga kajih ngai banga kahin jih hi keima kahung tengleh, kipana sangpen eipe ding ho chun eilung natsah louna dingu kati ahi. Nangho nakipa jal uva ka kipana hung umdoh theibou ahi ti hi nabon chauva nahet'u ahi.
English: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot kajih chu lunghemna lentah neija, lunggimna neipuma chule mitlhi tamtah sohleuva nangho lungnat ding chu deilou jeh a, ichan geiya nangho kangailut'u ham ti hi nahet joh dingu kati ahiye.
en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.
text:
2CO 2:4
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot kajih chu lunghemna lentah neija, lunggimna neipuma chule mitlhi tamtah sohleuva nangho lungnat ding chu deilou jeh a, ichan geiya nangho kangailut'u ham ti hi nahet joh dingu kati ahiye.
English: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

tcz: Keiman hiche hoa hahsatna hinlhutpa amatah hin keima eisuh lungnat sangin nangho nabon chauvin nalung natsah uve ti thudol kasei hi seivala thusei chu kahipoi.
en: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.
text:
2CO 2:5
Thadou: Keiman hiche hoa hahsatna hinlhutpa amatah hin keima eisuh lungnat sangin nangho nabon chauvin nalung natsah uve ti thudol kasei hi seivala thusei chu kahipoi.
English: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

tcz: Nangho atamjo chengsen kilungkhat tah a ama douna a thu natan uva chu gimbolna ama dinga aphakhopset kipea ahi.
en: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

tcz: Hinama jongleh, tua ama chu ngaidama chule lhamon joh ding ahitai. Achuti louva ahileh amahi lunglhah behsehna chun thunun khaget inte.
en: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.
text:
2CO 2:7
Thadou: Hinama jongleh, tua ama chu ngaidama chule lhamon joh ding ahitai. Achuti louva ahileh amahi lunglhah behsehna chun thunun khaget inte.
English: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

tcz: Hiti chun, tun ama hi na ngailut nau chu photchetna neipeh un tia kangeh nahiuve.
en: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.
text:
2CO 2:8
Thadou: Hiti chun, tun ama hi na ngailut nau chu photchetna neipeh un tia kangeh nahiuve.
English: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

tcz: Keiman kabol ji ngai banga nangho henga kahin jih hi nangho patepna a, phatea thua nung nahiu hinam ti kavet nau ahibouve.
en: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
text:
2CO 2:9
Thadou: Keiman kabol ji ngai banga nangho henga kahin jih hi nangho patepna a, phatea thua nung nahiu hinam ti kavet nau ahibouve.
English: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

tcz: Ama hi na ngaidam tenguleh keima tah in jong ka ngaidame. Chule keiman ka ngaidam dingdol chengse kangaidam tengleh, keiman Christa thuneina'a nangho phatchomna dinga ka ngaidam ahi.
en: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,
text:
2CO 2:10
Thadou: Ama hi na ngaidam tenguleh keima tah in jong ka ngaidame. Chule keiman ka ngaidam dingdol chengse kangaidam tengleh, keiman Christa thuneina'a nangho phatchomna dinga ka ngaidam ahi.
English: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

tcz: Hichu Satan in eithujo thei louna dingu hiya ahi. Ajeh iham itileh ama lunggon phalou ho chu ihetsau ahi.
en: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.
text:
2CO 2:11
Thadou: Hichu Satan in eithujo thei louna dingu hiya ahi. Ajeh iham itileh ama lunggon phalou ho chu ihetsau ahi.
English: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

tcz: Keima Troas khopia Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kahung chun, Pakaiyin keima dingin thusei theina kot eihonpeh in ahi.
en: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,
text:
2CO 2:12
Thadou: Keima Troas khopia Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga kahung chun, Pakaiyin keima dingin thusei theina kot eihonpeh in ahi.
English: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

tcz: Hinlah kasopipa Titus chu nanghoa kona thupoh hinpoa hunglhung loulai ana hi jeh chun, keiman lung olna kana nei theipon ahi. Hitia chu keiman nangho kadalhah uva Macedonia gam'a ama gahol dinga kana che ahitai.
en: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.
text:
2CO 2:13
Thadou: Hinlah kasopipa Titus chu nanghoa kona thupoh hinpoa hunglhung loulai ana hi jeh chun, keiman lung olna kana nei theipon ahi. Hitia chu keiman nangho kadalhah uva Macedonia gam'a ama gahol dinga kana che ahitai.
English: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman sohchanga eikoiyu hin Christa a jona a chu eipuilut'u ahitai. Tua hi aman eiho Christa hetna thuhi gimnamtui tobanga muntina seichoile dinga eimanchah u ahitai.
en: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
text:
2CO 2:14
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen thangvah in umhen! Aman sohchanga eikoiyu hin Christa a jona a chu eipuilut'u ahitai. Tua hi aman eiho Christa hetna thuhi gimnamtui tobanga muntina seichoile dinga eimanchah u ahitai.
English: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

tcz: Kahinkhou hi Christa atobanga Pathen henga gimnamtui hungnamdoh a ahitai. Hinlah hiche gimnamtui hi Huhhing'a umho dinga hihen amangthah ho ding hijongleh gimnam chom choma namdoh a kahi tauve.
en: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish:
text:
2CO 2:15
Thadou: Kahinkhou hi Christa atobanga Pathen henga gimnamtui hungnamdoh a ahitai. Hinlah hiche gimnamtui hi Huhhing'a umho dinga hihen amangthah ho ding hijongleh gimnam chom choma namdoh a kahi tauve.
English: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are saved and in those who perish:

tcz: Keiho hi amangthah ho dingin kichat um thina gimnam le mahthahna kanamu uve. Hinla huhhingna chang ho dingin keiho hi hinna pea gimnam kanam uve. Hitobang tah a tohding kingansena chang dinga kiloma koi hintem?
en: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?
text:
2CO 2:16
Thadou: Keiho hi amangthah ho dingin kichat um thina gimnam le mahthahna kanamu uve. Hinla huhhingna chang ho dingin keiho hi hinna pea gimnam kanam uve. Hitobang tah a tohding kingansena chang dinga kiloma koi hintem?
English: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

tcz: Keiho hi chang phatchomna hola thusei phong lea kahi pouve ti nanghon naheuve. Keiho hi Pathen in eivet jingu ahi ti hea lung dihtah pua chule Christa thuneina a thusei phonga panga kahiuve.
en: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.
text:
2CO 2:17
Thadou: Keiho hi chang phatchomna hola thusei phong lea kahi pouve ti nanghon naheuve. Keiho hi Pathen in eivet jingu ahi ti hea lung dihtah pua chule Christa thuneina a thusei phonga panga kahiuve.
English: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

tcz: Keimaho le keimaho kichang seiphat bol a kahiuvem? Keiho hi midangho banga seiphatna lekha poa hung ding kahiuvem? Ahilouleh amaho thalhenga lekhathot jih dinga kon na nganseu vem? Koima umponte.
en: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
text:
2CO 3:1
Thadou: Keimaho le keimaho kichang seiphat bol a kahiuvem? Keiho hi midangho banga seiphatna lekha poa hung ding kahiuvem? Ahilouleh amaho thalhenga lekhathot jih dinga kon na nganseu vem? Koima umponte.
English: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

tcz: Keihon seiphatna lekha kangeh u chu nangho tah nahiuve. Na hinkho man danu hi kalung sunguva kijihlut mitin in asim theiyu chule nalah uva napha katoh u mihon ahin hetdoh u chu ahitai.
en: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
text:
2CO 3:2
Thadou: Keihon seiphatna lekha kangeh u chu nangho tah nahiuve. Na hinkho man danu hi kalung sunguva kijihlut mitin in asim theiyu chule nalah uva napha katoh u mihon ahin hetdoh u chu ahitai.
English: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

tcz: Nangho hi Christa a kona lekhathot chu nahiuvin, nalah uva lhachana katoh doh'u kavetsah'u nahi tauve. Hiche lekhathot hi lekhatwiya kijihdoh hilouvin, Pathen hing lhagao toh kithoa kijihdoh chu ahi. Hichu songpheng chunga lekhajem chu hita louva mihem lungsunga kona kijih doh chu ahi.
en: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.
text:
2CO 3:3
Thadou: Nangho hi Christa a kona lekhathot chu nahiuvin, nalah uva lhachana katoh doh'u kavetsah'u nahi tauve. Hiche lekhathot hi lekhatwiya kijihdoh hilouvin, Pathen hing lhagao toh kithoa kijihdoh chu ahi. Hichu songpheng chunga lekhajem chu hita louva mihem lungsunga kona kijih doh chu ahi.
English: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

tcz: Keihon hicheho jouse chunga kakison nau chu Christa jal'a Pathen katahsanu chu ahi.
en: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
text:
2CO 3:4
Thadou: Keihon hicheho jouse chunga kakison nau chu Christa jal'a Pathen katahsanu chu ahi.
English: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

tcz: Hichu keima hon keiho changseh bou abol dinga gunchena neija kahiuve katinau ahipoi. Gunchena kaneiyu hi Pathena kon ahiye.
en: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,
text:
2CO 3:5
Thadou: Hichu keima hon keiho changseh bou abol dinga gunchena neija kahiuve katinau ahipoi. Gunchena kaneiyu hi Pathena kon ahiye.
English: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

tcz: Aman keiho hi Amaa Kitepna Thah lhacha ho hidinga boltheina eipeh u ahitai. Hiche Kitepna hi akijih dohsa Danbua kon hilouva, Lhagaova kon ahijo bouve. Kitepna Lui akijihdoh sapa chu thina a kichaiya ahin, hinla Kitepna Thah a Lhagaovin hinna apeh ahi.
en: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.
text:
2CO 3:6
Thadou: Aman keiho hi Amaa Kitepna Thah lhacha ho hidinga boltheina eipeh u ahitai. Hiche Kitepna hi akijih dohsa Danbua kon hilouva, Lhagaova kon ahijo bouve. Kitepna Lui akijihdoh sapa chu thina a kichaiya ahin, hinla Kitepna Thah a Lhagaovin hinna apeh ahi.
English: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

tcz: Lamlui, songphenga kijih chun thina asodoh in ahi, loupina nasatah Israel mipi ten ana vetngam lou u Mose maivah'a kipan ahivangin. Ajeh chu amaivah chu Pathen loupina toh vahtha ahin, hiche vah chu akem suhsuh in amang jenge.
en: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,
text:
2CO 3:7
Thadou: Lamlui, songphenga kijih chun thina asodoh in ahi, loupina nasatah Israel mipi ten ana vetngam lou u Mose maivah'a kipan ahivangin. Ajeh chu amaivah chu Pathen loupina toh vahtha ahin, hiche vah chu akem suhsuh in amang jenge.
English: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

tcz: Tua hi eihon Lhagao Thengin hinna apeh jeh a lampi thah a chu loupina lenjo lampi thah a chu iginchat diu hilou ham?
en: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?
text:
2CO 3:8
Thadou: Tua hi eihon Lhagao Thengin hinna apeh jeh a lampi thah a chu loupina lenjo lampi thah a chu iginchat diu hilou ham?
English: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

tcz: Lamluiya themmo channa polut bon chu aloupia ahileh Pathen toh kilungtoh lampi thah chu iti loupi jocheh ding hitam?
en: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.
text:
2CO 3:9
Thadou: Lamluiya themmo channa polut bon chu aloupia ahileh Pathen toh kilungtoh lampi thah chu iti loupi jocheh ding hitam?
English: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin lampithah a Kitepna Thah aloupi dan hi loupina masa chuto tekahpi thei ahipoi.
en: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.
text:
2CO 3:10
Thadou: Tahbeh mongin lampithah a Kitepna Thah aloupi dan hi loupina masa chuto tekahpi thei ahipoi.
English: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

tcz: Hitia lampilui chu kheldoh ahitah a ahileh, ichan geiya athah tonsot'a um chu loupijo cheh ding hi tam?
en: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
text:
2CO 3:11
Thadou: Hitia lampilui chu kheldoh ahitah a ahileh, ichan geiya athah tonsot'a um chu loupijo cheh ding hi tam?
English: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

tcz: Hiche lampi thah chu eiho eikipeuva ahitah leh eiho hatah a lungngam ding ihitauve.
en: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,
text:
2CO 3:12
Thadou: Hiche lampi thah chu eiho eikipeuva ahitah leh eiho hatah a lungngam ding ihitauve.
English: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

tcz: Eiho hi, Mosen aloupina amai pon'a akhu khum Israel mipi ten avetngam lou u tobang chu ihipouve, hiche aloupina chu kemmang dinga kigongsa ahi.
en: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.
text:
2CO 3:13
Thadou: Eiho hi, Mosen aloupina amai pon'a akhu khum Israel mipi ten avetngam lou u tobang chu ihipouve, hiche aloupina chu kemmang dinga kigongsa ahi.
English: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

tcz: Ahivangin mipite lunggel chu atahsahjo cheh in, chule tuni geiyin jong Kitepna Lui akisim doh chanin, hiche ponlukhu chun amaiyu akhu khumun, thutah chu ahekhen theiji tapouve. Chule hiche ponlukhuh hi Christa tahsan jal'a bou kisubei theiyah ahi.
en: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.
text:
2CO 3:14
Thadou: Ahivangin mipite lunggel chu atahsahjo cheh in, chule tuni geiyin jong Kitepna Lui akisim doh chanin, hiche ponlukhu chun amaiyu akhu khumun, thutah chu ahekhen theiji tapouve. Chule hiche ponlukhuh hi Christa tahsan jal'a bou kisubei theiyah ahi.
English: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

tcz: Ahi, tulai nikho jengin jong Mose lekhabuho asimlai chanun, alungthimu hiche ponlukhu chun atomjin, chule amahon ahekhen theiji tapouve.
en: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.
text:
2CO 3:15
Thadou: Ahi, tulai nikho jengin jong Mose lekhabuho asimlai chanun, alungthimu hiche ponlukhu chun atomjin, chule amahon ahekhen theiji tapouve.
English: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

tcz: Hinlah mi koiham khat chu Pakaiya ahung kihei tengleh, ponlukhu chu lahdoh ahitai.
en: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.
text:
2CO 3:16
Thadou: Hinlah mi koiham khat chu Pakaiya ahung kihei tengleh, ponlukhu chu lahdoh ahitai.
English: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule Pakai Lhagao umna chan chu chamlhatna ahi.
en: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
text:
2CO 3:17
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule Pakai Lhagao umna chan chu chamlhatna ahi.
English: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

tcz: Chutia chu eimaho jouse ponlukhu kiladoh chengse hi Pakai loupina chu mua chule tahlang'ah ihitauve. Chule Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule eiho Ama loupina mela chu kikhel cheh cheh a ihitauve.
en: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
text:
2CO 3:18
Thadou: Chutia chu eimaho jouse ponlukhu kiladoh chengse hi Pakai loupina chu mua chule tahlang'ah ihitauve. Chule Pakai chu Lhagao ahin, chule eiho Ama loupina mela chu kikhel cheh cheh a ihitauve.
English: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in, Pathen in ami khotona a hiche lhacha natohna hi eipeh u ahitah jeh in, keiho kalungu alhadah dehpoi.
en: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
text:
2CO 4:1
Thadou: Hiti chu ahijeh'in, Pathen in ami khotona a hiche lhacha natohna hi eipeh u ahitah jeh in, keiho kalungu alhadah dehpoi.
English: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

tcz: Keihon jachat um aguh a thilbol jouse le doha lheplhahna lungthim kapaiyun ahi. Keihon koima lheplhah ding kago pouve, ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi alam louvin kamangcha pouve. Keihon Pathen masangah thutah kaseiyun, chule hiche hi milungdih jousen aheuve.
en: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
text:
2CO 4:2
Thadou: Keihon jachat um aguh a thilbol jouse le doha lheplhahna lungthim kapaiyun ahi. Keihon koima lheplhah ding kago pouve, ahilouleh Pathen Thu hi alam louvin kamangcha pouve. Keihon Pathen masangah thutah kaseiyun, chule hiche hi milungdih jousen aheuve.
English: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

tcz: Keihon Kipana Thupha kaseiphongu hi ponlukhu lea kiselgua uma ahileh, hichu amangthah dingho a ding bou ahi.
en: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,
text:
2CO 4:3
Thadou: Keihon Kipana Thupha kaseiphongu hi ponlukhu lea kiselgua uma ahileh, hichu amangthah dingho a ding bou ahi.
English: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

tcz: Satan, hiche vannoi pathen hin, atahsan louho lungthim amotsah ahijeh a, amahon Kipana Thupha vah loupitah hi amudoh theilouvu ahi. Hiche Pathen lima um, Christa loupina thudol hi hetkhen theina anei pouvin ahi.
en: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
text:
2CO 4:4
Thadou: Satan, hiche vannoi pathen hin, atahsan louho lungthim amotsah ahijeh a, amahon Kipana Thupha vah loupitah hi amudoh theilouvu ahi. Hiche Pathen lima um, Christa loupina thudol hi hetkhen theina anei pouvin ahi.
English: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

tcz: Keiho hi kachung chang thu'u seiphonglea vahlea kahi pouve ti nanghon nahe nauve. Keihon Yeshua Christa hi Pakai ahi, chule keiho hi Yeshua jal'a nangho lhacha natonga kahiuve ti seiphong kahiuve.
en: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
text:
2CO 4:5
Thadou: Keiho hi kachung chang thu'u seiphonglea vahlea kahi pouve ti nanghon nahe nauve. Keihon Yeshua Christa hi Pakai ahi, chule keiho hi Yeshua jal'a nangho lhacha natonga kahiuve ti seiphong kahiuve.
English: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in, “Muthim lah a vah umhen” tia asei chun hiche vah chun ilungsungu asalvah tai, hichu eihon Pathen loupina chu Yeshua Christa maiya kona imudoh uva ihet theina dingu ahi.
en: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
text:
2CO 4:6
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in, “Muthim lah a vah umhen” tia asei chun hiche vah chun ilungsungu asalvah tai, hichu eihon Pathen loupina chu Yeshua Christa maiya kona imudoh uva ihet theina dingu ahi.
English: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

tcz: Tun eiho hiche vah hin ilung sungu asalvah in, hinla eima hotah hi leibel kehthei tobanga hiche gou manlu hi ichinu ahi. Hiche hin keihoa thaneina kidang tah hi Pathena hungkon ahin, keihoa tah ahipoi, ti aphot chenna ahi.
en: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
text:
2CO 4:7
Thadou: Tun eiho hiche vah hin ilung sungu asalvah in, hinla eima hotah hi leibel kehthei tobanga hiche gou manlu hi ichinu ahi. Hiche hin keihoa thaneina kidang tah hi Pathena hungkon ahin, keihoa tah ahipoi, ti aphot chenna ahi.
English: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

tcz: Keiho hi hahsatna hon aningtin'ah eidel phauvin, hinla eiki tatgoi pouve. Kalungu akichiah jin, hinla kalung lhapai jeng pouve.
en: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

tcz: Keiho delkhumin kaum un, hinla Pathen in einungsun deh pouve. Keiho eikison op uvin, hinla eiki sumangpai pouve.
en: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

tcz: Katahsau hin kagim thoh nauvah Yeshua thina a chan kanei jingun, hichu katahsauva Yeshua a hinna chu akimudoh na ding katiu ahi.
en: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
text:
2CO 4:10
Thadou: Katahsau hin kagim thoh nauvah Yeshua thina a chan kanei jingun, hichu katahsauva Yeshua a hinna chu akimudoh na ding katiu ahi.
English: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

tcz: Henge, keiho hin Yeshua na katoh jaluvin thina thei dinmun chan geiyin kaum uve, hitia chu katah sauva thina chun Yeshua a hinna chu phot chenna aumna ding ahi.
en: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
text:
2CO 4:11
Thadou: Henge, keiho hin Yeshua na katoh jaluvin thina thei dinmun chan geiyin kaum uve, hitia chu katah sauva thina chun Yeshua a hinna chu phot chenna aumna ding ahi.
English: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

tcz: Hitia keihon thina kimaitopi dia hinkho kamanu hi nangho dinga tonsot hinna asodohna ding katiu ahi.
en: So then death works in us, but life in you.
text:
2CO 4:12
Thadou: Hitia keihon thina kimaitopi dia hinkho kamanu hi nangho dinga tonsot hinna asodohna ding katiu ahi.
English: So then death works in us, but life in you.

tcz: Hinlah keihon tuni geiya thu kasei phongu hi tahsanna Lasunpan ana phondohsa, “Keiman Pathen katahsanin, hiti chun thu kaseiye,” ati tobang kaneiyu ahi.
en: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,
text:
2CO 4:13
Thadou: Hinlah keihon tuni geiya thu kasei phongu hi tahsanna Lasunpan ana phondohsa, “Keiman Pathen katahsanin, hiti chun thu kaseiye,” ati tobang kaneiyu ahi.
English: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

tcz: Eiho Pathen, Pakai Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chun eiho jong Ama toh chule Amaa dinga nangho toh eikaithou dingu ahi ti iheuve.
en: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.
text:
2CO 4:14
Thadou: Eiho Pathen, Pakai Yeshua thinaa kona kaithoupa chun eiho jong Ama toh chule Amaa dinga nangho toh eikaithou dingu ahi ti iheuve.
English: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

tcz: Hichengho jouse hi nangho phatchomna ding ahi. Chule Pathen lungsetna mitampi chunga alhuncheh cheh tobanga hi thangvahna loupi tah, chule Pathen chu loupina chang cheh cheh ding ahi.
en: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
text:
2CO 4:15
Thadou: Hichengho jouse hi nangho phatchomna ding ahi. Chule Pathen lungsetna mitampi chunga alhuncheh cheh tobanga hi thangvahna loupi tah, chule Pathen chu loupina chang cheh cheh ding ahi.
English: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiho kalhadah hihhel uve. Katahsau hin thina lam chu hinnai jeng jongleh, kalhagaovu hi anitinin ahalcheh cheh in ahi.
en: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
text:
2CO 4:16
Thadou: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiho kalhadah hihhel uve. Katahsau hin thina lam chu hinnai jeng jongleh, kalhagaovu hi anitinin ahalcheh cheh in ahi.
English: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

tcz: Ajehchu tupet kagim nauhi neocha bou ahin chule sotpi umbe talou ding ahi. Hinla hicheho hin keiho dinga loupina gamchenga phajo le sotjo ahinso doh sah ding ahi.
en: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
text:
2CO 4:17
Thadou: Ajehchu tupet kagim nauhi neocha bou ahin chule sotpi umbe talou ding ahi. Hinla hicheho hin keiho dinga loupina gamchenga phajo le sotjo ahinso doh sah ding ahi.
English: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

tcz: Hiti chu ahin, keihon hahsatna hi tupet'a kavet theiyu ahi vang'in, kave pouve; chusangin keihon mit'a kimu theilou lamjoh chu kagaldot'u ahi. Ajeh chu tua kimu thei ho hi chomkah a hung mang ding ahitai, hinla eihon imutheilou hou hi tonsot geiya um ding ahi.
en: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
text:
2CO 4:18
Thadou: Hiti chu ahin, keihon hahsatna hi tupet'a kavet theiyu ahi vang'in, kave pouve; chusangin keihon mit'a kimu theilou lamjoh chu kagaldot'u ahi. Ajeh chu tua kimu thei ho hi chomkah a hung mang ding ahitai, hinla eihon imutheilou hou hi tonsot geiya um ding ahi.
English: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon kaheuve, hiche leiset ponbuh a kachenu hi kiphelha jongleh (hichu ithiuva, hiche leitahsa hi idalhah tenguleh), eiho dinga tonsot tahsapum Pathen Amatah in eisempeh u, mihem khut'in asem hilou, van'a in inei dingu chu kaheuve.
en: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.
text:
2CO 5:1
Thadou: Ajehchu keihon kaheuve, hiche leiset ponbuh a kachenu hi kiphelha jongleh (hichu ithiuva, hiche leitahsa hi idalhah tenguleh), eiho dinga tonsot tahsapum Pathen Amatah in eisempeh u, mihem khut'in asem hilou, van'a in inei dingu chu kaheuve.
English: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

tcz: Tupet itahsauva hin ithachol jiuvin, chule vonthah kivon ding tobang'in vanvou chu ingaicha uvin ahi.
en: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
text:
2CO 5:2
Thadou: Tupet itahsauva hin ithachol jiuvin, chule vonthah kivon ding tobang'in vanvou chu ingaicha uvin ahi.
English: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

tcz: Ajehchu eihon vanvou tipum chu inei dingu ahin, tahsa pum neilou lhagao ho tobang ihi lou dingu ahi.
en: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.
text:
2CO 5:3
Thadou: Ajehchu eihon vanvou tipum chu inei dingu ahin, tahsa pum neilou lhagao ho tobang ihi lou dingu ahi.
English: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

tcz: Hiche leiset tahsa puma ihin sung uva hin eiho ikap-un chule imaovun ahi, hichu eiho thi noma chule tua itahsau hi abei ding ngahlel ihipouve. Chusanga eihon itahsau athah chu kivon noma, hiche thithei tahsa hi hinnan avallhum ding chu ngaicha joa ihiuve.
en: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.
text:
2CO 5:4
Thadou: Hiche leiset tahsa puma ihin sung uva hin eiho ikap-un chule imaovun ahi, hichu eiho thi noma chule tua itahsau hi abei ding ngahlel ihipouve. Chusanga eihon itahsau athah chu kivon noma, hiche thithei tahsa hi hinnan avallhum ding chu ngaicha joa ihiuve.
English: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

tcz: Pathen Amatah in hiche hi eiho dinga agon ahin, chule hiche photchetna a chu a Lhagao Theng eipeh u ahi.
en: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.
text:
2CO 5:5
Thadou: Pathen Amatah in hiche hi eiho dinga agon ahin, chule hiche photchetna a chu a Lhagao Theng eipeh u ahi.
English: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

tcz: Hiti chun keiho hiche tahsa a kahinlai sung uva hi Pakai to in'a umkhom'a kahi pouve ti kahetnau hi kisonpi khopset theiya hetna nei kahiu ahi.
en: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

tcz: Ajehchu keiho tahsan jal'a hinga kahiuvin chule hichu mit'a muthoa kon ahipoi.
en: for we walk by faith, not by sight.
text:
2CO 5:7
Thadou: Ajehchu keiho tahsan jal'a hinga kahiuvin chule hichu mit'a muthoa kon ahipoi.
English: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

tcz: Ahi, keiho alhing keiya kisonna nei kahiuvin, chule keiho leilam tahsaphe a kona hi kikangse ding kahiuve, chutah le bou keiho Pakai to umkhom ding kahi tauve.
en: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.
text:
2CO 5:8
Thadou: Ahi, keiho alhing keiya kisonna nei kahiuvin, chule keiho leilam tahsaphe a kona hi kikangse ding kahiuve, chutah le bou keiho Pakai to umkhom ding kahi tauve.
English: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

tcz: Hitia hi keiho hiche tahsaphepun umuving ting, ahilouleh hiche tahsa a konin chom umu jong leng, kalunggonu chu Ama lunglhaina ding hola kahiuve.
en: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.
text:
2CO 5:9
Thadou: Hitia hi keiho hiche tahsaphepun umuving ting, ahilouleh hiche tahsa a konin chom umu jong leng, kalunggonu chu Ama lunglhaina ding hola kahiuve.
English: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eiho jouse hi Christa masanga thutanna'a ding cheh ding ihiuve. Eimaho khat cheh hin hiche leiset itahsauva, thilpha hihen thilse hijongleh iboldoh dungjui uva ikisan cheh dingu ahi.
en: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.
text:
2CO 5:10
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh eiho jouse hi Christa masanga thutanna'a ding cheh ding ihiuve. Eimaho khat cheh hin hiche leiset itahsauva, thilpha hihen thilse hijongleh iboldoh dungjui uva ikisan cheh dingu ahi.
English: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon Pakaiya kamopohnau hetkhen themna kaneijeh uvin, keihon midang ho thujona teidinga hatah a kiseh a kahiuve. Keiho kitah tah'a tonggima ka hiu Pathen in ahen chule nanghon jong nahet'u kakinemun ahi. Pathen toh kicham'un
en: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.
text:
2CO 5:11
Thadou: Ajehchu keihon Pakaiya kamopohnau hetkhen themna kaneijeh uvin, keihon midang ho thujona teidinga hatah a kiseh a kahiuve. Keiho kitah tah'a tonggima ka hiu Pathen in ahen chule nanghon jong nahet'u kakinemun ahi. Pathen toh kicham'un
English: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

tcz: Keiho le keiho kiseipha kit a neingaitou ham? Ahipoi, keihon nangho neikisonpina dinguva ajeh kapeh ahin, hichu nanghon lunggila kona lhachana tonglouva mi mutheibep dinga lhachana tongho nadonbut theina dingu ahi.
en: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
text:
2CO 5:12
Thadou: Keiho le keiho kiseipha kit a neingaitou ham? Ahipoi, keihon nangho neikisonpina dinguva ajeh kapeh ahin, hichu nanghon lunggila kona lhachana tonglouva mi mutheibep dinga lhachana tongho nadonbut theina dingu ahi.
English: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

tcz: Keiho hi ngolmana tomngaina neiya neigeluva ahileh, hichu Pathen loupina ding ahi. Chule keiho hi achingtah a neigeluva ahileh, hichu nangho phatchomna ding ahiye.
en: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.
text:
2CO 5:13
Thadou: Keiho hi ngolmana tomngaina neiya neigeluva ahileh, hichu Pathen loupina ding ahi. Chule keiho hi achingtah a neigeluva ahileh, hichu nangho phatchomna ding ahiye.
English: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

tcz: Ahoichu hitaleh, Christa ngailutna chun eithunun u ahitai. Eihon Christa chu mijouse dinga thia ahitai ti itahsan uva ahileh, eima ho jong imilui uva chu thia ihitauve.
en: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.
text:
2CO 5:14
Thadou: Ahoichu hitaleh, Christa ngailutna chun eithunun u ahitai. Eihon Christa chu mijouse dinga thia ahitai ti itahsan uva ahileh, eima ho jong imilui uva chu thia ihitauve.
English: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

tcz: Ama mitin dinga thia ahitah jeh a chu Ama a hinna kisan ho chu amaho dinga hingjom talou ding ahitauve. Chusanga, amaho chu adinguva thia chule thoukitpa Christa ding joh a chu hing ding ahitauve.
en: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.
text:
2CO 5:15
Thadou: Ama mitin dinga thia ahitah jeh a chu Ama a hinna kisan ho chu amaho dinga hingjom talou ding ahitauve. Chusanga, amaho chu adinguva thia chule thoukitpa Christa ding joh a chu hing ding ahitauve.
English: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

tcz: Hitiahi keihon midangho chungchang thua mihem lunggela donsuhtoa thuseina kabol tapouve. Phatkhat chu keihon Christa chu mihem lunggel ngaiton kana ngaito uvin ahi. Tunvang keihon kageluhi ajatchom behtai.
en: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.
text:
2CO 5:16
Thadou: Hitiahi keihon midangho chungchang thua mihem lunggela donsuhtoa thuseina kabol tapouve. Phatkhat chu keihon Christa chu mihem lunggel ngaiton kana ngaito uvin ahi. Tunvang keihon kageluhi ajatchom behtai.
English: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

tcz: Hiche hin Christian hunghi jouse chu mithah ahitauve tina ahi. Amaho chu abepbep hitalou ahitai, ajeh chu hinkho lui chu chemang ahitai. Hinkho thah kipan ahitai!
en: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
text:
2CO 5:17
Thadou: Hiche hin Christian hunghi jouse chu mithah ahitauve tina ahi. Amaho chu abepbep hitalou ahitai, ajeh chu hinkho lui chu chemang ahitai. Hinkho thah kipan ahitai!
English: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

tcz: Chule hicheho jouse hi Christa jal'a Ama koma eilepuikit'u ahitah jeh in Pathena kona thilpeh ahije. Chule Pathen in miho chu Amatoh kichamna dinga ngansena eipeh u ahi.
en: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi Christa a uma, miho chonsetna chu amaho dounaa simta louva, vannoi hi Amatoh kichamna asem ahitai. Chule aman hiche kichamkitna thuhi ahin pohlut ahitai.
en: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
text:
2CO 5:19
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen hi Christa a uma, miho chonsetna chu amaho dounaa simta louva, vannoi hi Amatoh kichamna asem ahitai. Chule aman hiche kichamkitna thuhi ahin pohlut ahitai.
English: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

tcz: Keiho Christa Palai kahiuve, chule Pathen in nangho henga thusei dinga keiho eimanchah u ahi. Keihon nangho, Christa amatah in angeh banga kangeh nahiuve, “Pathen toh kicham'un.”
en: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.
text:
2CO 5:20
Thadou: Keiho Christa Palai kahiuve, chule Pathen in nangho henga thusei dinga keiho eimanchah u ahi. Keihon nangho, Christa amatah in angeh banga kangeh nahiuve, “Pathen toh kicham'un.”
English: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa, achonse khaloubeh chu, eiho lhatdoh dinga akatdoh ahi, chutia chu eiho Pathen toh Christa jal'a suhdih'a iumna diu ahi.
en: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
text:
2CO 5:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa, achonse khaloubeh chu, eiho lhatdoh dinga akatdoh ahi, chutia chu eiho Pathen toh Christa jal'a suhdih'a iumna diu ahi.
English: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

tcz: Pathen to tongkhom kahi jal'un, hiche Pathen milungset them ahina thilpeh kidang tah nakisan uhi, imacha louva nakoi louna dinguva kangeh nahiuve.
en: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
text:
2CO 6:1
Thadou: Pathen to tongkhom kahi jal'un, hiche Pathen milungset them ahina thilpeh kidang tah nakisan uhi, imacha louva nakoi louna dinguva kangeh nahiuve.
English: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in, “Aphat chan keiman nataona kasange. Huhhingna nikhoa chu, keiman kapanhu nahitai. Ahimongin ‘phat kijenpet’ chu tuhi ahi. Tuni hi Huhhingna nikho ahi,” ati.
en: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
text:
2CO 6:2
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen in, “Aphat chan keiman nataona kasange. Huhhingna nikhoa chu, keiman kapanhu nahitai. Ahimongin ‘phat kijenpet’ chu tuhi ahi. Tuni hi Huhhingna nikho ahi,” ati.
English: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

tcz: Keiho hinkho kiman chah hi koima kipalsah lou tei ding katiu ahi, chule kalhacha natoh uhi koiman ei-oimolou teina dingu kagel'un ahi.
en: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
text:
2CO 6:3
Thadou: Keiho hinkho kiman chah hi koima kipalsah lou tei ding katiu ahi, chule kalhacha natoh uhi koiman ei-oimolou teina dingu kagel'un ahi.
English: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

tcz: Thil kabol chanu hi, Pathen lhacha tahbeh kahiuve ti katahlah u ahi. Keihon boinaho le hahsatna ho chule settona ho tintang thohhat tah in kathoh uvin ahi.
en: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
text:
2CO 6:4
Thadou: Thil kabol chanu hi, Pathen lhacha tahbeh kahiuve ti katahlah u ahi. Keihon boinaho le hahsatna ho chule settona ho tintang thohhat tah in kathoh uvin ahi.
English: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

tcz: Keiho hi eikivo uvin, songkul'a eikikhum uvin, mihonpi lunghang kimaitopia kahiuvin, tha ngoilhah geiya tonggima kahiuvin, jan ihmut theilou, chule anne louva um thoh'a kahiuve.
en: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
text:
2CO 6:5
Thadou: Keiho hi eikivo uvin, songkul'a eikikhum uvin, mihonpi lunghang kimaitopia kahiuvin, tha ngoilhah geiya tonggima kahiuvin, jan ihmut theilou, chule anne louva um thoh'a kahiuve.
English: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

tcz: Keima ho tah kahina uva thenna nei, hetkhen themna nei, thohhatna nei, lungsetna nei, kasung uva Lhagao Theng chenga ahin, chule ngailutna dihtah neiya khosa jinga kahiuve.
en: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
text:
2CO 6:6
Thadou: Keima ho tah kahina uva thenna nei, hetkhen themna nei, thohhatna nei, lungsetna nei, kasung uva Lhagao Theng chenga ahin, chule ngailutna dihtah neiya khosa jinga kahiuve.
English: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

tcz: Keihon thutah chu tahsan umtah'a seiphonga kahiuve. Pathen thahatna chun keihoa na atongin ahi. Keihon chonphatna galvon chu ka khut jetlam uvah melma nonan kamanguvin, chule kaveilam uvah kihon nan kaneiyun ahi.
en: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
text:
2CO 6:7
Thadou: Keihon thutah chu tahsan umtah'a seiphonga kahiuve. Pathen thahatna chun keihoa na atongin ahi. Keihon chonphatna galvon chu ka khut jetlam uvah melma nonan kamanguvin, chule kaveilam uvah kihon nan kaneiyun ahi.
English: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

tcz: Keiho hi mihon eijabolu henlang ahilouleh imacha hilouvin eibolu jongleh, amaho chun eiseiseu henlang ahilouleh eipahchau jongleh Pathen natonga kahiuve. Keiho kitahna nei kahiuvin, hinla mihon kitahna nei louvin eingai touve.
en: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
text:
2CO 6:8
Thadou: Keiho hi mihon eijabolu henlang ahilouleh imacha hilouvin eibolu jongleh, amaho chun eiseiseu henlang ahilouleh eipahchau jongleh Pathen natonga kahiuve. Keiho kitahna nei kahiuvin, hinla mihon kitahna nei louvin eingai touve.
English: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

tcz: Keiho hi mihet tah kahi vangun, koiman eihepha pouve. Keiho hi thina toh kinai chan kaum uvin, hinlah tugeiyin kahinguve. Keiho hi eikivo uvin, hinla eithat doh deh pouve.
en: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
text:
2CO 6:9
Thadou: Keiho hi mihet tah kahi vangun, koiman eihepha pouve. Keiho hi thina toh kinai chan kaum uvin, hinlah tugeiyin kahinguve. Keiho hi eikivo uvin, hinla eithat doh deh pouve.
English: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

tcz: Kalungu anajin, hinla keiho kakipah jinguve. Vaicha tah kahiuvin, hinla keihon midang lhagaova kahaosah uve. Imacha kaneiden'u aumpon, hinla ijakai kaneiyun ahi.
en: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
text:
2CO 6:10
Thadou: Kalungu anajin, hinla keiho kakipah jinguve. Vaicha tah kahiuvin, hinla keihon midang lhagaova kahaosah uve. Imacha kaneiden'u aumpon, hinla ijakai kaneiyun ahi.
English: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

tcz: Vo, deitah Corinth mite keihon kitah tah in nangho kabolun, chule kalungu nangho henga akihongin ahi.
en: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
text:
2CO 6:11
Thadou: Vo, deitah Corinth mite keihon kitah tah in nangho kabolun, chule kalungu nangho henga akihongin ahi.
English: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailut nau akiphasam pon, hinla nang hon keiho chunga ngailutna neipe pouve.
en: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
text:
2CO 6:12
Thadou: Keihon nangho kangailut nau akiphasam pon, hinla nang hon keiho chunga ngailutna neipe pouve.
English: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

tcz: Nangho hi kacha tahbeh banga kagel'a nei lethuh diuva kangeh nahiuve. Nalungu keiho dingin hong uvin!
en: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
text:
2CO 6:13
Thadou: Nangho hi kacha tahbeh banga kagel'a nei lethuh diuva kangeh nahiuve. Nalungu keiho dingin hong uvin!
English: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

tcz: Atahsan lou ho toh pangkhom hih un. Itidan'a chonphatna chun gitlouna to chan aneikhom thei ding ham? Itidan'a muthim chu khovah to umkhom thei ding ham?
en: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
text:
2CO 6:14
Thadou: Atahsan lou ho toh pangkhom hih un. Itidan'a chonphatna chun gitlouna to chan aneikhom thei ding ham? Itidan'a muthim chu khovah to umkhom thei ding ham?
English: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

tcz: Christa le Diabol chun iti kitona anei thei lhon ding ham? Atahsan lou khat le atahsan khat chun iti chan anei khom thei ding ham?
en: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
text:
2CO 6:15
Thadou: Christa le Diabol chun iti kitona anei thei lhon ding ham? Atahsan lou khat le atahsan khat chun iti chan anei khom thei ding ham?
English: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

tcz: Pathen hou-in le milim ho houna in akilungtona ipi umem? Ajeh chu eiho Pathen hing hou-in ihiuve. Pathen in aseibang chun, “Keima amaho sunga kachena chule alah uva kavale ding ahi. Keima amaho Pathen kahiding, chule amaho kamite hiding ahi.”
en: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
text:
2CO 6:16
Thadou: Pathen hou-in le milim ho houna in akilungtona ipi umem? Ajeh chu eiho Pathen hing hou-in ihiuve. Pathen in aseibang chun, “Keima amaho sunga kachena chule alah uva kavale ding ahi. Keima amaho Pathen kahiding, chule amaho kamite hiding ahi.”
English: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

tcz: Hijeh chun, “Tahsan louho lah a kon chun hung potdoh'un, chule amahoa konin kikang seuvin, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Amaho thilthenglou chu tongkha hih un, chutileh keiman nangho kalem dingu ahi.”
en: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
text:
2CO 6:17
Thadou: Hijeh chun, “Tahsan louho lah a kon chun hung potdoh'un, chule amahoa konin kikang seuvin, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Amaho thilthenglou chu tongkha hih un, chutileh keiman nangho kalem dingu ahi.”
English: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

tcz: “Chule keima na Pa-u kahiding, chule nangho kachate nahi dingu ahi,” tin Pakai Hatchungnung in aseiye.
en: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
text:
2CO 6:18
Thadou: “Chule keima na Pa-u kahiding, chule nangho kachate nahi dingu ahi,” tin Pakai Hatchungnung in aseiye.
English: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

tcz: Hicheng thutep ho ichan jeh uvin, sopite ho, itahsau ahilouleh ilhagaovu suboh thei hoa kon chun ipipi lamah hijongleh eimaho kisuthengu hite. Chule eihon Pathen iginjeh uvin thenna chamkim lama kihabolu hite.
en: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
text:
2CO 7:1
Thadou: Hicheng thutep ho ichan jeh uvin, sopite ho, itahsau ahilouleh ilhagaovu suboh thei hoa kon chun ipipi lamah hijongleh eimaho kisuthengu hite. Chule eihon Pathen iginjeh uvin thenna chamkim lama kihabolu hite.
English: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

tcz: Nangho keiho dingin lung kihongin umun. Keihon koima alamlouvin kabol khapouvin, koima kapuikhel nau jong aumpoi, koima cha jong kaphat chomna diuvin kamang chapouve.
en: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.
text:
2CO 7:2
Thadou: Nangho keiho dingin lung kihongin umun. Keihon koima alamlouvin kabol khapouvin, koima kapuikhel nau jong aumpoi, koima cha jong kaphat chomna diuvin kamang chapouve.
English: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

tcz: Hiche hi nangho themmo chansahna a kasei ahipoi. Masanga kaseipeh banguvin nangho hi kalung uva kagel khoh uvin, chule nangho to hintha a chule thitha ding kahiuve.
en: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
text:
2CO 7:3
Thadou: Hiche hi nangho themmo chansahna a kasei ahipoi. Masanga kaseipeh banguvin nangho hi kalung uva kagel khoh uvin, chule nangho to hintha a chule thitha ding kahiuve.
English: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

tcz: Keiman nangho kisonpina lenpen kaneiyun, chule keiman nangho kakithang-at pilheh jeng uvin ahi. Nanghon neiha tilkhou lheh uvin, chule kahahsat nau jouse a jong nanghon nei kipasah uvin ahi.
en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.
text:
2CO 7:4
Thadou: Keiman nangho kisonpina lenpen kaneiyun, chule keiman nangho kakithang-at pilheh jeng uvin ahi. Nanghon neiha tilkhou lheh uvin, chule kahahsat nau jouse a jong nanghon nei kipasah uvin ahi.
English: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

tcz: Keiho Macedonia kaga lhun uchun lunga kicholdo theina kanei pouve. Hoimalam jouse lung kichiahna katoh un, polama kidouna ho aum toh, lungsunga kichatna kaneiyuve.
en: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.
text:
2CO 7:5
Thadou: Keiho Macedonia kaga lhun uchun lunga kicholdo theina kanei pouve. Hoimalam jouse lung kichiahna katoh un, polama kidouna ho aum toh, lungsunga kichatna kaneiyuve.
English: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in alunglha ho atilkhouvin, Titus hunglhun hin eitilkhou tauve.
en: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,
text:
2CO 7:6
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen in alunglha ho atilkhouvin, Titus hunglhun hin eitilkhou tauve.
English: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

tcz: Ama hunglhun hin eikipasah uvin, adehset'in nanghoa kona tilkhouna thu aman ahinmu chun keiho eitilkhou lheh jeng uvin ahi. Nang hon neimu nom lheh u thudol aseiya chule thilsoh jeh a nalung khamnau, chule keima dinga na kiphaltheng nau thu kajah chun, kipanan kadimset jenge!
en: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.
text:
2CO 7:7
Thadou: Ama hunglhun hin eikipasah uvin, adehset'in nanghoa kona tilkhouna thu aman ahinmu chun keiho eitilkhou lheh jeng uvin ahi. Nang hon neimu nom lheh u thudol aseiya chule thilsoh jeh a nalung khamnau, chule keima dinga na kiphaltheng nau thu kajah chun, kipanan kadimset jenge!
English: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

tcz: Chutobang thuhahsa lekhathot kahin thot chu, apet'a kakiphatlamna khat aum vang'in, nangho dinga phat chomkhat anat lheh ding vang chun, kiphatlam na kaneipoi.
en: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.
text:
2CO 7:8
Thadou: Chutobang thuhahsa lekhathot kahin thot chu, apet'a kakiphatlamna khat aum vang'in, nangho dinga phat chomkhat anat lheh ding vang chun, kiphatlam na kaneipoi.
English: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

tcz: Kahin thot chu tun kalung akipahtai, nangho kalung nopmosah u chu hijo louvin, nalung nat'u chun nakisih sah uvin, chule na hinkho man danu nakhel theiyun ahi. Hichu Pathen in amiten anei ding uva adei ahi, hitia chu nangho keihon nasetna dingu imacha kabolnau aumpoi.
en: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.
text:
2CO 7:9
Thadou: Kahin thot chu tun kalung akipahtai, nangho kalung nopmosah u chu hijo louvin, nalung nat'u chun nakisih sah uvin, chule na hinkho man danu nakhel theiyun ahi. Hichu Pathen in amiten anei ding uva adei ahi, hitia chu nangho keihon nasetna dingu imacha kabolnau aumpoi.
English: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

tcz: Ajehchu lungkhamna Pathen in eideipeh u chun chonset'a kona eipuidoh uva hichun huhhingna asodoh ahi. Hitobang lungkhamna chun kisihna asodohpoi. Hinla vannoi lungkham nan kisihna asodoh joulou ahin, hichun lhagao thina asodoh sah ahiye.
en: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.
text:
2CO 7:10
Thadou: Ajehchu lungkhamna Pathen in eideipeh u chun chonset'a kona eipuidoh uva hichun huhhingna asodoh ahi. Hitobang lungkhamna chun kisihna asodohpoi. Hinla vannoi lungkham nan kisihna asodoh joulou ahin, hichun lhagao thina asodoh sah ahiye.
English: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

tcz: Hiche Pathen ngaisahna lungkhamna in na hinkhoa ipi asodoh vetemin! Hitobang tah lunggutna, hibangtah a lungthenna nanei nau, hitobang tah a lunghimona, hitobang loma kihonna, hitobang loma nei munom tennau, hitobangtah a na gutchu pottho nau, hitobang tah a adihlou gimbolna. Nangho tah in thil ijakai adih bol angaina thudol nei hung vetsah tauve.
en: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.
text:
2CO 7:11
Thadou: Hiche Pathen ngaisahna lungkhamna in na hinkhoa ipi asodoh vetemin! Hitobang tah lunggutna, hibangtah a lungthenna nanei nau, hitobang tah a lunghimona, hitobang loma kihonna, hitobang loma nei munom tennau, hitobangtah a na gutchu pottho nau, hitobang tah a adihlou gimbolna. Nangho tah in thil ijakai adih bol angaina thudol nei hung vetsah tauve.
English: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

tcz: Keiman chuche pet'a lekha kajih lona ajeh chu, adihlou bola chu koi hiya ahiloule koiham adihlou bola ngoh ding chu tithua hola kahipoi. Keiman nahenguva Pathen mitmua kahin jih lona ajeh chu nang hon keiho dinga ichan geiya kiphalna naneiyu hitam ti naki mudoh theina dingu ahi bouve.
en: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.
text:
2CO 7:12
Thadou: Keiman chuche pet'a lekha kajih lona ajeh chu, adihlou bola chu koi hiya ahiloule koiham adihlou bola ngoh ding chu tithua hola kahipoi. Keiman nahenguva Pathen mitmua kahin jih lona ajeh chu nang hon keiho dinga ichan geiya kiphalna naneiyu hitam ti naki mudoh theina dingu ahi bouve.
English: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

tcz: Keiho tah hiche hin eitilkhou nau chu, Titus nana lamto nauva amaa kipana chu nang hon ama nabon chauva nanalem uva chule nalung olsah nau chu, keiho kipa thanopna dehset ahiye.
en: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.
text:
2CO 7:13
Thadou: Keiho tah hiche hin eitilkhou nau chu, Titus nana lamto nauva amaa kipana chu nang hon ama nabon chauva nanalem uva chule nalung olsah nau chu, keiho kipa thanopna dehset ahiye.
English: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

tcz: Keiman nangho hi ichan geiya ka kiletsah piu chule nei lunglhah sahlouvu thudol kaseipehsa ahitai. Keiman nangho thutahbeh kaseipeh jing nahiuvin chule tua hi Titus henga kakisonna thu kaseijong adih monge ti photchet ahitai.
en: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.
text:
2CO 7:14
Thadou: Keiman nangho hi ichan geiya ka kiletsah piu chule nei lunglhah sahlouvu thudol kaseipehsa ahitai. Keiman nangho thutahbeh kaseipeh jing nahiuvin chule tua hi Titus henga kakisonna thu kaseijong adih monge ti photchet ahitai.
English: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

tcz: Tuhin aman nangho atila sangin naha gelkhoh cheh tauvin ahi ajeh chu nang hon ama gin le ja umtah puma nabon chauva nalem uva asei nangai jalu ahi.
en: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.
text:
2CO 7:15
Thadou: Tuhin aman nangho atila sangin naha gelkhoh cheh tauvin ahi ajeh chu nang hon ama gin le ja umtah puma nabon chauva nalem uva asei nangai jalu ahi.
English: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

tcz: Keiman nangho tahsanna bulhingset'a kanei nahi jeh uva tua hi kipah tah a uma kahitai.
en: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
text:
2CO 7:16
Thadou: Keiman nangho tahsanna bulhingset'a kanei nahi jeh uva tua hi kipah tah a uma kahitai.
English: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.
