tcz: Tua hi kasopi deitahte, Macedonia gamkaiya houbung ho Pathen in akhohsah a, amanchah a na atohho thudol nahet ding uva kadeipeh nahiuve.
en: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,
text:
2CO 8:1
Thadou: Tua hi kasopi deitahte, Macedonia gamkaiya houbung ho Pathen in akhohsah a, amanchah a na atohho thudol nahet ding uva kadeipeh nahiuve.
English: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

tcz: Amaho hin hahsat na tintang'ah patepna atoh un, chule amaho avaicha lheh jenguvin ahi. Hinla amaho hi kipana chamkimin akipah uvin, hongphalna lama ahaonau chu along letlha jeng tauve.
en: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
text:
2CO 8:2
Thadou: Amaho hin hahsat na tintang'ah patepna atoh un, chule amaho avaicha lheh jenguvin ahi. Hinla amaho hi kipana chamkimin akipah uvin, hongphalna lama ahaonau chu along letlha jeng tauve.
English: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

tcz: Ajehchu keiman kahettohsah chu amaho hin apeh diuva kilom khamset chu apehdoh u hita louvin, chusangin akalvalin apeuvin ahi. Chule hichu amaho lung chamtah a abolu ahi.
en: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,
text:
2CO 8:3
Thadou: Ajehchu keiman kahettohsah chu amaho hin apeh diuva kilom khamset chu apehdoh u hita louvin, chusangin akalvalin apeuvin ahi. Chule hichu amaho lung chamtah a abolu ahi.
English: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

tcz: Amaho hin avel vel in Jerusalem khopi sunga tahsanho thilpeh pehding thua eingeh jomun ahi.
en: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.
text:
2CO 8:4
Thadou: Amaho hin avel vel in Jerusalem khopi sunga tahsanho thilpeh pehding thua eingeh jomun ahi.
English: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

tcz: Keihon ka ginchat kalvalun amahon aboluve, ajeh chu amaho chondan hi-amasa tahin Pakaiyah akipedoh uvin, chujouvin Pathen in amaho bol dinga adei tobang'in keiho eipeuvin ahi.
en: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
text:
2CO 8:5
Thadou: Keihon ka ginchat kalvalun amahon aboluve, ajeh chu amaho chondan hi-amasa tahin Pakaiyah akipedoh uvin, chujouvin Pathen in amaho bol dinga adei tobang'in keiho eipeuvin ahi.
English: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

tcz: Hiti chun keihon Titus, na thilpeh masat uva natilkhou uva panga anahin, ama chu naheng uva ahung kilekit'a chule hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh hi bulhit dinga kanganseu chu ahi.
en: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.
text:
2CO 8:6
Thadou: Hiti chun keihon Titus, na thilpeh masat uva natilkhou uva panga anahin, ama chu naheng uva ahung kilekit'a chule hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh hi bulhit dinga kanganseu chu ahi.
English: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

tcz: Nangho atamjoa–tahsannaa, thusei themna lama, hetna lama, gutchuna lama, chule keihoa kona ngailutna-hicheng hoa lolhinna nei nahiuto lhon'a thilpeh lama jong lungset neiya na lolhin dingu kati ahi.
en: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.
text:
2CO 8:7
Thadou: Nangho atamjoa–tahsannaa, thusei themna lama, hetna lama, gutchuna lama, chule keihoa kona ngailutna-hicheng hoa lolhinna nei nahiuto lhon'a thilpeh lama jong lungset neiya na lolhin dingu kati ahi.
English: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

tcz: Keiman nanghon hiche hi bolteiyun tia kaseina ahideh poi, houbung dangho abol dinga athanop lheh jeng vang uva, hiche hi nangailut nau atahbeh ahidan photchenna lampi khat ahi.
en: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.
text:
2CO 8:8
Thadou: Keiman nanghon hiche hi bolteiyun tia kaseina ahideh poi, houbung dangho abol dinga athanop lheh jeng vang uva, hiche hi nangailut nau atahbeh ahidan photchenna lampi khat ahi.
English: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

tcz: Nanghon I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa lungsetna a hongphal tah ahi chu nahe tauve. Ama ahao jeng vanga nangho jal'a vaicha hung kisoh a ahitai, hitia chu Ama vaichat jal'a chu Aman nangho nahaosah theina dingu ahiye.
en: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.
text:
2CO 8:9
Thadou: Nanghon I Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa lungsetna a hongphal tah ahi chu nahe tauve. Ama ahao jeng vanga nangho jal'a vaicha hung kisoh a ahitai, hitia chu Ama vaichat jal'a chu Aman nangho nahaosah theina dingu ahiye.
English: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

tcz: Hichea kathumop nau chu: Nanghon kum khat masanga nanapatsau chu jotei ding gong'un, ajeh chu nangho tah hiche pehdohna lama lunggel hin nei masapen nahiuvin chule apandoh masapen nana hiuve.
en: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.
text:
2CO 8:10
Thadou: Hichea kathumop nau chu: Nanghon kum khat masanga nanapatsau chu jotei ding gong'un, ajeh chu nangho tah hiche pehdohna lama lunggel hin nei masapen nahiuvin chule apandoh masapen nana hiuve.
English: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

tcz: Thanom tah a nana patdoh u natoh chu tua hi nasuh bulhit diu ahi. Nanei dung juiyun napeh thei chan peuvin.
en: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.
text:
2CO 8:11
Thadou: Thanom tah a nana patdoh u natoh chu tua hi nasuh bulhit diu ahi. Nanei dung juiyun napeh thei chan peuvin.
English: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

tcz: Naphaldoh u chu pehnomna lungthim neiya nahi pouleh santhei tah hiding ahi. Chule nanei dung juiyun, nanei louvu chu pego louvin, nanei khamun peuvin.
en: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
text:
2CO 8:12
Thadou: Naphaldoh u chu pehnomna lungthim neiya nahi pouleh santhei tah hiding ahi. Chule nanei dung juiyun, nanei louvu chu pego louvin, nanei khamun peuvin.
English: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

tcz: Ahimongin, na thilpeh u chun midang hinkho nom amansah a, nangho tah na hahsat dingu chu kasei ahipoi. Akitoh akilom hiding kaseina ahi.
en: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,
text:
2CO 8:13
Thadou: Ahimongin, na thilpeh u chun midang hinkho nom amansah a, nangho tah na hahsat dingu chu kasei ahipoi. Akitoh akilom hiding kaseina ahi.
English: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

tcz: Tua hi nangho naning lhinu ahin, chule panpi ngaiho napanpi theiyu ahi. Khonung teng, amaho aninglhin uva chule nanghon na ngaichat uva ahileh napanhu theiju ahi. Hitia hi, thil ho hi kibanga um thei ahi.
en: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.
text:
2CO 8:14
Thadou: Tua hi nangho naning lhinu ahin, chule panpi ngaiho napanpi theiyu ahi. Khonung teng, amaho aninglhin uva chule nanghon na ngaichat uva ahileh napanhu theiju ahi. Hitia hi, thil ho hi kibanga um thei ahi.
English: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei, “Tamtah lakhom hoa aval aumdoh dehpon, chule themcha bou lakhomho chun aphaset aneiyuve,” ati.
en: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”
text:
2CO 8:15
Thadou: Pathen Thubun asei, “Tamtah lakhom hoa aval aumdoh dehpon, chule themcha bou lakhomho chun aphaset aneiyuve,” ati.
English: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

tcz: Ahin Pathen thangvah un! Keiman nangho chunga thanopna kanei tobang'in Titus jong thanopna apen ahi.
en: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
text:
2CO 8:16
Thadou: Ahin Pathen thangvah un! Keiman nangho chunga thanopna kanei tobang'in Titus jong thanopna apen ahi.
English: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

tcz: Titus hin kangeh nau hi anasangin nangho navil kit uvin ahi. Ahimonga, amahin chenomna neiya nahung munomu ahi.
en: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.
text:
2CO 8:17
Thadou: Titus hin kangeh nau hi anasangin nangho navil kit uvin ahi. Ahimonga, amahin chenomna neiya nahung munomu ahi.
English: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

tcz: Keihon sopi dang khat jong Titus to kahin solthauvin ahi. Amahi Kipana Thupha seiphonga pang ahina a houbung ho jousen aseiphat'u ahi.
en: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.
text:
2CO 8:18
Thadou: Keihon sopi dang khat jong Titus to kahin solthauvin ahi. Amahi Kipana Thupha seiphonga pang ahina a houbung ho jousen aseiphat'u ahi.
English: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

tcz: Amahi houbung hon Jerusalema dinga sum kitoh khom ho podinga anganseu ahi-hiche kipedoh hi Pakai loupina kipehna chule ipanhu nomnau vetsahna ahi.
en: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.
text:
2CO 8:19
Thadou: Amahi houbung hon Jerusalema dinga sum kitoh khom ho podinga anganseu ahi-hiche kipedoh hi Pakai loupina kipehna chule ipanhu nomnau vetsahna ahi.
English: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

tcz: Hiche hongphal tah a thilpeh kipedoh chung chang thua kiginmona tapou chu vesui dinga kholjin khom kahiuve, ajeh chu koiman kathilbol nauva mo eichan louna diuva gelkhohna nei kahiuve.
en: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.
text:
2CO 8:20
Thadou: Hiche hongphal tah a thilpeh kipedoh chung chang thua kiginmona tapou chu vesui dinga kholjin khom kahiuve, ajeh chu koiman kathilbol nauva mo eichan louna diuva gelkhohna nei kahiuve.
English: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

tcz: Keiho hi Pakai angsunga jathei tah a umding gelkhoh a kahiuvin, chule midang koi koi hijongleh jathei kahiu hi amudoh dingu jong kadeiyu ahi.
en: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
text:
2CO 8:21
Thadou: Keiho hi Pakai angsunga jathei tah a umding gelkhoh a kahiuvin, chule midang koi koi hijongleh jathei kahiu hi amudoh dingu jong kadeiyu ahi.
English: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

tcz: Keihon isopihou lah a khat mun tamtah'a phatna tamtah nei, agutchuna kaphottohsau hi amaho toh kahinsol thauve. Nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong amahi thanomjo cheh ahi.
en: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.
text:
2CO 8:22
Thadou: Keihon isopihou lah a khat mun tamtah'a phatna tamtah nei, agutchuna kaphottohsau hi amaho toh kahinsol thauve. Nachunguva ginchatna lentah aneijeh a tujenga jong amahi thanomjo cheh ahi.
English: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

tcz: Titus thudol donga aum khat touva ahileh amahi nangho kithopina dinga keitoh tongkhoma ahi tin seiyun. Chule sopite ho houbung hon amatoh ahinsol thau ahin, amaho hin Christa jabolna ahinlhutna dingu ahi.
en: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.
text:
2CO 8:23
Thadou: Titus thudol donga aum khat touva ahileh amahi nangho kithopina dinga keitoh tongkhoma ahi tin seiyun. Chule sopite ho houbung hon amatoh ahinsol thau ahin, amaho hin Christa jabolna ahinlhutna dingu ahi.
English: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

tcz: Hiti hin amaho hi nangailut nau ana vetsah un, chule houbung ho jouse henga nangho kakisonpiu hi photchetna ana peuvin.
en: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.
text:
2CO 8:24
Thadou: Hiti hin amaho hi nangailut nau ana vetsah un, chule houbung ho jouse henga nangho kakisonpiu hi photchetna ana peuvin.
English: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

tcz: Keiman Jerusalema atahsan ho dinga thilpeh a lhacha natoh thudol'a kahin jih ding chu angaikhoh e tin kagelpoi.
en: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,
text:
2CO 9:1
Thadou: Keiman Jerusalema atahsan ho dinga thilpeh a lhacha natoh thudol'a kahin jih ding chu angaikhoh e tin kagelpoi.
English: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

tcz: Ajehchu keiman nanghon nakithopinom ten'u ahiti kahei, chule nangho Greece gamkaiya um hohin kum khat masanga kithopina naneinom uva nahin thot kigot'u anahi thudol chu Macedonia houbung ho henga kithang attah a ana seilea kanahi tai. Atahbeh in, nanghoa thanopna um chun Macedonia a um atahsanho mitampin ahin pehpat nauva atilkhou uva panga nahiuve.
en: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.
text:
2CO 9:2
Thadou: Ajehchu keiman nanghon nakithopinom ten'u ahiti kahei, chule nangho Greece gamkaiya um hohin kum khat masanga kithopina naneinom uva nahin thot kigot'u anahi thudol chu Macedonia houbung ho henga kithang attah a ana seilea kanahi tai. Atahbeh in, nanghoa thanopna um chun Macedonia a um atahsanho mitampin ahin pehpat nauva atilkhou uva panga nahiuve.
English: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

tcz: Hinlah keiman hiche sopite ho hi nakigot mongu ahi photchetna a amaho kaseipeh a kahinsol ahi, chule nasumu chu khopkhom sohkei hiding ahi. Keiman nangho kakisonpi nauva mo eikichan ding chu kanompoi.
en: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,
text:
2CO 9:3
Thadou: Hinlah keiman hiche sopite ho hi nakigot mongu ahi photchetna a amaho kaseipeh a kahinsol ahi, chule nasumu chu khopkhom sohkei hiding ahi. Keiman nangho kakisonpi nauva mo eikichan ding chu kanompoi.
English: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

tcz: Keima Macedonia a atahsan phabep ho chuto hung uving ting, nangho chungchang thu kaseijo uvin nakigot lou u chu hung mudoh khaleu, nangho nalungu lhailou ding, sei sei ngai talouva keiho kalungu lhai talou ding ahi.
en: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.
text:
2CO 9:4
Thadou: Keima Macedonia a atahsan phabep ho chuto hung uving ting, nangho chungchang thu kaseijo uvin nakigot lou u chu hung mudoh khaleu, nangho nalungu lhailou ding, sei sei ngai talouva keiho kalungu lhai talou ding ahi.
English: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

tcz: Hitia chu keiman sopiho hi keima hung masanga hinsol masah a, na thilpeh dingu chu gotsa nakoiyuva ahina ding kati ahi. Hinla keiman hichu lunga nopna neiya thilpeh ahi ding kadeiyin, phunchel puma peh ahi ding kanompoi.
en: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.
text:
2CO 9:5
Thadou: Hitia chu keiman sopiho hi keima hung masanga hinsol masah a, na thilpeh dingu chu gotsa nakoiyuva ahina ding kati ahi. Hinla keiman hichu lunga nopna neiya thilpeh ahi ding kadeiyin, phunchel puma peh ahi ding kanompoi.
English: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

tcz: Hiche hi geldoh in loubol mi muchi lhomcha tua chun aga lhomcha alokhom ding ahi. Hinla hongphal tah a tua chun ahongphalna tobangma akilokhom ding ahi.
en: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
text:
2CO 9:6
Thadou: Hiche hi geldoh in loubol mi muchi lhomcha tua chun aga lhomcha alokhom ding ahi. Hinla hongphal tah a tua chun ahongphalna tobangma akilokhom ding ahi.
English: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

tcz: Nangma ho cheh in nalunggel uva ijat napeh dingu nakigel lhah u angaiye. Chule pehih beh un ahilouleh seihat vang'in pehih un. “Ajeh chu Pathen in lunglhaisela pe mi chu angailun ahi.”
en: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
text:
2CO 9:7
Thadou: Nangma ho cheh in nalunggel uva ijat napeh dingu nakigel lhah u angaiye. Chule pehih beh un ahilouleh seihat vang'in pehih un. “Ajeh chu Pathen in lunglhaisela pe mi chu angailun ahi.”
English: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

tcz: Chule Pathen in na ngaichat jouseu hongphal tah a napeh dingu ahi. Chutengleh nanghon na ngaichat chan'u chu nanei dingu chule nanei letset uva aval'a midang nato thei dingu ahi.
en: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
text:
2CO 9:8
Thadou: Chule Pathen in na ngaichat jouseu hongphal tah a napeh dingu ahi. Chutengleh nanghon na ngaichat chan'u chu nanei dingu chule nanei letset uva aval'a midang nato thei dingu ahi.
English: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Amahon alungcham tah un chule hongphaltah in mi vaichate apeuve. Athilpha bol hou chu a imatih chan a kigeldoh jing ding ahi.”
en: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”
text:
2CO 9:9
Thadou: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Amahon alungcham tah un chule hongphaltah in mi vaichate apeuve. Athilpha bol hou chu a imatih chan a kigeldoh jing ding ahi.”
English: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen hi loubol mi dinga muchi-chivo pea ahin chule neh ding changlhah pea ahi. Hitobangma chun, Aman nathil neisa hou hin punbe sah intin chule nasung uva konin hongphalna lentah sodoh theina tohga nahin sodoh peh nauvinte.
en: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,
text:
2CO 9:10
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen hi loubol mi dinga muchi-chivo pea ahin chule neh ding changlhah pea ahi. Hitobangma chun, Aman nathil neisa hou hin punbe sah intin chule nasung uva konin hongphalna lentah sodoh theina tohga nahin sodoh peh nauvinte.
English: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

tcz: Ahi, imalam jousea ninglhingin umun natin, chutengleh nangho aphatseh in hongphal jing tauvin nate. Chule keihon nathilpeh u chu angaichaho koma kalhut tenguleh amahon Pathen athangvah dingu ahi.
en: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.
text:
2CO 9:11
Thadou: Ahi, imalam jousea ninglhingin umun natin, chutengleh nangho aphatseh in hongphal jing tauvin nate. Chule keihon nathilpeh u chu angaichaho koma kalhut tenguleh amahon Pathen athangvah dingu ahi.
English: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

tcz: Hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh a kona thilpha ni hung sohdoh ding chu-Jerusalema atahsan hon angaichat u kimu uvintin, chule amahon kipah le thanom tah a Pathen thangvahna aphondoh dingu ahi.
en: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,
text:
2CO 9:12
Thadou: Hiche thilpeh lhacha natoh a kona thilpha ni hung sohdoh ding chu-Jerusalema atahsan hon angaichat u kimu uvintin, chule amahon kipah le thanom tah a Pathen thangvahna aphondoh dingu ahi.
English: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

tcz: Nangho lhacha natoh jal'a chu, amahon Pathen loupina apeh thei dingu ahi. Amaho chunga le atahsan ho jouse chunga nahongphal nau hin Christa Kipana Thupha thua nanung uve ti aphotchen ding ahi.
en: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,
text:
2CO 9:13
Thadou: Nangho lhacha natoh jal'a chu, amahon Pathen loupina apeh thei dingu ahi. Amaho chunga le atahsan ho jouse chunga nahongphal nau hin Christa Kipana Thupha thua nanung uve ti aphotchen ding ahi.
English: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

tcz: Chule Pathen in nangho henga lungsetna longletset napehtah jeh uva, lung giltah a gelkhohna neiya nangho dinga hungtao ding ahiuve.
en: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.
text:
2CO 9:14
Thadou: Chule Pathen in nangho henga lungsetna longletset napehtah jeh uva, lung giltah a gelkhohna neiya nangho dinga hungtao ding ahiuve.
English: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

tcz: Hiche athilpeh hi thu aseidoh dinga kidang behseh ahijeh hin Pathen thangvah in umhen!
en: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
text:
2CO 9:15
Thadou: Hiche athilpeh hi thu aseidoh dinga kidang behseh ahijeh hin Pathen thangvah in umhen!
English: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

tcz: Tua hi Paul keiman Christa lungneng tah le nunnem tah ahina jal'a kangeh nahiuve–nang hon keima hi kamihina a mikichase chule gamlatah a lekhathot kajihna a bou lung ngamna nei dan in neigel uvin ahi.
en: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.
text:
2CO 10:1
Thadou: Tua hi Paul keiman Christa lungneng tah le nunnem tah ahina jal'a kangeh nahiuve–nang hon keima hi kamihina a mikichase chule gamlatah a lekhathot kajihna a bou lung ngamna nei dan in neigel uvin ahi.
English: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

tcz: Aphai, tua hi katemnau chu keima kahung tengleh keiho hi mihem hina lunggela lung ngama eingaito hou chuto lungngama kaumu ngailou ahina dinga kangeh nahiuve.
en: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.
text:
2CO 10:2
Thadou: Aphai, tua hi katemnau chu keima kahung tengleh keiho hi mihem hina lunggela lung ngama eingaito hou chuto lungngama kaumu ngailou ahina dinga kangeh nahiuve.
English: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

tcz: Keiho mihem kahiuvin, ahivangin mihem galsat in gal kasat pouve.
en: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

tcz: Keihon Pathen thahat tah gal manchah chu kamanguvin, vannoi galmanchah ho mihem lunggel pansat-na le kinelkalna lhemho chu ahipoi.
en: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
text:
2CO 10:4
Thadou: Keihon Pathen thahat tah gal manchah chu kamanguvin, vannoi galmanchah ho mihem lunggel pansat-na le kinelkalna lhemho chu ahipoi.
English: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

tcz: Keiho hin mihon Pathen ahetdohna ding uvin kiletsahna in adoudal thei jouse kasumang uvin, keihon amahoa dou lungput jouse chu kaman tup un chule Christa thua nung dingin kahil uvin ahi.
en: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,
text:
2CO 10:5
Thadou: Keiho hin mihon Pathen ahetdohna ding uvin kiletsahna in adoudal thei jouse kasumang uvin, keihon amahoa dou lungput jouse chu kaman tup un chule Christa thua nung dingin kahil uvin ahi.
English: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

tcz: Chule nang hon sei ngaina lhingset nanei jou uleh, keihon sei ngailou ho chu amichang cheh a gimbolna kapeh dingu ahi.
en: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
text:
2CO 10:6
Thadou: Chule nang hon sei ngaina lhingset nanei jou uleh, keihon sei ngailou ho chu amichang cheh a gimbolna kapeh dingu ahi.
English: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

tcz: Nang hon gahvet a akilom ding ho naveuvin ahi. Christa a kahi tia kigel ho chun amahon akigelna bang uva keiho Christa a kahiuve ti ahet dingu ahi.
en: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.
text:
2CO 10:7
Thadou: Nang hon gahvet a akilom ding ho naveuvin ahi. Christa a kahi tia kigel ho chun amahon akigelna bang uva keiho Christa a kahiuve ti ahet dingu ahi.
English: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

tcz: Keima hi Pakaiyin thuneina eipeh kalvala kisona neiyin eikigel inte. Hinla ka thunei nau hin nakisahdoh sah u ahin; hichun nasuhlhah diu hilou ahi. Hitia kathuneina keiman ka manchahna a hin jahcha ponge.
en: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,
text:
2CO 10:8
Thadou: Keima hi Pakaiyin thuneina eipeh kalvala kisona neiyin eikigel inte. Hinla ka thunei nau hin nakisahdoh sah u ahin; hichun nasuhlhah diu hilou ahi. Hitia kathuneina keiman ka manchahna a hin jahcha ponge.
English: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

tcz: Keiman lekhathot kajih hoa hi nangho kichatsah ding kagot ahipoi.
en: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
text:
2CO 10:9
Thadou: Keiman lekhathot kajih hoa hi nangho kichatsah ding kagot ahipoi.
English: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh mi phabep in, “Paul lekhathot hohi thugil tah ahin chule thanei tah ahi, hinla ama hi thalhom ahi chule athusei hojong pannabei ahi bouve,” atiuve.
en: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
text:
2CO 10:10
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh mi phabep in, “Paul lekhathot hohi thugil tah ahin chule thanei tah ahi, hinla ama hi thalhom ahi chule athusei hojong pannabei ahi bouve,” atiuve.
English: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

tcz: Hitobang miho chun keiho tahsa tah a kahung lhun teng uleh keiho gamla tah a lekhathot a thunei tah'a kaseiyu banga khautah a thu katan dingu ahi, ti hi ahet uva pha ahi.
en: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.
text:
2CO 10:11
Thadou: Hitobang miho chun keiho tahsa tah a kahung lhun teng uleh keiho gamla tah a lekhathot a thunei tah'a kaseiyu banga khautah a thu katan dingu ahi, ti hi ahet uva pha ahi.
English: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

tcz: Oh, olmo hih un, keihon nangho koma minasa tah a kiseiho tobanga chu keiho jong kidang tah chu kahiuve tia seina chu kanei pouve! Ahin amaho chu amaho lah a khat le khat kivetkah uva, amaho le amaho hin dan a kitekahna nei ahibouve. Datmo umtah ahiuve!
en: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
text:
2CO 10:12
Thadou: Oh, olmo hih un, keihon nangho koma minasa tah a kiseiho tobanga chu keiho jong kidang tah chu kahiuve tia seina chu kanei pouve! Ahin amaho chu amaho lah a khat le khat kivetkah uva, amaho le amaho hin dan a kitekahna nei ahibouve. Datmo umtah ahiuve!
English: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

tcz: Keima ho thuneina kallama keihon kisonna neideh pouvinge. Pathen in toh ding kin keiho einganse nau hop sunga bou chu kisonna kanei dingu, hichu nangho toh itohkhom nau chan gei hiya ahi.
en: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
text:
2CO 10:13
Thadou: Keima ho thuneina kallama keihon kisonna neideh pouvinge. Pathen in toh ding kin keiho einganse nau hop sunga bou chu kisonna kanei dingu, hichu nangho toh itohkhom nau chan gei hiya ahi.
English: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

tcz: Keihon nachung uva thuneina kaneiyuve tia kaseiyuhi akalval a seiyah kahi pouve. Ajeh iham itileh keiho hi Christa Kipana Thupha thudola Corinth khoa ana hung masa pen kahiuve.
en: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
text:
2CO 10:14
Thadou: Keihon nachung uva thuneina kaneiyuve tia kaseiyuhi akalval a seiyah kahi pouve. Ajeh iham itileh keiho hi Christa Kipana Thupha thudola Corinth khoa ana hung masa pen kahiuve.
English: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

tcz: Midangin apatdohsa natoh chunga kisonga chule hichu keiho natoh ga ahi tia sei kahi pouve. Chusanga, nalah uva kanatoh uhi ahopsung kehletbea aumna dinga natahsan'u akhantou ding kinem a kahiuve.
en: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,
text:
2CO 10:15
Thadou: Midangin apatdohsa natoh chunga kisonga chule hichu keiho natoh ga ahi tia sei kahi pouve. Chusanga, nalah uva kanatoh uhi ahopsung kehletbea aumna dinga natahsan'u akhantou ding kinem a kahiuve.
English: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

tcz: Chutengle nangho umna kallam peh'a koima dangin atohlouna muna kacheuva Kipana Thupha chu seiphongna kanei thei dingu ahitai. Chutengleh keiho hi midang gamhop sunga natong ahi tia dohna umlou ding ahitai.
en: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.
text:
2CO 10:16
Thadou: Chutengle nangho umna kallam peh'a koima dangin atohlouna muna kacheuva Kipana Thupha chu seiphongna kanei thei dingu ahitai. Chutengleh keiho hi midang gamhop sunga natong ahi tia dohna umlou ding ahitai.
English: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh, Pakai'a bou kisongin,” ati.
en: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”
text:
2CO 10:17
Thadou: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Nangma nakison noma ahileh, Pakai'a bou kisongin,” ati.
English: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

tcz: Miho chu amaho kiseipha ahiuva ahileh, ima phatchomna ding aum gunpoi. Pakaiyin amaho chu aseiphat ding chubou akiphamo pen ahi.
en: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.
text:
2CO 10:18
Thadou: Miho chu amaho kiseipha ahiuva ahileh, ima phatchomna ding aum gunpoi. Pakaiyin amaho chu aseiphat ding chubou akiphamo pen ahi.
English: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

tcz: Mingol tobanga kaumna a jong nei hetthem diu kakineme. Henge, nangho tah in nei hethem un.
en: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.
text:
2CO 11:1
Thadou: Mingol tobanga kaumna a jong nei hetthem diu kakineme. Henge, nangho tah in nei hethem un.
English: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

tcz: Keima nangho dia katom ngaina hi Pathen tomngaina jaljeh ahi. Keiman nangho jipa khat, Christa mou theng hidinga kalhendoh nahiuve.
en: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
text:
2CO 11:2
Thadou: Keima nangho dia katom ngaina hi Pathen tomngaina jaljeh ahi. Keiman nangho jipa khat, Christa mou theng hidinga kalhendoh nahiuve.
English: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

tcz: Hinlah Gulin lungthim doha pana Eve alheplhah tobang chun Christa lama lung thengsel le lungthim kehlou beh a napan nau chu suhboh in umkhante ti katijat peh nahiuve.
en: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
text:
2CO 11:3
Thadou: Hinlah Gulin lungthim doha pana Eve alheplhah tobang chun Christa lama lung thengsel le lungthim kehlou beh a napan nau chu suhboh in umkhante ti katijat peh nahiuve.
English: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

tcz: Mi khat touvin, keiho hung seiphong Yeshua hilou achom dang khat thu joh ahung seiya, ahilouleh Lhagao jatchom, nakisan u tobang hilou, ahung seiphonga, ahilouleh natahsan sau sanga jatchom Kipana Thupha ahungsei jongleh akisei tapou namoh tahsan kigot uve.
en: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.
text:
2CO 11:4
Thadou: Mi khat touvin, keiho hung seiphong Yeshua hilou achom dang khat thu joh ahung seiya, ahilouleh Lhagao jatchom, nakisan u tobang hilou, ahung seiphonga, ahilouleh natahsan sau sanga jatchom Kipana Thupha ahungsei jongleh akisei tapou namoh tahsan kigot uve.
English: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

tcz: Hinlah chutobang thuhil choi solchah achungnunga kiheho sanga noinung jon keima chang kakigel hih e.
en: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
text:
2CO 11:5
Thadou: Hinlah chutobang thuhil choi solchah achungnunga kiheho sanga noinung jon keima chang kakigel hih e.
English: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

tcz: Keima hi thusei kijil them tah chu hi hih nange, hinla ipi kasei kakihet nai. Hiche hi tun hethem tauvin nate tin kagel'e, ajeh chu avel vel'a iphotchen u ahitai.
en: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.
text:
2CO 11:6
Thadou: Keima hi thusei kijil them tah chu hi hih nange, hinla ipi kasei kakihet nai. Hiche hi tun hethem tauvin nate tin kagel'e, ajeh chu avel vel'a iphotchen u ahitai.
English: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

tcz: Keima kaki neosah a chule nanghoa kona lemukit ding kinem louhel'a Pathen Kipana Thupha seiya naheng uva kahunga, nangho kajabolna hi bolkhel kahi hitam?
en: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?
text:
2CO 11:7
Thadou: Keima kaki neosah a chule nanghoa kona lemukit ding kinem louhel'a Pathen Kipana Thupha seiya naheng uva kahunga, nangho kajabolna hi bolkhel kahi hitam?
English: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

tcz: Keiman houbung danghoa kona athil tokhom'u chu kakhop khoma nangho henga manbeiya lhacha natoh kanei thei ding kati ahi.
en: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.
text:
2CO 11:8
Thadou: Keiman houbung danghoa kona athil tokhom'u chu kakhop khoma nangho henga manbeiya lhacha natoh kanei thei ding kati ahi.
English: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

tcz: Chule keima nangho to kaumkhoma chule kihinsona ding imacha kanei loupet in jong koima sum lamah pohgih kapohsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu Macedonia akona hung sopiho chun kangaichat jouse eihin pohpeh tauve. Hiti chun keiman nangho dingin pohgih kapohsah khapouvin chule kapohsah lou hel ding nahiuve.
en: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.
text:
2CO 11:9
Thadou: Chule keima nangho to kaumkhoma chule kihinsona ding imacha kanei loupet in jong koima sum lamah pohgih kapohsah pon ahi. Ajeh chu Macedonia akona hung sopiho chun kangaichat jouse eihin pohpeh tauve. Hiti chun keiman nangho dingin pohgih kapohsah khapouvin chule kapohsah lou hel ding nahiuve.
English: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

tcz: Christa a thudih chu keiya aumjing akicheh laisea, hiche thudola kaki sonna hi Greece pumpia koiman eikham theilou ding ahi.
en: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
text:
2CO 11:10
Thadou: Christa a thudih chu keiya aumjing akicheh laisea, hiche thudola kaki sonna hi Greece pumpia koiman eikham theilou ding ahi.
English: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

tcz: Ipi dia em? Nangho kangailut loujeh u ham? Keiman kangailut nahiu Pathen in ahenai.
en: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.
text:
2CO 11:11
Thadou: Ipi dia em? Nangho kangailut loujeh u ham? Keiman kangailut nahiu Pathen in ahenai.
English: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kanabol jing chu kabol jom ding ahi. Hiche hin amahon kisonpina ding phat kijen aholuva anatoh u chu keiho natoh tobang bep ahi atiu chu abei theina ding hiya ahi.
en: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.
text:
2CO 11:12
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kanabol jing chu kabol jom ding ahi. Hiche hin amahon kisonpina ding phat kijen aholuva anatoh u chu keiho natoh tobang bep ahi atiu chu abei theina ding hiya ahi.
English: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

tcz: Hiche miho hi solchah lhemho chu ahiuve. Amaho hi doha thuhtah'a natong ho Christa solchahho a kisei ahiuve.
en: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
text:
2CO 11:13
Thadou: Hiche miho hi solchah lhemho chu ahiuve. Amaho hi doha thuhtah'a natong ho Christa solchahho a kisei ahiuve.
English: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

tcz: Hinlah keiman kadatmopoi. Satan jeng jong chu avah tah vantil tobanga kisoh thei ahi.
en: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.
text:
2CO 11:14
Thadou: Hinlah keiman kadatmopoi. Satan jeng jong chu avah tah vantil tobanga kisoh thei ahi.
English: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

tcz: Hitia chu asohte ho jong chu chonphatna sohtea kisem thei ahiuve. Achaina tengleh athil gilou boldoh hou jeh a gimbolna chang ding ahiuve.
en: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.
text:
2CO 11:15
Thadou: Hitia chu asohte ho jong chu chonphatna sohtea kisem thei ahiuve. Achaina tengleh athil gilou boldoh hou jeh a gimbolna chang ding ahiuve.
English: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

tcz: Kasei kit ahi, hitia thu kasei hi keima angolin neigel hih un. Hinla hitia chu neigelu ahi jongleh, keima angol tobanga kaumpet'in jong, mingol tobanga nagel nau pumin, kasei ngaiyuvin.
en: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
text:
2CO 11:16
Thadou: Kasei kit ahi, hitia thu kasei hi keima angolin neigel hih un. Hinla hitia chu neigelu ahi jongleh, keima angol tobanga kaumpet'in jong, mingol tobanga nagel nau pumin, kasei ngaiyuvin.
English: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

tcz: Hitobang kisonna hi Pakaiya kon ahipon, hinla mingol thuseiya kasei ahijoi.
en: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.
text:
2CO 11:17
Thadou: Hitobang kisonna hi Pakaiya kon ahipon, hinla mingol thuseiya kasei ahijoi.
English: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

tcz: Midang hon bon tahsa mihem hina a atohdoh hou akison piuva ahileh, ken jong kaki sonna seiyinge.
en: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.
text:
2CO 11:18
Thadou: Midang hon bon tahsa mihem hina a atohdoh hou akison piuva ahileh, ken jong kaki sonna seiyinge.
English: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

tcz: Nangho chingtah a kigel'a nahiu hilou ham, hinla nang hon angol ho chon chan nahethem nauve.
en: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.
text:
2CO 11:19
Thadou: Nangho chingtah a kigel'a nahiu hilou ham, hinla nang hon angol ho chon chan nahethem nauve.
English: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

tcz: Nangho hin koiham khat touvin sohchang bol'a nabol uva, nanei jouseu akilah uva, nanghoa phatchomna akimu uva, imajouse athu uva aheiyuva, chule namaiyu abeh gei uvin jong na hethem theiyuvin ahi.
en: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.
text:
2CO 11:20
Thadou: Nangho hin koiham khat touvin sohchang bol'a nabol uva, nanei jouseu akilah uva, nanghoa phatchomna akimu uva, imajouse athu uva aheiyuva, chule namaiyu abeh gei uvin jong na hethem theiyuvin ahi.
English: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

tcz: Chutobang bol dinga keiho thalhom val kahiu hi kajachat piuve tia kasei ahi! Hinla ipilam dol'a kisonna aneinau hijongleh–mingol banga kaseikit ahi–keijong chutobanga kisong thei kahi.
en: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.
text:
2CO 11:21
Thadou: Chutobang bol dinga keiho thalhom val kahiu hi kajachat piuve tia kasei ahi! Hinla ipilam dol'a kisonna aneinau hijongleh–mingol banga kaseikit ahi–keijong chutobanga kisong thei kahi.
English: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

tcz: Amaho Hebrew mi hiuvem? Keima jong chutima kahi! Ama ho Israel mi hiuvem? Keima jong hitima chu kahi! Amaho Abraham chilhah hiuvem? Keima jong hiti chu kahi!
en: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
text:
2CO 11:22
Thadou: Amaho Hebrew mi hiuvem? Keima jong chutima kahi! Ama ho Israel mi hiuvem? Keima jong hitima chu kahi! Amaho Abraham chilhah hiuvem? Keima jong hiti chu kahi!
English: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

tcz: Amaho Christa soh hiuvem? Mingol thusei bang bep kahi ding kakihet'e, hinla keiman kaha jen jocheh in ahi. Keiman kaha tohgim cheh in, songkul'a eikikhum matchet in, simjoulou khop in eikijep in, chule thina avelin kaki maito pin ahi.
en: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.
text:
2CO 11:23
Thadou: Amaho Christa soh hiuvem? Mingol thusei bang bep kahi ding kakihet'e, hinla keiman kaha jen jocheh in ahi. Keiman kaha tohgim cheh in, songkul'a eikikhum matchet in, simjoulou khop in eikijep in, chule thina avelin kaki maito pin ahi.
English: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

tcz: Munchom chom Juda-nam lamkai hon nga-veijen khaohol a jepna somthum le ko vei cheh einavo uvin ahi.
en: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.
text:
2CO 11:24
Thadou: Munchom chom Juda-nam lamkai hon nga-veijen khaohol a jepna somthum le ko vei cheh einavo uvin ahi.
English: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

tcz: Keima hi thihjol ah thumvei jen eina vouvin ahi. Khatvei songa eikisep in, thumveijen kongke katoh in, khatvei chu nikhat le jankhat twikhanglen'a kaumdenin ahi.
en: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
text:
2CO 11:25
Thadou: Keima hi thihjol ah thumvei jen eina vouvin ahi. Khatvei songa eikisep in, thumveijen kongke katoh in, khatvei chu nikhat le jankhat twikhanglen'a kaumdenin ahi.
English: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

tcz: Keima lamsaotah tah kana kholjinin ahi. Keiman vadung hoa le gucha michomho lah a vangsetna katoh in ahi. Keiman kamite, Judah nam'a konle chidang namdang ho lah a konin vangsetna katoh in ahi. Atahsan kahi tia ahia atahbeh ahilou jeh uvin amahoa konin tosetna katoh in ahi.
en: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

tcz: Keima ihmumon, na katong gimin, chule kathoh gimin ahi. Keiman dapthoh in kithing thingin eisulum jouding ponbeiyin kaumin ahi.
en: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.
text:
2CO 11:27
Thadou: Keima ihmumon, na katong gimin, chule kathoh gimin ahi. Keiman dapthoh in kithing thingin eisulum jouding ponbeiyin kaumin ahi.
English: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

tcz: Chuti chun, hiche ho jouse kalvalin, keiman houbung ho jouse dingin gelkhohna pohgih kaneiyin ahi.
en: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
text:
2CO 11:28
Thadou: Chuti chun, hiche ho jouse kalvalin, keiman houbung ho jouse dingin gelkhohna pohgih kaneiyin ahi.
English: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

tcz: Koiham athalhom keiman athalhomna chu kapohhu pi nomlou? Koi ham akipui lamvai keiman kalunghanpi lou?
en: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?
text:
2CO 11:29
Thadou: Koiham athalhom keiman athalhomna chu kapohhu pi nomlou? Koi ham akipui lamvai keiman kalunghanpi lou?
English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

tcz: Keima kisong ding hileng, keima ichan geiloma thalhoma kahim ti thil hoa bou kisong ding kahi.
en: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.
text:
2CO 11:30
Thadou: Keima kisong ding hileng, keima ichan geiloma thalhoma kahim ti thil hoa bou kisong ding kahi.
English: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

tcz: Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua Pa, Ama chu tonsot'a vahchoi jing dinga kilomtah ahin, keiman jou kaseipoi ti ahenai.
en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.
text:
2CO 11:31
Thadou: Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua Pa, Ama chu tonsot'a vahchoi jing dinga kilomtah ahin, keiman jou kaseipoi ti ahenai.
English: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

tcz: Keima Damascus a kaum chun, Leng Aretas in Gamvaipoa apansah pa chun keima matdohna dingin khopi kotpi hoa chun angah akoiyin ahi.
en: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
text:
2CO 11:32
Thadou: Keima Damascus a kaum chun, Leng Aretas in Gamvaipoa apansah pa chun keima matdohna dingin khopi kotpi hoa chun angah akoiyin ahi.
English: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

tcz: Amaa kona kaki huhdoh theina dingin keima chu khopi bang kotneova kona bom'a khailhah tho kanahi.
en: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.
text:
2CO 11:33
Thadou: Amaa kona kaki huhdoh theina dingin keima chu khopi bang kotneova kona bom'a khailhah tho kanahi.
English: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

tcz: Hiche kisonna ho hin phatna boldoh ponte, hinla keiman hinseibe nalai inge. Keiman seinomlou hijong leng Pakaiya kona thilmu kanei hole thil kahenga hung kiphongdoh ho seiyinge.
en: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
text:
2CO 12:1
Thadou: Hiche kisonna ho hin phatna boldoh ponte, hinla keiman hinseibe nalai inge. Keiman seinomlou hijong leng Pakaiya kona thilmu kanei hole thil kahenga hung kiphongdoh ho seiyinge.
English: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

tcz: Kum som le li masangjep chun keima van dan thum channa geiyin lahtouvin kanaume. Keiman hichu katahsa pum'a ha ahilouleh katahsa jaolouva hiham, keiman kahepoi-Pathen bouvin ahet ahi.
en: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.
text:
2CO 12:2
Thadou: Kum som le li masangjep chun keima van dan thum channa geiyin lahtouvin kanaume. Keiman hichu katahsa pum'a ha ahilouleh katahsa jaolouva hiham, keiman kahepoi-Pathen bouvin ahet ahi.
English: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

tcz: Ahin Pathen bouvin katahsa puma ham ahilouleh katahsa jaotha louva ham ahenai. Hinlah keiman kahet chu,
en: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
text:
2CO 12:3
Thadou: Ahin Pathen bouvin katahsa puma ham ahilouleh katahsa jaotha louva ham ahenai. Hinlah keiman kahet chu,
English: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

tcz: Keima Pathen gam loupi muna eiki latouvin, mihem koiman aseitheilou thil ho thuchenga hilchet joujai hilou ho datmo umtah thil ho chu kajai.
en: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
text:
2CO 12:4
Thadou: Keima Pathen gam loupi muna eiki latouvin, mihem koiman aseitheilou thil ho thuchenga hilchet joujai hilou ho datmo umtah thil ho chu kajai.
English: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

tcz: Hitobang hetna nei hi kisonpi thei khopset ahi, hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi. Keima kalhahsamna bouva kisong inge.
en: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.
text:
2CO 12:5
Thadou: Hitobang hetna nei hi kisonpi thei khopset ahi, hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi. Keima kalhahsamna bouva kisong inge.
English: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

tcz: Keima kisong nom jongleng keiman thutah chu kasei ding ahijeh'in, kakisonna chu kangol man hilou hel ding ahi. Hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi, ajeh chu keiman koima chan kahinkhoa amu kalvalu ahilouleh kathuseiya ajah kalval uva eipachat dingu kanompoi.
en: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.
text:
2CO 12:6
Thadou: Keima kisong nom jongleng keiman thutah chu kasei ding ahijeh'in, kakisonna chu kangol man hilou hel ding ahi. Hinla keiman hichu kabollou ding ahi, ajeh chu keiman koima chan kahinkhoa amu kalvalu ahilouleh kathuseiya ajah kalval uva eipachat dingu kanompoi.
English: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

tcz: Keiman chutobang Pathena kona kiphongdoh ho chu kachan ahijeng vang'in, keima kiletsah louva kaumna dingin, katahsa chunga hin ling khat, Satan a kona asolchah khat, keima eisunem ding le kakiletsah louna dingin eiki koipeh in ahi.
en: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.
text:
2CO 12:7
Thadou: Keiman chutobang Pathena kona kiphongdoh ho chu kachan ahijeng vang'in, keima kiletsah louva kaumna dingin, katahsa chunga hin ling khat, Satan a kona asolchah khat, keima eisunem ding le kakiletsah louna dingin eiki koipeh in ahi.
English: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

tcz: Keiman munchom chom'ah thumvei jen Pakaiyin eilahmang pehna dingin kangeh in ahi.
en: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.
text:
2CO 12:8
Thadou: Keiman munchom chom'ah thumvei jen Pakaiyin eilahmang pehna dingin kangeh in ahi.
English: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

tcz: Aman kasei chanin, “Kalungsetna hi nangman na ngaichat dehset chu ahi. Ka thahatna hi thalhomnaa kiha langdoh joa ahi.” Christaa thahatna chun keiya na atoh theina dinga ka thalhom pet tua hi kipahtah a kakisonpi ding ahi.
en: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
text:
2CO 12:9
Thadou: Aman kasei chanin, “Kalungsetna hi nangman na ngaichat dehset chu ahi. Ka thahatna hi thalhomnaa kiha langdoh joa ahi.” Christaa thahatna chun keiya na atoh theina dinga ka thalhom pet tua hi kipahtah a kakisonpi ding ahi.
English: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Christa thaneina chun keiya na atoh theina dinga, keima tah hi katha lhomna a lunglhaijia kahi, chule jumsonaho, hahsatnaho, gimbol hesoh thoh naho, chule boinaho hi Christa jal'a kathoh ahi. Ajeh iham itileh keima kalhahsam tengleh kahat ji ahiye.
en: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
text:
2CO 12:10
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Christa thaneina chun keiya na atoh theina dinga, keima tah hi katha lhomna a lunglhaijia kahi, chule jumsonaho, hahsatnaho, gimbol hesoh thoh naho, chule boinaho hi Christa jal'a kathoh ahi. Ajeh iham itileh keima kalhahsam tengleh kahat ji ahiye.
English: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

tcz: Nanghon keima mingol tobanga nei umdohsah uva hitobanga hi kisong'ah kahi. Nanghon keima seiphatna nei jihpeh ding dolu ahi, ajeh chu keima imacha kahidehlou vang hin chuche solchah achungnung dehset ho sang jong chun kanoinungjo dehpoi.
en: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.
text:
2CO 12:11
Thadou: Nanghon keima mingol tobanga nei umdohsah uva hitobanga hi kisong'ah kahi. Nanghon keima seiphatna nei jihpeh ding dolu ahi, ajeh chu keima imacha kahidehlou vang hin chuche solchah achungnung dehset ho sang jong chun kanoinungjo dehpoi.
English: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

tcz: Keima nangho toh kaumpet'in, keima tah in solchah kahi tin photchenna kana petai. Ajeh iham itileh keiman nalah uva vetsahna ho le akidang datmoho chule bolmo kidang ho thohhat tah in kabolin ahi.
en: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.
text:
2CO 12:12
Thadou: Keima nangho toh kaumpet'in, keima tah in solchah kahi tin photchenna kana petai. Ajeh iham itileh keiman nalah uva vetsahna ho le akidang datmoho chule bolmo kidang ho thohhat tah in kabolin ahi.
English: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

tcz: Thil khatseh nalah uva bol louva kana koi houbung dang jousea kanabol ngaiji chu, nangho sum le paiya pohgih sahna kana nei louvu hi ahi. Hiche kabol khelna jeh hin neihe themun!
en: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
text:
2CO 12:13
Thadou: Thil khatseh nalah uva bol louva kana koi houbung dang jousea kanabol ngaiji chu, nangho sum le paiya pohgih sahna kana nei louvu hi ahi. Hiche kabol khelna jeh hin neihe themun!
English: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

tcz: Tua hi keima nangho henga athumveina a hung ding kahitai, chule nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahi ding kanompoi. Keiman nathil neiyu chu ka deichat ahipon-nangho kamu nom joh u ahi. A'ipi chu hitaleh, chapang neo hon anu le pateu anneh ding apeh'u angaipoi. Alangkhat joh a hi, nule pate joh'in achateu nehding apeh u ahi.
en: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
text:
2CO 12:14
Thadou: Tua hi keima nangho henga athumveina a hung ding kahitai, chule nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahi ding kanompoi. Keiman nathil neiyu chu ka deichat ahipon-nangho kamu nom joh u ahi. A'ipi chu hitaleh, chapang neo hon anu le pateu anneh ding apeh'u angaipoi. Alangkhat joh a hi, nule pate joh'in achateu nehding apeh u ahi.
English: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

tcz: Keima kipah tah a kiphaldoh a chule nangho dinga kanei jouse phala kahin, ahijeng vang'in keiman kaha ngailut cheh le nei ngailut mo cheh cheh uvin kahei.
en: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
text:
2CO 12:15
Thadou: Keima kipah tah a kiphaldoh a chule nangho dinga kanei jouse phala kahin, ahijeng vang'in keiman kaha ngailut cheh le nei ngailut mo cheh cheh uvin kahei.
English: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

tcz: Keima nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahilou nalah uva phabep anomin ahi. Hinla nalah uva phabep in keima hi doha thuh a chule lungthim thema nanghoa phatchomna kimun neigel uvin ahi.
en: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.
text:
2CO 12:16
Thadou: Keima nangho dinga pohgih hahsa kahilou nalah uva phabep anomin ahi. Hinla nalah uva phabep in keima hi doha thuh a chule lungthim thema nanghoa phatchomna kimun neigel uvin ahi.
English: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

tcz: Hinlah keiman naheng uva kahin sol ho lah a koipen'in nangho phatchom pina aneiyem?
en: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?
text:
2CO 12:17
Thadou: Hinlah keiman naheng uva kahin sol ho lah a koipen'in nangho phatchom pina aneiyem?
English: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

tcz: Keiman Titus chu nangho hungvil dinga kangansea chule sopi midang khat amato kahin soltha a chu Titus in nangho phatchom pina aneina umem? Henge aneipoi! Ajeh chu eihon lhagao kithakhat ineiyuvin chule khat le khat khonung juiya ihiuvin, ipilam hijongleh hitobangma'a chu boljia ihiuve.
en: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?
text:
2CO 12:18
Thadou: Keiman Titus chu nangho hungvil dinga kangansea chule sopi midang khat amato kahin soltha a chu Titus in nangho phatchom pina aneina umem? Henge aneipoi! Ajeh chu eihon lhagao kithakhat ineiyuvin chule khat le khat khonung juiya ihiuvin, ipilam hijongleh hitobangma'a chu boljia ihiuve.
English: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

tcz: Keihon hitiho kaseiyuhi nanghon keima ho kithemchanna a seiyin nei ngaito uvin nate. Ahipoi, keiho Christa sohte kahinauva hiche hohi kaseiyu ahin, chule Pathen ahetoh a panga ahi. Ipi pi hijongleh kabol chanu hi kasopi deitah teho, nangho hatsahna ding katiu ahi.
en: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.
text:
2CO 12:19
Thadou: Keihon hitiho kaseiyuhi nanghon keima ho kithemchanna a seiyin nei ngaito uvin nate. Ahipoi, keiho Christa sohte kahinauva hiche hohi kaseiyu ahin, chule Pathen ahetoh a panga ahi. Ipi pi hijongleh kabol chanu hi kasopi deitah teho, nangho hatsahna ding katiu ahi.
English: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

tcz: Ajehchu keima kahung tengleh nangho a kamu ding chu keiman dei louva, chule nanghon kadonbut ding nadeilou dingu aum ding chu katijatpi ahi. Keiman nangho kina le kisauva, kithangsettoa, kilunghantoa, kichang khohsah a, miseisehat'a, mi themmo chan'a, louchalna neiya, chule alomlou tah a chon'ah naumkhah diu kakichat ahi.
en: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,
text:
2CO 12:20
Thadou: Ajehchu keima kahung tengleh nangho a kamu ding chu keiman dei louva, chule nanghon kadonbut ding nadeilou dingu aum ding chu katijatpi ahi. Keiman nangho kina le kisauva, kithangsettoa, kilunghantoa, kichang khohsah a, miseisehat'a, mi themmo chan'a, louchalna neiya, chule alomlou tah a chon'ah naumkhah diu kakichat ahi.
English: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

tcz: Ahiye, keima kahung kit tengleh keima namasang uva Pathen in eisuhnema kaum ding chu kati ajai. Chule nangho mi tampi hin nachonset nau aluisa chu nadalhah loulai jeh uvin kalung anan ahi. Nangho nathen lounau, jonlungputna chonthanghoina chule nopchon nomna a nalunglut uvin ahi.
en: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.
text:
2CO 12:21
Thadou: Ahiye, keima kahung kit tengleh keima namasang uva Pathen in eisuhnema kaum ding chu kati ajai. Chule nangho mi tampi hin nachonset nau aluisa chu nadalhah loulai jeh uvin kalung anan ahi. Nangho nathen lounau, jonlungputna chonthanghoina chule nopchon nomna a nalunglut uvin ahi.
English: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

tcz: Nangho vila kahungna thua tuhi athumna hung hiding ahitai (chule Pathen Thubun asei dungjuia, “Hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum chun ipipen thudol hijongleh aphudet ahi” tia kiseiya ahi).
en: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”
text:
2CO 13:1
Thadou: Nangho vila kahungna thua tuhi athumna hung hiding ahitai (chule Pathen Thubun asei dungjuia, “Hettohsahna ni ahilouleh thum chun ipipen thudol hijongleh aphudet ahi” tia kiseiya ahi).
English: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

tcz: Aniveinaa kahungvila chu chonset bol ho chu keiman kana hilchahsa ahiuve. Tua hi keiman avela amaho chule adangho jouse chu kana hilchah a, keiman masanga kanabol ngai banga, abankit teng amaho chu kakhen louhel ding ahi.
en: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,
text:
2CO 13:2
Thadou: Aniveinaa kahungvila chu chonset bol ho chu keiman kana hilchahsa ahiuve. Tua hi keiman avela amaho chule adangho jouse chu kana hilchah a, keiman masanga kanabol ngai banga, abankit teng amaho chu kakhen louhel ding ahi.
English: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

tcz: Keiman nangho jouse Christan keiya thu asei phot chenna na ngaichat jouseu chu kapeh ding nahiuve. Christa chu nangho toh kipol na a hatmoa ahipon, Ama nangho lah a hattah ahi.
en: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.
text:
2CO 13:3
Thadou: Keiman nangho jouse Christan keiya thu asei phot chenna na ngaichat jouseu chu kapeh ding nahiuve. Christa chu nangho toh kipol na a hatmoa ahipon, Ama nangho lah a hattah ahi.
English: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

tcz: Ama chu hatmoa thingpela kikhenbeh ahijeng vang'in, Ama tua hi Pathen thahatna'a hinga ahi. Eiho jong Christa tobanga chu thalhoma ihiuvin, hinla eiho Amatoh hintha ding ihitauvin chule Pathen thahat chu inei thei dingu ahitai.
en: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.
text:
2CO 13:4
Thadou: Ama chu hatmoa thingpela kikhenbeh ahijeng vang'in, Ama tua hi Pathen thahatna'a hinga ahi. Eiho jong Christa tobanga chu thalhoma ihiuvin, hinla eiho Amatoh hintha ding ihitauvin chule Pathen thahat chu inei thei dingu ahitai.
English: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

tcz: Natahsanu adih tahbeh hinam tithua vetchilna neiyun. Nangma tah kipatep'un. Yeshua Christa hi nalah uva aum mongnai ti nahet chet tahbeh u ahijeh'in; achuti louva ahileh natahsanu kicheh tah beh ahina patepna chu nalhinlel'u ahitai.
en: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.
text:
2CO 13:5
Thadou: Natahsanu adih tahbeh hinam tithua vetchilna neiyun. Nangma tah kipatep'un. Yeshua Christa hi nalah uva aum mongnai ti nahet chet tahbeh u ahijeh'in; achuti louva ahileh natahsanu kicheh tah beh ahina patepna chu nalhinlel'u ahitai.
English: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

tcz: Nangmaho tah naki patep tenguleh, nanghon keiho hi solchah hina thuneina chu kakiphasam pouve ti nanghon nahetdoh dingu kakinemin ahi.
en: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.
text:
2CO 13:6
Thadou: Nangmaho tah naki patep tenguleh, nanghon keiho hi solchah hina thuneina chu kakiphasam pouve ti nanghon nahetdoh dingu kakinemin ahi.
English: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

tcz: Keiho Pathena katao nau chu nanghon keiho suhdih ding noplouna jeh a adihlou chu nabollou dingu hi Pathena katao nau ahi. Keiho hung masang in adihtah chu bol uvin, keihon kathunei nau kavetsah joulou diu tobanga kilang ding hijongleh, kahung lhun tengu leh kathunei nau kaphotchet sah dingu ngaikhoh ponte ti kakinem uve.
en: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.
text:
2CO 13:7
Thadou: Keiho Pathena katao nau chu nanghon keiho suhdih ding noplouna jeh a adihlou chu nabollou dingu hi Pathena katao nau ahi. Keiho hung masang in adihtah chu bol uvin, keihon kathunei nau kavetsah joulou diu tobanga kilang ding hijongleh, kahung lhun tengu leh kathunei nau kaphotchet sah dingu ngaikhoh ponte ti kakinem uve.
English: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon thutah chu kadoudal pouve, hinla thutah jal a chu kadin jing dingu ahi.
en: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
text:
2CO 13:8
Thadou: Ajehchu keihon thutah chu kadoudal pouve, hinla thutah jal a chu kadin jing dingu ahi.
English: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

tcz: Keiho thalhom tobanga kaumu hin nangho nahat tahbeh nauve ti avetsahna a keiho kipah kahiuve. Nangho napilhin dingu hi kataonau ahi.
en: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.
text:
2CO 13:9
Thadou: Keiho thalhom tobanga kaumu hin nangho nahat tahbeh nauve ti avetsahna a keiho kipah kahiuve. Nangho napilhin dingu hi kataonau ahi.
English: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

tcz: Keima kahung masanga hiche naheng uva kajih hi keima kahung tengleh nangho khautah a kabollouna ding kati ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin thuneina keima eipeh hi nangho thahatsahna ding kati ahin lhahdah ding katiu ahipoi.
en: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.
text:
2CO 13:10
Thadou: Keima kahung masanga hiche naheng uva kajih hi keima kahung tengleh nangho khautah a kabollouna ding kati ahi. Ajeh chu Pakaiyin thuneina keima eipeh hi nangho thahatsahna ding kati ahin lhahdah ding katiu ahipoi.
English: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

tcz: Kasopi deitah teho, hicheng thua hin ka lekha thot hi khumkhana hinnei inge. Lung kipah tah in umun. Pilhinna lam manouvin. Khatle khat kitilkhouvun. Kilungtoh tah le chamna'a hingun. Chutah le ngailutna chule cham-lungmonna Pathen in naum piuhen.
en: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
text:
2CO 13:11
Thadou: Kasopi deitah teho, hicheng thua hin ka lekha thot hi khumkhana hinnei inge. Lung kipah tah in umun. Pilhinna lam manouvin. Khatle khat kitilkhouvun. Kilungtoh tah le chamna'a hingun. Chutah le ngailutna chule cham-lungmonna Pathen in naum piuhen.
English: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

tcz: Christian kingailutna'a khat le khat kichibaiyun.
en: Greet one another with a holy kiss.
text:
2CO 13:12
Thadou: Christian kingailutna'a khat le khat kichibaiyun.
English: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

tcz: Hichea Pathen mite jousen chibai nahin peuve.
en: All the saints greet you.
text:
2CO 13:13
Thadou: Hichea Pathen mite jousen chibai nahin peuve.
English: All the saints greet you.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi solchah Paul, mihem lhen le mihem thuneina vanga hilou, Yeshua Christa Amatah le Yeshua athia kona kaithouva Pa Pathen pansah pa, a kon ahi.
en: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
text:
GAL 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi solchah Paul, mihem lhen le mihem thuneina vanga hilou, Yeshua Christa Amatah le Yeshua athia kona kaithouva Pa Pathen pansah pa, a kon ahi.
English: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

tcz: Hikoma sopite ho jouse panna a Galatia houbung ho henga lemna thu kahin thot nahiuve.
en: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:
text:
GAL 1:2
Thadou: Hikoma sopite ho jouse panna a Galatia houbung ho henga lemna thu kahin thot nahiuve.
English: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
GAL 1:3
Thadou: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
English: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Ichennau vannoi gitlouna a kona huhdoh ichan theina ding uvin, Pa Pathen lunggon dungjuiyin, Yeshuan ahinna eiho chonset jal'in ahungpe tan ahi.
en: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—
text:
GAL 1:4
Thadou: Ichennau vannoi gitlouna a kona huhdoh ichan theina ding uvin, Pa Pathen lunggon dungjuiyin, Yeshuan ahinna eiho chonset jal'in ahungpe tan ahi.
English: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

tcz: Atonsot tonsot a dingin loupina chu Pathena hijing tahen! Amen.
en: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
text:
GAL 1:5
Thadou: Atonsot tonsot a dingin loupina chu Pathena hijing tahen! Amen.
English: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Nangho Christa ngailutna khotona a kona, Ama a dinga nakoupau Pathena kona nakihei mang loi jengu hi kahin datmo lheh jeng nahiuvin ahi. Nangho hin lampi achombeh najuiyu ahitai.
