en: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,
text:
GAL 1:6
Thadou: Nangho Christa ngailutna khotona a kona, Ama a dinga nakoupau Pathena kona nakihei mang loi jengu hi kahin datmo lheh jeng nahiuvin ahi. Nangho hin lampi achombeh najuiyu ahitai.
English: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

tcz: Hinlah Kipana Thupha tahbeh chu ahitapoi. Christa chungchang thua thudih heikoi hon nangho na ngol bolu ahitai.
en: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.
text:
GAL 1:7
Thadou: Hinlah Kipana Thupha tahbeh chu ahitapoi. Christa chungchang thua thudih heikoi hon nangho na ngol bolu ahitai.
English: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

tcz: Keihon nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphongu kalvala Kipana Thupha chom dang khat seiya auma ahileh keiho hiuving ting ahilouleh vana kona vantil khattou hijongleh Pathen gaosapna achunga umhen.
en: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.
text:
GAL 1:8
Thadou: Keihon nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphongu kalvala Kipana Thupha chom dang khat seiya auma ahileh keiho hiuving ting ahilouleh vana kona vantil khattou hijongleh Pathen gaosapna achunga umhen.
English: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

tcz: Keihon kaseisau kavelsei kit ahi. Nanghon nanajopsau kalvala Kipana Thupha achom seiphonga aumleh ama chu gaosap chang hen.
en: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.
text:
GAL 1:9
Thadou: Keihon kaseisau kavelsei kit ahi. Nanghon nanajopsau kalvala Kipana Thupha achom seiphonga aumleh ama chu gaosap chang hen.
English: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

tcz: Mitmua miho seiphat hol a kahipoi, Pathena kon joh chu kahol ahi. Miho lunglhaisah ding chu kalunggon ana hitaleh keima Christa soh hilou kahi ding ahitai.
en: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
text:
GAL 1:10
Thadou: Mitmua miho seiphat hol a kahipoi, Pathena kon joh chu kahol ahi. Miho lunglhaisah ding chu kalunggon ana hitaleh keima Christa soh hilou kahi ding ahitai.
English: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, keiman nangho kahetchensah nomu chu Kipana Thupha thudol kaseiphong hi mihem lunggel ngaitoa kingam'a ahipoi.
en: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.
text:
GAL 1:11
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, keiman nangho kahetchensah nomu chu Kipana Thupha thudol kaseiphong hi mihem lunggel ngaitoa kingam'a ahipoi.
English: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

tcz: Keiman kathupohle hi mihem a kon ahipon, koiman eihil ahipoi. Chusanga, keiman Yeshua Christan kahenga aphondoh hoa kona bou kamu ahiye.
en: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
text:
GAL 1:12
Thadou: Keiman kathupohle hi mihem a kon ahipon, koiman eihil ahipoi. Chusanga, keiman Yeshua Christan kahenga aphondoh hoa kona bou kamu ahiye.
English: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

tcz: Juda mite hou lama itobang loma katompana Pathen houbung chu keiman kanabolset hitam ti naheuve. Keiman hichu suhmanghel kanagot ahi.
en: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.
text:
GAL 1:13
Thadou: Juda mite hou lama itobang loma katompana Pathen houbung chu keiman kanabolset hitam ti naheuve. Keiman hichu suhmanghel kanagot ahi.
English: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

tcz: Kapu kapaten achepiu houlam chonna lamdol a keima Judah mi kachan khompi ho sanga gamchenga chung nung joa kana hi ahi.
en: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
text:
GAL 1:14
Thadou: Kapu kapaten achepiu houlam chonna lamdol a keima Judah mi kachan khompi ho sanga gamchenga chung nung joa kana hi ahi.
English: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

tcz: Hinlah keima kapen masang jenga jong, Pathen in eilhendoh a, chule Alungsetna kidangtah a chu eikou ahi. Ajeh chu hichun Ama alung lhaisah ahi.
en: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,
text:
GAL 1:15
Thadou: Hinlah keima kapen masang jenga jong, Pathen in eilhendoh a, chule Alungsetna kidangtah a chu eikou ahi. Ajeh chu hichun Ama alung lhaisah ahi.
English: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

tcz: keiman Kipana Thupha Yeshua thu chu chidang namdang ho koma kaphondoh na dinga AChapa chu kahenga aphondoh ahi. Hichu ahunghi phat in, keiman mihem khattou to kihoutohna dingin kamoh kino jengpon ahi.
en: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,
text:
GAL 1:16
Thadou: keiman Kipana Thupha Yeshua thu chu chidang namdang ho koma kaphondoh na dinga AChapa chu kahenga aphondoh ahi. Hichu ahunghi phat in, keiman mihem khattou to kihoutohna dingin kamoh kino jengpon ahi.
English: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

tcz: Chule keima masanga solchah himasaho to kihoutohna dingin Jerusalema kakaltou dehpoi. Chusangin, keima Arabia gam lama kachemangin chule khonungin Damascus khopia kahung kinungle kit in ahi.
en: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.
text:
GAL 1:17
Thadou: Chule keima masanga solchah himasaho to kihoutohna dingin Jerusalema kakaltou dehpoi. Chusangin, keima Arabia gam lama kachemangin chule khonungin Damascus khopia kahung kinungle kit in ahi.
English: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

tcz: Chujou kum thum alhinin, Peter to kiheto dingin Jerusalema kaga chetouvin, chule amato chun ni som le nga kaumkhomin ahi.
en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.
text:
GAL 1:18
Thadou: Chujou kum thum alhinin, Peter to kiheto dingin Jerusalema kaga chetouvin, chule amato chun ni som le nga kaumkhomin ahi.
English: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

tcz: Hiche pet a chu seijui dang kakimupi khat chu Pakai sopipa Jacob chu ahibouve.
en: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.
text:
GAL 1:19
Thadou: Hiche pet a chu seijui dang kakimupi khat chu Pakai sopipa Jacob chu ahibouve.
English: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

tcz: Keiman Pathen masanga nahenguva kahinjih a kaphondoh hohi jou apangpoi.
en: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.
text:
GAL 1:20
Thadou: Keiman Pathen masanga nahenguva kahinjih a kaphondoh hohi jou apangpoi.
English: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

tcz: Hiche kagavil jou chun keima Sahlamsang Syria le Cilicia gam sunga kagalut in ahi.
en: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text:
GAL 1:21
Thadou: Hiche kagavil jou chun keima Sahlamsang Syria le Cilicia gam sunga kagalut in ahi.
English: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

tcz: Chule hiche pet achu Judea gam'a houbung ho chun keima einahetchen loulaiyu ahi.
en: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
text:
GAL 1:22
Thadou: Chule hiche pet achu Judea gam'a houbung ho chun keima einahetchen loulaiyu ahi.
English: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

tcz: Amahon miho seinaa ahet u chu, “Eiho eigimbol hesohpau chun asuhmang got tahsan chu tun aseiphong tai” tin aseiyuve.
en: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
text:
GAL 1:23
Thadou: Amahon miho seinaa ahet u chu, “Eiho eigimbol hesohpau chun asuhmang got tahsan chu tun aseiphong tai” tin aseiyuve.
English: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

tcz: Chule amahon keima jal'in Pathen avahchoiyun ahi.
en: So they glorified God in me.
text:
GAL 1:24
Thadou: Chule amahon keima jal'in Pathen avahchoiyun ahi.
English: So they glorified God in me.

tcz: Chuin kum som le li jouvin Jerusalem'ah Barnabas to kaga che kit in, chule Titus jong ahung jaotha nalaiyin ahi.
en: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
text:
GAL 2:1
Thadou: Chuin kum som le li jouvin Jerusalem'ah Barnabas to kaga che kit in, chule Titus jong ahung jaotha nalaiyin ahi.
English: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

tcz: Chuche muna kaga che chu Pathen in gache dinga eihetsah jeh ahi. Chuchea kaum pet chun houbung lamakaiya kiheho chu atumbeh in kakimupin, chule amaho chu chidang namdang ho henga Kipana Thupha kaseiphong kaseipeh in ahi. Keiho thukhat kakisah louva ahileh katohgimna ho jouse mohseh sohthei ahi ti kahen, chule kilhaitet na a kalhai hi mohseh ahi ding kanompon ahi.
en: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
text:
GAL 2:2
Thadou: Chuche muna kaga che chu Pathen in gache dinga eihetsah jeh ahi. Chuchea kaum pet chun houbung lamakaiya kiheho chu atumbeh in kakimupin, chule amaho chu chidang namdang ho henga Kipana Thupha kaseiphong kaseipeh in ahi. Keiho thukhat kakisah louva ahileh katohgimna ho jouse mohseh sohthei ahi ti kahen, chule kilhaitet na a kalhai hi mohseh ahi ding kanompon ahi.
English: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

tcz: Chuin amahon eidinpi uvin, chule kalhonpi Titus jong chu chidang namdang mi ahijeng vang'in cheptantei ding ahi ti angeh deh tapouve.
en: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
text:
GAL 2:3
Thadou: Chuin amahon eidinpi uvin, chule kalhonpi Titus jong chu chidang namdang mi ahijeng vang'in cheptantei ding ahi ti angeh deh tapouve.
English: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

tcz: Hiche thudola thudoh ahung umdoh jong chu chuche muna Christian kahi tia kisei, sopi lhem ho guhthima hung kipuilut ho ahiuve. Amaho chu guhthim cha a hung kithollut a eivetlhih leuva chule Christa Yeshua a ka chamlhat nau hi ahung lahmang got'u ahi. Amaho chun eisoh chansah got'u ahin chule amahon Juda mi chonna ho chu juisah tei eigot u ahi.
en: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,
text:
GAL 2:4
Thadou: Hiche thudola thudoh ahung umdoh jong chu chuche muna Christian kahi tia kisei, sopi lhem ho guhthima hung kipuilut ho ahiuve. Amaho chu guhthim cha a hung kithollut a eivetlhih leuva chule Christa Yeshua a ka chamlhat nau hi ahung lahmang got'u ahi. Amaho chun eisoh chansah got'u ahin chule amahon Juda mi chonna ho chu juisah tei eigot u ahi.
English: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

tcz: Hinlah amaho khut noiya kipehlutna chomkhat jengcha jong kanei man pouve. Keihon kipana thupha thutah chu nangho dingin huhbit kanomun ahi.
en: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
text:
GAL 2:5
Thadou: Hinlah amaho khut noiya kipehlutna chomkhat jengcha jong kanei man pouve. Keihon kipana thupha thutah chu nangho dingin huhbit kanomun ahi.
English: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

tcz: Chule keiman kathu seiphong banjoma seibe ding jong aneideh pouve (amaho lamkai pipu ahinau chu keiman imachomin kagel sang dehpoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen chun dat aneipoi).
en: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
text:
GAL 2:6
Thadou: Chule keiman kathu seiphong banjoma seibe ding jong aneideh pouve (amaho lamkai pipu ahinau chu keiman imachomin kagel sang dehpoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen chun dat aneipoi).
English: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

tcz: Chusangin amahon Peter chu Judah mite lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga akinganse tobanga keima hi chidang namdang ho lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga eikinganse ahi ti aheuve.
en: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—
text:
GAL 2:7
Thadou: Chusangin amahon Peter chu Judah mite lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga akinganse tobanga keima hi chidang namdang ho lah a Kipana Thupha seiphong dinga eikinganse ahi ti aheuve.
English: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

tcz: Ajehchu Peter chunga solchah hina a natonga Pathen mama chun kei chunga jong na atoh a chidang namdang ho henga kaseiphong le ahi.
en: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—
text:
GAL 2:8
Thadou: Ajehchu Peter chunga solchah hina a natonga Pathen mama chun kei chunga jong na atoh a chidang namdang ho henga kaseiphong le ahi.
English: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

tcz: Hiti chun Jacob, Peter chule John hohi houbung khompiho tia kiheuva ahin, amaho chun keiya Pathen thilpeh kachan hi aheuvin, chule amahon Barnabas le keima jong atoh khompiuvin eisanguvin ahi. Amaho chun, amahon Judah nam mite ho lah a thu aseiphong bang uva chidang namdang ho koma kasei phong jom dingin eitilkhouvun ahi.
en: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
text:
GAL 2:9
Thadou: Hiti chun Jacob, Peter chule John hohi houbung khompiho tia kiheuva ahin, amaho chun keiya Pathen thilpeh kachan hi aheuvin, chule amahon Barnabas le keima jong atoh khompiuvin eisanguvin ahi. Amaho chun, amahon Judah nam mite ho lah a thu aseiphong bang uva chidang namdang ho koma kasei phong jom dingin eitilkhouvun ahi.
English: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

tcz: Amahon eitem nau khat vang chu avaicha ho ipanpi dingu chu aseipenu ahin, hichu ken jong kabolnom ahi.
en: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
text:
GAL 2:10
Thadou: Amahon eitem nau khat vang chu avaicha ho ipanpi dingu chu aseipenu ahin, hichu ken jong kabolnom ahi.
English: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

tcz: Hinlah Peter Antioch a ahung chun, athilbol dihlouna anaum jeh in, amaikoh a kasosalin ahi.
en: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
text:
GAL 2:11
Thadou: Hinlah Peter Antioch a ahung chun, athilbol dihlouna anaum jeh in, amaikoh a kasosalin ahi.
English: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

tcz: Ahung lhun masah chun cheptanlou chidang namdang Christian hotoh ana nekhomin ahi. Hinlah chomkhat jouvin, Jacob kiloipi ho ahunglhun phat un, Peter chun anehkhompi jom nom tapoi. Cheptan teiding ahi tia seiho chun a-oimo ding akichat tah jeh u ahi.
en: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
text:
GAL 2:12
Thadou: Ahung lhun masah chun cheptanlou chidang namdang Christian hotoh ana nekhomin ahi. Hinlah chomkhat jouvin, Jacob kiloipi ho ahunglhun phat un, Peter chun anehkhompi jom nom tapoi. Cheptan teiding ahi tia seiho chun a-oimo ding akichat tah jeh u ahi.
English: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

tcz: Hichea kon chun, Judah Christian dang ho jong chun Peter phatlhem umchan chu ajomun, chule amaho jal chun Barnabas jeng jong chu amaho phatlhemna chun apuimang uvin ahi.
en: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
text:
GAL 2:13
Thadou: Hichea kon chun, Judah Christian dang ho jong chun Peter phatlhem umchan chu ajomun, chule amaho jal chun Barnabas jeng jong chu amaho phatlhemna chun apuimang uvin ahi.
English: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

tcz: Amahon Kipana Thupha Thutah thudol chu ajuilouvu kamu doh phat in, midangho jouse masanga chun Peter jah a, “Nangma penlamdola Juda mi nahi ahin, Judate chonna chu imacha hilouva nagela chule chidang namdang ho hin banga nahin ahin, iti dana chidang namdang ho chu Judah te chonna a chonsah goa nahim,” ti kaseipeh tai.
en: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
text:
GAL 2:14
Thadou: Amahon Kipana Thupha Thutah thudol chu ajuilouvu kamu doh phat in, midangho jouse masanga chun Peter jah a, “Nangma penlamdola Juda mi nahi ahin, Judate chonna chu imacha hilouva nagela chule chidang namdang ho hin banga nahin ahin, iti dana chidang namdang ho chu Judah te chonna a chonsah goa nahim,” ti kaseipeh tai.
English: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

tcz: Nangho le keima pendol a Judah mi ihiuvin, chidang namdang ho tobanga chonsea ihipouve.
en: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,
text:
GAL 2:15
Thadou: Nangho le keima pendol a Judah mi ihiuvin, chidang namdang ho tobanga chonsea ihipouve.
English: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

tcz: Hinama jongleh, mikhat chu Danthu jui jal'a hilouva, Yeshua Christa a tahsan jal'a them changa ahi ti iheuve. Chule eihon Christa Yeshua chu tahsan'ah ihitauvin hia chu Pathen to dihna changkhoma ihitauve, hichu Danthu ijui jeh u hilouvin, Christa itahsan jalu ahi. Ajeh chu koima danthu jui jal a themchang ding aumpoi.
en: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
text:
GAL 2:16
Thadou: Hinama jongleh, mikhat chu Danthu jui jal'a hilouva, Yeshua Christa a tahsan jal'a them changa ahi ti iheuve. Chule eihon Christa Yeshua chu tahsan'ah ihitauvin hia chu Pathen to dihna changkhoma ihitauve, hichu Danthu ijui jeh u hilouvin, Christa itahsan jalu ahi. Ajeh chu koima danthu jui jal a themchang ding aumpoi.
English: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

tcz: Ahinlah ihamtin Christa tahsan jal'a Pathen toh kichamna hol ihiu hihenlang, chuteng eihon achonse jing nalai ihiu kimudoh taleu hen itin tem? Christan eichonset sah u hitam? Hiti chu ahipoi.
en: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
text:
GAL 2:17
Thadou: Ahinlah ihamtin Christa tahsan jal'a Pathen toh kichamna hol ihiu hihenlang, chuteng eihon achonse jing nalai ihiu kimudoh taleu hen itin tem? Christan eichonset sah u hitam? Hiti chu ahipoi.
English: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

tcz: Chusanga, keiman danlui kaphetsa chu kathah sahdoh kit a ahileh keima achonsea kahi.
en: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
text:
GAL 2:18
Thadou: Chusanga, keiman danlui kaphetsa chu kathah sahdoh kit a ahileh keima achonsea kahi.
English: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

tcz: Kami lui chu Christa to kikhenbeh tha a kahitai, ahing nalai hi keima hita louva, Christa chu keiya hinga ahi bouve. Hiti ahijeh chun tua tahsa a kahin hi Pathen Chapa eingailua chule keima dinga kipedohpa tahsan jal'a hinga kahi bouve.
en: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.
text:
GAL 2:20
Thadou: Kami lui chu Christa to kikhenbeh tha a kahitai, ahing nalai hi keima hita louva, Christa chu keiya hinga ahi bouve. Hiti ahijeh chun tua tahsa a kahin hi Pathen Chapa eingailua chule keima dinga kipedohpa tahsan jal'a hinga kahi bouve.
English: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

tcz: Keima Pathen milungsetna mohseh hisah ho lah a kapangpoi. Ijeh ham itileh danthu juiya a Pathen anga them eichan dingu hitahen lang hileh Christa chu ahung thi ngailou ding hiya ahitai.
en: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
text:
GAL 2:21
Thadou: Keima Pathen milungsetna mohseh hisah ho lah a kapangpoi. Ijeh ham itileh danthu juiya a Pathen anga them eichan dingu hitahen lang hileh Christa chu ahung thi ngailou ding hiya ahitai.
English: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

tcz: Vo Galatia mingol ho! Ipi doi le aiyin thilse lama dia nalhim uham? Ijeh ham itileh Yeshua Christa thingpel chunga athi lim chu atah a namu u tobang leuva kichen tah a nakihet chet sah'u ahitai.
en: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
text:
GAL 3:1
Thadou: Vo Galatia mingol ho! Ipi doi le aiyin thilse lama dia nalhim uham? Ijeh ham itileh Yeshua Christa thingpel chunga athi lim chu atah a namu u tobang leuva kichen tah a nakihet chet sah'u ahitai.
English: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

tcz: Hiche thudoh pen hi kahin dong uve: Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Mose Dan najui jalu hiya ham? Ahi hihbeh e! Nanghon Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Christa thudol kisei chu najah jalu ahiye.
en: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
text:
GAL 3:2
Thadou: Hiche thudoh pen hi kahin dong uve: Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Mose Dan najui jalu hiya ham? Ahi hihbeh e! Nanghon Lhagao Theng nachanu chu Christa thudol kisei chu najah jalu ahiye.
English: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

tcz: Ichan gei loma phottohna bei nahiu ahitadem? Lhagaova Christian hinkho najotpat nauva hi itidan a mihem nakihabol vang uva chamkim dinga nakigelu hintem?
en: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?
text:
GAL 3:3
Thadou: Ichan gei loma phottohna bei nahiu ahitadem? Lhagaova Christian hinkho najotpat nauva hi itidan a mihem nakihabol vang uva chamkim dinga nakigelu hintem?
English: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

tcz: Kipana Thupha jal'in nathoh genthei lheh jengui. Atahbeh in mohjen seh hiponte, dihnam? Nanghon tua hi aboncha na paidoh got u hitam?
en: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?
text:
GAL 3:4
Thadou: Kipana Thupha jal'in nathoh genthei lheh jengui. Atahbeh in mohjen seh hiponte, dihnam? Nanghon tua hi aboncha na paidoh got u hitam?
English: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

tcz: Nanghon Danthu najui jeh uva chu Pathen in Lhagao Theng napeh uva chule nalah uva thil kidang aboldoh hiya ham? Ahidehpoi! Ajeh chu Christa thudol kithuhilna chu nanghon na tahsan tauve.
en: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
text:
GAL 3:5
Thadou: Nanghon Danthu najui jeh uva chu Pathen in Lhagao Theng napeh uva chule nalah uva thil kidang aboldoh hiya ham? Ahidehpoi! Ajeh chu Christa thudol kithuhilna chu nanghon na tahsan tauve.
English: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

tcz: Hitobangma chun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin chule Pathen in Ama chu atahsan jal'in chonphan asemtai.”
en: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”
text:
GAL 3:6
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin chule Pathen in Ama chu atahsan jal'in chonphan asemtai.”
English: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

tcz: Abraham chate dihtah ho chu Pathen a atahsan ngamdet ho ahiuve.
en: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.
text:
GAL 3:7
Thadou: Abraham chate dihtah ho chu Pathen a atahsan ngamdet ho ahiuve.
English: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

tcz: Ipi ngaibem, Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu atahsan jal uva chonpha ahi tia aphondohna dinga hiche phat chu Pathen Thubun anagaldot sa ahitai. Pathen in hiche Kipana Thupha hi masang peh a ana thutepsa chu, “Nanga kona namtin phatthei chang ding ahi,” kitia anahisa ahi.
en: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”
text:
GAL 3:8
Thadou: Ipi ngaibem, Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu atahsan jal uva chonpha ahi tia aphondohna dinga hiche phat chu Pathen Thubun anagaldot sa ahitai. Pathen in hiche Kipana Thupha hi masang peh a ana thutepsa chu, “Nanga kona namtin phatthei chang ding ahi,” kitia anahisa ahi.
English: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

tcz: Hijeh chun Christaa atahsan ngamlha ho jouse chu Abraham tahsan jal'a phatthei achanna chu chang ding ahiuve.
en: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.
text:
GAL 3:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun Christaa atahsan ngamlha ho jouse chu Abraham tahsan jal'a phatthei achanna chu chang ding ahiuve.
English: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

tcz: Hinlah danthua kisonga Pathen to kilungtona hol ho chu Agaosapna chang ding ahi, ajeh chu Pathen Thun, “Pathen Dan lekhabua kisun thupeh jouse juiya chule nitsoh keilou chu koi hijongleh gaosap chang ahi,” ati.
en: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”
text:
GAL 3:10
Thadou: Hinlah danthua kisonga Pathen to kilungtona hol ho chu Agaosapna chang ding ahi, ajeh chu Pathen Thun, “Pathen Dan lekhabua kisun thupeh jouse juiya chule nitsoh keilou chu koi hijongleh gaosap chang ahi,” ati.
English: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

tcz: Hiti chun koima chan Danthu jui jeh a Pathen lungtona aneijou ding ahipoi ti akichen'e. Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” ati.
en: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”
text:
GAL 3:11
Thadou: Hiti chun koima chan Danthu jui jeh a Pathen lungtona aneijou ding ahipoi ti akichen'e. Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun asei, “Tahsan vanga michonpha chun hinna anei ahi,” ati.
English: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

tcz: Hiche tahsanna lampi hi Danthu juina lampi to kikhetah ahi, ajeh chu danthu chun, “Danjui vanga mi khat'in hinna anei ahi” kitia ahi.
en: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
text:
GAL 3:12
Thadou: Hiche tahsanna lampi hi Danthu juina lampi to kikhetah ahi, ajeh chu danthu chun, “Danjui vanga mi khat'in hinna anei ahi” kitia ahi.
English: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

tcz: Hinlah Christan Danin gaosapna aphondoh a kona eihuhdoh u ahitai. Ama thingpel chunga akikhetbeh pet a chu, Aman achunga gaosap ichanna diu chu akilah ahitai. Ajehchu Pathen Thun hitin aseiye, “Thing chunga kikhaisang a chu koi hijongleh gaosap changa ahi” ati.
en: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”
text:
GAL 3:13
Thadou: Hinlah Christan Danin gaosapna aphondoh a kona eihuhdoh u ahitai. Ama thingpel chunga akikhetbeh pet a chu, Aman achunga gaosap ichanna diu chu akilah ahitai. Ajehchu Pathen Thun hitin aseiye, “Thing chunga kikhaisang a chu koi hijongleh gaosap changa ahi” ati.
English: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

tcz: Christa Yeshua jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu Abraham phatthei abohna mama a chu phatthei aboh ahi, hitia hi eiho atahsan ho hin tahsan vanga Lhagao Theng athutep hi ichan diu hiya ahi.
en: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
text:
GAL 3:14
Thadou: Christa Yeshua jal'a Pathen in chidang namdang ho chu Abraham phatthei abohna mama a chu phatthei aboh ahi, hitia hi eiho atahsan ho hin tahsan vanga Lhagao Theng athutep hi ichan diu hiya ahi.
English: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, hichea hin nitin hinkhoa dinga vetsahna khat aume. Koiman kinoptona umsa khelthei hilou chu amoh kahlhah theipon ahilouleh asempha theipoi. Hiche jong hi hitima chu ahi.
en: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.
text:
GAL 3:15
Thadou: Kasopi deitahteho, hichea hin nitin hinkhoa dinga vetsahna khat aume. Koiman kinoptona umsa khelthei hilou chu amoh kahlhah theipon ahilouleh asempha theipoi. Hiche jong hi hitima chu ahi.
English: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

tcz: Pathen in Abraham le acha chu thutep ho anape e. Chule hetding chu Pathen Thubu chun “Achateho” tia achilhah tamtah koma athutep bangin aseipoi. Chusangin, “Achapa koma” atin-hichu Christa kiseina ahi.
en: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.
text:
GAL 3:16
Thadou: Pathen in Abraham le acha chu thutep ho anape e. Chule hetding chu Pathen Thubu chun “Achateho” tia achilhah tamtah koma athutep bangin aseipoi. Chusangin, “Achapa koma” atin-hichu Christa kiseina ahi.
English: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

tcz: Keiman kasei got chu hiche ahi: Pathen in Abraham to akitepna chu kum jali le somthum jouvin Pathen in Mose Danthu apeh geiyin jong ima hilouvin akikoi theipoi. Chutile Pathen in athutep chu asuhkeh hiding ahitai.
en: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.
text:
GAL 3:17
Thadou: Keiman kasei got chu hiche ahi: Pathen in Abraham to akitepna chu kum jali le somthum jouvin Pathen in Mose Danthu apeh geiyin jong ima hilouvin akikoi theipoi. Chutile Pathen in athutep chu asuhkeh hiding ahitai.
English: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

tcz: Ajehchu goulo ding chu Danthu jui jal'a kinei ding hitahen lang hileh, Pathen thutep kisan jal hitalou ding ahi. Hinla Pathen in lungset them ahina jal'a Abraham athutep hiya ahi.
en: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
text:
GAL 3:18
Thadou: Ajehchu goulo ding chu Danthu jui jal'a kinei ding hitahen lang hileh, Pathen thutep kisan jal hitalou ding ahi. Hinla Pathen in lungset them ahina jal'a Abraham athutep hiya ahi.
English: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

tcz: Chuti ahile Danthu chu ipi jeh a kipea hintem? Hiche kipeh lona jeh chu thutep toh kilhon a miho chu achonset'u mudoh sahna ding ahiye. Hinlah Danthu kipeh chu thutep Chapa chu ahung kahsea dinga bou kipe'ah ahi. Pathen in Danthu hi vantil hoa kona Mose khut a apeh ahin, ama chu Pathen le mihemte kah a palaija panga ahi.
en: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.
text:
GAL 3:19
Thadou: Chuti ahile Danthu chu ipi jeh a kipea hintem? Hiche kipeh lona jeh chu thutep toh kilhon a miho chu achonset'u mudoh sahna ding ahiye. Hinlah Danthu kipeh chu thutep Chapa chu ahung kahsea dinga bou kipe'ah ahi. Pathen in Danthu hi vantil hoa kona Mose khut a apeh ahin, ama chu Pathen le mihemte kah a palaija panga ahi.
English: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

tcz: Chuti ahileh Pathen Danthu le Pathen Athutep kikah a akikalna ipi umem? Aum hihbeh e! Danthun hinkho thah eipehtheiyu hihen lang hileh, hichu juijal a eihon Pathen to kilungtona ineithei dingu ahitai.
en: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.
text:
GAL 3:21
Thadou: Chuti ahileh Pathen Danthu le Pathen Athutep kikah a akikalna ipi umem? Aum hihbeh e! Danthun hinkho thah eipehtheiyu hihen lang hileh, hichu juijal a eihon Pathen to kilungtona ineithei dingu ahitai.
English: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thubun aphongdoh in, eiho jouse chonset a sohchang ihiuvin, Yeshua Christa tahsan jal a bou Pathen thutep chamlhatna chu changa ihiuve.
en: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.
text:
GAL 3:22
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen Thubun aphongdoh in, eiho jouse chonset a sohchang ihiuvin, Yeshua Christa tahsan jal a bou Pathen thutep chamlhatna chu changa ihiuve.
English: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

tcz: Christaa tahsanna lampi inei masang uvin eiho hi Danthu noiya vettup a uma inahi uve. Eiho hi huhbitna kul sunga chu tahsanna lampi ahung kilahdoh masangsea uma inahiu ahi.
en: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
text:
GAL 3:23
Thadou: Christaa tahsanna lampi inei masang uvin eiho hi Danthu noiya vettup a uma inahi uve. Eiho hi huhbitna kul sunga chu tahsanna lampi ahung kilahdoh masangsea uma inahiu ahi.
English: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

tcz: Lamchom jep in hinsei inge. Christa hung masangsea hi Danthu chu eipuihoiyuva panga anahin, tahsan vanga Pathen to kilungtona inei masang seuva dinga eihuhbit uva panga ahi.
en: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
text:
GAL 3:24
Thadou: Lamchom jep in hinsei inge. Christa hung masangsea hi Danthu chu eipuihoiyuva panga anahin, tahsan vanga Pathen to kilungtona inei masang seuva dinga eihuhbit uva panga ahi.
English: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

tcz: Tun tahsanna lampi chu hunga ahitan, eipuihoi ding uvin Danthu chu ingai chatbe tapouve.
en: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.
text:
GAL 3:25
Thadou: Tun tahsanna lampi chu hunga ahitan, eipuihoi ding uvin Danthu chu ingai chatbe tapouve.
English: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Christa Yeshua na tahsan jal uva nabon chauva Pathen chate nahisoh keiyu ahi.
en: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
text:
GAL 3:26
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Christa Yeshua na tahsan jal uva nabon chauva Pathen chate nahisoh keiyu ahi.
English: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chule Christa to baptize chang'a kigomkhom ho chun, vonthah kivon tobanga Christa chu akivon u ahitai.
en: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
text:
GAL 3:27
Thadou: Chule Christa to baptize chang'a kigomkhom ho chun, vonthah kivon tobanga Christa chu akivon u ahitai.
English: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

tcz: Juda mi ahilouleh chidang namdang aum chom tapoi, sohchang ahilou leh chamlhat, pasal le numei aumdeh tapoi. Ajeh iham itileh nangho nabon chauva Christa Yeshua a khat nahi tauve.
en: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
text:
GAL 3:28
Thadou: Juda mi ahilouleh chidang namdang aum chom tapoi, sohchang ahilou leh chamlhat, pasal le numei aumdeh tapoi. Ajeh iham itileh nangho nabon chauva Christa Yeshua a khat nahi tauve.
English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chule tun nangho Christaa nahi tauvin, Abraham chate tahbeh nahiuve. Nangho agoulo ding nahiuvin, chule Abraham henga Pathen thutep chu nanghoa ahitai.
en: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
text:
GAL 3:29
Thadou: Chule tun nangho Christaa nahi tauvin, Abraham chate tahbeh nahiuve. Nangho agoulo ding nahiuvin, chule Abraham henga Pathen thutep chu nanghoa ahitai.
English: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

tcz: Hiti lam hin gel uvin. Mipa khat chu athia chule achate neo nalai ho dinga goulo ding adalhah peh tah a ahi jongleh, hiche chapang ho chu apau nei jouse chu chang diu hinama jongleh, ahung letdoh kahse uva chu soh ho sanga achungnun johnau ima chom aum deh pouve.
en: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,
text:
GAL 4:1
Thadou: Hiti lam hin gel uvin. Mipa khat chu athia chule achate neo nalai ho dinga goulo ding adalhah peh tah a ahi jongleh, hiche chapang ho chu apau nei jouse chu chang diu hinama jongleh, ahung letdoh kahse uva chu soh ho sanga achungnun johnau ima chom aum deh pouve.
English: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

tcz: Amaho chu apauvin ateppeh-u kum alhin kahse uva aching hoiyuva pangho thu thua chu nung ding ahiuve.
en: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
text:
GAL 4:2
Thadou: Amaho chu apauvin ateppeh-u kum alhin kahse uva aching hoiyuva pangho thu thua chu nung ding ahiuve.
English: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

tcz: Eiho dinmun jong Christa ahung masanga chutobangma chu inahiu ahi. Eiho hi chapang ho banga chu hiche vannoiya hi lhagao thubul ho thudol a soh changa ina hiuve.
en: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.
text:
GAL 4:3
Thadou: Eiho dinmun jong Christa ahung masanga chutobangma chu inahiu ahi. Eiho hi chapang ho banga chu hiche vannoiya hi lhagao thubul ho thudol a soh changa ina hiuve.
English: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

tcz: Hinlah aphat chet chu ahung hi phat in, Pathen in Achapa chu numeiya kona hungpeng din, danthu noiya kipelut din ahinsol tan ahi.
en: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
text:
GAL 4:4
Thadou: Hinlah aphat chet chu ahung hi phat in, Pathen in Achapa chu numeiya kona hungpeng din, danthu noiya kipelut din ahinsol tan ahi.
English: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

tcz: Eiho Dan-thua sohchangsa ho hi Achatea eisem uva, chamlhat ihina dingun, Pathen in Achapa ahinsol tai.
en: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.
text:
GAL 4:5
Thadou: Eiho Dan-thua sohchangsa ho hi Achatea eisem uva, chamlhat ihina dingun, Pathen in Achapa ahinsol tai.
English: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

tcz: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uvin, Pathen in Achapa Lhagao chu ilung sung uva ahinsolin, Abba Pa tia koutheina einei sah tauve.
en: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”
text:
GAL 4:6
Thadou: Chule eiho Achate ihitah jeh uvin, Pathen in Achapa Lhagao chu ilung sung uva ahinsolin, Abba Pa tia koutheina einei sah tauve.
English: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

tcz: Tun nang chu soh nahi tapon, Pathen Cha tahbeh nahi ahitai. Chule nangma Acha nahitah jeh a, Pathen in agoulo dinga nasem ahitai.
en: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
text:
GAL 4:7
Thadou: Tun nang chu soh nahi tapon, Pathen Cha tahbeh nahi ahitai. Chule nangma Acha nahitah jeh a, Pathen in agoulo dinga nasem ahitai.
English: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

tcz: Chidang namdang nanghon Pathen nahet masang uva, auma jong hilou pathen ho soh a chu napanu anahi.
en: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.
text:
GAL 4:8
Thadou: Chidang namdang nanghon Pathen nahet masang uva, auma jong hilou pathen ho soh a chu napanu anahi.
English: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

tcz: Hiti chun tun Pathen nahe tauvin (ahiloule Pathen het nahi tauve tileng), iti dana chu nangho avela hiche vannoiya lhinlelna le lhagao thubul ho pannabei thudola sohchang kit dinga naki pehlut dingu ham?
en: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?
text:
GAL 4:9
Thadou: Hiti chun tun Pathen nahe tauvin (ahiloule Pathen het nahi tauve tileng), iti dana chu nangho avela hiche vannoiya lhinlelna le lhagao thubul ho pannabei thudola sohchang kit dinga naki pehlut dingu ham?
English: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

tcz: Nanghon Pathen lunglhaisahna dinga nikho ho ahiloule lhaho ahiloule kum kihei chin ahiloule kum ho geiya nanit u ahi.
en: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
text:
GAL 4:10
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen lunglhaisahna dinga nikho ho ahiloule lhaho ahiloule kum kihei chin ahiloule kum ho geiya nanit u ahi.
English: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

tcz: Nangho katijat peh uhi, ijemtia nangho chunga katohgim nau jouse hi mohseh hibep a hitam tihi ahi.
en: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
text:
GAL 4:11
Thadou: Nangho katijat peh uhi, ijemtia nangho chunga katohgim nau jouse hi mohseh hibep a hitam tihi ahi.
English: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, kangeh nomnau chu nangho hicheho a kona na chamlhatna ding uva, keima tah jong nangho chidang namdang te banga kaum hi, hiche danho a kon in keima bang hin ongtholun. Keiman nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphong masat chun alam louvin neibolse pouve.
en: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,
text:
GAL 4:12
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, kangeh nomnau chu nangho hicheho a kona na chamlhatna ding uva, keima tah jong nangho chidang namdang te banga kaum hi, hiche danho a kon in keima bang hin ongtholun. Keiman nangho henga Pathen Thu kahung seiphong masat chun alam louvin neibolse pouve.
English: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

tcz: Keiman naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahin poh chun keima kana dampoi ti na geldoh jing diu ka gingchai.
en: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.
text:
GAL 4:13
Thadou: Keiman naheng uva Kipana Thupha kahin poh chun keima kana dampoi ti na geldoh jing diu ka gingchai.
English: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

tcz: Ahin kadin mun umdan chun neisan louna ding uva lhep patepna nato jeng vangun, nang hon nei nahsahmo bol pouvin ahilouleh keiya konin nakihei mang pouve. Chuti louvin neina sanguvin, nanghon neina lhunsah uvin, chule Pathen vantil khat bangin ahilouleh Christa Yeshua Amatah nasan diu bangtah chun neibol phauvin ahi.
en: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
text:
GAL 4:14
Thadou: Ahin kadin mun umdan chun neisan louna ding uva lhep patepna nato jeng vangun, nang hon nei nahsahmo bol pouvin ahilouleh keiya konin nakihei mang pouve. Chuti louvin neina sanguvin, nanghon neina lhunsah uvin, chule Pathen vantil khat bangin ahilouleh Christa Yeshua Amatah nasan diu bangtah chun neibol phauvin ahi.
English: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chuche pet a nakipa nau le na thanop nau lungthim chu tua hoilamba hitam? Hithei bon henlang hileh namit u chu nakaldoh uva keima neipeh jeng thei diuva kaginchat nahiuvin ahi.
en: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.
text:
GAL 4:15
Thadou: Chuche pet a nakipa nau le na thanop nau lungthim chu tua hoilamba hitam? Hithei bon henlang hileh namit u chu nakaldoh uva keima neipeh jeng thei diuva kaginchat nahiuvin ahi.
English: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

tcz: Tua hi keiman thutah kaseipeh jeh uva namelma uva kapan hitam?
en: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
text:
GAL 4:16
Thadou: Tua hi keiman thutah kaseipeh jeh uva namelma uva kapan hitam?
English: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

tcz: Chuche thuhil dihlou ho chun nangho lung lhaisahna dingin akiha bol uvin, hinla alunggon'u apha ahipoi. Amaho chun nangho keima a kona nachom khen jeng got uhi, nang hon amaho bou najuina dingu ageljeh u ahi.
en: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.
text:
GAL 4:17
Thadou: Chuche thuhil dihlou ho chun nangho lung lhaisahna dingin akiha bol uvin, hinla alunggon'u apha ahipoi. Amaho chun nangho keima a kona nachom khen jeng got uhi, nang hon amaho bou najuina dingu ageljeh u ahi.
English: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

tcz: Mi khat touvin nangho dinga thilpha bolnomna aneiya ahileh, apha jenge; keiman nangho kaumpi pet jeng bou hilouvin aman boljing hen.
en: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.
text:
GAL 4:18
Thadou: Mi khat touvin nangho dinga thilpha bolnomna aneiya ahileh, apha jenge; keiman nangho kaumpi pet jeng bou hilouvin aman boljing hen.
English: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

tcz: Vo kacha deitahte! Keiman nangho dinga naosonat thohlel banga kathoh gim kit hi nanghoa Christa lim asodoh kahsea ding hiya ahi.
en: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
text:
GAL 4:19
Thadou: Vo kacha deitahte! Keiman nangho dinga naosonat thohlel banga kathoh gim kit hi nanghoa Christa lim asodoh kahsea ding hiya ahi.
English: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

tcz: Keima hi nangho toh tupet'a kaum khom hileh kati lheh e, chule kapao awcheng kakhel nome. Hinlah hitobanga kigamlatna hin ipi lamsanga kakithopi thei dingu kahe jengpoi.
en: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
text:
GAL 4:20
Thadou: Keima hi nangho toh tupet'a kaum khom hileh kati lheh e, chule kapao awcheng kakhel nome. Hinlah hitobanga kigamlatna hin ipi lamsanga kakithopi thei dingu kahe jengpoi.
English: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

tcz: Danthu noiya umnom hon neiseipeh un, Danthun ipi mong asei nahet chet mong hinam?
en: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?
text:
GAL 4:21
Thadou: Danthu noiya umnom hon neiseipeh un, Danthun ipi mong asei nahet chet mong hinam?
English: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

tcz: Pathen Lekhabun aseiye: Abraham'in chapa ni aneiyin, khat chu sohnu akon ahin chule khat chu numei ongthol nua kon ahi.
en: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.
text:
GAL 4:22
Thadou: Pathen Lekhabun aseiye: Abraham'in chapa ni aneiyin, khat chu sohnu akon ahin chule khat chu numei ongthol nua kon ahi.
English: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

tcz: Sohnu chapa chu mihem lungtup a Pathen thutep suh bulhit gotna ahi. Hinla aji tahbeh nu chapa chu Pathen thutep dungjuiya guilhungah ahi.
en: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.
text:
GAL 4:23
Thadou: Sohnu chapa chu mihem lungtup a Pathen thutep suh bulhit gotna ahi. Hinla aji tahbeh nu chapa chu Pathen thutep dungjuiya guilhungah ahi.
English: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

tcz: Hiche numei teni hi Pathen kitepna ni vetsahna ahi lhone. Numei masanu Hagar hi Sinai Mol'a kona Danthua asohchan nau chu vetsahna ahi.
en: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.
text:
GAL 4:24
Thadou: Hiche numei teni hi Pathen kitepna ni vetsahna ahi lhone. Numei masanu Hagar hi Sinai Mol'a kona Danthua asohchan nau chu vetsahna ahi.
English: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

tcz: Chule tun Jerusalem hi Arabia gam'a Sinai Mol tobang hiya ahi, ajeh chu ama le achate Danthua soh changin aumun ahi.
en: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.
text:
GAL 4:25
Thadou: Chule tun Jerusalem hi Arabia gam'a Sinai Mol tobang hiya ahi, ajeh chu ama le achate Danthua soh changin aumun ahi.
English: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

tcz: Hinlah numei chom dang nu, Sarah chu Van Jerusalem vetsahna ahi. Ama numei ongthol ahin, eiho nu ahi.
en: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
text:
GAL 4:26
Thadou: Hinlah numei chom dang nu, Sarah chu Van Jerusalem vetsahna ahi. Ama numei ongthol ahin, eiho nu ahi.
English: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

tcz: Isaiah themgaovin, “Vo chaneilou numei kipah thanomin, cha hing khalouhela, naosonat thoh khalouhelnu, kipah tah in awthong jejun samin! Ajeh chu numei chahinglou nun ajipato umkhomnu sangin chate ahaojo tai,” ati.
en: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”
text:
GAL 4:27
Thadou: Isaiah themgaovin, “Vo chaneilou numei kipah thanomin, cha hing khalouhela, naosonat thoh khalouhelnu, kipah tah in awthong jejun samin! Ajeh chu numei chahinglou nun ajipato umkhomnu sangin chate ahaojo tai,” ati.
English: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

tcz: Chule kasopite, nangho Isaac banga chu thutep chate nahiu ahi.
en: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.
text:
GAL 4:28
Thadou: Chule kasopite, nangho Isaac banga chu thutep chate nahiu ahi.
English: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

tcz: Hinlah tun nanghon danthu najui dingu deisah ho chun, Ishmael-mihem kibol hat'a hungpeng cha chun, Isaac–Lhagaova hungpeng cha chu agimbol tobanga nagimbolu ahi.
en: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.
text:
GAL 4:29
Thadou: Hinlah tun nanghon danthu najui dingu deisah ho chun, Ishmael-mihem kibol hat'a hungpeng cha chun, Isaac–Lhagaova hungpeng cha chu agimbol tobanga nagimbolu ahi.
English: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thubun hiche thua hi ipi asei em? “Sohnu le acha chu nodoh tha tan, ajeh iham itileh soh numei cha chun ongtholnu cha chuto gou lokhom thei ponte” ati.
en: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”
text:
GAL 4:30
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen Thubun hiche thua hi ipi asei em? “Sohnu le acha chu nodoh tha tan, ajeh iham itileh soh numei cha chun ongtholnu cha chuto gou lokhom thei ponte” ati.
English: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

tcz: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, eiho hi sohnu cha ihipouve, ongtholnu chate joh ihiu ahiye.
en: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.
text:
GAL 4:31
Thadou: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, eiho hi sohnu cha ihipouve, ongtholnu chate joh ihiu ahiye.
English: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

tcz: Hitia hi Christa chun tahbeh monga eichamlhat sah u ahitai. Tun chamlhat nahiu chu photchen nan umden un, chule Danthua sohchanna a kihen ohkit tahih un.
en: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
text:
GAL 5:1
Thadou: Hitia hi Christa chun tahbeh monga eichamlhat sah u ahitai. Tun chamlhat nahiu chu photchen nan umden un, chule Danthua sohchanna a kihen ohkit tahih un.
English: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

tcz: Ngaiyun! Keima Paul in hiche hi kasei peh nahiuve. Nanghon cheptan chu Pathen to kilungtona dinga kiphamoa nagel jing uva ahileh Christa chu nangho dinga ima phatchomna hitalou ding ahi.
en: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.
text:
GAL 5:2
Thadou: Ngaiyun! Keima Paul in hiche hi kasei peh nahiuve. Nanghon cheptan chu Pathen to kilungtona dinga kiphamoa nagel jing uva ahileh Christa chu nangho dinga ima phatchomna hitalou ding ahi.
English: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

tcz: Keiman velseikit inge, nanghon cheptan'a Pathen lung lhaisah nagot nahlai uva ahileh, nanghon Mose Danbua kisun jouse chonna dan ho najui diu ngai nalai tina ahi.
en: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
text:
GAL 5:3
Thadou: Keiman velseikit inge, nanghon cheptan'a Pathen lung lhaisah nagot nahlai uva ahileh, nanghon Mose Danbua kisun jouse chonna dan ho najui diu ngai nalai tina ahi.
English: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Danthu juiya Pathen lungtona nana got'u ahileh nangho Christa a kona satlhah nahiu ahitai! Pathen lungset chan'a kona pullha nahiu ahitai.
en: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.
text:
GAL 5:4
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Danthu juiya Pathen lungtona nana got'u ahileh nangho Christa a kona satlhah nahiu ahitai! Pathen lungset chan'a kona pullha nahiu ahitai.
English: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

tcz: Hinlah Lhagaova hing'ah eihon Pathen in chonphatna eithutep u chu tahsana thanoma ngah jinga um ihiuve.
en: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.
text:
GAL 5:5
Thadou: Hinlah Lhagaova hing'ah eihon Pathen in chonphatna eithutep u chu tahsana thanoma ngah jinga um ihiuve.
English: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eihon Christa Yeshua a itahsanu ingap lhah uva chu cheptan ahiloule cheptan louvin ima phatchomna aum tapoi. Athupi pen chu ngailutna a kiphongdoh tahsan hi ahi.
en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.
text:
GAL 5:6
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh eihon Christa Yeshua a itahsanu ingap lhah uva chu cheptan ahiloule cheptan louvin ima phatchomna aum tapoi. Athupi pen chu ngailutna a kiphongdoh tahsan hi ahi.
English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

tcz: Nalhaitet jaonau aphanai. Thutah nung najui nauva kona koi ham nanunghei kit uvah?
en: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?
text:
GAL 5:7
Thadou: Nalhaitet jaonau aphanai. Thutah nung najui nauva kona koi ham nanunghei kit uvah?
English: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

tcz: Pathen hilou beh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman chamlhatna dinga nakouvu ahi.
en: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.
text:
GAL 5:8
Thadou: Pathen hilou beh ding ahi, ajeh chu Aman chamlhatna dinga nakouvu ahi.
English: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

tcz: Hiche thuhil dihlou hi chol neocha changbong lah a kilhah tobang ahi!
en: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
text:
GAL 5:9
Thadou: Hiche thuhil dihlou hi chol neocha changbong lah a kilhah tobang ahi!
English: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

tcz: Pakaiyin thuhil dihlouva kona nahonbit dingu katahsan in ahi. Nalung nohphahsah uva chu Pathen in koipen hijongleh achung thu tanhen.
en: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.
text:
GAL 5:10
Thadou: Pakaiyin thuhil dihlouva kona nahonbit dingu katahsan in ahi. Nalung nohphahsah uva chu Pathen in koipen hijongleh achung thu tanhen.
English: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, keiman tugei hin nangho chep natan diu ahi tileng–mi phabep in kaseiyin alauvin–chuti ahileh ipi jeh a tugeiya hi keima eikigimbol hesoh hintem? Christa thingpel jal a Huhhingna thu seiphonga panglou hileng koima alungthoiya umlou ding ahi.
en: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.
text:
GAL 5:11
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, keiman tugei hin nangho chep natan diu ahi tileng–mi phabep in kaseiyin alauvin–chuti ahileh ipi jeh a tugeiya hi keima eikigimbol hesoh hintem? Christa thingpel jal a Huhhingna thu seiphonga panglou hileng koima alungthoiya umlou ding ahi.
English: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

tcz: Chuche boina sodoh ho, cheptan sah a imacha hilou nasogo hou chu amaho tah imacha hilou kisoh ule kati lheh jenge.
en: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.
text:
GAL 5:12
Thadou: Chuche boina sodoh ho, cheptan sah a imacha hilou nasogo hou chu amaho tah imacha hilou kisoh ule kati lheh jenge.
English: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh kasopi teho, nangho chamlhat hinkho mang dinga kikou nahiuve. Hinlah na chamlhat nau chu ngailutnaa khat le khat kijentonan mang jouvin.
en: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.
text:
GAL 5:13
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh kasopi teho, nangho chamlhat hinkho mang dinga kikou nahiuve. Hinlah na chamlhat nau chu ngailutnaa khat le khat kijentonan mang jouvin.
English: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Dan pumpi chu hiche thupeh khat a hi kingam'a ahi, hichu “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.”
en: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
text:
GAL 5:14
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Dan pumpi chu hiche thupeh khat a hi kingam'a ahi, hichu “Nangma nakingailut bangin naheng nakom ngailun.”
English: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

tcz: Hinlah nangho aphatseh a nakipeto uva chule kivallhumto sau sauva uma nahiu leh kihongpha uvin, khat le khat kisuhmang tona theiya ching theiyun.
en: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
text:
GAL 5:15
Thadou: Hinlah nangho aphatseh a nakipeto uva chule kivallhumto sau sauva uma nahiu leh kihongpha uvin, khat le khat kisuhmang tona theiya ching theiyun.
English: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh'in Lhagao Thengin nahinkhou kaihoi hen kati ahi. Hiti chu hileh nanghon nachonset nomnau lung ngaichat chu nabol lou dingu ahitai.
en: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
text:
GAL 5:16
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh'in Lhagao Thengin nahinkhou kaihoi hen kati ahi. Hiti chu hileh nanghon nachonset nomnau lung ngaichat chu nabol lou dingu ahitai.
English: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

tcz: Chonset nomna lungchang in thilse abolnomin, hichu Lhagaovin abolnom chuto kikala ahi. Chule Lhagao chun chonsetnomna lung ngaichat to kikal ngaichatna eipeh u ahitai. Hicheteni hi kidou jing jenga ahijeh a nangman nalunggot apha jong chu nabol theilou ahi.
en: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.
text:
GAL 5:17
Thadou: Chonset nomna lungchang in thilse abolnomin, hichu Lhagaovin abolnom chuto kikala ahi. Chule Lhagao chun chonsetnomna lung ngaichat to kikal ngaichatna eipeh u ahitai. Hicheteni hi kidou jing jenga ahijeh a nangman nalunggot apha jong chu nabol theilou ahi.
English: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

tcz: Hinlah nangma Lhagao chun nathunun tengleh nangma Mose Danthua chu na mopohna umlouva ahitai.
en: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
text:
GAL 5:18
Thadou: Hinlah nangma Lhagao chun nathunun tengleh nangma Mose Danthua chu na mopohna umlouva ahitai.
English: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

tcz: Nangho na chonset lung ngaichat thua nanun teng uleh, hichea kon chun: kingaichat tona lama chonhoilou, then louna, lungguh a chonset nopsah ngaichatna,
en: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
text:
GAL 5:19
Thadou: Nangho na chonset lung ngaichat thua nanun teng uleh, hichea kon chun: kingaichat tona lama chonhoilou, then louna, lungguh a chonset nopsah ngaichatna,
English: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

tcz: Milim houna, doichoina, kihotna, kinahna, kimit thipna, kilunghan khum tona, chang phatchom holna, kidouna, kibung khenna,
en: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,
text:
GAL 5:20
Thadou: Milim houna, doichoina, kihotna, kinahna, kimit thipna, kilunghan khum tona, chang phatchom holna, kidouna, kibung khenna,
English: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

tcz: kimit thipna, jukhamna, eltol golnop bol, chule hitobang chonset adangho jong ahi. Kana seisa bangin naseipeh kit uvinge, koi hitaleh hitobanga hingnalai ho chun Pathen Lenggam alolou ding ahi.
en: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.
text:
GAL 5:21
Thadou: kimit thipna, jukhamna, eltol golnop bol, chule hitobang chonset adangho jong ahi. Kana seisa bangin naseipeh kit uvinge, koi hitaleh hitobanga hingnalai ho chun Pathen Lenggam alolou ding ahi.
English: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

tcz: Hinlah Lhagao Theng chun hitobang gaho hi ihinkho uva ahin sodoh ding ahi: ngailut, kipa, cham-lungmon, thohhat, lungset them, phatna, tahsan um hina,
en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
text:
GAL 5:22
Thadou: Hinlah Lhagao Theng chun hitobang gaho hi ihinkho uva ahin sodoh ding ahi: ngailut, kipa, cham-lungmon, thohhat, lungset them, phatna, tahsan um hina,
English: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

tcz: lungneng, chule kitim them hichengse hi ahi. Hicheho chunga Danthun thaneina aneipoi.
en: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
text:
GAL 5:23
Thadou: lungneng, chule kitim them hichengse hi ahi. Hicheho chunga Danthun thaneina aneipoi.
English: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a hiho dingin tahsa lungtup hole chonset lung ngaichat ho chu Athingpela akhetbeh tha ahitai.
en: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.
text:
GAL 5:24
Thadou: Christa Yeshua a hiho dingin tahsa lungtup hole chonset lung ngaichat ho chu Athingpela akhetbeh tha ahitai.
English: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

tcz: Eiho Lhagaova hinga ihitauvin, ihinkho uvah imalam jousen Lhagao kaihoina hinkho chu mangu hite.
en: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.
text:
GAL 5:25
Thadou: Eiho Lhagaova hinga ihitauvin, ihinkho uvah imalam jousen Lhagao kaihoina hinkho chu mangu hite.
English: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

tcz: Eiho kihisah val pouhite, ahilouleh khat le khat lungphat mosah ahilouleh khat le khat kithangsetto pou hite.
en: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
text:
GAL 5:26
Thadou: Eiho kihisah val pouhite, ahilouleh khat le khat lungphat mosah ahilouleh khat le khat kithangsetto pou hite.
English: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, atahsan khat chu chonset in athujo tah a ahileh, nangho Pathen ngaisah hon lungneng tah le kineosah tah a lamdih lama nahin lepui uva napanhu diu hiya ahi. Chule nangma jong chuche chonsetna a chu nalhuh louna dingin chingtheiyin.
en: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.
text:
GAL 6:1
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, atahsan khat chu chonset in athujo tah a ahileh, nangho Pathen ngaisah hon lungneng tah le kineosah tah a lamdih lama nahin lepui uva napanhu diu hiya ahi. Chule nangma jong chuche chonsetna a chu nalhuh louna dingin chingtheiyin.
English: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

tcz: Khat'in khat pohgih poh huvin, hiti chun Christa danthu chu subulhit un.
en: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
text:
GAL 6:2
Thadou: Khat'in khat pohgih poh huvin, hiti chun Christa danthu chu subulhit un.
English: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

tcz: Nangman midang khattou gakithopi dinga lomlouva nakigela ahileh nang le nang kingolbol a nahi ahitai. Chutobang loma thupia nahipoi.
en: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
text:
GAL 6:3
Thadou: Nangman midang khattou gakithopi dinga lomlouva nakigela ahileh nang le nang kingolbol a nahi ahitai. Chutobang loma thupia nahipoi.
English: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

tcz: Na natoh chu chingthei tah in bolin, ajeh iham itileh phatah a nabol jeh a nalungna kim ding ahi, chule hichea chu na natohna chunga koima dang to naki tekah angaipoi.
en: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.
text:
GAL 6:4
Thadou: Na natoh chu chingthei tah in bolin, ajeh iham itileh phatah a nabol jeh a nalungna kim ding ahi, chule hichea chu na natohna chunga koima dang to naki tekah angaipoi.
English: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eima khat cheh hi eima natoh chung chang thua mopo cheh ihiuve.
en: For each man will bear his own burden.
text:
GAL 6:5
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh eima khat cheh hi eima natoh chung chang thua mopo cheh ihiuve.
English: For each man will bear his own burden.

tcz: Pathen Thu kihil ho chun ahil hou dinga, amaho tochun thilpha achan khompi ding agonpeh dingu adoltah ahi.
en: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.
text:
GAL 6:6
Thadou: Pathen Thu kihil ho chun ahil hou dinga, amaho tochun thilpha achan khompi ding agonpeh dingu adoltah ahi.
English: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

tcz: Koima kipui mangsah hih un–Pathen thutan dihje chu nelpeh hih un. Nangman natulut chu aga nalo tei ding ahi.
en: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
text:
GAL 6:7
Thadou: Koima kipui mangsah hih un–Pathen thutan dihje chu nelpeh hih un. Nangman natulut chu aga nalo tei ding ahi.
English: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

tcz: Achonsetnau lung ngaichat suh bulhitna dinga hing ho chun hiche chonset nomna chonna a chu akemmang theile thina chu aki-atdiu ahi. Hinlah Lhagao lung lhaina a hing ho chun Lhagaova kona tonsot hinna a aki-at dingu ahi.
en: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.
text:
GAL 6:8
Thadou: Achonsetnau lung ngaichat suh bulhitna dinga hing ho chun hiche chonset nomna chonna a chu akemmang theile thina chu aki-atdiu ahi. Hinlah Lhagao lung lhaina a hing ho chun Lhagaova kona tonsot hinna a aki-at dingu ahi.
English: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun apha bolna a lhadah pou hite. Imoh lhahdah lou uleh aphatcha phattheina tohga i-at dingu ahi.
en: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
text:
GAL 6:9
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun apha bolna a lhadah pou hite. Imoh lhahdah lou uleh aphatcha phattheina tohga i-at dingu ahi.
English: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun, phat kijen ineipet chauhin mitin koma thilpha bolu hite-adehset'a tahsan insung miho koma ibol diu ahi.
en: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
text:
GAL 6:10
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun, phat kijen ineipet chauhin mitin koma thilpha bolu hite-adehset'a tahsan insung miho koma ibol diu ahi.
English: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

tcz: KEIMAN JEM KHOUTAH A HICHE THUKHUMKHANA KAKHUTTAH A KAJIH HI HEUVIN.
en: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
text:
GAL 6:11
Thadou: KEIMAN JEM KHOUTAH A HICHE THUKHUMKHANA KAKHUTTAH A KAJIH HI HEUVIN.
English: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

tcz: Nangho cheptan sahtei nagohou chun midang mitvet a apha bola kingaito uva ahi. Amaho chun Christa thingpel bouvin ahuhhing jouve ti thuhila gimbol hesoh thoh ding chu anoplou jeh u ahi bouve.
en: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.
text:
GAL 6:12
Thadou: Nangho cheptan sahtei nagohou chun midang mitvet a apha bola kingaito uva ahi. Amaho chun Christa thingpel bouvin ahuhhing jouve ti thuhila gimbol hesoh thoh ding chu anoplou jeh u ahi bouve.
English: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

tcz: Chule cheptan teiding ahi tiho jong chun amaho jengin jong Danthu chu abonin anitdeh pouve. Amaho chun chep natan diu adeina jeh u chu nangho kiletsahpia neija chule kanung juiho ahiuve tia kithang atna a nanei got u ahi bouve.
en: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
text:
GAL 6:13
Thadou: Chule cheptan teiding ahi tiho jong chun amaho jengin jong Danthu chu abonin anitdeh pouve. Amaho chun chep natan diu adeina jeh u chu nangho kiletsahpia neija chule kanung juiho ahiuve tia kithang atna a nanei got u ahi bouve.
English: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

tcz: Keima dingin vang i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thingpel thu tailou imacha dang sonda beh jeng inge. Hiche thingpel jal'a chu, vannoiya ka lunglutna hi thingpel a kikhenbeh a ahitai, chule vannoi keiya alunglutna ding jong thidoh a ahitai.
en: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
text:
GAL 6:14
Thadou: Keima dingin vang i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa thingpel thu tailou imacha dang sonda beh jeng inge. Hiche thingpel jal'a chu, vannoiya ka lunglutna hi thingpel a kikhenbeh a ahitai, chule vannoi keiya alunglutna ding jong thidoh a ahitai.
English: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

tcz: Eiho cheptan ihiuvem ahilouleh cheptan lou ihiuvem tihi imacha akhoh poi. Akiphamo pen chu semthah na a chu kikhelna tahbeh ineitei dingu chu hiya ahi.
en: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
text:
GAL 6:15

text:
EPH 2:2
Thadou: Nangho vannoi mite adang chengse tobanga chu chonset a hing nahiuva, Diabol thua nananun'u ahin, akimulou vannoi thuneiho thununna noiya uma nanahiuve. Amahi Pathen thua nunglou ho lungsunga natonga lhagao chu ahi.

tcz: Eiho jouse hitia chu ihin jiu anahin, tahsaa ilungtup hou le ichonset nau lung ngaichat ho chu juiya inahiu ahi. Eiho ihinau ngaiya chu midang dang ho tobanga eiho jong Pathen lunghanna noiya uma inahi tauve.
