EPH 2:4
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen hi khotona a haotah ahijeh'in, chule Aman eingailut lheh jeh uvin,
English: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

tcz: Eiho ichonset jeh uva athia inahi jeng vangun, Aman Christa chu athia kona akaithou tah jeh in, hinna chu Aman eipeh u ahitai (Nangho hi Pathen lungsetna jal'a bou huhhing nahiu ahi).

EPH 2:5
Thadou: Eiho ichonset jeh uva athia inahi jeng vangun, Aman Christa chu athia kona akaithou tah jeh in, hinna chu Aman eipeh u ahitai (Nangho hi Pathen lungsetna jal'a bou huhhing nahiu ahi).

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Aman eiho thinaa konin Christa to eikai thou tha tauvin, chule Amatoh vanmun hoa eitou sah tauve, ajeh chu eiho Christa Yeshua to hing khoma ihi tauve.
en: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,
text:
EPH 2:6
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Aman eiho thinaa konin Christa to eikai thou tha tauvin, chule Amatoh vanmun hoa eitou sah tauve, ajeh chu eiho Christa Yeshua to hing khoma ihi tauve.

tcz: Nanghon natahsan pet uva chu Pathen in alungsetnaa na huhhingu ahitai. Chule nanghon hichu na kithang atpi theiyu ahipoi, Pathena kona thilpeh khat ahiye.

text:
EPH 2:8
Thadou: Nanghon natahsan pet uva chu Pathen in alungsetnaa na huhhingu ahitai. Chule nanghon hichu na kithang atpi theiyu ahipoi, Pathena kona thilpeh khat ahiye.
English: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh eiho Pathen khutsoh ihiuve. Aman eiho Christa Yeshua a athah a eisemu hi, Aman masanga pat a eiho dinga atohgon thilpha ho chu iboldoh theina dingu ahi.
en: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
text:
EPH 2:10
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh eiho Pathen khutsoh ihiuve. Aman eiho Christa Yeshua a athah a eisemu hi, Aman masanga pat a eiho dinga atohgon thilpha ho chu iboldoh theina dingu ahi.
English: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

tcz: Nangho chidang namdang ten gampam mi nahiu sumil hih un. Nangho hi chep kitanlou Pathen tahsanlou tia Juda miten nakouvu ahi, acheptanu kisonpia neiya, hichun atahsa uva bou amelchihna uma, alhagaovu vang hilou ahi.
en: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),
text:
EPH 2:11
Thadou: Nangho chidang namdang ten gampam mi nahiu sumil hih un. Nangho hi chep kitanlou Pathen tahsanlou tia Juda miten nakouvu ahi, acheptanu kisonpia neiya, hichun atahsa uva bou amelchihna uma, alhagaovu vang hilou ahi.
English: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

en: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.
text:
EPH 2:12
Thadou: Chuche laiya chu nangho Christa beiya nana hin'u ahi. Nangho Israel namsung mia kona khendoh a pamse nahiu ahin, chule nanghon Pathen in amaho toh akitepnaho chu nana hepouve. Nangho hiche vannoiya hi Pathen neilou le kinepna neilouva nahinu ahi.
English: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

tcz: Hinlah tua hi nangho Christa Yeshua to nahin khomu ahitai. Khatvei chu Pathena kona gamlatah nahiu ahin, tuavang hi Christa thisan jal'a Ama koma kipui naiya nahi tauve.
en: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
text:
EPH 2:13
Thadou: Hinlah tua hi nangho Christa Yeshua to nahin khomu ahitai. Khatvei chu Pathena kona gamlatah nahiu ahin, tuavang hi Christa thisan jal'a Ama koma kipui naiya nahi tauve.

en: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
text:
EPH 2:14
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Christa chun eiho henga cham-lungmon ahinpoh lut ahitai. Aman Juda-mite le chidang namdang te kikah a kikhenna daltan abanglai a panga chu Atahsa tah a thingpel chunga khat a agopkhomsoh ahitai.
English: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

tcz: Athina a kon chun aman chidang namdangte hoptha lou hiche chonna dan ho chu achaina asem ahitai. Aman hiche abollo na ajeh chu Judahte le chidang namdangte kikah a kichamna umsah a anamniuva kona mithah khat semdoh ding ati ahi.
en: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
text:
EPH 2:15
Thadou: Athina a kon chun aman chidang namdangte hoptha lou hiche chonna dan ho chu achaina asem ahitai. Aman hiche abollo na ajeh chu Judahte le chidang namdangte kikah a kichamna umsah a anamniuva kona mithah khat semdoh ding ati ahi.
English: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

tcz: Anilhon a chu tipum khat a agop khomtheina dinga Christa chu ania dinga thingpel a thia, chujala chu namthah asemdoh a, chule aniu kah a kitomona chu asuhmang ahitai.
en: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
text:
EPH 2:16
Thadou: Anilhon a chu tipum khat a agop khomtheina dinga Christa chu ania dinga thingpel a thia, chujala chu namthah asemdoh a, chule aniu kah a kitomona chu asuhmang ahitai.
English: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

tcz: Aman hiche kichamna thupha chu Amaa kona gamla tah a um chidang namdang mi nangho henga, chule anailama um Juda-mite henga ahin lhut ahitai.
en: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
text:
EPH 2:17
Thadou: Aman hiche kichamna thupha chu Amaa kona gamla tah a um chidang namdang mi nangho henga, chule anailama um Juda-mite henga ahin lhut ahitai.
English: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

tcz: Tua hi eiho jouse hi Christan eibolpeh u ahitah jeh a, hiche Lhagao Theng vanga chu Pa henga ihung theiyu ahitai.
en: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.
text:
EPH 2:18
Thadou: Tua hi eiho jouse hi Christan eibolpeh u ahitah jeh a, hiche Lhagao Theng vanga chu Pa henga ihung theiyu ahitai.
English: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

tcz: Hitia chu tua hi chidang namdang mi nangho hi kholgam mi le gampam mi hitalouva, Pathen mithengte jouse toh agam mi hina naneikhom'u ahitai. Nangho Pathen insungmi chu nahi tauve.
en: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,
text:
EPH 2:19
Thadou: Hitia chu tua hi chidang namdang mi nangho hi kholgam mi le gampam mi hitalouva, Pathen mithengte jouse toh agam mi hina naneikhom'u ahitai. Nangho Pathen insungmi chu nahi tauve.
English: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

tcz: Akigoma eiho hi Ama in chu ihiuvin, solchah ho le themgao ho bulphuna a chu kisadoh a ihiuve. Inninga songpia panga chu Christa Yeshua Ama tah ahi.
en: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

tcz: Eiho chingtheitah a Amato kijopmat a ihiuvin, Pakai dinga hou-in theng khat ihiuve.
en: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

tcz: Ama vanga chu chidang namdang nangho jong Pathen in a-Lhagaova chenna in'a anei chu nahi tauve.
en: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.
text:
EPH 2:22
Thadou: Ama vanga chu chidang namdang nangho jong Pathen in a-Lhagaova chenna in'a anei chu nahi tauve.
English: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

tcz: Hicheng jouse hi, Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul keiman chidang namdang nangho phat chomna ding kagelna ahi.
en: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,
text:
EPH 3:1
Thadou: Hicheng jouse hi, Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul keiman chidang namdang nangho phat chomna ding kagelna ahi.
English: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

tcz: Gah ngaito dia kiloma chu, Pathen in alungsetna homjal dinga mopohna keima eipeh hi chidang namdang nangho henga ahin lhut ahi naheuvin ahi.
en: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,
text:
EPH 3:2
Thadou: Gah ngaito dia kiloma chu, Pathen in alungsetna homjal dinga mopohna keima eipeh hi chidang namdang nangho henga ahin lhut ahi naheuvin ahi.
English: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

tcz: Keiman agomlama kana jihna a, Pathen in athuguh alunggon chu keima eihetsah ahitai.
en: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,
text:
EPH 3:3
Thadou: Keiman agomlama kana jihna a, Pathen in athuguh alunggon chu keima eihetsah ahitai.
English: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

tcz: Keiman kajihsa nasim uva kon chun, Christa a hiche tohgon thua kahet gil dan hedoh thei tauvin nate.
en: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,
text:
EPH 3:4
Thadou: Keiman kajihsa nasim uva kon chun, Christa a hiche tohgon thua kahet gil dan hedoh thei tauvin nate.
English: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

tcz: Hiche hi khang masa ho'ah Pathen in ana phongdoh pon, hinla tun a Lhagao jal in Aman asolchah thengho le themgao ho henga hiche hi ahin phongdoh tai.
en: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,
text:
EPH 3:5
Thadou: Hiche hi khang masa ho'ah Pathen in ana phongdoh pon, hinla tun a Lhagao jal in Aman asolchah thengho le themgao ho henga hiche hi ahin phongdoh tai.
English: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

tcz: Chule hiche hi Pathen lunggon ahi: chidang namdang le Juda mite Kipana Thupha tahsan Pathen chate ho chun ahaona gou chu kibang chet a chang ding ahiuve.
en: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,
text:
EPH 3:6
Thadou: Chule hiche hi Pathen lunggon ahi: chidang namdang le Juda mite Kipana Thupha tahsan Pathen chate ho chun ahaona gou chu kibang chet a chang ding ahiuve.
English: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

tcz: Ani lhona chu tipum kibang ahigel lhon in, chule ani lhona phattheina thutep chu chang gel ahi lhon hi Christa Yeshua a ahi jal jeh ahi.
en: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.
text:
EPH 3:7
Thadou: Ani lhona chu tipum kibang ahigel lhon in, chule ani lhona phattheina thutep chu chang gel ahi lhon hi Christa Yeshua a ahi jal jeh ahi.
English: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

tcz: Keima Pathen mite lah a imacha hiloupen hijeng jongleng, Aman Christa a gou kichaitih umlou chidang namdangho seipeh dinga alung gon chu lungset mana keima heng ahinlhut ahitai.
en: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
text:
EPH 3:8
Thadou: Keima Pathen mite lah a imacha hiloupen hijeng jongleng, Aman Christa a gou kichaitih umlou chidang namdangho seipeh dinga alung gon chu lungset mana keima heng ahinlhut ahitai.
English: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

tcz: Keima hi hiche thuguh tohgon um chu mitin seipeh dinga eikilheng doh ahin, Pathen ijakai sempa chun, atil abula pat a aguh a akoisa ahitai.
en: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,
text:
EPH 3:9
Thadou: Keima hi hiche thuguh tohgon um chu mitin seipeh dinga eikilheng doh ahin, Pathen ijakai sempa chun, atil abula pat a aguh a akoisa ahitai.
English: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

tcz: Hicheho jousea Pathen lunggon chu houbung mangcha a, chihna a van munhoa ahaona chu mutheilou vaipoho le athunei ho jouse henga phondoh ding ati ahi.
en: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
text:
EPH 3:10
Thadou: Hicheho jousea Pathen lunggon chu houbung mangcha a, chihna a van munhoa ahaona chu mutheilou vaipoho le athunei ho jouse henga phondoh ding ati ahi.
English: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

tcz: Hiche hi tonsot'a atohgon ahin, hichu Christa Yeshua i-Pakaiyu jal'a atohdoh ding ahi.
en: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
EPH 3:11
Thadou: Hiche hi tonsot'a atohgon ahin, hichu Christa Yeshua i-Pakaiyu jal'a atohdoh ding ahi.
English: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Christa jal leh Ama itahsan jal uva, tua hi eiho lungngam tah leh kisong tah a Pathen angsung ilut theiyu ahitai.
en: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
text:
EPH 3:12
Thadou: Christa jal leh Ama itahsan jal uva, tua hi eiho lungngam tah leh kisong tah a Pathen angsung ilut theiyu ahitai.
English: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

tcz: Hijeh chun, hiche mun a keima chungthu kikholna ho jeh hin lunglha hihbeh un. Nangho jeh a keiman kagim thoh hi nanghon sahtah nahiu kihet un.
en: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
text:
EPH 3:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun, hiche mun a keima chungthu kikholna ho jeh hin lunglha hihbeh un. Nangho jeh a keiman kagim thoh hi nanghon sahtah nahiu kihet un.
English: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

tcz: Hiche ho jouse hi kagel chun, keima ka dilsun, Pa henga ka taovin ahi.
en: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
EPH 3:14
Thadou: Hiche ho jouse hi kagel chun, keima ka dilsun, Pa henga ka taovin ahi.
English: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Ama hi van chunga hihen, leiset chunga hijongleh ijakai sempa ahi.
en: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
text:
EPH 3:15
Thadou: Ama hi van chunga hihen, leiset chunga hijongleh ijakai sempa ahi.
English: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

tcz: Keima kataona chu ahileh, aloupina, aLhagao Theng a kona aman nangho sunggila kona thahatna beitih nei louva napeh dingu hi ahi.
en: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,
text:
EPH 3:16
Thadou: Keima kataona chu ahileh, aloupina, aLhagao Theng a kona aman nangho sunggila kona thahatna beitih nei louva napeh dingu hi ahi.
English: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

tcz: Chutengleh Christa chun Ama natahsan jaljeh uva nalungsung uva achen theina ding ahi. Pathen ngailutna a chu na jungkho uva chule nahat dohna ding uvin thuhtah in kivuilut un.
en: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
text:
EPH 3:17
Thadou: Chutengleh Christa chun Ama natahsan jaljeh uva nalungsung uva achen theina ding ahi. Pathen ngailutna a chu na jungkho uva chule nahat dohna ding uvin thuhtah in kivuilut un.
English: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

tcz: Chule nanghon Pathen mite jousen anei dingu ahi bangin, tahsan theina thaneina chu neiyun–Angailutna chu ichan geiya len a, saova, sang a, chule thuh a hitam!
en: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,
text:
EPH 3:18
Thadou: Chule nanghon Pathen mite jousen anei dingu ahi bangin, tahsan theina thaneina chu neiyun–Angailutna chu ichan geiya len a, saova, sang a, chule thuh a hitam!
English: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

tcz: Nanghon Christa ngailutna hi tepkha teiyun! hiche hetchet ding chu hetjoujai hihih jong leh. Chutengleh hinkho bulhingset pum chule Pathena kona thilboltheina puma nakisem pilhing diu ahi.
en: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
text:
EPH 3:19
Thadou: Nanghon Christa ngailutna hi tepkha teiyun! hiche hetchet ding chu hetjoujai hihih jong leh. Chutengleh hinkho bulhingset pum chule Pathena kona thilboltheina puma nakisem pilhing diu ahi.
English: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

tcz: Tun loupina jouse chu, athilbol theina hattah a kona isunguva natong'ah, ithumu ahiloule igel'u kalval a hetjoujai hilou subulhit thei, Pathen a hita hen.
en: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
text:
EPH 3:20
Thadou: Tun loupina jouse chu, athilbol theina hattah a kona isunguva natong'ah, ithumu ahiloule igel'u kalval a hetjoujai hilou subulhit thei, Pathen a hita hen.
English: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

tcz: Houbung sunga chule Christa Yeshua a chun akhang khangin, atonsot tonsot'in loupina ama a hijing tahen, Amen.
en: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
text:
EPH 3:21
Thadou: Houbung sunga chule Christa Yeshua a chun akhang khangin, atonsot tonsot'in loupina ama a hijing tahen, Amen.
English: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun, Pakai kin bolna a sohchang keiman, Pathen in nakouvu ahitah jeh in, nakikou nau totoh in chonun tia nakom uva katao ahi.
en: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
text:
EPH 4:1
Thadou: Hiche jeh chun, Pakai kin bolna a sohchang keiman, Pathen in nakouvu ahitah jeh in, nakikou nau totoh in chonun tia nakom uva katao ahi.
English: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

tcz: Phatseh in kineosah un chule lungneng un. Khat chu khat chungah thoh hat'un, na ngailut nau jaljeh in khat in khat suhkhelna a kihepito cheh un.
en: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
text:
EPH 4:2
Thadou: Phatseh in kineosah un chule lungneng un. Khat chu khat chungah thoh hat'un, na ngailut nau jaljeh in khat in khat suhkhelna a kihepito cheh un.
English: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

tcz: Lhagaova pumkhat hina dingin kiseh un, khat le khat chamna in kikan khomun.
en: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
text:
EPH 4:3
Thadou: Lhagaova pumkhat hina dingin kiseh un, khat le khat chamna in kikan khomun.
English: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

tcz: Ajehchu nangho hi khonunga loupina kinem'a kikou nahi bangun, tipum khat ahin chule Lhagao jong khat ahi.
en: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
text:
EPH 4:4
Thadou: Ajehchu nangho hi khonunga loupina kinem'a kikou nahi bangun, tipum khat ahin chule Lhagao jong khat ahi.
English: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

tcz: Pakai khat, tahsan khat chule baptize chan khat bou ahi,
en: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
text:
EPH 4:5
Thadou: Pakai khat, tahsan khat chule baptize chan khat bou ahi,
English: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

tcz: Chule Pathen khat le Pa chu imajouse chung vum'a uma ahin, chule imajousea uma ahiye.
en: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
text:
EPH 4:6
Thadou: Chule Pathen khat le Pa chu imajouse chung vum'a uma ahin, chule imajousea uma ahiye.
English: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

tcz: Hiti chu hijongleh, Aman eiho khat cheh hi manbei thilpeh aguntah chu, Christa hong phalna jal in, eipe cheh uvin ahi.
en: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
text:
EPH 4:7
Thadou: Hiti chu hijongleh, Aman eiho khat cheh hi manbei thilpeh aguntah chu, Christa hong phalna jal in, eipe cheh uvin ahi.
English: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

tcz: Hijeh chun Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Ama achung sanglama akaltou chun, sohchang ho apuiyin chule Amite chu manbei thilpeh ho ape-in ahi,” akiti.
en: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
text:
EPH 4:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Ama achung sanglama akaltou chun, sohchang ho apuiyin chule Amite chu manbei thilpeh ho ape-in ahi,” akiti.
English: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

tcz: Melchih in, “Ama akaltou chun” kiti hi: Hiche hin Christa chu vannoi anoinung lama gakumsuh a ahi tina jong ahi.
en: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
text:
EPH 4:9
Thadou: Melchih in, “Ama akaltou chun” kiti hi: Hiche hin Christa chu vannoi anoinung lama gakumsuh a ahi tina jong ahi.
English: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

tcz: Chule Ama agakumsuh a chu vanho jouse sanga jong sang joa kaltouva ahi, hitia chu Aman vannoi pumpi hi Amatah in adimset sah ahi.
en: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
text:
EPH 4:10
Thadou: Chule Ama agakumsuh a chu vanho jouse sanga jong sang joa kaltouva ahi, hitia chu Aman vannoi pumpi hi Amatah in adimset sah ahi.
English: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

tcz: Tun hiche ho hi Christa in a houbung dinga manbei thilpeh'a apeh ahi: Solchah ho, Themgao ho, Evangelist ho, Pastor ho chule Mihil ho ahiuve.
en: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

tcz: Amaho amopoh nau chu Pathen mite chu Pathen natohna a pang ding chule Christa tipum, houbung chu sahdohna dinga ahi.
en: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,
text:
EPH 4:12
Thadou: Amaho amopoh nau chu Pathen mite chu Pathen natohna a pang ding chule Christa tipum, houbung chu sahdohna dinga ahi.
English: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

tcz: Hiche hi eiho ibon chauva chutobang tahsanna a kipumkhat a chule Pathen chapa hetna lama Pakaiya ipilhin theina ding uva, Christa a idim uva chule chamkimna a ichejompeh theina dingu ahi.
en: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,
text:
EPH 4:13
Thadou: Hiche hi eiho ibon chauva chutobang tahsanna a kipumkhat a chule Pathen chapa hetna lama Pakaiya ipilhin theina ding uva, Christa a idim uva chule chamkimna a ichejompeh theina dingu ahi.
English: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

tcz: Chutengleh eiho chapang ho banga pilhing louva iumlou dingu ahitai. Eiho hi thuhil thah hui hung nung tobang ahung ho chun eimut lonle le lou dingu ahitai. Eiho hi mihon jouva eihin doha bol teng uleh thutah banga chingtheitah a asei dingu ahi.
en: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

tcz: Chusangin, eihon thutah chu ngailutna neiyin seiyu hite, imalam jousea khangtouva Christa (Houbung Luchang), Atipum (Christa tahsa) dinga ihi theina dingu ahi.
en: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,
text:
EPH 4:15
Thadou: Chusangin, eihon thutah chu ngailutna neiyin seiyu hite, imalam jousea khangtouva Christa (Houbung Luchang), Atipum (Christa tahsa) dinga ihi theina dingu ahi.
English: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

tcz: Aman atipumpi chu chamkim keiya asuhto sohkei ahi. Tibah hon ama ama kin hoitah a akibol cheh uva ahileh hiche hin tibah dang jong akhantou sah ahi, hitia chu tipumpi chu damthei le khangtouva chule ngailutna dimset hiji ahi.
en: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
text:
EPH 4:16
Thadou: Aman atipumpi chu chamkim keiya asuhto sohkei ahi. Tibah hon ama ama kin hoitah a akibol cheh uva ahileh hiche hin tibah dang jong akhantou sah ahi, hitia chu tipumpi chu damthei le khangtouva chule ngailutna dimset hiji ahi.
English: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

tcz: Pakai thuneina'a hiche hi kasei ahi: chidang namdang ho bolngai bangin bol tahih un, ajeh chu amaho tah kinepna beiya lungnoh phah bep ahiuve.
en: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
text:
EPH 4:17
Thadou: Pakai thuneina'a hiche hi kasei ahi: chidang namdang ho bolngai bangin bol tahih un, ajeh chu amaho tah kinepna beiya lungnoh phah bep ahiuve.
English: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

tcz: Alunggelu muthim lhangkhal kiheh ahin, amaho Pathen in hinkho apehna uva konin akihei mangun, Pathen in amaho apeh u lungthim chu akhah chah un chule Ama dounan alungu atahsah cheh un ahi.
en: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
text:
EPH 4:18
Thadou: Alunggelu muthim lhangkhal kiheh ahin, amaho Pathen in hinkho apehna uva konin akihei mangun, Pathen in amaho apeh u lungthim chu akhah chah un chule Ama dounan alungu atahsah cheh un ahi.
English: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

tcz: Amahon jachat lamjong ahepouve. Amaho tahsa lung ngaichat nan ahinguvin chule then louna lam jousea akipeuvin ahi.
en: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
text:
EPH 4:19
Thadou: Amahon jachat lamjong ahepouve. Amaho tahsa lung ngaichat nan ahinguvin chule then louna lam jousea akipeuvin ahi.
English: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

tcz: Hinlah hichu Christaa kona nakihilu ahipoi.
en: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
text:
EPH 4:20
Thadou: Hinlah hichu Christaa kona nakihilu ahipoi.
English: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

tcz: Nanghon Yeshua thu najah u ahitan, chule Amaa kona thutah chu kihil'a nahi tauve.
en: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:
text:
EPH 4:21
Thadou: Nanghon Yeshua thu najah u ahitan, chule Amaa kona thutah chu kihil'a nahi tauve.
English: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

tcz: Na chonset luiyu chonna le masang nahinkhou then louna lung ngaichat le doha lhahna chu pailha uvin.
en: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
text:
EPH 4:22
Thadou: Na chonset luiyu chonna le masang nahinkhou then louna lung ngaichat le doha lhahna chu pailha uvin.
English: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

tcz: Chusangin, Lhagao chun nalunggel ule ngaito nau suthahjo hen.
en: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
text:
EPH 4:23
Thadou: Chusangin, Lhagao chun nalunggel ule ngaito nau suthahjo hen.
English: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

tcz: Na chonnau athah Pathen lim tobang pu–chonpha tahbeh le atheng chu kivonun.
en: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
text:
EPH 4:24
Thadou: Na chonnau athah Pathen lim tobang pu–chonpha tahbeh le atheng chu kivonun.
English: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

tcz: Hijeh chun jousei pailha tauvin. I-heng le ikom ho henga thutah chu seitau hite, ajeh chu eiho jouse hi tipum khat a chu jaova ihisoh keiyuve.
en: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
text:
EPH 4:25
Thadou: Hijeh chun jousei pailha tauvin. I-heng le ikom ho henga thutah chu seitau hite, ajeh chu eiho jouse hi tipum khat a chu jaova ihisoh keiyuve.
English: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

tcz: Chule chonset sodohna lunghan chun na thunun da tauhen. Nalunghan pet pum in nisa kilhum khum sah hih un.
en: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
text:
EPH 4:26
Thadou: Chule chonset sodohna lunghan chun na thunun da tauhen. Nalunghan pet pum in nisa kilhum khum sah hih un.
English: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

tcz: Ajehchu lunghan na hin Diabol dinga pansatna apeh ahi.
en: and don’t give place to the devil.
text:
EPH 4:27
Thadou: Ajehchu lunghan na hin Diabol dinga pansatna apeh ahi.
English: and don’t give place to the devil.

tcz: Gucha nahileh, guhchat ngajeng in. Chusang chun, nakhut teni chu thilpha hatoh nan mangchan, chujou teng angaicha ho chu hongphal tah in pen.
en: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
text:
EPH 4:28
Thadou: Gucha nahileh, guhchat ngajeng in. Chusang chun, nakhut teni chu thilpha hatoh nan mangchan, chujou teng angaicha ho chu hongphal tah in pen.
English: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

tcz: Paongeilou le thuphalou seihih in. Nasei chasun chu apha le aphachom ding hihen, hiti chun nathusei ngaiho dinga kitil khouna sohdoh hen.
en: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
text:
EPH 4:29
Thadou: Paongeilou le thuphalou seihih in. Nasei chasun chu apha le aphachom ding hihen, hiti chun nathusei ngaiho dinga kitil khouna sohdoh hen.
English: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

tcz: Na hinkho mandan u chu Pathen Lhagao Theng lung himosahna hida hen. Aman Amaa mong monga lhatdamna nikhoa nangho huhhing na channa ding uva namel chih u ahitai.
en: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
text:
EPH 4:30
Thadou: Na hinkho mandan u chu Pathen Lhagao Theng lung himosahna hida hen. Aman Amaa mong monga lhatdamna nikhoa nangho huhhing na channa ding uva namel chih u ahitai.
English: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

tcz: Lungdam louna jouse, lungsat, lunghan, thungai lou sei, chule seiset oimona, chule chonchan phalou jouse chu paimang un.
en: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
text:
EPH 4:31
Thadou: Lungdam louna jouse, lungsat, lunghan, thungai lou sei, chule seiset oimona, chule chonchan phalou jouse chu paimang un.
English: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

tcz: Chusangin, khat le khat kilungsetto cheh un, lungneng un, khat le khat kingaidam touvin, Christa in nangho na ngaidam bang uvin ngaidamun.
en: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
text:
EPH 4:32
Thadou: Chusangin, khat le khat kilungsetto cheh un, lungneng un, khat le khat kingaidam touvin, Christa in nangho na ngaidam bang uvin ngaidamun.
English: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

tcz: Hijeh chun imalam jousea Pathen umchan jomun, ajeh chu nangho Ama deilhen chate nahiuve.
en: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
text:
EPH 5:1
Thadou: Hijeh chun imalam jousea Pathen umchan jomun, ajeh chu nangho Ama deilhen chate nahiuve.
English: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

tcz: Ngailutna dimset hinkho manguvin, Christa in avetsahna nung chu juiyun. Aman eingailut uva, chule Amatah hung kipedoh a Pathena dinga gimnam tuiya kipedoh a ahitai.
en: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
text:
EPH 5:2
Thadou: Ngailutna dimset hinkho manguvin, Christa in avetsahna nung chu juiyun. Aman eingailut uva, chule Amatah hung kipedoh a Pathena dinga gimnam tuiya kipedoh a ahitai.
English: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

tcz: Nalah uva jon-thanhoina, thenlouna, ahilouleh chipset umdahen. Hitobang chonsetnaho hin Pathen mite lah a mun aneipoi.
en: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

tcz: Phatchomna bei thusim seiho, ngol-hoi thusei, alam louva totnaho-hiche hohi nangho hina ahipoi. Chusangn in, Pathen thangvahna sohjo hen.
en: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
text:
EPH 5:4
Thadou: Phatchomna bei thusim seiho, ngol-hoi thusei, alam louva totnaho-hiche hohi nangho hina ahipoi. Chusangn in, Pathen thangvahna sohjo hen.
English: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

tcz: Nahet chet diuva pha chu–jonthanhoi, thenlouna, ahilouleh michipse ho Christa le Pathen Lenggam lutlou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu michipse kiti hi milim hou ahin, hiche vannoi thil hohi pathena anei ahitai.
en: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
text:
EPH 5:5
Thadou: Nahet chet diuva pha chu–jonthanhoi, thenlouna, ahilouleh michipse ho Christa le Pathen Lenggam lutlou ding ahiuve. Ajeh chu michipse kiti hi milim hou ahin, hiche vannoi thil hohi pathena anei ahitai.
English: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

tcz: Hiche chonset hoa kithem chan ho dohan lhahih hel un, ajeh chu Pathen lunghan chu Ama seingailou ho jouse chunga chu ding ahi.
en: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
text:
EPH 5:6
Thadou: Hiche chonset hoa kithem chan ho dohan lhahih hel un, ajeh chu Pathen lunghan chu Ama seingailou ho jouse chunga chu ding ahi.
English: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

tcz: Hiche mihon thil abol nauva hin jao hihbeh in.
en: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
text:
EPH 5:7
Thadou: Hiche mihon thil abol nauva hin jao hihbeh in.
English: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

tcz: Ajehchu nangho khatvei chu muthim lhangkhal kihehleu lah a uma nana hiuvin, hinla tun nanghon Pakaiya kona vah chu naneiyu ahitai. Hijeh chun vahmite hin'in hing uvin.
en: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
text:
EPH 5:8
Thadou: Ajehchu nangho khatvei chu muthim lhangkhal kihehleu lah a uma nana hiuvin, hinla tun nanghon Pakaiya kona vah chu naneiyu ahitai. Hijeh chun vahmite hin'in hing uvin.
English: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

tcz: Ajehchu hiche vah nasung uva kona hungvah doh chun apha le adih chule thutah ahin hindoh sah ding ahi.
en: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
text:
EPH 5:9
Thadou: Ajehchu hiche vah nasung uva kona hungvah doh chun apha le adih chule thutah ahin hindoh sah ding ahi.
English: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

tcz: Pakai lunglhaina ipi ahi chu chingthei tah in holdoh un.
en: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
text:
EPH 5:10
Thadou: Pakai lunglhaina ipi ahi chu chingthei tah in holdoh un.
English: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

tcz: Phatchomna bei agiloupa le muthim natoh hoa chun pan lahih un, chusangin sosal jouvin.
en: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
text:
EPH 5:11
Thadou: Phatchomna bei agiloupa le muthim natoh hoa chun pan lahih un, chusangin sosal jouvin.
English: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

tcz: Pathen ngaisahlou hon guhthima athilbol hou hi gahsei dinga jong jachat umtah ahi.
en: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
text:
EPH 5:12
Thadou: Pathen ngaisahlou hon guhthima athilbol hou hi gahsei dinga jong jachat umtah ahi.
English: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

tcz: Hinlah amaho lungput phalou chu achungu vah'in ahinsal tengleh kilang doh ding ahi.
en: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
text:
EPH 5:13
Thadou: Hinlah amaho lungput phalou chu achungu vah'in ahinsal tengleh kilang doh ding ahi.
English: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

tcz: Ajehchu vah'in ijakai atahlang ding ahi. Hiche jeh a hi hitia hi kiseiya ahi, “Vo ihmumil, athilah a konin thoudoh in, chule Christa in nangma nasalvah ding ahi.”
en: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
text:
EPH 5:14
Thadou: Ajehchu vah'in ijakai atahlang ding ahi. Hiche jeh a hi hitia hi kiseiya ahi, “Vo ihmumil, athilah a konin thoudoh in, chule Christa in nangma nasalvah ding ahi.”
English: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

tcz: Hijeh chun itobang hinkho mang nahiu ching theiyun. Mingol ho tobang'in hinkho mang hih un, achingho tobang'in hing jouvin.
en: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
text:
EPH 5:15
Thadou: Hijeh chun itobang hinkho mang nahiu ching theiyun. Mingol ho tobang'in hinkho mang hih un, achingho tobang'in hing jouvin.
English: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

tcz: Tulai nikho phalou lah a hin phat kijenpet cha hi mang themun.
en: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
text:
EPH 5:16
Thadou: Tulai nikho phalou lah a hin phat kijenpet cha hi mang themun.
English: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

tcz: Lung geltoh louvin chon hih un, hinla Pakaiyin ipi nabol ding uva adei chu hedoh un.
en: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
text:
EPH 5:17
Thadou: Lung geltoh louvin chon hih un, hinla Pakaiyin ipi nabol ding uva adei chu hedoh un.
English: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

tcz: Lengpitwi don khamhih un, ajeh chu hichun nahinkhou amah thah sah ding ahi. Chusangin, Lhagao Thenga dimset un.
en: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
text:
EPH 5:18
Thadou: Lengpitwi don khamhih un, ajeh chu hichun nahinkhou amah thah sah ding ahi. Chusangin, Lhagao Thenga dimset un.
English: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

tcz: Vahchoina la ho le Pathen houna la chule lhagaolam laho nangma ho lah a sauvin, chule nalunggilun Pakaiya tumging tothon sauvin.
en: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

tcz: Chule imalam jousea Pa Pathen chu IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa minin thangvah un.
en: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

tcz: Chule akalvalin, Christa jana jal in khat chu khat thua kitulut'un.
en: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
text:
EPH 5:21
Thadou: Chule akalvalin, Christa jana jal in khat chu khat thua kitulut'un.
English: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

tcz: Nute ho, Pakai thua nung tobang'in najipa teu thu thun nungun.
en: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
text:
EPH 5:22
Thadou: Nute ho, Pakai thua nung tobang'in najipa teu thu thun nungun.
English: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

tcz: Ajehchu jipa khat chu Christa Houbung luchang ahi tobanga jipa chu ajinu dinga aluchang ahi. Ama hi Atahsa pum, hichu Houbung Huhhingpu chu ahije.
en: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
text:
EPH 5:23
Thadou: Ajehchu jipa khat chu Christa Houbung luchang ahi tobanga jipa chu ajinu dinga aluchang ahi. Ama hi Atahsa pum, hichu Houbung Huhhingpu chu ahije.
English: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

tcz: Houbung Christa thua nung ahibangin, hitobangma chun nute ho jong najipa teu thunoiya imalam jousen umun.
en: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
text:
EPH 5:24
Thadou: Houbung Christa thua nung ahibangin, hitobangma chun nute ho jong najipa teu thunoiya imalam jousen umun.
English: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

tcz: Chule nangho pate hon, Christa in Houbung angailut tobang chun, najinu teu chu ngailuvin. Aman amanu dinga ahinkho apeh'a
en: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
text:
EPH 5:25
Thadou: Chule nangho pate hon, Christa in Houbung angailut tobang chun, najinu teu chu ngailuvin. Aman amanu dinga ahinkho apeh'a
English: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

tcz: amanu chu athen'a chule angimsel na dinga Pathen Thule baptize kibol'a kona asilngim ahi.
en: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
text:
EPH 5:26
Thadou: amanu chu athen'a chule angimsel na dinga Pathen Thule baptize kibol'a kona asilngim ahi.
English: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

tcz: Hiche aman abol hi amanu hi Amaa dinga Loupi tah Houbung chu ahia anenlai, ahilouleh akohlai, ahilouleh adang nolna thei mun umlouna dinga abol ahi. Chusanga, amanu hi atheng le nolna bei hiding ahije.
en: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
text:
EPH 5:27
Thadou: Hiche aman abol hi amanu hi Amaa dinga Loupi tah Houbung chu ahia anenlai, ahilouleh akohlai, ahilouleh adang nolna thei mun umlouna dinga abol ahi. Chusanga, amanu hi atheng le nolna bei hiding ahije.
English: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

tcz: Hitobangma chu, jipa tehon jong ajinu teu chu atahsau banga angailut dingu ahi. Ajehchu mihem khat ajinu ngailua chun amatah kingailua ahi ti avetsah e.
en: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
text:
EPH 5:28
Thadou: Hitobangma chu, jipa tehon jong ajinu teu chu atahsau banga angailut dingu ahi. Ajehchu mihem khat ajinu ngailua chun amatah kingailua ahi ti avetsah e.
English: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

tcz: Christa in a-Houbung avettup tobang chun koiman ama tahsa ahotbol ngaipoi, chusangin avah jingin chule avetup jinge.
en: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,
text:
EPH 5:29
Thadou: Christa in a-Houbung avettup tobang chun koiman ama tahsa ahotbol ngaipoi, chusangin avah jingin chule avetup jinge.
English: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

tcz: Chule eiho Ama tipuma atibah ho ihiuve.
en: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
text:
EPH 5:30
Thadou: Chule eiho Ama tipuma atibah ho ihiuve.
English: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei tobang'in, “Pasal in apa le anu adalhah'a, chule ajinua beh ding ahi, chule ani lhona khat a kigom khom lhon ahitai.”
en: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”
text:
EPH 5:31
Thadou: Pathen Thubun asei tobang'in, “Pasal in apa le anu adalhah'a, chule ajinua beh ding ahi, chule ani lhona khat a kigom khom lhon ahitai.”
English: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

tcz: Hichea hi thuguh kidang tah uma ahi, hinla hichea hi Christa le houbung khat ahina vetsahna ahi.
en: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.
text:
EPH 5:32
Thadou: Hichea hi thuguh kidang tah uma ahi, hinla hichea hi Christa le houbung khat ahina vetsahna ahi.
English: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

tcz: Hijeh a hi avela kasei ahi, pasal khat cheh in amatah akingailut tobanga ajinu chu angailut teiding ahi, chule jinu chun ajipa chu aja ding ahi.
en: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
text:
EPH 5:33
Thadou: Hijeh a hi avela kasei ahi, pasal khat cheh in amatah akingailut tobanga ajinu chu angailut teiding ahi, chule jinu chun ajipa chu aja ding ahi.
English: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

tcz: Chateho, Pakaiya nahitah jeh uvin nanu le napa teu thun nungun, ajeh chu hiche hi thildih bolding dol chu ahi.
en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
text:
EPH 6:1
Thadou: Chateho, Pakaiya nahitah jeh uvin nanu le napa teu thun nungun, ajeh chu hiche hi thildih bolding dol chu ahi.
English: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

tcz: Napa le nanu jabolin. Hiche hi thutepto kigoma thupeh amasa ahi.
en: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:
text:
EPH 6:2
Thadou: Napa le nanu jabolin. Hiche hi thutepto kigoma thupeh amasa ahi.
English: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

tcz: Nangman napa le nanu najabola ahileh, “nangma dinga thil ijakai hoile pha hung hi ding, chule leiset chunga hi na hinkho sot ding ahi.”
en: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”
text:
EPH 6:3
Thadou: Nangman napa le nanu najabola ahileh, “nangma dinga thil ijakai hoile pha hung hi ding, chule leiset chunga hi na hinkho sot ding ahi.”
English: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

tcz: Pateho, nachateu chu sasahna nanei nauva kona lunghan sahna bol hih'un. Chusangin, Pakaiya kona thununna le thuhilnaa seiletsah jouvin.
en: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
text:
EPH 6:4
Thadou: Pateho, nachateu chu sasahna nanei nauva kona lunghan sahna bol hih'un. Chusangin, Pakaiya kona thununna le thuhilnaa seiletsah jouvin.
English: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

tcz: Soh ho, leiset a napakai teu phatah a jabolna le ginna nei pumin athu uva nungun. Nanghon Christa najen ding bangtah u chun jen un.
en: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,
text:
EPH 6:5
Thadou: Soh ho, leiset a napakai teu phatah a jabolna le ginna nei pumin athu uva nungun. Nanghon Christa najen ding bangtah u chun jen un.
English: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

tcz: Amaho chun na vet-vet pet bouva hilouvin, phat jousen lunglhaisah un. Christaa sohchang nahijal un, Pathen lunglam chu nalung pum piuvin bol un.
en: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
text:
EPH 6:6
Thadou: Amaho chun na vet-vet pet bouva hilouvin, phat jousen lunglhaisah un. Christaa sohchang nahijal un, Pathen lunglam chu nalung pum piuvin bol un.
English: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

tcz: Halpel in na tongun, miho dinga hilouvin Pakaiya dinga natong hijouvin.
en: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,
text:
EPH 6:7
Thadou: Halpel in na tongun, miho dinga hilouvin Pakaiya dinga natong hijouvin.
English: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

tcz: Geldoh un, Pakaiyin thilpha bol jeh a, eiho khat khat cheh hi tohman eipeh cheh dingu ahi, soh hihen, achamlhat ah hijongleh,
en: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.
text:
EPH 6:8
Thadou: Geldoh un, Pakaiyin thilpha bol jeh a, eiho khat khat cheh hi tohman eipeh cheh dingu ahi, soh hihen, achamlhat ah hijongleh,
English: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

tcz: Hitobangma chun pakaiho, nasohteu chu hitima chun bol un. Amaho chu hutum-gihsal bolhih un, nanghon nani lhona vana Pakai khat naneiyu ahi geldoh-un chule Ama chun koima maipha avepoi.
en: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
text:
EPH 6:9
Thadou: Hitobangma chun pakaiho, nasohteu chu hitima chun bol un. Amaho chu hutum-gihsal bolhih un, nanghon nani lhona vana Pakai khat naneiyu ahi geldoh-un chule Ama chun koima maipha avepoi.
English: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

tcz: Achaina keiyin: Pakaiya chule athahat thilbol theinaa chun hat un,
en: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
text:
EPH 6:10
Thadou: Achaina keiyin: Pakaiya chule athahat thilbol theinaa chun hat un,
English: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

tcz: Pathen galvon ho jouse kivonun hitia chu Diabol doha tintang ho nanan jou sohkeina diu ahi.
en: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
text:
EPH 6:11
Thadou: Pathen galvon ho jouse kivonun hitia chu Diabol doha tintang ho nanan jou sohkeina diu ahi.
English: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

tcz: Ajehchu eiho tahsaphe le thisanpua (mihem) melmato chun kidouva ihipouve, hinla agilou vaipo hotoh chule mutheilou vannoiya athuneiho toh, hiche vannoi muthim lah a hattah a thanei vaipo hotoh, chule van munhoa lhagao gilou engse hotoh kidouva ihiuve.
en: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
text:
EPH 6:12
Thadou: Ajehchu eiho tahsaphe le thisanpua (mihem) melmato chun kidouva ihipouve, hinla agilou vaipo hotoh chule mutheilou vannoiya athuneiho toh, hiche vannoi muthim lah a hattah a thanei vaipo hotoh, chule van munhoa lhagao gilou engse hotoh kidouva ihiuve.
English: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

tcz: Hijeh a chu, nikho phalounia melma chu nadou jou theiyuva, nalethuh jouna dingun Pathen galvon chengse panun. Chujongleh gal akichai jouva jong nangho nadindet jom jingna dingu ahi.
en: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
text:
EPH 6:13
Thadou: Hijeh a chu, nikho phalounia melma chu nadou jou theiyuva, nalethuh jouna dingun Pathen galvon chengse panun. Chujongleh gal akichai jouva jong nangho nadindet jom jingna dingu ahi.
English: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

tcz: Nadin nauva chun pang det un, thutah konggah in kigah un, chule tipum chu Pathen chonphatna galvon in kivonun.
en: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
text:
EPH 6:14
Thadou: Nadin nauva chun pang det un, thutah konggah in kigah un, chule tipum chu Pathen chonphatna galvon in kivonun.
English: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

tcz: Kipana Thupha a kona bulhingset a kigosadema naumtheina dingun chamna chu kengchot in kiseuvin.
en: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
text:
EPH 6:15
Thadou: Kipana Thupha a kona bulhingset a kigosadema naumtheina dingun chamna chu kengchot in kiseuvin.
English: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

tcz: Hicheng jouse chungvuma chun, Diabol meikou-thalchangho chu suhmit na dingin tahsan lumdal chu dom sangun.
en: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
text:
EPH 6:16
Thadou: Hicheng jouse chungvuma chun, Diabol meikou-thalchangho chu suhmit na dingin tahsan lumdal chu dom sangun.
English: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

tcz: Huhhingna chu lukhuh in neiyun, chule Lhagao chemjam Pathen Thu chu panun.
en: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

tcz: Lhagaovin phat bih nei jousea le thilsoh jousea tao jingun. Limgehchan umjingun chule muntina mithengte ho jouse dingin nataonauva pangdet jingun.
en: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
text:
EPH 6:18
Thadou: Lhagaovin phat bih nei jousea le thilsoh jousea tao jingun. Limgehchan umjingun chule muntina mithengte ho jouse dingin nataonauva pangdet jingun.
English: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

tcz: Chule keima dingin jong taovun. Pathen in aphat phat cha thuho eipeh a ngamtah a Pathen thuguh Kipana Thupha alunggon chu Judah mite le chidang namdangho jouse ding ahi hi kahil chet theina dingin.
en: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,
text:
EPH 6:19
Thadou: Chule keima dingin jong taovun. Pathen in aphat phat cha thuho eipeh a ngamtah a Pathen thuguh Kipana Thupha alunggon chu Judah mite le chidang namdangho jouse ding ahi hi kahil chet theina dingin.
English: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

tcz: Keima Pathen Palai kahi naa, hiche thu kaseiphong jeh'a thihkhaova kihena kahi. Hiti ahijeh chun, Ama dinga kaseiphong dingdola lung ngamtah a kasei jing theina dingin neitaopeh un.
en: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
text:
EPH 6:20
Thadou: Keima Pathen Palai kahi naa, hiche thu kaseiphong jeh'a thihkhaova kihena kahi. Hiti ahijeh chun, Ama dinga kaseiphong dingdola lung ngamtah a kasei jing theina dingin neitaopeh un.
English: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

tcz: Tychicus hin keiman ipi kabola chule itobanga kimanchahna kanei ahi thudol bulhing keiya naseipeh dingu ahinai. Ama hi Pakai natohnaa sopi deitah le kithopipha tahsan umtah ahi.
en: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.
text:
EPH 6:21
Thadou: Tychicus hin keiman ipi kabola chule itobanga kimanchahna kanei ahi thudol bulhing keiya naseipeh dingu ahinai. Ama hi Pakai natohnaa sopi deitah le kithopipha tahsan umtah ahi.
English: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

tcz: Ama naheng uva dinga kahinsol lona ajeh hi-nangho tilkhou ding le keiho ikatiu hetsah ding kagelkhoh u ahi.
en: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
text:
EPH 6:22
Thadou: Ama naheng uva dinga kahinsol lona ajeh hi-nangho tilkhou ding le keiho ikatiu hetsah ding kagelkhoh u ahi.
English: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, cham-lungmonna in naumpiu hen, chule Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun ngailutna le kitahna napeuhen.
en: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
EPH 6:23
Thadou: Kasopi deitahteho, cham-lungmonna in naumpiu hen, chule Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun ngailutna le kitahna napeuhen.
English: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Pathen milungsetna chu tonsot'in i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailuho jouse chunga umhen.
en: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.
text:
EPH 6:24
Thadou: Pathen milungsetna chu tonsot'in i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailuho jouse chunga umhen.
English: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul le Timothy'a kon ahi. Keiman Philippia um Pathen mitheng teho Christa Yeshua a um upa ho le deacon ho jouse dinga kajih ahi.
en: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
text:
PHP 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul le Timothy'a kon ahi. Keiman Philippia um Pathen mitheng teho Christa Yeshua a um upa ho le deacon ho jouse dinga kajih ahi.
English: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
PHP 1:2
Thadou: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Nangho kalunga kageldoh chanin Ka Pathen kathangvah jinge.
en: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
text:
PHP 1:3
Thadou: Nangho kalunga kageldoh chanin Ka Pathen kathangvah jinge.
English: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

tcz: Keiman taona kamanseh le kipah thanom tah in nangho jouse dingin kathumpeh jiuve.
en: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
text:
PHP 1:4
Thadou: Keiman taona kamanseh le kipah thanom tah in nangho jouse dingin kathumpeh jiuve.
English: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

tcz: Ajehchu Christa Kipana Thupha hillhangna thudol a, najah masat niuva pat tuni changeiyin nangho katohkhompi nahi jing uve.
en: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

tcz: Chule keiman nanghoa natohpha tongpan ah Pathen chun Christa Yeshua ahungkit nikho lhin masangsea Anatoh chu ajoma abulhit teiding ahi ti katahsan akichenin ahi.
en: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
text:
PHP 1:6
Thadou: Chule keiman nanghoa natohpha tongpan ah Pathen chun Christa Yeshua ahungkit nikho lhin masangsea Anatoh chu ajoma abulhit teiding ahi ti katahsan akichenin ahi.
English: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

tcz: Nangho nabonchauva thudol a keiman lung hitia kagel hi adih ahi, ajehchu nangho kalungsunga kagelkhoh jing nahiuve. Hichea hi keima songkul-lut thudol hihen chule Kipana Thupha lam dol a kihonna thu kaseina hihen chule thutah'a phudetna lam thudol hijongleh, nangho nabonchauva keima toh Pathen lungsetna kachan khompi nahiuve.
en: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
text:
PHP 1:7
Thadou: Nangho nabonchauva thudol a keiman lung hitia kagel hi adih ahi, ajehchu nangho kalungsunga kagelkhoh jing nahiuve. Hichea hi keima songkul-lut thudol hihen chule Kipana Thupha lam dol a kihonna thu kaseina hihen chule thutah'a phudetna lam thudol hijongleh, nangho nabonchauva keima toh Pathen lungsetna kachan khompi nahiuve.
English: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

tcz: Ichangeiya nangho kangailut nahiuva chule Christa Yeshua milungsetnaa chu nangho nabonchauva kangai lheh u ahi chu Pathen in ahenai.
en: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
text:
PHP 1:8
Thadou: Ichangeiya nangho kangailut nahiuva chule Christa Yeshua milungsetnaa chu nangho nabonchauva kangai lheh u ahi chu Pathen in ahenai.
English: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

tcz: Nanghoa ngailutna chu aha lonlhah cheh cheh a chule nangho hetna le hetkhenna a nakhantoube chehna dinguva katao ahi.
en: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
text:
PHP 1:9
Thadou: Nanghoa ngailutna chu aha lonlhah cheh cheh a chule nangho hetna le hetkhenna a nakhantoube chehna dinguva katao ahi.
English: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

tcz: Ajehchu keiman ipipen chu kiphamoa ham ti nanghon nahetdiu kadeisahpeh nahiuvin, hitia chu Christa ahungkit nikho hunglhun kahsea ngailutna theng le nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu kati ahi.
en: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,
text:
PHP 1:10
Thadou: Ajehchu keiman ipipen chu kiphamoa ham ti nanghon nahetdiu kadeisahpeh nahiuvin, hitia chu Christa ahungkit nikho hunglhun kahsea ngailutna theng le nolnabei hinkho naman theina dingu kati ahi.
English: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

tcz: Nangho huhhing nachannau hi ga sona lama nadim jinguva, Yeshua Christa a chonphatna nahin khouva nasodoh theiyuva ahileh Pathen loupina le vahchoina hung hiding ahi.
en: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
text:
PHP 1:11
Thadou: Nangho huhhing nachannau hi ga sona lama nadim jinguva, Yeshua Christa a chonphatna nahin khouva nasodoh theiyuva ahileh Pathen loupina le vahchoina hung hiding ahi.
English: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

tcz: Chule kasopite, nanghon kahinkhoa ahung sohsaho chengse chu ipipen chu hita jongleh Kipana Thupha machalsahna dinga soh ahi tihi nahet dingu kadeiyin ahi.
en: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
text:
PHP 1:12
Thadou: Chule kasopite, nanghon kahinkhoa ahung sohsaho chengse chu ipipen chu hita jongleh Kipana Thupha machalsahna dinga soh ahi tihi nahet dingu kadeiyin ahi.
English: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

tcz: Ajeh chu amitakip, hiche leng inpia umho eivesuiya pang sepai ho chan gei hin Christa jal a thihkhaova kihen kahi ti ahetsoh keiyu ahi.
en: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,
text:
PHP 1:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu amitakip, hiche leng inpia umho eivesuiya pang sepai ho chan gei hin Christa jal a thihkhaova kihen kahi ti ahetsoh keiyu ahi.
English: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

tcz: Chule keima songkul'a eikikoi jeh a hikoma um atahsan jousen lungngamna le hansanna aneiyuva Pathen thu chu kichatna neilouva aseitheiyu ahi.
en: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
text:
PHP 1:14
Thadou: Chule keima songkul'a eikikoi jeh a hikoma um atahsan jousen lungngamna le hansanna aneiyuva Pathen thu chu kichatna neilouva aseitheiyu ahi.
English: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

tcz: Mi phabep ho chun Christa thu chu kimit thipna le midehnan aseiphongun, chule mi phabep hon lungdih pun aseiyuve, kiti ahi.
en: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
text:
PHP 1:15
Thadou: Mi phabep ho chun Christa thu chu kimit thipna le midehnan aseiphongun, chule mi phabep hon lungdih pun aseiyuve, kiti ahi.
English: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

tcz: Amaho chun Kipana Thupha hongbit a panga kahi aheuvin, keima eingailut jeh uva aseiphongu ahi.
en: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

tcz: Midangho vang chun Christa thu aseiphongu chu, chang phatchomna lunggel, lungdihpua hilou, thihkhauva kakihen hi bolgenthei bea kaumna ding ngaitoa thuseiphonga ahiuve.
en: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
text:
PHP 1:17
Thadou: Midangho vang chun Christa thu aseiphongu chu, chang phatchomna lunggel, lungdihpua hilou, thihkhauva kakihen hi bolgenthei bea kaumna ding ngaitoa thuseiphonga ahiuve.
English: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

tcz: Hinlah hichu imacha akhohpoi. Alung gonu chu dihlou hihen, adih hijongleh, Christa thuchu akiseiphong poule kipah a kahi. Chule kipah jomnalai ding kahi.
en: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
text:
PHP 1:18
Thadou: Hinlah hichu imacha akhohpoi. Alung gonu chu dihlou hihen, adih hijongleh, Christa thuchu akiseiphong poule kipah a kahi. Chule kipah jomnalai ding kahi.
English: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima dinga nataovu chule Yeshua Christa Lhagao panpina chu, keima eikilhadohna hunghi ding ahi.
en: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
text:
PHP 1:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima dinga nataovu chule Yeshua Christa Lhagao panpina chu, keima eikilhadohna hunghi ding ahi.
English: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman ginchatna le kinepna bulhingset kanei chu, keima jachatna a kachuhlou helding, hinla keima Christa dinga masanga banga lung ngama kaumjom ding ahi. Chule kahinkho hi hinna hihen, thina hijongleh Christa jabolna hung soh ding ahi ti katahsan e.
en: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
text:
PHP 1:20
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman ginchatna le kinepna bulhingset kanei chu, keima jachatna a kachuhlou helding, hinla keima Christa dinga masanga banga lung ngama kaumjom ding ahi. Chule kahinkho hi hinna hihen, thina hijongleh Christa jabolna hung soh ding ahi ti katahsan e.
English: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

tcz: Ajehchu keima dinga hin kiti hi Christa dinga hin ahin, chule thi chu aphajo cheh ahi.
en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
text:
PHP 1:21
Thadou: Ajehchu keima dinga hin kiti hi Christa dinga hin ahin, chule thi chu aphajo cheh ahi.
English: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

tcz: Hinlah tahsaa kahinle, keiman Christa dinga tohga phajo kaboldoh ding ahi. Hijeh chun hoijoh hi aphajo ham ti kahepoi.
en: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
text:
PHP 1:22
Thadou: Hinlah tahsaa kahinle, keiman Christa dinga tohga phajo kaboldoh ding ahi. Hijeh chun hoijoh hi aphajo ham ti kahepoi.
English: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

tcz: Keima lung ngaichat ni neiya lunggel kichi-ah a uma kahi: Keima kache a Christa toh umkhom chu gamchenga keima dinga phajo'ah ahi.
en: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

English: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

tcz: Hinlah nangho khohsahna a tahsaa kahinjom ding hi kiphamo joa ahi.

text:
PHP 1:24

English: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

tcz: Nangho jouse tahsanna a nakhantou-uva chule kipana a hetna naneitheina dinguvin, keima hingnalai ing ting nakithopi jomuvinge, ti ginchat hi kaneiyin kahen ahi.

PHP 1:25

tcz: Chule keima nangho henga avela kahung kit tengleh nanghon Christa Yeshua a kisonna naneibe chehna dinguva kahinkhoa ipi aboldoh ham ti nahet dingu ahi.

text:
PHP 1:26

tcz: Chukalvalin, nangho van-gam mite chonin chon un, Christa Kipana Thupha to kitoh in hinkho manguvin. Chuti chun keiman kahunga nangho kahungmu u hihen ahilouleh athua nachung thu'u kajah tho hijongleh, nangho lhagao khat le lungkhatpua nadin khomuva chule Kipana Thupha thua tahsan gal nasatu thudol chu henange.
en: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

tcz: Chule namelmateu kichatsahna a chun kichahih beh un. Hichu amaho kisuhmangna dinga amelchihna hung hiding, hinla nangho vang Pathen Amatah chun nahuhdoh dingu photchetna ahi.
en: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
text:
PHP 1:28

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho Christa tahsanna a chanpha seh changa nahi pouve, hinlah Ama jal a hahsatna jong thoh dinga chanpha changa nahiuve.

text:
PHP 1:29

tcz: Hijeh chun masanga thoh gim puma kagalsat namu uvin, tujeng in jong naja soh keiyun ahi.

PHP 1:30

en: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

tcz: Chang kilunggel bol hih in, midang pachat hol hih'in. Kineosah in, nangma sanga midang chu aphajon gelin.

tcz: Naphatchomna dingbou velouvin, midang phatchomna ding jong ven.

text:
PHP 2:4

PHP 2:5

tcz: Ama Pathen ahijeng vang'in, Pathen toh kibah a, kolchah den chu abolpoi.

PHP 2:11

tcz: Henge, nangho kipah unlang, keiman jong nakipa huvinge.

text:
PHP 2:18
Thadou: Henge, nangho kipah unlang, keiman jong nakipa huvinge.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua lunglhaina ahileh Timothy hi nangho vila hinsol ding kati ahi. Chuteng chuleh nangho iti naumu aman eihil a konin keidingin jong kisuhhalna hinte.

en: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

PHP 2:24
Thadou: Chule Pakaiya kakisonna chu nanghoto kimuto vahding hi kakineme.
English: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

PHP 2:26

en: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

Thadou: Tahbeh in ama ana dammon chule thidehchet anahi'e. Hinla Pathen mikhotona chu achangin chule keima eikhoto dehset ahi. Ajeh chu keima lungkhamna chung chona lungkhamna kaneibe louna ding hiya ahi.

PHP 2:28
Thadou: Hijeh a chu ama nangho koma hinsol ding kagelkhoh ahi. Ajeh chu nanghon ama namu tenguleh nakipa uva chule nangho kalung olmopeh tahlouna ding ahiye.

en: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

PHP 2:30

en: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

PHP 3:1

PHP 3:7

text:
PHP 3:9
Thadou: Danthu juina a keima chonphatna chu hitalouva Amatoh thakhat kahia hitia chu keima Christa tahsan jal a chonpha eikisima ahitai. Ajeh chu tahsan jal'a Pathen in eiho chonpha a eisemu ahitai.
English: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

tcz: Keiman Christa chu kahet nomin, agimthohna chu thoh khoma, athina chu chankhompi kahi theina ding chule Ama thinaa kona kaithoupa thahat thilbol theina chu kachan theina ding kati ahi.
en: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
text:
PHP 3:10
Thadou: Keiman Christa chu kahet nomin, agimthohna chu thoh khoma, athina chu chankhompi kahi theina ding chule Ama thinaa kona kaithoupa thahat thilbol theina chu kachan theina ding kati ahi.
English: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

tcz: Hitia chu ipi iti jongleh keiman thinaa kona thokitna chu kachan teiding ahi.
en: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
text:
PHP 3:11
Thadou: Hitia chu ipi iti jongleh keiman thinaa kona thokitna chu kachan teiding ahi.
English: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

tcz: Keiman hicheho chu kaneitai kati ahipoi, ahilouleh keima chamkimna chu chang kahitai katipoi. Hinlah keima Christa Yeshuan einei banga hi keiman jong hiche chamkimna chu kaneina teiding kadel ahi.
en: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
text:
PHP 3:12
Thadou: Keiman hicheho chu kaneitai kati ahipoi, ahilouleh keima chamkimna chu chang kahitai katipoi. Hinlah keima Christa Yeshuan einei banga hi keiman jong hiche chamkimna chu kaneina teiding kadel ahi.
English: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

tcz: Kasopiteho, keiman hichu kanei hih laiye, hinla hiche thil khat bou hi kagut ahi. Keiman achesa thil chu kasumilin, kamasanga ipi umham ti kagelkhoh in ahi.
en: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
text:
PHP 3:13
Thadou: Kasopiteho, keiman hichu kanei hih laiye, hinla hiche thil khat bou hi kagut ahi. Keiman achesa thil chu kasumilin, kamasanga ipi umham ti kagelkhoh in ahi.
English: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

tcz: Keiman kilhaitetna chu achaina geiya lhailhunga chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua a eikounau van kipaman sanna ding mun chu hadel'a del kahi.
en: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
text:
PHP 3:14
Thadou: Keiman kilhaitetna chu achaina geiya lhailhunga chule Pathen in Christa Yeshua a eikounau van kipaman sanna ding mun chu hadel'a del kahi.
English: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Lhagaova apilhing chengsen hichehoa hin kinoptou hite. Ipiham jeh a lungkim louna nei aumle, hijong chu Pathen in naseichet peh tauvinte.
