en: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
text:
PHP 3:15
Thadou: Lhagaova apilhing chengsen hichehoa hin kinoptou hite. Ipiham jeh a lungkim louna nei aumle, hijong chu Pathen in naseichet peh tauvinte.
English: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

tcz: Hinlah eihon imasonnau chan geiya hi i-tuhchah diu angaiye.
en: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.
text:
PHP 3:16
Thadou: Hinlah eihon imasonnau chan geiya hi i-tuhchah diu angaiye.
English: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

tcz: Sopi deitah teho, keima umchan tobang hin nangho jong um uvin, chule keimaho nung juiya pangho um chana konin kihil uvin.
en: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
text:
PHP 3:17
Thadou: Sopi deitah teho, keima umchan tobang hin nangho jong um uvin, chule keimaho nung juiya pangho um chana konin kihil uvin.
English: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh masanga kanaseipeh matchet jiu bangun chule tua jong kamit a kamitlhi puma kaseipeh u ahi, amaho chu achonnau chun Christa Thingpel melmaho ahiuve ti aphotchenu ahi.
en: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
text:
PHP 3:18
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh masanga kanaseipeh matchet jiu bangun chule tua jong kamit a kamitlhi puma kaseipeh u ahi, amaho chu achonnau chun Christa Thingpel melmaho ahiuve ti aphotchenu ahi.
English: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

tcz: Amaho chun mahthahna lam amanouve. Amaho atumpiu chu a pathenu ahi, akithangatnau chu jachat akimuna diu, amaho chun tuhinkhoa dingbou agelu ahi.
en: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
text:
PHP 3:19
Thadou: Amaho chun mahthahna lam amanouve. Amaho atumpiu chu a pathenu ahi, akithangatnau chu jachat akimuna diu, amaho chun tuhinkhoa dingbou agelu ahi.
English: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

tcz: Ahinlah eiho Pakai Yeshua Christa chenna van-gam mite ihiuve. Chule eiho huhhingpu ahungkitna ding chu kinem'a ngah jinga ihiuve.
en: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
PHP 3:20
Thadou: Ahinlah eiho Pakai Yeshua Christa chenna van-gam mite ihiuve. Chule eiho huhhingpu ahungkitna ding chu kinem'a ngah jinga ihiuve.
English: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Aman itahsau thithei hi alah a, Amaa banga loupina vouphea akhel ding, Aman thil ijakai athuneina thunoiya akoi banga athua ahin nunsah ding ahi.
en: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
text:
PHP 3:21
Thadou: Aman itahsau thithei hi alah a, Amaa banga loupina vouphea akhel ding, Aman thil ijakai athuneina thunoiya akoi banga athua ahin nunsah ding ahi.
English: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

tcz: Hijeh chun kasopi deitahteho, Pakaiyah umdet jingun. Kasopi deitahteho keiman nangho kangailu uvin chule kamunom uve, ajeh chu nangho hi kakipana le kanatohna kalallukhuh nahiuve.
en: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
text:
PHP 4:1
Thadou: Hijeh chun kasopi deitahteho, Pakaiyah umdet jingun. Kasopi deitahteho keiman nangho kangailu uvin chule kamunom uve, ajeh chu nangho hi kakipana le kanatohna kalallukhuh nahiuve.
English: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

tcz: Tun keiman Euodia le Syntyche hengah, Pakaiya nahi lhon jeh in nakitomo nalhon chu umsah lhon tahih in tia kangehlhon nahi.
en: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
text:
PHP 4:2
Thadou: Tun keiman Euodia le Syntyche hengah, Pakaiya nahi lhon jeh in nakitomo nalhon chu umsah lhon tahih in tia kangehlhon nahi.
English: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

tcz: Chule nangma katohkhompi dihtah, nangman hiche numei teni hi kithopin, ajeh chu amani hi mi dang kipana thupha seiphong pehnaa gun chutah a pang lhon'ah ahi. Amani hi Clement to chule Hinna Lekhabua amin kisun dang hoto tongkhoma ahiuve.
en: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
text:
PHP 4:3
Thadou: Chule nangma katohkhompi dihtah, nangman hiche numei teni hi kithopin, ajeh chu amani hi mi dang kipana thupha seiphong pehnaa gun chutah a pang lhon'ah ahi. Amani hi Clement to chule Hinna Lekhabua amin kisun dang hoto tongkhoma ahiuve.
English: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

tcz: Pakaiya kipahtah in umjingun. Avel'in tikit inge–Kipahtah in umjingun.
en: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
text:
PHP 4:4
Thadou: Pakaiya kipahtah in umjingun. Avel'in tikit inge–Kipahtah in umjingun.
English: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

tcz: Amitakip in naum nauva nabol jouseuva lunggel toh them nahiu hehen. Pakai hungloi tading ahi geldoh un.
en: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
text:
PHP 4:5
Thadou: Amitakip in naum nauva nabol jouseuva lunggel toh them nahiu hehen. Pakai hungloi tading ahi geldoh un.
English: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

tcz: Imacha lungolmona neihih un, chusangin, imalam jousea dingin taovun. Nangaichat chu Pathen henga seiyun, chule athilbol dohsaho jal in thangvahna peuvin.
en: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
text:
PHP 4:6
Thadou: Imacha lungolmona neihih un, chusangin, imalam jousea dingin taovun. Nangaichat chu Pathen henga seiyun, chule athilbol dohsaho jal in thangvahna peuvin.
English: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

tcz: Chuti henlang hileh Pathena cham-lungmonna, ijakai hetna a khelsohkeiya chun, nalungu le nalungthimu Christa Yeshua a nahi jaluva chu napeh dingu ahi.
en: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
text:
PHP 4:7
Thadou: Chuti henlang hileh Pathena cham-lungmonna, ijakai hetna a khelsohkeiya chun, nalungu le nalungthimu Christa Yeshua a nahi jaluva chu napeh dingu ahi.
English: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Chule tun, kasopi deitah teho, achaina keiyin-akitah lam, ja-umdollam, adihlam, athenglam, lungset umle pachat umlam, aphalam le pachat theilama auma ahileh hitiho hi lunggel un.
en: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
text:
PHP 4:8
Thadou: Chule tun, kasopi deitah teho, achaina keiyin-akitah lam, ja-umdollam, adihlam, athenglam, lungset umle pachat umlam, aphalam le pachat theilama auma ahileh hitiho hi lunggel un.
English: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

tcz: Nanghon keiya kon a nakihilsa hou, nasansa ho-u chule keima a kon a najahsa hou le namusahou nitin in juiyun. Chuteng cham-lungmon Pathen chun naumpi dingu ahi.
en: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
text:
PHP 4:9
Thadou: Nanghon keiya kon a nakihilsa hou, nasansa ho-u chule keima a kon a najahsa hou le namusahou nitin in juiyun. Chuteng cham-lungmon Pathen chun naumpi dingu ahi.
English: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

tcz: Nanghon keima neigelkhoh kitnau jeh a Pakai iti kavahchoi hitam! Nanghon keima neigelkhoh jinguve ti kahei, hinla nanghon chutia kithopina thei phat kijen namulouvu ahi.
en: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
text:
PHP 4:10
Thadou: Nanghon keima neigelkhoh kitnau jeh a Pakai iti kavahchoi hitam! Nanghon keima neigelkhoh jinguve ti kahei, hinla nanghon chutia kithopina thei phat kijen namulouvu ahi.
English: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

tcz: Hichu kangaichat umjeh a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kanei khama chu lung lhaiya umje kahet ahi.
en: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
text:
PHP 4:11
Thadou: Hichu kangaichat umjeh a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keiman kanei khama chu lung lhaiya umje kahet ahi.
English: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

tcz: Keiman imacha neilouva um ahilouleh ijakai neiya umje kahen ahi. Itobang phat hunglhung dinga jong, oivaset ahilouleh keltah a umje jong chule ninglhingset hihen lhomcha hijongleh hiche thuguh chu kahet ahitai.
en: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
text:
PHP 4:12
Thadou: Keiman imacha neilouva um ahilouleh ijakai neiya umje kahen ahi. Itobang phat hunglhung dinga jong, oivaset ahilouleh keltah a umje jong chule ninglhingset hihen lhomcha hijongleh hiche thuguh chu kahet ahitai.
English: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

tcz: Ajeh chu keima thahat eipea Christa jal a chu ijakai bolthei kahi.
en: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
text:
PHP 4:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu keima thahat eipea Christa jal a chu ijakai bolthei kahi.
English: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

tcz: Hitima chun, nanghon tupet kahahsatna a neipanhu uhi nabol phalheh jenguve.
en: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
text:
PHP 4:14
Thadou: Hitima chun, nanghon tupet kahahsatna a neipanhu uhi nabol phalheh jenguve.
English: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

tcz: Philippia um nanghon nahenguva Kipana Thupha kahinpohpeh uva chu, nahetma banguvin, sum le paiya eikithopia nangho bou nahiuvin chule Macedonia a kona kagakholjin patkit chun koima houbung in achutibol pouvin ahi.
en: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
text:
PHP 4:15
Thadou: Philippia um nanghon nahenguva Kipana Thupha kahinpohpeh uva chu, nahetma banguvin, sum le paiya eikithopia nangho bou nahiuvin chule Macedonia a kona kagakholjin patkit chun koima houbung in achutibol pouvin ahi.
English: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

tcz: Thessalonica kho a kaumpet jengin jong kithopina khatveiseh hilouvin avel in neihin thot uvin ahi.
en: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
text:
PHP 4:16
Thadou: Thessalonica kho a kaumpet jengin jong kithopina khatveiseh hilouvin avel in neihin thot uvin ahi.
English: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

tcz: Keiman hiche kaseihi nanghoa thilpeh chu kangaichat ahipoi. Chusangin, lungsetthem nahijal uva kipaman nasandiu chu kadeijoh ahi.
en: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
text:
PHP 4:17
Thadou: Keiman hiche kaseihi nanghoa thilpeh chu kangaichat ahipoi. Chusangin, lungsetthem nahijal uva kipaman nasandiu chu kadeijoh ahi.
English: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

tcz: Tupet in kangaichat jouse kaneiye-chukalval in Epaphroditus khut a nathil peh u chun ninglhingset in eineisah'e. Hicheho chu kilhaina gimnamtui kihal Pathena dinga santheile lunglhai umtah ahi.
en: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
text:
PHP 4:18
Thadou: Tupet in kangaichat jouse kaneiye-chukalval in Epaphroditus khut a nathil peh u chun ninglhingset in eineisah'e. Hicheho chu kilhaina gimnamtui kihal Pathena dinga santheile lunglhai umtah ahi.
English: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

tcz: Chule hiche Pathen, keima eigelkhohpeh a chun, aloupinaa Christa Yeshua a ahao dungjuiyin nangaichat jouseu chu pebukim nauvinate.
en: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
text:
PHP 4:19
Thadou: Chule hiche Pathen, keima eigelkhohpeh a chun, aloupinaa Christa Yeshua a ahao dungjuiyin nangaichat jouseu chu pebukim nauvinate.
English: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Tun I-Pau Pathen'a chun loupina jouse atonsot atonsot in umjing hen! Amen.
en: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
text:
PHP 4:20
Thadou: Tun I-Pau Pathen'a chun loupina jouse atonsot atonsot in umjing hen! Amen.
English: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

tcz: Pathen mithengte jouse, Christa Yeshua a hiho jouse chu keima a konin salam anapeuvin. Sopite kaumpi chengsen salam nahin peuvin ahi.
en: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
text:
PHP 4:21
Thadou: Pathen mithengte jouse, Christa Yeshua a hiho jouse chu keima a konin salam anapeuvin. Sopite kaumpi chengsen salam nahin peuvin ahi.
English: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

tcz: Chule Pathen mithengte adang dangho jousen salam nahin thot uve, adehset in Caesar insung mitea konin salam napeuve.
en: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
text:
PHP 4:22
Thadou: Chule Pathen mithengte adang dangho jousen salam nahin thot uve, adehset in Caesar insung mitea konin salam napeuve.
English: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagaovu umpi hen.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
text:
PHP 4:23
Thadou: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagaovu umpi hen.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen in alunglama alhendoh Christa Yeshua solchah Paul le i-sopiu Timothy a kon ahi.
en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
text:
COL 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen in alunglama alhendoh Christa Yeshua solchah Paul le i-sopiu Timothy a kon ahi.
English: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

tcz: Pathen mithengte Colossae khopia um, Christa a tahsan umtah sopiho henga dinga kahin jih'u ahi. I Pau Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
en: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
COL 1:2
Thadou: Pathen mithengte Colossae khopia um, Christa a tahsan umtah sopiho henga dinga kahin jih'u ahi. I Pau Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
English: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Keiho nangho dingin katao jingun chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen chu kathangvah jingun ahi.
en: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
text:
COL 1:3
Thadou: Keiho nangho dingin katao jingun chule i-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen chu kathangvah jingun ahi.
English: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

tcz: Kipana Thupha thutah nanajah patniuva pat nangho dinga kinepna vana kikoipeh nahi tauve.
en: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
text:
COL 1:4
Thadou: Kipana Thupha thutah nanajah patniuva pat nangho dinga kinepna vana kikoipeh nahi tauve.
English: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

tcz: Ajeh chu keihon Christa Yeshua a natahsanu chule Pathen mite jouse nangailut u thudol kanaja tauve.
en: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News
text:
COL 1:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu keihon Christa Yeshua a natahsanu chule Pathen mite jouse nangailut u thudol kanaja tauve.
English: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

tcz: Hiche Kipana Thupha nahenguva hung chu vannoi muntin a kisol a ahitai. Pathen milungsetna kidangtah thu najahpat uva chule thutah thu chu nahet chet niuva pat a nahinkhou akikhel banga gasoa hinkhoho akikhelsah ahi.
en: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,
text:
COL 1:6
Thadou: Hiche Kipana Thupha nahenguva hung chu vannoi muntin a kisol a ahitai. Pathen milungsetna kidangtah thu najahpat uva chule thutah thu chu nahet chet niuva pat a nahinkhou akikhel banga gasoa hinkhoho akikhelsah ahi.
English: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

tcz: I-sopiu deitah katohkhompiu Epaphras a kon in jong Kipana Thupha nanahe tauve. Amahi Christa lhacha tahsan umtah le nangho thalhenga eikithopiuva pangah ahi.
en: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,
text:
COL 1:7
Thadou: I-sopiu deitah katohkhompiu Epaphras a kon in jong Kipana Thupha nanahe tauve. Amahi Christa lhacha tahsan umtah le nangho thalhenga eikithopiuva pangah ahi.
English: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

tcz: Amahin Lhagao Thengin napeh u ngailutna naneiyu thu eiseipeh u ahi.
en: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
text:
COL 1:8
Thadou: Amahin Lhagao Thengin napeh u ngailutna naneiyu thu eiseipeh u ahi.
English: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

tcz: Nangho thu kajah niuvapat nangho dinga tao jinga kahiuve: hichu Alunglam nahet bulhingset uva chule Lhagaolama chihna le hetthemna napehna dinguva tao kahiuve.
en: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
text:
COL 1:9
Thadou: Nangho thu kajah niuvapat nangho dinga tao jinga kahiuve: hichu Alunglam nahet bulhingset uva chule Lhagaolama chihna le hetthemna napehna dinguva tao kahiuve.
English: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

tcz: Hichea chu nahinkho mandan u Pakai jabolna le lunglhaina ahijinga, chule nahinkhou chun gapha asodohna dinga, chule Pathen hetna a nakhantou becheh cheh theina dingu hi ahiye.
en: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,
text:
COL 1:10
Thadou: Hichea chu nahinkho mandan u Pakai jabolna le lunglhaina ahijinga, chule nahinkhou chun gapha asodohna dinga, chule Pathen hetna a nakhantou becheh cheh theina dingu hi ahiye.
English: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

tcz: Kataonau jong hi, nangho athaneina loupi jal a nangho thahatsah a thohhatle lungdehat nangaichat dungjui uva napeh uva kipana a nadim letsetna dingu ahi.
en: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
text:
COL 1:11
Thadou: Kataonau jong hi, nangho athaneina loupi jal a nangho thahatsah a thohhatle lungdehat nangaichat dungjui uva napeh uva kipana a nadim letsetna dingu ahi.
English: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

tcz: Vah'a cheng Amithengte chuto goulo ding Apeh chu changkhom dinga eisemuva Pachu thangvah jingun.
en: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,
text:
COL 1:12
Thadou: Vah'a cheng Amithengte chuto goulo ding Apeh chu changkhom dinga eisemuva Pachu thangvah jingun.
English: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

tcz: Ajeh chu Amahin muthim lenggama kona eihuhdoh uva chule Alungset Chapa Lenggam mia eisemu ahitai.
en: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,
text:
COL 1:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu Amahin muthim lenggama kona eihuhdoh uva chule Alungset Chapa Lenggam mia eisemu ahitai.
English: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

tcz: Athisana chamlhatna eichohdoh peh uva, ichonsetnau jengjong angaidam ahitai.
en: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.
text:
COL 1:14
Thadou: Athisana chamlhatna eichohdoh peh uva, ichonsetnau jengjong angaidam ahitai.
English: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

tcz: Christa chu mutheilou Pathen chu muthei limpua hung ahi. Ama thil kisem masangpeh a ana umsa chule thilsem jouse chunga thunei vaihoma ahi.
en: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
text:
COL 1:15
Thadou: Christa chu mutheilou Pathen chu muthei limpua hung ahi. Ama thil kisem masangpeh a ana umsa chule thilsem jouse chunga thunei vaihoma ahi.
English: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

tcz: Ajeh chu Ama jal a Pathen in ijakai vana hihen chule leichunga umho hijongleh, imutheiyu le imutheilouvu hijongleh anasem ahi-laltouna ho, lenggamho, vaipoh naho, chule thuneinaho akimuphalou vannoi pumpia um, aboncha Ama jal le Ama dinga kisema ahi.
en: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.
text:
COL 1:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu Ama jal a Pathen in ijakai vana hihen chule leichunga umho hijongleh, imutheiyu le imutheilouvu hijongleh anasem ahi-laltouna ho, lenggamho, vaipoh naho, chule thuneinaho akimuphalou vannoi pumpia um, aboncha Ama jal le Ama dinga kisema ahi.
English: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

tcz: Ama imacha um masangpeh a anaumjingsa ahin, chule Aman thilsem jouse akhut a atuh ahi.
en: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
text:
COL 1:17
Thadou: Ama imacha um masangpeh a anaumjingsa ahin, chule Aman thilsem jouse akhut a atuh ahi.
English: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

tcz: Christa hi houbung luchang (hichu Ama tipum) ahi. Ama abul kipatna, thinaa kon a thoudoh jouse chunga thuneipa ahijeh a, ima jousea masapen ahi.
en: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.
text:
COL 1:18
Thadou: Christa hi houbung luchang (hichu Ama tipum) ahi. Ama abul kipatna, thinaa kon a thoudoh jouse chunga thuneipa ahijeh a, ima jousea masapen ahi.
English: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

tcz: Ajeh chu hichu Pa lunglam ahi.
en: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,
text:
COL 1:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu hichu Pa lunglam ahi.
English: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

tcz: Chule Christa a hi Pathen hina bulhingset um thingpel chunga Christa thisan kiso chun kichamna asem a; van'a umho hihen chuleh leiya umho hijongleh Pathen in ijakai Ama a dinga chamna chu asem ahitai.
en: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
text:
COL 1:20
Thadou: Chule Christa a hi Pathen hina bulhingset um thingpel chunga Christa thisan kiso chun kichamna asem a; van'a umho hihen chuleh leiya umho hijongleh Pathen in ijakai Ama a dinga chamna chu asem ahitai.
English: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

tcz: Hichehin, masanga nangho Pathen a kona gamlatah a naum uva, nalunggel u phaloule chonna phatlou jeh a amelmate nanahiu ahiye.
en: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
text:
COL 1:21
Thadou: Hichehin, masanga nangho Pathen a kona gamlatah a naum uva, nalunggel u phaloule chonna phatlou jeh a amelmate nanahiu ahiye.
English: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

tcz: Chuti jongleh, tua hi Christa hin atahsa tah a thina ato ahitah jeh in, Amatah in kichamna chu asem ahitai. Hiche hin, themmona neokhat jong neitalouva athenga le nolna beiya Ama angsunga nadinsah u ahitai.
en: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
text:
COL 1:22
Thadou: Chuti jongleh, tua hi Christa hin atahsa tah a thina ato ahitah jeh in, Amatah in kichamna chu asem ahitai. Hiche hin, themmona neokhat jong neitalouva athenga le nolna beiya Ama angsunga nadinsah u ahitai.
English: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

tcz: Hijongleh nanghon hiche thutah hi natahsan jomuva chule nadin detjom dingu ahi. Kipana Thupha nanajah uva nakisan u photchetna a kon chun kiheimang gohihbeh un. Hiche Kipana Thuphahi vannoi leiset munjousea kihillhanga ahitai, chule keima Paul hi Pathen lhacha hina a seiphong dinga eikingansea ahitai.
en: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
text:
COL 1:23
Thadou: Hijongleh nanghon hiche thutah hi natahsan jomuva chule nadin detjom dingu ahi. Kipana Thupha nanajah uva nakisan u photchetna a kon chun kiheimang gohihbeh un. Hiche Kipana Thuphahi vannoi leiset munjousea kihillhanga ahitai, chule keima Paul hi Pathen lhacha hina a seiphong dinga eikingansea ahitai.
English: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

tcz: Katahsatah a nangho dinga kagimthoh hi kakipah-e, ajeh chu keiman Christa hesoh thohna'a atipum, hichu Houbung, kathoh khompi ahi ti kahet ahi.
en: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,
text:
COL 1:24
Thadou: Katahsatah a nangho dinga kagimthoh hi kakipah-e, ajeh chu keiman Christa hesoh thohna'a atipum, hichu Houbung, kathoh khompi ahi ti kahet ahi.
English: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

tcz: Pathen in Ahoubung lhacha kinbol dinga eingansea Athupoh chu poa nangho henga phongdoh dinga hunga kahi.
en: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,
text:
COL 1:25
Thadou: Pathen in Ahoubung lhacha kinbol dinga eingansea Athupoh chu poa nangho henga phongdoh dinga hunga kahi.
English: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

tcz: Hiche thupoh hi kum aja ja a chule akhang khanga aguh a kikoi chu, tua hi Pathen mite henga kilangdoh a ahitai.
en: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
text:
COL 1:26
Thadou: Hiche thupoh hi kum aja ja a chule akhang khanga aguh a kikoi chu, tua hi Pathen mite henga kilangdoh a ahitai.
English: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa a ahaona le aloupina chu chidang namdang nangho jong nahetsah nom hin Aloupina nachantha nomu ahi ti aphotchetna ahi.
en: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.
text:
COL 1:27
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christa a ahaona le aloupina chu chidang namdang nangho jong nahetsah nom hin Aloupina nachantha nomu ahi ti aphotchetna ahi.
English: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

tcz: Hijeh a hi keihon midang Christa thu kaseipeh uva, amitakip Pathen in chihna eipeh jouseu mangcha a hilchah le thuhilna kaneiyu hi, amitakip Christa to akiguijopnau chamkimsahna dinga ahi.
en: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

tcz: Hijeh a hi keima tonggima kiseh tah a kapan a, kasunga Christan thahattah'a anatoh a chu kingam'a kahi.
en: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
text:
COL 1:29
Thadou: Hijeh a hi keima tonggima kiseh tah a kapan a, kasunga Christan thahattah'a anatoh a chu kingam'a kahi.
English: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

tcz: Keiman nangho le Laodicea a um houbungho chule tahsaa kakimupi loulaiho chengse dinga nasatah a kapohnat peh uhi nahet dingu kalunggot ahi.
en: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

tcz: Keiman amahohi alunguva lhamonna aumtheina dinga amahohi tilkhouva chule ngailutnaa akikandet uva, hitia hi amahon Pathen lunggon thuguh Christa Amatah a um chu ahetdoh theina dingu kangaito ahi.
en: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
text:
COL 2:2
Thadou: Keiman amahohi alunguva lhamonna aumtheina dinga amahohi tilkhouva chule ngailutnaa akikandet uva, hitia hi amahon Pathen lunggon thuguh Christa Amatah a um chu ahetdoh theina dingu kangaito ahi.
English: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

tcz: Ama a chu chihna le hetna gou aboncha kisela ahi.
en: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.
text:
COL 2:3
Thadou: Ama a chu chihna le hetna gou aboncha kisela ahi.
English: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

tcz: Hiche kaseipeh uhi koimachan doha pana nangho mohthua na lheplhah louna dingu ahi.
en: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
text:
COL 2:4
Thadou: Hiche kaseipeh uhi koimachan doha pana nangho mohthua na lheplhah louna dingu ahi.
English: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman tahsa a nalah uva kaumlou vang'in, lhagaovin kaumpiuve. Chule keiman nachondih ule Christaa natahsan det u thu chu kipahtah in kave jinge.
en: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
text:
COL 2:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman tahsa a nalah uva kaumlou vang'in, lhagaovin kaumpiuve. Chule keiman nachondih ule Christaa natahsan det u thu chu kipahtah in kave jinge.
English: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

tcz: Chule tun, nanghon Christa Yeshua chu Pakaiya nakisan bangu chun, Ama chu juijomun.
en: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,
text:
COL 2:6
Thadou: Chule tun, nanghon Christa Yeshua chu Pakaiya nakisan bangu chun, Ama chu juijomun.
English: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

tcz: Nakihilsa banguvin, Ama a jungkho uvin lang, thutah'a chun kisahdoh un, chule thangvahna dimletset in hinguvin.
en: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
text:
COL 2:7
Thadou: Nakihilsa banguvin, Ama a jungkho uvin lang, thutah'a chun kisahdoh un, chule thangvahna dimletset in hinguvin.
English: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

tcz: Mihem lunggel leh hiche vannoi lhagao thuneihoa hungkon chihgut lekhathemna le doha lheplhah a na-umlouna dingun chingtheiyun, hichu Christa a kon ahipoi.
en: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.
text:
COL 2:8
Thadou: Mihem lunggel leh hiche vannoi lhagao thuneihoa hungkon chihgut lekhathemna le doha lheplhah a na-umlouna dingun chingtheiyun, hichu Christa a kon ahipoi.
English: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

tcz: Ajeh chu Christa mihem tahsaa chu Pathen hina bulhingset a chenga ahi.
en: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
text:
COL 2:9
Thadou: Ajeh chu Christa mihem tahsaa chu Pathen hina bulhingset a chenga ahi.
English: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

tcz: Chule nangho hichea chu kisuchamkima nahiuve, amachu piputle thuneina jouse luchang ahi.
en: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.
text:
COL 2:10
Thadou: Chule nangho hichea chu kisuchamkima nahiuve, amachu piputle thuneina jouse luchang ahi.
English: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

tcz: Nangho Christa henga nahunguva chu aman lhagaova chep natan peh-u ahitai, hinla hichu tahsaa cheptan ngai chu hitalouvin, chonna ngai chonsetnomna chu atanlhah ahibouve.
en: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,
text:
COL 2:11
Thadou: Nangho Christa henga nahunguva chu aman lhagaova chep natan peh-u ahitai, hinla hichu tahsaa cheptan ngai chu hitalouvin, chonna ngai chonsetnomna chu atanlhah ahibouve.
English: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

tcz: Ajeh chu baptize nachanuva chu Christa toh kivuitha nahi tauve. Chule nanghon Christa kaithoupa Pathen thahat chu natahsan jaluva Amatoh hinkho thah a kaithouva uma nahi tauve.
en: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
text:
COL 2:12
Thadou: Ajeh chu baptize nachanuva chu Christa toh kivuitha nahi tauve. Chule nanghon Christa kaithoupa Pathen thahat chu natahsan jaluva Amatoh hinkho thah a kaithouva uma nahi tauve.
English: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

tcz: Nachonset nau le chonsetnom naho chu paidoh a um ahiloulai jeh a nangho athia nanahiu ahi. Pathen in ichonsetnau angaidam tahjeh a Christa to eihin khomsah u ahitai.
en: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
text:
COL 2:13
Thadou: Nachonset nau le chonsetnom naho chu paidoh a um ahiloulai jeh a nangho athia nanahiu ahi. Pathen in ichonsetnau angaidam tahjeh a Christa to eihin khomsah u ahitai.
English: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

tcz: Aman eiho dounaa themmo chansahna bat lekhabua kijih chu akah a, chule thingpel'a akhetbeh tah jeh a alahmang ahitai.
en: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
text:
COL 2:14
Thadou: Aman eiho dounaa themmo chansahna bat lekhabua kijih chu akah a, chule thingpel'a akhetbeh tah jeh a alahmang ahitai.
English: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

tcz: Hiti chun aman lhagao lama vaipohole thuneiho chu athaneinau alahpeh a, thingpel'a agaljona jal'a chu amaho chu lhangphonga maimoh-a alha ahitai.
en: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
text:
COL 2:15
Thadou: Hiti chun aman lhagao lama vaipohole thuneiho chu athaneinau alahpeh a, thingpel'a agaljona jal'a chu amaho chu lhangphonga maimoh-a alha ahitai.
English: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

tcz: Hijehchun nangho naneh u ahiloule nadonu ahiloule nikho khat achoma nitloujeh ahiloule lhathah nikho nit ahilouleh choldo nikho thua koiman na-oimo dauhen.
en: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
text:
COL 2:16
Thadou: Hijehchun nangho naneh u ahiloule nadonu ahiloule nikho khat achoma nitloujeh ahiloule lhathah nikho nit ahilouleh choldo nikho thua koiman na-oimo dauhen.
English: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh cheho chu atahbeh hunglhung ding vetsahna ho ahibouvin, hinla Christa chu atahbeh a hung hitai.
en: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
text:
COL 2:17
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh cheho chu atahbeh hunglhung ding vetsahna ho ahibouvin, hinla Christa chu atahbeh a hung hitai.
English: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

tcz: Koima kineosah lhema le vantil ho houna thua kipui mangsah hih un. Hitobang mi chu athilmu u thudol akip akoiyin aseiyun, amaho chun lhagao lam lunggel aneipouvin, tahsaa thaset lunggelin ahoithosah uvin,
en: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
text:
COL 2:18
Thadou: Koima kineosah lhema le vantil ho houna thua kipui mangsah hih un. Hitobang mi chu athilmu u thudol akip akoiyin aseiyun, amaho chun lhagao lam lunggel aneipouvin, tahsaa thaset lunggelin ahoithosah uvin,
English: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

tcz: Amaho chu aluchang Christa to kijopmatlou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Aman tipumpia agu kisuhtona le kikilmat tona chu akhut a aloikhoma Pathen in akhansah dungjuiya aumsah ahi.
en: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
text:
COL 2:19
Thadou: Amaho chu aluchang Christa to kijopmatlou ahiuve. Ajeh chu Aman tipumpia agu kisuhtona le kikilmat tona chu akhut a aloikhoma Pathen in akhansah dungjuiya aumsah ahi.
English: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

tcz: Nangho Christa to thithaa nahitah uleh, hiche vannoi lhagao thaneinaa kona nachamlhatsah u ahitai. Chuti ahileh ipi itia vannoiya hingnalai banga chu vannoi chonna dan kihilna,
en: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
text:
COL 2:20
Thadou: Nangho Christa to thithaa nahitah uleh, hiche vannoi lhagao thaneinaa kona nachamlhatsah u ahitai. Chuti ahileh ipi itia vannoiya hingnalai banga chu vannoi chonna dan kihilna,
English: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

tcz: Tham hih in, tep hih in, tuh hih in kitiho najui nahlaiyu hintem?
en: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
text:
COL 2:21
Thadou: Tham hih in, tep hih in, tuh hih in kitiho najui nahlaiyu hintem?
English: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

tcz: Hiche kipuina dan hohi mihem thupeh le thuhil ahin, ahung kimanchah toh lhon a mangthai ding thil ahibouve.
en: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
text:
COL 2:22
Thadou: Hiche kipuina dan hohi mihem thupeh le thuhil ahin, ahung kimanchah toh lhon a mangthai ding thil ahibouve.
English: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

tcz: Hiche chonnadan kijuihohi chihtoh a ahi, hichehoa hin eimatah lungchama hou, eima tah kingaitoma kingainemna chule tahsa kithununna angaiyin ahi. Hinla hicheho hin mikhat lung ngaichat phalou jona apechompoi.
en: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
text:
COL 2:23
Thadou: Hiche chonnadan kijuihohi chihtoh a ahi, hichehoa hin eimatah lungchama hou, eima tah kingaitoma kingainemna chule tahsa kithununna angaiyin ahi. Hinla hicheho hin mikhat lung ngaichat phalou jona apechompoi.
English: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

tcz: Nangho Christa toh hingkhoma nahiuleh, Pathen jetlam'a touva Christa umna chunglam chu veuvin.
en: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
text:
COL 3:1
Thadou: Nangho Christa toh hingkhoma nahiuleh, Pathen jetlam'a touva Christa umna chunglam chu veuvin.
English: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

tcz: Nanghon leiset thil ho geljo louvin, chunglam thilho geljo uvin.
en: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
text:
COL 3:2
Thadou: Nanghon leiset thil ho geljo louvin, chunglam thilho geljo uvin.
English: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho hiche hinkhoa dia athia nahi tauvin, nahinnau atahbeh chu Pathen a Christa toh kisela ahi.
en: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
text:
COL 3:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho hiche hinkhoa dia athia nahi tauvin, nahinnau atahbeh chu Pathen a Christa toh kisela ahi.
English: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

tcz: I-hinnau Christa ahung kilah phatteng nangho jong Amatoh loupia kilangkhom ding nahiuve.
en: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
text:
COL 3:4
Thadou: I-hinnau Christa ahung kilah phatteng nangho jong Amatoh loupia kilangkhom ding nahiuve.
English: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun, leiset chunga natibah chengu: jon lungput, thenlouna, huh lungput, lungdihlou ken, chule kiloset hichehohi milim houna ahin, abonchan thisah sohkeiyun.
en: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.
text:
COL 3:5
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun, leiset chunga natibah chengu: jon lungput, thenlouna, huh lungput, lungdihlou ken, chule kiloset hichehohi milim houna ahin, abonchan thisah sohkeiyun.
English: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

tcz: Hiche chonsetna ho jeh hin thua nunglouho chungah Pathen lunghanna chun alhun khumjin ahi.
en: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
text:
COL 3:6
Thadou: Hiche chonsetna ho jeh hin thua nunglouho chungah Pathen lunghanna chun alhun khumjin ahi.
English: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

tcz: Hicheho hi vannoiya dinga nanahinlai uva chu anaboljia nahiuve.
en: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,
text:
COL 3:7
Thadou: Hicheho hi vannoiya dinga nanahinlai uva chu anaboljia nahiuve.
English: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

tcz: Hinlah tuhin: lunghan, lungsat miduhabol, Pathen taitom, thuthanghoi seina kam, hichengho hi pailhauvin.
en: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
text:
COL 3:8
Thadou: Hinlah tuhin: lunghan, lungsat miduhabol, Pathen taitom, thuthanghoi seina kam, hichengho hi pailhauvin.
English: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

tcz: Khatle khat jouvin kiheh hih un, ajeh chu nanghon milui hinkho le anatoh chu napaiyu ahitai.
en: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
text:
COL 3:9
Thadou: Khatle khat jouvin kiheh hih un, ajeh chu nanghon milui hinkho le anatoh chu napaiyu ahitai.
English: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

tcz: Nanghon nasempau nahet nau lungthim chu panun chule mithah chu kivonun chule Ama tobang hiuvin.
en: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
text:
COL 3:10
Thadou: Nanghon nasempau nahet nau lungthim chu panun chule mithah chu kivonun chule Ama tobang hiuvin.
English: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

tcz: Hiche hinkhothah a hin hi Juda mi nahiha, chidang namdang nahim? Cheptanmi nahiha, cheptanlou nahim? Lekha helou akhangtou loulai soh chu nahiha, ongthol nahim? Christa chu eiho dinga ima jousea ininglhinnau ahitai.
en: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.
text:
COL 3:11
Thadou: Hiche hinkhothah a hin hi Juda mi nahiha, chidang namdang nahim? Cheptanmi nahiha, cheptanlou nahim? Lekha helou akhangtou loulai soh chu nahiha, ongthol nahim? Christa chu eiho dinga ima jousea ininglhinnau ahitai.
English: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

tcz: Hiche jeh chun Pathen lhenchom mithengte deiumtah angailut namthenga lhendoh nahitah jeh uvin–mikhotona lunggel, mihepi, kineosah, nunnemna lungthim, thohhatna in kivonun.
en: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

tcz: Khatle khat kidemdaito cheh un, kingaidam tona neiyun, akina khattou auma ahijongleh Christa chun nangaidam banguvin nanghon jong ngaidam'un.
en: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
text:
COL 3:13
Thadou: Khatle khat kidemdaito cheh un, kingaidam tona neiyun, akina khattou auma ahijongleh Christa chun nangaidam banguvin nanghon jong ngaidam'un.
English: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

tcz: Hicheng jouse chunga hin ngailutna chu kivonun, hichu kikankhomna phachamkim pen ahi.
en: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
text:
COL 3:14
Thadou: Hicheng jouse chunga hin ngailutna chu kivonun, hichu kikankhomna phachamkim pen ahi.
English: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

tcz: Chule Pathena cham lungmon chu nalunguva vaihomsah un, hichea dinga chu nangho jong tipum khat'a chamlen dinga kou nahiuvin chule thangvah jingun.
en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
text:
COL 3:15
Thadou: Chule Pathena cham lungmon chu nalunguva vaihomsah un, hichea dinga chu nangho jong tipum khat'a chamlen dinga kou nahiuvin chule thangvah jingun.
English: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

tcz: Christa thu chu chihna jouse tothon nasung uva cheng dimset hen; khat le khat tumgingtoh tholan houlan, chule lhagaolan kihilun chule kitilkhou touvin, nalung gil un Pakai choi-atnan lasauvin.
en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
text:
COL 3:16
Thadou: Christa thu chu chihna jouse tothon nasung uva cheng dimset hen; khat le khat tumgingtoh tholan houlan, chule lhagaolan kihilun chule kitilkhou touvin, nalung gil un Pakai choi-atnan lasauvin.
English: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

tcz: Chule thua hihen, natoh a hita jongleh, nabol jouseu chu Pakai Yeshua minin bolun lang, Ama jal'in Pa le Pathen chu thangvah un.
en: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.
text:
COL 3:17
Thadou: Chule thua hihen, natoh a hita jongleh, nabol jouseu chu Pakai Yeshua minin bolun lang, Ama jal'in Pa le Pathen chu thangvah un.
English: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

tcz: Ji numeiho, Pakai mitmua dih ahina jal in najipa teu thunoiya kipelut un.
en: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
text:
COL 3:18
Thadou: Ji numeiho, Pakai mitmua dih ahina jal in najipa teu thunoiya kipelut un.
English: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

tcz: Pateho, najinu teu ngailu uvin chule amaho chunga lunghimona neihih un.
en: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
text:
COL 3:19
Thadou: Pateho, najinu teu ngailu uvin chule amaho chunga lunghimona neihih un.
English: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

tcz: Chateho, imalam jousea nanule napateu sei thun nungun, hichu Pakai lunglhainapen ahi.
en: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
text:
COL 3:20
Thadou: Chateho, imalam jousea nanule napateu sei thun nungun, hichu Pakai lunglhainapen ahi.
English: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

tcz: Pateho, nachateu chu sulungphamo hih un, lunglhahnan neiget uvinte.
en: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
text:
COL 3:21
Thadou: Pateho, nachateu chu sulungphamo hih un, lunglhahnan neiget uvinte.
English: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

tcz: Sohteho, tahsalam hina dungjuiyin napakai teu seithua nungun, mihem lunglhaisahna a mitmu soh hilouvin, Pathen ging hinan lungdihpun umun.
en: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
text:
COL 3:22
Thadou: Sohteho, tahsalam hina dungjuiyin napakai teu seithua nungun, mihem lunglhaisahna a mitmu soh hilouvin, Pathen ging hinan lungdihpun umun.
English: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

tcz: Chule ipi hileh nabol'u chu Pakaiya lunggilin bolun, mitmu soh hilouvin Pakai jal abol hiuvin.
en: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
text:
COL 3:23
Thadou: Chule ipi hileh nabol'u chu Pakaiya lunggilin bolun, mitmu soh hilouvin Pakai jal abol hiuvin.
English: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

tcz: Pakaiya goulo ding tohman nachan dingu ahi chu heuvin: ajeh chu nangho Pakai Christa kinbol nahiu ahi.
en: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
text:
COL 3:24
Thadou: Pakaiya goulo ding tohman nachan dingu ahi chu heuvin: ajeh chu nangho Pakai Christa kinbol nahiu ahi.
English: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

tcz: Ahin thilse bola chu nahileh nathilse bol chu nakimu ding ahi. Hichea hin maipha vetna aumpoi.
en: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
text:
COL 3:25
Thadou: Ahin thilse bola chu nahileh nathilse bol chu nakimu ding ahi. Hichea hin maipha vetna aumpoi.
English: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

tcz: Pipua pang ho nanghon jong vana APipu khat naneiyu geldoh uvin lang nalhachahou chunga adih le ahoi bol hiuvin.
en: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
text:
COL 4:1
Thadou: Pipua pang ho nanghon jong vana APipu khat naneiyu geldoh uvin lang nalhachahou chunga adih le ahoi bol hiuvin.
English: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

tcz: Nangho taonaa ponpan tothon lunglimgeh in umun, chule thangvahna lunggel neijun.
en: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
text:
COL 4:2
Thadou: Nangho taonaa ponpan tothon lunglimgeh in umun, chule thangvahna lunggel neijun.
English: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

tcz: Pathen in keihoa Christa a athuguh alunggon chu aphondoh theina dingin, keiho dingin taovun. Hiche jeh a hi keima thihkhauva eikihen ah ahi.
en: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
text:
COL 4:3
Thadou: Pathen in keihoa Christa a athuguh alunggon chu aphondoh theina dingin, keiho dingin taovun. Hiche jeh a hi keima thihkhauva eikihen ah ahi.
English: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

tcz: Keiman hiche thupeh hi kicheh tah a kaseiphong theina dingin neitao peh un.
en: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
text:
COL 4:4
Thadou: Keiman hiche thupeh hi kicheh tah a kaseiphong theina dingin neitao peh un.
English: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

tcz: Tahsan neilouho lah a chun chingtheitah in hinkho mangun, chule phat kijen pat chu aphachom pen din mang un.
en: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
text:
COL 4:5
Thadou: Tahsan neilouho lah a chun chingtheitah in hinkho mangun, chule phat kijen pat chu aphachom pen din mang un.
English: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

tcz: Nanghon amitakip dinga donbutna dihtah nanei theina dingun, na kihoulim nau chu lungsetna thucheng le lahthei ding cheh hihen.
en: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
text:
COL 4:6
Thadou: Nanghon amitakip dinga donbutna dihtah nanei theina dingun, na kihoulim nau chu lungsetna thucheng le lahthei ding cheh hihen.
English: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

tcz: Pakaiya sopi deitah, lhacha natohna a tahsan umtah chule lhachana katohkhompi Tychicus hin kaumchan thudol abonchan nangho hinseipeh nauvinte.
en: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
text:
COL 4:7
Thadou: Pakaiya sopi deitah, lhacha natohna a tahsan umtah chule lhachana katohkhompi Tychicus hin kaumchan thudol abonchan nangho hinseipeh nauvinte.
English: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

tcz: Keiman amaa kona nachung changthu u chu kahetchentheina dinga chule amahin nalungu amonsah theina dingin nahenguva kahinsoltai.
en: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
text:
COL 4:8
Thadou: Keiman amaa kona nachung changthu u chu kahetchentheina dinga chule amahin nalungu amonsah theina dingin nahenguva kahinsoltai.
English: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

tcz: Chule amatoh kilhondin amin Onesimus, nalahuva tahsan umtah le sopi deitah toh'in nang ho heng lama kahinsol thauve. Amani hin hikoma nakitong thudol ijakai hetsah lhon nauvinate.
en: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
text:
COL 4:9
Thadou: Chule amatoh kilhondin amin Onesimus, nalahuva tahsan umtah le sopi deitah toh'in nang ho heng lama kahinsol thauve. Amani hin hikoma nakitong thudol ijakai hetsah lhon nauvinate.
English: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

tcz: Songkul kalut chankhompi Aristarchus in salam napeuve, chule Barnabas sopinu chapa Mark in jong salam napeuve (Mark hi nahenguva ahunga ahileh anasangun tia achungchang thua thupeh namusau ahitai).
en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
text:
COL 4:10
Thadou: Songkul kalut chankhompi Aristarchus in salam napeuve, chule Barnabas sopinu chapa Mark in jong salam napeuve (Mark hi nahenguva ahunga ahileh anasangun tia achungchang thua thupeh namusau ahitai).
English: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

tcz: Chule Yeshua (Justus kitipa chu) jong hin salam napeuve. Hichengho chengse bou hi cheptan holah a kona Pathen Lenggam chalsahna dinga katohkhompiho ahiuvin, amaho hi keima dinga monpi umtah ahiuve.
en: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
text:
COL 4:11
Thadou: Chule Yeshua (Justus kitipa chu) jong hin salam napeuve. Hichengho chengse bou hi cheptan holah a kona Pathen Lenggam chalsahna dinga katohkhompiho ahiuvin, amaho hi keima dinga monpi umtah ahiuve.
English: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

tcz: Yeshua Christa lhacha le nakiloi khompiu Epaphras in salam napeuve. Nanghon Pathen lunglam najui bukimkei uva chule nachamkimna dinguva ama nangho dinga gunchua taojing jenga ahi.
en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
text:
COL 4:12
Thadou: Yeshua Christa lhacha le nakiloi khompiu Epaphras in salam napeuve. Nanghon Pathen lunglam najui bukimkei uva chule nachamkimna dinguva ama nangho dinga gunchua taojing jenga ahi.
English: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

tcz: Ajeh chu keiman amahi-nangho dinga, Laodicea umho le Hierapolis a umho chengse dinga taonaa gunchu lheh jenga ahi, ti kahettohsah ahi.
en: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
text:
COL 4:13
Thadou: Ajeh chu keiman amahi-nangho dinga, Laodicea umho le Hierapolis a umho chengse dinga taonaa gunchu lheh jenga ahi, ti kahettohsah ahi.
English: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

tcz: Louthem deiumtah Luke le Demas teni hin salam napeuve.
en: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
text:
COL 4:14
Thadou: Louthem deiumtah Luke le Demas teni hin salam napeuve.
English: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

tcz: Laodicea khopia um sopite ho le Nymphas chule a-in'a um houbung miho salam anapeuvin.
en: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
text:
COL 4:15
Thadou: Laodicea khopia um sopite ho le Nymphas chule a-in'a um houbung miho salam anapeuvin.
English: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

tcz: Chule nanghon hiche lekhathot hi nalah uva akisim jouteng, Laodicea houbung sunga jong sim theiding ngaito uvin; chule chutima chun Laodicea a lekhathot jong chu anasim teiyun.
en: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
text:
COL 4:16
Thadou: Chule nanghon hiche lekhathot hi nalah uva akisim jouteng, Laodicea houbung sunga jong sim theiding ngaito uvin; chule chutima chun Laodicea a lekhathot jong chu anasim teiyun.
English: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

tcz: Chule Archippus jah a chun, “Pakaiya kona nakisan akinbolna natohna hi chingtheiyin lang subulhit in” tihi seipeh in.
en: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
text:
COL 4:17
Thadou: Chule Archippus jah a chun, “Pakaiya kona nakisan akinbolna natohna hi chingtheiyin lang subulhit in” tihi seipeh in.
English: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

tcz: Hiche hi keima Paul'in kakhut a kasut salamna ahi. Nanghon thihkhaova kihen kahi geldoh un. Lungsetna in naumpiuhen. Amen
en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
text:
COL 4:18
Thadou: Hiche hi keima Paul'in kakhut a kasut salamna ahi. Nanghon thihkhaova kihen kahi geldoh un. Lungsetna in naumpiuhen. Amen
English: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Paul, Silas chule Timothy a kon ahi. Keihon Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa a hiho Thessalonica Houbung mite henga kahin thot nahiuve. Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
1TH 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Paul, Silas chule Timothy a kon ahi. Keihon Pa Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa a hiho Thessalonica Houbung mite henga kahin thot nahiuve. Pathen chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeu hen.
English: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Keihon nangho jouse jal'in Pathen kathangvah jingun chule nangho dingin kataojom jinguvin ahi.
en: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
text:
1TH 1:2
Thadou: Keihon nangho jouse jal'in Pathen kathangvah jingun chule nangho dingin kataojom jinguvin ahi.
English: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

tcz: Keihon Pa le IPathen un nangho chung thua kataonauva, tahsan umtah'a natoh nau, ngailutna neiya nathil bol hou chule IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal a thoh hattah'a kinepna naneiyu chu kageldoh ui.
en: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
text:
1TH 1:3
Thadou: Keihon Pa le IPathen un nangho chung thua kataonauva, tahsan umtah'a natoh nau, ngailutna neiya nathil bol hou chule IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa jal a thoh hattah'a kinepna naneiyu chu kageldoh ui.
English: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, Pathen in nangailu uvin chule Pathen in Amite hidingin nalhengdoh tauve, ti kaheuve.
en: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
text:
1TH 1:4
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, Pathen in nangailu uvin chule Pathen in Amite hidingin nalhengdoh tauve, ti kaheuve.
English: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

tcz: Ajehchu keihon Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh u chu thucheng jengseh a hilouvin, thaneina to kilhon a Lhagao Thengin hetchetna lhingset napeh u ahitai tia keihon kaseiyu chu thutah ahi. Chule keihon nangho kagel khohnau nangho toka umkhom laiyun kahin danuvin nahe tauvin ahi.
en: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
text:
1TH 1:5
Thadou: Ajehchu keihon Kipana Thupha kahin pohpeh u chu thucheng jengseh a hilouvin, thaneina to kilhon a Lhagao Thengin hetchetna lhingset napeh u ahitai tia keihon kaseiyu chu thutah ahi. Chule keihon nangho kagel khohnau nangho toka umkhom laiyun kahin danuvin nahe tauvin ahi.
English: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

tcz: Hiti chun nanghon kathuseiyu chu nangho dinga hahsatna khohtah Lhagao Thenga konin kipah tah in nasangun ahi. Hiti chun nanghon keiho le Pakai umchan chu najom un ahi.
en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
text:
1TH 1:6
Thadou: Hiti chun nanghon kathuseiyu chu nangho dinga hahsatna khohtah Lhagao Thenga konin kipah tah in nasangun ahi. Hiti chun nanghon keiho le Pakai umchan chu najom un ahi.
English: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

tcz: Hitichun nang ho Greece a tahsan saho jouse-Macedonia le Achaia gam jousea vetjui thei nahung hitauve.
en: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
text:
1TH 1:7
Thadou: Hitichun nang ho Greece a tahsan saho jouse-Macedonia le Achaia gam jousea vetjui thei nahung hitauve.
English: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

tcz: Chule tun, Pakai thu chu Macedonia le Achaia gamkallam peh geiyin, hoilai mun hijongleh kachenau chan ah Pathen natahsannau thudol hi aseiyui. Keihon koima koma hithu chu kasei diu angaipoi.
en: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.
text:
1TH 1:8
Thadou: Chule tun, Pakai thu chu Macedonia le Achaia gamkallam peh geiyin, hoilai mun hijongleh kachenau chan ah Pathen natahsannau thudol hi aseiyui. Keihon koima koma hithu chu kasei diu angaipoi.
English: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not to say anything.

tcz: Ajehchu amahon phatah a eina lamtonau thudol aseiyun, chule nangho milim houna'a kona Pathen hing le dihtah kinbol dinga nalung naheiyu thudol aseijom jinguve.
en: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,
text:
1TH 1:9
Thadou: Ajehchu amahon phatah a eina lamtonau thudol aseiyun, chule nangho milim houna'a kona Pathen hing le dihtah kinbol dinga nalung naheiyu thudol aseijom jinguve.
English: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

tcz: Chule amaho chun Pathen Chapa–Pathen in athilah a kona akaithou Yeshua, vana kona ahung ding ngah jinga uma nahiu thudol aseiyun ahi. Ama hin ahunglhung ding thutanna kichat umtah'a kona eihuhdoh u ahi.
en: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
text:
1TH 1:10
Thadou: Chule amaho chun Pathen Chapa–Pathen in athilah a kona akaithou Yeshua, vana kona ahung ding ngah jinga uma nahiu thudol aseiyun ahi. Ama hin ahunglhung ding thutanna kichat umtah'a kona eihuhdoh u ahi.
English: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, nangho kahung vil uhi mohseh ahipoi ti nangho tah in naheuve.
en: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,
text:
1TH 2:1
Thadou: Kasopi deitahteho, nangho kahung vil uhi mohseh ahipoi ti nangho tah in naheuve.
English: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

tcz: Keiho nangho koma kahung masang jep uva Philippia ichan geiya gimbol hesohna katouvem ti nanghon naheuve. Hinama jongleh IPathen un Ama kipana Thupha chu ichan geiya doudalna aum vang'in, lung ngamtah a nangho koma kaseidoh thei nadiuvin hansanna eipeuve.
en: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.
text:
1TH 2:2
Thadou: Keiho nangho koma kahung masang jep uva Philippia ichan geiya gimbol hesohna katouvem ti nanghon naheuve. Hinama jongleh IPathen un Ama kipana Thupha chu ichan geiya doudalna aum vang'in, lung ngamtah a nangho koma kaseidoh thei nadiuvin hansanna eipeuve.
English: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

tcz: Hiti chun kathu seiphongu hi lheplhahna thu ahilouleh lungdihlou pua ahilouleh doha lheplhahna ima seina kanei pouve ti nanghon naheuve.
en: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.
text:
1TH 2:3
Thadou: Hiti chun kathu seiphongu hi lheplhahna thu ahilouleh lungdihlou pua ahilouleh doha lheplhahna ima seina kanei pouve ti nanghon naheuve.
English: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

tcz: Ajehchu keiho hin Pathen a kona photchetna neiya Kipana Thupha thusei lea panga kahiuve. Kalung gonu hi miho lunglhaina hollouva Pathen lunglhaina kahol joh u ahi. Ama bou chun kalung put u ipi ahi ahet ahi.
en: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.
text:
1TH 2:4
Thadou: Ajehchu keiho hin Pathen a kona photchetna neiya Kipana Thupha thusei lea panga kahiuve. Kalung gonu hi miho lunglhaina hollouva Pathen lunglhaina kahol joh u ahi. Ama bou chun kalung put u ipi ahi ahet ahi.
English: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

tcz: Nanghon nahet ngaima bangun keihon joulhep doha a nangho thunun kagopouve. Chule Pathen hi ijakai ahetoh a ahi, keihohi nasumu chanthei nadinga nangho toh jol le gol'a um'ah kahipouve!
en: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),
text:
1TH 2:5
Thadou: Nanghon nahet ngaima bangun keihon joulhep doha a nangho thunun kagopouve. Chule Pathen hi ijakai ahetoh a ahi, keihohi nasumu chanthei nadinga nangho toh jol le gol'a um'ah kahipouve!
English: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

tcz: Christa solchah kahiu hi mihem pachat channa dingin keihon nangho hihen midangho hijongleh, koima cha lung kahol pouve.
en: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.
text:
1TH 2:6
Thadou: Christa solchah kahiu hi mihem pachat channa dingin keihon nangho hihen midangho hijongleh, koima cha lung kahol pouve.
English: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

tcz: Christa solchahho hina jal a keihon nanghoa kona ngehna kanei theiyu ahi, hinla keiho nangho laha lung nengin kaum jouve ahilouleh keiho hi minun achate an apeh a avah a chule avetsui tobang kahiuve.
en: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.
text:
1TH 2:7
Thadou: Christa solchahho hina jal a keihon nanghoa kona ngehna kanei theiyu ahi, hinla keiho nangho laha lung nengin kaum jouve ahilouleh keiho hi minun achate an apeh a avah a chule avetsui tobang kahiuve.
English: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailut behseh jeh un nangho to Pathen Kipana Thupha seh seh a chan neikhom pi hilouvin, kahin nau jong nangho dinga kaphal ngamu ahi.
en: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.
text:
1TH 2:8
Thadou: Keihon nangho kangailut behseh jeh un nangho to Pathen Kipana Thupha seh seh a chan neikhom pi hilouvin, kahin nau jong nangho dinga kaphal ngamu ahi.
English: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, nalahuva ichan geiya katoh gimu hitam ti hi geldoh lou nahiuvem? Nahenguva Pathen Kipana Thupha seiphong na dinga, nangho pohgih pohsah kanop lou jeh un, sun le jan'in na katong gim un ahi.
en: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.
text:
1TH 2:9
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, nalahuva ichan geiya katoh gimu hitam ti hi geldoh lou nahiuvem? Nahenguva Pathen Kipana Thupha seiphong na dinga, nangho pohgih pohsah kanop lou jeh un, sun le jan'in na katong gim un ahi.
English: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

tcz: Nangho tah keiho hettohsah nahiuve–chule Pathen jong chuti ahi-keiho hi nangho atahsan ho jouse a dinga kipumpeh a, lungdih pua chule themmona neilou kahiuve.
en: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
text:
1TH 2:10
Thadou: Nangho tah keiho hettohsah nahiuve–chule Pathen jong chuti ahi-keiho hi nangho atahsan ho jouse a dinga kipumpeh a, lungdih pua chule themmona neilou kahiuve.
English: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

tcz: Chule keihon nangho khat khatcheh hi Pan achate abolna bangtah a kabol'u nahi.
en: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,
text:
1TH 2:11
Thadou: Chule keihon nangho khat khatcheh hi Pan achate abolna bangtah a kabol'u nahi.
English: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

tcz: Keihon nangho kangeh uva, katilkhou uva chule katem nau chu nangho Pathena dinga lomtah a nachonna dingu kati ahi. Ajeh chu aman aLenggam le aloupina a chan nei dinga nakouvu ahi.
en: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.
text:
1TH 2:12
Thadou: Keihon nangho kangeh uva, katilkhou uva chule katem nau chu nangho Pathena dinga lomtah a nachonna dingu kati ahi. Ajeh chu aman aLenggam le aloupina a chan nei dinga nakouvu ahi.
English: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

tcz: Hichejeh chun, keihon Pathen thangvahna kangadeh pouve, ajeh chu nanghon keihoa kona thu chu nasanu chun, kathuseiyu chu moh mihem thuseiyin nalapouve. Nanghon kathupoh uchu Pathena kon ahi tin nasanguve–hichu hijong hiyah ahi. Chule hiche thuhin nangho tahsan neihoa na atoh jom ahi.
en: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
text:
1TH 2:13
Thadou: Hichejeh chun, keihon Pathen thangvahna kangadeh pouve, ajeh chu nanghon keihoa kona thu chu nasanu chun, kathuseiyu chu moh mihem thuseiyin nalapouve. Nanghon kathupoh uchu Pathena kon ahi tin nasanguve–hichu hijong hiyah ahi. Chule hiche thuhin nangho tahsan neihoa na atoh jom ahi.
English: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.
