tcz: Chutima chun sopi deitahte, nanghon nagam miteuva kona gimbol hesohna nathoh u ahi. Hitia hi, nanghon Judea gam'a Pathen houbung ho umchan najomu ahi, amaho chun Christa Yeshua atahsan jeh uva, amiteu Judah ho khut a gimbol hesoh athoh u anahi.
en: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews
text:
1TH 2:14
Thadou: Chutima chun sopi deitahte, nanghon nagam miteuva kona gimbol hesohna nathoh u ahi. Hitia hi, nanghon Judea gam'a Pathen houbung ho umchan najomu ahi, amaho chun Christa Yeshua atahsan jeh uva, amiteu Judah ho khut a gimbol hesoh athoh u anahi.
English: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

tcz: Ajeh chu Juda ho lah a phabep chun themgao ho anathat un, chule phabep chun Pakai Yeshua jeng jong chu athau anahi. Tun amahon keiho jeng jong eibol hesoh uve. Ama hon Pathen alunglhai pouvin chule mi jouse to kikala natong ahiuve.
en: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,
text:
1TH 2:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu Juda ho lah a phabep chun themgao ho anathat un, chule phabep chun Pakai Yeshua jeng jong chu athau anahi. Tun amahon keiho jeng jong eibol hesoh uve. Ama hon Pathen alunglhai pouvin chule mi jouse to kikala natong ahiuve.
English: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

tcz: Amahon chidang namdang ho lah a huhhingna Kipana Thupha kaseiphong le diu eijada gouve.
en: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.
text:
1TH 2:16
Thadou: Amahon chidang namdang ho lah a huhhingna Kipana Thupha kaseiphong le diu eijada gouve.
English: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, phat chomkhat a dinga nangho to eiki chomkhen jouvin (kalungun vang nangho nadalha dehpouve), kajo chanun hungkit kagouve, ajeh chu keihon nangho kamukit nom lheh jengu ahi.
en: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,
text:
1TH 2:17
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, phat chomkhat a dinga nangho to eiki chomkhen jouvin (kalungun vang nangho nadalha dehpouve), kajo chanun hungkit kagouve, ajeh chu keihon nangho kamukit nom lheh jengu ahi.
English: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

tcz: Keiho kihambol tah in nangho kom kahung nomun, chule keima Paul jong avelvelin kahung gon, hinla Satan in eisuboijiuve.
en: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.
text:
1TH 2:18
Thadou: Keiho kihambol tah in nangho kom kahung nomun, chule keima Paul jong avelvelin kahung gon, hinla Satan in eisuboijiuve.
English: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua ahung kilekit nikhoa a-anga idin tengu leh ipia kinepna le ipin eikipasah uva, chule ipi chu kachandiu tohman le lallukhuh hiding hitam? Hichu nangho nahiuve!
en: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?
text:
1TH 2:19
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua ahung kilekit nikhoa a-anga idin tengu leh ipia kinepna le ipin eikipasah uva, chule ipi chu kachandiu tohman le lallukhuh hiding hitam? Hichu nangho nahiuve!
English: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

tcz: Henge, nangho keiho kisonpi le kipana nahiuve.
en: For you are our glory and our joy.
text:
1TH 2:20
Thadou: Henge, nangho keiho kisonpi le kipana nahiuve.
English: For you are our glory and our joy.

tcz: Kanan joulou helu ahung hi phat in, keima ho chang Athens a umden dingin kakigel lhatauve.
en: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,
text:
1TH 3:1
Thadou: Kanan joulou helu ahung hi phat in, keima ho chang Athens a umden dingin kakigel lhatauve.
English: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

tcz: Chule Timothy hi nang ho vil ding in kahinsol tauve. Ama hi isopiu le Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong naa Pathen na katoh khompiu ahiye. Aman nang ho nahatsah uva, natahsan nauva natil khouna dinguva kahinsolu ahi.
en: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,
text:
1TH 3:2
Thadou: Chule Timothy hi nang ho vil ding in kahinsol tauve. Ama hi isopiu le Christa Kipana Thupha seiphong naa Pathen na katoh khompiu ahiye. Aman nang ho nahatsah uva, natahsan nauva natil khouna dinguva kahinsolu ahi.
English: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

tcz: Chule nanghon hahsatna nato chung changuva chu lung olmo tah a naum louna dinguva navetup dinguva ama kahinsolu ahi. Keiho vang hiti hahsatna ho toh mong dinga eikigonguva ahi ti naheuve.
en: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.
text:
1TH 3:3
Thadou: Chule nanghon hahsatna nato chung changuva chu lung olmo tah a naum louna dinguva navetup dinguva ama kahinsolu ahi. Keiho vang hiti hahsatna ho toh mong dinga eikigonguva ahi ti naheuve.
English: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

tcz: Keihon kaumpipet jenguva jong hahsatna hung lhungloi jeng thei ahi tia kahilchah nau chu, nahet banguvin, amahon ahinboldoh jeng tauve.
en: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.
text:
1TH 3:4
Thadou: Keihon kaumpipet jenguva jong hahsatna hung lhungloi jeng thei ahi tia kahilchah nau chu, nahet banguvin, amahon ahinboldoh jeng tauve.
English: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh a, kathoh joulou phata, natahsan nau det jinga hinam ti kaphotchet nomjeh a Timothy kahinsol anahi. Achuti louleh alhempa chun nanghoa aphapen chu akilahdoh a chule kanatohnau hi mohseh bep hitam tia tija'a um kanahi ahi.
en: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.
text:
1TH 3:5
Thadou: Hiti chu ahijeh a, kathoh joulou phata, natahsan nau det jinga hinam ti kaphotchet nomjeh a Timothy kahinsol anahi. Achuti louleh alhempa chun nanghoa aphapen chu akilahdoh a chule kanatohnau hi mohseh bep hitam tia tija'a um kanahi ahi.
English: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

tcz: Hinlah tun Timothy ahung lhungin, nangho tahsan le ngailut thu ahung lhuttai. Amahin keihon kahung vilnau thudol chu kipahtah in nageldoh jingun chule keihon nangho kamunom tobangun nanghon jong neimu nomuve ti thulhut aneiye.
en: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.
text:
1TH 3:6

tcz: Hitihin kasopi deitahte, nangho tahsannaa nahat jing jaluvin, keihon hahsatna le gimbolna kathoh laitah jenguvin jong hatah in nei tilkhouvun ahi.
en: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.
text:
1TH 3:7

1TH 3:8

1TH 3:10

English: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun nahenguva eihin puiloi jeng tauhen.
en: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.
text:
1TH 3:11

English: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

tcz: Keihon nangho kangailutnau alon letset tobang'in, Pakaiyin nangho khatle khat kingailutna le mijouse ngailutna chu khansah hen chule longlet doh hen.
en: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,
text:
1TH 3:12

English: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

tcz: Hichea kon hin, nangho I-Pakaiyu Yeshua amithengte jouse toh ahungkit niteng, I-Pau Pathen angsunga nadin tenguleh, aman nalungu hatsah hen, nolna beiyin koihen chule athengin hinkoi hen. Amen.
en: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
text:
1TH 3:13
Thadou: Hichea kon hin, nangho I-Pakaiyu Yeshua amithengte jouse toh ahungkit niteng, I-Pau Pathen angsunga nadin tenguleh, aman nalungu hatsah hen, nolna beiyin koihen chule athengin hinkoi hen. Amen.

tcz: Achainakeiyin sopi deitahte, Pakai Yeshua mina kahintem nom nau chu kanahil tobanguvin Pathen lunglhainna hinkho mangun. Nangho hitia hi nana kiman chahsau ahi bangin tua jong nahabol cheh dinguvin kahin tilkhou uve.
en: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.
text:
1TH 4:1
Thadou: Achainakeiyin sopi deitahte, Pakai Yeshua mina kahintem nom nau chu kanahil tobanguvin Pathen lunglhainna hinkho mangun. Nangho hitia hi nana kiman chahsau ahi bangin tua jong nahabol cheh dinguvin kahin tilkhou uve.

tcz: Ajehchu keihon nangho Pakai Yeshua thuneina'a ipi kahilu nageldoh uve.
en: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
text:
1TH 4:2
Thadou: Ajehchu keihon nangho Pakai Yeshua thuneina'a ipi kahilu nageldoh uve.
English: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

tcz: Pathen in nangho dinga alung gon chu nathenuva, jonthanhoiya kona nakikangse dingu hi ahi.
en: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
text:
1TH 4:3
Thadou: Pathen in nangho dinga alung gon chu nathenuva, jonthanhoiya kona nakikangse dingu hi ahi.
English: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

tcz: Chutah le nangho khatcheh hin atahsa kivettup nahiuva chule thenna le jathei hinkho naman dingu hi ahi.
en: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,
text:
1TH 4:4
Thadou: Chutah le nangho khatcheh hin atahsa kivettup nahiuva chule thenna le jathei hinkho naman dingu hi ahi.
English: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

tcz: Nanghon Pathen le alamlhah umdan hephalou milim houna neiho bangin jon lung puhih un.
en: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,
text:
1TH 4:5
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen le alamlhah umdan hephalou milim houna neiho bangin jon lung puhih un.
English: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

tcz: Hiche thudol ahin, Christian sopi khat chun ajinu engbolna ahilouleh dohabolna alamlouvin neihih un, ajeh chu khohtah amasanga kagihji nau bang chun Pakaiyin hitia chonseho chu alethuh ji.
en: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.
text:
1TH 4:6
Thadou: Hiche thudol ahin, Christian sopi khat chun ajinu engbolna ahilouleh dohabolna alamlouvin neihih un, ajeh chu khohtah amasanga kagihji nau bang chun Pakaiyin hitia chonseho chu alethuh ji.
English: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in eikouvu hi thenlouna hinkho mang ding hilouvin, hinkho thenga hing ding ihijo bouvui.
en: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
text:
1TH 4:7
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in eikouvu hi thenlouna hinkho mang ding hilouvin, hinkho thenga hing ding ihijo bouvui.
English: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

tcz: Hijeh chun, koi hijongle hiche hoa chona dan juilou chu mihem thuhil juinom lou ahitapon, A Lhagao Theng eipeuva Pathen deilou jeh joh ahiye.
en: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
text:
1TH 4:8
Thadou: Hijeh chun, koi hijongle hiche hoa chona dan juilou chu mihem thuhil juinom lou ahitapon, A Lhagao Theng eipeuva Pathen deilou jeh joh ahiye.
English: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

tcz: Hinlah keihon nangho henga khatle khat kingailut ding thua kahin jih khoh u angaipoi, ajeh chu Pathen in khatle khat kingailu uvin tia nahilsau ahitai.
en: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,
text:
1TH 4:9
Thadou: Hinlah keihon nangho henga khatle khat kingailut ding thua kahin jih khoh u angaipoi, ajeh chu Pathen in khatle khat kingailu uvin tia nahilsau ahitai.

tcz: Tahbeh mongin, nanghon Macedonia pumpia tahsanho jouse nangailut nau navetsah sau ahitai. Hitima chun, sopite, amaho chu hatah a nangailut cheh diu kangeh nahiuve.
en: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

tcz: Masanga keihon nangho kana hilsa bangu chun, thip beh a hinkho manding gelkhoh uvin lang, natoh diu cheh kigelkhoh uvin chule nangma khutcheh a natonguvin.
en: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,
text:
1TH 4:11
Thadou: Masanga keihon nangho kana hilsa bangu chun, thip beh a hinkho manding gelkhoh uvin lang, natoh diu cheh kigelkhoh uvin chule nangma khutcheh a natonguvin.
English: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

tcz: Chutengleh Christian hilou hon nahinkho man dan'u chun najabol untin, chule midanga nakingaiyu ngailou ding ahitai.
en: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
text:
1TH 4:12

tcz: Chule tun sopi deitahte, nangho kinepna neilou miho tobanga lunghema naum louna dinguva Pakaiya thisa ho chung chang thudol nahet teiding'u kanom uvin ahi.
en: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.
text:
1TH 4:13

en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

1TH 4:14

tcz: Keihon hiche hi Pakaiya kona kalah u kaseiyu ahi: Pakai hungkile tengleh ahingnalai eiho hi anathisaho sanga Amato kimuto masajo ding ihipouve.
en: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.
text:
1TH 4:15
Thadou: Keihon hiche hi Pakaiya kona kalah u kaseiyu ahi: Pakai hungkile tengleh ahingnalai eiho hi anathisaho sanga Amato kimuto masajo ding ihipouve.

en: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

1TH 4:18

text:
1TH 5:6

English: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

tcz: Jan phat le miho ihmu jiuva chule judon hon ju adonkham jiu phat ahi.

text:
1TH 5:7
Thadou: Jan phat le miho ihmu jiuva chule judon hon ju adonkham jiu phat ahi.
English: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

1TH 5:8

text:
1TH 5:9

text:
1TH 5:10

1TH 5:11

text:
1TH 5:13

en: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
text:
1TH 5:14
Thadou: Sopite ho, kahin ngehnau chu mithase ho chu gihsal un. Akichaseho tilkhouvun. Atha lhasam ho phaten khohsah in vesuiyun. Amitakip chunga thoh hat'un.
English: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

tcz: Koiman ase chu asea alethuh louna dingin vephauvin, chusangin khat in khat chunga chule mijouse chunga thilpha boljing ding gouvin.

text:
1TH 5:15

1TH 5:16

1TH 5:17

Thadou: Numei hohi pasalho chunga thunei dingleh thuhil dingin thu kapepoi, thipkhen chan thu ngaileu kati.
English: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in Adam asem masan chujouvin Eve asemin ahi.
en: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
text:
1TI 2:13
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen in Adam asem masan chujouvin Eve asemin ahi.
English: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

tcz: Chuleh Satan in alheplhah chu Adam ahipon, numeinu joh chu ana lheplhah-a chonset hunglut ahi.
en: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

tcz: Ahinlah numeiho hi tahsannale ngailutna'a, thenna le chonnema aum jingleh achahin uva kona huhhing'a umding ahiuve.
en: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.
text:
1TI 2:15
Thadou: Ahinlah numeiho hi tahsannale ngailutna'a, thenna le chonnema aum jingleh achahin uva kona huhhing'a umding ahiuve.
English: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

tcz: Hiche hi tahsanthei ding doltah'a kisei ahi. “Khattouvin Houbung Upa hi ding natoh anopleh amachun ja umtah panmun adei ahi.”
en: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.
text:
1TI 3:1
Thadou: Hiche hi tahsanthei ding doltah'a kisei ahi. “Khattouvin Houbung Upa hi ding natoh anopleh amachun ja umtah panmun adei ahi.”
English: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

tcz: Hijehchun Houbung Upa ding chu ja umtah nolnabei hinkho mang hiding ahi. Aji ang'a kitah ding, ama le ama kitimjoumi hiding, chingthei tah a hing hiding, chule minphat na nei hiding ahi. Jindot them chule mihilthem hiding ahi.
en: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

tcz: Ama chu julopmi ahiloule agilou hilou ding ahi. Ama chu milungneng hiding, mitoh kinahat hilou ding, chule sum ngailu lou mi hiding ahi.
en: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

tcz: A-insung kipohtupjou mi, achaten ajathei le athua nunsah joumi hiding ahi.
en: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

tcz: Ajehchu a-insung akivettup joulouleh Pathen houbung chu iti avettup jouding ham?
en: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)
text:
1TI 3:5
Thadou: Ajehchu a-insung akivettup joulouleh Pathen houbung chu iti avettup jouding ham?
English: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

tcz: Houbung Upa ding chu tahsanthah hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu hung kiletsah intin Diabolin asuhlhuh ding ahi.
en: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
text:
1TI 3:6
Thadou: Houbung Upa ding chu tahsanthah hilou ding ahi, ajeh chu hung kiletsah intin Diabolin asuhlhuh ding ahi.
English: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

tcz: Chujong leh, pam a miho seiphat changmi hiding ahi, achuti louleh miseiset achanna-a kon chun Diabol thangkolah ohkhaget inte.
en: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
text:
1TI 3:7
Thadou: Chujong leh, pam a miho seiphat changmi hiding ahi, achuti louleh miseiset achanna-a kon chun Diabol thangkolah ohkhaget inte.
English: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

tcz: Chutobang ma chun deacon panmun loding ho jong chu ja-um mi chuleh kitahna neimi hiding, ju'a lopmi hilou ding, sum a kitahlou mi hilou ding ahi.
en: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
text:
1TI 3:8
Thadou: Chutobang ma chun deacon panmun loding ho jong chu ja-um mi chuleh kitahna neimi hiding, ju'a lopmi hilou ding, sum a kitahlou mi hilou ding ahi.
English: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

tcz: Tahsan thugil tua kiphongdoh thudol'a kipeh theng nanei, chule lungthengsel a hing mi hidiu ahi.
en: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
text:
1TI 3:9
Thadou: Tahsan thugil tua kiphongdoh thudol'a kipeh theng nanei, chule lungthengsel a hing mi hidiu ahi.
English: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

tcz: Amahohi Deacon a akipansah masanga hoitah a kholchil masat ding, alhin uva ahileh Deacon panmun a pang ding ahiuve.
en: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
text:
1TI 3:10
Thadou: Amahohi Deacon a akipansah masanga hoitah a kholchil masat ding, alhin uva ahileh Deacon panmun a pang ding ahiuve.
English: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

tcz: Hitobangma-a chu ajiteu jong ja um mi hiding, miseiset hat hilou ding, amale ama kitimjoumi hiding chuleh anatohna jousea jong kitahna neimi hiding ahiuve.
en: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
text:
1TI 3:11
Thadou: Hitobangma-a chu ajiteu jong ja um mi hiding, miseiset hat hilou ding, amale ama kitimjoumi hiding chuleh anatohna jousea jong kitahna neimi hiding ahiuve.
English: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

tcz: Deacon ho chu jikhat neimi hiding chuleh achateu leh a-insung kivetsuijou mi hiding,
en: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
text:
1TI 3:12
Thadou: Deacon ho chu jikhat neimi hiding chuleh achateu leh a-insung kivetsuijou mi hiding,
English: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

tcz: Deacon natohna a lolhingtah michun mipia kon a jana changdiu hichun Yeshua Christa atahsannau toh tahsan aumnau asuhpung ding ahi.
en: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
text:
1TI 3:13
Thadou: Deacon natohna a lolhingtah michun mipia kon a jana changdiu hichun Yeshua Christa atahsannau toh tahsan aumnau asuhpung ding ahi.
English: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Nakom u hunglhunvah ding kinepna kanei jing vang'in tun hiche hohi kahin sun e.
en: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,
text:
1TI 3:14
Thadou: Nakom u hunglhunvah ding kinepna kanei jing vang'in tun hiche hohi kahin sun e.
English: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

tcz: Ijemtia keima kahunggei khah leh Pathen insung mite iti chondiu ham ti nahettheina dinga kati ahi. Hiche hi hingjing Pathen houbung ahin, hichu thutah kingapna khombul ahi.
en: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
text:
1TI 3:15
Thadou: Ijemtia keima kahunggei khah leh Pathen insung mite iti chondiu ham ti nahettheina dinga kati ahi. Hiche hi hingjing Pathen houbung ahin, hichu thutah kingapna khombul ahi.
English: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

tcz: Kinelna beihel in, hiche hi itahsan nauthugil loupitah chu ahi. Christa chu mihem a hung kilanga Lhagaovin atahlanga vantil hon amuu ahi. Ama thuhi chitin namtin lah-a akiphong jal in vannoi miten atahsan un chuleh loupitah in van ah lahtouvin aumtai.
en: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
text:
1TI 3:16
Thadou: Kinelna beihel in, hiche hi itahsan nauthugil loupitah chu ahi. Christa chu mihem a hung kilanga Lhagaovin atahlanga vantil hon amuu ahi. Ama thuhi chitin namtin lah-a akiphong jal in vannoi miten atahsan un chuleh loupitah in van ah lahtouvin aumtai.
English: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

tcz: Tun Lhagao Thengin kichehtah-in eiseipeh-un, ni nunung teng mitamtah, tahsan dihtah-a kona pullha ding, amahon thilha hoa kona lhagao dihlouho thuhil ajui diu ahi.
en: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,
text:
1TI 4:1
Thadou: Tun Lhagao Thengin kichehtah-in eiseipeh-un, ni nunung teng mitamtah, tahsan dihtah-a kona pullha ding, amahon thilha hoa kona lhagao dihlouho thuhil ajui diu ahi.
English: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

tcz: Amaho chu thuhillhem chule mijouho ahiuvin, selepha ahetnau lungthim chu athisa ahi.
en: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,
text:
1TI 4:2
Thadou: Amaho chu thuhillhem chule mijouho ahiuvin, selepha ahetnau lungthim chu athisa ahi.
English: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

tcz: Amahon jinei hi adihpoi atiuvin chuleh thutah hea tahsanten thangvah taona puma aneh diuva Pathen in asemho chu nehding adihpoi atidiu ahi.
en: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
text:
1TI 4:3
Thadou: Amahon jinei hi adihpoi atiuvin chuleh thutah hea tahsanten thangvah taona puma aneh diuva Pathen in asemho chu nehding adihpoi atidiu ahi.
English: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thilsemho jouse hi thangvah taona puma ikisana ahileh aphamo umlou paidoh ding jong umlou ahi.
en: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.
text:
1TI 4:4
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen thilsemho jouse hi thangvah taona puma ikisana ahileh aphamo umlou paidoh ding jong umlou ahi.
English: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

tcz: Ajehchu hiche hi Pathen Thule taonaa santhei ding dol a kisuthenga ahiti iheuve.
en: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.
text:
1TI 4:5
Thadou: Ajehchu hiche hi Pathen Thule taonaa santhei ding dol a kisuthenga ahiti iheuve.
English: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

tcz: Timothy nangin hichehohi sopiho koma nasei chetpehleh nangma, tahsan thua kikhoukhah chule thuhilpha juiyah, Christa Yeshua lhacha lomtah nahi ding ahi.
en: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.
text:
1TI 4:6
Thadou: Timothy nangin hichehohi sopiho koma nasei chetpehleh nangma, tahsan thua kikhoukhah chule thuhilpha juiyah, Christa Yeshua lhacha lomtah nahi ding ahi.
English: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

tcz: Amavang Pathen deilou gollui thusimho le thuchavai ki houlimna hoa konin kidalsen lang Pathen dei hinkhoa kipuikhangna ah kipelutjon.
en: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
text:
1TI 4:7
Thadou: Amavang Pathen deilou gollui thusimho le thuchavai ki houlimna hoa konin kidalsen lang Pathen dei hinkhoa kipuikhangna ah kipelutjon.
English: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

tcz: Tahsalam phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphanai, ahinla Lhagaolam dol a phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphajoi, ajeh chu hichehin tuhinkhoa dingleh khonunga dinga phatchomna tah ahi chu thutep uma ahi.
en: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.
text:
1TI 4:8
Thadou: Tahsalam phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphanai, ahinla Lhagaolam dol a phatchomna dinga kimanchah hi aphajoi, ajeh chu hichehin tuhinkhoa dingleh khonunga dinga phatchomna tah ahi chu thutep uma ahi.
English: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

tcz: Hichehi tahsan theidol tah-a kisei ahin, mijousen asanding doltah ahi.
en: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.
text:
1TI 4:9
Thadou: Hichehi tahsan theidol tah-a kisei ahin, mijousen asanding doltah ahi.
English: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

tcz: Hiche ding jeh-a hi hatah a itoh-u ahin, tohjong itohjom jing dingu ahi, ajeh chu, mijouse huhhingpu ahidehset a tahsan chate Huhhingpu hingjing Pathena ikijopnau uma ahi.
en: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.
text:
1TI 4:10
Thadou: Hiche ding jeh-a hi hatah a itoh-u ahin, tohjong itohjom jing dingu ahi, ajeh chu, mijouse huhhingpu ahidehset a tahsan chate Huhhingpu hingjing Pathena ikijopnau uma ahi.
English: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

tcz: Hiche thu hohi hil inlang amaho chu hetthemsah teiding khohsah-in.
en: Command and teach these things.
text:
1TI 4:11
Thadou: Hiche thu hohi hil inlang amaho chu hetthemsah teiding khohsah-in.
English: Command and teach these things.

tcz: Nakhandonjeh hin mi nahsahmo theiyin umhih-in, amavang nathusei dan leh nahinkho mandan in, namingailutna-in, natahsan hinkho kimanchah danleh thenna hinkho naman danin atahsan ho vetjui theiyin um'in.
en: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
text:
1TI 4:12
Thadou: Nakhandonjeh hin mi nahsahmo theiyin umhih-in, amavang nathusei dan leh nahinkho mandan in, namingailutna-in, natahsan hinkho kimanchah danleh thenna hinkho naman danin atahsan ho vetjui theiyin um'in.
English: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

tcz: Keima kahung kahsen, Pathen Thu simna in, tahsan chate tilkhouna-in chuleh thuhillam in anaponthon.
en: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.
text:
1TI 4:13
Thadou: Keima kahung kahsen, Pathen Thu simna in, tahsan chate tilkhouna-in chuleh thuhillam in anaponthon.
English: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

tcz: Houbunga Pakai lhachaten nachunga khut angap uva nachungchang thua themgao thuphondoh naa kona Lhagao Thilpeh nachan chu nahsahmo hihbeh-in.
en: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
text:
1TI 4:14
Thadou: Houbunga Pakai lhachaten nachunga khut angap uva nachungchang thua themgao thuphondoh naa kona Lhagao Thilpeh nachan chu nahsahmo hihbeh-in.
English: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

tcz: Hichenga hin lungluttah-in pangin. Nakhantouna hi mijouse het a akilah dohtheina dingin nanatohna-a hin kipumpeh jingin.
en: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.
text:
1TI 4:15
Thadou: Hichenga hin lungluttah-in pangin. Nakhantouna hi mijouse het a akilah dohtheina dingin nanatohna-a hin kipumpeh jingin.
English: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

tcz: Nathuhil dungjui chun kimangchan, hichu chepi jingin chutileh Pathen in phatthei naboh ding chuleh nathuhil jahojong phatthei chang diu ahi.
en: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
text:
1TI 4:16
Thadou: Nathuhil dungjui chun kimangchan, hichu chepi jingin chutileh Pathen in phatthei naboh ding chuleh nathuhil jahojong phatthei chang diu ahi.
English: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

tcz: Upa tehseho chu phoh hih-in, napa tobang'in jana neitah'in jolthon, khangdong pasalho chu napenpi nasopitah tobang'in kihoupin,
en: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

tcz: Nupi tehseho chu nanu tobang'in gel inlang, nasanga dongjo numeiho chu napenpi nasopinu tobang'in lungthengtah-in kaihoiyin.
en: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.
text:
1TI 5:2
Thadou: Nupi tehseho chu nanu tobang'in gel inlang, nasanga dongjo numeiho chu napenpi nasopinu tobang'in lungthengtah-in kaihoiyin.
English: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

tcz: Ajending koimacha neilou meithai hochu jana neitah-in kaihoiyin,
en: Honor widows who are widows indeed.
text:
1TI 5:3
Thadou: Ajending koimacha neilou meithai hochu jana neitah-in kaihoiyin,
English: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

tcz: Ahinlah chate le tute nei ahiuleh amopohnau masapen chu a-insunga Pathen mikhotona apohdoh dingu, ahinguvah anule apateu phatna ngailutna-a alethuh diu ahi. Hichu Pathen lung lhaina ahi.
en: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.
text:
1TI 5:4
Thadou: Ahinlah chate le tute nei ahiuleh amopohnau masapen chu a-insunga Pathen mikhotona apohdoh dingu, ahinguvah anule apateu phatna ngailutna-a alethuh diu ahi. Hichu Pathen lung lhaina ahi.
English: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

tcz: Amavang leiset chunga ainsungmi umtalou meithai dihtah hochun Pathena akingapnau ngaplhahna aneitheiyun, Pathen in apanpina diuvin sunle jan in ataojingun ahi.
en: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
text:
1TI 5:5
Thadou: Amavang leiset chunga ainsungmi umtalou meithai dihtah hochun Pathena akingapnau ngaplhahna aneitheiyun, Pathen in apanpina diuvin sunle jan in ataojingun ahi.
English: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

tcz: Ahinlah meithai nopsahna hinkhoa kimang chajing hovang ahinlai sunga jong athisa ahiuve.
en: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.
text:
1TI 5:6
Thadou: Ahinlah meithai nopsahna hinkhoa kimang chajing hovang ahinlai sunga jong athisa ahiuve.
English: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

tcz: Amaho chu miseiset achanlouna diuva hiche thupeh hohi napeh ding ahi.
en: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.
text:
1TI 5:7
Thadou: Amaho chu miseiset achanlouna diuva hiche thupeh hohi napeh ding ahi.
English: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

tcz: Ahinlah koihileh ama sopite ding khohsahna neilou adeh deh'a ama insung mite ding khohsah louho chun tahsan dihtah chu apaidoh-u ahitan, hitobang ho chu atahsanlouho sanga khohjo ahiuve.
en: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
text:
1TI 5:8
Thadou: Ahinlah koihileh ama sopite ding khohsahna neilou adeh deh'a ama insung mite ding khohsah louho chun tahsan dihtah chu apaidoh-u ahitan, hitobang ho chu atahsanlouho sanga khohjo ahiuve.
English: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

tcz: Kithopi dinga amin kikhum meithaiho chu alhompen a kum somgup hiding, ajipa anga kitahna ana neimi hiding ahi.
en: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,
text:
1TI 5:9
Thadou: Kithopi dinga amin kikhum meithaiho chu alhompen a kum somgup hiding, ajipa anga kitahna ana neimi hiding ahi.
English: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

tcz: Amachu achate ahin khoukhahna a athilphabol jeh'a mijouse jana changmi hiding, maljin khoto, tahsan kibahpiho kisunemtah a jenmi hiding, hahsatna tohho kithopi nommi hiding ahi.
en: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.
text:
1TI 5:10
Thadou: Amachu achate ahin khoukhahna a athilphabol jeh'a mijouse jana changmi hiding, maljin khoto, tahsan kibahpiho kisunemtah a jenmi hiding, hahsatna tohho kithopi nommi hiding ahi.
English: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

tcz: Khangdong meithaiho vang panglou diu ahi, ajeh chu Christa dinga akipehnau sanga atahsau ngaichatna chu hatjoding jineikit nomdiu ahi.
en: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,
text:
1TI 5:11
Thadou: Khangdong meithaiho vang panglou diu ahi, ajeh chu Christa dinga akipehnau sanga atahsau ngaichatna chu hatjoding jineikit nomdiu ahi.
English: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

tcz: Hiche chun kitepna aneisau chu asuhkeh-a themona changdiu ahi.
en: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.
text:
1TI 5:12
Thadou: Hiche chun kitepna aneisau chu asuhkeh-a themona changdiu ahi.
English: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

tcz: Chuleh amaho chun thaset hinpanuntin intina vahle untin, thuchavai seina'a kipeuvintin, mi natohna-a gakikum lediu chuleh akinlouva thuseina'a gakamjao lediu ahi.
en: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.
text:
1TI 5:13
Thadou: Chuleh amaho chun thaset hinpanuntin intina vahle untin, thuchavai seina'a kipeuvintin, mi natohna-a gakikum lediu chuleh akinlouva thuseina'a gakamjao lediu ahi.
English: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

tcz: Hijeh chun hitobang khangdong meithai hohi ajineikit uva cha aneidiu, inchen akisemdiu kaphatsah ahi. Chutileh melma chun amaho chu aseisetna diu agomkom aneilou diu ahi.
en: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.
text:
1TI 5:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun hitobang khangdong meithai hohi ajineikit uva cha aneidiu, inchen akisemdiu kaphatsah ahi. Chutileh melma chun amaho chu aseisetna diu agomkom aneilou diu ahi.
English: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

tcz: Ajehchu amaho lah a phabep khat hi achelengun, Satan nung ajui tauve tihin eitijat sah'in ahi.
en: For already some have turned away after Satan.
text:
1TI 5:15
Thadou: Ajehchu amaho lah a phabep khat hi achelengun, Satan nung ajui tauve tihin eitijat sah'in ahi.
English: For already some have turned away after Satan.

tcz: Tahsancha numei khat chun sopi meithai aneiya ahileh amaho chu phatah-in kivetsui henlang mopohna houbung chunga ngapdahen. Chutileh houbungin achangseh'a cheng meithaiho phatah-a avetsuithei dingu ahi.
en: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.
text:
1TI 5:16
Thadou: Tahsancha numei khat chun sopi meithai aneiya ahileh amaho chu phatah-in kivetsui henlang mopohna houbung chunga ngapdahen. Chutileh houbungin achangseh'a cheng meithaiho phatah-a avetsuithei dingu ahi.
English: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

tcz: Houbung Upa akin phatah-a tongho adehset athupha lhangsapna le thuhilna-a hapanho chu jana pehding chuleh atohman jong phatah a pehding ahi.
en: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.
text:
1TI 5:17
Thadou: Houbung Upa akin phatah-a tongho adehset athupha lhangsapna le thuhilna-a hapanho chu jana pehding chuleh atohman jong phatah a pehding ahi.
English: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Bongchal changchila chu amuh kikan hihhen chujongleh natonga chu atohman asanding lomtah ahi,” ati.
en: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
text:
1TI 5:18
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen thun, “Bongchal changchila chu amuh kikan hihhen chujongleh natonga chu atohman asanding lomtah ahi,” ati.
English: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

tcz: Houbung lhacha khat chunga hehna aumleh hettohsah mini, mithum aumlouleh lahih in.
en: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
text:
1TI 5:19
Thadou: Houbung lhacha khat chunga hehna aumleh hettohsah mini, mithum aumlouleh lahih in.
English: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.

tcz: Adanghon kichatna aneitheina dingin achonseho chu mipi angsunga sosal'in.
en: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.
text:
1TI 5:20
Thadou: Adanghon kichatna aneitheina dingin achonseho chu mipi angsunga sosal'in.
English: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

tcz: Pathen leh Yeshua Christa chuleh vantil sangpen ho mitmua hiche thuhi kapeh nahi, hiche thupeh hohi langnei naleh sihneina koimacha koma neilouvin mangchan.
en: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.
text:
1TI 5:21
Thadou: Pathen leh Yeshua Christa chuleh vantil sangpen ho mitmua hiche thuhi kapeh nahi, hiche thupeh hohi langnei naleh sihneina koimacha koma neilouvin mangchan.
English: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

tcz: Houbung sunga Pakai lhacha napansah ding tengleh kino hihbeh in. Midang chonsetna-a kinunat hih-in, nangle nang kisuthengin.
en: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.
text:
1TI 5:22
Thadou: Houbung sunga Pakai lhacha napansah ding tengleh kino hihbeh in. Midang chonsetna-a kinunat hih-in, nangle nang kisuthengin.
English: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

tcz: Tuisih jengseh donhih in, naveiset jeh leh nagilpi damlouna jeh in lengpitwi themkhat khat anamang jitan.
en: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.
text:
1TI 5:23
Thadou: Tuisih jengseh donhih in, naveiset jeh leh nagilpi damlouna jeh in lengpitwi themkhat khat anamang jitan.
English: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

tcz: Miphabep chonsetna hi mijouse het in akilangin, suhdihthei ahi. Ahinla miphabep chonsetna hi khonungle bou hung kilang ding loi aume ti sumil hih in.
en: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.
text:
1TI 5:24
Thadou: Miphabep chonsetna hi mijouse het in akilangin, suhdihthei ahi. Ahinla miphabep chonsetna hi khonungle bou hung kilang ding loi aume ti sumil hih in.
English: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

tcz: Chutobang chun miphabep thilpha bol hi mipi het in akilangdoh theiyin, chuleh miphabep in thilpha abol hi phatkhat lebou hung kilang doh ding ahi.
en: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.
text:
1TI 5:25
Thadou: Chutobang chun miphabep thilpha bol hi mipi het in akilangdoh theiyin, chuleh miphabep in thilpha abol hi phatkhat lebou hung kilang doh ding ahi.
English: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

tcz: Sohhon Pathen min leh athuhil taiponga aumsah louna dinguvin a Pakai teu ginleh jabolna lhingset apehjing diu angaiye.
en: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.
text:
1TI 6:1
Thadou: Sohhon Pathen min leh athuhil taiponga aumsah louna dinguvin a Pakai teu ginleh jabolna lhingset apehjing diu angaiye.
English: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

tcz: Chuleh apakai teu chu tahsan chate anahi khah jongleh sopi ahijeh chun nahsahmon boldau hen, chusang chun hajencheh joh uhen, ajeh chu anatoh-u phatchompi hochu angailut u tahsan chate mama ahiuve. Timothy, hiche thuhi hilin, anitchehna diuvin tilkhouvin.
en: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.
text:
1TI 6:2
Thadou: Chuleh apakai teu chu tahsan chate anahi khah jongleh sopi ahijeh chun nahsahmon boldau hen, chusang chun hajencheh joh uhen, ajeh chu anatoh-u phatchompi hochu angailut u tahsan chate mama ahiuve. Timothy, hiche thuhi hilin, anitchehna diuvin tilkhouvin.
English: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

tcz: Mi phabep in kathuhilu hi ana khel maitheiyu ahi, ahinla hichehi Pakai Yeshua Christa thuhil phachomtah chu ahi. Hiche thuhil hin Pathen deilam hinkho akhantousah ahi.
en: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,
text:
1TI 6:3
Thadou: Mi phabep in kathuhilu hi ana khel maitheiyu ahi, ahinla hichehi Pakai Yeshua Christa thuhil phachomtah chu ahi. Hiche thuhil hin Pathen deilam hinkho akhantousah ahi.
English: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

tcz: Koitobang khat in hicheto kitohlouva thuhil aumleh amachu thuhila nunglou chule hetna lhasama ahi. Hitobang michun hiche thudih hi aheimanggot ahi. Hichehin kinel bautamna asodohsah jia achaina chu kimitthipna, kibungkhen, kidemto, chuleh kiginmoto phaloutah asodohsah ji ahi.
en: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,
text:
1TI 6:4
Thadou: Koitobang khat in hicheto kitohlouva thuhil aumleh amachu thuhila nunglou chule hetna lhasama ahi. Hitobang michun hiche thudih hi aheimanggot ahi. Hichehin kinel bautamna asodohsah jia achaina chu kimitthipna, kibungkhen, kidemto, chuleh kiginmoto phaloutah asodohsah ji ahi.
English: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

tcz: Hitobang hohin phat tinin thilphalou asodohsah jin ahi. Alungthim'u asuboh un thutah anungsun tauvin ahi. Hitobang miho ding in Pathen lama lunglut dana aumu hi tahsa lama haodohna ding tohgonbep ahijin ahi.
en: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.
text:
1TI 6:5
Thadou: Hitobang hohin phat tinin thilphalou asodohsah jin ahi. Alungthim'u asuboh un thutah anungsun tauvin ahi. Hitobang miho ding in Pathen lama lunglut dana aumu hi tahsa lama haodohna ding tohgonbep ahijin ahi.
English: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

tcz: Ahinlah Pathen ngaisahnatoh kilhon'a lungnachim hinkho hi haona tahbeh ahi.
en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
text:
1TI 6:6
Thadou: Ahinlah Pathen ngaisahnatoh kilhon'a lungnachim hinkho hi haona tahbeh ahi.
English: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

tcz: Atahbeh-in, eihon leiset a hin ima ihinpolut pouvin, chuleh idalhah tenguleh ima ipohdoh diu aumpon ahi.
en: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.
text:
1TI 6:7
Thadou: Atahbeh-in, eihon leiset a hin ima ihinpolut pouvin, chuleh idalhah tenguleh ima ipohdoh diu aumpon ahi.
English: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

tcz: Hijehchun eihon neh le von ineiyuleh ilunglhai jeng diu angaiye.
en: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.
text:
1TI 6:8
Thadou: Hijehchun eihon neh le von ineiyuleh ilunglhai jeng diu angaiye.
English: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

tcz: Ahinlah ahaodoh nom loihohi lhepna ah alhajiuve chuleh ngolhoitah le hamset umtah ngaichat hohin manthahna-a alehlutji bep in ahi.
en: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.
text:
1TI 6:9
Thadou: Ahinlah ahaodoh nom loihohi lhepna ah alhajiuve chuleh ngolhoitah le hamset umtah ngaichat hohin manthahna-a alehlutji bep in ahi.
English: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

tcz: Ajehchu sum ngaichatna hi thilphalou jouse hung konna ahi, chuleh sum ngaichatna hin miphabep tahsan dihtah a konin alamvaisah-in lunggimna tamtah-in amaho asuhnatlo ji bep in ahi.
en: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
text:
1TI 6:10
Thadou: Ajehchu sum ngaichatna hi thilphalou jouse hung konna ahi, chuleh sum ngaichatna hin miphabep tahsan dihtah a konin alamvaisah-in lunggimna tamtah-in amaho asuhnatlo ji bep in ahi.
English: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

tcz: Ahinlah Timothy nangma vang Pathen mi nahijeh in hiche thilse hoa kon in jammangin lang lungnengtah le thohhatna neitah-in ngailutna le tahsanna neipumin Pathen deilam le chonphatna del in.
en: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.
text:
1TI 6:11
Thadou: Ahinlah Timothy nangma vang Pathen mi nahijeh in hiche thilse hoa kon in jammangin lang lungnengtah le thohhatna neitah-in ngailutna le tahsanna neipumin Pathen deilam le chonphatna del in.
English: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

tcz: Tahsan dihtah chuna-in galsat phachu sat'in. Pathen in nakouna tonsot hinkemlou chu tuhchah in, hichu ahetoh mitamtah masanga phatah a naphondoh ahitai.
en: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.
text:
1TI 6:12
Thadou: Tahsan dihtah chuna-in galsat phachu sat'in. Pathen in nakouna tonsot hinkemlou chu tuhchah in, hichu ahetoh mitamtah masanga phatah a naphondoh ahitai.
English: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

tcz: Mihem hinkho pea Pathen angsungleh Pontius Pilate masanga hettohsahna phatah pea Yeshua Christa angsunga hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi.
en: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,
text:
1TI 6:13
Thadou: Mihem hinkho pea Pathen angsungleh Pontius Pilate masanga hettohsahna phatah pea Yeshua Christa angsunga hiche thupeh hi kapeh nahi.
English: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

tcz: Tohdinga nakipe chu bulhingset in tongin, chutileh tuapat le Pakai Yeshua hungkit kah in koimachan themmo nachanponte.
en: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text:
1TI 6:14
Thadou: Tohdinga nakipe chu bulhingset in tongin, chutileh tuapat le Pakai Yeshua hungkit kah in koimachan themmo nachanponte.
English: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

tcz: Lengho Lengle Pakaiho Pakai anunnom leh hat chungnung Pathen amabou chun Christa chu aphatcha vana kona ahin kilahdohsah ding ahi.
en: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
text:
1TI 6:15
Thadou: Lengho Lengle Pakaiho Pakai anunnom leh hat chungnung Pathen amabou chun Christa chu aphatcha vana kona ahin kilahdohsah ding ahi.
English: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

tcz: Amabou hi thithei louna hinna nei ahin aumna chu vahbehseh-a koimachan aphah theilou, mihem mit in amuphahlou ding ahi. Loupina le thaneina jouse atonsot tonsot'in Amaa hijing tahen! Amen.
en: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.
text:
1TI 6:16
Thadou: Amabou hi thithei louna hinna nei ahin aumna chu vahbehseh-a koimachan aphah theilou, mihem mit in amuphahlou ding ahi. Loupina le thaneina jouse atonsot tonsot'in Amaa hijing tahen! Amen.
English: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

tcz: Hiche leiset a haosaho chu akiletsah louna diuleh kisonpi thei hilou asum u chu kisonna a aneilouna diuvin hilchah in. Ingaichat hou ning lhingset'a eipeuva Pathen joh kisonnan neiyuhen.
en: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

tcz: Asum u chu thilpha bolna a aman diuvin seipeh in. Thilpha bolna lama ninglhingu henlang alhasamho khotona hinneiyuhen. Chuleh midang koma phaldoh dingin phattin in kigosan umjing'u hen.
en: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

tcz: Hitia chu abol uleh gou kikhol khonunga dinga akhombul phatah nei hidiu chutia chu hinna tahbeh chu atekhah thei dingu ahi.
en: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.
text:
1TI 6:19
Thadou: Hitia chu abol uleh gou kikhol khonunga dinga akhombul phatah nei hidiu chutia chu hinna tahbeh chu atekhah thei dingu ahi.
English: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

tcz: Timothy, Pathen in nangansena chu kichintup in. Nadou hotoh Pathen deilou ngolhoi tah a kihoulimna ho, amahon chihna atiuva kon chun kiheimangin.
en: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,
text:
1TI 6:20
Thadou: Timothy, Pathen in nangansena chu kichintup in. Nadou hotoh Pathen deilou ngolhoi tah a kihoulimna ho, amahon chihna atiuva kon chun kiheimangin.
English: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

tcz: Mi phabep in hitobang ngolnaho chu ajui uvin tahsanna akonin alamvai tauve. Pathen mikhotona chun nabon un naumpiu hen.
en: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.
text:
1TI 6:21
Thadou: Mi phabep in hitobang ngolnaho chu ajui uvin tahsanna akonin alamvai tauve. Pathen mikhotona chun nabon un naumpiu hen.
English: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

tcz: Hiche hi Yeshua Christa solchah hidinga Pathen lunglhaina-a lhendoh a um Paul lekhathot ahi. Keima Christa Yeshua tahsan a kon hinna athutep seiphong dinga eikisol'ah ahi.
en: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
text:
2TI 1:1
Thadou: Hiche hi Yeshua Christa solchah hidinga Pathen lunglhaina-a lhendoh a um Paul lekhathot ahi. Keima Christa Yeshua tahsan a kon hinna athutep seiphong dinga eikisol'ah ahi.
English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

tcz: Kangailuttah kachapa Timothy dinga kajih ahi. Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailutna le khotona chuleh lungmon na chun naumpi hen.
en: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
text:
2TI 1:2
Thadou: Kangailuttah kachapa Timothy dinga kajih ahi. Pa Pathen le I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa ngailutna le khotona chuleh lungmon na chun naumpi hen.
English: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

tcz: Timothy, kapu kapaten apom banga selepha hetna lunggel thengtah puma kapom Pathen chu nang jal'in kathangvah e. Asun ajan in kataona a nangma kageldoh jinge.
en: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
text:
2TI 1:3
Thadou: Timothy, kapu kapaten apom banga selepha hetna lunggel thengtah puma kapom Pathen chu nang jal'in kathangvah e. Asun ajan in kataona a nangma kageldoh jinge.
English: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

tcz: I-kikhen a namitlhilon chu kageldoh in, nangma kamukit nom lheh jenge. Chule iumkhom kit tengleh keima kipana a dimset ding kahitai.
en: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

tcz: Natahsan dihtah chu kageldoh e, ajehchu napi Lois leh nanu Eunice a anaumdim masa tahsan chu nachan khompi ahi. Chule hiche tahsan chu nang'ah dettah in aum jinge ti kahen ahi.
en: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.
text:
2TI 1:5
Thadou: Natahsan dihtah chu kageldoh e, ajehchu napi Lois leh nanu Eunice a anaumdim masa tahsan chu nachan khompi ahi. Chule hiche tahsan chu nang'ah dettah in aum jinge ti kahen ahi.
English: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

tcz: Hichejeh achu, nachunga kakhut kangap a Pathen in lhagao thilpeh napeh chu nasuhlang jing dinga kahin geldohsahkit nahi.
en: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
text:
2TI 1:6
Thadou: Hichejeh achu, nachunga kakhut kangap a Pathen in lhagao thilpeh napeh chu nasuhlang jing dinga kahin geldohsahkit nahi.
English: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen in tijatna le meisanna Lhagao eipepouve, amavang thohhatna, ngailutna chule kitimthemna joh eipeuve.
en: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
text:
2TI 1:7
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen in tijatna le meisanna Lhagao eipepouve, amavang thohhatna, ngailutna chule kitimthemna joh eipeuve.
English: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

tcz: Amaho doha lungthim in mi insunga alutjiuvin, tahsa ngaichatnan alodim chonset pohgih poa numei tikitimlou ho alhemlhauvin gal hingin amanjiuvin ahi.
en: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
text:
2TI 3:6
Thadou: Amaho doha lungthim in mi insunga alutjiuvin, tahsa ngaichatnan alodim chonset pohgih poa numei tikitimlou ho alhemlhauvin gal hingin amanjiuvin ahi.
English: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

tcz: Hitobang numeiho hin, thuhil thah hi ajui jingun ahinlah thutah chu ahethem pouvin ahi.

text:
2TI 3:7
Thadou: Hitobang numeiho hin, thuhil thah hi ajui jingun ahinlah thutah chu ahethem pouvin ahi.
English: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

tcz: Jannes le Jambres tenin Mose adoudal lhon bang chun amaho hin thutah chu adoudalun ahi. Amahohin lungthim chavai aneiyun tahsan lhem achepiuvin ahi.
en: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.
text:
2TI 3:8
Thadou: Jannes le Jambres tenin Mose adoudal lhon bang chun amaho hin thutah chu adoudalun ahi. Amahohin lungthim chavai aneiyun tahsan lhem achepiuvin ahi.
English: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

tcz: Ahinlah amahohi hitiahi hoidoh sottaloudiu Jannes le Jambres banga chu itobanga ngol hiuvam ti nikhatleh mijousen ahin hetdoh diu ahi.
en: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.
text:
2TI 3:9
Thadou: Ahinlah amahohi hitiahi hoidoh sottaloudiu Jannes le Jambres banga chu itobanga ngol hiuvam ti nikhatleh mijousen ahin hetdoh diu ahi.

tcz: Ahinlah Timothy keiman, nangma ipi thu kahil, chule ipi iti kahin chule kahinkhoa kalunggon nahet ahinai. Hiti chun nangman katahsanna, kathohhatna, kangailutna chule kathoh lhumkeina hohi nahe chen nai.
en: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,
text:
2TI 3:10
Thadou: Ahinlah Timothy keiman, nangma ipi thu kahil, chule ipi iti kahin chule kahinkhoa kalunggon nahet ahinai. Hiti chun nangman katahsanna, kathohhatna, kangailutna chule kathoh lhumkeina hohi nahe chen nai.
English: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

tcz: Ichan geiya gimbol hesohna chule hahsatna kathoh hitam ti nahenai. Chule keiman Antioch, Iconium chule Lystra khohoa bol-hesohna kathoh hohi nahei, hinla Pakaiyin hicheho jousea konin eihuhdoh tai.
en: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.
text:
2TI 3:11
Thadou: Ichan geiya gimbol hesohna chule hahsatna kathoh hitam ti nahenai. Chule keiman Antioch, Iconium chule Lystra khohoa bol-hesohna kathoh hohi nahei, hinla Pakaiyin hicheho jousea konin eihuhdoh tai.
English: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

tcz: Ahiye chule koi koi hijongleh Christa Yeshua a Pathen ngaisahna hinkho mangnom jouse chun bolhesohna athohtei ding ahi.
en: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.
text:
2TI 3:12
Thadou: Ahiye chule koi koi hijongleh Christa Yeshua a Pathen ngaisahna hinkho mangnom jouse chun bolhesohna athohtei ding ahi.
English: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

tcz: Ahinlah migilouho leh milhem lhaho chu hung pungcheh cheh ding ahiuve. Amahon midangho alheplhah uva chule amaho tah lheplhah a umding ahiuve.
en: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
text:
2TI 3:13
Thadou: Ahinlah migilouho leh milhem lhaho chu hung pungcheh cheh ding ahiuve. Amahon midangho alheplhah uva chule amaho tah lheplhah a umding ahiuve.

tcz: Ahinlah nangma nana kihilsa thilhoa chu tahsan umtah nahi ding ahi. Nangman hicheho chu adih ahin, chule nahil ho chu natahsan thei ahiuve ti nahenai.
en: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.
text:
2TI 3:14
Thadou: Ahinlah nangma nana kihilsa thilhoa chu tahsan umtah nahi ding ahi. Nangman hicheho chu adih ahin, chule nahil ho chu natahsan thei ahiuve ti nahenai.
English: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

tcz: Nangma naneova pat a Thuthengbu hi nana kihilsa ahin, chule amaho chun huhhingna nakisan theina dinga chihna chu napehsonu ahitai.
en: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
text:
2TI 3:15
Thadou: Nangma naneova pat a Thuthengbu hi nana kihilsa ahin, chule amaho chun huhhingna nakisan theina dinga chihna chu napehsonu ahitai.
English: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Pathen thubu hi aboncha Pathen Hu haikhum ahi chule hichu eiho dinga ipi chu adih chule ipi chu adihlou ham ti ihinkhouva eihet dohsah dingu ahi. Idihlou tenguleh eisudih diu chule ipi chu adih ham ti eihiluva panga ahi.

tcz: Hiche hi Pathen in amite chu abolsah nom thilpha tincheng bolna lama boltheina dimset inei theina diuva kigotna lampi ahi.

text:
2TI 3:17

tcz: Keiman Pathen le alenggam tungdoh a hung ding Christa Yeshua, ahingho le athiho chungthu tana pang dingpa angsunga, lungguttah a katilkhou nahi:

2TI 4:1

tcz: Pathen Thu chu seiphong in. Phat kijenpet hihen, hihih jongleh kigosademin um'in. Thohhattah in sudih in, phoh in chule phatah a hilpumin namiteu chu tilkhouvin.
en: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
text:
2TI 4:2
Thadou: Pathen Thu chu seiphong in. Phat kijenpet hihen, hihih jongleh kigosademin um'in. Thohhattah in sudih in, phoh in chule phatah a hilpumin namiteu chu tilkhouvin.

tcz: Ajehchu mihon thuhilpha le adihtah a kihilna thu angainom lounau phat hunglhung ding ahi. Amaho chun alung ngaichat u ajui uva, anakolu thahtun tun'a um chun angainom ding thubou hilding mihil akikou dingu ahi.
en: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,
text:
2TI 4:3
Thadou: Ajehchu mihon thuhilpha le adihtah a kihilna thu angainom lounau phat hunglhung ding ahi. Amaho chun alung ngaichat u ajui uva, anakolu thahtun tun'a um chun angainom ding thubou hilding mihil akikou dingu ahi.
English: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

tcz: Amaho chun thutah chu adeilou dingu chule akisemthu thusimho pou adel le dingu ahi.
en: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.
text:
2TI 4:4
Thadou: Amaho chun thutah chu adeilou dingu chule akisemthu thusimho pou adel le dingu ahi.
English: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

tcz: Hinlah nangma aphat totoh'a imalam jousea lunggel kicheh hina neiyin. Pakaiya dinga gimhesoh thohding kichatna neihih in. Kipana Thupha thu chu hilin chule Pathen in lhacha natohna napeh chu tongdoh in.
en: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.
text:
2TI 4:5
Thadou: Hinlah nangma aphat totoh'a imalam jousea lunggel kicheh hina neiyin. Pakaiya dinga gimhesoh thohding kichatna neihih in. Kipana Thupha thu chu hilin chule Pathen in lhacha natohna napeh chu tongdoh in.
English: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

tcz: Keima vang kahinkho hi Pathena dinga maichama kisunglha kahitai. Ka leihinkho kichaina ding ahung naitai.
en: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
text:
2TI 4:6
Thadou: Keima vang kahinkho hi Pathena dinga maichama kisunglha kahitai. Ka leihinkho kichaina ding ahung naitai.
English: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

tcz: Keiman kidouna chu kasat chaitai, keiman lhaitetna chu kajo ahitai chule tahsanna a kapangdet e.
en: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
text:
2TI 4:7
Thadou: Keiman kidouna chu kasat chaitai, keiman lhaitetna chu kajo ahitai chule tahsanna a kapangdet e.
English: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

tcz: Chule tua hi kipaman kasan ding gotsa koi ahitai. Pakai, thutan dihtah pa chun, ahungkile nitengleh chonphatna lallukhuh chu eipeh ding ahi. Chule hiche kipaman san ding chu keima chang dingseh hilouva Ama hung kilah ding nikho ngaicha geova ngah jing ho dinga jong ahi.
en: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
text:
2TI 4:8
Thadou: Chule tua hi kipaman kasan ding gotsa koi ahitai. Pakai, thutan dihtah pa chun, ahungkile nitengleh chonphatna lallukhuh chu eipeh ding ahi. Chule hiche kipaman san ding chu keima chang dingseh hilouva Ama hung kilah ding nikho ngaicha geova ngah jing ho dinga jong ahi.
English: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

tcz: Timothy, lungsettah in agan nathei chanin hungin.
en: Be diligent to come to me soon,
text:
2TI 4:9
Thadou: Timothy, lungsettah in agan nathei chanin hungin.
English: Be diligent to come to me soon,

tcz: Demas chun tu hinkho thil ho angaichat jeh in keima eidalhan, Thessalonica lama achetai. Crescens chu Galatia ah achen, chule Titus Dalmatia ah achetai.
en: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.
text:
2TI 4:10

tcz: Luke bouseh kakoma aume. Nahung phatleh Mark chu hinpuiyin, ajeh chu ama lhacha natohnaa eipanpi phachomtah hiding ahi.
en: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.
text:
2TI 4:11
Thadou: Luke bouseh kakoma aume. Nahung phatleh Mark chu hinpuiyin, ajeh chu ama lhacha natohnaa eipanpi phachomtah hiding ahi.

tcz: Keiman Tychicus chu Ephesus a kasol in ahi.

text:
2TI 4:12
Thadou: Keiman Tychicus chu Ephesus a kasol in ahi.
English: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

tcz: Nahung phatleh Troas khoa Carpus koma kadalhah Sangkholchol chu hinpo teiyin. Chujongleh kalekhabu ho, adeh'a kalekhajol ho chu hinpon.
en: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.
text:
2TI 4:13
Thadou: Nahung phatleh Troas khoa Carpus koma kadalhah Sangkholchol chu hinpo teiyin. Chujongleh kalekhabu ho, adeh'a kalekhajol ho chu hinpon.
English: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

tcz: Alexander, sum-eng khengpa chun eigimbol lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin athilbol dungjuiyin achungthu tan nante.
en: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
text:
2TI 4:14
Thadou: Alexander, sum-eng khengpa chun eigimbol lheh jenge, hinlah Pakaiyin athilbol dungjuiyin achungthu tan nante.
English: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

tcz: Amaa konin chingtheiyin, ajeh chu amahin isei jouseu hadouvin adouvin ahi.
en: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.
text:
2TI 4:15
Thadou: Amaa konin chingtheiyin, ajeh chu amahin isei jouseu hadouvin adouvin ahi.
English: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

tcz: Thutanna anga eikipui masat chun koima eikilhonpia aumpoi. Amitinin eidalhauve. Ama ho dounaa ima sodahen.
en: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
text:
2TI 4:16
Thadou: Thutanna anga eikipui masat chun koima eikilhonpia aumpoi. Amitinin eidalhauve. Ama ho dounaa ima sodahen.
English: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai chun eidinpin chule thaneina eipei hitia chu keiman chidang namdang ho jouse henga Kipana Thupha kalhangsap chu ajah theina dingu ahi. Chule aman thina theiya konin jong eihuh dohtai.
en: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
text:
2TI 4:17
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai chun eidinpin chule thaneina eipei hitia chu keiman chidang namdang ho jouse henga Kipana Thupha kalhangsap chu ajah theina dingu ahi. Chule aman thina theiya konin jong eihuh dohtai.
English: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

tcz: Henge, hitia chu Pakaiyin gitlouna eihin nokhum theiya konin eihuhdoh intin, chule avan gam'a bitkeiya eipuilut ding ahi. Pathena chun loupina jouse umjing tahen! Amen.
en: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
text:
2TI 4:18
Thadou: Henge, hitia chu Pakaiyin gitlouna eihin nokhum theiya konin eihuhdoh intin, chule avan gam'a bitkeiya eipuilut ding ahi. Pathena chun loupina jouse umjing tahen! Amen.
English: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Priscilla le Aquila teni chule Onisephorus insunga umho jouse chu keikhelin analemin.
en: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.
text:
2TI 4:19
Thadou: Priscilla le Aquila teni chule Onisephorus insunga umho jouse chu keikhelin analemin.
English: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

tcz: Erastus Corinth a aumdenin, chule keiman Trophimus chu Miletas ah damlouvin kadalhatai.
en: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.
text:
2TI 4:20
Thadou: Erastus Corinth a aumdenin, chule keiman Trophimus chu Miletas ah damlouvin kadalhatai.
English: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

tcz: Phalbi ma-in hikoma hung teijin. Eubulus in chibai nahinbol e, chule Pudente, Linus, Claudia chule sopi ho jousen jong chibai nahinbol uve.
en: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.
text:
2TI 4:21
Thadou: Phalbi ma-in hikoma hung teijin. Eubulus in chibai nahinbol e, chule Pudente, Linus, Claudia chule sopi ho jousen jong chibai nahinbol uve.
English: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

tcz: Pakai chun nalhagaovu umpi hen. Chule Amilungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiuhen.
en: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
text:
2TI 4:22
Thadou: Pakai chun nalhagaovu umpi hen. Chule Amilungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiuhen.
English: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

tcz: Hiche Lekhathot hi Pathen soh chule Yeshua Christa solchah, Paul'a kon ahi. Keima Pathen in alhendoh saho laha tahsan thudol seiphong ding le Pathen mite hindan ahetthem theina diu thutah chu hil dinga ei kisol ahi.
en: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,
text:
TIT 1:1
Thadou: Hiche Lekhathot hi Pathen soh chule Yeshua Christa solchah, Paul'a kon ahi. Keima Pathen in alhendoh saho laha tahsan thudol seiphong ding le Pathen mite hindan ahetthem theina diu thutah chu hil dinga ei kisol ahi.
English: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

tcz: Chuche thutah, jou seitheilou Pathen in vannoi bul kiphudoh masanga ana tepsa, chun tonsot hinna aneiyu chu kisonna apeh ahi.
en: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

tcz: Chule tua aphat alhintaha hiche thuhi aman ahin phondoh'a, keihon mijouse laha kasei phongleu ahi. Hiche hi eihuhhing uva Pathen a kona thupeh, ama na tong dinga keima ei kinganse ahi.
en: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
text:
TIT 1:3
Thadou: Chule tua aphat alhintaha hiche thuhi aman ahin phondoh'a, keihon mijouse laha kasei phongleu ahi. Hiche hi eihuhhing uva Pathen a kona thupeh, ama na tong dinga keima ei kinganse ahi.
English: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,
