tcz: Keiman, kakikop pi tahsanna jal'a kachapa dihtah, Titus henga kasut ahi. Pa Pathen chule eihuhhing uva Christa Yeshuan chamna le lungmon nape tahen.
en: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.
text:
TIT 1:4
Thadou: Keiman, kakikop pi tahsanna jal'a kachapa dihtah, Titus henga kasut ahi. Pa Pathen chule eihuhhing uva Christa Yeshuan chamna le lungmon nape tahen.
English: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

tcz: Keiman nangma Crete twikol a kadalhah chu, inatoh lhon nasuhbulhit a chule kahilna banga khopi tinchenga upa ho napansah na dinga kadalhah nahi.
en: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—
text:
TIT 1:5
Thadou: Keiman nangma Crete twikol a kadalhah chu, inatoh lhon nasuhbulhit a chule kahilna banga khopi tinchenga upa ho napansah na dinga kadalhah nahi.
English: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

tcz: Upa khat chun nolnabei hinkho amanding ahi. Ainneipi dinga kitahna neimi hiding, chule achate chu atahsan chonchatvaina lamle thua nunlouna lama seiset changlou hiding ahi.
en: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
text:
TIT 1:6
Thadou: Upa khat chun nolnabei hinkho amanding ahi. Ainneipi dinga kitahna neimi hiding, chule achate chu atahsan chonchatvaina lamle thua nunlouna lama seiset changlou hiding ahi.
English: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

tcz: Upa khat chu Pathen insunga gouching ahi, hijeh a chu nolna beiya hinkho amanding ahi. Ama chu kichamsah, lungsabai, ju'a loplou hiding, alamlouva sum ngailu mi hilouding ahi.
en: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

tcz: Maljin phatbol mi, a-in'a jin alhunle kipah, chule Pathen ginga, chondihtaha hinkho mang mi hiding, thilpha ngailu, lunglimgeh, chondih, amachang kitimthei, Pathen ging mi hiding ahi.
en: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,
text:
TIT 1:8
Thadou: Maljin phatbol mi, a-in'a jin alhunle kipah, chule Pathen ginga, chondihtaha hinkho mang mi hiding, thilpha ngailu, lunglimgeh, chondih, amachang kitimthei, Pathen ging mi hiding ahi.
English: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

tcz: Tahsan umtah thu ana kihilna ho detchet a tuhchah mi hiteiding ahi; chutileh aman midang ho chu kihilna hoitah a atilkhou thei ding chule mi nelkal hatho jong athemmonau akomu peh thei ding ahi.
en: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.
text:
TIT 1:9
Thadou: Tahsan umtah thu ana kihilna ho detchet a tuhchah mi hiteiding ahi; chutileh aman midang ho chu kihilna hoitah a atilkhou thei ding chule mi nelkal hatho jong athemmonau akomu peh thei ding ahi.
English: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

tcz: Ajeh chu adoudal ah mi tamtah panna bei thuseiya thanom chule milhemlha tamtah aume. Hiche hi ahideh'a cheptan vanga sochatna um ahi tia sei holah'a aum nom e.
en: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,
text:
TIT 1:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu adoudal ah mi tamtah panna bei thuseiya thanom chule milhemlha tamtah aume. Hiche hi ahideh'a cheptan vanga sochatna um ahi tia sei holah'a aum nom e.
English: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

tcz: Amaho chu suhthip ding ahiuve, ajeh chu athuhil dihlou uva kon chun insung tamtah apuimangun ahi. Chule hiche athilbol u chu sum ngailut jeh a bou abolu ahi.
en: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
text:
TIT 1:11
Thadou: Amaho chu suhthip ding ahiuve, ajeh chu athuhil dihlou uva kon chun insung tamtah apuimangun ahi. Chule hiche athilbol u chu sum ngailut jeh a bou abolu ahi.
English: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

tcz: Amaho lah jenga jong, mi khat, Crete a kona themgao khat, in amaho thudol hitin aseiyin, “Crete miho hi abon'uva mijou, gam sahang, chule mithase nehlop ahiuve” ati.
en: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
text:
TIT 1:12
Thadou: Amaho lah jenga jong, mi khat, Crete a kona themgao khat, in amaho thudol hitin aseiyin, “Crete miho hi abon'uva mijou, gam sahang, chule mithase nehlop ahiuve” ati.
English: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

tcz: Hichehi adihtah mong ahi. Chuti ahijeh chun amaho hi tahsan kicheh mi ahi nadingun hatah in phohsal in.
en: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
text:
TIT 1:13
Thadou: Hichehi adihtah mong ahi. Chuti ahijeh chun amaho hi tahsan kicheh mi ahi nadingun hatah in phohsal in.
English: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

tcz: Thutah'a kona mi puikon thei, Juda ho moh thusimle miho thupeh ah lunglut dauhen.
en: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
text:
TIT 1:14
Thadou: Thutah'a kona mi puikon thei, Juda ho moh thusimle miho thupeh ah lunglut dauhen.
English: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

tcz: Alung theng dinga imajouse thengsoh kei ahi, ahinlah akisuboh atahsanlouho ding vanga athenga khatcha umlou ahi, ajeh chu alunggel ule selepha hetna alungsungu bohji a ahi.
en: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
text:
TIT 1:15
Thadou: Alung theng dinga imajouse thengsoh kei ahi, ahinlah akisuboh atahsanlouho ding vanga athenga khatcha umlou ahi, ajeh chu alunggel ule selepha hetna alungsungu bohji a ahi.
English: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

tcz: Hitobang miho chun akamsunguva Pathen kahenai tin aphongdoh nauvin, ahinlah ahinkho mandan uvin aseilep un ahi. Amaho chu thet umtah, thungailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama panna bei ahiuve.
en: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
text:
TIT 1:16
Thadou: Hitobang miho chun akamsunguva Pathen kahenai tin aphongdoh nauvin, ahinlah ahinkho mandan uvin aseilep un ahi. Amaho chu thet umtah, thungailou ahiuvin, thilpha bolna lama panna bei ahiuve.
English: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

tcz: Titus, nangman vang, kithuhilna dihtah dungjuiya hinkho manding dan domsang in.
en: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
text:
TIT 2:1
Thadou: Titus, nangman vang, kithuhilna dihtah dungjuiya hinkho manding dan domsang in.
English: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

tcz: Upa lang jep ho chu mi kitim them, ja umtah, lunglimgeh cha a hing, ahithei na diuvin hil'in. Amaho chun tahsan dettah aneiyuva chule ngailutna lethohhat na a adimset diu ngai ahi.
en: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
text:
TIT 2:2
Thadou: Upa lang jep ho chu mi kitim them, ja umtah, lunglimgeh cha a hing, ahithei na diuvin hil'in. Amaho chun tahsan dettah aneiyuva chule ngailutna lethohhat na a adimset diu ngai ahi.
English: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

tcz: Chutobangma chun, nupi tehse lang jep ho jong chu Pathen jatah'a hinkho mang din hil'in. Amaho chu mihehse hatle ju a lop hilouva, chusanga midang thilpha ipi ahi ahildiu ahi.
en: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
text:
TIT 2:3
Thadou: Chutobangma chun, nupi tehse lang jep ho jong chu Pathen jatah'a hinkho mang din hil'in. Amaho chu mihehse hatle ju a lop hilouva, chusanga midang thilpha ipi ahi ahildiu ahi.
English: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

tcz: Hiche nupi tehse lang jep hochun nutil khangdongho chu ainneipute chengu ngailut leh achateu ngailutje ahil diu,
en: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
text:
TIT 2:4
Thadou: Hiche nupi tehse lang jep hochun nutil khangdongho chu ainneipute chengu ngailut leh achateu ngailutje ahil diu,
English: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

tcz: Lung limgeh le thengsel'a umding, ama in'a natong mi hiding, chule naphatong le ainneiputeu noiya kun ahina diuva ahildiu ahi. Chutile Pathen thu chu jachatna a asosah lou diu ahi.
en: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
text:
TIT 2:5
Thadou: Lung limgeh le thengsel'a umding, ama in'a natong mi hiding, chule naphatong le ainneiputeu noiya kun ahina diuva ahildiu ahi. Chutile Pathen thu chu jachatna a asosah lou diu ahi.
English: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

tcz: Hitobang machun, khangdong ho chu limgeh cha-a hingdin tilkhouvin.
en: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
text:
TIT 2:6
Thadou: Hitobang machun, khangdong ho chu limgeh cha-a hingdin tilkhouvin.
English: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

tcz: Chule nangma tah jong imalam jousea amahon thilpha bolna lama avettoh a ajui nadingun um'in.
en: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
text:
TIT 2:7
Thadou: Chule nangma tah jong imalam jousea amahon thilpha bolna lama avettoh a ajui nadingun um'in.
English: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

tcz: Thutah chu hilin, chutileh nathuhil chu adem thei lou dingu ahi. Chuteng eiho dem'a pang hochu jahchauva chule ichunguva seiding ima aneilou dingu ahi.
en: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
text:
TIT 2:8
Thadou: Thutah chu hilin, chutileh nathuhil chu adem thei lou dingu ahi. Chuteng eiho dem'a pang hochu jahchauva chule ichunguva seiding ima aneilou dingu ahi.
English: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

tcz: Sohho chun apakaihou thuphat jousea angai jing dingu chule ajochan uva alunglhaisah diu ahi. Amahon nelkal dauhen,
en: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
text:
TIT 2:9
Thadou: Sohho chun apakaihou thuphat jousea angai jing dingu chule ajochan uva alunglhaisah diu ahi. Amahon nelkal dauhen,
English: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

tcz: ahilouleh guhchat bol dauhen, amavang imalam jouseah ginchat theile apha ahinau vetsah uhen. Chuteng eihuhhing uva Pathen chungchang a kithuhilna chu dei umtah asodoh dingu ahi.
en: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
text:
TIT 2:10
Thadou: ahilouleh guhchat bol dauhen, amavang imalam jouseah ginchat theile apha ahinau vetsah uhen. Chuteng eihuhhing uva Pathen chungchang a kithuhilna chu dei umtah asodoh dingu ahi.
English: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

tcz: Ajehchu Pathen mihepina hung kilah-a mijouse huhhing na chu ahinlhut ahitai.
en: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
text:
TIT 2:11
Thadou: Ajehchu Pathen mihepina hung kilah-a mijouse huhhing na chu ahinlhut ahitai.
English: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

tcz: Chuleh eiho Pathen ngaisah lou nale chonset nopsahna a kona kiheimang dinga kihilchah ihiuve. Hiche gitlouna leiset a hi lunglima, chondihna a chule Pathen ngaisahna neiya ikhosah dingu ahi,
en: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

tcz: chutia kinep umtah chuche nikho loupitah Pathen hatchungnung le eihuhhing uva Yeshua Christa loupina hung kilah ding ni chu katjinga um ihiu ahi.
en: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,
text:
TIT 2:13
Thadou: chutia kinep umtah chuche nikho loupitah Pathen hatchungnung le eihuhhing uva Yeshua Christa loupina hung kilah ding ni chu katjinga um ihiu ahi.
English: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

tcz: Aman chonsetna jousea kon eisoptheng diu, i-onthol nadiu, chule ama mitea eisem uva napha tong dinga apumpia kiphaltheng ihina ding uva ahinkho manbeiya eipeh u ahi.
en: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
text:
TIT 2:14
Thadou: Aman chonsetna jousea kon eisoptheng diu, i-onthol nadiu, chule ama mitea eisem uva napha tong dinga apumpia kiphaltheng ihina ding uva ahinkho manbeiya eipeh u ahi.
English: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

tcz: Nangman hichengse hi nahil'a chule tahsan chate chun abol diuva natilkhou ding ahi. Angaikhoh dungjuiya nangman amaho suhdih na tha nanei ahi, hijeh chun koimacha nathusei nahsahmo bolsah hihhel in.
en: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
text:
TIT 2:15
Thadou: Nangman hichengse hi nahil'a chule tahsan chate chun abol diuva natilkhou ding ahi. Angaikhoh dungjuiya nangman amaho suhdih na tha nanei ahi, hijeh chun koimacha nathusei nahsahmo bolsah hihhel in.
English: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

tcz: Tahsan chate chu solkal le avaipoho thunoiya umdingin geldohsah in. Amaho chu seingai, thilpha boldia phat jousea kigosadema umjing hidiu ahi.
en: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
text:
TIT 3:1
Thadou: Tahsan chate chu solkal le avaipoho thunoiya umdingin geldohsah in. Amaho chu seingai, thilpha boldia phat jousea kigosadema umjing hidiu ahi.
English: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

tcz: Amahon mi seisetle kinah abollou diu ahi. Chusanga nunnem nale kineosahna dihtah chu mijouse avetsah diu ahi.
en: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
text:
TIT 3:2
Thadou: Amahon mi seisetle kinah abollou diu ahi. Chusanga nunnem nale kineosahna dihtah chu mijouse avetsah diu ahi.
English: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

tcz: Eihojong, khatvei chu, lungthimbei le seingailou inahiu ahi. Eiho lamdihlou lama puilonlea inaum uva chule tahsa lungngaichat le nomsahna tamtah soh a inaum'u ahi. Ihinkhou chu gitlouna le kithangsetto naa dima, chule khatle khat kihotoa ina umu ahi.
en: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
text:
TIT 3:3
Thadou: Eihojong, khatvei chu, lungthimbei le seingailou inahiu ahi. Eiho lamdihlou lama puilonlea inaum uva chule tahsa lungngaichat le nomsahna tamtah soh a inaum'u ahi. Ihinkhou chu gitlouna le kithangsetto naa dima, chule khatle khat kihotoa ina umu ahi.
English: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

tcz: Ahinlah–“Eihuhhing uva Pathen chun amingailut nale khotona ahin tahlang phat chun,
en: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
text:
TIT 3:4
Thadou: Ahinlah–“Eihuhhing uva Pathen chun amingailut nale khotona ahin tahlang phat chun,
English: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

tcz: aman eihuhhing tauve, eiho chonphat vang le natoh vang hilouvin amihepina vang'in. Aman ichonsetnau jouse asoptheng in, penthahna eipeuvin, Lhagao theng vang'in hinkhothah eipeuvin ahi.
en: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
text:
TIT 3:5
Thadou: aman eihuhhing tauve, eiho chonphat vang le natoh vang hilouvin amihepina vang'in. Aman ichonsetnau jouse asoptheng in, penthahna eipeuvin, Lhagao theng vang'in hinkhothah eipeuvin ahi.
English: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

tcz: Aman hongphal tah in Yeshua Christa vang'in ichunguvah Lhagao theng chu abunglhan ahi.
en: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

tcz: Amihepina vang'in michonphan eisimun chule tonsot vangou lodia kisonna eipe tauve.”
en: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
text:
TIT 3:7
Thadou: Amihepina vang'in michonphan eisimun chule tonsot vangou lodia kisonna eipe tauve.”
English: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

tcz: Hichehi tahsan umtaha kisei ahi, chule nangman hiche thuhil hi hatah a nadopsang ding kadeiye chutia chu Pathen tahsan ho chun thilpha bolding agelkhoh nadingun. Hiche thuhil hohi pha a chule mijouse dinga phachomtah ahi.
en: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

tcz: Ngolhoi thua kihoulimna hole khanggui thua kinel bautam Judaho danthu dola kinah, hichenga kon chun kikhindoh in, hitiho chu phatchom nading ahipoi, phat mansah bep ahibouve.
en: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
text:
TIT 3:9
Thadou: Ngolhoi thua kihoulimna hole khanggui thua kinel bautam Judaho danthu dola kinah, hichenga kon chun kikhindoh in, hitiho chu phatchom nading ahipoi, phat mansah bep ahibouve.
English: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

tcz: Mihon nalah uva kibung khenna asemuleh, amaho chu khatvei nivei gihsal in. Akalse limsah tahih in.
en: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
text:
TIT 3:10
Thadou: Mihon nalah uva kibung khenna asemuleh, amaho chu khatvei nivei gihsal in. Akalse limsah tahih in.
English: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

tcz: Ajeh chu chutobang miho chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahiuvin, amaho le amaho achonset nauvin themmo achan ahi.
en: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
text:
TIT 3:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu chutobang miho chu lamvaija chule chonsejia ahiuvin, amaho le amaho achonset nauvin themmo achan ahi.
English: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

tcz: Keman Artimas ahilouleh Tychichus nahenga kahin solgot ahi. Khat pen pen ahunglhun lhon tengleh Nicopolis a ahithei chan in kimupi ding neigon, ajeh chu, chukoma chu phalbi sungsea umdia kakigel lhah ahitai.
en: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
text:
TIT 3:12
Thadou: Keman Artimas ahilouleh Tychichus nahenga kahin solgot ahi. Khat pen pen ahunglhun lhon tengleh Nicopolis a ahithei chan in kimupi ding neigon, ajeh chu, chukoma chu phalbi sungsea umdia kakigel lhah ahitai.
English: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

tcz: Dan thusun Zenas le Apollos chu akholjinna lhon'ah nabolthei chan'in kithopin. Angaichat lhon jouse bolpeh a aumna dingin vesuiyin.
en: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
text:
TIT 3:13
Thadou: Dan thusun Zenas le Apollos chu akholjinna lhon'ah nabolthei chan'in kithopin. Angaichat lhon jouse bolpeh a aumna dingin vesuiyin.
English: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

tcz: Imiteu jong chun midang ngaichat khohtah tah neiho chunga thilpha bol na lamah kiha bol uhen, chutileh gasolouva umloudiu ahi.
en: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
text:
TIT 3:14
Thadou: Imiteu jong chun midang ngaichat khohtah tah neiho chunga thilpha bol na lamah kiha bol uhen, chutileh gasolouva umloudiu ahi.
English: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

tcz: Hikoma kaum khompi chengsen nasalamui. Lungsettah in, tahsan chate eingailuho jouse salam einapeh pih'un. Pathen mihepinan nabonchavin naumpi jing tauhen.
en: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
text:
TIT 3:15
Thadou: Hikoma kaum khompi chengsen nasalamui. Lungsettah in, tahsan chate eingailuho jouse salam einapeh pih'un. Pathen mihepinan nabonchavin naumpi jing tauhen.
English: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Paul a kon in salam Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua chung chang a Kipana Thupha seiphongjeh a songkullut Paul le sopi Timothy teni a kon ahi. Keiman ngailut umtah, tohkhompi, Philemon henga,
en: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
text:
PHM 1:1
Thadou: Paul a kon in salam Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua chung chang a Kipana Thupha seiphongjeh a songkullut Paul le sopi Timothy teni a kon ahi. Keiman ngailut umtah, tohkhompi, Philemon henga,
English: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

tcz: chule isopinu'u Apphia chule kasepai chankhompiu Archippus, chule na-in'a kikhom houbung henga dinga kahinsut ahi.
en: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
text:
PHM 1:2
Thadou: chule isopinu'u Apphia chule kasepai chankhompiu Archippus, chule na-in'a kikhom houbung henga dinga kahinsut ahi.
English: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

tcz: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le lungmon napeu hen.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
PHM 1:3
Thadou: I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le lungmon napeu hen.
English: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Philemon, nangma dinga katao tengleh ka Pathen kathangvah jingin ahi.
en: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,
text:
PHM 1:4
Thadou: Philemon, nangma dinga katao tengleh ka Pathen kathangvah jingin ahi.
English: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pakai Yeshuan atahsan le Pathen mite jouse nangailut thudol kana jajingin ahi.
en: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,
text:
PHM 1:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pakai Yeshuan atahsan le Pathen mite jouse nangailut thudol kana jajingin ahi.
English: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

tcz: Chule eihon Christa a ineiyu thilpha jouse hetna le hetchetna hin nanga um natahsan chu thilpha boldohna asona dingin kataopeh jinge.
en: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.
text:
PHM 1:6
Thadou: Chule eihon Christa a ineiyu thilpha jouse hetna le hetchetna hin nanga um natahsan chu thilpha boldohna asona dingin kataopeh jinge.
English: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

tcz: Kasopi, nangman Pathen mite nahepina hin alungthimu nasuhalin, na-mingailutna hin kipana tahbeh le lungmonna eipei.
en: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
text:
PHM 1:7
Thadou: Kasopi, nangman Pathen mite nahepina hin alungthimu nasuhalin, na-mingailutna hin kipana tahbeh le lungmonna eipei.
English: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman lung ngamtah a napanpina Christa jal'a kangeh hi nangman naboltei dia kilomtah ahi.
en: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,
text:
PHM 1:8
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keiman lung ngamtah a napanpina Christa jal'a kangeh hi nangman naboltei dia kilomtah ahi.
English: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

tcz: Hinlah ikingailutna jaljeh a, keiman kahin ngehnom joh ahi. Hiche hi keima, kum upa tah le Christa Yeshua jal'a tupet'a songkullut, Paul'a kona taona ahi, tin neigelpeh in.
en: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
text:
PHM 1:9
Thadou: Hinlah ikingailutna jaljeh a, keiman kahin ngehnom joh ahi. Hiche hi keima, kum upa tah le Christa Yeshua jal'a tupet'a songkullut, Paul'a kona taona ahi, tin neigelpeh in.
English: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

tcz: Keiman hiche kacha Onesimus hi nakhotona namusah dinga kangeh nahi. Keima songkul'a kaumpet in tahsanjal'in apa kahung hi.
en: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,
text:
PHM 1:10
Thadou: Keiman hiche kacha Onesimus hi nakhotona namusah dinga kangeh nahi. Keima songkul'a kaumpet in tahsanjal'in apa kahung hi.
English: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

tcz: Tumasanga chu Onesimus hi nangma dinga phachomlou anahi maithei ahi, hinla tua amahi eini dinga phatchomna higela ahitai.
en: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
text:
PHM 1:11
Thadou: Tumasanga chu Onesimus hi nangma dinga phachomlou anahi maithei ahi, hinla tua amahi eini dinga phatchomna higela ahitai.
English: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

tcz: Keiman amahi nahenga dingin kalungthim pumin kahinsole.
en: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
text:
PHM 1:12
Thadou: Keiman amahi nahenga dingin kalungthim pumin kahinsole.
English: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

tcz: Keiman amahi hiche thihkhaova kakihen sunga hi Kipana Thupha seiphongnaa nangma thalhenga eikithopi dia umdensah ding kalunggon ahi.
en: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.
text:
PHM 1:13
Thadou: Keiman amahi hiche thihkhaova kakihen sunga hi Kipana Thupha seiphongnaa nangma thalhenga eikithopi dia umdensah ding kalunggon ahi.
English: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

tcz: Hinlah nangma phalpehna louvin imacha kabol nompoi. Nangma lungchamtah a neikithopi ding, seihat vanga bolchu hidahen kati ahi.
en: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
text:
PHM 1:14
Thadou: Hinlah nangma phalpehna louvin imacha kabol nompoi. Nangma lungchamtah a neikithopi ding, seihat vanga bolchu hidahen kati ahi.
English: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

tcz: Nangman phat chomkhat a dinga Onesimus hi namansah chu aitih a naumpiden theina ding hinte.
en: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
text:
PHM 1:15
Thadou: Nangman phat chomkhat a dinga Onesimus hi namansah chu aitih a naumpiden theina ding hinte.
English: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

tcz: Amahi nangma a dinga soh chu hijomtalouva, soh sanga chungnungjo, sopi deium dehset, keima dinga hung hi ahitai.
en: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.
text:
PHM 1:16
Thadou: Amahi nangma a dinga soh chu hijomtalouva, soh sanga chungnungjo, sopi deium dehset, keima dinga hung hi ahitai.
English: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

tcz: Hijeh chun keima hi natoh khompia neigela ahileh keima neilem ding tobang chun amahi analemin.
en: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
text:
PHM 1:17
Thadou: Hijeh chun keima hi natoh khompia neigela ahileh keima neilem ding tobang chun amahi analemin.
English: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

tcz: Aman nangma chu ipipena alamlouva nabolna umkham, aman bat nanei aumkhah a ahijongleh hichu keima bat in sun in.
en: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
text:
PHM 1:18
Thadou: Aman nangma chu ipipena alamlouva nabolna umkham, aman bat nanei aumkhah a ahijongleh hichu keima bat in sun in.
English: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

tcz: Keimatah Paul in kakhuttah a hiche hi kajih ahi: Keiman sahpeh nange. Chule keiman nangin lhagaova neibat chu neisah dingin seiponge.
en: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).
text:
PHM 1:19
Thadou: Keimatah Paul in kakhuttah a hiche hi kajih ahi: Keiman sahpeh nange. Chule keiman nangin lhagaova neibat chu neisah dingin seiponge.
English: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

tcz: Tahbeh in, kasopi, Pakai jal'in hiche hi nei gelkhoh peh'in kati ahi. Christa ah hiche tilkhouna hi neipen.
en: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.
text:
PHM 1:20
Thadou: Tahbeh in, kasopi, Pakai jal'in hiche hi nei gelkhoh peh'in kati ahi. Christa ah hiche tilkhouna hi neipen.
English: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

tcz: Keiman, hiche lekhathot kajih hin, kangeh banga aphajocheh a nabol ding kaging chai.
en: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.
text:
PHM 1:21
Thadou: Keiman, hiche lekhathot kajih hin, kangeh banga aphajocheh a nabol ding kaging chai.
English: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

tcz: Chukal val'in, keima dingin lhunna ding indan neinagonpeh in, ajehchu Pathen in nataonaho asan a chule keima nahenga kahung vahjet kit ding kakineme.
en: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.
text:
PHM 1:22
Thadou: Chukal val'in, keima dingin lhunna ding indan neinagonpeh in, ajehchu Pathen in nataonaho asan a chule keima nahenga kahung vahjet kit ding kakineme.
English: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

tcz: Christa Yeshua a songkul kalutpi Epaphras hin nangma lemnathu aseiye.
en: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
text:
PHM 1:23
Thadou: Christa Yeshua a songkul kalutpi Epaphras hin nangma lemnathu aseiye.
English: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

tcz: Chutima chun Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule katohkhompi Luke teho hin nangho lemnathu aseiyuve.
en: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.
text:
PHM 1:24
Thadou: Chutima chun Mark, Aristarchus, Demas chule katohkhompi Luke teho hin nangho lemnathu aseiyuve.
English: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

tcz: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagao umpi hen.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
text:
PHM 1:25
Thadou: Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna chun nalhagao umpi hen.
English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

tcz: Masanglai chun Pathen in tamtahvei chule gotchom chomin ipu ipateu henga themgao hoa konin thu anaseiye.
en: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
text:
HEB 1:1
Thadou: Masanglai chun Pathen in tamtahvei chule gotchom chomin ipu ipateu henga themgao hoa konin thu anaseiye.
English: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

tcz: Chule tuphat nunung pena hin Aman eiho henga Achapa a konin thu ahinseitai. Pathen in Chapa chu ijakai goulo dinga athutep sa ahin chule Chapa a kona vannoi pumpihi anasem ahi.
en: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
text:
HEB 1:2
Thadou: Chule tuphat nunung pena hin Aman eiho henga Achapa a konin thu ahinseitai. Pathen in Chapa chu ijakai goulo dinga athutep sa ahin chule Chapa a kona vannoi pumpihi anasem ahi.
English: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

tcz: Chapa chun Pathen loupina vah akilahdoh sah in, chule Pathen chondan dihtah chu aphongdoh tan ahi, chule Aman athupeh thahattah jal'a ijakai atuhchah ahi. Aman ichonsetnauva kona eisilngim jouvu phat chun, Ama jabolna mun Pathen jetlam'a atouvin, Van mun'a loupitah in atoutai.
en: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,
text:
HEB 1:3
Thadou: Chapa chun Pathen loupina vah akilahdoh sah in, chule Pathen chondan dihtah chu aphongdoh tan ahi, chule Aman athupeh thahattah jal'a ijakai atuhchah ahi. Aman ichonsetnauva kona eisilngim jouvu phat chun, Ama jabolna mun Pathen jetlam'a atouvin, Van mun'a loupitah in atoutai.
English: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

tcz: Hichun avetsah chu, Pathen in apeh min chu amaho minsanga chungnungjo ahi tobanga chu, Chapa chu vantil ho sanga gamchenga chungnungjo ahi.
en: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
text:
HEB 1:4
Thadou: Hichun avetsah chu, Pathen in apeh min chu amaho minsanga chungnungjo ahi tobanga chu, Chapa chu vantil ho sanga gamchenga chungnungjo ahi.
English: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Yeshua koma asei chu vantil ho khatpen komah, “Nangma kachapa nahi, tunia hi keima napa kahung hi ahitai,” tin aseidoh khapoi, Chule Pathen in, “Keima Apa hingting, chule Ama kachapa hiding ahi,” tin aseikit in ahi.
en: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”
text:
HEB 1:5
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in Yeshua koma asei chu vantil ho khatpen komah, “Nangma kachapa nahi, tunia hi keima napa kahung hi ahitai,” tin aseidoh khapoi, Chule Pathen in, “Keima Apa hingting, chule Ama kachapa hiding ahi,” tin aseikit in ahi.
English: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

tcz: Chule Aman achapa chungnungpen chu vannoiya ahinpui chun, Pathen in, “Pathen vantil ho jousen Ama houcheh un.”
en: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”
text:
HEB 1:6
Thadou: Chule Aman achapa chungnungpen chu vannoiya ahinpui chun, Pathen in, “Pathen vantil ho jousen Ama houcheh un.”
English: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

tcz: Vantil ho thudola Aman aseijin, “Aman avantilte chu hui bangin asoldoh in, asohte chu meikongto abahsah e,” ati.
en: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”
text:
HEB 1:7
Thadou: Vantil ho thudola Aman aseijin, “Aman avantilte chu hui bangin asoldoh in, asohte chu meikongto abahsah e,” ati.
English: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

tcz: Hinlah aman Chapa jah a, “Vo Pathen, nalaltouna chu atonsot tonsot'in aum jinge, nangman leng tenggola thutah'in vai napon ahi.
en: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.
text:
HEB 1:8
Thadou: Hinlah aman Chapa jah a, “Vo Pathen, nalaltouna chu atonsot tonsot'in aum jinge, nangman leng tenggola thutah'in vai napon ahi.
English: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

tcz: Nangman thutandih nadeijin, chule aphalou nahotbol e. Hijeh a chu vo Pathen, na Pathen in thaonanua, kipana thao chu midang chung sanga nachunga asunlhah ahitai,” ati.
en: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”
text:
HEB 1:9
Thadou: Nangman thutandih nadeijin, chule aphalou nahotbol e. Hijeh a chu vo Pathen, na Pathen in thaonanua, kipana thao chu midang chung sanga nachunga asunlhah ahitai,” ati.
English: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

tcz: Aman Chapa jah a aseikit in, “Vo Pakai, atil in, nangman leiset bulhi nanaphutdoh in, chule van hohi nakhuttah a nasem ahi.
en: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.
text:
HEB 1:10
Thadou: Aman Chapa jah a aseikit in, “Vo Pakai, atil in, nangman leiset bulhi nanaphutdoh in, chule van hohi nakhuttah a nasem ahi.
English: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

tcz: Hiche hohi mangthah diu, hinlah Nangma aitih a umjing ding nahi. Hiche hohi ponbanga chul lhaloi dingu ahi.
en: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.
text:
HEB 1:11
Thadou: Hiche hohi mangthah diu, hinlah Nangma aitih a umjing ding nahi. Hiche hohi ponbanga chul lhaloi dingu ahi.
English: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

tcz: Nangman hicheho hi pon kijeltum banga najeltum ding, ponlui banga napaidoh ding ahi. Hinla nangma angai chu nahi jingin; nangma aitih a nahin jing ding ahi,” ati.
en: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”
text:
HEB 1:12
Thadou: Nangman hicheho hi pon kijeltum banga najeltum ding, ponlui banga napaidoh ding ahi. Hinla nangma angai chu nahi jingin; nangma aitih a nahin jing ding ahi,” ati.
English: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

tcz: Chule Pathen chun vantil ho khatpen koma, “Namelmate kasuhnema nakengphang noiya kakoi masangsen, kakhut jetlam jabolna a touvin,” tin aseikhapoi.
en: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”
text:
HEB 1:13
Thadou: Chule Pathen chun vantil ho khatpen koma, “Namelmate kasuhnema nakengphang noiya kakoi masangsen, kakhut jetlam jabolna a touvin,” tin aseikhapoi.
English: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

tcz: Hijeh chun vantil ho hi lhachabou ahiuvin-huhhingna gouloding ho kinbol dinga kisoldoh lhagaoho ahibouvui.
en: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
text:
HEB 1:14
Thadou: Hijeh chun vantil ho hi lhachabou ahiuvin-huhhingna gouloding ho kinbol dinga kisoldoh lhagaoho ahibouvui.
English: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a chu eihon ithujah u thutah hi chingtheitah a ingaidiu ahi, achuti louva ahileh hichea kona hi ikiheimang theiyu ahi.
en: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
text:
HEB 2:1
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh a chu eihon ithujah u thutah hi chingtheitah a ingaidiu ahi, achuti louva ahileh hichea kona hi ikiheimang theiyu ahi.
English: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in vantil hoa kona apehdoh Athu chu adingdet jingin, chule dan palkeh le seingai louho chu atotoh in engbolna achangjiuvin ahi.
en: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
text:
HEB 2:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in vantil hoa kona apehdoh Athu chu adingdet jingin, chule dan palkeh le seingai louho chu atotoh in engbolna achangjiuvin ahi.
English: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

tcz: Hiti ahijeh achu hiche Huhhingna loupitah, amasatah a Pakai Yeshua Christa amatah in aphondoh chule chujouva Athusei jahon eiho henga ahung phondohson u, hi isahlouva ikoi uleh, ahoidoh dinga iti ikigeltheiyu ahidem?
en: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
text:
HEB 2:3
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh achu hiche Huhhingna loupitah, amasatah a Pakai Yeshua Christa amatah in aphondoh chule chujouva Athusei jahon eiho henga ahung phondohson u, hi isahlouva ikoi uleh, ahoidoh dinga iti ikigeltheiyu ahidem?
English: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

tcz: Chule Pathen in Athusei chu aphudetna dinga melchihna ho le thil kidang ho chule bolmo kidang jatchom chomho chule Lhagao thilpeh, aman alhendoh phat phat'a, apeh ahi.
en: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
text:
HEB 2:4
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Athusei chu aphudetna dinga melchihna ho le thil kidang ho chule bolmo kidang jatchom chomho chule Lhagao thilpeh, aman alhendoh phat phat'a, apeh ahi.
English: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

tcz: Chule akalvalin, tua iseiyu ahung lhung ding vannoi jong vantil ho thuneina ding ahipoi.
en: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
text:
HEB 2:5
Thadou: Chule akalvalin, tua iseiyu ahung lhung ding vannoi jong vantil ho thuneina ding ahipoi.
English: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

tcz: Ajeh chu mun khat ah Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Mihem hi ipi hiya nangman nagelkhoh a, ahilouleh Mihem Chapa hi ipi hiya nakhohsah ham?
en: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
text:
HEB 2:6
Thadou: Ajeh chu mun khat ah Pathen Thubun aseiyin, “Mihem hi ipi hiya nangman nagelkhoh a, ahilouleh Mihem Chapa hi ipi hiya nakhohsah ham?
English: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

tcz: Ahijeng vang'in nangman vantil ho sangin noi nung jon nasemin chule amaho hi loupina le jabolnan lallukhuh nakhuhsah in ahi.
en: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
text:
HEB 2:7
Thadou: Ahijeng vang'in nangman vantil ho sangin noi nung jon nasemin chule amaho hi loupina le jabolnan lallukhuh nakhuhsah in ahi.
English: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

tcz: Nangman thil jouse chungah thuneina napetan ahi” ati. Tua “thil jouse” kitina a hi, imacha ajaolou umlou ahi. Hinla imacha amaho thuneina noiya akikoi akimudoh hihlaiye.
en: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.
text:
HEB 2:8
Thadou: Nangman thil jouse chungah thuneina napetan ahi” ati. Tua “thil jouse” kitina a hi, imacha ajaolou umlou ahi. Hinla imacha amaho thuneina noiya akikoi akimudoh hihlaiye.
English: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

tcz: Eihon imupenu chu Yeshua, vantil ho sanga panmun neojep akikoi chu ahin, chule Aman eiho dinga thina ahungthoh ahi tah jeh in, Ama hi tun “loupina lallukhuh khuhpehna le jabolna achangtan ahi.” Ahi, Pathen lungset in, Yeshuan mitin dingin thina chu ahung tepkha tan ahi.
en: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
text:
HEB 2:9
Thadou: Eihon imupenu chu Yeshua, vantil ho sanga panmun neojep akikoi chu ahin, chule Aman eiho dinga thina ahungthoh ahi tah jeh in, Ama hi tun “loupina lallukhuh khuhpehna le jabolna achangtan ahi.” Ahi, Pathen lungset in, Yeshuan mitin dingin thina chu ahung tepkha tan ahi.
English: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

tcz: Pathen in, chate tamtah loupina a apuilut theina dinga amadinga alhena chule amajala ijakai asem ahi.
en: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
text:
HEB 2:10
Thadou: Pathen in, chate tamtah loupina a apuilut theina dinga amadinga alhena chule amajala ijakai asem ahi.
English: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

tcz: Hiti chun tun Yeshua le aman athenga asemho dingin Pa kibang aneiyu ahitai. Hijeh a chu Yeshua chun asopite tia akouding chu jahcha louva ahi.
en: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
text:
HEB 2:11
Thadou: Hiti chun tun Yeshua le aman athenga asemho dingin Pa kibang aneiyu ahitai. Hijeh a chu Yeshua chun asopite tia akouding chu jahcha louva ahi.
English: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh aman Pathen koma, “Keiman kasopite koma namin kaphondoh ding, Mihonpi kikhop khomna a keiman kavahchoi ding nahi,” ati.
en: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”
text:
HEB 2:12
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh aman Pathen koma, “Keiman kasopite koma namin kaphondoh ding, Mihonpi kikhop khomna a keiman kavahchoi ding nahi,” ati.
English: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

tcz: Aman jong aseijin, “Keiman katahsan achunga kangap ding ahi,” hichu, “Keima le kachate Pathen in eipeh ahitai,” ati.
en: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
text:
HEB 2:13
Thadou: Aman jong aseijin, “Keiman katahsan achunga kangap ding ahi,” hichu, “Keima le kachate Pathen in eipeh ahitai,” ati.
English: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen chate chu mihemho ahiuvin–tahsa le thisana kisem ahiuvin–Chapa jong chu tahsaphele thisan pu ahung hitai. Ajeh chu mihemte ahijal a bou chu thithei ding ahin, chule athi jal a bou thina thaneina neipa Diabol thaneina chu ajoding hiya ahi.
en: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
text:
HEB 2:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen chate chu mihemho ahiuvin–tahsa le thisana kisem ahiuvin–Chapa jong chu tahsaphele thisan pu ahung hitai. Ajeh chu mihemte ahijal a bou chu thithei ding ahin, chule athi jal a bou thina thaneina neipa Diabol thaneina chu ajoding hiya ahi.
English: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

tcz: Hichea kona bou thina kichatna a hinkho mang sohchang ho chamlhatna apehthei ding hiya ahi.
en: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
text:
HEB 2:15
Thadou: Hichea kona bou thina kichatna a hinkho mang sohchang ho chamlhatna apehthei ding hiya ahi.
English: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

tcz: Chapa chu vantil ho kithopi dinga hunga ahipoi tijong iheuvin ahi. Abraham chilhah ho panhu dinga hunga ahi.
en: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
text:
HEB 2:16
Thadou: Chapa chu vantil ho kithopi dinga hunga ahipoi tijong iheuvin ahi. Abraham chilhah ho panhu dinga hunga ahi.
English: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

tcz: Hichejeh a chu, Amatah jong chu imalam jousea eiho, asopite, tobang ahithei nadinga sem ngai ahi, chutia chu ama Pathen masanga lungset them le tahsan umtah thempu chungnung ahithei nadinga ahi. Chujeh a chu aman miho chonset pomang dinga kilhaina abol theibou ahi.
en: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
text:
HEB 2:17
Thadou: Hichejeh a chu, Amatah jong chu imalam jousea eiho, asopite, tobang ahithei nadinga sem ngai ahi, chutia chu ama Pathen masanga lungset them le tahsan umtah thempu chungnung ahithei nadinga ahi. Chujeh a chu aman miho chonset pomang dinga kilhaina abol theibou ahi.
English: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

tcz: Aman thohhahsa athoh lhumkeiya chule patep naho athoh tah jeh a, eihon patepna ichan tengu jongleh aman eipanpi theiyu ahi.
en: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
text:
HEB 2:18
Thadou: Aman thohhahsa athoh lhumkeiya chule patep naho athoh tah jeh a, eihon patepna ichan tengu jongleh aman eipanpi theiyu ahi.
English: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

tcz: Chule hiti chun kasopi deitahte, Pathena nahitah jeh ule vana dinga kikou hoto chan neikhoma nahitah jeh uvin, kaphondoh u hiche Yeshua keihon Pathen thupole Thempu chungnunga kaneiyu hi phatechan geilun.
en: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
text:
HEB 3:1
Thadou: Chule hiti chun kasopi deitahte, Pathena nahitah jeh ule vana dinga kikou hoto chan neikhoma nahitah jeh uvin, kaphondoh u hiche Yeshua keihon Pathen thupole Thempu chungnunga kaneiyu hi phatechan geilun.
English: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Mose chu Pathen insung pumpia akingansena a tahsan umtah ahi bang chun, Ama jong alhengdohpa Pathena dinga tahsan umtah ahi.
en: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
text:
HEB 3:2
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Mose chu Pathen insung pumpia akingansena a tahsan umtah ahi bang chun, Ama jong alhengdohpa Pathena dinga tahsan umtah ahi.
English: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

tcz: Hinlah, Insapa chu ainsah sanga vahchoina achan dinga kilomtah ahi banga Yeshua chu Mose sanga gamchenga loupina chang dinga lomtah ahi.
en: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
text:
HEB 3:3
Thadou: Hinlah, Insapa chu ainsah sanga vahchoina achan dinga kilomtah ahi banga Yeshua chu Mose sanga gamchenga loupina chang dinga lomtah ahi.
English: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh inkhat cheh hi asapa uma ahin, hinla ijakai hinsadohpa chu Pathen ahi.
en: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
text:
HEB 3:4
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh inkhat cheh hi asapa uma ahin, hinla ijakai hinsadohpa chu Pathen ahi.
English: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

tcz: Mose chu sohkhat hina a Pathen in'a tahsan umtah hiya ahi. Ama natoh hi khonunga Pathen in ahin phondoh ding vetsahna hiya ahi.
en: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
text:
HEB 3:5
Thadou: Mose chu sohkhat hina a Pathen in'a tahsan umtah hiya ahi. Ama natoh hi khonunga Pathen in ahin phondoh ding vetsahna hiya ahi.
English: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

tcz: Hinlah Christa chu Chapa hina a Pathen insung pumpia kingansea ahi. Chule eiho Pathen insung hina a ilungngamnau le Christa a ikinepnauva chu ikison jom dingu ahi.
en: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
text:
HEB 3:6
Thadou: Hinlah Christa chu Chapa hina a Pathen insung pumpia kingansea ahi. Chule eiho Pathen insung hina a ilungngamnau le Christa a ikinepnauva chu ikison jom dingu ahi.
English: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

tcz: Hijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiye, “Tunia nanghon a aw najah uva ahileh,
en: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
text:
HEB 3:7
Thadou: Hijeh chun Lhagao Thengin aseiye, “Tunia nanghon a aw najah uva ahileh,
English: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

tcz: Israelten keima gamthip a eipatep uva, chua dou lungchang aken uva abol bangu chun nalungu tahsah hih un.
en: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
text:
HEB 3:8
Thadou: Israelten keima gamthip a eipatep uva, chua dou lungchang aken uva abol bangu chun nalungu tahsah hih un.
English: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

tcz: Chupet chun napu napa teuvin kum som li jen thil kidang kanabol ho anamu jeng vangun, eipatep un chule kathohhatna eiveuvin.
en: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
text:
HEB 3:9
Thadou: Chupet chun napu napa teuvin kum som li jen thil kidang kanabol ho anamu jeng vangun, eipatep un chule kathohhatna eiveuvin.
English: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

tcz: Hitichun keima amaho chunga kana lunghang in, chule kaseiyin, ‘Alungthimu keiya konin akiheimang jingun ahi. Keiman kasei thua anung nom pouve.’
en: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
text:
HEB 3:10
Thadou: Hitichun keima amaho chunga kana lunghang in, chule kaseiyin, ‘Alungthimu keiya konin akiheimang jingun ahi. Keiman kasei thua anung nom pouve.’
English: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

tcz: Hijeh a chu kalunghanna a kahahsel amaho keima choldona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve, kati ahi.”
en: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
text:
HEB 3:11
Thadou: Hijeh a chu kalunghanna a kahahsel amaho keima choldona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve, kati ahi.”
English: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

tcz: Chuti ahileh sopi deitahte, Pathen hing jinga kona kiheimangna aso louna dingin chingtheiyun, lungthim gitlouna le tahsanlelna neihih un.
en: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

tcz: Tuni akiti thei petcha hin nangho khatle khat kihilchah uvin, hiti chun bolleu chun nangho lah a koima chonset a lhalut le Pathen dounaa lungtah naumlou dingu ahitai.
en: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
text:
HEB 3:13
Thadou: Tuni akiti thei petcha hin nangho khatle khat kihilchah uvin, hiti chun bolleu chun nangho lah a koima chonset a lhalut le Pathen dounaa lungtah naumlou dingu ahitai.
English: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho achaina geiya Pathen songa ithoh uva itahsan masah pet uva banga idindet uva ahileh, Christa toh aneijousea chu chan neikhoma ihi dingu ahitai.
en: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
text:
HEB 3:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu eiho achaina geiya Pathen songa ithoh uva itahsan masah pet uva banga idindet uva ahileh, Christa toh aneijousea chu chan neikhoma ihi dingu ahitai.
English: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

tcz: Akisei chu geldoh un, “Tunikhoa a aw najah uva ahileh, Israelten abol bangu chun nanghon nalungu tahsah cheh hih un.”
en: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
text:
HEB 3:15
Thadou: Akisei chu geldoh un, “Tunikhoa a aw najah uva ahileh, Israelten abol bangu chun nanghon nalungu tahsah cheh hih un.”
English: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

tcz: Chule koi hiuvem amaho a aw ajah jeng vanguva Pathen douna a kimangchaho chu? Mosen Egypt a kona ahinpuidoh ho chu hilou ham?
en: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
text:
HEB 3:16
Thadou: Chule koi hiuvem amaho a aw ajah jeng vanguva Pathen douna a kimangchaho chu? Mosen Egypt a kona ahinpuidoh ho chu hilou ham?
English: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

tcz: Chule koiham kum somli jen Pathen lung hansah ho chu? Amaho chu chonsetbol mipite, atahsau long damsa gamthip'a kijamden ho chu hilou ham?
en: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
text:
HEB 3:17
Thadou: Chule koiham kum somli jen Pathen lung hansah ho chu? Amaho chu chonsetbol mipite, atahsau long damsa gamthip'a kijamden ho chu hilou ham?
English: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

tcz: Chule Pathen in kihahselna aneipet a kacholngahna a lut louhel dingu ahi atia chu koiho koma thu aseiyem? Asei ngailou miho koma hilou ham?
en: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
text:
HEB 3:18
Thadou: Chule Pathen in kihahselna aneipet a kacholngahna a lut louhel dingu ahi atia chu koiho koma thu aseiyem? Asei ngailou miho koma hilou ham?
English: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

tcz: Hiti chun amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin acholngahna ah aluttapouve ti imutauve.
en: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
text:
HEB 3:19
Thadou: Hiti chun amahon atahsan lou jeh uvin acholngahna ah aluttapouve ti imutauve.
English: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

tcz: Acholdona a lut ding thua Pathen kitepna tuchanin adingjing nalaiye. Hijeh a chu, nalah uva mi phabep khattou chuche thutep chu tepkhalou ding naum khahdiu kichatna a eiho kichatah le kithing puma iumdiu ahi.
en: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
text:
HEB 4:1
Thadou: Acholdona a lut ding thua Pathen kitepna tuchanin adingjing nalaiye. Hijeh a chu, nalah uva mi phabep khattou chuche thutep chu tepkhalou ding naum khahdiu kichatna a eiho kichatah le kithing puma iumdiu ahi.
English: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh hiche Kipana Thupha Pathen in kicholdona a asem hi-amaho koma akiphongdoh ahitah banga eiho koma jong kiphongdoh a ahitai. Hinla amahon aphatchompi pouve, ajeh chu amahon Pathen sei ngaiho tahsan chu akikoppi pouve.
en: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.
text:
HEB 4:2
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh hiche Kipana Thupha Pathen in kicholdona a asem hi-amaho koma akiphongdoh ahitah banga eiho koma jong kiphongdoh a ahitai. Hinla amahon aphatchompi pouve, ajeh chu amahon Pathen sei ngaiho tahsan chu akikoppi pouve.
English: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

tcz: Ajeh chu eiho atahsan ho hi acholngahna a lutthei ihiuve. Hinla adangho dingin vang Pathen in, “Kalunghanna a kahahsel ahi: Amaho kacholdona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve,” ati. Hiche cholngahna hi vannoi asemlaiya pat a gotsa akoi ahivangin.
en: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
text:
HEB 4:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu eiho atahsan ho hi acholngahna a lutthei ihiuve. Hinla adangho dingin vang Pathen in, “Kalunghanna a kahahsel ahi: Amaho kacholdona a lutlouhel ding ahiuve,” ati. Hiche cholngahna hi vannoi asemlaiya pat a gotsa akoi ahivangin.
English: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

tcz: Hiche hi gotsa koi ahi ti ihetnau ajeh chu Pathen Thubu munkhat'ah ni sagi thudol hitihin akisune, “Ni sagi nin Pathen anatoh na jousea konin akicholdo tai.”
en: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
text:
HEB 4:4
Thadou: Hiche hi gotsa koi ahi ti ihetnau ajeh chu Pathen Thubu munkhat'ah ni sagi thudol hitihin akisune, “Ni sagi nin Pathen anatoh na jousea konin akicholdo tai.”
English: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

tcz: Hinlah munchom khatma ah Pathen in, “Amaho kacholdona muna lutlouhel dingu ahi,” ati.
en: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”
text:
HEB 4:5
Thadou: Hinlah munchom khatma ah Pathen in, “Amaho kacholdona muna lutlouhel dingu ahi,” ati.
English: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen choldona chu miho luttheina dingin aume, hinla hiche Kipana Thupha jamasaho chun Pathen sei angailou jeh uchun alut theitapouve.
en: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
text:
HEB 4:6
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen choldona chu miho luttheina dingin aume, hinla hiche Kipana Thupha jamasaho chun Pathen sei angailou jeh uchun alut theitapouve.
English: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

tcz: Hiti chun Pathen in acholdona a luttheina dingin phat chomkhat agonpeh in, chule hiche phat chu tunihi ahi. Pathen in hiche hi David a konin khonung in anaphongdoh in, “Tunia Ama aw najah tengleh, nalung tahsah hih un,” atikit in ahi.
en: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”
text:
HEB 4:7
Thadou: Hiti chun Pathen in acholdona a luttheina dingin phat chomkhat agonpeh in, chule hiche phat chu tunihi ahi. Pathen in hiche hi David a konin khonung in anaphongdoh in, “Tunia Ama aw najah tengleh, nalung tahsah hih un,” atikit in ahi.
English: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

tcz: Tun Joshua chun hiche choldona hi ananeisah ahitah leh, Pathen in choldona nikhochom hung lhung nalaiding aseitahlou ding ahi.
en: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
text:
HEB 4:8
Thadou: Tun Joshua chun hiche choldona hi ananeisah ahitah leh, Pathen in choldona nikhochom hung lhung nalaiding aseitahlou ding ahi.
English: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

tcz: Hijeh a chu, Pathen mite dinga choldona chombeh khat nga jing ding umnalai ahi.
en: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.
text:
HEB 4:9
Thadou: Hijeh a chu, Pathen mite dinga choldona chombeh khat nga jing ding umnalai ahi.
English: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in vannoi asemjouva acholdo banga chu, Pathen cholngahnaa lut ho chu atohgimnauva kona choldoa ahitauve.
en: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
text:
HEB 4:10
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in vannoi asemjouva acholdo banga chu, Pathen cholngahnaa lut ho chu atohgimnauva kona choldoa ahitauve.
English: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun ijochanun chuche cholngahna a chu lutding kiseh u hite. Hinla eihon Israel mite banga Pathen sei ingailou uleh ilhuh diu ahi.
en: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
text:
HEB 4:11
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun ijochanun chuche cholngahna a chu lutding kiseh u hite. Hinla eihon Israel mite banga Pathen sei ingailou uleh ilhuh diu ahi.
English: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen Thuhi ahinga le thaneitah ahi. Hemto chemjam ahempen sanga jong hemjoa ahin, hinna le lhagao chule gukisuhtona le lhin jong sukhen thei ahi.
en: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
text:
HEB 4:12
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen Thuhi ahinga le thaneitah ahi. Hemto chemjam ahempen sanga jong hemjoa ahin, hinna le lhagao chule gukisuhtona le lhin jong sukhen thei ahi.
English: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

tcz: Thilsem jouse lah a imacha Pathena kona kiselthei aumpoi. Ijakai amitmua sagohkeo chule kihongsa ahi, chule Ama ichonnau jouse sutoh dingpa chu hiya ahi.
en: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
text:
HEB 4:13
Thadou: Thilsem jouse lah a imacha Pathena kona kiselthei aumpoi. Ijakai amitmua sagohkeo chule kihongsa ahi, chule Ama ichonnau jouse sutoh dingpa chu hiya ahi.
English: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

tcz: Hiti chun eihon Thempu chungnung, Pathen Chapa Yeshua, van mun galut ah, chu ineiyu ahitah jeh in, Ama itahsanu hi kolchah jingu hite.
en: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.
text:
HEB 4:14
Thadou: Hiti chun eihon Thempu chungnung, Pathen Chapa Yeshua, van mun galut ah, chu ineiyu ahitah jeh in, Ama itahsanu hi kolchah jingu hite.
English: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

tcz: Hiche ithempu Chungnung uhi ilhahsamnau hethem tah ahi, ajeh chu Aman eiho banga patepna jouse ato ahin, ahivangin chonselou ahiye.
en: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
text:
HEB 4:15
Thadou: Hiche ithempu Chungnung uhi ilhahsamnau hethem tah ahi, ajeh chu Aman eiho banga patepna jouse ato ahin, ahivangin chonselou ahiye.
English: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun eilungset uva IPathenu Laltouna a chun lung ngamtah in hungu hite. Chukoma chu eihon hepina le ingaichat khoh dehset tenguleh lungsetna panpina imu diu ahi.
en: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
text:
HEB 4:16
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun eilungset uva IPathenu Laltouna a chun lung ngamtah in hungu hite. Chukoma chu eihon hepina le ingaichat khoh dehset tenguleh lungsetna panpina imu diu ahi.
English: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

tcz: Thempu chungnung chu midang thalhenga Pathen koma galut ji ahi. Aman amaho thilto chu Pathen koma apeha chule achonset jeh uva maichama thil atou chu akatdoh ji ahi.
en: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
text:
HEB 5:1
Thadou: Thempu chungnung chu midang thalhenga Pathen koma galut ji ahi. Aman amaho thilto chu Pathen koma apeha chule achonset jeh uva maichama thil atou chu akatdoh ji ahi.
English: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

tcz: Chule Amahi ima helou le seingailou ho jeng jong lungnengtah a bolthei ahi, ajeh chu Amatah jong hiche lhahsamna thunoiya chu kipelut a ahi.
en: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
text:
HEB 5:2
Thadou: Chule Amahi ima helou le seingailou ho jeng jong lungnengtah a bolthei ahi, ajeh chu Amatah jong hiche lhahsamna thunoiya chu kipelut a ahi.
English: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

tcz: Hichejeh a chu Ama le midang ho chonsetna ho jeh a chu kilhaina aboltei hiji ahi.
en: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
text:
HEB 5:3
Thadou: Hichejeh a chu Ama le midang ho chonsetna ho jeh a chu kilhaina aboltei hiji ahi.
English: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

tcz: Chule mi koima thempu chungnung chu jabolna tah achan jeh a ahinom mana moh hi jengthei ahidehpoi. Ama chu Aaron tobanga hiche natohna dinga hi Pathen kouna chang mi hiding ahiye.
en: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
text:
HEB 5:4
Thadou: Chule mi koima thempu chungnung chu jabolna tah achan jeh a ahinom mana moh hi jengthei ahidehpoi. Ama chu Aaron tobanga hiche natohna dinga hi Pathen kouna chang mi hiding ahiye.
English: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh a Christa jeng jong chu Thempu Chungnung hina na atoh jeng vang chun Amatah kichoian dehlouva ahi. Ama chu Pathen deilhen changa ahin, ajah a hitia hi asei ahi, “Nangma ka Chapa nahi. Keima tunia na Pa kahunghi ahitai.”
en: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
text:
HEB 5:5
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh a Christa jeng jong chu Thempu Chungnung hina na atoh jeng vang chun Amatah kichoian dehlouva ahi. Ama chu Pathen deilhen changa ahin, ajah a hitia hi asei ahi, “Nangma ka Chapa nahi. Keima tunia na Pa kahunghi ahitai.”
English: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

tcz: Chule munchom khat ah, Pathen in ajah a aseiyin, “Nangma Melchizedek themputna tobanga tonsot thempu nahi,” ati.
en: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
text:
HEB 5:6
Thadou: Chule munchom khat ah, Pathen in ajah a aseiyin, “Nangma Melchizedek themputna tobanga tonsot thempu nahi,” ati.
English: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

tcz: Yeshua chu leiset a anaum laiyin, Aman taona le thumna aneiyin hapen in apengin kana le mitlhi tothon thinaa kona ahuhdoh theipa henga chun ataove. Chule Aman Pathen aginlheh jeh chun Pathen in ataonaho chu angaipehtai.
en: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
text:
HEB 5:7
Thadou: Yeshua chu leiset a anaum laiyin, Aman taona le thumna aneiyin hapen in apengin kana le mitlhi tothon thinaa kona ahuhdoh theipa henga chun ataove. Chule Aman Pathen aginlheh jeh chun Pathen in ataonaho chu angaipehtai.
English: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

tcz: Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahijeng vang'in, Aman athohgimna a chun sei angaiyin ahi.
en: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
text:
HEB 5:8
Thadou: Yeshua chu Pathen Chapa ahijeng vang'in, Aman athohgimna a chun sei angaiyin ahi.
English: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

tcz: Hiti hin, Pathen in thempu chungnung hina chamkim tah in asemin, chule asei ngai jouse dingin tonsot hinna bulpin asemtai.
en: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
text:
HEB 5:9
Thadou: Hiti hin, Pathen in thempu chungnung hina chamkim tah in asemin, chule asei ngai jouse dingin tonsot hinna bulpin asemtai.
English: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

tcz: Chule Pathen in Ama hi Melchizedek banga Thempu chungnunga apehdoh ahitai.
en: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
text:
HEB 5:10
Thadou: Chule Pathen in Ama hi Melchizedek banga Thempu chungnunga apehdoh ahitai.
English: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

tcz: Keihon hiche thudol hi tampi kaseibe nomun, hinla hilchet ding ahahsai, adeh in nangho lhagaolam dol ah nalungmo un chule na ngainom diu chu ginchat aumpoi.
en: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
text:
HEB 5:11
Thadou: Keihon hiche thudol hi tampi kaseibe nomun, hinla hilchet ding ahahsai, adeh in nangho lhagaolam dol ah nalungmo un chule na ngainom diu chu ginchat aumpoi.
English: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

tcz: Tahsan cha nahung hinau sotpi ahunghitan, tua hi midang hil theiding nahiu ahitai. Chusangin, nanghon midang khat in Pathen Thubul lam nahildiu nangaicha nalaiyuve. Nangho hi naosen noitui ngaicha nalai chule anham nethei loulai tobang nahiuve.
en: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
text:
HEB 5:12
Thadou: Tahsan cha nahung hinau sotpi ahunghitan, tua hi midang hil theiding nahiu ahitai. Chusangin, nanghon midang khat in Pathen Thubul lam nahildiu nangaicha nalaiyuve. Nangho hi naosen noitui ngaicha nalai chule anham nethei loulai tobang nahiuve.
English: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh noichep nalai chu naosen hinalaibep ahin, chule thilpha itibol ding ham chu ahetloulai ahi.
en: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
text:
HEB 5:13
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh noichep nalai chu naosen hinalaibep ahin, chule thilpha itibol ding ham chu ahetloulai ahi.
English: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
