tcz: An ham chu akikhanlhit hoa ding ahi, amaho chun akithemchuh uva kona adih le adihlou hetkhenna aneiyu ahitai.
en: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
text:
HEB 5:14
Thadou: An ham chu akikhanlhit hoa ding ahi, amaho chun akithemchuh uva kona adih le adihlou hetkhenna aneiyu ahitai.
English: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

tcz: Hijehchun eihon Christa thudol thubul lam avel vel'a kihilna ngatau hite. Chusangin masotjou hitin hetna lam'ah pilhin ding gouhite. Tahbeh mongin eihon thilsebolnaa kona lunghei chule Pathen a itahsan nau ngaplhah thudol a thubul lam kithah pat kitna ingaicha tapouve.
en: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,
text:
HEB 6:1
Thadou: Hijehchun eihon Christa thudol thubul lam avel vel'a kihilna ngatau hite. Chusangin masotjou hitin hetna lam'ah pilhin ding gouhite. Tahbeh mongin eihon thilsebolnaa kona lunghei chule Pathen a itahsan nau ngaplhah thudol a thubul lam kithah pat kitna ingaicha tapouve.
English: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

tcz: Baptize chan thudol, khutngap thudol, mithi thokitna, chule tonsot thutanna thudol a kihilbena nangaichat u ahitapoi.
en: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
text:
HEB 6:2
Thadou: Baptize chan thudol, khutngap thudol, mithi thokitna, chule tonsot thutanna thudol a kihilbena nangaichat u ahitapoi.
English: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

tcz: Chule hitia hi Pathen phatsah ahileh, eihon aban hetbena lam imasot dingu ahiye.
en: This will we do, if God permits.
text:
HEB 6:3
Thadou: Chule hitia hi Pathen phatsah ahileh, eihon aban hetbena lam imasot dingu ahiye.
English: This will we do, if God permits.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh khatvei lhagao mitvahna neisa–vanlam thilphaho hetna nei chule Lhagao Theng chankhompi hitasa ho,
en: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,
text:
HEB 6:4
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh khatvei lhagao mitvahna neisa–vanlam thilphaho hetna nei chule Lhagao Theng chankhompi hitasa ho,
English: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

tcz: Pathen thu aphatna ho tepkha a chule ahunglhung ding khangho umdidol hetna neitasa,
en: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
text:
HEB 6:5
Thadou: Pathen thu aphatna ho tepkha a chule ahunglhung ding khangho umdidol hetna neitasa,
English: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

tcz: chujouva Pathen a kona kiheimang ho chu: Pathen Chapa sangnomlou, Ama chu thingpel to avela akilbeh kit ahin, chule mihonpi lah a jachatsahna'a atahlah ahitah jeh chun akisihkitna dinguva hinlepui chu thil hahsatah ahi.
en: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
text:
HEB 6:6
Thadou: chujouva Pathen a kona kiheimang ho chu: Pathen Chapa sangnomlou, Ama chu thingpel to avela akilbeh kit ahin, chule mihonpi lah a jachatsahna'a atahlah ahitah jeh chun akisihkitna dinguva hinlepui chu thil hahsatah ahi.
English: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

tcz: Vana kon go hunglha chun leiset achapnouvin chule loubol mi dingin Pathen phattheina gapha ahin sodoh in ahi.
en: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

tcz: Hinlah lou chun lingphung le nangkai hinsodoh henlang hileh, panabei hiding ahitai. Loubolpa chun hiche lou chu themmo chanpai intin chule ahalvam jeng ding ahitai.
en: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
text:
HEB 6:8
Thadou: Hinlah lou chun lingphung le nangkai hinsodoh henlang hileh, panabei hiding ahitai. Loubolpa chun hiche lou chu themmo chanpai intin chule ahalvam jeng ding ahitai.
English: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, keihon hitihin sei jengu jongleng, nangho chungchang thu akisei ahipoi ti kaheuve. Keihon katahsanu chu aphajo, nangho huhhing chana thudola hinte tihi ahi.
en: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
text:
HEB 6:9
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, keihon hitihin sei jengu jongleng, nangho chungchang thu akisei ahipoi ti kaheuve. Keihon katahsanu chu aphajo, nangho huhhing chana thudola hinte tihi ahi.
English: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen chondih louva ahipoi. Aman nanghon ichangeiya ama dinga kisalunggima nahiu chule nanghon tugeija naboljomu atahsan dangho nakhohsahnau navetsah u chu asuhmil lou ding ahi.
en: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
text:
HEB 6:10
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen chondih louva ahipoi. Aman nanghon ichangeiya ama dinga kisalunggima nahiu chule nanghon tugeija naboljomu atahsan dangho nakhohsahnau navetsah u chu asuhmil lou ding ahi.
English: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

tcz: Kagelkhoh tah u chu nahinkhou umsungin atahsan midangho chu ngailu jomun, hichun nakinepnau chu atah hung himong ding ahinai ti aphotchet teina ding ahije.
en: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
text:
HEB 6:11
Thadou: Kagelkhoh tah u chu nahinkhou umsungin atahsan midangho chu ngailu jomun, hichun nakinepnau chu atah hung himong ding ahinai ti aphotchet teina ding ahije.
English: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

tcz: Chutileh nangho lhagao lama amol le ima khohsalou nahilou dingu ahitai. Chusanga Pathen thutep loding ho tahsan le thoh hat umchan nungjuiya nahi dingu ahi.
en: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
text:
HEB 6:12
Thadou: Chutileh nangho lhagao lama amol le ima khohsalou nahilou dingu ahitai. Chusanga Pathen thutep loding ho tahsan le thoh hat umchan nungjuiya nahi dingu ahi.
English: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

tcz: Vetsahnan, Pathen in Abraham koma thutep ananeiye. Ama sanga hettohsah lenjo dang aum tahlou jeh in Pathen chu Amatah minin kihahselin,
en: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,
text:
HEB 6:13
Thadou: Vetsahnan, Pathen in Abraham koma thutep ananeiye. Ama sanga hettohsah lenjo dang aum tahlou jeh in Pathen chu Amatah minin kihahselin,
English: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

tcz: “Keiman thonlou hela phatthei kaboh ding, chule keiman nachilhah ho chu simjou louva katamsah ding ahi,” ati.
en: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”
text:
HEB 6:14
Thadou: “Keiman thonlou hela phatthei kaboh ding, chule keiman nachilhah ho chu simjou louva katamsah ding ahi,” ati.
English: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

tcz: Chuti chun Abraham'in thohhattah in angah'in, chule Pathen thutep chu achangtai.
en: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
text:
HEB 6:15
Thadou: Chuti chun Abraham'in thohhattah in angah'in, chule Pathen thutep chu achangtai.
English: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

tcz: Hitia hi mihon kihahselna aneiji tenguleh amaho sanga lenjoa chun akihahsel jiuvin chule hiche kihahselna chu kidohna ngailouvin akiphutdetjin ahi.
en: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
text:
HEB 6:16
Thadou: Hitia hi mihon kihahselna aneiji tenguleh amaho sanga lenjoa chun akihahsel jiuvin chule hiche kihahselna chu kidohna ngailouvin akiphutdetjin ahi.
English: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

tcz: Pathen Amatah jonghin athutep chang hon alung akhel kit louna photchennan, kihahselna achun amajong aumin ahi.
en: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
text:
HEB 6:17
Thadou: Pathen Amatah jonghin athutep chang hon alung akhel kit louna photchennan, kihahselna achun amajong aumin ahi.
English: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

tcz: Hitia hi Pathen in Athutep le akihahselna chu apehdoh gel ahije. Hicheteni hi khelkit thei ahitapoi, ajeh chu Pathen joutheilou ahije. Hijeh a hi, Ama henga kipelut a kiselho chun kinepna imasanguva um chu ituhchah jinguva ahileh kisonna phatah ineitheiyu ahi.
en: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
text:
HEB 6:18
Thadou: Hitia hi Pathen in Athutep le akihahselna chu apehdoh gel ahije. Hicheteni hi khelkit thei ahitapoi, ajeh chu Pathen joutheilou ahije. Hijeh a hi, Ama henga kipelut a kiselho chun kinepna imasanguva um chu ituhchah jinguva ahileh kisonna phatah ineitheiyu ahi.
English: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

tcz: Hiche kinepna hi ilhagao dinguva kingapdetna a phatah le tahsan umtah ahin, hichun pondal noiya Pathen muntheng sunga eipuilut theiyu ahi.
en: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
text:
HEB 6:19
Thadou: Hiche kinepna hi ilhagao dinguva kingapdetna a phatah le tahsan umtah ahin, hichun pondal noiya Pathen muntheng sunga eipuilut theiyu ahi.
English: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

tcz: Yeshua chu chuche muna eiho dinga analut a eiho dinga tonsot thempu chungnung Melchizedek dinmuna uma ahitai.
en: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
text:
HEB 6:20
Thadou: Yeshua chu chuche muna eiho dinga analut a eiho dinga tonsot thempu chungnung Melchizedek dinmuna uma ahitai.
English: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

tcz: Hiche Melchizedek hi Salem khopia Leng ahin chule Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahi. Abraham'in lengho douna agal asat chu ajoa ahung kile chun Melchizedek hin akimupin chule phatthei bohna apen ahi.
en: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,
text:
HEB 7:1
Thadou: Hiche Melchizedek hi Salem khopia Leng ahin chule Chungnungpen Pathen thempu ahi. Abraham'in lengho douna agal asat chu ajoa ahung kile chun Melchizedek hin akimupin chule phatthei bohna apen ahi.
English: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

tcz: Chuphat in Abraham'in galsatna a achomkhom jouse lah a hopsoma hopkhat chu Melchizedek apen ahi. Melchizedek kiti min hi “Thutandih Lengpa chule Salem lengpa kiti hi ‘Chamna lengpa,’” kiseina ahi.
en: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,
text:
HEB 7:2
Thadou: Chuphat in Abraham'in galsatna a achomkhom jouse lah a hopsoma hopkhat chu Melchizedek apen ahi. Melchizedek kiti min hi “Thutandih Lengpa chule Salem lengpa kiti hi ‘Chamna lengpa,’” kiseina ahi.
English: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

tcz: Apa le anu ahilouleh apu apa min kisutna aumpon–apatna umlou, ahilouleh ahinkho kichaina jong aumpoi. Ama tonsot thempu ahin, Pathen Chapa to kilouva ahi.
en: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.
text:
HEB 7:3
Thadou: Apa le anu ahilouleh apu apa min kisutna aumpon–apatna umlou, ahilouleh ahinkho kichaina jong aumpoi. Ama tonsot thempu ahin, Pathen Chapa to kilouva ahi.
English: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

tcz: Chuti ahileh hiche Melchizedek hi ichan geiya lena hitam ngaito temin. Israel te mipa, Abraham jaumtahpa chun hiche hi ahet a agalsatnaa athillah hoa kona hopsoma hopkhat apeh jeng hi!
en: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
text:
HEB 7:4
Thadou: Chuti ahileh hiche Melchizedek hi ichan geiya lena hitam ngaito temin. Israel te mipa, Abraham jaumtahpa chun hiche hi ahet a agalsatnaa athillah hoa kona hopsoma hopkhat apeh jeng hi!
English: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

tcz: Tun, Mose Dan chun thempuho, Levi son ho, Abraham chilhah jong hiho, chun Israel mipi lah a kona hopsoma khat chu akilah diu angeh in ahi.
en: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,
text:
HEB 7:5
Thadou: Tun, Mose Dan chun thempuho, Levi son ho, Abraham chilhah jong hiho, chun Israel mipi lah a kona hopsoma khat chu akilah diu angeh in ahi.
English: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

tcz: Ahin Melchizedek, Levi son hilou chun, Abraham a konin soma khat chu akilah in ahi. Chule Melchizedek chun Pathen thutep ho anachangsa, Abraham chunga phattheina apen ahi.
en: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
text:
HEB 7:6
Thadou: Ahin Melchizedek, Levi son hilou chun, Abraham a konin soma khat chu akilah in ahi. Chule Melchizedek chun Pathen thutep ho anachangsa, Abraham chunga phattheina apen ahi.
English: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

tcz: Chule kidoh ngailou hel chu phattheina pepa thaneina chu phattheina changpa sanga chungnung joa ahi.
en: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
text:
HEB 7:7
Thadou: Chule kidoh ngailou hel chu phattheina pepa thaneina chu phattheina changpa sanga chungnung joa ahi.
English: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

tcz: Thempuho hopsom donga pangho chu thithei mihem ahiuvin, hiti chun Melchizedek chu amaho sanga chungnungjoa ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama ahing jing ahi.
en: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
text:
HEB 7:8
Thadou: Thempuho hopsom donga pangho chu thithei mihem ahiuvin, hiti chun Melchizedek chu amaho sanga chungnungjoa ahi, ijeh inem itileh ama ahing jing ahi.
English: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

tcz: Hiche banjoma chu, eihon Levi mite som a khat donga pangho chun apuluiyu Abraham'in hopsoma hopkhat anapeh jeh a chu amahon jong Melchizedek chu hopsoma khat chu apeh u ahi.
en: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,
text:
HEB 7:9
Thadou: Hiche banjoma chu, eihon Levi mite som a khat donga pangho chun apuluiyu Abraham'in hopsoma hopkhat anapeh jeh a chu amahon jong Melchizedek chu hopsoma khat chu apeh u ahi.
English: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Levi chu anapen loulai jeng vang chun ama hung kon dohna Abraham tibah a chu uma ahin, hichea chu Melchizedek in amaa hopsoma hopkhat analah ahitai.
en: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.
text:
HEB 7:10
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Levi chu anapen loulai jeng vang chun ama hung kon dohna Abraham tibah a chu uma ahin, hichea chu Melchizedek in amaa hopsoma hopkhat analah ahitai.
English: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

tcz: Hiti chun Levi thempu hina Dana kingapna chun Pathen lunggon chu chamkimsah jou hitaleh Pathen in ipi dia themputna achombeh a Levi le Aaron thalhenga Melchizedek thempuhina tobang chu aphudoh ngaiding ham?
en: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
text:
HEB 7:11
Thadou: Hiti chun Levi thempu hina Dana kingapna chun Pathen lunggon chu chamkimsah jou hitaleh Pathen in ipi dia themputna achombeh a Levi le Aaron thalhenga Melchizedek thempuhina tobang chu aphudoh ngaiding ham?
English: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

tcz: Chule thempu hina chu akikhel tah a ahileh phatsahna dan jong chu kikhel ding adoltah ahi.
en: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
text:
HEB 7:12
Thadou: Chule thempu hina chu akikhel tah a ahileh phatsahna dan jong chu kikhel ding adoltah ahi.
English: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh thempu ikihoulimna dingpau hi phung choma ahin, hiche phunga kona chu thempu natong anaum khaloulai ahi.
en: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
text:
HEB 7:13
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh thempu ikihoulimna dingpau hi phung choma ahin, hiche phunga kona chu thempu natong anaum khaloulai ahi.
English: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

tcz: Keiman kahin seinom chu IPakai chu Judah phunga hungkon ahin, chule Mose chun hiche phunga kona thempu hung umdoh ding anaphapoh hihbeh in ahi.
en: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
text:
HEB 7:14
Thadou: Keiman kahin seinom chu IPakai chu Judah phunga hungkon ahin, chule Mose chun hiche phunga kona thempu hung umdoh ding anaphapoh hihbeh in ahi.
English: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

tcz: Hiche kikhelna hi thempu gotchom beh Melchizedek tobang khat hung kilangdoh a ahitai.
en: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
text:
HEB 7:15
Thadou: Hiche kikhelna hi thempu gotchom beh Melchizedek tobang khat hung kilangdoh a ahitai.
English: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

tcz: Yeshua thempu hina hi tahsalam dol a Levi phunga mihina ngaichatna pachu hitalouvin, suhmangthei hilou hinna thaneina a konjoh hiya ahi.
en: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

tcz: Chule David, Labu jihpan, hiche hi apodoh in, “Nangma tonsot thempu hina Melchizedek a tobang chu nahi,” ati.
en: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
text:
HEB 7:17
Thadou: Chule David, Labu jihpan, hiche hi apodoh in, “Nangma tonsot thempu hina Melchizedek a tobang chu nahi,” ati.
English: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

tcz: Ahi, thempu hina a kingeh alui chu alhahsama chule pannabei ahitah jeh a achombeh a kikoidoh a ahitai.
en: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
text:
HEB 7:18
Thadou: Ahi, thempu hina a kingeh alui chu alhahsama chule pannabei ahitah jeh a achombeh a kikoidoh a ahitai.
English: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh danthun ima achamkim sahna aumpoi. Hinla tun eihon kinepna phajo ikisonpiuvin, hichea chu eihon Pathen kom inaitheiyu ahi.
en: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.
text:
HEB 7:19
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh danthun ima achamkim sahna aumpoi. Hinla tun eihon kinepna phajo ikisonpiuvin, hichea chu eihon Pathen kom inaitheiyu ahi.
English: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

tcz: Hiche athahbehpa hi kihahselna gimneitah a kibol'a ahi. Aaron son ho chun hiche kihahselna jaotha louva hi thempuna atoh u ahi.
en: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath
text:
HEB 7:20
Thadou: Hiche athahbehpa hi kihahselna gimneitah a kibol'a ahi. Aaron son ho chun hiche kihahselna jaotha louva hi thempuna atoh u ahi.
English: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua chung chang thua kihahselna khat aumin ahi. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in ajah a aseijin, “Pakaiyin kihahselna chu akilahtai chule akihahselna chu asuhkeh loubeh ding ahi; Nangma tonsot'a thempu nahitai,” ati.
en: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”
text:
HEB 7:21
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshua chung chang thua kihahselna khat aumin ahi. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in ajah a aseijin, “Pakaiyin kihahselna chu akilahtai chule akihahselna chu asuhkeh loubeh ding ahi; Nangma tonsot'a thempu nahitai,” ati.
English: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

tcz: Hiche kihahselna jal a hi, Yeshua hin kitepna phajo Pathen to kinei chu aphat atep a panga ahi.
en: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
text:
HEB 7:22
Thadou: Hiche kihahselna jal a hi, Yeshua hin kitepna phajo Pathen to kinei chu aphat atep a panga ahi.
English: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

tcz: Chonna luinoiya chun thempu tampi anaumuvin, thina chun anatohna muna umden theilouna asodoh u hiya ahi.
en: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
text:
HEB 7:23
Thadou: Chonna luinoiya chun thempu tampi anaumuvin, thina chun anatohna muna umden theilouna asodoh u hiya ahi.
English: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

tcz: Hinlah Yeshua chu tonsot'a uma ahijeha thempu ahina jong tonsot'a ding ahitai.
en: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
text:
HEB 7:24
Thadou: Hinlah Yeshua chu tonsot'a uma ahijeha thempu ahina jong tonsot'a ding ahitai.
English: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Aman khatveiya le tonsot geiya dinga Ama jal a Pathen kom hinnaiho thalhenga Pathen koma taopeh dinga Aman huhhing jou theina tha anei ahi.
en: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
text:
HEB 7:25
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Aman khatveiya le tonsot geiya dinga Ama jal a Pathen kom hinnaiho thalhenga Pathen koma taopeh dinga Aman huhhing jou theina tha anei ahi.
English: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

tcz: Ama thempu chungnung ingaichat u ahina chu Ama athenga le nolna bei, chonsetnen behlou hel ahi. Ama chonsehoa kona chom uma ahin, chule van mun a jabolna sangtah mun changa ahi.
en: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

tcz: Thempu chungnung dang tobang ahiloujeh a niseh a kilhaina thilto abol ngaitalou ahi. Amaho chun amasapen tah a amaho chonset jeh a chule aban'a midangho chonsetna jeh a kilhaina asemjiu ahi.
en: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
text:
HEB 7:27
Thadou: Thempu chungnung dang tobang ahiloujeh a niseh a kilhaina thilto abol ngaitalou ahi. Amaho chun amasapen tah a amaho chonset jeh a chule aban'a midangho chonsetna jeh a kilhaina asemjiu ahi.
English: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

tcz: Danthu chun thempu chung nungho alhendoh jiho chu mihem lhahsam jal a ahi. Hinla Danthu kipehdoh jou nunga chu Pathen in Achapa chu kihahsel puma alhendoh a, chule Achapa chu Tonsot themput chungnung chamkima asem ahitai.
en: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.
text:
HEB 7:28
Thadou: Danthu chun thempu chung nungho alhendoh jiho chu mihem lhahsam jal a ahi. Hinla Danthu kipehdoh jou nunga chu Pathen in Achapa chu kihahsel puma alhendoh a, chule Achapa chu Tonsot themput chungnung chamkima asem ahitai.
English: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

tcz: Tun thu kiseilona jeh pen tah chu: Eihon jaumtah Laltouna muna toupa, Van mun'a Thempu chungnung jabolna changa, chu ineiyuve.
en: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,
text:
HEB 8:1
Thadou: Tun thu kiseilona jeh pen tah chu: Eihon jaumtah Laltouna muna toupa, Van mun'a Thempu chungnung jabolna changa, chu ineiyuve.
English: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

tcz: Chuche muna Aman Van mun'a aman houbuh sunga lhachana atohna mun chu, Pathen houna mun dihtah Pakaiyin asahdoh ahin, mihem khut'a kisadoh ahipoi.
en: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.
text:
HEB 8:2
Thadou: Chuche muna Aman Van mun'a aman houbuh sunga lhachana atohna mun chu, Pathen houna mun dihtah Pakaiyin asahdoh ahin, mihem khut'a kisadoh ahipoi.
English: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

tcz: Chule thempu chungnung ho chun thilpeh ho le maichama katdohna aneijiu ahijeh chun, iThempu Chungnungu jong chun maicham thilto ding aneitei ding ahi.
en: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
text:
HEB 8:3
Thadou: Chule thempu chungnung ho chun thilpeh ho le maichama katdohna aneijiu ahijeh chun, iThempu Chungnungu jong chun maicham thilto ding aneitei ding ahi.
English: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

tcz: Ama chu leichunga hi uma hileh Ama thempu jong hinom ponte, ajeh iham itileh Danin angaichat maicham thilto chu bol dinga thempu tampi um uva ahinai.
en: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
text:
HEB 8:4
Thadou: Ama chu leichunga hi uma hileh Ama thempu jong hinom ponte, ajeh iham itileh Danin angaichat maicham thilto chu bol dinga thempu tampi um uva ahinai.
English: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

tcz: Amaho chun vana Pathen hou atahbeh limso chu hiche thempu ho chun agongso umdan athou ahibouve. Ijeh ham itileh Mose chun Pathen houbuh asahgotpet chun, Pathen in hiche gihsalna hi ahinpei: “Molchunga agongso um dingdan kavetsah tobanga chu naboldohna dingin photchenna neiyin,” ati.
en: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”
text:
HEB 8:5
Thadou: Amaho chun vana Pathen hou atahbeh limso chu hiche thempu ho chun agongso umdan athou ahibouve. Ijeh ham itileh Mose chun Pathen houbuh asahgotpet chun, Pathen in hiche gihsalna hi ahinpei: “Molchunga agongso um dingdan kavetsah tobanga chu naboldohna dingin photchenna neiyin,” ati.
English: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

tcz: Hinlah tun Yeshua, IThempu Chungnungu hi thempu natoh lui sanga gamchenga chungnungjo tohding nei ahitah jeh hin, thutep phajohoa Pathen to kitepna phajo eiho dinga palai hiya ahi.
en: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
text:
HEB 8:6
Thadou: Hinlah tun Yeshua, IThempu Chungnungu hi thempu natoh lui sanga gamchenga chungnungjo tohding nei ahitah jeh hin, thutep phajohoa Pathen to kitepna phajo eiho dinga palai hiya ahi.
English: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

tcz: Kitepna masa chu akisuhmona umlou hileh, kitepna anina akhelding gon ngaitalou ding ahitai.
en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
text:
HEB 8:7
Thadou: Kitepna masa chu akisuhmona umlou hileh, kitepna anina akhelding gon ngaitalou ding ahitai.
English: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in miho chu athemmo nau amu ahitah jeh in, hitihin aseiye: “Pakaiyin aseiye, Keiman Israel le Judah mite toh kitepna thah kasemna nikho hunglhung ding ahi.
en: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

tcz: Hiche kitepna hi apu-apateu keiman kakhut a amaho kapuiya, Egypt gam'a kona kahinpuidoh pet a tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Amaho chu keima to kitepna a tahsan um ahitapouvin, hijeh a chu kanung-ngat ahi” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
en: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.
text:
HEB 8:9
Thadou: Hiche kitepna hi apu-apateu keiman kakhut a amaho kapuiya, Egypt gam'a kona kahinpuidoh pet a tobang chu hilou ding ahi. Amaho chu keima to kitepna a tahsan um ahitapouvin, hijeh a chu kanung-ngat ahi” tin Pakaiyin aseiye.
English: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

tcz: “Hinlah Keiman hiche nikho chuleh kitepna thah Israel mitetoh kanei ding ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Keiman ka danthu alunggeluva kakoipeh ding, chule alungsunguva kajihlut peh ding ahi. Chule keima aPathenu kahi ding, chule Amaho kamite hiding ahiuve.”
en: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
text:
HEB 8:10
Thadou: “Hinlah Keiman hiche nikho chuleh kitepna thah Israel mitetoh kanei ding ahi,” tin Pakaiyin aseiye. “Keiman ka danthu alunggeluva kakoipeh ding, chule alungsunguva kajihlut peh ding ahi. Chule keima aPathenu kahi ding, chule Amaho kamite hiding ahiuve.”
English: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

tcz: Chule amahon aheng akomuva ho hihen, akinaipiu sopiho kom hijongleh, “Nanghon PAKAI nahet'u angaiye” tia nahilu ngaitalou ding ahi. Ajeh chu aneopen a pat alenpen geiyin keima eihet chensau hiding ahitai.
en: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
text:
HEB 8:11
Thadou: Chule amahon aheng akomuva ho hihen, akinaipiu sopiho kom hijongleh, “Nanghon PAKAI nahet'u angaiye” tia nahilu ngaitalou ding ahi. Ajeh chu aneopen a pat alenpen geiyin keima eihet chensau hiding ahitai.
English: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

tcz: “Chule keiman agitlounahou kangaidam ding, chule achonsetnau keiman kageldohkit tah louhel ding ahitai.”
en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”
text:
HEB 8:12
Thadou: “Chule keiman agitlounahou kangaidam ding, chule achonsetnau keiman kageldohkit tah louhel ding ahitai.”
English: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

tcz: Pathen in kitepna “thah” thudol aseiteng, hichun amasa chu donlouva akoi ahitai. Hichu tua aphat kichaiya chule hungmangloi ding ahi kitia ahitai.
en: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
text:
HEB 8:13
Thadou: Pathen in kitepna “thah” thudol aseiteng, hichun amasa chu donlouva akoi ahitai. Hichu tua aphat kichaiya chule hungmangloi ding ahi kitia ahitai.
English: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

tcz: Hiche Pathen le Israelte kikah akitepna masa a chu leiset chunga Ama houna mun le Ama houna chondanho uma ahi.
en: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
text:
HEB 9:1
Thadou: Hiche Pathen le Israelte kikah akitepna masa a chu leiset chunga Ama houna mun le Ama houna chondanho uma ahi.
English: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

tcz: Hiche houbuh chu dannia kihom khena ahi. Dan masa sunga chu thaomeikhom khat, dokhang khat, chule dokhang chunga chu changlhah theng pheng ni uma ahi. Hiche dan hi “Muntheng” kitia ahi.
en: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.
text:
HEB 9:2
Thadou: Hiche houbuh chu dannia kihom khena ahi. Dan masa sunga chu thaomeikhom khat, dokhang khat, chule dokhang chunga chu changlhah theng pheng ni uma ahi. Hiche dan hi “Muntheng” kitia ahi.
English: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

tcz: Abanah pondal khat aumin, chule hiche pondal nung lama adan sung nung um chu “Muntheng” pena kitin ahi.
en: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,
text:
HEB 9:3
Thadou: Abanah pondal khat aumin, chule hiche pondal nung lama adan sung nung um chu “Muntheng” pena kitin ahi.
English: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

tcz: Hiche dan sunga chun Sana maicham kihal namtui aumin chule thinga kisem thingkonglen Kitepna Thingkong chu aninglia sana jenga kitoma ahi. Thingkong sunga chun sana a kisem bel khat aumin, belsunga chun-Manna, Aaron Tenggol hungpah ado um chule Kitepna Songpheng teni jong aume.
en: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

tcz: Chule Kitepna Thingkong chunga chun Pathen loupina Cherub ni aumin, alhaving teni chun Kitepna kong chung, lhatdohna mun, chu atomkhum jengin. Hinla hitiho jouse hi tun achen achaiyin ihilchen joupouve.
en: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
text:
HEB 9:5
Thadou: Chule Kitepna Thingkong chunga chun Pathen loupina Cherub ni aumin, alhaving teni chun Kitepna kong chung, lhatdohna mun, chu atomkhum jengin. Hinla hitiho jouse hi tun achen achaiyin ihilchen joupouve.
English: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

tcz: Hicheho jouse amun akigontup chun, thempuho chu indan masa pena chu aniseh a lut uva kilhaina natoh ho chu atoh jingu ahi.
en: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
text:
HEB 9:6
Thadou: Hicheho jouse amun akigontup chun, thempuho chu indan masa pena chu aniseh a lut uva kilhaina natoh ho chu atoh jingu ahi.
English: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

tcz: Hinlah Thempu chungnung bou chu Muntheng pena chu lutthei, chule kumkhat'a khatvei bou galut thei ahi. Ama chun ama le amiten hetlouva chonset abol dohhouva kilhaina a thisan chukoma akat ji ahi.
en: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
text:
HEB 9:7
Thadou: Hinlah Thempu chungnung bou chu Muntheng pena chu lutthei, chule kumkhat'a khatvei bou galut thei ahi. Ama chun ama le amiten hetlouva chonset abol dohhouva kilhaina a thisan chukoma akat ji ahi.
English: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

tcz: Hiche chonnaho Lhagao Thengin aphondoh chu ahileh Muntheng pen a luttheina chu Houbuh le chuchea kimanchahna dan ho manchah ahilai sung sen gahmohlut ahithei poi tihi ahi.
en: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
text:
HEB 9:8
Thadou: Hiche chonnaho Lhagao Thengin aphondoh chu ahileh Muntheng pen a luttheina chu Houbuh le chuchea kimanchahna dan ho manchah ahilai sung sen gahmohlut ahithei poi tihi ahi.
English: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

tcz: Hiche hi tuphat umdol vetsahna khat hiya ahi. Ijeh inem itileh thilpeh le kilhainaho thempuhon akatdoh u chun thilto ding hinchoi ho dingin selepha hetna alungthimu chu athensah joupoi.
en: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
text:
HEB 9:9
Thadou: Hiche hi tuphat umdol vetsahna khat hiya ahi. Ijeh inem itileh thilpeh le kilhainaho thempuhon akatdoh u chun thilto ding hinchoi ho dingin selepha hetna alungthimu chu athensah joupoi.
English: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

tcz: Ajeh chu chonna lui hoa neh le don chule kisuhthengna gotchom chom, tahsa thila juiding chonna anaumho chu aphajo chonna ahung umdoh kahsea ding bou ahije.
en: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
text:
HEB 9:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu chonna lui hoa neh le don chule kisuhthengna gotchom chom, tahsa thila juiding chonna anaumho chu aphajo chonna ahung umdoh kahsea ding bou ahije.
English: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

tcz: Hiti chun tun Christa hi ahungding thilpha jousea dinga Thempu Chungnunga hung panga ahitai. Ama alenjo, achamkimjoa Van mun'a houbuh a chu lut'ah ahitan, hichu mihem khut in asah hitalou vannoi kisemna a jong jaotha louva ahiye.
en: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
text:
HEB 9:11
Thadou: Hiti chun tun Christa hi ahungding thilpha jousea dinga Thempu Chungnunga hung panga ahitai. Ama alenjo, achamkimjoa Van mun'a houbuh a chu lut'ah ahitan, hichu mihem khut in asah hitalou vannoi kisemna a jong jaotha louva ahiye.
English: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

tcz: Kelchal hole bongnou hoa hitalouvin, Ama thisan a chu Ama Munthengpen tah'a chu khatveiya chule a-itih a dinga eiho lhatdohna chu asemdoh ahitai.
en: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.
text:
HEB 9:12
Thadou: Kelchal hole bongnou hoa hitalouvin, Ama thisan a chu Ama Munthengpen tah'a chu khatveiya chule a-itih a dinga eiho lhatdohna chu asemdoh ahitai.
English: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

tcz: Chonna luiya chu kelchal ho le bongchal ho chule bongnou kihalvamna vut a chu chonna ngaidol thenlouna hoa kona kisutheng thei ahiuve.
en: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
text:
HEB 9:13
Thadou: Chonna luiya chu kelchal ho le bongchal ho chule bongnou kihalvamna vut a chu chonna ngaidol thenlouna hoa kona kisutheng thei ahiuve.
English: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

tcz: Ngaito le chun, ichan geiya Christa thisan chun chonset natohnaa kona selepha hetna chu gamchenga asuhthenga Pathen hing chu ihou thei dingu asodoh hitam. Ijeh ham itileh tonsot Lhagao thaneina a kona Christa Amatah chu ichonset jal uva Pathen a kikatdoh a ahitai.
en: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
text:
HEB 9:14
Thadou: Ngaito le chun, ichan geiya Christa thisan chun chonset natohnaa kona selepha hetna chu gamchenga asuhthenga Pathen hing chu ihou thei dingu asodoh hitam. Ijeh ham itileh tonsot Lhagao thaneina a kona Christa Amatah chu ichonset jal uva Pathen a kikatdoh a ahitai.
English: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

tcz: Hijeh a chu Ama Pathen le mipite kikah a palaiya panga Pathen in athutep ho dinga tonsot'a alodingu chu akouho chun akisan theiyu ahitai. Ijeh ham itileh kitepna masaa chonset aboljeh'uva thiho chu lhatdoh dinga Christa chu hungthia ahitai.
en: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
text:
HEB 9:15
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Ama Pathen le mipite kikah a palaiya panga Pathen in athutep ho dinga tonsot'a alodingu chu akouho chun akisan theiyu ahitai. Ijeh ham itileh kitepna masaa chonset aboljeh'uva thiho chu lhatdoh dinga Christa chu hungthia ahitai.
English: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

tcz: Tun, koiham khat chun kitepna aneiya ahileh aphotchenna a kitepna bolpa chu athi angaiyin ahi.
en: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
text:
HEB 9:16
Thadou: Tun, koiham khat chun kitepna aneiya ahileh aphotchenna a kitepna bolpa chu athi angaiyin ahi.
English: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

tcz: Kitepna chu akitem pa thitengle bou kisudet'a ahi. Kitepna bolpa chu ahinlaisea kitepna chu kisudet louva ahi.
en: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
text:
HEB 9:17
Thadou: Kitepna chu akitem pa thitengle bou kisudet'a ahi. Kitepna bolpa chu ahinlaisea kitepna chu kisudet louva ahi.
English: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

tcz: Hijeh achu kitepna masa jong chu gancha khat thisan a kitahsoa ahi.
en: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
text:
HEB 9:18
Thadou: Hijeh achu kitepna masa jong chu gancha khat thisan a kitahsoa ahi.
English: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Mosen Pathen thupeh ho chu khat khata mijouse masanga asimdoh jou chun, aman bongnou le kelchal thisan ho chu alan, twitoh alahthan, Pathen Danbu le mihonpi chu hyssop thingbahho mangchan a samul sandup jong chu athekhum ahi.
en: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
text:
HEB 9:19
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Mosen Pathen thupeh ho chu khat khata mijouse masanga asimdoh jou chun, aman bongnou le kelchal thisan ho chu alan, twitoh alahthan, Pathen Danbu le mihonpi chu hyssop thingbahho mangchan a samul sandup jong chu athekhum ahi.
English: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

tcz: Chuin aman, “Hiche thisan hin Pathen in kitepna nangho toh asem chu aphudet ahi,” ati.
en: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”
text:
HEB 9:20
Thadou: Chuin aman, “Hiche thisan hin Pathen in kitepna nangho toh asem chu aphudet ahi,” ati.
English: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

tcz: Chule hitima chun, aman houbuh chule Pathen houna'a kimang jouse chunga chun thisan athekhum in ahi.
en: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
text:
HEB 9:21
Thadou: Chule hitima chun, aman houbuh chule Pathen houna'a kimang jouse chunga chun thisan athekhum in ahi.
English: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

tcz: Tahbeh in, Mose Danbu dungjuia imajouse chu thisanin athensah ji ahi. Ijeh inem itileh thisan kisolouna a chu chonset ngaidam channa umlou ahi.
en: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
text:
HEB 9:22
Thadou: Tahbeh in, Mose Danbu dungjuia imajouse chu thisanin athensah ji ahi. Ijeh inem itileh thisan kisolouna a chu chonset ngaidam channa umlou ahi.
English: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

tcz: Hiche jeh a chu Houbuh le asunga umjouse chu, van'a um thil ho vetsahna ahin, gancha ho thisan a suhtheng ngai ahi. Hinla atahbeh van'a um chu gancha ho thisan sanga phajo chun asuhtheng ngai ahi.
en: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
text:
HEB 9:23
Thadou: Hiche jeh a chu Houbuh le asunga umjouse chu, van'a um thil ho vetsahna ahin, gancha ho thisan a suhtheng ngai ahi. Hinla atahbeh van'a um chu gancha ho thisan sanga phajo chun asuhtheng ngai ahi.
English: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh mihem khut a kisa muntheng chu, vana atahbehpa gongso ahibouvin, hichea chun Christa agalutpoi. Ama chu vana alut in Pathen angsungah eiho thalhengin agakilah in ahi.
en: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

tcz: Chule Ama van'a agalut hi thempu chungnung hiche leiset chunga muntheng pena ganthisan choiya agalut tobanga chu avel vel'a akikatdohna dinga galut'ah ahitapoi.
en: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
text:
HEB 9:25
Thadou: Chule Ama van'a agalut hi thempu chungnung hiche leiset chunga muntheng pena ganthisan choiya agalut tobanga chu avel vel'a akikatdohna dinga galut'ah ahitapoi.
English: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

tcz: Hichu ngaikhoh ahileh Christa chu vannoi kiphudoh a pat a avel vel'a hung thiding ahitai. Hinla tun, khang kichaikon lama hi chonset suhbeina dinga Amatah hung kilah a khatveiya a-itih a dinga kikatdoh a thia ahitai.
en: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
text:
HEB 9:26
Thadou: Hichu ngaikhoh ahileh Christa chu vannoi kiphudoh a pat a avel vel'a hung thiding ahitai. Hinla tun, khang kichaikon lama hi chonset suhbeina dinga Amatah hung kilah a khatveiya a-itih a dinga kikatdoh a thia ahitai.
English: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

tcz: Chule amichang cheh hi khat vei thidinga gonsa ahi chujoutahle thutanna hunglhung ding ahi.
en: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
text:
HEB 9:27
Thadou: Chule amichang cheh hi khat vei thidinga gonsa ahi chujoutahle thutanna hunglhung ding ahi.
English: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

tcz: Hitobanga chu Christa hi mitampi chonsetna lamang dinga khatvei thia ahi. Ama ichonset u chungchang thutan dinga hilouva, Ama ngahjinga umho jouse huhhing dinga hungkit ding joh ahi.
en: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
text:
HEB 9:28
Thadou: Hitobanga chu Christa hi mitampi chonsetna lamang dinga khatvei thia ahi. Ama ichonset u chungchang thutan dinga hilouva, Ama ngahjinga umho jouse huhhing dinga hungkit ding joh ahi.
English: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

tcz: Mose Dan noiya Chonna lui chu agongso bou ahin, gaophel phul'a thilpha hung lhung ding ho vetsahna bou ahi, thilpha tahbehho chu hiloulai ahi. Chuche chonna noiya kilhaina chu avel vel'a, akumseh a kibol ahin, ahijeng vang'in Pathen houva hungho dingin thenna chamkim apetheipoi.
en: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
text:
HEB 10:1
Thadou: Mose Dan noiya Chonna lui chu agongso bou ahin, gaophel phul'a thilpha hung lhung ding ho vetsahna bou ahi, thilpha tahbehho chu hiloulai ahi. Chuche chonna noiya kilhaina chu avel vel'a, akumseh a kibol ahin, ahijeng vang'in Pathen houva hungho dingin thenna chamkim apetheipoi.
English: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

tcz: Thenna chamkim pethei ding ana hitaleu, ahouho dinga khatveiya thenna asodoh ding ahitan, chule akilhainau gantha chu tangdiu chule themmo akichannau jong umtalou ding ahitai.
en: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
text:
HEB 10:2
Thadou: Thenna chamkim pethei ding ana hitaleu, ahouho dinga khatveiya thenna asodoh ding ahitan, chule akilhainau gantha chu tangdiu chule themmo akichannau jong umtalou ding ahitai.
English: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

tcz: Hinlah chusangin, chuche kilhaina thilto ho chun amaho chu akum kum'in achonset'u geldohna apejin ahi.
en: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
text:
HEB 10:3
Thadou: Hinlah chusangin, chuche kilhaina thilto ho chun amaho chu akum kum'in achonset'u geldohna apejin ahi.
English: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh bongchal ho le kelchal ho thisanin chonset ho apohmang ding chu hitheilou ahije.
en: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
text:
HEB 10:4
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh bongchal ho le kelchal ho thisanin chonset ho apohmang ding chu hitheilou ahije.
English: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

tcz: Hijeh a hi Christa vannoiya ahunga chu Aman Pathen koma, “Nangman gancha a kilhaina ho ahilouleh chonset man katdoh ding nangehpoi. Hinla nangman katdoh ding tahsa neipetai.
en: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
text:
HEB 10:5
Thadou: Hijeh a hi Christa vannoiya ahunga chu Aman Pathen koma, “Nangman gancha a kilhaina ho ahilouleh chonset man katdoh ding nangehpoi. Hinla nangman katdoh ding tahsa neipetai.
English: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

tcz: Nangma pumgo thilto a ahilouleh adang chonset kilhaina a lunglhai nahipoi.
en: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
text:
HEB 10:6
Thadou: Nangma pumgo thilto a ahilouleh adang chonset kilhaina a lunglhai nahipoi.
English: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

tcz: Chuphat'in keiman kaseiyin-Pathen Thubua keima chungchang thua kisunsa bang chun-Vo Pathen, Ven, keima nangma lunglam boldingin kahunge,” ati.
en: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
text:
HEB 10:7
Thadou: Chuphat'in keiman kaseiyin-Pathen Thubua keima chungchang thua kisunsa bang chun-Vo Pathen, Ven, keima nangma lunglam boldingin kahunge,” ati.
English: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

tcz: Amasan Christan, “Nangman gantha a kilhaina ahilouleh chonset man thilto ahilouleh pumgo thilto nangehpoi, chuho jenga jong chun nalunglhaipoi,” ati (hiche ho chu Mose Danbun angeh ahicheh vang'in).
en: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
text:
HEB 10:8
Thadou: Amasan Christan, “Nangman gantha a kilhaina ahilouleh chonset man thilto ahilouleh pumgo thilto nangehpoi, chuho jenga jong chun nalunglhaipoi,” ati (hiche ho chu Mose Danbun angeh ahicheh vang'in).
English: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

tcz: Chutah in aman, “Ven, Keima nangma lunglam bol dingin kahungtai,” ati. Kitepna nunung chu akichepi theina dingin amasa chu asuhbei ahitai.
en: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
text:
HEB 10:9
Thadou: Chutah in aman, “Ven, Keima nangma lunglam bol dingin kahungtai,” ati. Kitepna nunung chu akichepi theina dingin amasa chu asuhbei ahitai.
English: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen eiho dinga alunglam chu Yeshua Christa khatvei aitih a dinga ahung kikatdoh jal'a athenga eikisim dingu chu ahi.
en: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
text:
HEB 10:10
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen eiho dinga alunglam chu Yeshua Christa khatvei aitih a dinga ahung kikatdoh jal'a athenga eikisim dingu chu ahi.
English: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

tcz: Kitepna luiya chu, thempu chun dinpum'a maicham mun a chu lhachana anitina aboljinga kilhaina abolngai jingho chu abol jing jeng ahin, chonsetnaho lamang theilou anahi.
en: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
text:
HEB 10:11
Thadou: Kitepna luiya chu, thempu chun dinpum'a maicham mun a chu lhachana anitina aboljinga kilhaina abolngai jingho chu abol jing jeng ahin, chonsetnaho lamang theilou anahi.
English: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

tcz: Hinlah ithempu chungnungu chu Amatah Pathena hung kikatdoh a chonsetna jeh a amachang hung kipedoh ah ahin, aphat jousea dinga pha ahi. Chujouva Ama jabolna mun Pathen jetlam'a chu touvah ahitai.
en: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,
text:
HEB 10:12
Thadou: Hinlah ithempu chungnungu chu Amatah Pathena hung kikatdoh a chonsetna jeh a amachang hung kipedoh ah ahin, aphat jousea dinga pha ahi. Chujouva Ama jabolna mun Pathen jetlam'a chu touvah ahitai.
English: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

tcz: Chuche muna chu Ama amelmate suhnema aumuva chule akengto noiya kikoi ding chu ngah a umjing ahi.
en: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
text:
HEB 10:13
Thadou: Chuche muna chu Ama amelmate suhnema aumuva chule akengto noiya kikoi ding chu ngah a umjing ahi.
English: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

tcz: Ijeh inem itileh hiche khatvei Ama kikatdoh a akisutheng ho chu aitih a dinga athenga ahitauve.
en: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
text:
HEB 10:14
Thadou: Ijeh inem itileh hiche khatvei Ama kikatdoh a akisutheng ho chu aitih a dinga athenga ahitauve.
English: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

tcz: Chule Lhagao Theng chun hitima chu ahije tin ahettohsah in, hitin aseiye,
en: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
text:
HEB 10:15
Thadou: Chule Lhagao Theng chun hitima chu ahije tin ahettohsah in, hitin aseiye,
English: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

tcz: “Hiche hi keiman kamite to kitepna thah chuche nikhoa kasem ding chu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Keiman alungsunguvah kadan thupeh khum ingting, chule alunggel uva kajihlut peh ding ahi,” ati.
en: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,
text:
HEB 10:16
Thadou: “Hiche hi keiman kamite to kitepna thah chuche nikhoa kasem ding chu ahi, tin Pakaiyin aseiye. Keiman alungsunguvah kadan thupeh khum ingting, chule alunggel uva kajihlut peh ding ahi,” ati.
English: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

tcz: Chuin aseiyin, “Keiman achonsetnau le danjuilou ahinau geldoh taponge,” ati.
en: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
text:
HEB 10:17
Thadou: Chuin aseiyin, “Keiman achonsetnau le danjuilou ahinau geldoh taponge,” ati.
English: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

tcz: Chule chonset ho chu akingaidam tengleh kilhaina ngaibekit talou ahi.
en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
text:
HEB 10:18
Thadou: Chule chonset ho chu akingaidam tengleh kilhaina ngaibekit talou ahi.
English: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

tcz: Chule hitia chu sopi deitahte, van mun thengpen a chu Yeshua thisan jal'a eiho iluttheiyu ahitai.
en: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
text:
HEB 10:19
Thadou: Chule hitia chu sopi deitahte, van mun thengpen a chu Yeshua thisan jal'a eiho iluttheiyu ahitai.
English: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

tcz: Ama athi jal'a chu Yeshuan lampi thah le hinna thah chu ahon a Muntheng pentah a pondal chu ahonlhah ahitai.
en: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,
text:
HEB 10:20
Thadou: Ama athi jal'a chu Yeshuan lampi thah le hinna thah chu ahon a Muntheng pentah a pondal chu ahonlhah ahitai.
English: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

tcz: Chule eiho Thempu Chungnung Pathen in'a vaihompa chu neiya ihitah jeh uvin,
en: and having a great priest over God’s house,
text:
HEB 10:21
Thadou: Chule eiho Thempu Chungnung Pathen in'a vaihompa chu neiya ihitah jeh uvin,
English: and having a great priest over God’s house,

tcz: eiho Pathen angsungah lungdih pun tahsanna kicheh in lutjengu hite. Ijeh ham itileh selepha hetna lungthima ikithemmo channau chu Christa thisan to kichoh hal a eithensah uva chule itahsau jong twithenga kisilngima ihitauve.
en: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,
text:
HEB 10:22
Thadou: eiho Pathen angsungah lungdih pun tahsanna kicheh in lutjengu hite. Ijeh ham itileh selepha hetna lungthima ikithemmo channau chu Christa thisan to kichoh hal a eithensah uva chule itahsau jong twithenga kisilngima ihitauve.
English: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

tcz: Eihon kinepna iphotchet u hi lunglinglau louhel in kolchah kheh u hite, ijeh ham itileh Pathen hi akitepna a tahsan umtah ahije.
en: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
text:
HEB 10:23
Thadou: Eihon kinepna iphotchet u hi lunglinglau louhel in kolchah kheh u hite, ijeh ham itileh Pathen hi akitepna a tahsan umtah ahije.
English: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

tcz: Eihon khat le khat kingailutna lama kitilkhou tona le thilpha bolna lunggelu hite.
en: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
text:
HEB 10:24
Thadou: Eihon khat le khat kingailutna lama kitilkhou tona le thilpha bolna lunggelu hite.
English: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

tcz: Chule eiho ikikhop khom dingu hi mi abang khattou anahsahmo umjongleh nahsahmo pouhite, hinla khat le khat tuhin, adehset in ahungna ding nikho anai ihet u ahitah jeh hin kitilkhou tou hite.
en: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
text:
HEB 10:25
Thadou: Chule eiho ikikhop khom dingu hi mi abang khattou anahsahmo umjongleh nahsahmo pouhite, hinla khat le khat tuhin, adehset in ahungna ding nikho anai ihet u ahitah jeh hin kitilkhou tou hite.
English: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

tcz: Ngaitahteho, eihon thutah hetna inei nunguvin henasan chonset bolleu hen, hiche chonsetna ho khukhumna ding longlhenna chu umkit talouva ahitai.
en: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
text:
HEB 10:26
Thadou: Ngaitahteho, eihon thutah hetna inei nunguvin henasan chonset bolleu hen, hiche chonsetna ho khukhumna ding longlhenna chu umkit talouva ahitai.
English: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

tcz: Pathen thutanna kichat umtah chule alunghanna meikou deujeju chun namelmateho akahvam ding ahi.
en: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
text:
HEB 10:27
Thadou: Pathen thutanna kichat umtah chule alunghanna meikou deujeju chun namelmateho akahvam ding ahi.
English: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Mose dan chu ajuinom lou auma ahileh khotona beihela hettohsah mi ni ahilouleh mi thum'a kona kithatjia ahi.
en: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
text:
HEB 10:28
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Mose dan chu ajuinom lou auma ahileh khotona beihela hettohsah mi ni ahilouleh mi thum'a kona kithatjia ahi.
English: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

tcz: Geltemin Pathen Chapa akengtoa chotphaa koiya, eithensah uvah thisana kitepna chu ima hilou le aboh a gela jachatna a chuhsah, chule Pathen lungsetna ichunguva hin lhunsah Lhagao Theng pampaija koiho, chun ichangeiya khohse jo gimbolna amu dingu hitam!
en: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
text:
HEB 10:29
Thadou: Geltemin Pathen Chapa akengtoa chotphaa koiya, eithensah uvah thisana kitepna chu ima hilou le aboh a gela jachatna a chuhsah, chule Pathen lungsetna ichunguva hin lhunsah Lhagao Theng pampaija koiho, chun ichangeiya khohse jo gimbolna amu dingu hitam!
English: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

tcz: Ijehham itileh eihon hitia seidohpa chu iheuve, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman kalethuh teiding ahi.” Ama chun hitin jong aseiye, “Pakai chun amite thu atanding ahi.”
en: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
text:
HEB 10:30
Thadou: Ijehham itileh eihon hitia seidohpa chu iheuve, “Keiman phuba kalah ding ahi. Keiman kalethuh teiding ahi.” Ama chun hitin jong aseiye, “Pakai chun amite thu atanding ahi.”
English: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

tcz: Hingjing Pathen khut tenia chu gimthohna tijat umtah ahi.
en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
text:
HEB 10:31
Thadou: Hingjing Pathen khut tenia chu gimthohna tijat umtah ahi.
English: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

tcz: Nanghon Christa thu nakijil pattil laiyu chu nung geldoh un. Gimbol hesohna khohsetah thohnaa jong tahsan umtah nahiu chu geldoh uvin.
en: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:
text:
HEB 10:32
Thadou: Nanghon Christa thu nakijil pattil laiyu chu nung geldoh un. Gimbol hesohna khohsetah thohnaa jong tahsan umtah nahiu chu geldoh uvin.
English: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

tcz: Khatvei komle japi lah'ah aeng engin nakibol jiuvin chule nakivo jiuvin chule khatvei komle genthei nathoh khompi hou napanhu jiuvin ahi.
en: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
text:
HEB 10:33
Thadou: Khatvei komle japi lah'ah aeng engin nakibol jiuvin chule nakivo jiuvin chule khatvei komle genthei nathoh khompi hou napanhu jiuvin ahi.
English: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

tcz: Songkul sunga kikoiho toh genthei nathoh khomuvin, chule nanei jouseu nanghoa kona akilahdoh in jong kipana in nagel nalai uvin ahi. Nanghon nangho dinga aphajo kikoipeh a aitih a umjing ding nangau ahi naheuve.
en: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
text:
HEB 10:34
Thadou: Songkul sunga kikoiho toh genthei nathoh khomuvin, chule nanei jouseu nanghoa kona akilahdoh in jong kipana in nagel nalai uvin ahi. Nanghon nangho dinga aphajo kikoipeh a aitih a umjing ding nangau ahi naheuve.
English: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

tcz: Hijeh hin hiche Pakaiya nakingainau na-ngaplhah u tahsanna hi paidoh hih un. Hichea hin tohman nasan dingu lentah aume.
en: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
text:
HEB 10:35
Thadou: Hijeh hin hiche Pakaiya nakingainau na-ngaplhah u tahsanna hi paidoh hih un. Hichea hin tohman nasan dingu lentah aume.
English: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

tcz: Tua nangaichat u hi thohhat tohthoa lungdehat ahin, hiti hin Pathen lunglam chu boljomun. Chuteng Aman nateppeh jouseu namu dingu ahi.
en: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
text:
HEB 10:36
Thadou: Tua nangaichat u hi thohhat tohthoa lungdehat ahin, hiti hin Pathen lunglam chu boljomun. Chuteng Aman nateppeh jouseu namu dingu ahi.
English: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

tcz: “Ijeh ham itileh hetmanlouva hung dingpa chu hungding chule geisang lou ding ahi.
en: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.
text:
HEB 10:37
Thadou: “Ijeh ham itileh hetmanlouva hung dingpa chu hungding chule geisang lou ding ahi.
English: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

tcz: Chule Ka michonphaho chu tahsan jal'a hing ding ahiuve. Hinla akihei manga aumkhah le kalung lhailou ding ahi.”
en: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
text:
HEB 10:38
Thadou: Chule Ka michonphaho chu tahsan jal'a hing ding ahiuve. Hinla akihei manga aumkhah le kalung lhailou ding ahi.”
English: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

tcz: Hinlah eiho hi manthahna dinga kihei mangho ihipouve. Eiho tahsan umtah ho, alhagao huhhing'a umding ho ihiuve.
en: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
text:
HEB 10:39
Thadou: Hinlah eiho hi manthahna dinga kihei mangho ihipouve. Eiho tahsan umtah ho, alhagao huhhing'a umding ho ihiuve.
English: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

tcz: Tahsan kiti hi ikinepnau khat atahbeh a hung sohding ahi tia lunggila kisonna ahi; hichun imulouvu thil hoa lungmonna eipeuvin ahi.
en: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
text:
HEB 11:1
Thadou: Tahsan kiti hi ikinepnau khat atahbeh a hung sohding ahi tia lunggila kisonna ahi; hichun imulouvu thil hoa lungmonna eipeuvin ahi.
English: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

tcz: Atahsan jal uvin malai mi hon min phatna akimu uvin ahi.
en: For by this, the elders obtained approval.
text:
HEB 11:2
Thadou: Atahsan jal uvin malai mi hon min phatna akimu uvin ahi.
English: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

tcz: Tahsan jal in vannoi pumpi hi Pathen thupeh a kisem ahi ti iheuvin, tua imu hou hi akimuthei thil hoa kona kisema ahipoi ti iheuve.
en: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.
text:
HEB 11:3
Thadou: Tahsan jal in vannoi pumpi hi Pathen thupeh a kisem ahi ti iheuvin, tua imu hou hi akimuthei thil hoa kona kisema ahipoi ti iheuve.
English: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abel chun Cain sangin kilhaina thilto santhei aboldoh in ahi. Abel kilhaina thilto chun ama michonpha ahi ti atahlang in, chule Pathen in athilto chu asange ti akihen ahi. Abel chu athina asotlheh tah vang'in, aman vetjuithei atahsanna jal'a kon chun thu eiseipeh nalaiyun ahi.
en: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.
text:
HEB 11:4
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Abel chun Cain sangin kilhaina thilto santhei aboldoh in ahi. Abel kilhaina thilto chun ama michonpha ahi ti atahlang in, chule Pathen in athilto chu asange ti akihen ahi. Abel chu athina asotlheh tah vang'in, aman vetjuithei atahsanna jal'a kon chun thu eiseipeh nalaiyun ahi.
English: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Enoch chun thina tohlouvin vana lahtouvin aumtai–“Ama akimutapoi, ajeh chu Pathen in alah ahitai.” Ijeh inem itileh ama lahtouva aum masang chun, Pathen sulunglhai mi ahi tin anakihen ahi.
en: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.
text:
HEB 11:5
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Enoch chun thina tohlouvin vana lahtouvin aumtai–“Ama akimutapoi, ajeh chu Pathen in alah ahitai.” Ijeh inem itileh ama lahtouva aum masang chun, Pathen sulunglhai mi ahi tin anakihen ahi.
English: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

tcz: Chule tahsanna pang louva Pathen suh lunglhai kiti hi thil hithei hoi ahipoi. Chule koi hileh Ama henga hungnom chan chun Pathen aumin chule lungdihpua Ama hol ho chu tohphatman apei, kiti hi atahsan ding ahi.
en: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.
text:
HEB 11:6
Thadou: Chule tahsanna pang louva Pathen suh lunglhai kiti hi thil hithei hoi ahipoi. Chule koi hileh Ama henga hungnom chan chun Pathen aumin chule lungdihpua Ama hol ho chu tohphatman apei, kiti hi atahsan ding ahi.
English: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

tcz: Tahsan jal in Noah chun twisanglet'a kona ama insung huhdohna dingin kong lentah asemin ahi. Aman tumasanga anasoh khalou thudol hoa chun Pathen in agihna chu sei angaiyin ahi. Atahsan jal'in Noah in vannoi mitin themmo achan'in chule aman tahsan jal'a chonphatna chu akisantan ahi.
en: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.
text:
HEB 11:7
Thadou: Tahsan jal in Noah chun twisanglet'a kona ama insung huhdohna dingin kong lentah asemin ahi. Aman tumasanga anasoh khalou thudol hoa chun Pathen in agihna chu sei angaiyin ahi. Atahsan jal'in Noah in vannoi mitin themmo achan'in chule aman tahsan jal'a chonphatna chu akisantan ahi.
English: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abraham chu Pathen in a'in dalha dinga akouva chule gouva alodinga ateppehna gam'a che dinga akou chun thun ananung'e. Aman hoilama ache ding jong kihetlouvin anapotdoh jenge.
en: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.
text:
HEB 11:8
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Abraham chu Pathen in a'in dalha dinga akouva chule gouva alodinga ateppehna gam'a che dinga akou chun thun ananung'e. Aman hoilama ache ding jong kihetlouvin anapotdoh jenge.
English: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

tcz: Chule Pathen in ateppeh gam alhun jengin jong tahsan jal'in chua chun achengin ahi-ijeh ham itileh ama gampam mi bangin ponbuh in achengin ahi. Chule Isaac le Jacob thutep chang gel teni jong hitima chun aumlhon e.
