en: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.
text:
HEB 11:9
Thadou: Chule Pathen in ateppeh gam alhun jengin jong tahsan jal'in chua chun achengin ahi-ijeh ham itileh ama gampam mi bangin ponbuh in achengin ahi. Chule Isaac le Jacob thutep chang gel teni jong hitima chun aumlhon e.
English: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

tcz: Abraham chun malam a kinepna neitah a tonsot'a abul kiphutdoh khopi, Pathen in agontoh le asahdoh khopi, chu avetjing ahi.
en: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.
text:
HEB 11:10
Thadou: Abraham chun malam a kinepna neitah a tonsot'a abul kiphutdoh khopi, Pathen in agontoh le asahdoh khopi, chu avetjing ahi.
English: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Sarah jeng jong chu aching'ah ahia chule atehlheh tah vang chun cha aneitheiye. Amanu hin Pathen in akitepna asuhbulhit ding ahi ti atahsanin ahi.
en: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.
text:
HEB 11:11
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Sarah jeng jong chu aching'ah ahia chule atehlheh tah vang chun cha aneitheiye. Amanu hin Pathen in akitepna asuhbulhit ding ahi ti atahsanin ahi.
English: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

tcz: Chuti chun nampumpi khat chu athisa tobang mikhat a kon mi atama tam, vana ahsi ho jat le twikhanglen panga neldijat, hung hidoh ahiuve, asimje jong umlou ahiuve.
en: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.
text:
HEB 11:12
Thadou: Chuti chun nampumpi khat chu athisa tobang mikhat a kon mi atama tam, vana ahsi ho jat le twikhanglen panga neldijat, hung hidoh ahiuve, asimje jong umlou ahiuve.
English: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

tcz: Hiche mite jouse hi Pathen in ateppeh u chu tahsanpumin athigam tauve. Amaho hi thutep chu achangpouvin, hinla gamla tah a konin agaldot'un chule alemuvin ahi. Amahon leiset chunga hi maljin le khopemle kahi ti anomuve.
en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
text:
HEB 11:13
Thadou: Hiche mite jouse hi Pathen in ateppeh u chu tahsanpumin athigam tauve. Amaho hi thutep chu achangpouvin, hinla gamla tah a konin agaldot'un chule alemuvin ahi. Amahon leiset chunga hi maljin le khopemle kahi ti anomuve.
English: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

tcz: Ahimongin hitia sei hohin gamkhat, hichu amahoa ahimong nai tia kou ding, agaldot'u ahi.
en: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.
text:
HEB 11:14
Thadou: Ahimongin hitia sei hohin gamkhat, hichu amahoa ahimong nai tia kou ding, agaldot'u ahi.
English: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

tcz: Amahon ahung potdohnau gam chu nung ngaichatkit leu, ana kilekit thei mama ahiuve.
en: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.
text:
HEB 11:15
Thadou: Amahon ahung potdohnau gam chu nung ngaichatkit leu, ana kilekit thei mama ahiuve.
English: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

tcz: Hinlah amaho hin mun phajo agaldot'u ahi, hichu van gam ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen chu a Pathen'u tia kikou ding jahchalou ahi, ijeh ham itileh amaho ding khopi khat asem ahi.
en: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.
text:
HEB 11:16
Thadou: Hinlah amaho hin mun phajo agaldot'u ahi, hichu van gam ahi. Hijeh a chu Pathen chu a Pathen'u tia kikou ding jahchalou ahi, ijeh ham itileh amaho ding khopi khat asem ahi.
English: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Abraham Pathen in apatep chun Isaac chu akatdoh jengin ahi. Pathen thutep ho changpa, Abraham, chun achapa changkhat “Isaac chu katdoh dingin kigosademin aumin ahi,
en: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,
text:
HEB 11:17
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Abraham Pathen in apatep chun Isaac chu akatdoh jengin ahi. Pathen thutep ho changpa, Abraham, chun achapa changkhat “Isaac chu katdoh dingin kigosademin aumin ahi,
English: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

tcz: Pathen in Isaac a kona nachilhah kisim ding ahi,” tia anaseipehsa ahijeng vang chun.
en: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”
text:
HEB 11:18
Thadou: Pathen in Isaac a kona nachilhah kisim ding ahi,” tia anaseipehsa ahijeng vang chun.
English: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

tcz: Abraham chun Isaac chu athitah jongleh Pathen in ahinsah kitthei ahi tin agelin ahi. Chuleh atahbeh in, Abraham chun achapa chu athia kona akilemu kit tobanga lahthei ahitai.
en: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.
text:
HEB 11:19
Thadou: Abraham chun Isaac chu athitah jongleh Pathen in ahinsah kitthei ahi tin agelin ahi. Chuleh atahbeh in, Abraham chun achapa chu athia kona akilemu kit tobanga lahthei ahitai.
English: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

tcz: Isaac in achateni, Jacob le Esau, khonunga phattheina ateppeh chu tahsan jal ahi.
en: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.
text:
HEB 11:20
Thadou: Isaac in achateni, Jacob le Esau, khonunga phattheina ateppeh chu tahsan jal ahi.
English: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Jacob chu ateh a chule athikonin, Joseph chateni chu phatthei aboh in chule atenggol chunga akingaiyin, akunin Pathen ahoutai.
en: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.
text:
HEB 11:21
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Jacob chu ateh a chule athikonin, Joseph chateni chu phatthei aboh in chule atenggol chunga akingaiyin, akunin Pathen ahoutai.
English: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Joseph chu athi konin, lung ngamtah in Israel mipite chun Egypt adalhah dingu thu aseiye. Aman amaho chun Egypt adalhah tengu jongleh agu-achangho chu apoh dinguvin thu apen ahi.
en: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.
text:
HEB 11:22
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Joseph chu athi konin, lung ngamtah in Israel mipite chun Egypt adalhah dingu thu aseiye. Aman amaho chun Egypt adalhah tengu jongleh agu-achangho chu apoh dinguvin thu apen ahi.
English: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose nulepa chun apen'in lha thum jen asel lhonin ahi. Pathen in cha lamdang tahkhat apeh lhon ahi chu ahelhon in, chuti chun lengpa thupeh thua nunlou ding jong chu akichalhon pon ahi.
en: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
text:
HEB 11:23
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Mose nulepa chun apen'in lha thum jen asel lhonin ahi. Pathen in cha lamdang tahkhat apeh lhon ahi chu ahelhon in, chuti chun lengpa thupeh thua nunlou ding jong chu akichalhon pon ahi.
English: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose chu ahung kikhanlhit phat in, Pharaoh-chanu chapa kitiding anom tapon ahi.
en: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,
text:
HEB 11:24
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Mose chu ahung kikhanlhit phat in, Pharaoh-chanu chapa kitiding anom tapon ahi.
English: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

tcz: Ama chonset nopsahna a umsang chun Pathen mite kibol hesohna chu thohkhompi ding alheng jotan ahi.
en: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,
text:
HEB 11:25
Thadou: Ama chonset nopsahna a umsang chun Pathen mite kibol hesohna chu thohkhompi ding alheng jotan ahi.
English: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

tcz: Aman Christa jal'a thoh hahsa thoh chu Egypt gouloding sanga chungnungjon agel'e, ijeh ham itileh ama chun kipaman lentah chan ding chu agaldot ahi.
en: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.
text:
HEB 11:26
Thadou: Aman Christa jal'a thoh hahsa thoh chu Egypt gouloding sanga chungnungjon agel'e, ijeh ham itileh ama chun kipaman lentah chan ding chu agaldot ahi.
English: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mose chun Lengpa lunghan ding jong chu akichapon Egypt gam adalha jengin ahi. Aman muthei loupa lam chu amit'a vejing ahijeh'in amason jom jingin ahi.
en: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
text:
HEB 11:27
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Mose chun Lengpa lunghan ding jong chu akichapon Egypt gam adalha jengin ahi. Aman muthei loupa lam chu amit'a vejing ahijeh'in amason jom jingin ahi.
English: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Mosen Israel mipite chu Kalchuh Kut mang jing dingin thupeh apen chule mithat vantil chun chapa peng masapen ho athalouna dingin thisan chu kotbul ah athekhumin ahi.
en: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.
text:
HEB 11:28
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Mosen Israel mipite chu Kalchuh Kut mang jing dingin thupeh apen chule mithat vantil chun chapa peng masapen ho athalouna dingin thisan chu kotbul ah athekhumin ahi.
English: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Israel chate chun Twipisan chu tolgolai lamjot bangin ajot galkaiyun ahi. Hinlah Egypt miten ajuigotna lamuvin abonchauvin twi lah'a alhalut gamtauve.
en: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.
text:
HEB 11:29
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Israel chate chun Twipisan chu tolgolai lamjot bangin ajot galkaiyun ahi. Hinlah Egypt miten ajuigotna lamuvin abonchauvin twi lah'a alhalut gamtauve.
English: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in Israel mite chun Jericho kulpi chu ni sagi avelun, chule kulpi bangho chu achim in ajal lhatai.
en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.
text:
HEB 11:30
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in Israel mite chun Jericho kulpi chu ni sagi avelun, chule kulpi bangho chu achim in ajal lhatai.
English: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

tcz: Tahsan jal'in notinu Rahab chu ama chenna khopi mite Pathen sei ngailou ho tochun amantha tapoi. Ijeh ham itileh aman gamvelhi ho chu phatechan analamdot in ahi.
en: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.
text:
HEB 11:31
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in notinu Rahab chu ama chenna khopi mite Pathen sei ngailou ho tochun amantha tapoi. Ijeh ham itileh aman gamvelhi ho chu phatechan analamdot in ahi.
English: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

tcz: Ipi ijat kaseibe nahlai ding ham? Tahsan neiho–Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel, chule themgao ho jouse thudol velsei chu saoval ding ahi.
en: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—
text:
HEB 11:32
Thadou: Ipi ijat kaseibe nahlai ding ham? Tahsan neiho–Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jepthah, David, Samuel, chule themgao ho jouse thudol velsei chu saoval ding ahi.
English: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

tcz: Tahsan jal'in amaho hin lenggam ho alehkhup uvin, thudih in vai ahomun, chule Pathen in ateppeh houchu achangtauve. Keipiho kam asippeh uvin,
en: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
text:
HEB 11:33
Thadou: Tahsan jal'in amaho hin lenggam ho alehkhup uvin, thudih in vai ahomun, chule Pathen in ateppeh houchu achangtauve. Keipiho kam asippeh uvin,
English: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

tcz: meikou achendaiyun, chemjam hema konin thinaa asohchauve. Athalhomnau chu thahatna asohdoh in ahi. Amaho galsatna a ahat un chule sepai jouse chu gal asatsah uve.
en: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.
text:
HEB 11:34
Thadou: meikou achendaiyun, chemjam hema konin thinaa asohchauve. Athalhomnau chu thahatna asohdoh in ahi. Amaho galsatna a ahat un chule sepai jouse chu gal asatsah uve.
English: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

tcz: Numei hon jong angailut hou chu athinauva konin ahingin akimu kit un ahi. Hinlah midang phabep chu gimbol hesoh athoh un, chamlhat ding deina a Pathen nungat anomdeh pouve. Amahon thokitna ahunglhun jouva hinkho phajo chu akineppiu ahi.
en: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.
text:
HEB 11:35
Thadou: Numei hon jong angailut hou chu athinauva konin ahingin akimu kit un ahi. Hinlah midang phabep chu gimbol hesoh athoh un, chamlhat ding deina a Pathen nungat anomdeh pouve. Amahon thokitna ahunglhun jouva hinkho phajo chu akineppiu ahi.
English: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

tcz: Mi phabep chu nuisat achangun, chule atungtunu chu jepna mahaho jeh in atan chetchut'e. Adangho chu songkul sunga thihkhaova hen ahiuve.
en: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
text:
HEB 11:36
Thadou: Mi phabep chu nuisat achangun, chule atungtunu chu jepna mahaho jeh in atan chetchut'e. Adangho chu songkul sunga thihkhaova hen ahiuve.
English: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

tcz: Phabep chu songa aseplih un, phabepma thing atna ah akehso un, chule mi phabep chu chemjam a athat un ahi. Phabep jen chu kelngoivun le kelchavun kiahpumin, lhasam le engsetah in abol'un, chule abolseuvin ahi.
en: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—
text:
HEB 11:37
Thadou: Phabep chu songa aseplih un, phabepma thing atna ah akehso un, chule mi phabep chu chemjam a athat un ahi. Phabep jen chu kelngoivun le kelchavun kiahpumin, lhasam le engsetah in abol'un, chule abolseuvin ahi.
English: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

tcz: Amaho hiche vannoi ding hin apha behseh un ahi, gamthipho le molchunga avahvei leuvin, leikole songko hoa akiseluvin ahi.
en: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.
text:
HEB 11:38
Thadou: Amaho hiche vannoi ding hin apha behseh un ahi, gamthipho le molchunga avahvei leuvin, leikole songko hoa akiseluvin ahi.
English: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

tcz: Amaho jouse hin atahsan jal uvin minphatna akilodoh tauve, ahijeng vang'in amaho khatbeh in jong Pathen in athuteppeh jouseu chu achangdeh pouve.
en: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,
text:
HEB 11:39
Thadou: Amaho jouse hin atahsan jal uvin minphatna akilodoh tauve, ahijeng vang'in amaho khatbeh in jong Pathen in athuteppeh jouseu chu achangdeh pouve.
English: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in eiho dinga thilphajo akheh ahin, hitia chu eiho louva amaho chamkimna changlou ding ahiuve.
en: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
text:
HEB 11:40
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in eiho dinga thilphajo akheh ahin, hitia chu eiho louva amaho chamkimna changlou ding ahiuve.
English: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

tcz: Hijehchun, tahsan hinkhoa jong hettohsah mihonpi nasatah in eiumkimvelu ahin, ichunguva kaijing ipohgih u eihatmosah u, adehset'a einohphahsah uva chonset hi pailhau hite. Chule thohhattah in Pathen in imasanguva akoi kilhaitetna a hin lhaiyuhite.
en: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
text:
HEB 12:1
Thadou: Hijehchun, tahsan hinkhoa jong hettohsah mihonpi nasatah in eiumkimvelu ahin, ichunguva kaijing ipohgih u eihatmosah u, adehset'a einohphahsah uva chonset hi pailhau hite. Chule thohhattah in Pathen in imasanguva akoi kilhaitetna a hin lhaiyuhite.
English: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

tcz: Eihon hiche hi, itahsanu akipatna le achamkim sahpa, Yeshua, lam jeng vea ibol'u ahi. Aman kipana amuding jeh chun, thingpel gimna chu anathoh in, jumna le mai mohna ijaseplouvin aumin ahi. Tun, Ama Pathen laltouna muna jabolna a atoutan ahi.
en: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
text:
HEB 12:2
Thadou: Eihon hiche hi, itahsanu akipatna le achamkim sahpa, Yeshua, lam jeng vea ibol'u ahi. Aman kipana amuding jeh chun, thingpel gimna chu anathoh in, jumna le mai mohna ijaseplouvin aumin ahi. Tun, Ama Pathen laltouna muna jabolna a atoutan ahi.
English: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

tcz: Michonse hoa kona adoudalnau natoh jouse thoh lhumkei pachu geldoh un, chutile nangma thachola naum louding chule moh ngahnomna naneilou ding ahi.
en: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
text:
HEB 12:3
Thadou: Michonse hoa kona adoudalnau natoh jouse thoh lhumkei pachu geldoh un, chutile nangma thachola naum louding chule moh ngahnomna naneilou ding ahi.
English: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

tcz: Among'in, nangho chonset douna a napan nauvah hinkho katdoh chan geiyin nathoh gimpouve.
en: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
text:
HEB 12:4
Thadou: Among'in, nangho chonset douna a napan nauvah hinkho katdoh chan geiyin nathoh gimpouve.
English: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

tcz: Achate hina jal'a Pathen in nahenguva tilkhounaa athusei chu nasuhmilu hitam? Aman hitin ati, “Ka chapa Pakai thununna chu imalouvin gelhihbeh in, Aman nasuhdih tengleh lunglhahnan neihih in.
en: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh Pakaiyin angailut chu athunun ahi, chule Acha hina a alah chan chu agimbolji ahi.”
en: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
text:
HEB 12:6
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh Pakaiyin angailut chu athunun ahi, chule Acha hina a alah chan chu agimbolji ahi.”
English: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

tcz: Nanghon hiche Pathena kona thununna chu nasan uva ahileh Pathen in achate tahbeh hina a nabolu ahi. Koiham apan athununlou chapa najah khah um?
en: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
text:
HEB 12:7
Thadou: Nanghon hiche Pathena kona thununna chu nasan uva ahileh Pathen in achate tahbeh hina a nabolu ahi. Koiham apan athununlou chapa najah khah um?
English: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

tcz: Pathen in achate jouse abolna banga nathunun louva ahileh nangho jaocha nahiu chule chatahbeh hilou nahiuve.
en: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
text:
HEB 12:8
Thadou: Pathen in achate jouse abolna banga nathunun louva ahileh nangho jaocha nahiu chule chatahbeh hilou nahiuve.
English: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

tcz: Eihon leiset a ipateu eithunun hou chu ijaboluva ahileh, chusanga chu ilhagaohou le tonsot'a umjing iPau thua chu nungcheh lou ding ihiuvem?
en: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
text:
HEB 12:9
Thadou: Eihon leiset a ipateu eithunun hou chu ijaboluva ahileh, chusanga chu ilhagaohou le tonsot'a umjing iPau thua chu nungcheh lou ding ihiuvem?
English: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh leiset a ipateuvin eithununnau hi kum phabep sunga dinga abolthei chan gei uva dinga aboljiu ahi. Hinla Pathen in eithunun nauhi eihon Ama thennaa chu chanpha ineikhom theina dingu ahiye.
en: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
text:
HEB 12:10
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh leiset a ipateuvin eithununnau hi kum phabep sunga dinga abolthei chan gei uva dinga aboljiu ahi. Hinla Pathen in eithunun nauhi eihon Ama thennaa chu chanpha ineikhom theina dingu ahiye.
English: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

tcz: Thununna hi apet a anom khatcha aumpoi–thoh hahsa ahi! Hinla hitia kichuhna neisaho dinga chu cham-lungmonna hinkhoa hinna aneithei dingu ahi.
en: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
text:
HEB 12:11
Thadou: Thununna hi apet a anom khatcha aumpoi–thoh hahsa ahi! Hinla hitia kichuhna neisaho dinga chu cham-lungmonna hinkhoa hinna aneithei dingu ahi.
English: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun thacholsa nakhut'u chun tuhchah phakit henlang chule khup ngoisa ho chu thahatsah kit'un.
en: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
text:
HEB 12:12
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun thacholsa nakhut'u chun tuhchah phakit henlang chule khup ngoisa ho chu thahatsah kit'un.
English: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

tcz: Nakengphang teniuva ding uvin lampi jangkeiyin jot'un chutileh thalhom le elbaihon kiseplhu louva, thanei tah a lam ajotdiu ahitai.
en: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
text:
HEB 12:13
Thadou: Nakengphang teniuva ding uvin lampi jangkeiyin jot'un chutileh thalhom le elbaihon kiseplhu louva, thanei tah a lam ajotdiu ahitai.
English: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

tcz: Amitakip to kitohdel a hinding gelkhoh un, chule hinkho thenga hing dingin kiseh un, thenna hinkho manglou hon Pakai chu amulou dingu ahi.
en: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
text:
HEB 12:14
Thadou: Amitakip to kitohdel a hinding gelkhoh un, chule hinkho thenga hing dingin kiseh un, thenna hinkho manglou hon Pakai chu amulou dingu ahi.
English: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

tcz: Pathen milungsetna changlel a naum louna dinguvin nangho khat le khat kivephauvin. Kihongphauvin koiman thinathei lunggitlou kengpumin nahinkho man suhboi dauhen, mitampi suhboh thei ahi.
en: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
text:
HEB 12:15
Thadou: Pathen milungsetna changlel a naum louna dinguvin nangho khat le khat kivephauvin. Kihongphauvin koiman thinathei lunggitlou kengpumin nahinkho man suhboi dauhen, mitampi suhboh thei ahi.
English: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

tcz: Chingtheiyun koima Esau tobanga chonlambei ahilouleh Pathen ngaisahlouna neiya cha masapen hina chanvou chu an khoukhat neh a kijoh doh umkhauvin nate.
en: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
text:
HEB 12:16
Thadou: Chingtheiyun koima Esau tobanga chonlambei ahilouleh Pathen ngaisahlouna neiya cha masapen hina chanvou chu an khoukhat neh a kijoh doh umkhauvin nate.
English: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

tcz: Aman khonungin apa phatthei bohna chu achannom vang'in kisihna dinga vaigei behseh ahitah jeh in kisih a kappuma ahol vang'in akiphalpeh tapoi.
en: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
text:
HEB 12:17
Thadou: Aman khonungin apa phatthei bohna chu achannom vang'in kisihna dinga vaigei behseh ahitah jeh in kisih a kappuma ahol vang'in akiphalpeh tapoi.
English: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

tcz: Nangho Israel ten Sinai mol a amuu meikou, muthim lhangkhal kiheh, chimpei aumna mun, molchung mun tobanga chu hunga nahi pouve.
en: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
text:
HEB 12:18
Thadou: Nangho Israel ten Sinai mol a amuu meikou, muthim lhangkhal kiheh, chimpei aumna mun, molchung mun tobanga chu hunga nahi pouve.
English: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh amaho chun sumkon kimut ginglenglung chu ajauvin chule tijat umtah awgin chu ajah uva konin Pathen in ajah uva thu aseitahlou dingin ataovun ahi.
en: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
text:
HEB 12:19
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh amaho chun sumkon kimut ginglenglung chu ajauvin chule tijat umtah awgin chu ajah uva konin Pathen in ajah uva thu aseitahlou dingin ataovun ahi.
English: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

tcz: Mihonpi chun Pathen Thupeh, “Ganchan mol chu atohkhah jongleh songa selih ding ahi,” kiti chu kidang asauvin anunglhuh ui.
en: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
text:
HEB 12:20
Thadou: Mihonpi chun Pathen Thupeh, “Ganchan mol chu atohkhah jongleh songa selih ding ahi,” kiti chu kidang asauvin anunglhuh ui.
English: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

tcz: Mose amatah jengin jong amittaha amuchun atijavalin aseitai, “Keima kati ajan chule kakithing thing e,” ati.
en: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
text:
HEB 12:21
Thadou: Mose amatah jengin jong amittaha amuchun atijavalin aseitai, “Keima kati ajan chule kakithing thing e,” ati.
English: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

tcz: Ahin, nangho Zion Mol, hingjing Pathen khopi, Van Jerusalem, chule asangsang simsenlou vantil ho kikhopna mun chu lhunga nahi tauve.
en: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
text:
HEB 12:22
Thadou: Ahin, nangho Zion Mol, hingjing Pathen khopi, Van Jerusalem, chule asangsang simsenlou vantil ho kikhopna mun chu lhunga nahi tauve.
English: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

tcz: Nangho Pathen cha apeng masa, van'a aminu kisun ho lah a chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho Pathen ijakai chunga thutanpa henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho tua chamkima kisem chondih ho lhagao umna van gam'a chu hunga nahi tauve.
en: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
text:
HEB 12:23
Thadou: Nangho Pathen cha apeng masa, van'a aminu kisun ho lah a chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho Pathen ijakai chunga thutanpa henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Nangho tua chamkima kisem chondih ho lhagao umna van gam'a chu hunga nahi tauve.
English: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

tcz: Nangho Pathen le miho kikah a palaiya pangpa Yeshua henga chu hunga nahi tauvin, chule thisan kithekhum muna chu hunga nahi tauve, hichu Abel thisan tobanga phuba lahna dinga ka-na awgin chu hilouvin, ngaidamna thu asei ahitai.
en: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
text:
HEB 12:24
Thadou: Nangho Pathen le miho kikah a palaiya pangpa Yeshua henga chu hunga nahi tauvin, chule thisan kithekhum muna chu hunga nahi tauve, hichu Abel thisan tobanga phuba lahna dinga ka-na awgin chu hilouvin, ngaidamna thu asei ahitai.
English: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

tcz: Najah uva thuseipa thu chu ngailouva naum louna dinguvin kichih theiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Israel mipiten bon Mose, leiset'a athupole palaipa, sei angailou jeh uva asochatlou uva ahileh, eihon vana kona thuseipa thu chu ingailou uleh ihoidoh louhel dingu ahi.
en: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
text:
HEB 12:25
Thadou: Najah uva thuseipa thu chu ngailouva naum louna dinguvin kichih theiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Israel mipiten bon Mose, leiset'a athupole palaipa, sei angailou jeh uva asochatlou uva ahileh, eihon vana kona thuseipa thu chu ingailou uleh ihoidoh louhel dingu ahi.
English: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

tcz: Pathen in Sinai Mola kona thu asei chun a awgin chun leiset ahotlingin, hinla tun thutep chom dang khat eineiyuve, “Keiman leiset jengseh kaholing ding ahipon, vanho jong kaholing ding ahi,” ati.
en: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
text:
HEB 12:26
Thadou: Pathen in Sinai Mola kona thu asei chun a awgin chun leiset ahotlingin, hinla tun thutep chom dang khat eineiyuve, “Keiman leiset jengseh kaholing ding ahipon, vanho jong kaholing ding ahi,” ati.
English: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

tcz: Hiche hin thilsem jouse kihotlingsoh a chule kichondoh ding ahi ti avetsah e, hitia chu akiling theilou ho bou umden ding ahi.
en: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
text:
HEB 12:27
Thadou: Hiche hin thilsem jouse kihotlingsoh a chule kichondoh ding ahi ti avetsah e, hitia chu akiling theilou ho bou umden ding ahi.
English: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

tcz: Eihon Lenggam khat akiling louhel ichan diu ahijeh'in, kichatna thenga Ama houna le ginna neipum in thangvah'u hitin chule Pathen lunglhaina peu hite.
en: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
text:
HEB 12:28
Thadou: Eihon Lenggam khat akiling louhel ichan diu ahijeh'in, kichatna thenga Ama houna le ginna neipum in thangvah'u hitin chule Pathen lunglhaina peu hite.
English: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh IPathenu chu mivallhum meikong ahi.
en: for our God is a consuming fire.
text:
HEB 12:29
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh IPathenu chu mivallhum meikong ahi.
English: for our God is a consuming fire.

tcz: Sopi hina a khat le khat kingailut tona neijom jingun.
en: Let brotherly love continue.
text:
HEB 13:1
Thadou: Sopi hina a khat le khat kingailut tona neijom jingun.
English: Let brotherly love continue.

tcz: Nanghon kholjin hungho chu phatbol ding sumil hih un, ijeh ham itileh hitia bol a vantil ho hetlouva lhunsah khah aumun ahi!
en: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
text:
HEB 13:2
Thadou: Nanghon kholjin hungho chu phatbol ding sumil hih un, ijeh ham itileh hitia bol a vantil ho hetlouva lhunsah khah aumun ahi!
English: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

tcz: Songkul'a nangho tah aumsa bangin kigelun lang, songkul'a umho chu geldoh un. Nanghon natahsauva gimbol natna amahon athoh u nangho tah in nathoh sau ahi tobang'in, alamlouva kibolho jong chu geldoh un.
en: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
text:
HEB 13:3
Thadou: Songkul'a nangho tah aumsa bangin kigelun lang, songkul'a umho chu geldoh un. Nanghon natahsauva gimbol natna amahon athoh u nangho tah in nathoh sau ahi tobang'in, alamlouva kibolho jong chu geldoh un.
English: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

tcz: Imalam jousea kichenhi jabolun, chule kichenna a kitahna hi khat'in khatchunga neiyun. Pathen in chonthanghoi bol ho le jonbol ho thu atanding ahi.
en: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
text:
HEB 13:4
Thadou: Imalam jousea kichenhi jabolun, chule kichenna a kitahna hi khat'in khatchunga neiyun. Pathen in chonthanghoi bol ho le jonbol ho thu atanding ahi.
English: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

tcz: Sum ngailu hih un; nanei chung'ah lungkimna neiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in aseisa ahitai, “Keiman nangma kalha louhel ding nahi. Keiman nangma kachanglha lou hel ding nahi,” ati.
en: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
text:
HEB 13:5
Thadou: Sum ngailu hih un; nanei chung'ah lungkimna neiyun. Ijeh ham itileh Pathen in aseisa ahitai, “Keiman nangma kalha louhel ding nahi. Keiman nangma kachanglha lou hel ding nahi,” ati.
English: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

tcz: Hijeh a chu eihon lungngam tah a, “Pakaiyin eikithopin, hijeh a keima kichalou ding kahi. Miho bep'in ka chunga ipi abol diu ham?” tia isei theiyu ahi.
en: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
text:
HEB 13:6
Thadou: Hijeh a chu eihon lungngam tah a, “Pakaiyin eikithopin, hijeh a keima kichalou ding kahi. Miho bep'in ka chunga ipi abol diu ham?” tia isei theiyu ahi.
English: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

tcz: Na lamkaiyu Pathen Thu nahil hou chu geldoh un. Ahinkhouva thilpha ahinsodoh hou chu gelun, chule atahsanu vettonthei chu juiyun.
en: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
text:
HEB 13:7
Thadou: Na lamkaiyu Pathen Thu nahil hou chu geldoh un. Ahinkhouva thilpha ahinsodoh hou chu gelun, chule atahsanu vettonthei chu juiyun.
English: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

tcz: Yeshua Christa hi janhi, tuni chule a-i-tih a ahina abang ahijinge.
en: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
text:
HEB 13:8
Thadou: Yeshua Christa hi janhi, tuni chule a-i-tih a ahina abang ahijinge.
English: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

tcz: Hijeh chun thuhil lamdang le gotchom'ah lunglut hih helun. Na thahatnau hi Pathen lungsetnaa hungkon ahibouvin, anneh thudola chonna hoa kon ahipoi, hiche thua kisalunggim hon ima phatchomna aneipouve.
en: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
text:
HEB 13:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun thuhil lamdang le gotchom'ah lunglut hih helun. Na thahatnau hi Pathen lungsetnaa hungkon ahibouvin, anneh thudola chonna hoa kon ahipoi, hiche thua kisalunggim hon ima phatchomna aneipouve.
English: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

tcz: Eihon maicham khat, thempuhon Houbuh sunga nehtheina thaneina aneilouvu, ineiyun ahi.
en: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
text:
HEB 13:10
Thadou: Eihon maicham khat, thempuhon Houbuh sunga nehtheina thaneina aneilouvu, ineiyun ahi.
English: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

tcz: Chonna lui dungjuiya thempu chungnung chun gancha thisan chu Munthenga chonset maicham thiltoa ahin choilut ahin, chule gancha ho tahsa pumho chu khopi pamlama ahalvam jiu ahi.
en: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
text:
HEB 13:11
Thadou: Chonna lui dungjuiya thempu chungnung chun gancha thisan chu Munthenga chonset maicham thiltoa ahin choilut ahin, chule gancha ho tahsa pumho chu khopi pamlama ahalvam jiu ahi.
English: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

tcz: Hitobangma a jong chu Yeshua chun khopi kotpi polama chu gim athoh a chule thia athisan'a amite athensah ahi.
en: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
text:
HEB 13:12
Thadou: Hitobangma a jong chu Yeshua chun khopi kotpi polama chu gim athoh a chule thia athisan'a amite athensah ahi.
English: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

tcz: Hiti chun eiho Ama henga kulpi pam lama chun gachedoh uhitin, chule Aman jachatna apoh chu gapoh hu-ute.
en: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
text:
HEB 13:13
Thadou: Hiti chun eiho Ama henga kulpi pam lama chun gachedoh uhitin, chule Aman jachatna apoh chu gapoh hu-ute.
English: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

tcz: Ijeh ham itileh hiche vannoiya hi indet aumden ding ineipouve; eihon ahunglhung ding in inga nahlaiyu ahi.
en: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
text:
HEB 13:14
Thadou: Ijeh ham itileh hiche vannoiya hi indet aumden ding ineipouve; eihon ahunglhung ding in inga nahlaiyu ahi.
English: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

tcz: Hichejeh chun Yeshua vanga Pathen vahchoi jingna eihon Amina ikitahnau phondohna kilhaina neijom jingu hite.
en: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
text:
HEB 13:15
Thadou: Hichejeh chun Yeshua vanga Pathen vahchoi jingna eihon Amina ikitahnau phondohna kilhaina neijom jingu hite.
English: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

tcz: Chule thilpha bol le ngaichatna neiho to chan neikhom ding sumil hih un. Hitobang kilhaina ho hi Pathen lunglhaina ahi.
en: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
text:
HEB 13:16
Thadou: Chule thilpha bol le ngaichatna neiho to chan neikhom ding sumil hih un. Hitobang kilhaina ho hi Pathen lunglhaina ahi.
English: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

tcz: Lhagaova nalamkai hou thun nungun, chule ipi aseiyu bol un. Amaho hi nalhagaovu honbitna a natong ahiuvin, chule amaho Pathena mopoa ahiuve. Amaho chun kipahtah a aboltheina dingu le lunghimo puma bol louna dinguvin, ajeh phatah in peuvin. Hichu nangho dinga phatchomna hilou hel ding ahi.
en: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
text:
HEB 13:17
Thadou: Lhagaova nalamkai hou thun nungun, chule ipi aseiyu bol un. Amaho hi nalhagaovu honbitna a natong ahiuvin, chule amaho Pathena mopoa ahiuve. Amaho chun kipahtah a aboltheina dingu le lunghimo puma bol louna dinguvin, ajeh phatah in peuvin. Hichu nangho dinga phatchomna hilou hel ding ahi.
English: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

tcz: Keiho dingin taovun, ijeh ham itileh selepha hetna kaneiyu hi akicheh in chule kabolnalam jouseuvah jana neitah in hinkho kaman nomuvin ahi.
en: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
text:
HEB 13:18
Thadou: Keiho dingin taovun, ijeh ham itileh selepha hetna kaneiyu hi akicheh in chule kabolnalam jouseuvah jana neitah in hinkho kaman nomuvin ahi.
English: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

tcz: Chule adeh'a keima nangho kom agangthei pena kahungtheina dingin taovun.
en: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
text:
HEB 13:19
Thadou: Chule adeh'a keima nangho kom agangthei pena kahungtheina dingin taovun.
English: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

tcz: Tun cham-lungmon kona Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua, kelngoiho Achingpipa, thina a kona kaithoupa, athisan a tonsot kitepna namdet nom pa chun–
en: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
text:
HEB 13:20
Thadou: Tun cham-lungmon kona Pathen, IPakaiyu Yeshua, kelngoiho Achingpipa, thina a kona kaithoupa, athisan a tonsot kitepna namdet nom pa chun–
English: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

tcz: Nangaichatnau jousea alunggot bolna dingin nabulhinsah uhen. Ama chun Yeshua Christa thuneina jal in, nachung uva thilpha lamjousea Ama lunglhaina dingin sodoh hen. Loupina jouse tonsot atonsot in Amaa hijinghen! Amen.
en: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
text:
HEB 13:21
Thadou: Nangaichatnau jousea alunggot bolna dingin nabulhinsah uhen. Ama chun Yeshua Christa thuneina jal in, nachung uva thilpha lamjousea Ama lunglhaina dingin sodoh hen. Loupina jouse tonsot atonsot in Amaa hijinghen! Amen.
English: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte kangeh nahiuve, hiche tilkhouna chomcha kajih hi gelkhoh uvin.
en: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
text:
HEB 13:22
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte kangeh nahiuve, hiche tilkhouna chomcha kajih hi gelkhoh uvin.
English: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

tcz: Keiman nahet dingu kadei chu isopiu Timothy chu songkul'a konin ahinlha doh tauve. Ama hikoma ahungvah a ahileh nanghoto kimuto dinga kahin lhonpi ding ahi.
en: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
text:
HEB 13:23
Thadou: Keiman nahet dingu kadei chu isopiu Timothy chu songkul'a konin ahinlha doh tauve. Ama hikoma ahungvah a ahileh nanghoto kimuto dinga kahin lhonpi ding ahi.
English: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

tcz: Chuche mun a nalamkaihou le tahsannei ho jouse analemun. Italy a tahsan neihon lemna nahin thot ui.
en: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
text:
HEB 13:24
Thadou: Chuche mun a nalamkaihou le tahsannei ho jouse analemun. Italy a tahsan neihon lemna nahin thot ui.
English: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

tcz: Pathen milungsetna chu nabonchauva chunga umhen. Amen.
en: Grace be with you all. Amen.
text:
HEB 13:25
Thadou: Pathen milungsetna chu nabonchauva chunga umhen. Amen.
English: Grace be with you all. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa soh, Jacob a kon ahi. keiman Judah mi atahsan ho Israel phungsom le ni gamtina kithecheh ho henga dinga kajih ahi. Chibai!
en: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.
text:
JAS 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa soh, Jacob a kon ahi. keiman Judah mi atahsan ho Israel phungsom le ni gamtina kithecheh ho henga dinga kajih ahi. Chibai!
English: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

tcz: Sopi deitahteho, nangho hahsatna hon nahinphah tenguleh, hichu hachangpa kipana dinga chanpha changin kingaitouvin.
en: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,
text:
JAS 1:2
Thadou: Sopi deitahteho, nangho hahsatna hon nahinphah tenguleh, hichu hachangpa kipana dinga chanpha changin kingaitouvin.
English: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

tcz: Ajehchu natahsanu chu akipatep tengleh, natahsan chu khanglen ding ahi ti naheuve.
en: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.
text:
JAS 1:3
Thadou: Ajehchu natahsanu chu akipatep tengleh, natahsan chu khanglen ding ahi ti naheuve.
English: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

tcz: Hijehchun khansah un, ajeh chu nathoh hatnau chu ahung khan'a abulhin tengleh nangho nabulhinuva chule nachamkim uva, imacha kiphahsamna neilou nahi dingu ahi.
en: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
text:
JAS 1:4
Thadou: Hijehchun khansah un, ajeh chu nathoh hatnau chu ahung khan'a abulhin tengleh nangho nabulhinuva chule nachamkim uva, imacha kiphahsamna neilou nahi dingu ahi.
English: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

tcz: Nanghon chihna na-ngaichat uva ahileh, hongphaltah IPathen'u koma chun thum'un, chutileh Aman napeh dingu ahi. Nathum jeh uva chu Aman nahouset louhel dingu ahi.
en: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
text:
JAS 1:5
Thadou: Nanghon chihna na-ngaichat uva ahileh, hongphaltah IPathen'u koma chun thum'un, chutileh Aman napeh dingu ahi. Nathum jeh uva chu Aman nahouset louhel dingu ahi.
English: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

tcz: Hinlah Ama koma nathum tenguleh Pathen bou natahsan chu kicheh hen. Lunglinglau hih un, ajeh chu atahsan detlou mi chu twikhanglen kinong le detna neilou huimut lon le tobang hiding ahi.
en: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
text:
JAS 1:6
Thadou: Hinlah Ama koma nathum tenguleh Pathen bou natahsan chu kicheh hen. Lunglinglau hih un, ajeh chu atahsan detlou mi chu twikhanglen kinong le detna neilou huimut lon le tobang hiding ahi.
English: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

tcz: Hitobang mi chun Pakaiya kona imacha muding kinepna neihih hen.
en: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.
text:
JAS 1:7
Thadou: Hitobang mi chun Pakaiya kona imacha muding kinepna neihih hen.
English: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

tcz: Amaho kiphaldohna chu Pathen le vannoiya kihom khen'ah ahiuvin, chule abol jouseu chu detna neilou ahiuve.
en: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
text:
JAS 1:8
Thadou: Amaho kiphaldohna chu Pathen le vannoiya kihom khen'ah ahiuvin, chule abol jouseu chu detna neilou ahiuve.
English: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

tcz: Tahsan cha avaicha hon kisonna ding khat chu aneiyuve, ajeh chu Pathen in amaho ajabol ahitai.
en: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

tcz: Chule mihao ho chu Pathen in asuhnemu chu kithang-atnan neijou hen. Amaho chu loujaova pahcha neocha tobanga mola ahitauve.
en: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.
text:
JAS 1:10
Thadou: Chule mihao ho chu Pathen in asuhnemu chu kithang-atnan neijou hen. Amaho chu loujaova pahcha neocha tobanga mola ahitauve.
English: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

tcz: Nisa sat chu ahungsa cheh cheh in hampa chu asang gop in: Pahcha neocha chu apul in chule ahoina jong amollha jitai. Hitobang a chu, mihaoho jong athilbol doh jouseu toh mollha jeng diu ahiuve.
en: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
text:
JAS 1:11
Thadou: Nisa sat chu ahungsa cheh cheh in hampa chu asang gop in: Pahcha neocha chu apul in chule ahoina jong amollha jitai. Hitobang a chu, mihaoho jong athilbol doh jouseu toh mollha jeng diu ahiuve.
English: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

tcz: Patepna le lhepna a thoh hattah'a pang ho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh ding ahi: Chujoutah chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho athutep hinna lallukhuh chu amahon asan dingu ahi.
en: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.
text:
JAS 1:12
Thadou: Patepna le lhepna a thoh hattah'a pang ho chu Pathen in phatthei aboh ding ahi: Chujoutah chule Pathen in Ama ngailuho athutep hinna lallukhuh chu amahon asan dingu ahi.
English: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

tcz: Chule nanghon lhepna nato tenguleh geldoh un, “Pathen in eilhep patep ahi” tin hinsei hih beh un. Pathen chu thil dihlou bol dingin akilhem patep khapoi chule Ama chun koima alhem khapoi.
en: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.
text:
JAS 1:13
Thadou: Chule nanghon lhepna nato tenguleh geldoh un, “Pathen in eilhep patep ahi” tin hinsei hih beh un. Pathen chu thil dihlou bol dingin akilhem patep khapoi chule Ama chun koima alhem khapoi.
English: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

tcz: Lhep patepna hi eima ho lung ngaichatna a hung kipanjia hichun eidoha boljiuva chule eipui mang jiu ahi.
en: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.
text:
JAS 1:14
Thadou: Lhep patepna hi eima ho lung ngaichatna a hung kipanjia hichun eidoha boljiuva chule eipui mang jiu ahi.
English: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

tcz: Hiche lung ngaichatna ho hin chonset natoh ahin sodohji ahi. Chule chonset chu akhangtou dia akiphal teng leh, hichun thina ahin sohdoh ji ahi.
en: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.
text:
JAS 1:15
Thadou: Hiche lung ngaichatna ho hin chonset natoh ahin sodohji ahi. Chule chonset chu akhangtou dia akiphal teng leh, hichun thina ahin sohdoh ji ahi.
English: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopite, puimang theiyin umhih'un.
en: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
text:
JAS 1:16
Thadou: Hijeh chun sopite, puimang theiyin umhih'un.
English: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

tcz: Ipi hileh apha le achamkim chu I-Pau Pathena hungkon ahi, Ama chun van hoa vah jouse asem ahi. Ama akichonle theile banga kikhel jing ahipoi.
en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.
text:
JAS 1:17
Thadou: Ipi hileh apha le achamkim chu I-Pau Pathena hungkon ahi, Ama chun van hoa vah jouse asem ahi. Ama akichonle theile banga kikhel jing ahipoi.
English: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

tcz: Ama chun eiho dinga Athutah chu eipeh tah jeh uva pengthah dia eilhendoh u ahi. Chule eiho hi athilsem jouse lah a agou manlu tah chu ihung hiu ahitai.
en: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.
text:
JAS 1:18
Thadou: Ama chun eiho dinga Athutah chu eipeh tah jeh uva pengthah dia eilhendoh u ahi. Chule eiho hi athilsem jouse lah a agou manlu tah chu ihung hiu ahitai.
English: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, hiche hi heuvin, nangho thungaina lama gang uvin lang, thuseiyin kino hih un.
en: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

tcz: Mihem lung hanna hin Pathen ngaichat chonphatna ahin lhutpoi.
en: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
text:
JAS 1:20
Thadou: Mihem lung hanna hin Pathen ngaichat chonphatna ahin lhutpoi.
English: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

tcz: Hijeh chun, anen anamse chule na hinkhouva aphalou jouse chu paidoh un, chule Pathen in nalunguva akhum Thu chu kisanun, ajeh chu hichun na lhagaovu ahuhhing thei ahi.
en: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.
text:
JAS 1:21
Thadou: Hijeh chun, anen anamse chule na hinkhouva aphalou jouse chu paidoh un, chule Pathen in nalunguva akhum Thu chu kisanun, ajeh chu hichun na lhagaovu ahuhhing thei ahi.
English: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

tcz: Pathen Thu chu moh ngaitho hih un. Pathen Thun asei chu bolteiyun. Achuti louva ahileh nang le nang ki-ngolbol nahi ding ahitai.
en: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
text:
JAS 1:22
Thadou: Pathen Thu chu moh ngaitho hih un. Pathen Thun asei chu bolteiyun. Achuti louva ahileh nang le nang ki-ngolbol nahi ding ahitai.
English: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman Thu chu nangaiya chule najui louva ahileh, phatvet a namai vea tobang nahi ding ahi.
en: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

tcz: Nangma le nangma nakivet jouva nache mang tengleh, itobang lim pua nahi nasumil jitai.
en: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.
text:
JAS 1:24
Thadou: Nangma le nangma nakivet jouva nache mang tengleh, itobang lim pua nahi nasumil jitai.
English: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

tcz: Hinlah nangman nachamlhat sahthei achamkim kei dan chu chingthei tah'a navet a, chule hichun ipi asei nasuh mil louva najui leh, Pathen in hichu nabol jeh a phatthei naboh ding ahi.
en: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.
text:
JAS 1:25
Thadou: Hinlah nangman nachamlhat sahthei achamkim kei dan chu chingthei tah'a navet a, chule hichun ipi asei nasuh mil louva najui leh, Pathen in hichu nabol jeh a phatthei naboh ding ahi.
English: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

tcz: Nangma hou ngaisah a nakigel a ahia nakam nathunun louva ahileh, nangma tah kingol bol nahin, na Pathen hou chu pannabei hiya ahi.
en: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.
text:
JAS 1:26
Thadou: Nangma hou ngaisah a nakigel a ahia nakam nathunun louva ahileh, nangma tah kingol bol nahin, na Pathen hou chu pannabei hiya ahi.
English: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

tcz: Pa Pathen mitmua hou thengsel le adihtah chu–meithai ho chule nuneilou le pa neilou ho alunglhah nauva gakhotoa chule vannoiyin suhboh ding jahnom lou hiya ahi.
en: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
text:
JAS 1:27
Thadou: Pa Pathen mitmua hou thengsel le adihtah chu–meithai ho chule nuneilou le pa neilou ho alunglhah nauva gakhotoa chule vannoiyin suhboh ding jahnom lou hiya ahi.
English: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, loupitah IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa tahsanna neiya nakiseiyuva iti dana nanghon khohsah tum naneitheiyu hintem?
en: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.
text:
JAS 2:1
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, loupitah IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa tahsanna neiya nakiseiyuva iti dana nanghon khohsah tum naneitheiyu hintem?
English: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

tcz: Vetsahnan, nakikhop nauva chun khat tou ponsil lultah le von mantamtah kivonin hung henlang, chule midang khat avaicha le vonnen deh'a kivon khat jong chu hung lut tahen lang,
en: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,
text:
JAS 2:2
Thadou: Vetsahnan, nakikhop nauva chun khat tou ponsil lultah le von mantamtah kivonin hung henlang, chule midang khat avaicha le vonnen deh'a kivon khat jong chu hung lut tahen lang,
English: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

tcz: Nanghon mihaopa chu khohsah tum le touna nomlai peuvin lang, hinla avaicha pa jah a chun nangma hikom a khu nagadin thei ahi ahilouleh tollhanga hi natouthei ahi natileu, hi chun–
en: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”
text:
JAS 2:3
Thadou: Nanghon mihaopa chu khohsah tum le touna nomlai peuvin lang, hinla avaicha pa jah a chun nangma hikom a khu nagadin thei ahi ahilouleh tollhanga hi natouthei ahi natileu, hi chun–
English: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

tcz: Hiche dat neiya nathil bol'u chu lungthim gilou puihoi nahiu hilou ding ham?
en: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?
text:
JAS 2:4
Thadou: Hiche dat neiya nathil bol'u chu lungthim gilou puihoi nahiu hilou ding ham?
English: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

tcz: Kasei hi ngaiyun, kasopi deitahte, Pathen in vannoiya hi avaicha chu tahsan naa hao dinga alhendoh hilou ham? Ama ngailuho dinga Lenggam atep peh chu amaho chun alo dingu hilou ham?
en: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?
text:
JAS 2:5
Thadou: Kasei hi ngaiyun, kasopi deitahte, Pathen in vannoiya hi avaicha chu tahsan naa hao dinga alhendoh hilou ham? Ama ngailuho dinga Lenggam atep peh chu amaho chun alo dingu hilou ham?
English: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

tcz: Hinlah nanghon avaicha ho chu nahsah mon nabol tauve! Mihao ho chu nabolseuva le thutanna'a na puilut jiu hilou ham?
en: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?
text:
JAS 2:6
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon avaicha ho chu nahsah mon nabol tauve! Mihao ho chu nabolseuva le thutanna'a na puilut jiu hilou ham?
English: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

tcz: Amaho tah chun Yeshua Christa chu ataitomuva, amin ja um chu nakipoh u hilou ham?
en: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?
text:
JAS 2:7
Thadou: Amaho tah chun Yeshua Christa chu ataitomuva, amin ja um chu nakipoh u hilou ham?
English: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

tcz: Henge atahbeh in, nanghon Pathen Thubua dan juidia kisei: “Na heng nakom chu nangma na kingailut bangin ngailun,” kiti chu najui uleh aphai.
en: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.
text:
JAS 2:8
Thadou: Henge atahbeh in, nanghon Pathen Thubua dan juidia kisei: “Na heng nakom chu nangma na kingailut bangin ngailun,” kiti chu najui uleh aphai.
English: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon khat sanga khat he bol nahiuva ahileh, achonsea nahiuve. Danthu sukeh athemmoa nahi tauve.
en: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.
text:
JAS 2:9
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon khat sanga khat he bol nahiuva ahileh, achonsea nahiuve. Danthu sukeh athemmoa nahi tauve.
English: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

tcz: Ajeh chu dan jouse nit a khat sukeh a chu Pathen danthu jouse sukeh to kibanga ahi.
en: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.
text:
JAS 2:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu dan jouse nit a khat sukeh a chu Pathen danthu jouse sukeh to kibanga ahi.
English: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen, “Jon bol hih in,” tipa mama chun, “Tolthat hih in,” jong ati ahi. Hitia chu nangman mi natha a, jon nabollou chu hijongleh nangman dan chu napalkeh ahitai.
en: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.
text:
JAS 2:11
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen, “Jon bol hih in,” tipa mama chun, “Tolthat hih in,” jong ati ahi. Hitia chu nangman mi natha a, jon nabollou chu hijongleh nangman dan chu napalkeh ahitai.
English: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

tcz: Hijeh achu, ipi nasei hihen ahilouleh ipi nabol hijongleh, nangma nacham lhatsah dan chun nathu atanding ahiye.
en: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.
text:
JAS 2:12
Thadou: Hijeh achu, ipi nasei hihen ahilouleh ipi nabol hijongleh, nangma nacham lhatsah dan chun nathu atanding ahiye.
English: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

tcz: Midang chunga hepina neilou chu amaho chunga hepina kipelou ding ahi. Hinla nangma hepina nei nahia ahileh, Pathen in nachung thu atan teng nahepi ding ahi.
en: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
text:
JAS 2:13
Thadou: Midang chunga hepina neilou chu amaho chunga hepina kipelou ding ahi. Hinla nangma hepina nei nahia ahileh, Pathen in nachung thu atan teng nahepi ding ahi.
English: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, Nanghon katahsan aume tiuvin lang, hinla nachonnaa navetsah umhih taleh ipi phatchomna hin tem? Hitobang tahsanna chun koipen ahuhhing jou dem?
en: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
text:
JAS 2:14
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, Nanghon katahsan aume tiuvin lang, hinla nachonnaa navetsah umhih taleh ipi phatchomna hin tem? Hitobang tahsanna chun koipen ahuhhing jou dem?
English: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

tcz: Vetsahnan, nangman sopipa ahilouleh sopinu khat chu neh ding neilou ahilouleh silding neilouvin um henlang,
en: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,
text:
JAS 2:15
Thadou: Vetsahnan, nangman sopipa ahilouleh sopinu khat chu neh ding neilou ahilouleh silding neilouvin um henlang,
English: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

tcz: chule nangman, “Damselin, nikho pha mangin; lumsan chule neva set'in”—tinlang, hinla nangman hichepa chu anneh ding pelou ahilouleh silding jong pelouvin umle chun, hichun ipi phatna aboldoh em?
en: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?
text:
JAS 2:16
Thadou: chule nangman, “Damselin, nikho pha mangin; lumsan chule neva set'in”—tinlang, hinla nangman hichepa chu anneh ding pelou ahilouleh silding jong pelouvin umle chun, hichun ipi phatna aboldoh em?
English: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

tcz: Hijehchun, nangman, tahsan jengseh aphachompoi ti namutai. Thilpha bolna asodoh louva ahileh, hichu athia le pannabei ahije.
en: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.
text:
JAS 2:17
Thadou: Hijehchun, nangman, tahsan jengseh aphachompoi ti namutai. Thilpha bolna asodoh louva ahileh, hichu athia le pannabei ahije.
English: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

tcz: Tun hiche hi koiham khattouvin anelkal theiye, “Tahsan neiloi aumin, abang khatloi chun thilpha abol theiye” atiuve. Hinla kasei ahi, “Nangman thil pha nabol louva ahileh iti natahsan chu neimusah thei ding ham?” Keiman ka tahsan chu ka tohphat'in navetsah inge.
en: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.
text:
JAS 2:18
Thadou: Tun hiche hi koiham khattouvin anelkal theiye, “Tahsan neiloi aumin, abang khatloi chun thilpha abol theiye” atiuve. Hinla kasei ahi, “Nangman thil pha nabol louva ahileh iti natahsan chu neimusah thei ding ham?” Keiman ka tahsan chu ka tohphat'in navetsah inge.
English: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

tcz: Nangman tahsan kaneiye nati, ajeh chu Pathen khat ahi ti na tahsan e. Nangdin aphai! Lhagao gilouho jengin jong hiche hi atahsanun, chule akichat nauva kihot hot ah ahiuve.
en: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.
text:
JAS 2:19
Thadou: Nangman tahsan kaneiye nati, ajeh chu Pathen khat ahi ti na tahsan e. Nangdin aphai! Lhagao gilouho jengin jong hiche hi atahsanun, chule akichat nauva kihot hot ah ahiuve.
English: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

tcz: Itobanga ngolkai hitam! Tahsan chu anatoh beiya athisa ahiti namuthei tah em?
en: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
text:
JAS 2:20
Thadou: Itobanga ngolkai hitam! Tahsan chu anatoh beiya athisa ahiti namuthei tah em?
English: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

tcz: Ipuluiyu Abraham chun achapa Isaac chu maichama akatdoh jeh a athilbol chun Pathen mitmua chondih tia kisima ahi geldohlou nahiu vem?
en: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
text:
JAS 2:21
Thadou: Ipuluiyu Abraham chun achapa Isaac chu maichama akatdoh jeh a athilbol chun Pathen mitmua chondih tia kisima ahi geldohlou nahiu vem?
English: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

tcz: Nanghon atahsan le athilbol ho chu achekhom e, ti namuuve. Atahsan chu anatoh in asuh chamkim ahitai.
en: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.
text:
JAS 2:22
Thadou: Nanghon atahsan le athilbol ho chu achekhom e, ti namuuve. Atahsan chu anatoh in asuh chamkim ahitai.
English: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

tcz: Hitichun Pathen Thubun asei dung jui in, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin, Pathen in atahsan jal in chonpha tin ama chu asim tan ahi.” Ama chu Pathen golpa tinjong akikouve.
en: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.
text:
JAS 2:23
Thadou: Hitichun Pathen Thubun asei dung jui in, “Abraham'in Pathen atahsanin, Pathen in atahsan jal in chonpha tin ama chu asim tan ahi.” Ama chu Pathen golpa tinjong akikouve.
English: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

tcz: Chutichun, eihon ithilbol jeh uva Pathen anga midih hina chu ichan theiyu ahin, tahsan jengseh a kon ahipoi, ti imudoh tauve.
en: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.
text:
JAS 2:24
Thadou: Chutichun, eihon ithilbol jeh uva Pathen anga midih hina chu ichan theiyu ahin, tahsan jengseh a kon ahipoi, ti imudoh tauve.
English: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

tcz: Rahab notinu chu vetsahna chom khat ahi. Amanu hi athilbol jal'a Pathen anga midih hina chu chang theiya ahi, ajeh chu aman gam velhi teni chu asel a chule lampi chom lama bitkei cha asoldoh jeh ahi.
en: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?
text:
JAS 2:25
Thadou: Rahab notinu chu vetsahna chom khat ahi. Amanu hi athilbol jal'a Pathen anga midih hina chu chang theiya ahi, ajeh chu aman gam velhi teni chu asel a chule lampi chom lama bitkei cha asoldoh jeh ahi.
English: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

tcz: Haitheina hu aumlouleh tahsa phatchomna aumlou tobanga hi, thilpha bolna natoh ho beiya tahsan chu athi ahibouve.
en: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
text:
JAS 2:26
Thadou: Haitheina hu aumlouleh tahsa phatchomna aumlou tobanga hi, thilpha bolna natoh ho beiya tahsan chu athi ahibouve.
English: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, mitampi hi houbunga mihilin pang hih un, ajeh chu ahila pangho chunga thutanna chu gihjo cheh ding ahi.
en: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
text:
JAS 3:1
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, mitampi hi houbunga mihilin pang hih un, ajeh chu ahila pangho chunga thutanna chu gihjo cheh ding ahi.
English: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

tcz: Ahimongin, eiho jousen suhkhel tampi ineijiuve. Ajeh chu eihon ileiyu kithunun jou leuhen, eiho chamkim ihi dingu ahi chule thil danga jong kitim jou ihi dingu ahi.
en: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
text:
JAS 3:2
Thadou: Ahimongin, eiho jousen suhkhel tampi ineijiuve. Ajeh chu eihon ileiyu kithunun jou leuhen, eiho chamkim ihi dingu ahi chule thil danga jong kitim jou ihi dingu ahi.
English: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

tcz: Eihon sakol lentah khu idei dei nauva ichesah theina dinguvin akamdal ikoipeh uvin ahi.
en: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
text:
JAS 3:3
Thadou: Eihon sakol lentah khu idei dei nauva ichesah theina dinguvin akamdal ikoipeh uvin ahi.
English: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

tcz: Chule Kong innei lenpitah jong chu ahehna neocha a chu atolpan achesah nomna lam lama aheiya, hui hat jongleh athunun ahi.
en: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
text:
JAS 3:4
Thadou: Chule Kong innei lenpitah jong chu ahehna neocha a chu atolpan achesah nomna lam lama aheiya, hui hat jongleh athunun ahi.
English: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

tcz: Hitobang maa chu lei hi thil neocha thil thupi tahtah ho seithei hiya ahi. Ahin mei-am neocha khat in gammang lentah akah lhah jengthei chu ahi.
en: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
text:
JAS 3:5
Thadou: Hitobang maa chu lei hi thil neocha thil thupi tahtah ho seithei hiya ahi. Ahin mei-am neocha khat in gammang lentah akah lhah jengthei chu ahi.
English: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

tcz: Chule leigui hi mei kong tobang ahi. Hiche hi vannoi gitlouna dimset, natahsa pumpi suboh ahi. Hiche hin nahinkho pumpi meiya ahalthei, ajeh chu hiche hin meidil meikou chu akahsah ahi.
en: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
text:
JAS 3:6
Thadou: Chule leigui hi mei kong tobang ahi. Hiche hi vannoi gitlouna dimset, natahsa pumpi suboh ahi. Hiche hin nahinkho pumpi meiya ahalthei, ajeh chu hiche hin meidil meikou chu akahsah ahi.
English: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

tcz: Miho hin ganhing jouse, vacha ho, a-op a kitholho chule ngaho avah ngoi theicheh-e,
en: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

tcz: Hinlah koiman lei hi avah ngoi joupoi. Hiche hi kicholdo theilou le gilou, thina thei gu dimset ahi.
