en: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
text:
JAS 3:8
Thadou: Hinlah koiman lei hi avah ngoi joupoi. Hiche hi kicholdo theilou le gilou, thina thei gu dimset ahi.
English: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

tcz: Khatvei kom le hiche hin IPakaiyu le Pachu avahchoiyin, chule khatvei kom le Pathen lima kisem chu agaosap jin ahi.
en: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
text:
JAS 3:9
Thadou: Khatvei kom le hiche hin IPakaiyu le Pachu avahchoiyin, chule khatvei kom le Pathen lima kisem chu agaosap jin ahi.
English: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

tcz: Chutia chu kamhom khat ma a kona chu phatthei bohna le gaosapna hung kisunglha khom jia ahi.
en: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
text:
JAS 3:10
Thadou: Chutia chu kamhom khat ma a kona chu phatthei bohna le gaosapna hung kisunglha khom jia ahi.
English: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

tcz: Twinah khat a kona chu twi thengsel le twi kha putdoh khom ngaiyem?
en: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
text:
JAS 3:11
Thadou: Twinah khat a kona chu twi thengsel le twi kha putdoh khom ngaiyem?
English: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

tcz: Theichang phungin olive ga asodoh theija ahilouleh leng piguiyin theichang ga asodoh theiyem? Ahipoi, nangman twitheng chu chitwiya konin nathaldoh thei poi.
en: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
text:
JAS 3:12
Thadou: Theichang phungin olive ga asodoh theija ahilouleh leng piguiyin theichang ga asodoh theiyem? Ahipoi, nangman twitheng chu chitwiya konin nathaldoh thei poi.
English: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

tcz: Nangma nachih a chule Pathen lamlhah ho chu nahet a ahileh, jabolna lama hinkho naman chu aphotchenna hihen chule chihna a kona natohpha kineosahna hinsodoh hen.
en: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
text:
JAS 3:13
Thadou: Nangma nachih a chule Pathen lamlhah ho chu nahet a ahileh, jabolna lama hinkho naman chu aphotchenna hihen chule chihna a kona natohpha kineosahna hinsodoh hen.
English: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon kithangthip tona naneiyuva chule nalunguva chang phatchomna hollea nahiuleh, thutah lekhuna a kiletsahna pum le jouvin thu seihih un.
en: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
text:
JAS 3:14
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon kithangthip tona naneiyuva chule nalunguva chang phatchomna hollea nahiuleh, thutah lekhuna a kiletsahna pum le jouvin thu seihih un.
English: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

tcz: Ajeh chu kithangthip le chang phatchomna holna ho hi Pathen'a hungkon chihna chu ahipoi. Hiti hohi leiset thudol, lhagao thu hilou chule lhagao gilouva kon joh ahi.
en: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
text:
JAS 3:15
Thadou: Ajeh chu kithangthip le chang phatchomna holna ho hi Pathen'a hungkon chihna chu ahipoi. Hiti hohi leiset thudol, lhagao thu hilou chule lhagao gilouva kon joh ahi.
English: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

tcz: Ajeh chu, kimit thipna le chang phatchomna umna mun a chu phatlouna jouse le kitomona namu ding ahi.
en: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
text:
JAS 3:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu, kimit thipna le chang phatchomna umna mun a chu phatlouna jouse le kitomona namu ding ahi.
English: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

tcz: Hinlah, chunga kona chihna hi amasapen a atheng ahi. Chujongleh chamna ngaichatna, phat jousea lungneng, chule midang thua jong nung nom tina ahi. Khotona dimset le thilpha bolna asodoh in ahi. Koima lama langkaina aneipon chule lungdih pun aum jinge.
en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
text:
JAS 3:17
Thadou: Hinlah, chunga kona chihna hi amasapen a atheng ahi. Chujongleh chamna ngaichatna, phat jousea lungneng, chule midang thua jong nung nom tina ahi. Khotona dimset le thilpha bolna asodoh in ahi. Koima lama langkaina aneipon chule lungdih pun aum jinge.
English: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

tcz: Chule kicham ding deiho dinga chamna muchi kitu ding chule chonphatna tohga chu amuding ahitai.
en: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
text:
JAS 3:18
Thadou: Chule kicham ding deiho dinga chamna muchi kitu ding chule chonphatna tohga chu amuding ahitai.
English: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

tcz: Nalah uva kinah le kidel ho hi ipia kon ham? Nasung uva ngaichat dihlou ho chu kidouva hilou ham?
en: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?
text:
JAS 4:1
Thadou: Nalah uva kinah le kidel ho hi ipia kon ham? Nasung uva ngaichat dihlou ho chu kidouva hilou ham?
English: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

tcz: Naneilouvu chu na deiyun, hichu mutei na gongun chutia na got nalamun nathat jiuve. Mi dang thilnei nathangseuvin, hinla na neithei pouvin, hiti chun nanghon gal nasatun amahoa kona lahdoh pehding na gouve. Ahijeng vang'in, nanghon nadeiyu chu nanei theipouve, Pathen koma nathum loujeh u ahi.
en: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.
text:
JAS 4:2
Thadou: Naneilouvu chu na deiyun, hichu mutei na gongun chutia na got nalamun nathat jiuve. Mi dang thilnei nathangseuvin, hinla na neithei pouvin, hiti chun nanghon gal nasatun amahoa kona lahdoh pehding na gouve. Ahijeng vang'in, nanghon nadeiyu chu nanei theipouve, Pathen koma nathum loujeh u ahi.
English: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

tcz: Chule nathum jeng vangun namudeh pouve, ajeh chu nalung gonu chu abona dihlou ahi-nang ho nopsahna ding bou na deijeh u ahi.
en: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
text:
JAS 4:3
Thadou: Chule nathum jeng vangun namudeh pouve, ajeh chu nalung gonu chu abona dihlou ahi-nang ho nopsahna ding bou na deijeh u ahi.
English: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

tcz: Nangho jonbolteho! Vannoito kigolvop theina hin Pathen melma a nasemu ahi geldoh lou nahiu vem? Seikit inge: Nangho Vannoito na kigolvop uva ahileh, Pathen melma a kisema nahiu ahitai.
en: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.
text:
JAS 4:4
Thadou: Nangho jonbolteho! Vannoito kigolvop theina hin Pathen melma a nasemu ahi geldoh lou nahiu vem? Seikit inge: Nangho Vannoito na kigolvop uva ahileh, Pathen melma a kisema nahiu ahitai.
English: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

tcz: Pathen Thubun Pathen Lhagao isunguva cheng hin thangsetna a eidip dimu ahi kiti hi ipi nagel uvem?
en: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
text:
JAS 4:5
Thadou: Pathen Thubun Pathen Lhagao isunguva cheng hin thangsetna a eidip dimu ahi kiti hi ipi nagel uvem?
English: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

tcz: Hinlah Ama hin hitobang lung gitlou ngaichatna idou jouna dinguva lungsetna eichan cheh joh u ahi. Pathen Thubun, “Pathen in akiletsah ho adouvin, akineosah ho akhoto'e,” ati.
en: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
text:
JAS 4:6
Thadou: Hinlah Ama hin hitobang lung gitlou ngaichatna idou jouna dinguva lungsetna eichan cheh joh u ahi. Pathen Thubun, “Pathen in akiletsah ho adouvin, akineosah ho akhoto'e,” ati.
English: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

tcz: Hitichun, Pathen masanga kineosah un. Diabol chu douvun chutileh nanghoa konin jamdoh tante.
en: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
text:
JAS 4:7
Thadou: Hitichun, Pathen masanga kineosah un. Diabol chu douvun chutileh nanghoa konin jamdoh tante.
English: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

tcz: Pathen kom nailut un, chutileh Pathen in nahin nailut dingu ahi. Nakhut u sutheng un, michonse nangho; nalungu sutheng un, ajeh chu nangho Pathen le vannoi kikah ah nalungthimu akikehsotai.
en: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
text:
JAS 4:8
Thadou: Pathen kom nailut un, chutileh Pathen in nahin nailut dingu ahi. Nakhut u sutheng un, michonse nangho; nalungu sutheng un, ajeh chu nangho Pathen le vannoi kikah ah nalungthimu akikehsotai.
English: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

tcz: Nathilbol chunguva kisihna mitlhi longdoh hen. Lungkhamna le lunghemna tahbeh soh hen. Nuina sangin kana, chule kipana sangin lhasetna sohhen.
en: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.
text:
JAS 4:9
Thadou: Nathilbol chunguva kisihna mitlhi longdoh hen. Lungkhamna le lunghemna tahbeh soh hen. Nuina sangin kana, chule kipana sangin lhasetna sohhen.
English: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

tcz: Pakai masanga kineosah un, chuteng Aman jabolna'a nadopsang dingu ahi.
en: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.
text:
JAS 4:10
Thadou: Pakai masanga kineosah un, chuteng Aman jabolna'a nadopsang dingu ahi.
English: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, khat in khat dounan thuse seihih un. Nangho naki oimo touva chule khat in khat chung thu natan u ahileh Pathen danthu chu oimoa chule athutana napanu ahitai. Hinla naboldiu dol chu danthu najui diu bou ahin, athutan ding nahi lou u ahi.
en: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
text:
JAS 4:11
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, khat in khat dounan thuse seihih un. Nangho naki oimo touva chule khat in khat chung thu natan u ahileh Pathen danthu chu oimoa chule athutana napanu ahitai. Hinla naboldiu dol chu danthu najui diu bou ahin, athutan ding nahi lou u ahi.
English: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

tcz: Danthu pea pang Pathen bou chu Thutanpa ahi. Ama bou chu huhhingthei ahilouleh sumangthei hiya ahi. Achutileh, nangman naheng nakom chunga thutan theina ipi thu naneiyem?
en: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?
text:
JAS 4:12
Thadou: Danthu pea pang Pathen bou chu Thutanpa ahi. Ama bou chu huhhingthei ahilouleh sumangthei hiya ahi. Achutileh, nangman naheng nakom chunga thutan theina ipi thu naneiyem?
English: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

tcz: Tun veuvin, “Tuni ahilouleh jing tengleh khopi khat a gacheu hitin chule chuche mun a chun kum khat ga-umu hite. Chumuna chun sumkol gakiveiyu hitin chule sumpung holuhite,” natiuve.
en: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
text:
JAS 4:13
Thadou: Tun veuvin, “Tuni ahilouleh jing tengleh khopi khat a gacheu hitin chule chuche mun a chun kum khat ga-umu hite. Chumuna chun sumkol gakiveiyu hitin chule sumpung holuhite,” natiuve.
English: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

tcz: Jing nikhoa itobang hinkho naman diu nahet uvem? Nahin khou chu jingkah twimei tobang ahi-hikoma chomkhat uma, chujoule chemang tobang ahi.
en: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.
text:
JAS 4:14
Thadou: Jing nikhoa itobang hinkho naman diu nahet uvem? Nahin khou chu jingkah twimei tobang ahi-hikoma chomkhat uma, chujoule chemang tobang ahi.
English: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

tcz: Gahsei dia pha chu, “Pakaiyin eidei peh u ahileh eiho hingu hitin chule hiche ahilouleh khuche bolu hite,” tiuvin.
en: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
text:
JAS 4:15
Thadou: Gahsei dia pha chu, “Pakaiyin eidei peh u ahileh eiho hingu hitin chule hiche ahilouleh khuche bolu hite,” tiuvin.
English: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

tcz: Achuti louva natoh gon uva nakiletsah piuva ahileh hitobang kiletsah a thusei chu phalouva ahi.
en: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
text:
JAS 4:16
Thadou: Achuti louva natoh gon uva nakiletsah piuva ahileh hitobang kiletsah a thusei chu phalouva ahi.
English: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

tcz: Geldohun, nanghon nabol dingu chu ipi ahi henasa'a nabol lou u chu chonset ahi.
en: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.
text:
JAS 4:17
Thadou: Geldohun, nanghon nabol dingu chu ipi ahi henasa'a nabol lou u chu chonset ahi.
English: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

tcz: Hinveuvin, nangho mihao hon: Kap'un chule lunghem pumin maoleuvin, ajeh chu tijat um hahsatna ho jouse na masanguva aume.
en: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
text:
JAS 5:1
Thadou: Hinveuvin, nangho mihao hon: Kap'un chule lunghem pumin maoleuvin, ajeh chu tijat um hahsatna ho jouse na masanguva aume.
English: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

tcz: Nagou thilhou amonlha gamtai, chule napon hoitah tah hou jong nget in ane heng gamtai.
en: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
text:
JAS 5:2
Thadou: Nagou thilhou amonlha gamtai, chule napon hoitah tah hou jong nget in ane heng gamtai.
English: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

tcz: Na sana hou le na dangka hou panna bei asoh gamtai. Na gou thil hou na sahlut u chun na tahsau chu meikah banga aneh mang ding ahi. Hiche gou nakhol khomu chu thutan nikhoa dinga nangho dounaa hung pang ding ahi.
en: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
text:
JAS 5:3
Thadou: Na sana hou le na dangka hou panna bei asoh gamtai. Na gou thil hou na sahlut u chun na tahsau chu meikah banga aneh mang ding ahi. Hiche gou nakhol khomu chu thutan nikhoa dinga nangho dounaa hung pang ding ahi.
English: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

tcz: Ajeh chu ngaiyun! Naloulhou atohman nalhimlhah peh hou ka awgin ngaiyun. Atohman napehlou hou chun nangho dounan kho ahin samui. Ajeh chu nalouuva tohman napehlou hou kana aw chu Van Pakai sepaite nakolsunga ahung lhung tai.
en: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
text:
JAS 5:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu ngaiyun! Naloulhou atohman nalhimlhah peh hou ka awgin ngaiyun. Atohman napehlou hou chun nangho dounan kho ahin samui. Ajeh chu nalouuva tohman napehlou hou kana aw chu Van Pakai sepaite nakolsunga ahung lhung tai.
English: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

tcz: Nanghon leiset chunga hi nomsatah a nahinkhou namanu ahin, na ngaichat chasunu chu nasuh bulhit u ahi. Nangho nakivah thaovu hi nakithana diu nikhoa dinga nahi tauve.
en: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
text:
JAS 5:5
Thadou: Nanghon leiset chunga hi nomsatah a nahinkhou namanu ahin, na ngaichat chasunu chu nasuh bulhit u ahi. Nangho nakivah thaovu hi nakithana diu nikhoa dinga nahi tauve.
English: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

tcz: Nanghon suhkhel neilou ho chu themmo nachanuva chule natha vangun, amaho chun nalethuh pouve.
en: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
text:
JAS 5:6
Thadou: Nanghon suhkhel neilou ho chu themmo nachanuva chule natha vangun, amaho chun nalethuh pouve.
English: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

tcz: Sopi deitahte, Pakai hungkilena ding na-nga nauva thoh hat un. Loubol mipan thoh hattah'a goju masa le goju nunung angaji khu ngaito uvin. Amaho chun chang amina chang atphat man lutah chu kinem tah in angah uve.
en: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
text:
JAS 5:7
Thadou: Sopi deitahte, Pakai hungkilena ding na-nga nauva thoh hat un. Loubol mipan thoh hattah'a goju masa le goju nunung angaji khu ngaito uvin. Amaho chun chang amina chang atphat man lutah chu kinem tah in angah uve.
English: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

tcz: Nangho jong thoh hat'un, lung det'un, ajeh chu Pakai hung na ding anaitai.
en: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
text:
JAS 5:8
Thadou: Nangho jong thoh hat'un, lung det'un, ajeh chu Pakai hung na ding anaitai.
English: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

tcz: Sopite, khat le khat kiphun lou jenun, achuti louleh themo changin umget uvinate. Ajeh chu veuvin-Thutanpa chu kot'a adinge!
en: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
text:
JAS 5:9
Thadou: Sopite, khat le khat kiphun lou jenun, achuti louleh themo changin umget uvinate. Ajeh chu veuvin-Thutanpa chu kot'a adinge!
English: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

tcz: Kasopi deitahte, thohhatna thudola avetsahpi dingin, Pakai mina thusei themgao ho veuvin.
en: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
text:
JAS 5:10
Thadou: Kasopi deitahte, thohhatna thudola avetsahpi dingin, Pakai mina thusei themgao ho veuvin.
English: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

tcz: Thohgimna thoh jouho eihon jabolna lentah ineiyuve. Vetsahnan, nanghon Job thoh hat chu nana heuve. Ajonaa Pakaiyin ichan geiya akhoto hitam, ajeh chu Pakai hi lungset dimset le khoto them ahi.
en: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
text:
JAS 5:11
Thadou: Thohgimna thoh jouho eihon jabolna lentah ineiyuve. Vetsahnan, nanghon Job thoh hat chu nana heuve. Ajonaa Pakaiyin ichan geiya akhoto hitam, ajeh chu Pakai hi lungset dimset le khoto them ahi.
English: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

tcz: Ahin adehset'in, kasopiteho, van panin ahilouleh lei panin, ahilouleh ipi pen min hijongleh kihahsel hih beh un.
en: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
text:
JAS 5:12
Thadou: Ahin adehset'in, kasopiteho, van panin ahilouleh lei panin, ahilouleh ipi pen min hijongleh kihahsel hih beh un.
English: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

tcz: Nalah uva hahsatna thoh um'em? Natao jing diu ahiye. Chule thangvahna ding ajeh neihon Pakai chu avahchoi jing diu ahi.
en: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
text:
JAS 5:13
Thadou: Nalah uva hahsatna thoh um'em? Natao jing diu ahiye. Chule thangvahna ding ajeh neihon Pakai chu avahchoi jing diu ahi.
English: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

tcz: Nalah uva ana damlou um'em? Nanghon houbung upa ho ahunguva, nachung uva Pakai mina thao anuuva chule taona aneina dinguva nakou diu ahi.
en: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

tcz: Hitobanga tahsan neitah a taona chun ana chu adamsah a, chule Pakaiyin nadamsah dingu ahi. Chule nanghon chonsetna chu nana bolu ahileh ngaidam chang ding nahiuve.
en: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
text:
JAS 5:15
Thadou: Hitobanga tahsan neitah a taona chun ana chu adamsah a, chule Pakaiyin nadamsah dingu ahi. Chule nanghon chonsetna chu nana bolu ahileh ngaidam chang ding nahiuve.
English: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

tcz: Na dam theina dingun nachonset'u khat in khat koma phong unlang, chule khat chu khat dingin taovun. Michonpha lung gutten'a ataona chun thaneina lentah aneiyin chule kidangtah ahinbol doh e.
en: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
text:
JAS 5:16
Thadou: Na dam theina dingun nachonset'u khat in khat koma phong unlang, chule khat chu khat dingin taovun. Michonpha lung gutten'a ataona chun thaneina lentah aneiyin chule kidangtah ahinbol doh e.
English: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

tcz: Elijah chu eimaho tobangbep mihem ahin, chuti ahijeng vang'in lung giltah a gojuh louna dinga ataova ahileh kum 3 le akeh leiset a go ajutapon ahi.
en: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
text:
JAS 5:17
Thadou: Elijah chu eimaho tobangbep mihem ahin, chuti ahijeng vang'in lung giltah a gojuh louna dinga ataova ahileh kum 3 le akeh leiset a go ajutapon ahi.
English: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

tcz: Chutah in ama ataokit in ahileh vana konin go ajun chule leiset'in aga asodohtai.
en: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
text:
JAS 5:18
Thadou: Chutah in ama ataokit in ahileh vana konin go ajun chule leiset'in aga asodohtai.
English: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

tcz: Kasopi deitahteho, nalah uva thutah'a kona avahmanga naumuva ahinlepui kitah auma ahileh,
en: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
text:
JAS 5:19
Thadou: Kasopi deitahteho, nalah uva thutah'a kona avahmanga naumuva ahinlepui kitah auma ahileh,
English: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

tcz: Koi hita jongleh michonse hin lepuiya chu, hiche mi chu thinaa kona huh doh ahin chule chonset tampi ngaidamna ahinlhut ding ahi
en: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
text:
JAS 5:20
Thadou: Koi hita jongleh michonse hin lepuiya chu, hiche mi chu thinaa kona huh doh ahin chule chonset tampi ngaidamna ahinlhut ding ahi
English: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa solchah Peter a kon ahi. Keiman Pathen lhendoh mite gamchom mi dinmun a, Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia chule Bithynia gamkai hoa cheng ho henga kajih ahi.
en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
text:
1PE 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa solchah Peter a kon ahi. Keiman Pathen lhendoh mite gamchom mi dinmun a, Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia chule Bithynia gamkai hoa cheng ho henga kajih ahi.
English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

tcz: Pa Pathen in nanahet uva chule masang peh a nalhendoh uva, chule a Lhagaovin nasuhtheng u ahitai. Hichea kona chu nanghon asei na ngaiyuva chule Yeshua Christa thisan a nasop thengu ahitai. Pathen in lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeh be be jengtau hen.
en: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
text:
1PE 1:2
Thadou: Pa Pathen in nanahet uva chule masang peh a nalhendoh uva, chule a Lhagaovin nasuhtheng u ahitai. Hichea kona chu nanghon asei na ngaiyuva chule Yeshua Christa thisan a nasop thengu ahitai. Pathen in lungsetna le cham-lungmon napeh be be jengtau hen.
English: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

tcz: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen ah vahchoina jouse umjing tahen. Ama milungsetna let jeh'a eiho pengthah a ihiu hi Pathen in Yeshua Christa chu athilah a kona akai thou jal jeh ahi.
en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
text:
1PE 1:3
Thadou: I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa Pa Pathen ah vahchoina jouse umjing tahen. Ama milungsetna let jeh'a eiho pengthah a ihiu hi Pathen in Yeshua Christa chu athilah a kona akai thou jal jeh ahi.
English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

tcz: Chule eihon gou simjou lou loding ineiyui-gouchan ding chu vana nangho dinga kikoiya ahi.
en: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
text:
1PE 1:4
Thadou: Chule eihon gou simjou lou loding ineiyui-gouchan ding chu vana nangho dinga kikoiya ahi.
English: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

tcz: Chule natahsan jaluva chu, Pathen in athahat'a hiche huhhingna hi nakisan kahseuva na honbit uva, mi jousen amutheina dinguva ni nununga hung kilang ding ahi.
en: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
text:
1PE 1:5
Thadou: Chule natahsan jaluva chu, Pathen in athahat'a hiche huhhingna hi nakisan kahseuva na honbit uva, mi jousen amutheina dinguva ni nununga hung kilang ding ahi.
English: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

tcz: Hijehchun kipah tahbeh un. Nanghon phat chomkhat a dinga patepna hahsa tampi nathoh dingu ahivangin, kipana kidangtah namasanguvah aume.
en: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,
text:
1PE 1:6
Thadou: Hijehchun kipah tahbeh un. Nanghon phat chomkhat a dinga patepna hahsa tampi nathoh dingu ahivangin, kipana kidangtah namasanguvah aume.
English: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

tcz: Hiche patepna ho hin natahsanu chu akicheh monge ti avetsah ding ahi. Meiyin apatep banga natahsan u chu patep'a uma ahin chule sana maimai sanga natahsan nau mantamjo ahivanga, sana kilhantheng banga natahsan u chu kipatep'ah ahi. Hijeh a chu natahsan u chun patepna tintang ato jouva hattah a aum den a ahileh, Yeshua Christa chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh teng chuleh nangho dinga vahchoina le loupina chule jabolna tamtah ahin lhutding ahitai.
en: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
text:
1PE 1:7
Thadou: Hiche patepna ho hin natahsanu chu akicheh monge ti avetsah ding ahi. Meiyin apatep banga natahsan u chu patep'a uma ahin chule sana maimai sanga natahsan nau mantamjo ahivanga, sana kilhantheng banga natahsan u chu kipatep'ah ahi. Hijeh a chu natahsan u chun patepna tintang ato jouva hattah a aum den a ahileh, Yeshua Christa chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh teng chuleh nangho dinga vahchoina le loupina chule jabolna tamtah ahin lhutding ahitai.
English: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

tcz: Ama namu khah louvang uvin nangailu uve. Tuhin Ama namu loulai vanguvin, Ama natahsan tauve; chule nangho kipana loupitah phondoh theihoi hilou chun nakipah tauve.
en: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
text:
1PE 1:8
Thadou: Ama namu khah louvang uvin nangailu uve. Tuhin Ama namu loulai vanguvin, Ama natahsan tauve; chule nangho kipana loupitah phondoh theihoi hilou chun nakipah tauve.
English: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

tcz: Ama natahsan jeh uva ahung sohdoh chu na lhagaovu huhhing channa ahung hitai.
en: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
text:
1PE 1:9
Thadou: Ama natahsan jeh uva ahung sohdoh chu na lhagaovu huhhing channa ahung hitai.
English: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

tcz: Hiche huhhingna thudol, lungset man'a huhhingna nangho dinga kigong chu ahi, themgao hon gaova anasei laiyuva ahetchet nom'u chu.
en: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
text:
1PE 1:10
Thadou: Hiche huhhingna thudol, lungset man'a huhhingna nangho dinga kigong chu ahi, themgao hon gaova anasei laiyuva ahetchet nom'u chu.
English: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

tcz: Amahon itih phat a ahilouleh itih a asunguva um Christa Lhagao chun Christa gimthohna le khonunga Aloupina kidangtah thudol chu akihou piuva, anaseipeh masah u ham ti chu adatmo uvin ahi.
en: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.
text:
1PE 1:11
Thadou: Amahon itih phat a ahilouleh itih a asunguva um Christa Lhagao chun Christa gimthohna le khonunga Aloupina kidangtah thudol chu akihou piuva, anaseipeh masah u ham ti chu adatmo uvin ahi.
English: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

tcz: Amaho chu athupohhou amahoa dinga hilouvin, nanghoa ding joh ahi ti seipeh anahiuve. Chule hiche Kipana Thuphahi nangho koma Vana kona Lhagao Theng thahatna'a seiphonga pang ho chun ahin phondoh u ahitai. Hiche hi akidanna kit chu vantil tenjong lung gutten a hicheho hi avetvet'u ahi.
en: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
text:
1PE 1:12
Thadou: Amaho chu athupohhou amahoa dinga hilouvin, nanghoa ding joh ahi ti seipeh anahiuve. Chule hiche Kipana Thuphahi nangho koma Vana kona Lhagao Theng thahatna'a seiphonga pang ho chun ahin phondoh u ahitai. Hiche hi akidanna kit chu vantil tenjong lung gutten a hicheho hi avetvet'u ahi.
English: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

tcz: Hijeh chun, phatechan gelun chule kitim themun. Yeshua chu vannoiya ahung kilah tengleh nachunguva lungsetna huhhingna hung lhung ding chu galdot un.
en: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
text:
1PE 1:13
Thadou: Hijeh chun, phatechan gelun chule kitim themun. Yeshua chu vannoiya ahung kilah tengleh nachunguva lungsetna huhhingna hung lhung ding chu galdot un.
English: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

tcz: Hiti chun, Pathen thua nungte bangin hinkho mangun. Nalung ngaichat u suhbulhitna dingin masang nahin khouva chun kinungtol kit hih un. Chupet a chu aphajo ding nahet loulaiyu ahi.
en: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
text:
1PE 1:14
Thadou: Hiti chun, Pathen thua nungte bangin hinkho mangun. Nalung ngaichat u suhbulhitna dingin masang nahin khouva chun kinungtol kit hih un. Chupet a chu aphajo ding nahet loulaiyu ahi.
English: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

tcz: Hinlah tun, Pathen nadei lhenpau athen tobanga chu nangho jong imalam jousea nathen dingu ahi.
en: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
text:
1PE 1:15
Thadou: Hinlah tun, Pathen nadei lhenpau athen tobanga chu nangho jong imalam jousea nathen dingu ahi.
English: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun, “Keima kathen jeh hin nangho jong thengun,” ati.
en: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
text:
1PE 1:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen Thubun, “Keima kathen jeh hin nangho jong thengun,” ati.
English: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

tcz: Chule geldoh uvin, natao nau Vana Pa chun koima lungset tum aneipoi. Aman natoh dung juiyuva nachung thu'u atan ding ahilouleh kipaman napeh dingu ahi. Hitia hi gamsunga kholjin nahi nauva hi Ama jana neiya nagin lhungkei dingu ahi.
en: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
text:
1PE 1:17
Thadou: Chule geldoh uvin, natao nau Vana Pa chun koima lungset tum aneipoi. Aman natoh dung juiyuva nachung thu'u atan ding ahilouleh kipaman napeh dingu ahi. Hitia hi gamsunga kholjin nahi nauva hi Ama jana neiya nagin lhungkei dingu ahi.
English: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

tcz: Ajeh chu nanghon nahe tauve, Pathen in napu napa teuva kona kiloson hinkho panna beiya kona hi lhatdohna man apeh ahitai. Chule hiche lhatna man apeh chu sana ahilouleh dangka thila ahipoi.
en: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
text:
1PE 1:18
Thadou: Ajeh chu nanghon nahe tauve, Pathen in napu napa teuva kona kiloson hinkho panna beiya kona hi lhatdohna man apeh ahitai. Chule hiche lhatna man apeh chu sana ahilouleh dangka thila ahipoi.
English: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

tcz: Chonset bei, nolnabei Pathen kelngoinou, Christa thisan manlutah a chu kilhat nahiuve.
en: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
text:
1PE 1:19
Thadou: Chonset bei, nolnabei Pathen kelngoinou, Christa thisan manlutah a chu kilhat nahiuve.
English: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

tcz: Pathen in ama chu vannoi kiphudoh masangpeh a nalhat diuva alhendoh chu, hiche ninununga hi Ama hung kiphongdoh a ahitai.
en: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
text:
1PE 1:20
Thadou: Pathen in ama chu vannoi kiphudoh masangpeh a nalhat diuva alhendoh chu, hiche ninununga hi Ama hung kiphongdoh a ahitai.
English: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

tcz: Christa jal'a Pathen nahin tahsanu ahitai. Chule nanghon Pathena natahsan u le nakinep nau chu nangap det'u ahitai, ajeh chu Aman Christa chu thinaa konin akaithouvin chule loupina lentah chu napetauve.
en: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.
text:
1PE 1:21
Thadou: Christa jal'a Pathen nahin tahsanu ahitai. Chule nanghon Pathena natahsan u le nakinep nau chu nangap det'u ahitai, ajeh chu Aman Christa chu thinaa konin akaithouvin chule loupina lentah chu napetauve.
English: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

tcz: Nangho thutah thua nanun phat uva nachonset nauva kona thenga nahi tauve, hijeh a chu tua hi nangho sopi hina a nangho ngailutna dihtah chu nakineito diu ahitai. Nalung gil pum piuvin khat le khat kingailu touvin.
en: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,
text:
1PE 1:22
Thadou: Nangho thutah thua nanun phat uva nachonset nauva kona thenga nahi tauve, hijeh a chu tua hi nangho sopi hina a nangho ngailutna dihtah chu nakineito diu ahitai. Nalung gil pum piuvin khat le khat kingailu touvin.
English: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho penthahna hi abeiloi ding tuhinkhoa ahipoi. Hinna thah naneiyu hi aitih a umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu hichu Pathen Thuhing jing tonsot'a um jinga kon ahi.
en: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
text:
1PE 1:23
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho penthahna hi abeiloi ding tuhinkhoa ahipoi. Hinna thah naneiyu hi aitih a umjing ding ahi, ajeh chu hichu Pathen Thuhing jing tonsot'a um jinga kon ahi.
English: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Mihemte hi hampa tobangbep ahi, ahoinau jong loujaova pahcha pah tobangbep ahi. Hampa agopjin chule apah chu amolloiji.
en: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

tcz: Hinlah Pakai Thu chu imatih chan'a umjing ding ahi.” Chule hiche thuhi Kipana Thupha nahenguva kiseiphong chu ahi.
en: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
text:
1PE 1:25
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai Thu chu imatih chan'a umjing ding ahi.” Chule hiche thuhi Kipana Thupha nahenguva kiseiphong chu ahi.
English: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

tcz: Hiti chun umchan phalou ho, mi lheplhahna jouse, phatlhem, mithang thipna, chule ngainom umlou thusei jouse pailhauvin.
en: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
text:
1PE 2:1
Thadou: Hiti chun umchan phalou ho, mi lheplhahna jouse, phatlhem, mithang thipna, chule ngainom umlou thusei jouse pailhauvin.
English: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

tcz: Naosen sohthah ho bangin, lhagao bongnoi thengsel chu ngaichauvin chutileh lhagao huhhingna a chu na kikhanlhit thei dingu ahi.
en: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,
text:
1PE 2:2
Thadou: Naosen sohthah ho bangin, lhagao bongnoi thengsel chu ngaichauvin chutileh lhagao huhhingna a chu na kikhanlhit thei dingu ahi.
English: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

tcz: Tun nanghon Pakai phatna chu natekhah u ahitai.
en: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
text:
1PE 2:3
Thadou: Tun nanghon Pakai phatna chu natekhah u ahitai.
English: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

tcz: Nangho Christa, Pathen Hou-in hingjing inning songpi, henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Ama chu miho pampai ahin, ahinlah Pathen in jana lentah chang dinga alhendoh joh ahitai.
en: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
text:
1PE 2:4
Thadou: Nangho Christa, Pathen Hou-in hingjing inning songpi, henga chu hunga nahi tauve. Ama chu miho pampai ahin, ahinlah Pathen in jana lentah chang dinga alhendoh joh ahitai.
English: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

tcz: Chule nangho, song hingho Pathen in lhagao hou-in a dinga asahdoh chu nahiuve. Akalval ipi um'em, nangho Ama dia thempu thengho nahi tauve. Yeshua Christa Palai hina a Pathen lunglhaina theiya lhagaova kilhaina-thilto chu bol'ah nahi tauve.
en: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
text:
1PE 2:5
Thadou: Chule nangho, song hingho Pathen in lhagao hou-in a dinga asahdoh chu nahiuve. Akalval ipi um'em, nangho Ama dia thempu thengho nahi tauve. Yeshua Christa Palai hina a Pathen lunglhaina theiya lhagaova kilhaina-thilto chu bol'ah nahi tauve.
English: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

tcz: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Keiman Jerusalema inning songpi kakoiyin, jabolna lentah dinga kilheng dohsa ahi, chule koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chu lungsetna changlouva umloubeh ding ahi,” ati.
en: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
text:
1PE 2:6
Thadou: Pathen Thubun asei dung juiyin, “Keiman Jerusalema inning songpi kakoiyin, jabolna lentah dinga kilheng dohsa ahi, chule koi hileh Ama tahsan chan chu lungsetna changlouva umloubeh ding ahi,” ati.
English: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

tcz: Tahbeh in, nangho Ama tahsan hon Pathen in apeh jabolna chu nahetpeh un. Hinlah Ama pampai ho din “insahon adeimouva apampaiyu song chu tun inning sonpin apangtai.”
en: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”
text:
1PE 2:7
Thadou: Tahbeh in, nangho Ama tahsan hon Pathen in apeh jabolna chu nahetpeh un. Hinlah Ama pampai ho din “insahon adeimouva apampaiyu song chu tun inning sonpin apangtai.”
English: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

tcz: Chule “Ama miho kipalsah chu ahin, chule amaho lhuhna songpi chu ahitai.” Amaho akipalnau ajeh chu amaho Pathen Thun anung pouve, chule amaho dinga kigong achandiu chu akimu tauve.
en: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.
text:
1PE 2:8
Thadou: Chule “Ama miho kipalsah chu ahin, chule amaho lhuhna songpi chu ahitai.” Amaho akipalnau ajeh chu amaho Pathen Thun anung pouve, chule amaho dinga kigong achandiu chu akimu tauve.
English: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

tcz: Ahin nangho hitobang chu nahi lou u ahi, ajeh chu nangho lhen tum mite nahiuve. Nangho leng-thempu ho, namtheng, Pathen nei chu nahi tauve. Hijeh a chu, nanghon midang ho Pathen phatna chu navetsah theiju ahitai, ajeh chu Aman muthim lah a kona avah loupi kidangtah a chu napuilut u ahitai.
en: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
text:
1PE 2:9
Thadou: Ahin nangho hitobang chu nahi lou u ahi, ajeh chu nangho lhen tum mite nahiuve. Nangho leng-thempu ho, namtheng, Pathen nei chu nahi tauve. Hijeh a chu, nanghon midang ho Pathen phatna chu navetsah theiju ahitai, ajeh chu Aman muthim lah a kona avah loupi kidangtah a chu napuilut u ahitai.
English: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

tcz: “Masanga chu amite hina photchenna neilou nahiu ahin, tua hi nangho Pathen mite nahiu ahitai. Masanga chu khotona anachanglou nahiu ahin, tua hi Pathen khotona chu changa nahi tauve.”
en: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
text:
1PE 2:10
Thadou: “Masanga chu amite hina photchenna neilou nahiu ahin, tua hi nangho Pathen mite nahiu ahitai. Masanga chu khotona anachanglou nahiu ahin, tua hi Pathen khotona chu changa nahi tauve.”
English: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

tcz: Deitahte, “chomkhat a dinga khosa chule gamchom mi” nahiu toh kilhon'a kagihsal nahiuve, nangho nalhagaovu douva pang vannoi lung ngaichat hoa konin kikang seuvin.
en: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,
text:
1PE 2:11
Thadou: Deitahte, “chomkhat a dinga khosa chule gamchom mi” nahiu toh kilhon'a kagihsal nahiuve, nangho nalhagaovu douva pang vannoi lung ngaichat hoa konin kikang seuvin.
English: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

tcz: Naheng nakom atahsanlou to cheng khom nahiu chu heuvin lang, chingtheiyun. Chujouleh amahon thildihlou bol a themmo nachan ujongleh ja theiya naum nau chu mudoh uvintin, chule Aman vannoi thu atan teng Pathen chu jana apeh dingu ahi.
en: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.
text:
1PE 2:12
Thadou: Naheng nakom atahsanlou to cheng khom nahiu chu heuvin lang, chingtheiyun. Chujouleh amahon thildihlou bol a themmo nachan ujongleh ja theiya naum nau chu mudoh uvintin, chule Aman vannoi thu atan teng Pathen chu jana apeh dingu ahi.
English: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

tcz: Pakai jal'in, mihem thuneina jouse jabol un, Lengpa chu gamneipa ahinaa jading ahi,
en: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,
text:
1PE 2:13
Thadou: Pakai jal'in, mihem thuneina jouse jabol un, Lengpa chu gamneipa ahinaa jading ahi,
English: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

tcz: ahilouleh thunei aman alhendoh hijongleh jana pen. Ajeh chu lengpa chun thildihlou bolho gimbol dinga chule thilpha bolho jabolna pedinga amaho chu ngansena apeh ahi.
en: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.
text:
1PE 2:14
Thadou: ahilouleh thunei aman alhendoh hijongleh jana pen. Ajeh chu lengpa chun thildihlou bolho gimbol dinga chule thilpha bolho jabolna pedinga amaho chu ngansena apeh ahi.
English: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

tcz: Ja umtah'a hinkho naman diu chu Pathen lunglam ahi, hichun alamlouva ngolhoitah a themmo nahin chanhou chu asuhthip ding ahi.
en: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.
text:
1PE 2:15
Thadou: Ja umtah'a hinkho naman diu chu Pathen lunglam ahi, hichun alamlouva ngolhoitah a themmo nahin chanhou chu asuhthip ding ahi.
English: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangho chamlhat nahiu ahi, hinlah nangho Pathen sohte nahiuve, hiti ahijeh chun nachamlhatnau chu thilse bolnan neihih un.
en: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.
text:
1PE 2:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangho chamlhat nahiu ahi, hinlah nangho Pathen sohte nahiuve, hiti ahijeh chun nachamlhatnau chu thilse bolnan neihih un.
English: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

tcz: Amitakip jabolun, chule Christian nasopi chu ngailun. Pathen gingin, chule lengpa chu jabol in.
en: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.
text:
1PE 2:17
Thadou: Amitakip jabolun, chule Christian nasopi chu ngailun. Pathen gingin, chule lengpa chu jabol in.
English: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

tcz: Chule nangho sohho naputeu thuneina chu jana neitoh thon sanguvin. Amahon bol'un tia nahilu chu bolun-amaho chu mihepithem le lunggel toh them ahiseh-u hilouvin, mi engse ahiu jongleh bolun.
en: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
text:
1PE 2:18
Thadou: Chule nangho sohho naputeu thuneina chu jana neitoh thon sanguvin. Amahon bol'un tia nahilu chu bolun-amaho chu mihepithem le lunggel toh them ahiseh-u hilouvin, mi engse ahiu jongleh bolun.
English: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen lunglhaina chu nanghon adih ahi ti nahet'u chu naboluva chule alamlouva nakibol nauva jong thohhattah a napan dingu ahi.
en: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
text:
1PE 2:19
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen lunglhaina chu nanghon adih ahi ti nahet'u chu naboluva chule alamlouva nakibol nauva jong thohhattah a napan dingu ahi.
English: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

tcz: Ahinai, thilse boljeh a nathoh hatnau chun ima chanding nanei pouve. Hinlah thilphabol jeh a gimbolna nathoh uva thohhattah a napanuva ahileh, Pathen nachunguva lunglhaiyah ahi.
en: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.
text:
1PE 2:20
Thadou: Ahinai, thilse boljeh a nathoh hatnau chun ima chanding nanei pouve. Hinlah thilphabol jeh a gimbolna nathoh uva thohhattah a napanuva ahileh, Pathen nachunguva lunglhaiyah ahi.
English: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christan nangho dinga gimbol hesoh athoh banga chu gimthohna ding hijongleh thilpha boldinga nakouvu ahi. Ama navettoh uva najui dingu chule akhonung najui dingu ahiye.
en: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,
text:
1PE 2:21
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen in Christan nangho dinga gimbol hesoh athoh banga chu gimthohna ding hijongleh thilpha boldinga nakouvu ahi. Ama navettoh uva najui dingu chule akhonung najui dingu ahiye.
English: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

tcz: Ama achonse khapoi, koima cha jong alhemlha khapoi.
en: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
text:
1PE 2:22
Thadou: Ama achonse khapoi, koima cha jong alhemlha khapoi.
English: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

tcz: Ama ajumsou jong chun alethuhpoi, agimhesoh thoh pet in jong akithuhpoi. Aman achungchang thu adihtah a thutan jing Pathen khut a angam lhan ahi.
en: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.
text:
1PE 2:23
Thadou: Ama ajumsou jong chun alethuhpoi, agimhesoh thoh pet in jong akithuhpoi. Aman achungchang thu adihtah a thutan jing Pathen khut a angam lhan ahi.
English: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

tcz: Amatah in atahsa chunga ichonsetna hou thingpel chunga chun apoi, hichu eiho chonsetna lama ithiuva chule chonphatna lama ihin theina dingu ahi. Ama kijepna mahahoa chu nanghon damna namu u ahi.
en: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.
text:
1PE 2:24
Thadou: Amatah in atahsa chunga ichonsetna hou thingpel chunga chun apoi, hichu eiho chonsetna lama ithiuva chule chonphatna lama ihin theina dingu ahi. Ama kijepna mahahoa chu nanghon damna namu u ahi.
English: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

tcz: Nangho masanga chu avah manga nana hiu ahin, hinlah tun na Chingpau, na lhagaovu Kaihoipa henga chu hung kilekit'ah nahi tauve.
en: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.
text:
1PE 2:25
Thadou: Nangho masanga chu avah manga nana hiu ahin, hinlah tun na Chingpau, na lhagaovu Kaihoipa henga chu hung kilekit'ah nahi tauve.
English: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

tcz: Chutima chun, nangho ji numei hon napasalteu thuneina chu kisan uvin. Chutengleh, amaho lah a Kipana Thupha joplou aum tah jongleh, thuchenga seilouva na Pathen ngaisahnau navetsah uchun thu aseijoh ding ahi. Amaho nathujona ding uchu,
en: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,
text:
1PE 3:1
Thadou: Chutima chun, nangho ji numei hon napasalteu thuneina chu kisan uvin. Chutengleh, amaho lah a Kipana Thupha joplou aum tah jongleh, thuchenga seilouva na Pathen ngaisahnau navetsah uchun thu aseijoh ding ahi. Amaho nathujona ding uchu,
English: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

tcz: Nanghon thenna le jana hinkho naman'u amuuva kon hiding ahi.
en: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
text:
1PE 3:2
Thadou: Nanghon thenna le jana hinkho naman'u amuuva kon hiding ahi.
English: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

tcz: Polam hoina khohsahnan sampheh a kijep hoi, thil mantam sana khi-o ahilouleh ponsil hoi hoa kijem ding gelkhoh hih un.
en: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,
text:
1PE 3:3
Thadou: Polam hoina khohsahnan sampheh a kijep hoi, thil mantam sana khi-o ahilouleh ponsil hoi hoa kijem ding gelkhoh hih un.
English: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

tcz: Nangho sunggila kona hoina, chultheilou lungneng le thip khen cha um, hichea chu nakijep joh dingu ahi, hichu Pathena dinga manlutah ahi.
en: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.
text:
1PE 3:4
Thadou: Nangho sunggila kona hoina, chultheilou lungneng le thip khen cha um, hichea chu nakijep joh dingu ahi, hichu Pathena dinga manlutah ahi.
English: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

tcz: Hiche hi malai numei theng masa ho amaho tah akijep hoinau chu anahi. Amahon Pathen atahsanun chule ajipateu thuneina chu anakisan u ahi.
en: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
text:
1PE 3:5
Thadou: Hiche hi malai numei theng masa ho amaho tah akijep hoinau chu anahi. Amahon Pathen atahsanun chule ajipateu thuneina chu anakisan u ahi.
English: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

tcz: Avetsahnan, Sarah chu ajipa Abraham, thun anungin, chule ajipa chu ka-pakai tin akouve. Najipa teuvin ipi ahinbol dingu kichatna neilou hel'a nanghon thilpha chu naboluva ahileh ama chanute nahiu ahi.
en: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.
text:
1PE 3:6
Thadou: Avetsahnan, Sarah chu ajipa Abraham, thun anungin, chule ajipa chu ka-pakai tin akouve. Najipa teuvin ipi ahinbol dingu kichatna neilou hel'a nanghon thilpha chu naboluva ahileh ama chanute nahiu ahi.
English: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, pasal nanghon najinu teu jabolun. Nijinu teu chuto umkhom'a nahiu toh kilhon in hetkhen themna neijin bolun. Ama nangho sanga thalhomjo hitheinante, hinlah Pathen in hinkho thah a hinkho naman khompi dinga napeh-u chu ahi. Nataonau adal louna dingin amaho chu nabolna dingdola chun bolin.
en: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.
text:
1PE 3:7
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, pasal nanghon najinu teu jabolun. Nijinu teu chuto umkhom'a nahiu toh kilhon in hetkhen themna neijin bolun. Ama nangho sanga thalhomjo hitheinante, hinlah Pathen in hinkho thah a hinkho naman khompi dinga napeh-u chu ahi. Nataonau adal louna dingin amaho chu nabolna dingdola chun bolin.
English: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

tcz: Achainakeiyin, nangho jouse lungkhat kisauvin. Khatle khat kigelkhohto uvin. Sopi hina in kingailu touvin. Lungneng unlang chule kineosah cheh un.
en: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,
text:
1PE 3:8
Thadou: Achainakeiyin, nangho jouse lungkhat kisauvin. Khatle khat kigelkhohto uvin. Sopi hina in kingailu touvin. Lungneng unlang chule kineosah cheh un.
English: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

tcz: Setna chu asen lethuh hih un. Mihon najumso tenguleh jumso kitna ding lunggel hih un. Hisang chun phattheiboh jouvin. Hichu Pathen in nabol dinga nakouna chu ahi, chule Aman hiche jal a chu phatthei naboh ding ahi.
en: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.
text:
1PE 3:9
Thadou: Setna chu asen lethuh hih un. Mihon najumso tenguleh jumso kitna ding lunggel hih un. Hisang chun phattheiboh jouvin. Hichu Pathen in nabol dinga nakouna chu ahi, chule Aman hiche jal a chu phatthei naboh ding ahi.
English: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

tcz: Ajehchu, Pathen Thubun asei chu, “Nangman hinkho chu nakipapia, nikho kipa um tampi namu noma ahileh, naleigui chu thilse seinaa konin kihuh tup in, thilpha bolin chule namuh chu jou seina a konin kikangsen.
en: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
text:
1PE 3:10
Thadou: Ajehchu, Pathen Thubun asei chu, “Nangman hinkho chu nakipapia, nikho kipa um tampi namu noma ahileh, naleigui chu thilse seinaa konin kihuh tup in, thilpha bolin chule namuh chu jou seina a konin kikangsen.
English: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

tcz: Thil phalouva konin kiheimangin, chule thilpha chu bol in.
en: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.
text:
1PE 3:11
Thadou: Thil phalouva konin kiheimangin, chule thilpha chu bol in.
English: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

tcz: Thildih bolho chu Pakaiyin ntin a avetsui ahi, chule ataonau ngaina in anakol asung jinge. Hinlah Pakai chun thilse bol ho dounaa amai angat jing ahi.”
en: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
text:
1PE 3:12
Thadou: Thildih bolho chu Pakaiyin ntin a avetsui ahi, chule ataonau ngaina in anakol asung jinge. Hinlah Pakai chun thilse bol ho dounaa amai angat jing ahi.”
English: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

tcz: Tun, nanghon thilpha nabol nomuva ahileh koiham nasugim dinguva?
en: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
text:
1PE 3:13
Thadou: Tun, nanghon thilpha nabol nomuva ahileh koiham nasugim dinguva?
English: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

tcz: Thildih boljeh a hahsatna nato tah uva ahijongleh, Pathen in hichea chu nale thuhding ahi. Hijehchun, amaho gihsal jeh chun lung himo ahilouleh kichat bol hih un.
en: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
text:
1PE 3:14
Thadou: Thildih boljeh a hahsatna nato tah uva ahijongleh, Pathen in hichea chu nale thuhding ahi. Hijehchun, amaho gihsal jeh chun lung himo ahilouleh kichat bol hih un.
English: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

tcz: Chusanga nangman Christa chu nahinkhoa Pakaiya nanei ding hiya ahi. Chule koiham khat'in na-Christian hina anakinepna thudol chu nadoh a ahileh hilchenin.
en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,
text:
1PE 3:15
Thadou: Chusanga nangman Christa chu nahinkhoa Pakaiya nanei ding hiya ahi. Chule koiham khat'in na-Christian hina anakinepna thudol chu nadoh a ahileh hilchenin.
English: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

tcz: Hinlah hiche hi lungneng le jatheiyin bolin. Selepha nahetna chu thengin koiyin. Chua chu mihon nangho douna a thu aseiyuva ahileh amahon Christa a nahijeh uva hinkho phatah naman chu amu tenguleh jahcha dingu ahi.
en: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
text:
1PE 3:16
Thadou: Hinlah hiche hi lungneng le jatheiyin bolin. Selepha nahetna chu thengin koiyin. Chua chu mihon nangho douna a thu aseiyuva ahileh amahon Christa a nahijeh uva hinkho phatah naman chu amu tenguleh jahcha dingu ahi.
English: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

tcz: Geldoh in, thilphalou boljeh a gimthoh sanga chu, thilpha bol jeh a gimthoh chu Pathen deilam ahijoi.
en: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.
text:
1PE 3:17
Thadou: Geldoh in, thilphalou boljeh a gimthoh sanga chu, thilpha bol jeh a gimthoh chu Pathen deilam ahijoi.
English: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

tcz: Christa chun a-itih a dinga khatvei athohgim ahi. Ama achonse khapoi, hinlah ama Pathen kom a chu bit keicha lhun theina dinga chonseho jeh a thia ahi. Aman tahsa tah a thina ato ahin, hinlah Ama Lhagaova kaithouva uma hingdoh kit ahi.
en: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,
text:
1PE 3:18
Thadou: Christa chun a-itih a dinga khatvei athohgim ahi. Ama achonse khapoi, hinlah ama Pathen kom a chu bit keicha lhun theina dinga chonseho jeh a thia ahi. Aman tahsa tah a thina ato ahin, hinlah Ama Lhagaova kaithouva uma hingdoh kit ahi.
English: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

tcz: Hiti chun, Ama gachea lhagao songkul'a kihenho koma aga seiphong ahitai.
en: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
text:
1PE 3:19
Thadou: Hiti chun, Ama gachea lhagao songkul'a kihenho koma aga seiphong ahitai.
English: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

tcz: Amaho hi masanglai peh a Noah chun kong anasui laiya Pathen in thoh hattah'a anga laiya Pathen thua nung louva ahiuve. Hiche tijat umtah twisanglet'a lhah lhumna dinga kona chu mi get bou sohchaa ahiuve.
en: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
text:
1PE 3:20
Thadou: Amaho hi masanglai peh a Noah chun kong anasui laiya Pathen in thoh hattah'a anga laiya Pathen thua nung louva ahiuve. Hiche tijat umtah twisanglet'a lhah lhumna dinga kona chu mi get bou sohchaa ahiuve.
English: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

tcz: Chule hiche twi chu baptize chan vetsahna ahi, hichun tua hi nahuhhingu ahi, tipuma anen pailhahna hilouva, Pathen lama selepha hetna kichehna ding ahi. Yeshua Christa thodoh kit jal a hichun na atoh ahiye.
en: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
text:
1PE 3:21
Thadou: Chule hiche twi chu baptize chan vetsahna ahi, hichun tua hi nahuhhingu ahi, tipuma anen pailhahna hilouva, Pathen lama selepha hetna kichehna ding ahi. Yeshua Christa thodoh kit jal a hichun na atoh ahiye.
English: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

tcz: Tun Christa chu van'a gachea ahitan, Ama Pathen bantah a jabol channa muna touva ahitai, chule Vantilte le athuneiho chule thaneiho jousen Ama thuneina asangun ahi.
en: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
text:
1PE 3:22
Thadou: Tun Christa chu van'a gachea ahitan, Ama Pathen bantah a jabol channa muna touva ahitai, chule Vantilte le athuneiho chule thaneiho jousen Ama thuneina asangun ahi.
English: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

tcz: Hiti chu ahin, Christa chun tahsaa athoh gim tah jeh in, Ama a um lungput chu nanghon jong naneiyu angaiye, chule gimthoh dingin kigosan umun. Ajeh chu nanghon Christa jal a tahsa lama gim hesoh nathoh uva ahileh chonset chu najou tauve.
en: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,
text:
1PE 4:1
Thadou: Hiti chu ahin, Christa chun tahsaa athoh gim tah jeh in, Ama a um lungput chu nanghon jong naneiyu angaiye, chule gimthoh dingin kigosan umun. Ajeh chu nanghon Christa jal a tahsa lama gim hesoh nathoh uva ahileh chonset chu najou tauve.
English: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

tcz: Nanghon nahinkhou aum chengse chu nangma ho lung ngaichatlam chu holtalouva, Pathen lunglam joh chu bol nomna nanei dingu ahitai.
en: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
text:
1PE 4:2
Thadou: Nanghon nahinkhou aum chengse chu nangma ho lung ngaichatlam chu holtalouva, Pathen lunglam joh chu bol nomna nanei dingu ahitai.
English: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

tcz: Nang hon chidang namdang nahilai uva chu Pathen ngaisahlouna lunggotlam nathanopnau, chonhoilou le tahsa lung ngaichat, kinopvahna le jukhamna chule motchon tothoa lamna, chule milim houna'a tijat jat um nanabol u chu aphaset ahitai.
en: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.
text:
1PE 4:3
Thadou: Nang hon chidang namdang nahilai uva chu Pathen ngaisahlouna lunggotlam nathanopnau, chonhoilou le tahsa lung ngaichat, kinopvahna le jukhamna chule motchon tothoa lamna, chule milim houna'a tijat jat um nanabol u chu aphaset ahitai.
English: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

tcz: Amahon setna chu twisoh banga motchon le man thahna thei thil ho aboluva chu nathanoppi tahloujeh uva chu nana kivoppi hou chun adat mouva hitia chu naseiset u ahibouve.
en: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.
text:
1PE 4:4
Thadou: Amahon setna chu twisoh banga motchon le man thahna thei thil ho aboluva chu nathanoppi tahloujeh uva chu nana kivoppi hou chun adat mouva hitia chu naseiset u ahibouve.
English: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

tcz: Hinlah geldoh un, amahon amitakip ahing le athiho chung thutan ding Pathen chu akimutopi diu ahi.
en: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
text:
1PE 4:5
Thadou: Hinlah geldoh un, amahon amitakip ahing le athiho chung thutan ding Pathen chu akimutopi diu ahi.
English: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

tcz: Hijeh a chu Kipana Thupha thu chu tua athiho henga kiseiphonga ahitai-hichu amaho midang jouse banga athi diu gonchaisa ahiuvin, tua hi amaho Pathen toa-i-tih a dinga lhagaova hing jing dinga gonsa ahitauve.
en: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.
text:
1PE 4:6
Thadou: Hijeh a chu Kipana Thupha thu chu tua athiho henga kiseiphonga ahitai-hichu amaho midang jouse banga athi diu gonchaisa ahiuvin, tua hi amaho Pathen toa-i-tih a dinga lhagaova hing jing dinga gonsa ahitauve.
English: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

tcz: Vannoi kichaina ding phat hung lhung pai ding ahitai. Hiti ahijeh chun lungdih tah pun chule tao jingna dingin limgeh chan umun.
en: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
text:
1PE 4:7
Thadou: Vannoi kichaina ding phat hung lhung pai ding ahitai. Hiti ahijeh chun lungdih tah pun chule tao jingna dingin limgeh chan umun.
English: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

tcz: Athupi penin, khat le khat kingailutna nangho khat in khat chunga neiyuvin, ajeh chu ngailut hin chonset tamtah akhun ahi.
en: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
text:
1PE 4:8
Thadou: Athupi penin, khat le khat kingailutna nangho khat in khat chunga neiyuvin, ajeh chu ngailut hin chonset tamtah akhun ahi.
English: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

tcz: Nehding ngaicha ahilouleh umna ding hol a chu kipahtah in na-in'a lhunsah un.
en: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
text:
1PE 4:9
Thadou: Nehding ngaicha ahilouleh umna ding hol a chu kipahtah in na-in'a lhunsah un.
English: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

tcz: Pathen in nangho khat chang cheh hi lhagao thilpeh ho napeh cheh u ahi. Hichu khat le khat kijen nan mangun.
en: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
text:
1PE 4:10
Thadou: Pathen in nangho khat chang cheh hi lhagao thilpeh ho napeh cheh u ahi. Hichu khat le khat kijen nan mangun.
English: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

tcz: Thusei theina lhagao thilpeh nakipe em? Chuti ahileh Pathen in nang koma thu asei bangtah in seijin. Midang kithopina thilpeh nachan em? Pathen in thahat le thaneina napeh chu panin bol'in. Chutileh nabol jouse chu Yeshua Christa jal in Pathen loupina hung hitheiyinte. Aimatih chanin loupina le thaneina jouse chu Ama a hi jing hen! Amen.
en: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.
text:
1PE 4:11
Thadou: Thusei theina lhagao thilpeh nakipe em? Chuti ahileh Pathen in nang koma thu asei bangtah in seijin. Midang kithopina thilpeh nachan em? Pathen in thahat le thaneina napeh chu panin bol'in. Chutileh nabol jouse chu Yeshua Christa jal in Pathen loupina hung hitheiyinte. Aimatih chanin loupina le thaneina jouse chu Ama a hi jing hen! Amen.
English: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Deitah teho, nanghon patepna meikou banga hahsa nathoh u chu, thil nahet khahlou hel'u nato'u tobang'in datmo hih un.
en: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.
text:
1PE 4:12
Thadou: Deitah teho, nanghon patepna meikou banga hahsa nathoh u chu, thil nahet khahlou hel'u nato'u tobang'in datmo hih un.
English: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

tcz: Chusangin hapan kipah jouvin–ijeh inem itileh nanghon Christan athoh gimna a chu chan neikhoma nahiuve, hitia chu Aloupina kipana kidangtah chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh tengleh nanghon namuva nanei dingu ahi.
en: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.
text:
1PE 4:13
Thadou: Chusangin hapan kipah jouvin–ijeh inem itileh nanghon Christan athoh gimna a chu chan neikhoma nahiuve, hitia chu Aloupina kipana kidangtah chu vannoi pumpia akiphondoh tengleh nanghon namuva nanei dingu ahi.
English: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

tcz: Hiti ahijeh chun Christian nahi jeh uva najachatsah tengu jongleh kipah un, ajeh chu loupina Pathen lhagao chu nachunguva uma ahi.
en: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.
text:
1PE 4:14
Thadou: Hiti ahijeh chun Christian nahi jeh uva najachatsah tengu jongleh kipah un, ajeh chu loupina Pathen lhagao chu nachunguva uma ahi.
English: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

tcz: Hinama jongleh nathoh gimnau chu tolthat hijeh, guhchat jeh, setboljeh, ahilouva ahileh midang chunga kikum jeh hida hen.
en: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
text:
1PE 4:15
Thadou: Hinama jongleh nathoh gimnau chu tolthat hijeh, guhchat jeh, setboljeh, ahilouva ahileh midang chunga kikum jeh hida hen.
English: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.
