tcz: Ahin Christian hijeh a thohgim chu jachatna ding ahipoi. Amina kikou nahi jal in Pathen chu vahchoiyin!
en: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.
text:
1PE 4:16
Thadou: Ahin Christian hijeh a thohgim chu jachatna ding ahipoi. Amina kikou nahi jal in Pathen chu vahchoiyin!
English: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

tcz: Ajeh chu thutanna phat hung lhunga ahitai, chule Pathen insung pumpia kipan ding ahi. Chule thutanna chu eihoa akipat a ahileh, Pathen Kipana Thupha joplou ho chan ding chu iti tijat um hiding hitam?
en: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?
text:
1PE 4:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu thutanna phat hung lhunga ahitai, chule Pathen insung pumpia kipan ding ahi. Chule thutanna chu eihoa akipat a ahileh, Pathen Kipana Thupha joplou ho chan ding chu iti tijat um hiding hitam?
English: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

tcz: Chukit jongleh, “Mi dih chu huhhing ahahsatleh, Pathen ngaisahlou chonseho ititauvin tem?”
en: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”
text:
1PE 4:18
Thadou: Chukit jongleh, “Mi dih chu huhhing ahahsatleh, Pathen ngaisahlou chonseho ititauvin tem?”
English: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

tcz: Hitia chu Pathen lunglhaina a gim nathoh uva ahileh, adih chu boljom jingun, chule nahinkhou chu nasempau Pathena ngamlhauvin, ajeh chu Aman itinama jongleh nalha kanglou dingu ahi.
en: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.
text:
1PE 4:19
Thadou: Hitia chu Pathen lunglhaina a gim nathoh uva ahileh, adih chu boljom jingun, chule nahinkhou chu nasempau Pathena ngamlhauvin, ajeh chu Aman itinama jongleh nalha kanglou dingu ahi.
English: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

tcz: Chule tun, houbung hoa Upa ho henga, keima jong Upa khat hina a Christa gimthohna a chan kachan khompi hina a kathumop nom nahiuve. Chule, keima jong, Ama loupina a chu vannoiya ahung kilah teng chuleh aloupina chu chang khom ding kahi. Upat nachan khompiu keiman nahenguva kahin ngeh nahiuve:
en: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:
text:
1PE 5:1
Thadou: Chule tun, houbung hoa Upa ho henga, keima jong Upa khat hina a Christa gimthohna a chan kachan khompi hina a kathumop nom nahiuve. Chule, keima jong, Ama loupina a chu vannoiya ahung kilah teng chuleh aloupina chu chang khom ding kahi. Upat nachan khompiu keiman nahenguva kahin ngeh nahiuve:
English: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

tcz: Pathen in chin dinga nanganseu kelngoi hon chengse chu chingun. Lungcham tah in, lunghimo louhelin bolun-nanghon ipi phatchomna kakimudoh theidem ti hilouvin, Pathen na natoh nom joh jeh uvin bol jouvin.
en: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

tcz: Na kinganse hou chunga kipiputsahna bol louvin, na umchanhoi chu vetsah in puihoi jouvin.
en: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
text:
1PE 5:3
Thadou: Na kinganse hou chunga kipiputsahna bol louvin, na umchanhoi chu vetsah in puihoi jouvin.
English: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

tcz: Chule Kelngoi ching pipu ahung kilah teng chuleh, nanghon aitih a abeitih umlou loupina le jabolna Lallukhuh chu nachan dingu ahi.
en: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
text:
1PE 5:4
Thadou: Chule Kelngoi ching pipu ahung kilah teng chuleh, nanghon aitih a abeitih umlou loupina le jabolna Lallukhuh chu nachan dingu ahi.
English: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

tcz: Hitobangma chun, nangho khangdong hon jong Upa vaihom ho thuneina chu noppeh un. Chule nangho nabonchauvin, khat in khat kineosah pumin jenun, ajeh chu “Pathen in akiletsah chu adouvin, akineosah mi vang chu alung lhaina ahi.”
en: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
text:
1PE 5:5
Thadou: Hitobangma chun, nangho khangdong hon jong Upa vaihom ho thuneina chu noppeh un. Chule nangho nabonchauvin, khat in khat kineosah pumin jenun, ajeh chu “Pathen in akiletsah chu adouvin, akineosah mi vang chu alung lhaina ahi.”
English: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

tcz: Hiti chun nangho Pathen thahattah thaneina noiya umun chule aman aphatcha jabolna tohthoa nachoisang dingu ahi.
en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,
text:
1PE 5:6
Thadou: Hiti chun nangho Pathen thahattah thaneina noiya umun chule aman aphatcha jabolna tohthoa nachoisang dingu ahi.
English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

tcz: Nalung khamnahou le nagelkhoh hou chu Pathena peuvin, ijeh inem itileh aman nachung chang thu nagelkhoh pehnai.
en: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
text:
1PE 5:7
Thadou: Nalung khamnahou le nagelkhoh hou chu Pathena peuvin, ijeh inem itileh aman nachung chang thu nagelkhoh pehnai.
English: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

tcz: Kichih theiyuvin! Namelmau pipu, Diabol jeh chun kihong phauvin. Ama keipi bahkai kitum tobang'in vallhum ding mi ahol in ahi.
en: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
text:
1PE 5:8
Thadou: Kichih theiyuvin! Namelmau pipu, Diabol jeh chun kihong phauvin. Ama keipi bahkai kitum tobang'in vallhum ding mi ahol in ahi.
English: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

tcz: Ama dounaa dingdet un, chule natahsan nauva chun hat'un. Vannoi pumpia nasopiu Christian ho chu nangho banga thohgimna atocheh u ahi.
en: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.
text:
1PE 5:9
Thadou: Ama dounaa dingdet un, chule natahsan nauva chun hat'un. Vannoi pumpia nasopiu Christian ho chu nangho banga thohgimna atocheh u ahi.
English: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

tcz: Pathen in amikhoto themna Christa Yeshua jal a tonsot aloupina chu chang dinga nakouvu ahitai.
en: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
text:
1PE 5:10
Thadou: Pathen in amikhoto themna Christa Yeshua jal a tonsot aloupina chu chang dinga nakouvu ahitai.
English: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

tcz: Amaa thaneina chu tonsot tonsotin hijing hen! Amen.
en: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
text:
1PE 5:11
Thadou: Amaa thaneina chu tonsot tonsotin hijing hen! Amen.
English: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

tcz: Tahsan umtah sopi Silas, nangho koma seiphatna kapeh, ama kithopina jal a hiche lekhathot chomcha hi nahenguva dinga kahin jih ahi. Nakomuva dinga kahin jihlona ajeh chu nanghon tua hi Pathen lungset nachan tahbeh u ahi tia tilkhouna le photchetsahnaa ding ahi. Hiche lungsetna a hin ding det un.
en: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.
text:
1PE 5:12
Thadou: Tahsan umtah sopi Silas, nangho koma seiphatna kapeh, ama kithopina jal a hiche lekhathot chomcha hi nahenguva dinga kahin jih ahi. Nakomuva dinga kahin jihlona ajeh chu nanghon tua hi Pathen lungset nachan tahbeh u ahi tia tilkhouna le photchetsahnaa ding ahi. Hiche lungsetna a hin ding det un.
English: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

tcz: Hikom Rome muna na-houbung chanpiu le kachapa Mark in jong chibai nahin peuve.
en: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.
text:
1PE 5:13
Thadou: Hikom Rome muna na-houbung chanpiu le kachapa Mark in jong chibai nahin peuve.
English: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

tcz: Christian kingailutna chun khat in khat chibai kibohtouvin. Christa Yeshua a umho jouse cham-lungmonna in na umpiu hen.
en: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
text:
1PE 5:14
Thadou: Christian kingailutna chun khat in khat chibai kibohtouvin. Christa Yeshua a umho jouse cham-lungmonna in na umpiu hen.
English: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa soh le solchah, Simon Peter a kon ahi. Keiman tahsan manlu tah kanei khompi ho henga kahin jih ahi. Hiche tahsan hi thutandih le pha nahin peuva eihuhhing uva le IPathenu Yeshua Christa jal jeh ahi.
en: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
text:
2PE 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Yeshua Christa soh le solchah, Simon Peter a kon ahi. Keiman tahsan manlu tah kanei khompi ho henga kahin jih ahi. Hiche tahsan hi thutandih le pha nahin peuva eihuhhing uva le IPathenu Yeshua Christa jal jeh ahi.
English: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

tcz: Nanghon Pathen le IPakaiyu Yeshua nahet nau lama nakhantouna dingun Pathen in nangho lungset le cham-lungmon napeh be jingu hen.
en: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
text:
2PE 1:2
Thadou: Nanghon Pathen le IPakaiyu Yeshua nahet nau lama nakhantouna dingun Pathen in nangho lungset le cham-lungmon napeh be jingu hen.
English: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

tcz: Aman Pathena kona thahatna anei jal'in, Pathen ngaisahna hinkho iman theina dinguvin Aman ingaichat jouseu eipetauve. Ama dinga eikoupau hin Ama hetna ineiyuva kona Aloupina kidangtah le ahoipen hina jal'a eihon hicheho jouse hi ikisanu ahi.
en: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
text:
2PE 1:3
Thadou: Aman Pathena kona thahatna anei jal'in, Pathen ngaisahna hinkho iman theina dinguvin Aman ingaichat jouseu eipetauve. Ama dinga eikoupau hin Ama hetna ineiyuva kona Aloupina kidangtah le ahoipen hina jal'a eihon hicheho jouse hi ikisanu ahi.
English: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

tcz: Chule aloupina le ahoipen hina jal'in Aman thutep lentah le manlutah eipetauve. Hiche athutep ho hi Pathen ahina a chan neikhompina le mihem lung ngaichat vannoi kisuhbohna a kona onthol theina ahi.
en: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
text:
2PE 1:4
Thadou: Chule aloupina le ahoipen hina jal'in Aman thutep lentah le manlutah eipetauve. Hiche athutep ho hi Pathen ahina a chan neikhompina le mihem lung ngaichat vannoi kisuhbohna a kona onthol theina ahi.
English: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

tcz: Hicheho jouse jal hin, Pathen thutep ho channa dingin kihabol un, natahsan nau chu umchanhoi pendoh nan neiyun, chule umchanhoi penna chun hetna,
en: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

tcz: chule hetna chun chang kitim themna, chule chang kitim themna chun thohhatna chule thohhatna chun Pathen ngaisahna,
en: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

tcz: chule Pathen ngaisahna chun sopi hina a kigelkhoh tona a amichang cheh ngailutna sodoh hen.
en: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
text:
2PE 1:7
Thadou: chule Pathen ngaisahna chun sopi hina a kigelkhoh tona a amichang cheh ngailutna sodoh hen.
English: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

tcz: Hitia nakhan toube cheh nauva chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa hetna a chu gasoa chule phatchomna nanei dingu ahi.
en: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text:
2PE 1:8
Thadou: Hitia nakhan toube cheh nauva chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa hetna a chu gasoa chule phatchomna nanei dingu ahi.
English: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hinlah hichea khantouna neilou ho chun chomcha ding bou amuu ahilouleh mitchouva, amaho achonsetnau masaa kona chu kisilngima ahiu asuhmil jiu ahitai.
en: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
text:
2PE 1:9
Thadou: Hinlah hichea khantouna neilou ho chun chomcha ding bou amuu ahilouleh mitchouva, amaho achonsetnau masaa kona chu kisilngima ahiu asuhmil jiu ahitai.
English: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

tcz: Hitichun sopi deitahte, nanghon Pathen in nakouvu adeilhenna a chu najaovu ahi photchennan, kiseh in tonggimun. Hiche hohi bolleu chun, nangho nalhah manglou hel diu ahi.
en: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
text:
2PE 1:10
Thadou: Hitichun sopi deitahte, nanghon Pathen in nakouvu adeilhenna a chu najaovu ahi photchennan, kiseh in tonggimun. Hiche hohi bolleu chun, nangho nalhah manglou hel diu ahi.
English: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

tcz: Chutengleh Pathen in IPakaiyu le Huhhingpu Yeshua Christa tonsot Lenggama luttheina dia phalna namu dingu ahitai.
en: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
text:
2PE 1:11
Thadou: Chutengleh Pathen in IPakaiyu le Huhhingpu Yeshua Christa tonsot Lenggama luttheina dia phalna namu dingu ahitai.
English: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hiche jeh'a chu, hiche ho thudol hi keiman avel a kageldoh sahkit jing ding nahiuve-nangho hichu nahetsau le hiche thutah nakihil sauva chu nadin det u ahitai.
en: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
text:
2PE 1:12
Thadou: Hiche jeh'a chu, hiche ho thudol hi keiman avel a kageldoh sahkit jing ding nahiuve-nangho hichu nahetsau le hiche thutah nakihil sauva chu nadin det u ahitai.
English: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

tcz: Chule hichebou hi adih chu ahin, keiman kahinlai sunga kavel geldoh sah jing ding nahiuve.
en: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
text:
2PE 1:13
Thadou: Chule hichebou hi adih chu ahin, keiman kahinlai sunga kavel geldoh sah jing ding nahiuve.
English: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

tcz: Ajeh chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah vahding ahitai ti eiseipeh ahitai.
en: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
text:
2PE 1:14
Thadou: Ajeh chu, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa chun hiche leiset hinkho hi kadalhah vahding ahitai ti eiseipeh ahitai.
English: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

tcz: Hitia hi keima kache nung jong leh hiche hohi nana geldoh jingna dinguva keima kiseh tah a pang jing ding kahi.
en: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
text:
2PE 1:15
Thadou: Hitia hi keima kache nung jong leh hiche hohi nana geldoh jingna dinguva keima kiseh tah a pang jing ding kahi.
English: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

tcz: Ajeh chu keihon IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa thaneitah a ahung thudol nangho kaseipeh u chun semthu thusim seiya kanahi pouve. Keihon aloupina gunchena bulhingset kamit tah uva kana mu u chun,
en: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
text:
2PE 1:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu keihon IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa thaneitah a ahung thudol nangho kaseipeh u chun semthu thusim seiya kanahi pouve. Keihon aloupina gunchena bulhingset kamit tah uva kana mu u chun,
English: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

tcz: Pa Pathena kona jana le loupina Aman anamu ahitai. Pathen loupi thaneinaa aw chun ajah a, “Hiche hi keiman kangailut tah, kipana sangtah eipea ka Chapa ahi,” ati.
en: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
text:
2PE 1:17
Thadou: Pa Pathena kona jana le loupina Aman anamu ahitai. Pathen loupi thaneinaa aw chun ajah a, “Hiche hi keiman kangailut tah, kipana sangtah eipea ka Chapa ahi,” ati.
English: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

tcz: Keihotah in Amatoh moltheng chunga kaumpet'un vana kon in hiche aw chu kajauvin ahi.
en: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
text:
2PE 1:18
Thadou: Keihotah in Amatoh moltheng chunga kaumpet'un vana kon in hiche aw chu kajauvin ahi.
English: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

tcz: Hiche hetchetna neijal hin, keihon themgao ho thupoh kaseiphongu hi kakihason chehna theiyu aumin ahi. Amahon ajih u thudol hi phatah a vetsuina naneiyu angaiye, ajeh chu athuseiyu hi muthimlah a meivah kidevah tobanga, kho ahungvah lhah kahsea, chule Christa Jing Valpa chu nalung sunguva kona ahung vahdoh kahsea ding ahi.
en: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
text:
2PE 1:19
Thadou: Hiche hetchetna neijal hin, keihon themgao ho thupoh kaseiphongu hi kakihason chehna theiyu aumin ahi. Amahon ajih u thudol hi phatah a vetsuina naneiyu angaiye, ajeh chu athuseiyu hi muthimlah a meivah kidevah tobanga, kho ahungvah lhah kahsea, chule Christa Jing Valpa chu nalung sunguva kona ahung vahdoh kahsea ding ahi.
English: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

tcz: Hicheho jouse chunga hin, Pathen Lekhabua themgao thusei dohho hi themgao ama hetna lungthima hungpeng ahipoi, ti nahetdoh'u ngai ahi.
en: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
text:
2PE 1:20
Thadou: Hicheho jouse chunga hin, Pathen Lekhabua themgao thusei dohho hi themgao ama hetna lungthima hungpeng ahipoi, ti nahetdoh'u ngai ahi.
English: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

tcz: Ahilouleh mihem lung gela kona jong ahipoi, chuche themgao ho chu Lhagao Thengin athunun uva, chule amahon Pathena kona aseidoh u ahi.
en: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
text:
2PE 1:21
Thadou: Ahilouleh mihem lung gela kona jong ahipoi, chuche themgao ho chu Lhagao Thengin athunun uva, chule amahon Pathena kona aseidoh u ahi.
English: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

tcz: Hinlah Israel lah a jong themgao dihlouho ana um tobanga chu nangho lah a jong thuhil dihlou hung um ding ahiuve. Amaho chun chingthei tah a mahthahna thei thuhil phalou ahil dingu chule aPakaiyu amaho chodohpa geiya ahinseilep nahlai dingu ahi. Hitiahi, amaho tah in phulou helouva amah thahna dingu ahin kilhut dingu ahi.
en: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
text:
2PE 2:1
Thadou: Hinlah Israel lah a jong themgao dihlouho ana um tobanga chu nangho lah a jong thuhil dihlou hung um ding ahiuve. Amaho chun chingthei tah a mahthahna thei thuhil phalou ahil dingu chule aPakaiyu amaho chodohpa geiya ahinseilep nahlai dingu ahi. Hitiahi, amaho tah in phulou helouva amah thahna dingu ahin kilhut dingu ahi.
English: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

tcz: Amaho thuhil phalou le jachat umtah ajonthan hoinauhi mitampin ahinjui ding ahiuve. Chule hiche thuhil choiho jeh'a hi thutah lampi hi seiset a hung um ding ahi.
en: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
text:
2PE 2:2
Thadou: Amaho thuhil phalou le jachat umtah ajonthan hoinauhi mitampin ahinjui ding ahiuve. Chule hiche thuhil choiho jeh'a hi thutah lampi hi seiset a hung um ding ahi.
English: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

tcz: Ama ho chun chingthei tah a jou aseiyuva, nasum'u chu ahin kisip tup dingu ahi. Hinlah Pathen in amaho chu masangpeh a themmo achansau ahin, chule amah thahna dingu chu kho ngaisot lou helding ahi.
en: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
text:
2PE 2:3
Thadou: Ama ho chun chingthei tah a jou aseiyuva, nasum'u chu ahin kisip tup dingu ahi. Hinlah Pathen in amaho chu masangpeh a themmo achansau ahin, chule amah thahna dingu chu kho ngaisot lou helding ahi.
English: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen in vantil achonseho jeng jong akhendehlou ahi. Aman amaho chu muthim lhangkhal kiheh gomtong sunga, Damuna chu alelut jenga, thutanna nikho lhin kahsea dinga akhum tup ahi.
en: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

tcz: Chule Pathen in vannoi mi masa jong chu-Noah le ainsung mi sagi tailou anakhen dehpoi. Noah chun vannoi mite chu Pathen thutandih thua anahilchah ahi. Hitia hi Pathen in vannoi pumpia Ama ngaisah louho twisang let'a asuh manga Noah ana huhdoh ahi.
en: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
text:
2PE 2:5
Thadou: Chule Pathen in vannoi mi masa jong chu-Noah le ainsung mi sagi tailou anakhen dehpoi. Noah chun vannoi mite chu Pathen thutandih thua anahilchah ahi. Hitia hi Pathen in vannoi pumpia Ama ngaisah louho twisang let'a asuh manga Noah ana huhdoh ahi.
English: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

tcz: Khonungin, Pathen in Sodom le Gomorrah khopi teni jong themmo achanin, vutvai kisetkhomna mun asohtai. Aman amaho chu Ama ngaisah lou ho chunga ipi ahungso ding avetsah ahitai.
en: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
text:
2PE 2:6
Thadou: Khonungin, Pathen in Sodom le Gomorrah khopi teni jong themmo achanin, vutvai kisetkhomna mun asohtai. Aman amaho chu Ama ngaisah lou ho chunga ipi ahungso ding avetsah ahitai.
English: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

tcz: Hinlah Pathen in Lot jong chu midih ahijeh'in Sodoma konin ahuh doh e, ajeh chu akimvel a jachat umtah'a huhna nei migilou ho chu alungnat pin ahi.
en: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
text:
2PE 2:7
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen in Lot jong chu midih ahijeh'in Sodoma konin ahuh doh e, ajeh chu akimvel a jachat umtah'a huhna nei migilou ho chu alungnat pin ahi.
English: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

tcz: Ahi, Lotchu midih khat anahin, ama chun miho phatlouna ani ania ajah le amu ho chu alung thimah athoh gimpin ahi.
en: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
text:
2PE 2:8
Thadou: Ahi, Lotchu midih khat anahin, ama chun miho phatlouna ani ania ajah le amu ho chu alung thimah athoh gimpin ahi.
English: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

tcz: Hijeh chun nangman namui, Pakaiyin Ama ngaisah ho chu thoh hasatna atonauva kona iti ahuhdoh ding ahen, Aman migilou chu hahsat thutanna nunung nikho lhinkah jenga jong gimbolna munah akoiye ahenai.
en: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
text:
2PE 2:9
Thadou: Hijeh chun nangman namui, Pakaiyin Ama ngaisah ho chu thoh hasatna atonauva kona iti ahuhdoh ding ahen, Aman migilou chu hahsat thutanna nunung nikho lhinkah jenga jong gimbolna munah akoiye ahenai.
English: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

tcz: Aman adehset in huh lung ngaichat neiho le thuneina neiho ijaseplou ho chunga alung hang dehset in ahi. Amaho hi akiletsah uvin chule alouchalun, kichatna neilou hel'in achungnung thuneiho jong atai tomun, kicha'a kithin ding jong ago pouvin ahi.
en: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
text:
2PE 2:10
Thadou: Aman adehset in huh lung ngaichat neiho le thuneina neiho ijaseplou ho chunga alung hang dehset in ahi. Amaho hi akiletsah uvin chule alouchalun, kichatna neilou hel'in achungnung thuneiho jong atai tomun, kicha'a kithin ding jong ago pouvin ahi.
English: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

tcz: Hinlah vantil ho, gamchenga thanei joa le thahatjo ho, chun chungnungjo thaneina neiho chunga chun Pakaiya konin taitomna thucheng alhutngam pouve.
en: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
text:
2PE 2:11
Thadou: Hinlah vantil ho, gamchenga thanei joa le thahatjo ho, chun chungnungjo thaneina neiho chunga chun Pakaiya konin taitomna thucheng alhutngam pouve.
English: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

tcz: Hiche thuhil dihlou ho hi lung geltohlou gamsa tobang ahiuvin, alungphut dung jui uva chon, ahing chang uva mat'a chule suhmang theibep dia penga ahiuve. Amahon ahetlouvu aseiseuvin, chule ganhingho banga kisumang ding ahiuve.
en: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,
text:
2PE 2:12
Thadou: Hiche thuhil dihlou ho hi lung geltohlou gamsa tobang ahiuvin, alungphut dung jui uva chon, ahing chang uva mat'a chule suhmang theibep dia penga ahiuve. Amahon ahetlouvu aseiseuvin, chule ganhingho banga kisumang ding ahiuve.
English: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

tcz: Amaho amanthahna dingu chu thilse abolnau jaljeh a atohgao asan dingu ahi. Amahon sunlai nipi noiya ase bolding chu lunga thanopna aneiyuve. Amaho chu lungsetna bei le setbol mi, nalah uva um ahiuve. Amaho mi doha bolna a athau anomun, nanghotoh nakiloikhom nauva an naneh khomnauva alhauve.
en: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

tcz: Amahon amit uva jon abol'un chule chonset angaichatnau lungkimna aneipouve. Amahon lungdetna neilou ho chonsetnaa apuilut un, chule chipsetna lama phatah a kikhoukhah a ahiuve. Amaho Pathen gaosapna noiya hinga ahiuve.
en: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!
text:
2PE 2:14
Thadou: Amahon amit uva jon abol'un chule chonset angaichatnau lungkimna aneipouve. Amahon lungdetna neilou ho chonsetnaa apuilut un, chule chipsetna lama phatah a kikhoukhah a ahiuve. Amaho Pathen gaosapna noiya hinga ahiuve.
English: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

tcz: Amaho lamdih a kona pampet'a ahitauvin, chule Beor chapa Balaam, thilse bola sumlo nompa khonung juiya ahiuve.
en: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

tcz: Hinlah Balaam chu ngoltah a amason got pet'in asangan chun mihem aw in thu ahinsei doh in, ama chu aphoh jengin ahi.
en: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.
text:
2PE 2:16
Thadou: Hinlah Balaam chu ngoltah a amason got pet'in asangan chun mihem aw in thu ahinsei doh in, ama chu aphoh jengin ahi.
English: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

tcz: Hiche mite hi twivei talou twinah kang chu ahiuvin, ahilouleh meibol hung um huiyin amutmang tobang ahiuve. Amaho hi athimpen muthim lah a mahthahden ding ahitauve.
en: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
text:
2PE 2:17
Thadou: Hiche mite hi twivei talou twinah kang chu ahiuvin, ahilouleh meibol hung um huiyin amutmang tobang ahiuve. Amaho hi athimpen muthim lah a mahthahden ding ahitauve.
English: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

tcz: Ajeh chu amaho pannabei, ngolhoi tah a hamhoithouva ahin, athuseiyuva lamvaina a umho lah a kona hung jamdoh ho chu tahsa lam huhna lung ngaichatnaa miho athujouva lheplhah bai chu athunun jou jiu ahi.
en: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

tcz: Amahon chamlhatna thutep mi aneipiuvin, hinlah amaho tah chonset le kisuhbohna a sohchang ahiuve. Ajeh chu nangho athua nananun pet uva chu asoh a lut nahi tauve.
en: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.
text:
2PE 2:19
Thadou: Amahon chamlhatna thutep mi aneipiuvin, hinlah amaho tah chonset le kisuhbohna a sohchang ahiuve. Ajeh chu nangho athua nananun pet uva chu asoh a lut nahi tauve.
English: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

tcz: Miho chun IPakaiyu le huhhingpu Yeshua Christa ahet tenguleh hiche vannoi Phatlouna a kona hi ongdoh a ahiuvin, chujou tengleh chonsetna a akihen ohkit uva chule asohchan kit tenguleh, amaho chu amasa sangin akhohjo cheh jitauve.
en: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
text:
2PE 2:20
Thadou: Miho chun IPakaiyu le huhhingpu Yeshua Christa ahet tenguleh hiche vannoi Phatlouna a kona hi ongdoh a ahiuvin, chujou tengleh chonsetna a akihen ohkit uva chule asohchan kit tenguleh, amaho chu amasa sangin akhohjo cheh jitauve.
English: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

tcz: Amahon chonphatna lampi chu ahet uva chujouva hinkho thenga hin ding thupeh nahsah louva abol sanguvin, chonphatna lampi chu anahetlou beh u hihenlang hileh phajo ngap ding ahi.
en: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
text:
2PE 2:21
Thadou: Amahon chonphatna lampi chu ahet uva chujouva hinkho thenga hin ding thupeh nahsah louva abol sanguvin, chonphatna lampi chu anahetlou beh u hihenlang hileh phajo ngap ding ahi.
English: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

tcz: Amahon hiche thuchih: “Uichan alohlhahsa anekitjie, kiti hileh, Vohcha kisil ngimsa bonlhoh a akibolkit ji'e,” tia kisei hi aphotchen u ahitai!
en: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
text:
2PE 2:22
Thadou: Amahon hiche thuchih: “Uichan alohlhahsa anekitjie, kiti hileh, Vohcha kisil ngimsa bonlhoh a akibolkit ji'e,” tia kisei hi aphotchen u ahitai!
English: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

tcz: Kagol ngaitah teho, hiche hi nahenguva dinga ka lekhathot ani channa ahitai, chule ani gel'a hi nalung gelu pha chu suhthouna ding le nalung thimu suhthah chehna ding kalung ngaito ahi.
en: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you
text:
2PE 3:1
Thadou: Kagol ngaitah teho, hiche hi nahenguva dinga ka lekhathot ani channa ahitai, chule ani gel'a hi nalung gelu pha chu suhthouna ding le nalung thimu suhthah chehna ding kalung ngaito ahi.
English: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

tcz: Masang peh a themgao thenghon ipi aseiyu, chule IPakaiyu le Huhhingpun na solchah teu henga ipi thu apeh nageldoh dingu kalung gon ahi.
en: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,
text:
2PE 3:2
Thadou: Masang peh a themgao thenghon ipi aseiyu, chule IPakaiyu le Huhhingpun na solchah teu henga ipi thu apeh nageldoh dingu kalung gon ahi.
English: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

tcz: Akhoh dehset a kageldoh sahkit nomu chu ni nunung lam leh jontai hat ho hung ding ahiuve, amaho chun thutah chu ataiponguva chule amaho lung ngaichat dungjuiya chon ding ahiuve.
en: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
text:
2PE 3:3
Thadou: Akhoh dehset a kageldoh sahkit nomu chu ni nunung lam leh jontai hat ho hung ding ahiuve, amaho chun thutah chu ataiponguva chule amaho lung ngaichat dungjuiya chon ding ahiuve.
English: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

tcz: Amaho chun, “Yeshua hungkit ding ahi tia thutep chu itiba hitam? Ipu ipateu masanga vannoi kisem til laiya pat in tuchan geiyin ijakai angai chu ahi jinge,” tia ahinsei dingu ahi.
en: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”
text:
2PE 3:4
Thadou: Amaho chun, “Yeshua hungkit ding ahi tia thutep chu itiba hitam? Ipu ipateu masanga vannoi kisem til laiya pat in tuchan geiyin ijakai angai chu ahi jinge,” tia ahinsei dingu ahi.
English: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

tcz: Amahon Pathen in van hohi thu apeh a asem a, chule Aman leiset hi twiya kona ahin umdohsah a chule twiya aum kimvel sah ahi, tihi alungcham tah in asumil un ahi.
en: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
text:
2PE 3:5
Thadou: Amahon Pathen in van hohi thu apeh a asem a, chule Aman leiset hi twiya kona ahin umdohsah a chule twiya aum kimvel sah ahi, tihi alungcham tah in asumil un ahi.
English: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

tcz: Chujouva chu Aman twi chu amanchah a vannoi aluipa chu twisanglet'a asuh mang ahi.
en: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.
text:
2PE 3:6
Thadou: Chujouva chu Aman twi chu amanchah a vannoi aluipa chu twisanglet'a asuh mang ahi.
English: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

tcz: Chule hiche thum'a ma a chu tua vanho le leiset jong hi meiya dinga kikhol khoma ahi. Amaho hi thutan nikhoa dinga kikoitup'a ahiuvin, chutengleh Pathen ngaisah lou ho kisu manghel jeng diu ahitai.
en: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
text:
2PE 3:7
Thadou: Chule hiche thum'a ma a chu tua vanho le leiset jong hi meiya dinga kikhol khoma ahi. Amaho hi thutan nikhoa dinga kikoitup'a ahiuvin, chutengleh Pathen ngaisah lou ho kisu manghel jeng diu ahitai.
English: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

tcz: Hinlah kangaitah teho, nanghon hiche thilkhat hi sumil hih un. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dingin nikho khat jong chu kum sangkhat tobang chule kum sangkhat jong chu nikho khat tobangma ahi ti heuvin.
en: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
text:
2PE 3:8
Thadou: Hinlah kangaitah teho, nanghon hiche thilkhat hi sumil hih un. Ajeh chu Pakaiya dingin nikho khat jong chu kum sangkhat tobang chule kum sangkhat jong chu nikho khat tobangma ahi ti heuvin.
English: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

tcz: Mi phabep in Pakai chu athutep lam dol a geisang hidinga agel u chu hilou ahi. Ahipoi, ama nangho jal a thoh hat joh'ah ahibouve. Aman koimacha suhmanga aum ding adeipoi, chusanga mitin lung akisih dingu adei ahi.
en: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
text:
2PE 3:9
Thadou: Mi phabep in Pakai chu athutep lam dol a geisang hidinga agel u chu hilou ahi. Ahipoi, ama nangho jal a thoh hat joh'ah ahibouve. Aman koimacha suhmanga aum ding adeipoi, chusanga mitin lung akisih dingu adei ahi.
English: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

tcz: Hinlah Pakai nikho hi gucha banga kigin loupet le hung lhung ding ahi. Chutengleh vanho jong meikouva kisubei ding, chule asunga umjouse hi thutanna chang diu ahiuve.
en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.
text:
2PE 3:10
Thadou: Hinlah Pakai nikho hi gucha banga kigin loupet le hung lhung ding ahi. Chutengleh vanho jong meikouva kisubei ding, chule asunga umjouse hi thutanna chang diu ahiuve.
English: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

tcz: Hitia hi ikimvel uva umjouse hi kisumang ding ahiuva ahitah leh, nangho la ichan geiya thenna le Pathen ngaisah a nahin dingu ham?
en: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
text:
2PE 3:11
Thadou: Hitia hi ikimvel uva umjouse hi kisumang ding ahiuva ahitah leh, nangho la ichan geiya thenna le Pathen ngaisah a nahin dingu ham?
English: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

tcz: Pathen nikho ahung lhun ding chu katjinga chule kinem'a ngahjinga um ding ahi. Hiche nikhoachu, Aman vanho chu meiya ahal ding, chule thil ho chu meikonga junlha gam ding ahitauve.
en: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?
text:
2PE 3:12
Thadou: Pathen nikho ahung lhun ding chu katjinga chule kinem'a ngahjinga um ding ahi. Hiche nikhoachu, Aman vanho chu meiya ahal ding, chule thil ho chu meikonga junlha gam ding ahitauve.
English: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

tcz: Hinlah eihon Aman athutep Van thahho le leiset thah chu kinem'a ingau ahi, hichea chu Pathen chonphatna dimset ahi.
en: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
text:
2PE 3:13
Thadou: Hinlah eihon Aman athutep Van thahho le leiset thah chu kinem'a ingau ahi, hichea chu Pathen chonphatna dimset ahi.
English: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

tcz: Chule hitia chu, deitahte nanghon hichengse hi ahung lhun ding nanga pet un, ama mitmua atheng le nolnabeiya kichamdela hinding kihabolun.
en: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
text:
2PE 3:14
Thadou: Chule hitia chu, deitahte nanghon hichengse hi ahung lhun ding nanga pet un, ama mitmua atheng le nolnabeiya kichamdela hinding kihabolun.
English: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

tcz: Chule geldoh un, IPakaiyu thohhatna chun miho huhhing'a umna ding phat apeh ahi. Hiche hi isopiu Paul jengin jong Pathen in chihna apeh a chu nahenguva ajih ahi.
en: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
text:
2PE 3:15
Thadou: Chule geldoh un, IPakaiyu thohhatna chun miho huhhing'a umna ding phat apeh ahi. Hiche hi isopiu Paul jengin jong Pathen in chihna apeh a chu nahenguva ajih ahi.
English: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

tcz: Alekhathot jousea hiche thudol hi asei ahi. Alung gel phabep aseiho chu hethahsa aumin, chule ima hetna neilou holeh dinmun detlou ho chun Pathen Thudang aboljiu bang chun lamchom lang akosah un, chule hiche hin amanthahna dingu ahinsodoh ding ahi.
en: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
text:
2PE 3:16
Thadou: Alekhathot jousea hiche thudol hi asei ahi. Alung gel phabep aseiho chu hethahsa aumin, chule ima hetna neilou holeh dinmun detlou ho chun Pathen Thudang aboljiu bang chun lamchom lang akosah un, chule hiche hin amanthahna dingu ahinsodoh ding ahi.
English: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

tcz: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, phat lhin masanga kahin jih masat ahi. Kihong phauvin, hitia chu chuche migilou ho suhkhelna chun napui mang louna dinguvin chule nadindet pet u lhaso khaget uvinate.
en: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
text:
2PE 3:17
Thadou: Hijeh chun sopi deitahte, phat lhin masanga kahin jih masat ahi. Kihong phauvin, hitia chu chuche migilou ho suhkhelna chun napui mang louna dinguvin chule nadindet pet u lhaso khaget uvinate.
English: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

tcz: Chusangin, nangho I Pakaiyu le Huhhingpa Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna le hetna a chun khangtou jingun. Abonchan Ama a chun tule a-itih a dingin loupina hijing tahen! Amen.
en: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
text:
2PE 3:18
Thadou: Chusangin, nangho I Pakaiyu le Huhhingpa Pakai Yeshua Christa lungsetna le hetna a chun khangtou jingun. Abonchan Ama a chun tule a-itih a dingin loupina hijing tahen! Amen.
English: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

tcz: Keihon nangho koma kahillhang leu-atil abula pat'a ana umjing, kanakol uva kajahsau, kamit uva kamusau chule kakhut uva kathamsau Hinna Thu chu ahi.
en: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
text:
1JN 1:1
Thadou: Keihon nangho koma kahillhang leu-atil abula pat'a ana umjing, kanakol uva kajahsau, kamit uva kamusau chule kakhut uva kathamsau Hinna Thu chu ahi.
English: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

tcz: Amatah hinna ahi chu keiho henga kiphongdoh ahitai chule keihon Ama chu kamutauve, chule tua hi keihon kahettohsah uva chule Amatah Tonsot Hinna ahi tia kaseiphongu ahi. Ama Pa toh ana umsa chujouva keiho henga hung kiphongdoh'ah ahi.
en: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

tcz: Keiho tah in kamuchet uva chule kajahsau chu nangho henga kahillhangu ahin, hichu keiho toh ikiloikhom theina dingu ahi. Chule keiho toh kiloikhomna hi Pa le AChapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhomna ahi.
en: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
text:
1JN 1:3
Thadou: Keiho tah in kamuchet uva chule kajahsau chu nangho henga kahillhangu ahin, hichu keiho toh ikiloikhom theina dingu ahi. Chule keiho toh kiloikhomna hi Pa le AChapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhomna ahi.
English: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

tcz: Hicheho chengse kajih uhi nanghon keihoa kipana nanei bulhing-chamkim theina dingu ahi.
en: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
text:
1JN 1:4
Thadou: Hicheho chengse kajih uhi nanghon keihoa kipana nanei bulhing-chamkim theina dingu ahi.
English: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

tcz: Keihon Yeshua a kona kajahsau thupoh chule tua nahenguva kaphondoh u chu hichehi ahi-Pathen chu vah ahi, chule Ama a chu muthim umlouhel ahi.
en: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
text:
1JN 1:5
Thadou: Keihon Yeshua a kona kajahsau thupoh chule tua nahenguva kaphondoh u chu hichehi ahi-Pathen chu vah ahi, chule Ama a chu muthim umlouhel ahi.
English: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

tcz: Hijeh achu eihon Pathen to kiloikhom kahi itiuva ahia lhagao muthim lah a vahle nalai ihiuleh eiho thutah chu jui jing lou ihiu ahi.
en: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.
text:
1JN 1:6
Thadou: Hijeh achu eihon Pathen to kiloikhom kahi itiuva ahia lhagao muthim lah a vahle nalai ihiuleh eiho thutah chu jui jing lou ihiu ahi.
English: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen vah'a aum banga vah'a chu eiho iumuva ahileh, eiho khat le khat kiloikhom ihitauve, chule Achapa Yeshua thisan chun ichonsetnau jouse a kona eisil thengu ahitai.
en: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
text:
1JN 1:7
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen vah'a aum banga vah'a chu eiho iumuva ahileh, eiho khat le khat kiloikhom ihitauve, chule Achapa Yeshua thisan chun ichonsetnau jouse a kona eisil thengu ahitai.
English: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

tcz: Eiho chonsetna neilouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eima hotah kilhemlha ihiuvin, thutah'a hinga ihi lou u ahi.
en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
text:
1JN 1:8
Thadou: Eiho chonsetna neilouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eima hotah kilhemlha ihiuvin, thutah'a hinga ihi lou u ahi.
English: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

tcz: Hinlah eihon ichonset u Ama koma iphondoh uva ahileh, Ama chu ichonsetnau ngaidam dinga tahsan umle kitah ahin, chule gitlouna jousea kona eisil theng theiyu ahi.
en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
text:
1JN 1:9
Thadou: Hinlah eihon ichonset u Ama koma iphondoh uva ahileh, Ama chu ichonsetnau ngaidam dinga tahsan umle kitah ahin, chule gitlouna jousea kona eisil theng theiyu ahi.
English: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

tcz: Eiho chonse khalouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eihon Pathen jou seiya ingoh u chule Athu chun ilunguva mun aneilou ahi ti ivetsah u ahi.
en: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
text:
1JN 1:10
Thadou: Eiho chonse khalouva ikiseidoh uva ahileh eihon Pathen jou seiya ingoh u chule Athu chun ilunguva mun aneilou ahi ti ivetsah u ahi.
English: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

tcz: Kacha deitahte, nachonset louna dinguva hiche hi nahenguva kahinjih ahi. Hinlah achonse aumtah a ahileh ichung thu'u eiseichampeh thei dingu chonphatah Yeshua Christa chu inei nauve.
en: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.
text:
1JN 2:1
Thadou: Kacha deitahte, nachonset louna dinguva hiche hi nahenguva kahinjih ahi. Hinlah achonse aumtah a ahileh ichung thu'u eiseichampeh thei dingu chonphatah Yeshua Christa chu inei nauve.
English: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

tcz: Amatah hi ichonset nauva kona lhatdohna dinga hung kikatdoh a ahitai–chule eiho chonset jengseh hilouvin vannoi mite chonset jaljeh jong ahi.
en: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
text:
1JN 2:2
Thadou: Amatah hi ichonset nauva kona lhatdohna dinga hung kikatdoh a ahitai–chule eiho chonset jengseh hilouvin vannoi mite chonset jaljeh jong ahi.
English: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

tcz: Chule eihon Athupeh ho ijuiyuva ahileh Ama chu iheuve tia iseitheiyu ahi.
en: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.
text:
1JN 2:3
Thadou: Chule eihon Athupeh ho ijuiyuva ahileh Ama chu iheuve tia iseitheiyu ahi.
English: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

tcz: Koiham khattouvin, Keiman Pathen kahei tihen Pathen Thupeh ho jui hih henlang hitaleh, amatah chu mijou ahin, chule thutah'a chu hinglouva ahi.
en: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.
text:
1JN 2:4
Thadou: Koiham khattouvin, Keiman Pathen kahei tihen Pathen Thupeh ho jui hih henlang hitaleh, amatah chu mijou ahin, chule thutah'a chu hinglouva ahi.
English: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

tcz: Hinlah Pathen Thu jui'a chu Ama ngailutna ivetsah tahbeh u ahi. Hichea hin Amaa hinga ihiuve ti ihetnau ahi.
en: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:
text:
1JN 2:5
Thadou: Hinlah Pathen Thu jui'a chu Ama ngailutna ivetsah tahbeh u ahi. Hichea hin Amaa hinga ihiuve ti ihetnau ahi.
English: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

tcz: Koihileh Pathena kahinge tiho chun Yeshua banga abol diu ahi.
en: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.
text:
1JN 2:6
Thadou: Koihileh Pathena kahinge tiho chun Yeshua banga abol diu ahi.
English: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

tcz: Deitahte, keiman nangho henga thupeh thah kajih ahipoi; atil abula naneisau thupehlui chu kahin jih joh ahi. Hiche thupehlui chu–khat le khat kingailut ding masanga najahsau chu ahi.
en: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
text:
1JN 2:7
Thadou: Deitahte, keiman nangho henga thupeh thah kajih ahipoi; atil abula naneisau thupehlui chu kahin jih joh ahi. Hiche thupehlui chu–khat le khat kingailut ding masanga najahsau chu ahi.
English: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

tcz: Hiche thupeh hi athah jong ahi. Yeshua chu hiche thupeh a chon'ah ahin chule nangho jong hichea hi nachon diu ahi. Ajeh chu muthim hi hungmang ding chule vah tahbeh chu hungvah doh a ahitai.
en: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
text:
1JN 2:8
Thadou: Hiche thupeh hi athah jong ahi. Yeshua chu hiche thupeh a chon'ah ahin chule nangho jong hichea hi nachon diu ahi. Ajeh chu muthim hi hungmang ding chule vah tahbeh chu hungvah doh a ahitai.
English: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

tcz: Koiham khattouvin, “Keima Vah'a kavahlei,” tihen hinlah Christian asopi khat chu hotboltaleh, hichepa chu muthim lah a umnalai ahi.
en: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.
text:
1JN 2:9
Thadou: Koiham khattouvin, “Keima Vah'a kavahlei,” tihen hinlah Christian asopi khat chu hotboltaleh, hichepa chu muthim lah a umnalai ahi.
English: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

tcz: Koipen hijongleh sopi midang khat angailut'a ahileh vah'a chu chon'ah ahin, chule koima kipal lhuh sahlou ahije.
en: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.
text:
1JN 2:10
Thadou: Koipen hijongleh sopi midang khat angailut'a ahileh vah'a chu chon'ah ahin, chule koima kipal lhuh sahlou ahije.
English: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

tcz: Hinlah sopi michom dang khat hot bola chu muthimlah a uma chule vahlea ahi. Hitobang mi chun achena ding lampi ahepon, muthim chun amit chotsah ahi.
en: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.
text:
1JN 2:11
Thadou: Hinlah sopi michom dang khat hot bola chu muthimlah a uma chule vahlea ahi. Hitobang mi chun achena ding lampi ahepon, muthim chun amit chotsah ahi.
English: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

tcz: Pathen chate ho dinga kajih ahi, ajeh chu Yeshua jal'a nachonset u ngaidam nahi tauve.
en: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
text:
1JN 2:12
Thadou: Pathen chate ho dinga kajih ahi, ajeh chu Yeshua jal'a nachonset u ngaidam nahi tauve.
English: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

tcz: Tahsan naa pilhing ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu atil abula pat'a anaumsa Christa chu nanghon naheuve. Tahsana khangdong nangho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon agiloupa chu nakidou piuva najou ahitai.
en: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.
text:
1JN 2:13
Thadou: Tahsan naa pilhing ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu atil abula pat'a anaumsa Christa chu nanghon naheuve. Tahsana khangdong nangho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon agiloupa chu nakidou piuva najou ahitai.
English: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

tcz: Nangho Pathen Chate ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pachu naheuve. Tahsan'a pilhing nangho henga kajih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Christa chu naheuvin, Ama chu atil abula anaum jingsa ahi. Tahsanna khang dong nangho henga kahin jih ahi, ajeh chu nangho nahat uvin chule Pathen Thu nalung sunguva achenge, chule agilouto nakidouvu chu najou tauve.
en: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
text:
1JN 2:14
Thadou: Nangho Pathen Chate ho henga kahinjih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Pachu naheuve. Tahsan'a pilhing nangho henga kajih ahi, ajeh chu nanghon Christa chu naheuvin, Ama chu atil abula anaum jingsa ahi. Tahsanna khang dong nangho henga kahin jih ahi, ajeh chu nangho nahat uvin chule Pathen Thu nalung sunguva achenge, chule agilouto nakidouvu chu najou tauve.
English: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

tcz: Hiche vannoi hi ngailu hih un ahilouleh vannoiyin napeh u jong ngailu hih un, ajeh chu nanghon vannoi nangailut tenguleh, nanghon Pa ngailutna chu nanei lou u ahi.
en: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.
text:
1JN 2:15
Thadou: Hiche vannoi hi ngailu hih un ahilouleh vannoiyin napeh u jong ngailu hih un, ajeh chu nanghon vannoi nangailut tenguleh, nanghon Pa ngailutna chu nanei lou u ahi.
English: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

tcz: Ajeh chu vannoiyin tahsalam lung ngaichat ho, mitmua deichatthei ho, chule ithilbol doh hou chule ineihouva kiletsah pina apehthei ahi. Hitihohi Pa a kon ahipoi, ahin hiche vannoiya kon joh ahi.
en: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.
text:
1JN 2:16
Thadou: Ajeh chu vannoiyin tahsalam lung ngaichat ho, mitmua deichatthei ho, chule ithilbol doh hou chule ineihouva kiletsah pina apehthei ahi. Hitihohi Pa a kon ahipoi, ahin hiche vannoiya kon joh ahi.
English: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

tcz: Chule hiche vannoi le miho lung ngaichatna ho jong akem tul tule. Hinlah Pathen lunglambol ho chu tonsot'a umjing ding ahiuve.
en: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
text:
1JN 2:17
Thadou: Chule hiche vannoi le miho lung ngaichatna ho jong akem tul tule. Hinlah Pathen lunglambol ho chu tonsot'a umjing ding ahiuve.
English: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

tcz: Cha ngaitahteho, phat nunung chu ahitai. Christa doupa ahunge ti naja tauve. Chule Christa dou tampi ahung kilangtai. Hichea kon hin phat kichai kon ahunghitai ti naheuve.
en: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.
text:
1JN 2:18
Thadou: Cha ngaitahteho, phat nunung chu ahitai. Christa doupa ahunge ti naja tauve. Chule Christa dou tampi ahung kilangtai. Hichea kon hin phat kichai kon ahunghitai ti naheuve.
English: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

tcz: Hiche miho hin i-houbung hou adalhauve, hinlah amaho eihoto houbunga ium khom tahbeh khapouve, chuti lou hileh eiho toh umkhom diu ahitai. Adalhah u chun, amaho hi eihoa ahipouve ti aphotchen ahi.
en: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.
text:
1JN 2:19
Thadou: Hiche miho hin i-houbung hou adalhauve, hinlah amaho eihoto houbunga ium khom tahbeh khapouve, chuti lou hileh eiho toh umkhom diu ahitai. Adalhah u chun, amaho hi eihoa ahipouve ti aphotchen ahi.
English: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

tcz: Hinlah nangho hitobang chun naumpouve, ajeh chu Lhagao Theng nachung uvah ahung tan chule nangho jousen thutah chu nahesoh keiyuve.
en: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.
text:
1JN 2:20
Thadou: Hinlah nangho hitobang chun naumpouve, ajeh chu Lhagao Theng nachung uvah ahung tan chule nangho jousen thutah chu nahesoh keiyuve.
English: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

tcz: Hichea keiman nangho koma kajih hi thutah nahe pouve tia kasei ahipon, ahin nanghon thutahle jouthu akibahlouna naheuve.
en: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.
text:
1JN 2:21
Thadou: Hichea keiman nangho koma kajih hi thutah nahe pouve tia kasei ahipon, ahin nanghon thutahle jouthu akibahlouna naheuve.
English: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

tcz: Chule koiham jouseipa chu? Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahipoi ti chan chu Christa dou ahi.
en: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.
text:
1JN 2:22
Thadou: Chule koiham jouseipa chu? Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahipoi ti chan chu Christa dou ahi.
English: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

tcz: Koi hileh Chapa seilep chan chun Pa aneilou ahi. Hinlah Chapa phongdoh chan chun Pachu anei ahitai.
en: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
text:
1JN 2:23
Thadou: Koi hileh Chapa seilep chan chun Pa aneilou ahi. Hinlah Chapa phongdoh chan chun Pachu anei ahitai.
English: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

tcz: Hitiahi, atil abula pat'a nakihiluva chu tahsan umtah'a napandet dingu ahi. Hichu nabol ahileh, nangma Pa le Chapa toh kiloikhoma nahi ding ahi.
en: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.
text:
1JN 2:24
Thadou: Hitiahi, atil abula pat'a nakihiluva chu tahsan umtah'a napandet dingu ahi. Hichu nabol ahileh, nangma Pa le Chapa toh kiloikhoma nahi ding ahi.
English: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

tcz: Chule hiche kiloikhomna ithanop nau hi aman eithutep peh u Tonsot Hinna chu ahi.
en: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.
text:
1JN 2:25
Thadou: Chule hiche kiloikhomna ithanop nau hi aman eithutep peh u Tonsot Hinna chu ahi.
English: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

tcz: Keiman hicheng thil ho kajih hi nangho napui lamvai dinghou chung chang thua nangho kagih nahiuve.
en: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.
text:
1JN 2:26
Thadou: Keiman hicheng thil ho kajih hi nangho napui lamvai dinghou chung chang thua nangho kagih nahiuve.
English: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

tcz: Hinlah nanghon Lhagao Theng naneiyuve chule Ama nangho sunga achenge chule ipi chu thutah ham tithua koiman nahil dingu ngaikhoh ahitapoi. Ajeh chu Lhagao chun imalam jousea nahil dingu ahi, chule Aman ahil chu thutah ahi, Ama ah jou apangpoi. Hiti chun aman nahilsau bang chun, Christa to kiloikhomna nei jingun.
en: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
text:
1JN 2:27
Thadou: Hinlah nanghon Lhagao Theng naneiyuve chule Ama nangho sunga achenge chule ipi chu thutah ham tithua koiman nahil dingu ngaikhoh ahitapoi. Ajeh chu Lhagao chun imalam jousea nahil dingu ahi, chule Aman ahil chu thutah ahi, Ama ah jou apangpoi. Hiti chun aman nahilsau bang chun, Christa to kiloikhomna nei jingun.
English: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

tcz: Chule tun, cha deitahte, Christa toh kiloikhomna neijingun, ajeh chu Ama ahung kilah tengleh nanghon lung ngamna bulhingset nanei dingu chule jahcha a chon talou ding nahiuve.
en: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
text:
1JN 2:28
Thadou: Chule tun, cha deitahte, Christa toh kiloikhomna neijingun, ajeh chu Ama ahung kilah tengleh nanghon lung ngamna bulhingset nanei dingu chule jahcha a chon talou ding nahiuve.
English: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

tcz: Eihon Christa chu chonpha ahi ti ihettah jeh uvin, koi hijongleh adih bola chu Pathen cha ahiuve tijong iheuve.
en: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.
text:
1JN 2:29
Thadou: Eihon Christa chu chonpha ahi ti ihettah jeh uvin, koi hijongleh adih bola chu Pathen cha ahiuve tijong iheuve.
English: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

tcz: Veuvin, Van'a um IPauvin ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam? Ajeh chu Aman Achate tin eikou tauve–chule eiho jong ihi tahbeh u ahi! Hinlah hiche hi vannoiya hihon Pathen Chate ihiu hi ahephapouve, ajeh chu amahon Ama ahetlou jeh u ahi.
en: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
text:
1JN 3:1
Thadou: Veuvin, Van'a um IPauvin ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam? Ajeh chu Aman Achate tin eikou tauve–chule eiho jong ihi tahbeh u ahi! Hinlah hiche hi vannoiya hihon Pathen Chate ihiu hi ahephapouve, ajeh chu amahon Ama ahetlou jeh u ahi.
English: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

tcz: Ngaitah teho–eiho Pathen chate ihiu ahitai. Chule ipi ihi dingu tun akilangdoh hih laiye. Hinlah eihon ihet'u chu Christa ahung kilah teng chuleh eihon Ama ahina tahbeh a imu dingu ahitai.
en: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.
text:
1JN 3:2
Thadou: Ngaitah teho–eiho Pathen chate ihiu ahitai. Chule ipi ihi dingu tun akilangdoh hih laiye. Hinlah eihon ihet'u chu Christa ahung kilah teng chuleh eihon Ama ahina tahbeh a imu dingu ahitai.
English: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

tcz: Chule Ama hung ding kinem'a ngah jingho chu Ama athen banga amaho jouse jong thenga umding ahiuve.
en: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.
text:
1JN 3:3
Thadou: Chule Ama hung ding kinem'a ngah jingho chu Ama athen banga amaho jouse jong thenga umding ahiuve.
English: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

tcz: Koihileh chonset bol chun Pathen Danthu apalkeh ahi, ajeh chu chonset jouse hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi.
en: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.
text:
1JN 3:4
Thadou: Koihileh chonset bol chun Pathen Danthu apalkeh ahi, ajeh chu chonset jouse hi Pathen Danthutoh kikal ahi.
English: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

tcz: Koi hileh Amatoh hingkhom chu chonsejom lou ding ahiuve. Hinlah chonset boljom jing mi chu Ama heloulai ahilouleh Ama koi ahi hechenlou ahi.
en: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.
text:
1JN 3:5
Thadou: Koi hileh Amatoh hingkhom chu chonsejom lou ding ahiuve. Hinlah chonset boljom jing mi chu Ama heloulai ahilouleh Ama koi ahi hechenlou ahi.
English: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

tcz: Koi hileh Amaa umjom jing mi chu chonselou ding ahi. Hinlah achonse jom jing chu koi hileh Ama chu heloulai ahilouleh hetkhenna neiloulai ahi.
en: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.
text:
1JN 3:6
Thadou: Koi hileh Amaa umjom jing mi chu chonselou ding ahi. Hinlah achonse jom jing chu koi hileh Ama chu heloulai ahilouleh hetkhenna neiloulai ahi.
English: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

tcz: Cha deitahte, hiche chungchang thu'ah koiman nalhep lhah dauhen: Mihon adih tia ahol tenguleh, Christa chu chondih ahi banga amaho chondih a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi.
en: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
text:
1JN 3:7
Thadou: Cha deitahte, hiche chungchang thu'ah koiman nalhep lhah dauhen: Mihon adih tia ahol tenguleh, Christa chu chondih ahi banga amaho chondih a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi.
English: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

tcz: Hinlah miho chu achonset jom jing tenguleh amaho chu Diabol a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi. Ama chu atil abula pat'a anachonse peh ahi. Hinlah Diabol natoh ho sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung anahi.
en: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.
text:
1JN 3:8
Thadou: Hinlah miho chu achonset jom jing tenguleh amaho chu Diabol a ahiuve ti avetsah ahi. Ama chu atil abula pat'a anachonse peh ahi. Hinlah Diabol natoh ho sumang dinga Pathen Chapa hung anahi.
English: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

tcz: Pathen insung mia peng ho chun chonset aboljom jing pouve, Pathena hinna chu amahoa um ahijeh ahi.
en: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
text:
1JN 3:9
Thadou: Pathen insung mia peng ho chun chonset aboljom jing pouve, Pathena hinna chu amahoa um ahijeh ahi.
English: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

tcz: Hitichun, tun koiho hi Pathen chate hiuva chule koiho chu Diabol chate hiuvem ti iseithei tauve. Koi hileh chonphatna a hinglouho chule midang tahsan chankhompi ngailulou ho chu Pathena ahipouve.
en: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.
text:
1JN 3:10
Thadou: Hitichun, tun koiho hi Pathen chate hiuva chule koiho chu Diabol chate hiuvem ti iseithei tauve. Koi hileh chonphatna a hinglouho chule midang tahsan chankhompi ngailulou ho chu Pathena ahipouve.
English: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

tcz: Hiche hi atil abula pat a nana jahsau chu ahi: Eiho khatle khat ikingailut dingu hi ahi.
en: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—
text:
1JN 3:11
Thadou: Hiche hi atil abula pat a nana jahsau chu ahi: Eiho khatle khat ikingailut dingu hi ahi.
English: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

tcz: Eiho Cain tobanga agilouva ihipouve, ama chun asopipa anatha ahi: Ipi jeh a atha hintem? Ajeh chu Cain chun aphalou abola chule asopipa chun chonphat abol jeh ahi.
en: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
text:
1JN 3:12
Thadou: Eiho Cain tobanga agilouva ihipouve, ama chun asopipa anatha ahi: Ipi jeh a atha hintem? Ajeh chu Cain chun aphalou abola chule asopipa chun chonphat abol jeh ahi.
English: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

tcz: Hijehchun, sopi deitah te, vannoiyin nahot uva ahileh datmo hih un!
en: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.
text:
1JN 3:13
Thadou: Hijehchun, sopi deitah te, vannoiyin nahot uva ahileh datmo hih un!
English: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

tcz: Eihon Christian isopihou ingailut u ahileh, eiho thinaa kona hinna a galkai ihitauve. Hinlah ngailutna neilou chu athisa ahi.
en: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.
text:
1JN 3:14
Thadou: Eihon Christian isopihou ingailut u ahileh, eiho thinaa kona hinna a galkai ihitauve. Hinlah ngailutna neilou chu athisa ahi.
English: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

tcz: Koi hileh sopi michom khat hotbola chu alung sunga tolthat ahitai chule tolthat ho chun asunguva Tonsot Hinna aneipouve.
en: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.
text:
1JN 3:15
Thadou: Koi hileh sopi michom khat hotbola chu alung sunga tolthat ahitai chule tolthat ho chun asunguva Tonsot Hinna aneipouve.
English: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

tcz: Eihon ngailutna atahbeh ipiham ti iheuve, ajeh chu Yeshuan eiho dinga ahinna chu ahung pehdohsa ahitai.
en: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
text:
1JN 3:16
Thadou: Eihon ngailutna atahbeh ipiham ti iheuve, ajeh chu Yeshuan eiho dinga ahinna chu ahung pehdohsa ahitai.
English: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.
