tcz: Koiham khat chun sum neihen lang sopinu ahilouleh sopipan angaichat he hen lang, hinlah khotona neitahih leh–hichepa chu Pathen ngailutna a iti umthei ding ham?
en: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?
text:
1JN 3:17
Thadou: Koiham khat chun sum neihen lang sopinu ahilouleh sopipan angaichat he hen lang, hinlah khotona neitahih leh–hichepa chu Pathen ngailutna a iti umthei ding ham?
English: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

tcz: Kacha deitahte, eiho khat le khat ikingailu uve tin sei maimai pouhite, atahbeh chu ichonnauva vetsah u hite.
en: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.
text:
1JN 3:18
Thadou: Kacha deitahte, eiho khat le khat ikingailu uve tin sei maimai pouhite, atahbeh chu ichonnauva vetsah u hite.
English: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

tcz: Ichonnauvin thutah'a hinga ihiu avetsah ding ahi, hitia chu Pathen masanga idin tenguleh lungngam tah a ium dingu ahi.
en: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,
text:
1JN 3:19
Thadou: Ichonnauvin thutah'a hinga ihiu avetsah ding ahi, hitia chu Pathen masanga idin tenguleh lungngam tah a ium dingu ahi.
English: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

tcz: Ikithemmo channau aum jeng jongleh Pathen chu eimaho lunggel sanga lenjoa ahijeh'in ijakai Aman ahet ahinai.
en: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
text:
1JN 3:20
Thadou: Ikithemmo channau aum jeng jongleh Pathen chu eimaho lunggel sanga lenjoa ahijeh'in ijakai Aman ahet ahinai.
English: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

tcz: Kagol ngaitahte, eimahon kithemmo channa ineilouva ahileh, Pathen komchu lungngam tah a inailut theiyu ahi.
en: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

tcz: Chule ipi hijeng jongleh ithum chanu chu Amaa kona imuthei dingu ahi, ajeh chu eihon Ama sei ingaiyuvin, chule Ama lunglhaina chu ibolun ahi.
en: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.
text:
1JN 3:22
Thadou: Chule ipi hijeng jongleh ithum chanu chu Amaa kona imuthei dingu ahi, ajeh chu eihon Ama sei ingaiyuvin, chule Ama lunglhaina chu ibolun ahi.
English: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

tcz: Chule hiche hi Ama thupeh ho ahi: Eihon Achapa Yeshua Christa itahsan uva chule Aman eithupeh banguva eiho khat le khat ikingailut dingu ahije.
en: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.
text:
1JN 3:23
Thadou: Chule hiche hi Ama thupeh ho ahi: Eihon Achapa Yeshua Christa itahsan uva chule Aman eithupeh banguva eiho khat le khat ikingailut dingu ahije.
English: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

tcz: Pathen Thupeh ho nit a juiho chu: Amatoh kiloikhom ahiuvin, chule Ama jong amahoa chu uma ahi. Chule eihon eihoa Ama aume ti iheuve, ajeh chu Aman Lhagao eipeh u chu isunguva achengin ahi.
en: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.
text:
1JN 3:24
Thadou: Pathen Thupeh ho nit a juiho chu: Amatoh kiloikhom ahiuvin, chule Ama jong amahoa chu uma ahi. Chule eihon eihoa Ama aume ti iheuve, ajeh chu Aman Lhagao eipeh u chu isunguva achengin ahi.
English: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

tcz: Deitah teho, Lhagaovin aseisah dana thuseiya kingaito koi koi hijongleh tahsan hih un. Nanghon amaho hung konna lhagao chu Pathen akon hinam ti patepna nei masauvin. Ajeh iham itileh themgao lhem tamtah vannoiya aumtai.
en: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
text:
1JN 4:1
Thadou: Deitah teho, Lhagaovin aseisah dana thuseiya kingaito koi koi hijongleh tahsan hih un. Nanghon amaho hung konna lhagao chu Pathen akon hinam ti patepna nei masauvin. Ajeh iham itileh themgao lhem tamtah vannoiya aumtai.
English: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

tcz: Hiche hi eihon Pathen Lhagao ineiyu kihetna ding ahi. Mikhat chu themgao hia akiseiya Yeshua Christa chu tahsaphe le vou pun ahunge ti aphondoh a ahileh hiche michun Pathen Lhagao anei ahi.
en: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,
text:
1JN 4:2
Thadou: Hiche hi eihon Pathen Lhagao ineiyu kihetna ding ahi. Mikhat chu themgao hia akiseiya Yeshua Christa chu tahsaphe le vou pun ahunge ti aphondoh a ahileh hiche michun Pathen Lhagao anei ahi.
English: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

tcz: Hinlah koi hamkhat chun themgao kahi tia akiseidoh a ahiala Yeshua chung chang thudih chu aphondoh louva ahileh, hichepa kiphondohna themgao kahi tia akisei chu Pathen a kon ahipoi. Hitobang michu Christa dou lhagao vannoiya hung ding ahi tia kisei najah u chule hichea hi uma ahitai ti nahetna dinguva ahi.
en: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.
text:
1JN 4:3
Thadou: Hinlah koi hamkhat chun themgao kahi tia akiseidoh a ahiala Yeshua chung chang thudih chu aphondoh louva ahileh, hichepa kiphondohna themgao kahi tia akisei chu Pathen a kon ahipoi. Hitobang michu Christa dou lhagao vannoiya hung ding ahi tia kisei najah u chule hichea hi uma ahitai ti nahetna dinguva ahi.
English: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

tcz: Hinlah nangho Pathen a nahiu ahitai, kacha ngaitah teho, nanghon hiche mite hi najosau ahitai, ajeh chu nasung uva cheng Lhagao chu vannoiya cheng lhagao sanga chu lenjoa ahi.
en: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
text:
1JN 4:4
Thadou: Hinlah nangho Pathen a nahiu ahitai, kacha ngaitah teho, nanghon hiche mite hi najosau ahitai, ajeh chu nasung uva cheng Lhagao chu vannoiya cheng lhagao sanga chu lenjoa ahi.
English: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

tcz: Amaho chu vannoiya hiuva ahin, hijeh a chu vannoi lunggellam thua aseidoh jiu ahin, chule vannoiyin aseiyu angaiyu ahi.
en: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.
text:
1JN 4:5
Thadou: Amaho chu vannoiya hiuva ahin, hijeh a chu vannoi lunggellam thua aseidoh jiu ahin, chule vannoiyin aseiyu angaiyu ahi.
English: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

tcz: Hinlah eiho Pathen a ihiuve, chule Pathen heho chun eiho sei angaiyuve. Hiche hi mikhat chun thutah lhagao aneiham, ahilouva ahileh lheplhahna lhagao changa ham ti ihetnau ahiye.
en: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
text:
1JN 4:6
Thadou: Hinlah eiho Pathen a ihiuve, chule Pathen heho chun eiho sei angaiyuve. Hiche hi mikhat chun thutah lhagao aneiham, ahilouva ahileh lheplhahna lhagao changa ham ti ihetnau ahiye.
English: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

tcz: Deitah teho, eiho kingailu jom jingu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna neija chu Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna nei chu Pathen cha ahin chule Pathen ahei.
en: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
text:
1JN 4:7
Thadou: Deitah teho, eiho kingailu jom jingu hite, ajeh chu ngailut hi Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna neija chu Pathen a kon ahi. Koi hitaleh ngailutna nei chu Pathen cha ahin chule Pathen ahei.
English: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

tcz: Hinlah koi hitaleh ngailutna neilou chun Pathen ahetlou ahi. Ajeh iham itileh Pathen chu ngailut ahi.
en: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
text:
1JN 4:8
Thadou: Hinlah koi hitaleh ngailutna neilou chun Pathen ahetlou ahi. Ajeh iham itileh Pathen chu ngailut ahi.
English: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

tcz: Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam ti eivetsahnau chu Achapa chang khatseh chu vannoiya hi ahinsol ahitai, hitia chu Ama jal a eihon tonsot hinna ineitheina dingu ahi.
en: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.
text:
1JN 4:9
Thadou: Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut'u hitam ti eivetsahnau chu Achapa chang khatseh chu vannoiya hi ahinsol ahitai, hitia chu Ama jal a eihon tonsot hinna ineitheina dingu ahi.
English: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

tcz: Hiche hi ngailutna tahbeh ahi–eimahon Pathen ingailut u ahipoi, hinlah Aman eiho eingailut uva chule ichonsetnau chu lahmangna dinga Achapa chu maichama ahin katdoh ahitai.
en: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
text:
1JN 4:10
Thadou: Hiche hi ngailutna tahbeh ahi–eimahon Pathen ingailut u ahipoi, hinlah Aman eiho eingailut uva chule ichonsetnau chu lahmangna dinga Achapa chu maichama ahin katdoh ahitai.
English: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

tcz: Deitah teho, Pathen in hichan geiya hi eingailut'u ahijeh'in, eiho khatle khat ikingailut diu ahi.
en: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.
text:
1JN 4:11
Thadou: Deitah teho, Pathen in hichan geiya hi eingailut'u ahijeh'in, eiho khatle khat ikingailut diu ahi.
English: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

tcz: Koimachan itih in jong Pathen amukhapoi. Hinlah eimaho khatle khat ikingailut touva ahileh Pathen chu eihoa uma chule Ami ngailutna chu eiho akiphondoh na ihiu ahi.
en: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.
text:
1JN 4:12
Thadou: Koimachan itih in jong Pathen amukhapoi. Hinlah eimaho khatle khat ikingailut touva ahileh Pathen chu eihoa uma chule Ami ngailutna chu eiho akiphondoh na ihiu ahi.
English: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

tcz: Chule Pathen in a Lhagao eipeh u hi eiho Ama a ihingun chule Ama eihoa aume, ti photchenna ahi.
en: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
text:
1JN 4:13
Thadou: Chule Pathen in a Lhagao eipeh u hi eiho Ama a ihingun chule Ama eihoa aume, ti photchenna ahi.
English: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

tcz: Chukalval in, eimahon imit tah uvin imuvin chule tun Pa chun Chapa hi vannoi huhhingpu dinga ahinsol ahi ti iphongdoh theiyun ahi.
en: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.
text:
1JN 4:14
Thadou: Chukalval in, eimahon imit tah uvin imuvin chule tun Pa chun Chapa hi vannoi huhhingpu dinga ahinsol ahi ti iphongdoh theiyun ahi.
English: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

tcz: Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi tia akama phongdoh ho chu asunguva Pathen chenga ahin, chule amaho Pathen a hinga ahiuve.
en: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.
text:
1JN 4:15
Thadou: Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi tia akama phongdoh ho chu asunguva Pathen chenga ahin, chule amaho Pathen a hinga ahiuve.
English: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

tcz: Eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut u hitam ti iheuve chule eihon Angailutna tahsanna chu ineitauve. Pathen hi ngailut ahi chule ngailutnaa hing jouse chu Pathena hinga chule Pathen asunguva uma ahi.
en: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
text:
1JN 4:16
Thadou: Eihon Pathen in ichan geiya eingailut u hitam ti iheuve chule eihon Angailutna tahsanna chu ineitauve. Pathen hi ngailut ahi chule ngailutnaa hing jouse chu Pathena hinga chule Pathen asunguva uma ahi.
English: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

tcz: Chule eiho Pathena ihin jeh uva, ingailutnau chamkim cheh na dinga khang khang jing ahi. Hitia hi thutanna nikhoa jong kichatna ineilou dingu ahi. Chusanga lung ngamna neiya Ama kimupina ineitheiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho hiche vannoiya hi Yeshua tobanga ihinu ahitai.
en: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.
text:
1JN 4:17
Thadou: Chule eiho Pathena ihin jeh uva, ingailutnau chamkim cheh na dinga khang khang jing ahi. Hitia hi thutanna nikhoa jong kichatna ineilou dingu ahi. Chusanga lung ngamna neiya Ama kimupina ineitheiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho hiche vannoiya hi Yeshua tobanga ihinu ahitai.
English: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

tcz: Hitobang ngailutna hin kichatna aneipoi, ajeh chu ngailutna bulhingset chun kichat chu anodoh ahi. Eihon kichatna ineiyuleh gimbolna chan ding kichat jal ahi, chule hiche hin Angailutna bulhingset in ihechen hih laiyuve ti avetsahna ahi.
en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
text:
1JN 4:18
Thadou: Hitobang ngailutna hin kichatna aneipoi, ajeh chu ngailutna bulhingset chun kichat chu anodoh ahi. Eihon kichatna ineiyuleh gimbolna chan ding kichat jal ahi, chule hiche hin Angailutna bulhingset in ihechen hih laiyuve ti avetsahna ahi.
English: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

tcz: Aman eingailut masat jeh uvin eihon Pathen ingailuve.
en: We love him, because he first loved us.
text:
1JN 4:19
Thadou: Aman eingailut masat jeh uvin eihon Pathen ingailuve.
English: We love him, because he first loved us.

tcz: Koiham khat in, “Keiman Pathen kangailui,” ti hen, hinlah Christian sopi khat chu hotbol taleh, hichepa chu mijou ahi, ajeh chu eihon imutheiyu miho ingailut louva ahileh, imuthei lou u Pathen chu iti ingailut dingu ham?
en: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
text:
1JN 4:20
Thadou: Koiham khat in, “Keiman Pathen kangailui,” ti hen, hinlah Christian sopi khat chu hotbol taleh, hichepa chu mijou ahi, ajeh chu eihon imutheiyu miho ingailut louva ahileh, imuthei lou u Pathen chu iti ingailut dingu ham?
English: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

tcz: Chule Aman hiche thupeh hi eipeuve, hichu-Pathen ngailuhon a Christian chanpiu sopiho chu angailut dingu ahi.
en: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.
text:
1JN 4:21
Thadou: Chule Aman hiche thupeh hi eipeuve, hichu-Pathen ngailuhon a Christian chanpiu sopiho chu angailut dingu ahi.
English: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

tcz: Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahi ti tahsana chu Pathen cha ahitai. Chule koi hileh Pa ngailua chun Achate jong angailut ding ahi.
en: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.
text:
1JN 5:1
Thadou: Koi hileh Yeshua chu Christa ahi ti tahsana chu Pathen cha ahitai. Chule koi hileh Pa ngailua chun Achate jong angailut ding ahi.
English: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

tcz: Eihon Pathen ingailut uva chule Athupeh ho init uva ahileh Pathen chate ingailuve ti iheuve.
en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
text:
1JN 5:2
Thadou: Eihon Pathen ingailut uva chule Athupeh ho init uva ahileh Pathen chate ingailuve ti iheuve.
English: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

tcz: Pathen ngailut kiti hi Athupeh ho nit hi ahi. Chule Athupeh ho chu pohgih ahipoi.
en: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
text:
1JN 5:3
Thadou: Pathen ngailut kiti hi Athupeh ho nit hi ahi. Chule Athupeh ho chu pohgih ahipoi.
English: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

tcz: Ajeh chu Pathen chate tapou chun hiche vannoi gitlouna hi ajo ahitai, chule hiche jona chu itahsan jal'u ahi.
en: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.
text:
1JN 5:4
Thadou: Ajeh chu Pathen chate tapou chun hiche vannoi gitlouna hi ajo ahitai, chule hiche jona chu itahsan jal'u ahi.
English: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

tcz: Chule hiche vannoi douna a kisatna hi koiyin ajoding ham? Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi ti tahsan ho bouvin ajo ahi.
en: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?
text:
1JN 5:5
Thadou: Chule hiche vannoi douna a kisatna hi koiyin ajoding ham? Yeshua hi Pathen Chapa ahi ti tahsan ho bouvin ajo ahi.
English: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

tcz: Chule Yeshua Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahina kiphonna chu twiya baptize channa le Thingpel chunga athisan sonajeh jal ahi, twisih jengseh a hilouvin, twi le thisan jal ahi. Chule Lhagao jong chun hichu ahettohsah in adih ahi ati.
en: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.
text:
1JN 5:6
Thadou: Chule Yeshua Christa chu Pathen Chapa ahina kiphonna chu twiya baptize channa le Thingpel chunga athisan sonajeh jal ahi, twisih jengseh a hilouvin, twi le thisan jal ahi. Chule Lhagao jong chun hichu ahettohsah in adih ahi ati.
English: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

tcz: Hitichun, eihon hiche hettohsahna thum hohi ineiyuve–
en: For there are three who testify:
text:
1JN 5:7
Thadou: Hitichun, eihon hiche hettohsahna thum hohi ineiyuve–
English: For there are three who testify:

tcz: Lhagao, Twi, chule Thisan–Chule hiche thum hohi khat ahiuve.
en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.
text:
1JN 5:8
Thadou: Lhagao, Twi, chule Thisan–Chule hiche thum hohi khat ahiuve.
English: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

tcz: Eihon mihem hettohsahna itahsan uva ahileh, Pathena kona hettohsahna chu iha tahsan cheh dingu hiya ahi. Chule Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahitai.
en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.
text:
1JN 5:9
Thadou: Eihon mihem hettohsahna itahsan uva ahileh, Pathena kona hettohsahna chu iha tahsan cheh dingu hiya ahi. Chule Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah ahitai.
English: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

tcz: Pathen Chapa tahsan jouse chun alung sunguva hiche hettohsahna hi adih ahi ti itahsanuve. Hiche tahsan lou ho chun Pathen chu ajouve tia aseiyu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah chu atahsan lou jeh u ahi.
en: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.
text:
1JN 5:10
Thadou: Pathen Chapa tahsan jouse chun alung sunguva hiche hettohsahna hi adih ahi ti itahsanuve. Hiche tahsan lou ho chun Pathen chu ajouve tia aseiyu ahi, ajeh chu Pathen in Achapa thudol ahettohsah chu atahsan lou jeh u ahi.
English: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

tcz: Chule Pathen in ahettohsahna chu hiche hi ahi: Aman tonsot hinna eipetauve, chule hiche Hinna chu Achapa koma uma ahi.
en: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
text:
1JN 5:11
Thadou: Chule Pathen in ahettohsahna chu hiche hi ahi: Aman tonsot hinna eipetauve, chule hiche Hinna chu Achapa koma uma ahi.
English: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

tcz: Koi koi hileh Chapa neiya chun Hinna anei ahitai. Koi koi hijongleh Pathen Chapa neilou chun Hinna aneilou ahi.
en: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
text:
1JN 5:12
Thadou: Koi koi hileh Chapa neiya chun Hinna anei ahitai. Koi koi hijongleh Pathen Chapa neilou chun Hinna aneilou ahi.
English: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

tcz: Pathen Chapa mina tahsan nangho henga hiche hi kahinjih ahitai, hichu Tonsot Hinna nei nahiu nakihetdohna dingu ahi.
en: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.
text:
1JN 5:13
Thadou: Pathen Chapa mina tahsan nangho henga hiche hi kahinjih ahitai, hichu Tonsot Hinna nei nahiu nakihetdohna dingu ahi.
English: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

tcz: Chule Aman ipi hijongleh alunglhaina hoa ithum chanu chu eingaipeh uve ti tahsanna ineiyuve.
en: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
text:
1JN 5:14
Thadou: Chule Aman ipi hijongleh alunglhaina hoa ithum chanu chu eingaipeh uve ti tahsanna ineiyuve.
English: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

tcz: Chule eihon ithum tenguleh Aman eingaipeh uve ti ihettahjeh uvin ipi hijongleh Aman eipeh dingu ahi tijong iheuve.
en: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.
text:
1JN 5:15
Thadou: Chule eihon ithum tenguleh Aman eingaipeh uve ti ihettahjeh uvin ipi hijongleh Aman eipeh dingu ahi tijong iheuve.
English: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

tcz: Nangman Christian sopi khat chun thina khop chonsetna hilou abol namua ahileh nataopeh ding ahi, chule Pathen in ama chu ahinsah ding ahi. Hinlah chonsetna thina khop geiya bol'ah aume chule keiman chutobang bol ho dingin taovin kati ahipoi.
en: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.
text:
1JN 5:16
Thadou: Nangman Christian sopi khat chun thina khop chonsetna hilou abol namua ahileh nataopeh ding ahi, chule Pathen in ama chu ahinsah ding ahi. Hinlah chonsetna thina khop geiya bol'ah aume chule keiman chutobang bol ho dingin taovin kati ahipoi.
English: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

tcz: Gitlou boljouse hi chonset ahi, hinlah chonset kitipou chun thina a apuilutpoi.
en: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.
text:
1JN 5:17
Thadou: Gitlou boljouse hi chonset ahi, hinlah chonset kitipou chun thina a apuilutpoi.
English: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

tcz: Eiho Pathen chaten chonset boljom jingna aneipoi ti iheuve, ajeh chu Pathen Chapan amaho chu akolchah a ahuhbit u ahi chule Agiloupa chun amaho atong khapoi.
en: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.
text:
1JN 5:18
Thadou: Eiho Pathen chaten chonset boljom jingna aneipoi ti iheuve, ajeh chu Pathen Chapan amaho chu akolchah a ahuhbit u ahi chule Agiloupa chun amaho atong khapoi.
English: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

tcz: Eiho Pathen chate ihiuve chule vannoi ikimveluva umhi Agiloupa thuneina noiya uma ahi ti iheuve.
en: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.
text:
1JN 5:19
Thadou: Eiho Pathen chate ihiuve chule vannoi ikimveluva umhi Agiloupa thuneina noiya uma ahi ti iheuve.
English: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

tcz: Chule Pathen Chapa chu ana hunga chule hetkhen themna chu eihungpeh u ahitai-chutia chu eihon Pathen dihtah chu ihettheiyu ahi ti iheuve. Chule tua hi eiho Pathen dihtah toh ihinkhom theiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho Achapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhom ihitauve. Ama chu Pathen dihtah le Tonsot Hinna ahi.
en: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
text:
1JN 5:20
Thadou: Chule Pathen Chapa chu ana hunga chule hetkhen themna chu eihungpeh u ahitai-chutia chu eihon Pathen dihtah chu ihettheiyu ahi ti iheuve. Chule tua hi eiho Pathen dihtah toh ihinkhom theiyu ahitai, ajeh chu eiho Achapa Yeshua Christa toh kiloikhom ihitauve. Ama chu Pathen dihtah le Tonsot Hinna ahi.
English: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

tcz: Chapang deitahte, nalunguva Pathen munlothei ding ipi hita jongleh hia kon chun kikhin mangun.
en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.
text:
1JN 5:21
Thadou: Chapang deitahte, nalunguva Pathen munlothei ding ipi hita jongleh hia kon chun kikhin mangun.
English: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman thutah'a kangailut, lhendoh numei Ja-umnu le achate chule keima jengseh hilouva, thutah heho jouse hetdia jong kajih ahi.
en: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,
text:
2JN 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman thutah'a kangailut, lhendoh numei Ja-umnu le achate chule keima jengseh hilouva, thutah heho jouse hetdia jong kajih ahi.
English: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

tcz: Ajeh chu thutah chu isunguva chenga chule eihotoh atonsot a umjing ding ahi.
en: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
text:
2JN 1:2
Thadou: Ajeh chu thutah chu isunguva chenga chule eihotoh atonsot a umjing ding ahi.
English: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

tcz: Pa Pathen le Achapa Pakai Yeshua Christa a hungkon–ngailutna le thutah'a ilah uva umjing ding, Lungset, hepi, chule Cham-lungmon chun naumpi jinguhen.
en: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
text:
2JN 1:3
Thadou: Pa Pathen le Achapa Pakai Yeshua Christa a hungkon–ngailutna le thutah'a ilah uva umjing ding, Lungset, hepi, chule Cham-lungmon chun naumpi jinguhen.
English: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

tcz: Pa chun athupeh bang tah a nachateu phabep thutah dungjuiya hinkho aman jal'in kakipapi lheh jenge.
en: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
text:
2JN 1:4
Thadou: Pa chun athupeh bang tah a nachateu phabep thutah dungjuiya hinkho aman jal'in kakipapi lheh jenge.
English: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

tcz: Keiman nangma numei ja-umnu kahin geldohsah naa kajih ahi, eiho khatle khat kingailua ium dingu ahi. Hiche thupeh thah ahipoi, hinlah atil abul'a pat'a inanei jingu chu ahi.
en: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
text:
2JN 1:5
Thadou: Keiman nangma numei ja-umnu kahin geldohsah naa kajih ahi, eiho khatle khat kingailua ium dingu ahi. Hiche thupeh thah ahipoi, hinlah atil abul'a pat'a inanei jingu chu ahi.
English: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

tcz: Hiche kaseina jeh chu, vannoiya hin milhemlha tampi asohdoh tauve. Amaho chun Yeshua Christa hi tahsaphea hung tahbeh ahi ti asei le pouve. Hitobang mi chu milhemlha le Christa dou ahi.
en: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
text:
2JN 1:7
Thadou: Hiche kaseina jeh chu, vannoiya hin milhemlha tampi asohdoh tauve. Amaho chun Yeshua Christa hi tahsaphea hung tahbeh ahi ti asei le pouve. Hitobang mi chu milhemlha le Christa dou ahi.
English: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

tcz: Kihong phauvin, hahsatah a nahin neidoh u chu namansah louna dinguvin. Chingtheiyun, chutileh abulhingset a tohman namu dingu ahi.
en: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
text:
2JN 1:8
Thadou: Kihong phauvin, hahsatah a nahin neidoh u chu namansah louna dinguvin. Chingtheiyun, chutileh abulhingset a tohman namu dingu ahi.
English: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

tcz: Koi hijongleh hiche thuhila kona vahmang ho chu Pathen to kijopmat lou ahiuve. Hinlah koi hijongleh Christa thuhila umjing ho chu Pa le Chapa to kigui jop jingna nei ahitai.
en: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
text:
2JN 1:9
Thadou: Koi hijongleh hiche thuhila kona vahmang ho chu Pathen to kijopmat lou ahiuve. Hinlah koi hijongleh Christa thuhila umjing ho chu Pa le Chapa to kigui jop jingna nei ahitai.
English: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

tcz: Koiham khattou hijongleh nakikhop khom nauva ahunga Christa thuhil thutah chu akalea ahil leh hitobang mi chu na in'a kou hih in, ahilouleh tilkhouna ima neihih un.
en: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
text:
2JN 1:10
Thadou: Koiham khattou hijongleh nakikhop khom nauva ahunga Christa thuhil thutah chu akalea ahil leh hitobang mi chu na in'a kou hih in, ahilouleh tilkhouna ima neihih un.
English: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

tcz: Hitobang mi ho tilkhouva chu koi hijongleh anatoh phalouva chu chan aneikhomu ahitai.
en: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
text:
2JN 1:11
Thadou: Hitobang mi ho tilkhouva chu koi hijongleh anatoh phalouva chu chan aneikhomu ahitai.
English: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

tcz: Keiman nangho koma thutampi seibe ding kanei nalaiye, hinlah keiman lekhapeh le lekha-twiyin kajih nompoi. Ajeh chu keiman nangho hung muloi ding kakinepna ahi. Chule kimaitoa nangho to kihoulim ding kanom'e. Chutengleh ikinepnau chamkim tante.
en: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
text:
2JN 1:12
Thadou: Keiman nangho koma thutampi seibe ding kanei nalaiye, hinlah keiman lekhapeh le lekha-twiyin kajih nompoi. Ajeh chu keiman nangho hung muloi ding kakinepna ahi. Chule kimaitoa nangho to kihoulim ding kanom'e. Chutengleh ikinepnau chamkim tante.
English: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

tcz: Pathen lhendoh nasopinu chatea konin chibai kahinpeuve.
en: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
text:
2JN 1:13
Thadou: Pathen lhendoh nasopinu chatea konin chibai kahinpeuve.
English: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman kagol ngaitah, Gaius, thutah'a kangailut henga kajih ahi.
en: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.
text:
3JN 1:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi upa John a kon ahi. Keiman kagol ngaitah, Gaius, thutah'a kangailut henga kajih ahi.

en: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.
text:
REV 2:17

tcz: Keiman nathilbol ho jouse kahei. Keiman nangailutna, natahsanna, nalhacha natohna, chule thohhattah a napanna kahenai. Keiman nangma imalam jousea namachal jingna ho kahenai.
en: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.
text:
REV 2:19
Thadou: Keiman nathilbol ho jouse kahei. Keiman nangailutna, natahsanna, nalhacha natohna, chule thohhattah a napanna kahenai. Keiman nangma imalam jousea namachal jingna ho kahenai.

tcz: Hinlah keiman nachunga lunglhai louna hiche hi kaneiye. Nangman chuche numeinu–Jezebel amatah themgao nua kisei chun kasoh ho apui lamvaiyin ahi. Amanu hin jonthanhoi boldingin thu ahil in chule milim houna a kikatdoh anneh anehsah e.
en: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
text:
REV 2:20
Thadou: Hinlah keiman nachunga lunglhai louna hiche hi kaneiye. Nangman chuche numeinu–Jezebel amatah themgao nua kisei chun kasoh ho apui lamvaiyin ahi. Amanu hin jonthanhoi boldingin thu ahil in chule milim houna a kikatdoh anneh anehsah e.

tcz: Keiman amanu akisihna ding phat kapen, hinla amanu themlouna a konin akiheimang nompon ahi.
en: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
text:
REV 2:21
Thadou: Keiman amanu akisihna ding phat kapen, hinla amanu themlouna a konin akiheimang nompon ahi.
English: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

tcz: Hijeh a chu keiman amanu hi gimthohna jalkhun'a kalelut ding ahi. Chule aman ajonpi ho chu akisihlouva chuleh athilsebolnaa kona alung aheilouva ahileh gimthohna nasatah athoh dingu ahi.
en: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
text:
REV 2:22
Thadou: Hijeh a chu keiman amanu hi gimthohna jalkhun'a kalelut ding ahi. Chule aman ajonpi ho chu akisihlouva chuleh athilsebolnaa kona alung aheilouva ahileh gimthohna nasatah athoh dingu ahi.
English: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

tcz: Keiman amanu achate kavoh a thidiu ahi. Chutengleh houbung hon keima hi lunggel jouse le amichang cheh lung ngaito Hepa kahi hi ahet dingu ahi.
en: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.
text:
REV 2:23
Thadou: Keiman amanu achate kavoh a thidiu ahi. Chutengleh houbung hon keima hi lunggel jouse le amichang cheh lung ngaito Hepa kahi hi ahet dingu ahi.
English: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

tcz: Hinlah keiman jong Thyatira khopia cheng, hiche thuhil dihlou juilouho dinga jong thulhut ding kaneiye. Hiche kalval keiman nanghoa ngehbe nei ponge.
en: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.
text:
REV 2:24
Thadou: Hinlah keiman jong Thyatira khopia cheng, hiche thuhil dihlou juilouho dinga jong thulhut ding kaneiye. Hiche kalval keiman nanghoa ngehbe nei ponge.
English: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

tcz: Keima kahung masangsea naneisunu chu nakituhchah dingu bou hi ahi.
en: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
text:
REV 2:25
Thadou: Keima kahung masangsea naneisunu chu nakituhchah dingu bou hi ahi.
English: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

tcz: Kasei achaina geiya ngaiho jona neijouse dinga chu chitin namtin chunga thuneina kapeh ding ahi.
en: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.
text:
REV 2:26
Thadou: Kasei achaina geiya ngaiho jona neijouse dinga chu chitin namtin chunga thuneina kapeh ding ahi.
English: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

tcz: Amaho chun chitin namtin chunga thih tenggola vai ahom ding chule leibel banga amaho chu avohchip ding ahi.
en: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

text:
REV 2:29

tcz: Hiche lekhathot hi Sardis khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi neiya chule ahsi sagi neipa thulhut chu ahi. “Keiman nathilbol jouse, chule ahinga minchena jouse naneiye ti kahei-hinla nangma athi nahi.”
en: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
text:
REV 3:1
Thadou: Hiche lekhathot hi Sardis khopi sunga um houbunga Thupo henga hitin sun in. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi neiya chule ahsi sagi neipa thulhut chu ahi. “Keiman nathilbol jouse, chule ahinga minchena jouse naneiye ti kahei-hinla nangma athi nahi.”
English: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

tcz: “Khangdoh in! Amohthem aumden ho suhat'in, ajeh chu amoh them umdenho jeng jong hi athikon cha ahitauve. Ijeh ham itileh nachonna ho hi Pathen mitmun thutah to akigamlat lheh jenge.
en: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
text:
REV 3:2
Thadou: “Khangdoh in! Amohthem aumden ho suhat'in, ajeh chu amoh them umdenho jeng jong hi athikon cha ahitauve. Ijeh ham itileh nachonna ho hi Pathen mitmun thutah to akigamlat lheh jenge.
English: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

tcz: Nangman najah sa, chule natahsan masah achun umdenin. Kisih in chule kaheng lama hung kihei kit in. Nangma nakhahdoh kitlouva ahileh keima phulou helouva naginchat loupet tahle gucha tobanga kahung ding ahi.
en: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
text:
REV 3:3
Thadou: Nangman najah sa, chule natahsan masah achun umdenin. Kisih in chule kaheng lama hung kihei kit in. Nangma nakhahdoh kitlouva ahileh keima phulou helouva naginchat loupet tahle gucha tobanga kahung ding ahi.
English: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

tcz: Chuti jongleh, Sardis houbung a aponsilu gitlouna a kisubohlou miphabep aumuve. Amaho chu kilomtah ahijeh uva keima toh ponbang kisila vahle ding ahiuve.
en: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
text:
REV 3:4
Thadou: Chuti jongleh, Sardis houbung a aponsilu gitlouna a kisubohlou miphabep aumuve. Amaho chu kilomtah ahijeh uva keima toh ponbang kisila vahle ding ahiuve.
English: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

tcz: Jona neijouse chu ponbang kisila vahle cheh ding ahiuve. Keiman aminu chu Hinna Lekhabua kanoimang louhel ding, chusanga keiman aminu chu Kapa angsunga le Vantilte masanga keiya ahiuve tia kaphondoh ding ahi.
en: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
text:
REV 3:5
Thadou: Jona neijouse chu ponbang kisila vahle cheh ding ahiuve. Keiman aminu chu Hinna Lekhabua kanoimang louhel ding, chusanga keiman aminu chu Kapa angsunga le Vantilte masanga keiya ahiuve tia kaphondoh ding ahi.

en: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

REV 3:8

tcz: Ven, Satan kikhopna a jaoho–jousei Juda mi kahi tia ahivanga hilou ho, chu ada achamlouva amaho chu ahunguva chule nakengphang bul'a kakunsah ding ahiuve. Amahon nangma kangailut nahi ti hetsahna aphondoh thei dingu ahi.
en: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
text:
REV 3:9
Thadou: Ven, Satan kikhopna a jaoho–jousei Juda mi kahi tia ahivanga hilou ho, chu ada achamlouva amaho chu ahunguva chule nakengphang bul'a kakunsah ding ahiuve. Amahon nangma kangailut nahi ti hetsahna aphondoh thei dingu ahi.
English: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

tcz: Ajeh chu nangman kathupeh ho thohhattah a najui ahijeh'in, vannoi pumpi a patepna khoh chungnung hiche vannoiya hiho dinga hung ding patepna akona kahoidoh ding nahi.
en: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
text:
REV 3:10
Thadou: Ajeh chu nangman kathupeh ho thohhattah a najui ahijeh'in, vannoi pumpi a patepna khoh chungnung hiche vannoiya hiho dinga hung ding patepna akona kahoidoh ding nahi.
English: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

tcz: Keima ka hungloi ding ahi. Koimachan nalal lukhuh chu nalahpeh louna dingin kolchah jingin.
en: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
text:
REV 3:11

Chule keiman achunguva ka Pathen min kajih ding chule amaho ka Pathen khopi mite hiding ahiuve–Jerusalem thah, vana ka Pathena kona hungkumlha mun'a chu. Chule keiman achunguva kaminthah kasut ding ahi.
en: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
text:
REV 3:12

text:
REV 3:14

tcz: Nangman thil nabol jouse chu kahei, hiti chun nangma sa jong nasapon, votjong navotpoi. Keiman nangma khat joh sang nahi ding chu kadeipeh nahi.
en: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
text:
REV 3:15
Thadou: Nangman thil nabol jouse chu kahei, hiti chun nangma sa jong nasapon, votjong navotpoi. Keiman nangma khat joh sang nahi ding chu kadeipeh nahi.
English: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

tcz: Hinlah nangma twilum tobangbep nahin, sajong salou, votjong votlou nahijeh a kakama kona kaphidoh dingkon nahi.
en: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
text:
REV 3:16
Thadou: Hinlah nangma twilum tobangbep nahin, sajong salou, votjong votlou nahijeh a kakama kona kaphidoh dingkon nahi.
English: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

tcz: Nangman kahaove, kadeichan kaneiyin, imacha kangaichapoi nati. Ahinla nangma adapen, khoto umtah, vaichatah, mitcho chule sagohkeo nahi chu nakihetpoi.
en: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

tcz: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiman nangma kathumop nom chu keiya konin sana kichoh in–Meiya kilhathengsel sana chu kichoh in. Chutengleh nangma nahao ding ahitai. Chujongleh keiya konin ponsil bangleh kichoh in chutengleh sagoh keova naumna chu jahcha taponatin, chule mamit a dinga mitlou jong chu kho namuna hiding ahi.
en: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
text:
REV 3:18
Thadou: Hiti chu ahijeh'in keiman nangma kathumop nom chu keiya konin sana kichoh in–Meiya kilhathengsel sana chu kichoh in. Chutengleh nangma nahao ding ahitai. Chujongleh keiya konin ponsil bangleh kichoh in chutengleh sagoh keova naumna chu jahcha taponatin, chule mamit a dinga mitlou jong chu kho namuna hiding ahi.
English: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

tcz: Keiman kangailut chan kasuhdih jia chule kathunun ji ahi. Hiti chun gunchun chule nalunggel dihlouva konin hung kihei kit'in.
en: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
text:
REV 3:19
Thadou: Keiman kangailut chan kasuhdih jia chule kathunun ji ahi. Hiti chun gunchun chule nalunggel dihlouva konin hung kihei kit'in.
English: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

tcz: Ven! Keima kot'a kadingin chule kot kakiuve. Nangman ka aw najah a chule kot nahon'a ahile keima hunglut ingting chule loi le gol hina a an kaneh khompi ding nahi.
en: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.
text:
REV 3:20
Thadou: Ven! Keima kot'a kadingin chule kot kakiuve. Nangman ka aw najah a chule kot nahon'a ahile keima hunglut ingting chule loi le gol hina a an kaneh khompi ding nahi.
English: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

tcz: Jona neiho chu koikoi hileh keiman jona kaneiya ka-Pa Laltouna a katoukhom banga hi amaho jong chu kalaltouna a katoukhom pi ding ahi.
en: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.
text:
REV 3:21
Thadou: Jona neiho chu koikoi hileh keiman jona kaneiya ka-Pa Laltouna a katoukhom banga hi amaho jong chu kalaltouna a katoukhom pi ding ahi.
English: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

tcz: “Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.”
en: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
text:
REV 3:22
Thadou: “Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.”
English: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

tcz: Chujouvin keiman kavetleh vana kotkhat akihon kamun, chuin aw kana jahsa mama chun kajah a thu asei chu sumkon kimutging toh abangin ahi. Aw chun kajah a, “Hilai muna hungkal touvin, chule keiman hiche jouva ipi hungsoh ding ahi naseipeh inge,” ati.
en: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”
text:
REV 4:1
Thadou: Chujouvin keiman kavetleh vana kotkhat akihon kamun, chuin aw kana jahsa mama chun kajah a thu asei chu sumkon kimutging toh abangin ahi. Aw chun kajah a, “Hilai muna hungkal touvin, chule keiman hiche jouva ipi hungsoh ding ahi naseipeh inge,” ati.
English: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

tcz: Chule apettah chun keima Lhagaovin kaumin, chule van'ah laltouna kamun chuin koiham khat achunga atou kamun ahi.
en: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne
text:
REV 4:2
Thadou: Chule apettah chun keima Lhagaovin kaumin, chule van'ah laltouna kamun chuin koiham khat achunga atou kamun ahi.
English: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

tcz: Laltouna a toupa chu songmantam vah'a vahjenga ahin–songmantam ajempol le asandang tobang ahi. Chule vah hung kikapdoh chu songmantam-eng vallah lah tobang chun Alaltouna kimvel chu lhagui bangin atomin ahi.
en: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.
text:
REV 4:3
Thadou: Laltouna a toupa chu songmantam vah'a vahjenga ahin–songmantam ajempol le asandang tobang ahi. Chule vah hung kikapdoh chu songmantam-eng vallah lah tobang chun Alaltouna kimvel chu lhagui bangin atomin ahi.
English: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

tcz: Laltouna somni le lin Ama akimvel un, chule upa somni le li hia chun atouvui. Amaho chun abonchauvin ponbang akivonun chule aluchunguva sana lallukhuh akikhuh cheh uve.
en: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.
text:
REV 4:4
Thadou: Laltouna somni le lin Ama akimvel un, chule upa somni le li hia chun atouvui. Amaho chun abonchauvin ponbang akivonun chule aluchunguva sana lallukhuh akikhuh cheh uve.
English: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

tcz: Laltouna a konin kolphe le van ginglullul chu ahung kithongdoh in ahi. Chule laltouna masanga meivah sagi meikong banga vah ahungvah in ahi. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi ho chu ahi.
en: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
text:
REV 4:5
Thadou: Laltouna a konin kolphe le van ginglullul chu ahung kithongdoh in ahi. Chule laltouna masanga meivah sagi meikong banga vah ahungvah in ahi. Hiche hi Pathen Lhagao sagi ho chu ahi.
English: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

tcz: Chule Laltouna masanga chun Songval tobanga vah, phatvet twikhanglen valset, kolphemeivah tobang chu ahungvah in: chule Laltouna lailung le akimvel a chun hinnanei li, amasang le anunga amit jeng amitjeng nei chu kamui.
en: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.
text:
REV 4:6
Thadou: Chule Laltouna masanga chun Songval tobanga vah, phatvet twikhanglen valset, kolphemeivah tobang chu ahungvah in: chule Laltouna lailung le akimvel a chun hinnanei li, amasang le anunga amit jeng amitjeng nei chu kamui.
English: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

tcz: Hiche Hinnanei li ho lah a a-khatna chu keipi tobang ahi; a-nina chu bongchal tobang ahi; a-thumna chun mihem mel apui; chule a-lina chu muvanlai lenpet tobang ahi.
en: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
text:
REV 4:7
Thadou: Hiche Hinnanei li ho lah a a-khatna chu keipi tobang ahi; a-nina chu bongchal tobang ahi; a-thumna chun mihem mel apui; chule a-lina chu muvanlai lenpet tobang ahi.
English: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

tcz: Hinnanei li ho hin lhaving gup aneicheh uvin, chule alhavingu chun amit'u asunglam le apolam asim cheh uvin ahi. Suntin le jantinin amaho chun, “Athenge, athenge, athenge, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung–Anaumjingsapa, tua uma chule ahung umnalai ding” tin asamjom jingun ahi.
en: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”
text:
REV 4:8
Thadou: Hinnanei li ho hin lhaving gup aneicheh uvin, chule alhavingu chun amit'u asunglam le apolam asim cheh uvin ahi. Suntin le jantinin amaho chun, “Athenge, athenge, athenge, Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung–Anaumjingsapa, tua uma chule ahung umnalai ding” tin asamjom jingun ahi.
English: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

tcz: Hinnanei li ho chun loupina le jabolna chule thangvahna chu Laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hingjingpa) chu apeh tenguleh,
en: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,
text:
REV 4:9
Thadou: Hinnanei li ho chun loupina le jabolna chule thangvahna chu Laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hingjingpa) chu apeh tenguleh,
English: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

tcz: Upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chule laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hing jingpa) masanga chun, alallukhuh u chu akoilhauvin, chule aseiyun,
en: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,
text:
REV 4:10
Thadou: Upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chule laltouna a toupa (atonsot tonsot'a hing jingpa) masanga chun, alallukhuh u chu akoilhauvin, chule aseiyun,
English: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

tcz: “O Pakai ka Pathenu, Nangma loupina le Jabolna chule thaneina changa loma nahi. Ajeh chu nangman ijakai nasemin, chule amaho hi nangma phatsah a uma chule kisema ahiuve,” atiuve.
en: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”
text:
REV 4:11
Thadou: “O Pakai ka Pathenu, Nangma loupina le Jabolna chule thaneina changa loma nahi. Ajeh chu nangman ijakai nasemin, chule amaho hi nangma phatsah a uma chule kisema ahiuve,” atiuve.
English: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

tcz: Chutah'in keiman Laltouna a toupan akhut jetlam'a lekhajol khat achoi chu kamun ahi. Lekhajol chu asung lam le apolam kijihgel ahin, chule hichu sinkhana sagin mohor akinam khum in ahi.
en: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.
text:
REV 5:1
Thadou: Chutah'in keiman Laltouna a toupan akhut jetlam'a lekhajol khat achoi chu kamun ahi. Lekhajol chu asung lam le apolam kijihgel ahin, chule hichu sinkhana sagin mohor akinam khum in ahi.
English: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

tcz: Chuin keiman vantil hattah khat aw sangtah'a kho asap kajai: “Koiham hiche lekhajol sinkhana kinam khum hi ahong dinga kiloma chu?” ati.
en: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”
text:
REV 5:2
Thadou: Chuin keiman vantil hattah khat aw sangtah'a kho asap kajai: “Koiham hiche lekhajol sinkhana kinam khum hi ahong dinga kiloma chu?” ati.
English: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

tcz: Hinlah vana hihen, ahilouleh leichunga hihen chule leinoiya hijongleh lekhajol chu ahongthei le asimthei ding akimutapoi.
en: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.
text:
REV 5:3
Thadou: Hinlah vana hihen, ahilouleh leichunga hihen chule leinoiya hijongleh lekhajol chu ahongthei le asimthei ding akimutapoi.
English: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

tcz: Chuphat in keima hakan kakaptai, ajeh chu lekhajol chu ahong ding le asim ding'ah koima akimutapon ahi.
en: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
text:
REV 5:4
Thadou: Chuphat in keima hakan kakaptai, ajeh chu lekhajol chu ahong ding le asim ding'ah koima akimutapon ahi.
English: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

tcz: Hinlah upa somni le li holah a khatchun kajah a aseiyin, “Kaptahih in! Ven, Judah phunga Keipi, David Laltouna a toudingpa chun jona aneitai. Amahi lekhajol hong dinga le a sinkhana sagi lhamlha dinga kiloma ahi,” ati.
en: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”
text:
REV 5:5
Thadou: Hinlah upa somni le li holah a khatchun kajah a aseiyin, “Kaptahih in! Ven, Judah phunga Keipi, David Laltouna a toudingpa chun jona aneitai. Amahi lekhajol hong dinga le a sinkhana sagi lhamlha dinga kiloma ahi,” ati.
English: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

tcz: Chuphat'in keiman Kelngoinou khat akithatsa lheh lheh chu Laltouna le Hinnanei li ho kahlah a chule upa somni le li ho kahlah a adin chu kamun ahi. Ama chun ki-sagi aneiyin, chule vannoi muntina kisoldoh a Pathen lhagao sagi, mit-sagi jong neiya chu ahi.
en: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
text:
REV 5:6
Thadou: Chuphat'in keiman Kelngoinou khat akithatsa lheh lheh chu Laltouna le Hinnanei li ho kahlah a chule upa somni le li ho kahlah a adin chu kamun ahi. Ama chun ki-sagi aneiyin, chule vannoi muntina kisoldoh a Pathen lhagao sagi, mit-sagi jong neiya chu ahi.
English: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

tcz: Ama chu ahung pheiyin chuin Laltouna a toupa khut jet lama kon chun lekhajol chu aladoh in ahi.
en: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.
text:
REV 5:7
Thadou: Ama chu ahung pheiyin chuin Laltouna a toupa khut jet lama kon chun lekhajol chu aladoh in ahi.
English: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

tcz: Chuin aman lekhajol chu alahphat in, Hinnanei-li ho chule upa somni le li ho chu Kelngoinou masanga chun akuncheh tauve. Khat khat cheh in akhut uva selangdah, chule sana khon gimnamtwi dimset a kikoi, Pathen mite taona chu akichoicheh un ahi.
en: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
text:
REV 5:8
Thadou: Chuin aman lekhajol chu alahphat in, Hinnanei-li ho chule upa somni le li ho chu Kelngoinou masanga chun akuncheh tauve. Khat khat cheh in akhut uva selangdah, chule sana khon gimnamtwi dimset a kikoi, Pathen mite taona chu akichoicheh un ahi.
English: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

tcz: Chule amaho chun lathah khat hiche thucheng hohin asaove: “Nangma lekhajol chu la a chule asinkhana chu lhamlha dinga kiloma nahi. Ajeh chu nangma akithatsa nahin chule nathisanin mitampi chu–phungtina kon, paotina kon chule mijouse le namtina konin Pathena dingin nalhatdamtai.
en: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,
text:
REV 5:9
Thadou: Chule amaho chun lathah khat hiche thucheng hohin asaove: “Nangma lekhajol chu la a chule asinkhana chu lhamlha dinga kiloma nahi. Ajeh chu nangma akithatsa nahin chule nathisanin mitampi chu–phungtina kon, paotina kon chule mijouse le namtina konin Pathena dingin nalhatdamtai.
English: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

tcz: Chule nangman amaho chu IPathen uva dingin Lenggam thempuhoa nahisah'in, chule amahon leiset chunga vai ahom dingu ahi.”
en: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”
text:
REV 5:10
Thadou: Chule nangman amaho chu IPathen uva dingin Lenggam thempuhoa nahisah'in, chule amahon leiset chunga vai ahom dingu ahi.”
English: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

tcz: Chuin kavekit in ahileh keiman mi asangsang, simsenlou laltouna kimvela um Vantilte ho le sahem-hing ho chule upa ho awgin chu kajan ahi.
en: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
text:
REV 5:11
Thadou: Chuin kavekit in ahileh keiman mi asangsang, simsenlou laltouna kimvela um Vantilte ho le sahem-hing ho chule upa ho awgin chu kajan ahi.
English: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

tcz: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun la asauvin, “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu–thaneina le haonaho chule chihna le thahatna chule jabolna le loupina chule phattheina chang dinga lom ahi.”
en: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”
text:
REV 5:12
Thadou: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun la asauvin, “Akithatsa Kelngoinou chu–thaneina le haonaho chule chihna le thahatna chule jabolna le loupina chule phattheina chang dinga lom ahi.”
English: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

tcz: Chuin keiman vana le leichunga chule leinoiya le twikhanglen'a hinna nei jousen vahchoila asah u kajan, “Phattheina le jabolna chule loupina chule thilbolthei thahatna chu Laltouna a toupa chung'ah chule Kelngoinou chung ah atonsot tonsot'in umhen” atiuve.
en: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”
text:
REV 5:13
Thadou: Chuin keiman vana le leichunga chule leinoiya le twikhanglen'a hinna nei jousen vahchoila asah u kajan, “Phattheina le jabolna chule loupina chule thilbolthei thahatna chu Laltouna a toupa chung'ah chule Kelngoinou chung ah atonsot tonsot'in umhen” atiuve.
English: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

tcz: Chule Hinnanei-li ho chun “Amen!” tin aseiyuve. Chuin upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chuin Kelngoinou chu ahou tauvin ahi.
en: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.
text:
REV 5:14
Thadou: Chule Hinnanei-li ho chun “Amen!” tin aseiyuve. Chuin upa somni le li ho chu abohkhup un chuin Kelngoinou chu ahou tauvin ahi.
English: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

tcz: Keiman kavetleh, Kelngoinou chun lekhajol sinkhana sagia kinam lah a amasapen chu alhamlhatan ahi. Chuphat in Hinnanei-li ho lah a khat chun van-gin tobang'in thu ahinseiyin, “Hungin!” ati.
en: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”
text:
REV 6:1
Thadou: Keiman kavetleh, Kelngoinou chun lekhajol sinkhana sagia kinam lah a amasapen chu alhamlhatan ahi. Chuphat in Hinnanei-li ho lah a khat chun van-gin tobang'in thu ahinseiyin, “Hungin!” ati.
English: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

tcz: Keima kadah in ahileh sakol kang khat adin kamui. Achunga toupa chun thalpi khat achoiyin, chule aluchunga lallukhuh khat akhuhsah uvin ahi. Amahi galkisatna tampi chu jou dinga chule gajoutei dinga hungkondoh ahi.
en: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
text:
REV 6:2
Thadou: Keima kadah in ahileh sakol kang khat adin kamui. Achunga toupa chun thalpi khat achoiyin, chule aluchunga lallukhuh khat akhuhsah uvin ahi. Amahi galkisatna tampi chu jou dinga chule gajoutei dinga hungkondoh ahi.
English: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nina chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei-ninapa chun aseiyin, “Hungin” ati.
en: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
text:
REV 6:3
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nina chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei-ninapa chun aseiyin, “Hungin” ati.
English: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

tcz: Chuphat in sakolchom, asan khat, chu ahung kilahdoh in ahi. Achunga toupa chu chemjam ahema hemkhat akipen chule leiset chunga cham-lungmonna lamang dingin thuneina akipei. Chule chua chun gal aumin chule mitamtah akithat muntinah aumin ahi.
en: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.
text:
REV 6:4
Thadou: Chuphat in sakolchom, asan khat, chu ahung kilahdoh in ahi. Achunga toupa chu chemjam ahema hemkhat akipen chule leiset chunga cham-lungmonna lamang dingin thuneina akipei. Chule chua chun gal aumin chule mitamtah akithat muntinah aumin ahi.
English: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana athumna chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei–athum napa chun, “Hungin” ati kajai. Keima kadah in kavetleh sakolvom khat kamun, chule achunga toupa chun agih tetohna tokhat chu akhut'a atuh in ahi.
en: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
text:
REV 6:5
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana athumna chu alhap'a ahileh, Hinnanei–athum napa chun, “Hungin” ati kajai. Keima kadah in kavetleh sakolvom khat kamun, chule achunga toupa chun agih tetohna tokhat chu akhut'a atuh in ahi.
English: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

tcz: Chule keiman Hinnanei–liho lah a aw-khat kajai, “Suhlouchang lhah pheng-khat ahilouleh sakol changlhah pheng thumchu nikhotha khat manjat hiding ahi. Chule Olive thao le lengpitwi chu mohmahthah sah hih in,” ati.
en: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”
text:
REV 6:6
Thadou: Chule keiman Hinnanei–liho lah a aw-khat kajai, “Suhlouchang lhah pheng-khat ahilouleh sakol changlhah pheng thumchu nikhotha khat manjat hiding ahi. Chule Olive thao le lengpitwi chu mohmahthah sah hih in,” ati.
English: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana alina pachu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman Hinnanei lina pa chun asei, “Hungin” ati kajan ahi.
en: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”
text:
REV 6:7
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana alina pachu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman Hinnanei lina pa chun asei, “Hungin” ati kajan ahi.
English: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

tcz: Keima kadadoh a ahileh keiman sakol eng-dang khat kamui. Achunga Toupa chu Thina akiti, chule akilhonpi chu Lhankhuh ahi. Anilhona hi leiset chunga hoplia hopkhat chunga thuneina kipea, chemjama, kel'a le natnaa chule gamsa hang khut'a thitheina uma ahi.
en: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
text:
REV 6:8
Thadou: Keima kadadoh a ahileh keiman sakol eng-dang khat kamui. Achunga Toupa chu Thina akiti, chule akilhonpi chu Lhankhuh ahi. Anilhona hi leiset chunga hoplia hopkhat chunga thuneina kipea, chemjama, kel'a le natnaa chule gamsa hang khut'a thitheina uma ahi.
English: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nganapa chu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman maicham mun noiya chun Pathen Thu jal'a kithatsa ho chule athu hettohsah nauva kithat a thiho lhagao chu kamun ahi.
en: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.
text:
REV 6:9
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana nganapa chu alhamlhan ahileh, keiman maicham mun noiya chun Pathen Thu jal'a kithatsa ho chule athu hettohsah nauva kithat a thiho lhagao chu kamun ahi.
English: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

tcz: Amaho chun Pakai koma asamun, “Vo hatchungnung Pakai, theng le kitah, itih chanpi hi nangman vannoi miten keiho chunga athisan sonau thisan phuba lah ding chu nakhongai nahlai ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
en: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
text:
REV 6:10
Thadou: Amaho chun Pakai koma asamun, “Vo hatchungnung Pakai, theng le kitah, itih chanpi hi nangman vannoi miten keiho chunga athisan sonau thisan phuba lah ding chu nakhongai nahlai ding ham?” atiuvin ahi.
English: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

tcz: Chutah in amaho khatcheh chu ponbang silding apecheh uvin ahi. Chule amaho chu chomkhat kicholdo be nalai dingu, asopitehou Yeshua a asoh chanpiteho chu martyr chang nalaidingho chun ahinjop masang seuva anga dinguva kiseipeh uva ahi.
en: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
text:
REV 6:11
Thadou: Chutah in amaho khatcheh chu ponbang silding apecheh uvin ahi. Chule amaho chu chomkhat kicholdo be nalai dingu, asopitehou Yeshua a asoh chanpiteho chu martyr chang nalaidingho chun ahinjop masang seuva anga dinguva kiseipeh uva ahi.
English: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana gupna chu alhap kavet'a ahileh chua chun ling nasatah akihot'in ahi. Hiti chun nisa chu ponvom tobang'in athimin, chule Lha jong chu thisan tobang'in asantai.
en: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
text:
REV 6:12
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana gupna chu alhap kavet'a ahileh chua chun ling nasatah akihot'in ahi. Hiti chun nisa chu ponvom tobang'in athimin, chule Lha jong chu thisan tobang'in asantai.
English: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

tcz: Chule vana Ahsi ho jong chu hui hattah in theichang ga adonglai chang'a amutlhah tobang'in leiset a apullha gamtai.
en: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
text:
REV 6:13
Thadou: Chule vana Ahsi ho jong chu hui hattah in theichang ga adonglai chang'a amutlhah tobang'in leiset a apullha gamtai.
English: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

tcz: Chule vanthamjol jong chu lekhajol tobang'in akijel in, chule mol ho le twikol umnaho jouse jong chu aumnau mun akichondoh tai.
en: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
text:
REV 6:14
Thadou: Chule vanthamjol jong chu lekhajol tobang'in akijel in, chule mol ho le twikol umnaho jouse jong chu aumnau mun akichondoh tai.
English: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

tcz: Chutah in–Leiset Lengho, vaipo ho, lamkai pipuho, mihaoho, thaneiho, chule sohho le ongthol-chamlhat ho-abonchauvin songkoa chule molchunga songpi ho lah a chun akiselun ahi.
en: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
text:
REV 6:15
Thadou: Chutah in–Leiset Lengho, vaipo ho, lamkai pipuho, mihaoho, thaneiho, chule sohho le ongthol-chamlhat ho-abonchauvin songkoa chule molchunga songpi ho lah a chun akiselun ahi.
English: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

tcz: Chule amaho chun molchung le songpi ho chunga konchun ahinsamdoh un, “Kachunguva hunglhuvin chule Laltouna a toupa le Kelngoinou masanga lunghanna a konin neisel un.
en: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,
text:
REV 6:16
Thadou: Chule amaho chun molchung le songpi ho chunga konchun ahinsamdoh un, “Kachunguva hunglhuvin chule Laltouna a toupa le Kelngoinou masanga lunghanna a konin neisel un.
