English: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

tcz: Ajeh chu alunghanna nikho tijat umtah chu hunglhunga ahitai, chule koiham chua kona hoidoh ding chu,” atiuve.
en: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”
text:
REV 6:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu alunghanna nikho tijat umtah chu hunglhunga ahitai, chule koiham chua kona hoidoh ding chu,” atiuve.
English: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

tcz: Chujouvin keiman vantil li leiset kolning-li a adin'u kamun, amahon leiset chunga anunlouna dinguvin huinun-li chu atuhtangun ahi. Thingphung hoa thingna khat jong akiling pon, chule twikhanglen jong phatvet mai bangin ajolsel jenge.
en: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
text:
REV 7:1
Thadou: Chujouvin keiman vantil li leiset kolning-li a adin'u kamun, amahon leiset chunga anunlouna dinguvin huinun-li chu atuhtangun ahi. Thingphung hoa thingna khat jong akiling pon, chule twikhanglen jong phatvet mai bangin ajolsel jenge.
English: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

tcz: Chule keiman vantil chomkhat Solama kona ahunga Pathen hing mohor achoi chu kamun ahi. Chule amachun hiche vantil-li, leiset chung le twikhanglen suhset theina thaneina kipeho jah a asamin,
en: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
text:
REV 7:2
Thadou: Chule keiman vantil chomkhat Solama kona ahunga Pathen hing mohor achoi chu kamun ahi. Chule amachun hiche vantil-li, leiset chung le twikhanglen suhset theina thaneina kipeho jah a asamin,
English: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

tcz: “Keihon Pathen Mohor chu Asohte ho chalpanga kanampeh masang seuvin leiset ahilouleh twikhanglen ahilouleh thing ho susehih un,” ahinti-e.
en: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”
text:
REV 7:3
Thadou: “Keihon Pathen Mohor chu Asohte ho chalpanga kanampeh masang seuvin leiset ahilouleh twikhanglen ahilouleh thing ho susehih un,” ahinti-e.
English: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

tcz: Chule keiman mi ijat chu Pathen Mohor kinam khum hiuvem–Israel nam sunga kona mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li ahiuve, ti kajan ahi.
en: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
text:
REV 7:4
Thadou: Chule keiman mi ijat chu Pathen Mohor kinam khum hiuvem–Israel nam sunga kona mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li ahiuve, ti kajan ahi.
English: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

tcz: Judah phunga kona mi sang som le ni, Reuben phunga kona sang som le sang ni, Gad phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

tcz: Asher phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Naphtali phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Manasseh phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

tcz: Simeon phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Levi phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Issachar phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni;
en: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

tcz: Zebulun phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni ahiuve.
en: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
text:
REV 7:8
Thadou: Zebulun phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Joseph phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni, Benjamin phunga kona mi sang som le sang ni ahiuve.
English: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

tcz: Hiche jou chun keiman mi atama tam, sima simjou ding hilou chitin namtina kon, phungtina kon, mitina kon chule paotin a kona Laltouna mai chule Kelngoinou anga adinu chu kamui. Amaho chun ponbang jeng akivonun, chule akhut uva lusu-bah akichoi cheh uvin ahi.
en: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
text:
REV 7:9
Thadou: Hiche jou chun keiman mi atama tam, sima simjou ding hilou chitin namtina kon, phungtina kon, mitina kon chule paotin a kona Laltouna mai chule Kelngoinou anga adinu chu kamui. Amaho chun ponbang jeng akivonun, chule akhut uva lusu-bah akichoi cheh uvin ahi.
English: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

tcz: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun asamuvin, “Huhhingna chu Laltouna a toupa IPathen uva kon le Kelngoinouva kon ahi,” atiuve.
en: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
text:
REV 7:10
Thadou: Chule amaho chun aw chohjejun asamuvin, “Huhhingna chu Laltouna a toupa IPathen uva kon le Kelngoinouva kon ahi,” atiuve.
English: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

tcz: Chule vantil ho jouse chu Laltouna kimvela, chule upa ho kimvela, chule Hinnanei-li ho kimvela chun adinguvin ahi. Chule amaho Laltouna angsunga chun alhu uvin amaiyu tol'a asulut un chule Pathen chu ahouvun ahi.
en: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,
text:
REV 7:11
Thadou: Chule vantil ho jouse chu Laltouna kimvela, chule upa ho kimvela, chule Hinnanei-li ho kimvela chun adinguvin ahi. Chule amaho Laltouna angsunga chun alhu uvin amaiyu tol'a asulut un chule Pathen chu ahouvun ahi.
English: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

tcz: Amahon avahchoiyun, “Amen! Phattheina le loupina le chihna le thangvahna le jabolna le thaneina chule thahatna chu IPathen uva a-i-matih chanin hijinghen, Amen” tin asamuve.
en: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”
text:
REV 7:12
Thadou: Amahon avahchoiyun, “Amen! Phattheina le loupina le chihna le thangvahna le jabolna le thaneina chule thahatna chu IPathen uva a-i-matih chanin hijinghen, Amen” tin asamuve.
English: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

tcz: Chuphat in vantil ho lah a khat chun kajah a, “Hiche abang jenga kivon ho hi koiho hiuvem? Hoiya hungkon hiuva ham?” eiti.
en: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”
text:
REV 7:13
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil ho lah a khat chun kajah a, “Hiche abang jenga kivon ho hi koiho hiuvem? Hoiya hungkon hiuva ham?” eiti.
English: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

tcz: Chuin keiman ajah a, “Pu nangman nahenai” tin kaseiye. Chuphat in aman kajah a, “Amaho hi Thohhahsa phat sunga thiho ahiuve. Amaho hin aponsil'u chu kelngoinou thisana akisop ngimuva chule bangleh ah ahitai.”
en: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.
text:
REV 7:14
Thadou: Chuin keiman ajah a, “Pu nangman nahenai” tin kaseiye. Chuphat in aman kajah a, “Amaho hi Thohhahsa phat sunga thiho ahiuve. Amaho hin aponsil'u chu kelngoinou thisana akisop ngimuva chule bangleh ah ahitai.”
English: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

tcz: “Hijeh a chu amaho hi Pathen Laltouna masanga dinguva olmo louva sun le jana Houin sunga chu kicholdo manlouva Pathen ajenu ahi. Chule Laltouna a toupa chun amaho aumna diu apeh ding ahi.”
en: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
text:
REV 7:15
Thadou: “Hijeh a chu amaho hi Pathen Laltouna masanga dinguva olmo louva sun le jana Houin sunga chu kicholdo manlouva Pathen ajenu ahi. Chule Laltouna a toupa chun amaho aumna diu apeh ding ahi.”
English: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

tcz: Amaho gilkel kit talou dingu chule dangchah kit talouhel dingu ahi; nisasat in jong amaho akahkhah tahlou hel dingu ahi.
en: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

tcz: Ajeh chu Laltouna a toupa chu amaho kelngoi chin'a aching dingpa hiding ahi. Aman amaho chu Hintwi lonna muna apuilut ding chule Pathen in amit uva kona amitlhiu atheh hulpeh dingu ahi.
en: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”
text:
REV 7:17
Thadou: Ajeh chu Laltouna a toupa chu amaho kelngoi chin'a aching dingpa hiding ahi. Aman amaho chu Hintwi lonna muna apuilut ding chule Pathen in amit uva kona amitlhiu atheh hulpeh dingu ahi.
English: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

tcz: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana sagi lhinna lekha jol chu alhap a ahileh van mun pumpia nidan keh khat tobang chu athip chettai.
en: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
text:
REV 8:1
Thadou: Kelngoinou chun sinkhana sagi lhinna lekha jol chu alhap a ahileh van mun pumpia nidan keh khat tobang chu athip chettai.
English: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

tcz: Chuin Pathen masanga ding jing vantil sagi ho chu kamun chule amaho chu sumkon sagi akipen ahi.
en: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
text:
REV 8:2
Thadou: Chuin Pathen masanga ding jing vantil sagi ho chu kamun chule amaho chu sumkon sagi akipen ahi.
English: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

tcz: Chutah chun vantil chomkhat gimnamtwi halna sanabom kichoiyah ahungin, chuin maicham muna chun adingin ahi. Chule gimnamtwi tamtah chu Pathen mite taona chuto haltha a sana maicham muna laltouna maiya sunlhah dingin ama chu akipen ahi.
en: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
text:
REV 8:3
Thadou: Chutah chun vantil chomkhat gimnamtwi halna sanabom kichoiyah ahungin, chuin maicham muna chun adingin ahi. Chule gimnamtwi tamtah chu Pathen mite taona chuto haltha a sana maicham muna laltouna maiya sunlhah dingin ama chu akipen ahi.
English: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

tcz: Gimnamtwi kihalna meikhu chu Pathen mithengte taona chuto maichama vantil chun asunlhahna muna konin Pathen koma akaltouvin, alhungtai.
en: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
text:
REV 8:4
Thadou: Gimnamtwi kihalna meikhu chu Pathen mithengte taona chuto maichama vantil chun asunlhahna muna konin Pathen koma akaltouvin, alhungtai.
English: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

tcz: Chutah in vantil chun gimnamtwi kihalna boma chun maichama mei chu akoilut'in chuin leiset chunga aseplhai; chutah chun aw tampi ahung gingin, van aginglul lulin, kol aphejap jap'in chule lingpi tijat umtah chu akihot'in ahi.
en: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.
text:
REV 8:5
Thadou: Chutah in vantil chun gimnamtwi kihalna boma chun maichama mei chu akoilut'in chuin leiset chunga aseplhai; chutah chun aw tampi ahung gingin, van aginglul lulin, kol aphejap jap'in chule lingpi tijat umtah chu akihot'in ahi.
English: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil sagi chun asumkon cheh u chu gingtah a mutcheh dingin akigo tauve.
en: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
text:
REV 8:6
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil sagi chun asumkon cheh u chu gingtah a mutcheh dingin akigo tauve.
English: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

tcz: Vantil akhatna chun asumkon amut in ahileh gelchang le meikou thisanto kihal chu leiset chunga ahung kisep lhatai. Leiset hop-thum'a hop-khat meiyin akatai, thingho hop-thum'a hop-khat akalhan, chule hamhing jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akavamtai.
en: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
text:
REV 8:7
Thadou: Vantil akhatna chun asumkon amut in ahileh gelchang le meikou thisanto kihal chu leiset chunga ahung kisep lhatai. Leiset hop-thum'a hop-khat meiyin akatai, thingho hop-thum'a hop-khat akalhan, chule hamhing jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akavamtai.
English: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil nina in asumkon amut'in ahileh, meikou moul lentah tobang chu twikhanglen'a akilehlut tai. Hiti chun twikhanglen'a twi chu hop-thum'a hop-khat thisan akisohtai.
en: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
text:
REV 8:8
Thadou: Chujouvin vantil nina in asumkon amut'in ahileh, meikou moul lentah tobang chu twikhanglen'a akilehlut tai. Hiti chun twikhanglen'a twi chu hop-thum'a hop-khat thisan akisohtai.
English: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

tcz: Hiti chun twikhanglen'a hinna nei jouse hop-thum'a hop-khat athigam tai, chule twikhanglen'a konglen jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akisuse gamtai.
en: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
text:
REV 8:9
Thadou: Hiti chun twikhanglen'a hinna nei jouse hop-thum'a hop-khat athigam tai, chule twikhanglen'a konglen jouse jong hop-thum'a hop-khat akisuse gamtai.
English: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil thumna chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh ahsi lentah khat vana konin ahung lenglhan, kolphemeivah tobang'in asal jenge. Hichu vadung ho chunga le twinah ho hop-thum'a hop-khat chunga achun ahi.
en: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.
text:
REV 8:10
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil thumna chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh ahsi lentah khat vana konin ahung lenglhan, kolphemeivah tobang'in asal jenge. Hichu vadung ho chunga le twinah ho hop-thum'a hop-khat chunga achun ahi.
English: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

tcz: Ahsi min chu akha akiti. Hichun twi hopthum a hop-khat akhatsah in, chule twi akhat jeh chun adon ho atama tam athitauve.
en: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
text:
REV 8:11
Thadou: Ahsi min chu akha akiti. Hichun twi hopthum a hop-khat akhatsah in, chule twi akhat jeh chun adon ho atama tam athitauve.
English: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil-lina chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh Nisa chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, Lha chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, chule Ahsi ho jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chengse chu abonun athimtai. Chule nikho jong chu hop-thum'a hop-khat athimtan ahi. Chule jan jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chu athimtai.
en: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
text:
REV 8:12
Thadou: Chujouvin vantil-lina chun asumkon chu amut in ahileh Nisa chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, Lha chu hop-thum'a hop-khat, chule Ahsi ho jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chengse chu abonun athimtai. Chule nikho jong chu hop-thum'a hop-khat athimtan ahi. Chule jan jong hop-thum'a hop-khat chu athimtai.
English: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman kaven, chule mulaopi khat huilah a alengle chun alenpumin gingleng lungin ahinsamin: “Vantil thum achaina hon asumkonu ahinmut tenguleh hiche vannoiya chengho dingin tijat aume, tijat aume, tijat aume,” ati.
en: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
text:
REV 8:13
Thadou: Chujouvin keiman kaven, chule mulaopi khat huilah a alengle chun alenpumin gingleng lungin ahinsamin: “Vantil thum achaina hon asumkonu ahinmut tenguleh hiche vannoiya chengho dingin tijat aume, tijat aume, tijat aume,” ati.
English: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

tcz: Chujouchun vantil a-nga na chun asumkon amut in ahileh vana kona Ahsi khat leiset'a ahung lenlhah kamun, chule ama chun amongbei onghom kot-heh chu achoiyin ahi.
en: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
text:
REV 9:1
Thadou: Chujouchun vantil a-nga na chun asumkon amut in ahileh vana kona Ahsi khat leiset'a ahung lenlhah kamun, chule ama chun amongbei onghom kot-heh chu achoiyin ahi.
English: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

tcz: Aman hichu ahon a ahileh meilhum nasatah a kona hungpot tobang meikhu ahungdoh in, chule nisavah le hui chu meikhua konin avomsoh jengin ahi.
en: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
text:
REV 9:2
Thadou: Aman hichu ahon a ahileh meilhum nasatah a kona hungpot tobang meikhu ahungdoh in, chule nisavah le hui chu meikhua konin avomsoh jengin ahi.
English: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

tcz: Chujouvin meikhua pat in khaokhoho ahung potdoh uvin, chule leiset a ahungkum lhauvin chule amaho chu aipi mide natna thaneina kipeuva ahi.
en: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
text:
REV 9:3
Thadou: Chujouvin meikhua pat in khaokhoho ahung potdoh uvin, chule leiset a ahungkum lhauvin chule amaho chu aipi mide natna thaneina kipeuva ahi.
English: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

tcz: Amaho chun hampa ahilouleh anchephung ahilouleh thingphung ho asuhsetlou dingu, amavang mihemho Pathen mohor achalpanguva kinam ding nomlou ho asuh genthei dingu ahi.
en: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.
text:
REV 9:4
Thadou: Amaho chun hampa ahilouleh anchephung ahilouleh thingphung ho asuhsetlou dingu, amavang mihemho Pathen mohor achalpanguva kinam ding nomlou ho asuh genthei dingu ahi.
English: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

tcz: Amaho chun athalou dingu ahivangin lha-nga jen asuhgim dingu, aipin amidena natna a chu amaho adenat uva agimbol dingu ahiye.
en: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
text:
REV 9:5
Thadou: Amaho chun athalou dingu ahivangin lha-nga jen asuhgim dingu, aipin amidena natna a chu amaho adenat uva agimbol dingu ahiye.
English: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

tcz: Chuchelai le chun mihon thina ahol dingu ahiala amujou lou dingu ahi. Amahon thina angaichat lheh dingu ahiala thina chu amahoa kona jammang ding ahitai!
en: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
text:
REV 9:6
Thadou: Chuchelai le chun mihon thina ahol dingu ahiala amujou lou dingu ahi. Amahon thina angaichat lheh dingu ahiala thina chu amahoa kona jammang ding ahitai!
English: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

tcz: Khaokhoho chu sakolho galsatna muna dinga kigo tobang ahiuve. Amaho chun aluchunguva Sana-lallukhuh tobang aneiyun, chule amaiyu chu mihem maitobang ahi.
en: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.
text:
REV 9:7
Thadou: Khaokhoho chu sakolho galsatna muna dinga kigo tobang ahiuve. Amaho chun aluchunguva Sana-lallukhuh tobang aneiyun, chule amaiyu chu mihem maitobang ahi.
English: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

tcz: Amaho chun alu uvah numei samtobang apu'uvin chule ahau chu keipi-bahkai ha tobang ahi.
en: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
text:
REV 9:8
Thadou: Amaho chun alu uvah numei samtobang apu'uvin chule ahau chu keipi-bahkai ha tobang ahi.
English: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

tcz: Amahon galvon akivonu chu thih a kisem ahi chule alhavingu hugin chu sakol kangtalai chunga touva galsatna mun del galmi tobang ahiuve.
en: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.
text:
REV 9:9
Thadou: Amahon galvon akivonu chu thih a kisem ahi chule alhavingu hugin chu sakol kangtalai chunga touva galsatna mun del galmi tobang ahiuve.
English: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

tcz: Amahon mei aneiyu chun aipi midena tobang gu aneiyun, chule lha-nga jen miho chu suhgim theina thaneina aneiyuve.
en: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
text:
REV 9:10
Thadou: Amahon mei aneiyu chun aipi midena tobang gu aneiyun, chule lha-nga jen miho chu suhgim theina thaneina aneiyuve.
English: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

tcz: Alengpau chu amongbei lei-onga hungkondoh vantil chu ahi; amin chu Hebrew paovin Abaddon akitin, chule Greek paovin Apollyon akitin–Asumang pa tina ahi.
en: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.
text:
REV 9:11
Thadou: Alengpau chu amongbei lei-onga hungkondoh vantil chu ahi; amin chu Hebrew paovin Abaddon akitin, chule Greek paovin Apollyon akitin–Asumang pa tina ahi.
English: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

tcz: Kichat tijat umtah akhatna chu kichaiya ahitai, hinla ven, kichat tijat umtah ni hung be ding ahi!
en: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
text:
REV 9:12
Thadou: Kichat tijat umtah akhatna chu kichaiya ahitai, hinla ven, kichat tijat umtah ni hung be ding ahi!
English: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil agupna chun asumkon amut in ahileh, keiman Pathen angsunga kikoi sana maicham ki-li umna muna konin aw khat ahung gin doh kajan ahi.
en: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
text:
REV 9:13
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil agupna chun asumkon amut in ahileh, keiman Pathen angsunga kikoi sana maicham ki-li umna muna konin aw khat ahung gin doh kajan ahi.
English: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

tcz: Chule aw chun sumkon kichoi vantil agupna jah a, “Euphrates Vadung Lentah a kihen vantil-li ho chu lhadoh in,” ati.
en: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”
text:
REV 9:14
Thadou: Chule aw chun sumkon kichoi vantil agupna jah a, “Euphrates Vadung Lentah a kihen vantil-li ho chu lhadoh in,” ati.
English: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

tcz: Chuphat in vantil-li ho, hiche phat a chule anikho le alha chule akum sungsea dinga leiset chunga miho hop-thum'a hop-khat that dinga kigongsaho, chu alhadoh tauve.
en: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
text:
REV 9:15
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil-li ho, hiche phat a chule anikho le alha chule akum sungsea dinga leiset chunga miho hop-thum'a hop-khat that dinga kigongsaho, chu alhadoh tauve.
English: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

tcz: Keiman sepaihon amijat'u chu kajan, hichu sakol chunga tou niel-jani alhinguve.
en: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.
text:
REV 9:16
Thadou: Keiman sepaihon amijat'u chu kajan, hichu sakol chunga tou niel-jani alhinguve.
English: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

tcz: Chule kamitlha a chun keiman sakol ho le achunguva touho kamun ahi. Achunga touho chun galvon aki-ah uchu asanthip le adumvom chule a-eng ahije. Sakol ho chu aluchangu keipi-bahkai tobang, chule akamuva kona mei le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang ahung potdoh e.
en: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
text:
REV 9:17
Thadou: Chule kamitlha a chun keiman sakol ho le achunguva touho kamun ahi. Achunga touho chun galvon aki-ah uchu asanthip le adumvom chule a-eng ahije. Sakol ho chu aluchangu keipi-bahkai tobang, chule akamuva kona mei le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang ahung potdoh e.
English: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

tcz: Hiche gamna hise thum-ho: meikong le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang hiche sakol ho kam'a konin ahung potdoh'in ahileh leiset chunga miho chu athattan ahi.
en: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
text:
REV 9:18
Thadou: Hiche gamna hise thum-ho: meikong le meikhu chule kath kihal deujeju tobang hiche sakol ho kam'a konin ahung potdoh'in ahileh leiset chunga miho chu athattan ahi.
English: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

tcz: Amaho thaneina chu akam uva le amei uva uma ahi. Ijeh inem itileh ameiyuva chu gulluchang tobanga boh a, hichun miho asuhnat theina tha apeh ahi.
en: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
text:
REV 9:19
Thadou: Amaho thaneina chu akam uva le amei uva uma ahi. Ijeh inem itileh ameiyuva chu gulluchang tobanga boh a, hichun miho asuhnat theina tha apeh ahi.
English: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

tcz: Hinlah hiche gamna hisea thilouho chu athilse bolnauva konin alungu aheideh pouvin chule Pathen lam asang dehpouve. Amahon thilhaho le sana a, dangkaa, hah a, songa chule thinga milim kisemho–milim semthu kho mutheilou, kho jatheilou, chatloh theilou ho chu ahoujom jinguvin ahi.
en: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.
text:
REV 9:20
Thadou: Hinlah hiche gamna hisea thilouho chu athilse bolnauva konin alungu aheideh pouvin chule Pathen lam asang dehpouve. Amahon thilhaho le sana a, dangkaa, hah a, songa chule thinga milim kisemho–milim semthu kho mutheilou, kho jatheilou, chatloh theilou ho chu ahoujom jinguvin ahi.
English: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

tcz: Chule amahon amithanauva konin, ahilouleh thilha ahounauva konin, ahilouleh thenlouna hoa konin chuleh aguhchatnauva konin lung aheideh pouvin ahi.
en: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
text:
REV 9:21
Thadou: Chule amahon amithanauva konin, ahilouleh thilha ahounauva konin, ahilouleh thenlouna hoa konin chuleh aguhchatnauva konin lung aheideh pouvin ahi.
English: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

tcz: Chutah in vantil hattah achom dang khat meibolin akimvelin, aluchunga lhagui um chu vana konin ahung kumlhan ahi. Amai chu nisa bangin avah in chule akengphangteni chu meikhompi ho to abang jenge.
en: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
text:
REV 10:1
Thadou: Chutah in vantil hattah achom dang khat meibolin akimvelin, aluchunga lhagui um chu vana konin ahung kumlhan ahi. Amai chu nisa bangin avah in chule akengphangteni chu meikhompi ho to abang jenge.
English: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

tcz: Chule akhut a chun lekhajol neokhat akiphongkeosa aumin ahi. Ama chu akeng jetlam chu twikhanglen sunga adingin chule akeng veilam chu tolgo lai'ah apansan ahi.
en: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
text:
REV 10:2
Thadou: Chule akhut a chun lekhajol neokhat akiphongkeosa aumin ahi. Ama chu akeng jetlam chu twikhanglen sunga adingin chule akeng veilam chu tolgo lai'ah apansan ahi.
English: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

tcz: Chule ama chu keipi bahkai kitum'ah bangin agin kithongleuvin thu aseiye. Chuin ama chun kho ahinsap phat in, van gin sagi chun ahin donbut e.
en: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
text:
REV 10:3
Thadou: Chule ama chu keipi bahkai kitum'ah bangin agin kithongleuvin thu aseiye. Chuin ama chun kho ahinsap phat in, van gin sagi chun ahin donbut e.
English: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

tcz: Chuin van gin sagi chun thu aseiyin, keiman kajihgotan ahi. Hinla keiman vana konin aw khat kajan hitin aseiye, “Vang in sagi in athusei chu sel'in, jihdoh hihbeh in,” ati.
en: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”
text:
REV 10:4
Thadou: Chuin van gin sagi chun thu aseiyin, keiman kajihgotan ahi. Hinla keiman vana konin aw khat kajan hitin aseiye, “Vang in sagi in athusei chu sel'in, jihdoh hihbeh in,” ati.
English: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

tcz: Chupet a vantil twikhanglen chunga le tolgo laiya adin kamu chun akhut jetlam vanlam'ah adomsangin ahi.
en: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky
text:
REV 10:5
Thadou: Chupet a vantil twikhanglen chunga le tolgo laiya adin kamu chun akhut jetlam vanlam'ah adomsangin ahi.
English: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

tcz: Ama tonsot tonsot'a hing jing van le asunga umjouse, leiset le asunga umjouse, twikhanglen le asunga umjouse sempa mina chun akihahselin, ahi. Ama chun aseiyin “Khongaisot be talou ding ahitai.
en: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
text:
REV 10:6
Thadou: Ama tonsot tonsot'a hing jing van le asunga umjouse, leiset le asunga umjouse, twikhanglen le asunga umjouse sempa mina chun akihahselin, ahi. Ama chun aseiyin “Khongaisot be talou ding ahitai.
English: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

tcz: Vantil sagina chun asumkon ahin mut tengleh Pathen in kidang tah a athilgon chu guilhung ding ahi. Asohte themgao hon aphondoh banga chu hung guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
en: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.
text:
REV 10:7
Thadou: Vantil sagina chun asumkon ahin mut tengleh Pathen in kidang tah a athilgon chu guilhung ding ahi. Asohte themgao hon aphondoh banga chu hung guilhung ding ahi,” ati.
English: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

tcz: Chuphat in van'a kona aw chun eikihoupi kit in, “Gachen, lekhajol kihongsa chu twikhanglen chung le tolgo laiya ding vantil khut a konin galan,” eiti.
en: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”
text:
REV 10:8
Thadou: Chuphat in van'a kona aw chun eikihoupi kit in, “Gachen, lekhajol kihongsa chu twikhanglen chung le tolgo laiya ding vantil khut a konin galan,” eiti.
English: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

tcz: Hiti chun keima vantil koma chun kagachen chule amajah a chun lekhajol chu neipen tin kagaseitai. Aman, “Henge, kilah in lang, nen. Nakama dinga khoiju lhuma lhum ding, hinla na-oisung dinga thuhcheh chuh jeng ding ahi,” eiti.
en: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”
text:
REV 10:9
Thadou: Hiti chun keima vantil koma chun kagachen chule amajah a chun lekhajol chu neipen tin kagaseitai. Aman, “Henge, kilah in lang, nen. Nakama dinga khoiju lhuma lhum ding, hinla na-oisung dinga thuhcheh chuh jeng ding ahi,” eiti.
English: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

tcz: Hiti chun keiman lekhajol neocha chu vantil khut a kon chun kalan chuin kanetai! Hichu kakam'ah alhumin, hinla kaval phat in, kaoisunga chun athuhdohtai.
en: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
text:
REV 10:10
Thadou: Hiti chun keiman lekhajol neocha chu vantil khut a kon chun kalan chuin kanetai! Hichu kakam'ah alhumin, hinla kaval phat in, kaoisunga chun athuhdohtai.
English: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

tcz: Chuphat in keima eikiseipeh in, “Nangman mitampi ding, namtin dinga, paotin le lengho dinga gaova thu nasei tei ding ahije,” eiti.
en: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”
text:
REV 10:11
Thadou: Chuphat in keima eikiseipeh in, “Nangman mitampi ding, namtin dinga, paotin le lengho dinga gaova thu nasei tei ding ahije,” eiti.
English: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

tcz: Chupet in keima tetohna mol eikipei, chule keima eikiseipeh in, “Chenlang Pathen Hou-in le maicham gatenlang chule Pathen houho jat simdoh in.
en: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.
text:
REV 11:1
Thadou: Chupet in keima tetohna mol eikipei, chule keima eikiseipeh in, “Chenlang Pathen Hou-in le maicham gatenlang chule Pathen houho jat simdoh in.
English: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

tcz: Hinlah apolam vang tehih in, ijeh inem itileh hichu chidang namdang ho kipea ahitai. Amaho chun khopi theng chu lha-somli le ni atoupha dingu ahi.
en: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
text:
REV 11:2
Thadou: Hinlah apolam vang tehih in, ijeh inem itileh hichu chidang namdang ho kipea ahitai. Amaho chun khopi theng chu lha-somli le ni atoupha dingu ahi.
English: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

tcz: Chule athu hettohsah teni chu thaneina kapeh ding, chule amani chu khaodip pon'a kivon lhon'a chule ni sang khat ni jani le ni somni le gup; sunga gaothu aseilhon ding ahi.”
en: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”
text:
REV 11:3
Thadou: Chule athu hettohsah teni chu thaneina kapeh ding, chule amani chu khaodip pon'a kivon lhon'a chule ni sang khat ni jani le ni somni le gup; sunga gaothu aseilhon ding ahi.”
English: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

tcz: Hiche themgao teni hi Olive thing teni chu ahin, vannoi pumpi Pakai masanga dinga thaomeikhom teni chu ahi.
en: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.
text:
REV 11:4
Thadou: Hiche themgao teni hi Olive thing teni chu ahin, vannoi pumpi Pakai masanga dinga thaomeikhom teni chu ahi.
English: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

tcz: Koihileh amani alamlouva bol auma ahileh, akamlhon'a kona meikong lengdoh a chule amelmateu chu akahvam ding ahi. Hitia hi koi hijongleh amani alamlouva bol ho chu thi diu ahi.
en: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
text:
REV 11:5
Thadou: Koihileh amani alamlouva bol auma ahileh, akamlhon'a kona meikong lengdoh a chule amelmateu chu akahvam ding ahi. Hitia hi koi hijongleh amani alamlouva bol ho chu thi diu ahi.
English: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

tcz: Amanin van gotwi jong ajuhlouna dinga khamtang jeng thei thaneina, gaothusei theina anei lhon ahi. Chule amani hin vadung hole twipi ho chunga thisan sosah theina thuneina aneilhonin, chule leiset jeng jong hi gamna hise alhunsahnom nomna lhona alhunsahthei lhon ahi.
en: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
text:
REV 11:6
Thadou: Amanin van gotwi jong ajuhlouna dinga khamtang jeng thei thaneina, gaothusei theina anei lhon ahi. Chule amani hin vadung hole twipi ho chunga thisan sosah theina thuneina aneilhonin, chule leiset jeng jong hi gamna hise alhunsahnom nomna lhona alhunsahthei lhon ahi.
English: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

tcz: Amanin ahettohsah lhon natoh achai lhon tengleh, amongbei lei-onga kona hungdoh sahem chun amani dounaa gal ahinbol ding, chule amani chu ahinjo ding chule atha ding ahi.
en: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.
text:
REV 11:7
Thadou: Amanin ahettohsah lhon natoh achai lhon tengleh, amongbei lei-onga kona hungdoh sahem chun amani dounaa gal ahinbol ding, chule amani chu ahinjo ding chule atha ding ahi.
English: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

tcz: Chule atahsa lhon chu Jerusalem khopi lamlhongpia kijamden ding, hiche khopi chu avetsahna a “Sodom” le “Egypt” kisah a ahin, a Pakaiyu thingpel'a akhetbehnau khopi chu hiya ahi.
en: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.
text:
REV 11:8
Thadou: Chule atahsa lhon chu Jerusalem khopi lamlhongpia kijamden ding, hiche khopi chu avetsahna a “Sodom” le “Egypt” kisah a ahin, a Pakaiyu thingpel'a akhetbehnau khopi chu hiya ahi.
English: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

tcz: Chule ni thumle akeh sunga chu mi jouse, phung jouse, pao jouse chule namtin jouse chun atahsau chu avetvet dingu ahi. Koiman athilong lhon chu vui ding aphatsahlou diu ahi.
en: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
text:
REV 11:9
Thadou: Chule ni thumle akeh sunga chu mi jouse, phung jouse, pao jouse chule namtin jouse chun atahsau chu avetvet dingu ahi. Koiman athilong lhon chu vui ding aphatsahlou diu ahi.
English: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

tcz: Mijouse hiche vannoiya hiho chun vetnom'a avetvet jeng diu chule amaho bol hesoh'a pang, hettohsah teni ahilhon jeh'a kipana jal-a thilpeh kithotto diu ahi.
en: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
text:
REV 11:10
Thadou: Mijouse hiche vannoiya hiho chun vetnom'a avetvet jeng diu chule amaho bol hesoh'a pang, hettohsah teni ahilhon jeh'a kipana jal-a thilpeh kithotto diu ahi.
English: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

tcz: Hinlah ni thumle akeh jou tengleh Pathen in hinna hu alhakhumpeh lhona, chule amani hung dingdoh lhon ding ahi! Amani vejouse kichatna dim diu ahi.
en: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.
text:
REV 11:11
Thadou: Hinlah ni thumle akeh jou tengleh Pathen in hinna hu alhakhumpeh lhona, chule amani hung dingdoh lhon ding ahi! Amani vejouse kichatna dim diu ahi.
English: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

tcz: Chutengleh vana kona aw gingtah khat chun themgao teni chu, “Hikoma hin hungtou lhonin!” tia ahin kouding, chule amani chu vanlama meilhang khat'a amelmateuvin avetvetpet lhona kaltoulhon ding ahi.
en: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
text:
REV 11:12
Thadou: Chutengleh vana kona aw gingtah khat chun themgao teni chu, “Hikoma hin hungtou lhonin!” tia ahin kouding, chule amani chu vanlama meilhang khat'a amelmateuvin avetvetpet lhona kaltoulhon ding ahi.
English: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

tcz: Apettah chun gimneitah in ling ahung kihot in ahileh, khopi chu hop som a hop khat suhbeiyin aumtai. Hiche ling kihoa chun mi sang sagi athitai, chule amitin chu akichauvin, atijauvin chule van Pathen chu loupina apeuvin ahi.
en: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
text:
REV 11:13
Thadou: Apettah chun gimneitah in ling ahung kihot in ahileh, khopi chu hop som a hop khat suhbeiyin aumtai. Hiche ling kihoa chun mi sang sagi athitai, chule amitin chu akichauvin, atijauvin chule van Pathen chu loupina apeuvin ahi.
English: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

tcz: Kichat tijat umtah nina chu kichaiya ahitai, hinlah ven kichat tijat umtah athum na hunglhung pai jeng thei ahitai.
en: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.
text:
REV 11:14
Thadou: Kichat tijat umtah nina chu kichaiya ahitai, hinlah ven kichat tijat umtah athum na hunglhung pai jeng thei ahitai.
English: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

tcz: Chujou vin vantil asagi na pan asumkon amut'in ahileh, vana konchun aw tampi hung kithongdoh'a kisam akijan: “Vannoi hi tun I-Pakaiyu le A-Christa Lenggam ahung hitai, chule Aman atonsot atonsot a vai ahomding ahi,” ati.
en: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”
text:
REV 11:15
Thadou: Chujou vin vantil asagi na pan asumkon amut'in ahileh, vana konchun aw tampi hung kithongdoh'a kisam akijan: “Vannoi hi tun I-Pakaiyu le A-Christa Lenggam ahung hitai, chule Aman atonsot atonsot a vai ahomding ahi,” ati.
English: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

tcz: Upa somni le liho chu alaltounauva konin Pathen anga amaiyu tol'a asulut'un abohkhup un, chule Pathen chu ahou tauve.
en: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
text:
REV 11:16
Thadou: Upa somni le liho chu alaltounauva konin Pathen anga amaiyu tol'a asulut'un abohkhup un, chule Pathen chu ahou tauve.
English: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

tcz: Chuin amaho chun, “Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, a uma chule ana umjingsa Nangma kathangvah uve, ijeh ham itileh tun nangman nathaneina loupi chu nakilah tan, chule vainahom pantai.
en: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.
text:
REV 11:17
Thadou: Chuin amaho chun, “Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, a uma chule ana umjingsa Nangma kathangvah uve, ijeh ham itileh tun nangman nathaneina loupi chu nakilah tan, chule vainahom pantai.
English: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

tcz: Chidang namdang ho alung hanglheh tauvin, hinlah tun, nalunghanna phat chu hunglhunga ahitai. Tuhi athisaho thutan phat ahi; chule na themgao ho hihen, namithengte chule nangma min ging jouse, aneopen a pat alenpen geiya tohphatman peh phat ahi. Leiset chunga mahthahna hinlhut ho jouse suhmangna phat hunglhunga ahitai,” atiuve.
en: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
text:
REV 11:18
Thadou: Chidang namdang ho alung hanglheh tauvin, hinlah tun, nalunghanna phat chu hunglhunga ahitai. Tuhi athisaho thutan phat ahi; chule na themgao ho hihen, namithengte chule nangma min ging jouse, aneopen a pat alenpen geiya tohphatman peh phat ahi. Leiset chunga mahthahna hinlhut ho jouse suhmangna phat hunglhunga ahitai,” atiuve.
English: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

tcz: Chutah in van munah, Pathen Hou-in kot akihong in chule Hou-in sunga Kitepna Thingkong chu akimuphan ahi. Kawl ahungphen, van agingin, chuin vanthamjol pumpi akitol in, chule lingpi ahung kihot in, gel nasatah jong ahunglhan ahi.
en: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
text:
REV 11:19
Thadou: Chutah in van munah, Pathen Hou-in kot akihong in chule Hou-in sunga Kitepna Thingkong chu akimuphan ahi. Kawl ahungphen, van agingin, chuin vanthamjol pumpi akitol in, chule lingpi ahung kihot in, gel nasatah jong ahunglhan ahi.
English: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

tcz: Chupet chun keiman vana thil kidangtah khat kaveven ahileh numei khat Nisa a kijem, akengto noiya Lhathah um kamun, chule alua lallukhuh a chun Ahsi som le ni aumin ahi.
en: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
text:
REV 12:1
Thadou: Chupet chun keiman vana thil kidangtah khat kaveven ahileh numei khat Nisa a kijem, akengto noiya Lhathah um kamun, chule alua lallukhuh a chun Ahsi som le ni aumin ahi.
English: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

tcz: Amanu hi naovop ahin, chule naosonat athoh jeh in apengin, naosonatna chu athohgim lheh jengtai.
en: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
text:
REV 12:2
Thadou: Amanu hi naovop ahin, chule naosonat athoh jeh in apengin, naosonatna chu athohgim lheh jengtai.
English: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

tcz: Chupet in van kavet'a ahileh thil kidang achom khat kamudoh kit in ahi. Keiman dragon lentah asan khat chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule ki som aneiyin, chule aluchanga chun lallukhuh sagi akikhuh in ahi.
en: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
text:
REV 12:3
Thadou: Chupet in van kavet'a ahileh thil kidang achom khat kamudoh kit in ahi. Keiman dragon lentah asan khat chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule ki som aneiyin, chule aluchanga chun lallukhuh sagi akikhuh in ahi.
English: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

tcz: Amei chun vana Ahsi hop thum'a hop khat aloilhan, chuin leiset chunga ahinleh lhatai. Ama hin numei nu nao nei ding chu angah in, ahung penlhah lhah le anao chu vallhum dinga kigong ahi.
en: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
text:
REV 12:4
Thadou: Amei chun vana Ahsi hop thum'a hop khat aloilhan, chuin leiset chunga ahinleh lhatai. Ama hin numei nu nao nei ding chu angah in, ahung penlhah lhah le anao chu vallhum dinga kigong ahi.
English: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

tcz: Amanu hin chapa khat ahingin, ama chun chitin namtin chunga thihtengol-a vai ahinhom ding ahi. Chuin acha chu dragona konin akipomangin chule Pathen henga lahtouvin aum in chule alaltounaa aumtai.
en: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.
text:
REV 12:5
Thadou: Amanu hin chapa khat ahingin, ama chun chitin namtin chunga thihtengol-a vai ahinhom ding ahi. Chuin acha chu dragona konin akipomangin chule Pathen henga lahtouvin aum in chule alaltounaa aumtai.
English: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

tcz: Chuin numeinu chu Pathen in agonpehsa ni sang khat le ni jani le ni som gup sung chun, ama vetup din gamthip lam'a ajamdoh in ahi.
en: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.
text:
REV 12:6
Thadou: Chuin numeinu chu Pathen in agonpehsa ni sang khat le ni jani le ni som gup sung chun, ama vetup din gamthip lam'a ajamdoh in ahi.
English: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

tcz: Chuphat in Van mun'a gal ahung umtai. Michael le avantil ten dragon le ama vantilte chu asattauvin ahi.
en: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.
text:
REV 12:7
Thadou: Chuphat in Van mun'a gal ahung umtai. Michael le avantil ten dragon le ama vantilte chu asattauvin ahi.
English: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

tcz: Chuin dragon chun gal chu aleltan, hiti chun ama le avantilte chu vana konin nodoh ahitauve.
en: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.
text:
REV 12:8
Thadou: Chuin dragon chun gal chu aleltan, hiti chun ama le avantilte chu vana konin nodoh ahitauve.
English: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

tcz: Hiche dragon lentah chu—masanglai peh'a gul kiti Diabol ahilouleh Satan, vannoi pumpi lhemlhapa ahin, ama chu avantilte jouse toh leiset a ahin kinolhatai.
en: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.
text:
REV 12:9
Thadou: Hiche dragon lentah chu—masanglai peh'a gul kiti Diabol ahilouleh Satan, vannoi pumpi lhemlhapa ahin, ama chu avantilte jouse toh leiset a ahin kinolhatai.
English: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman aw gingleng lung khat vanthamjol-a akisap kajai. “Achainakeiyin-sochatna le thahatna chule IPathen'u Lenggam chule a-Christa thuneina chu hunga ahitai. Ijeh ham itileh isopiteu hehsepa, IPathen masanga sun le jana hehsepa, chu leiset'a akison lhatai.
en: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.
text:
REV 12:10
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman aw gingleng lung khat vanthamjol-a akisap kajai. “Achainakeiyin-sochatna le thahatna chule IPathen'u Lenggam chule a-Christa thuneina chu hunga ahitai. Ijeh ham itileh isopiteu hehsepa, IPathen masanga sun le jana hehsepa, chu leiset'a akison lhatai.
English: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

tcz: Chule amahon ama hi Kelngoinou thisan le athu hettohsah jal-a ajo ahi. Chule amahon ahinkhou angailupouvin, thigeija kiphaldoh a ahitauve.
en: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.
text:
REV 12:11
Thadou: Chule amahon ama hi Kelngoinou thisan le athu hettohsah jal-a ajo ahi. Chule amahon ahinkhou angailupouvin, thigeija kiphaldoh a ahitauve.
English: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

tcz: Hijeh chun, Vo vanho kipah uvin! Chule vana cheng ho, kipah uvin! Hinlah leiset chunga le twikhanglen'a kichat tijat hunglhung ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh diabol chun phat chomcha bou anei ahi chu akihetjeh'a, lunghanna sangpen a leiset'a hung kumlha ahitai.”
en: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”
text:
REV 12:12
Thadou: Hijeh chun, Vo vanho kipah uvin! Chule vana cheng ho, kipah uvin! Hinlah leiset chunga le twikhanglen'a kichat tijat hunglhung ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh diabol chun phat chomcha bou anei ahi chu akihetjeh'a, lunghanna sangpen a leiset'a hung kumlha ahitai.”
English: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

tcz: Dragon chun leiset chunga nolhah'a aum chu akihet phat in, aman chapa hingnu numeinu chu anungdelpeh in ahi.
en: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.
text:
REV 12:13
Thadou: Dragon chun leiset chunga nolhah'a aum chu akihet phat in, aman chapa hingnu numeinu chu anungdelpeh in ahi.
English: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

tcz: Hinlah amanu chu mulaopi lentah lhaving tobang lhaving ni, gamthip'a chu ama dinga gotsa mun'a chu agalenlutna ding kigonpeh ahi. Chua chu amanu hi kivetup a chule dragon a kona chu ahoidoh nading phatkhat, phat ho chule phatkeh khat chu kihongbit ding ahi.
en: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
text:
REV 12:14
Thadou: Hinlah amanu chu mulaopi lentah lhaving tobang lhaving ni, gamthip'a chu ama dinga gotsa mun'a chu agalenlutna ding kigonpeh ahi. Chua chu amanu hi kivetup a chule dragon a kona chu ahoidoh nading phatkhat, phat ho chule phatkeh khat chu kihongbit ding ahi.
English: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

tcz: Chuphat in dragon chun numeinu chu twisoh lhohsah'a aumna dingin akama kon chun twisoh ahinsosah in ahi.
en: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.
text:
REV 12:15
Thadou: Chuphat in dragon chun numeinu chu twisoh lhohsah'a aumna dingin akama kon chun twisoh ahinsosah in ahi.
English: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

tcz: Hinlah leiset in amanu chu akithopin akam akan chule dragon kam'a kon hunglongdoh vadung twisoh chu avallhumin ahi.
en: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.
text:
REV 12:16
Thadou: Hinlah leiset in amanu chu akithopin akam akan chule dragon kam'a kon hunglongdoh vadung twisoh chu avallhumin ahi.
English: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

tcz: Chuin dragon chu numeinu chunga chule numeinu sonle chilhahho Pathen Thupeh ho jui'a, chule Yeshua jal-a ahinau kituh chah ho chunga chun alung hangin ahi.
en: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.
text:
REV 12:17
Thadou: Chuin dragon chu numeinu chunga chule numeinu sonle chilhahho Pathen Thupeh ho jui'a, chule Yeshua jal-a ahinau kituh chah ho chunga chun alung hangin ahi.
English: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her offspring, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman sahem khat twikhanglen'a kon hungpot doh chu kamun ahi. Sahem chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule aki som, chule lallukhuh som akikhuh cheh uvin ahi. Aluchang cheh chunga chun Pathen taitomna thucheng akijih in ahi.
en: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.
text:
REV 13:1
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman sahem khat twikhanglen'a kon hungpot doh chu kamun ahi. Sahem chun lu sagi aneiyin, chule aki som, chule lallukhuh som akikhuh cheh uvin ahi. Aluchang cheh chunga chun Pathen taitomna thucheng akijih in ahi.
English: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

tcz: Hiche sahem hi lutnu tobang ahi, hinlah akeng chu vompi kengto abangin chule akam chu keipi kamto abangin ahi! Chule dragon chun sahem chu athahatna, athaneina, alaltouna chule athuneina loupi chu apetai.
en: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.
text:
REV 13:2
Thadou: Hiche sahem hi lutnu tobang ahi, hinlah akeng chu vompi kengto abangin chule akam chu keipi kamto abangin ahi! Chule dragon chun sahem chu athahatna, athaneina, alaltouna chule athuneina loupi chu apetai.
English: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

tcz: Keiman sahem luho lah'a khat chu damdoh jou talou ding hile kilom mahapu chu kamun ahi. Hinlah amaha putna chu adamdohtai! Hiche thil kidangtah chu vannoi pumpin adatmo lheh jengun chule sahem thunoiya chun akipelut tauve.
en: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.
text:
REV 13:3
Thadou: Keiman sahem luho lah'a khat chu damdoh jou talou ding hile kilom mahapu chu kamun ahi. Hinlah amaha putna chu adamdohtai! Hiche thil kidangtah chu vannoi pumpin adatmo lheh jengun chule sahem thunoiya chun akipelut tauve.
English: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

tcz: Amaho chun sahem chutobang tah'a thaneina pepa chu Pathen houvin ahou un, chule sahem jong chu ahou un, “Sahem tobanga lenchungnung koi umintem? Koiham ama dou ngapcha ding,” atiuve.
en: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”
text:
REV 13:4
Thadou: Amaho chun sahem chutobang tah'a thaneina pepa chu Pathen houvin ahou un, chule sahem jong chu ahou un, “Sahem tobanga lenchungnung koi umintem? Koiham ama dou ngapcha ding,” atiuve.
English: They worshiped the dragon because he gave his authority to the beast; and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

tcz: Chuphat in sahem chu Pathen taitomna khoh setah chu seidoh dinga phatsahna kipea ahi. Chule ama chu ipi hijongleh abol nomchan chu boldinga thaneina lha som li le ni phalna kipea ahi.
en: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.
text:
REV 13:5
Thadou: Chuphat in sahem chu Pathen taitomna khoh setah chu seidoh dinga phatsahna kipea ahi. Chule ama chu ipi hijongleh abol nomchan chu boldinga thaneina lha som li le ni phalna kipea ahi.
English: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

tcz: Chule amachun hoisetah'a Pathen dounaa taitomna–Amin le Achenna mun taimona thuho aseiyin ahi.
en: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.
text:
REV 13:6
Thadou: Chule amachun hoisetah'a Pathen dounaa taitomna–Amin le Achenna mun taimona thuho aseiyin ahi.
English: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, his dwelling, and those who dwell in heaven.

tcz: Chule sahem chu Pathen mithengte kisatpi dinga, chule amaho chu jou dinga phalna kipea ahi. Ama chu phungtin le miho le pao chule nam jouse chunga thuneina kipea ahi.
en: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.
text:
REV 13:7
Thadou: Chule sahem chu Pathen mithengte kisatpi dinga, chule amaho chu jou dinga phalna kipea ahi. Ama chu phungtin le miho le pao chule nam jouse chunga thuneina kipea ahi.
English: It was given to him to make war with the saints and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

tcz: Hiche vannoiya hiho jouse chun ahou diu ahi. Amaho chu vannoi kisem masang peh'a pat'a Akithatsa Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kisunlou chengse chun ahou tauve.
en: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.
text:
REV 13:8
Thadou: Hiche vannoiya hiho jouse chun ahou diu ahi. Amaho chu vannoi kisem masang peh'a pat'a Akithatsa Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kisunlou chengse chun ahou tauve.
English: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

tcz: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.
en: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
text:
REV 13:9
Thadou: Koi hileh Houbung ho henga Lhagao thusei angaina ding nakol neiya chule hetkhenna neichan chun ngaihen.
English: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

tcz: Koi hileh songkul-a lut dinga kigongsaho chu songkullut ding ahiuve. Chule chemjam'a lou dinga kigongsaho chu chemjama thi diu ahi. Hiche hin athudoi chu Pathen mithengte chun thoh hattah'a gimbol hesohna athoh a chule tahsan umtah hiding ahiuve.
en: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
text:
REV 13:10
Thadou: Koi hileh songkul-a lut dinga kigongsaho chu songkullut ding ahiuve. Chule chemjam'a lou dinga kigongsaho chu chemjama thi diu ahi. Hiche hin athudoi chu Pathen mithengte chun thoh hattah'a gimbol hesohna athoh a chule tahsan umtah hiding ahiuve.
English: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman sahem chomdang khat leiset a kon ahung potdoh kamui. Ama chun kelngoi bang in ki ni aneiyin, ahin sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan; hinlah ama chun dragon tobang'in thu aseiye.
en: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.
text:
REV 13:11
Thadou: Chujou chun keiman sahem chomdang khat leiset a kon ahung potdoh kamui. Ama chun kelngoi bang in ki ni aneiyin, ahin sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan; hinlah ama chun dragon tobang'in thu aseiye.
English: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb and it spoke like a dragon.

tcz: Ama chun sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan, chule ama chun leiset chung pumpi le mijouse chun sahem masapa athi chan geiya dinga kimavo chu Pathen-houva hou dingin angeh in ahi.
en: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
text:
REV 13:12
Thadou: Ama chun sahem masapa thuneina jouse chu amangchan, chule ama chun leiset chung pumpi le mijouse chun sahem masapa athi chan geiya dinga kimavo chu Pathen-houva hou dingin angeh in ahi.
English: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

tcz: Ama chun datmo um tahtah thil kidang abol in, ama chun mihon avet pettah uva mei jeng jong chu vana kon leiset'a ahin lenlhahsah in ahi.
en: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.
text:
REV 13:13
Thadou: Ama chun datmo um tahtah thil kidang abol in, ama chun mihon avet pettah uva mei jeng jong chu vana kon leiset'a ahin lenlhahsah in ahi.
English: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

tcz: Aman thil kidang abol jouse chu sahem masapa tha lhenga chu aboltheina dinga aphatsah peh ahin, chuche dung juiya ama chun leiset pumpia mi jouse jouva lhepna anei ahi. Aman miho chun sahem nasapa thinathei leuva kimavopa hung damdoh kit lim lentah chu sem dingin thu apen ahi.
en: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.
text:
REV 13:14
Thadou: Aman thil kidang abol jouse chu sahem masapa tha lhenga chu aboltheina dinga aphatsah peh ahin, chuche dung juiya ama chun leiset pumpia mi jouse jouva lhepna anei ahi. Aman miho chun sahem nasapa thinathei leuva kimavopa hung damdoh kit lim lentah chu sem dingin thu apen ahi.
English: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast, saying to those who dwell on the earth that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

tcz: Hiche milim kisemthu chu hinna petheiya thusei thei dingin phatsah pehna akineiyin ahi. Chuphat in sahem lim kisem chun thu apen koi hileh ahoulou jouse chu thi ding ahi, ati.
en: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.
text:
REV 13:15
Thadou: Hiche milim kisemthu chu hinna petheiya thusei thei dingin phatsah pehna akineiyin ahi. Chuphat in sahem lim kisem chun thu apen koi hileh ahoulou jouse chu thi ding ahi, ati.
English: It was given to him to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

tcz: Ama chun amitin aneo le alen, ahao le avai, chamlhat le soh hijongleh khut jetlam ahilouleh achalpanga melchihna chu kitah dingin asolin ahi.
en: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands or on their foreheads;

tcz: Chule koiman chuche melchihna neilouvin johtheilou ding ahilouleh chotheilou ding, hichu sahem min ahilouva ahileh amin khel-a number hiding ahi.
en: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.
text:
REV 13:17
Thadou: Chule koiman chuche melchihna neilouvin johtheilou ding ahilouleh chotheilou ding, hichu sahem min ahilouva ahileh amin khel-a number hiding ahi.
English: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell unless he has that mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of his name.

tcz: Hichea hin chihna angaiye. Hetkhen themna neimi chun sahem number in ipi kiseina ahi hedoh hen, ijeh inem itileh hichu mihem number ahi. Ama number chu 666 ahi.
en: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.
text:
REV 13:18
Thadou: Hichea hin chihna angaiye. Hetkhen themna neimi chun sahem number in ipi kiseina ahi hedoh hen, ijeh inem itileh hichu mihem number ahi. Ama number chu 666 ahi.
English: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman Kelngoinou chu Zion Mol chunga adin kamun, chule Ama chutoh mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li chalpanga Ama min le Apa min kijih chu kamun ahi.
en: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.
text:
REV 14:1
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman Kelngoinou chu Zion Mol chunga adin kamun, chule Ama chutoh mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li chalpanga Ama min le Apa min kijih chu kamun ahi.
English: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written on their foreheads.

tcz: Chule keiman vana kon twikhanglen kinong gin tobang leuva hugin ahilouleh van-gin kitol tobang chu kajan ahi. Hiche gin umdan chu selangdah tampi kitumging tobang leuvin ahung kithongdoh in ahi.
en: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.
text:
REV 14:2
Thadou: Chule keiman vana kon twikhanglen kinong gin tobang leuva hugin ahilouleh van-gin kitol tobang chu kajan ahi. Hiche gin umdan chu selangdah tampi kitumging tobang leuvin ahung kithongdoh in ahi.
English: I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

tcz: Hiche lasaho tamtah chun lathah kidangtah chu Pathen Laltouna masangleh Hinnanei li ho masang chule upa somni le li ho masanga chun asauve. Hiche la hi koimacha dang in sathem theilou mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li leiset a kon lhatdam changho bouvin asahtheiyu ahi.
en: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.
text:
REV 14:3
Thadou: Hiche lasaho tamtah chun lathah kidangtah chu Pathen Laltouna masangleh Hinnanei li ho masang chule upa somni le li ho masanga chun asauve. Hiche la hi koimacha dang in sathem theilou mi sang jakhat le sang som li le sang li leiset a kon lhatdam changho bouvin asahtheiyu ahi.
English: They sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

tcz: Amaho hi nungah-thengsel ho tobanga kivet tupna nei ahiuvin, Kelngoinou chu achena chan-a juiya ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi vannoi leiset mitea kon'a Pathen le Kelngoinou dinga kikatdoh theng lhatdam changsaho chu ahiuve.
en: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
text:
REV 14:4
