Thadou: Amaho hi nungah-thengsel ho tobanga kivet tupna nei ahiuvin, Kelngoinou chu achena chan-a juiya ahiuve. Amaho chengse hi vannoi leiset mitea kon'a Pathen le Kelngoinou dinga kikatdoh theng lhatdam changsaho chu ahiuve.
English: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

tcz: Amaho hi jou seikha louhel, nolna beihel hinkho mang ahiuve.
en: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.
text:
REV 14:5
Thadou: Amaho hi jou seikha louhel, nolna beihel hinkho mang ahiuve.
English: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

tcz: Chule keiman vantil chom dang khat vantham jol'a lenglelea tonsot Kipana Thupha chu hiche vannoi mite namtin, phungtin, paotin, chule miho jah a,
en: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
text:
REV 14:6
Thadou: Chule keiman vantil chom dang khat vantham jol'a lenglelea tonsot Kipana Thupha chu hiche vannoi mite namtin, phungtin, paotin, chule miho jah a,
English: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

tcz: “Pathen gingun, Amaa loupina peuvin. Ijeh ham itileh Aman thu atanna ding phat hunglhunga ahitai. Vanho le leiset, twikhanglen le twinah ho jouse sempa chu Hou un,” tin asamin ahi.
en: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”
text:
REV 14:7
Thadou: “Pathen gingun, Amaa loupina peuvin. Ijeh ham itileh Aman thu atanna ding phat hunglhunga ahitai. Vanho le leiset, twikhanglen le twinah ho jouse sempa chu Hou un,” tin asamin ahi.
English: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

tcz: Chujouvin vanlai jol'a vantil chom dang khat in ama chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Babylon hi achim-a ahitai, chuche khopi lentah chu achimtai, ajeh chu amanu hin vannoi namtin jouse ajonthanhoi jeh'a lunghanna lengpiju chitin namtin le phungtin adonsah ahi,” ati.
en: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”
text:
REV 14:8
Thadou: Chujouvin vanlai jol'a vantil chom dang khat in ama chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Babylon hi achim-a ahitai, chuche khopi lentah chu achimtai, ajeh chu amanu hin vannoi namtin jouse ajonthanhoi jeh'a lunghanna lengpiju chitin namtin le phungtin adonsah ahi,” ati.
English: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

tcz: Chujouvin vantil thumna chun amani nung chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Koi hileh sahem le alim chu Pathen houva hou ahilouleh amelchihna achalpang ahilouleh akhut jetlam'a kibeh achun,
en: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
text:
REV 14:9
Thadou: Chujouvin vantil thumna chun amani nung chu ajuiyin, asamin, “Koi hileh sahem le alim chu Pathen houva hou ahilouleh amelchihna achalpang ahilouleh akhut jetlam'a kibeh achun,
English: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,

tcz: Pathen lunghanna khon'a chu lhingsetna kisung lha a umsa chu adon ding ahi. Chule amaho chu mei le kath'a Kelngoinou le avantil thengte masanga chu kisugim diu ahi.
en: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.
text:
REV 14:10
Thadou: Pathen lunghanna khon'a chu lhingsetna kisung lha a umsa chu adon ding ahi. Chule amaho chu mei le kath'a Kelngoinou le avantil thengte masanga chu kisugim diu ahi.
English: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb.

tcz: Amaho kigimbolna meikhu chu a-itih a ding ahi, chule amaho kigimbolna chu sun le jana angah tih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh amaho chun sahem le alim chu ahou'un chule ama melchihna akisan uvin ahi.
en: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.
text:
REV 14:11
Thadou: Amaho kigimbolna meikhu chu a-itih a ding ahi, chule amaho kigimbolna chu sun le jana angah tih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh amaho chun sahem le alim chu ahou'un chule ama melchihna akisan uvin ahi.
English: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

tcz: Hiche hin Pathen mithengte chun gimbol hesohna thoh hattah'a athoh diu, athupeh ho anit diu, athupeh ho anit uva chule Yeshua atahsan nauva alung-u angapdet diu ahi.
en: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”
text:
REV 14:12
Thadou: Hiche hin Pathen mithengte chun gimbol hesohna thoh hattah'a athoh diu, athupeh ho anit diu, athupeh ho anit uva chule Yeshua atahsan nauva alung-u angapdet diu ahi.
English: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.”

tcz: Chule keiman vana kon in aw khat in hitia asei kajai, “Hiche hi jihdoh in: Tua pat'a Pakaiya thiho anunnomui. Ahiye, tin Lhagaovin aseiye, amaho anunnom monga ahiuve, ijeh inem itileh amaho anatoh gimnauva kon'a kicholdoa ahitauvin; athilpha boluvin anung-u ajuiye.”
en: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”
text:
REV 14:13
Thadou: Chule keiman vana kon in aw khat in hitia asei kajai, “Hiche hi jihdoh in: Tua pat'a Pakaiya thiho anunnomui. Ahiye, tin Lhagaovin aseiye, amaho anunnom monga ahiuve, ijeh inem itileh amaho anatoh gimnauva kon'a kicholdoa ahitauvin; athilpha boluvin anung-u ajuiye.”
English: I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.”

tcz: Chujou chun keiman meibol bangleh khat kamun chule meibol chunga toupa chu Mihem Chapa lheh lheh ahi. Ama chun Sana lallukhuh alua akikhuh in chule akhut a chun koite hemtah khat akichoi in ahi.
en: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
text:
REV 14:14
Thadou: Chujou chun keiman meibol bangleh khat kamun chule meibol chunga toupa chu Mihem Chapa lheh lheh ahi. Ama chun Sana lallukhuh alua akikhuh in chule akhut a chun koite hemtah khat akichoi in ahi.
English: I looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chom dang khat Hou-in a kon chun ahungin, meibol chunga toupa chu asamin, “Koite chu kilap pantan, ijeh ham itileh chang atphat chu hunglhunga ahitai: leiset chunga chang ga chu min ahitai,” ati.
en: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”
text:
REV 14:15
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil chom dang khat Hou-in a kon chun ahungin, meibol chunga toupa chu asamin, “Koite chu kilap pantan, ijeh ham itileh chang atphat chu hunglhunga ahitai: leiset chunga chang ga chu min ahitai,” ati.
English: Another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

tcz: Hiti chun meibol lah'a toupa chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampan in, chule leiset pumpi chu akiat chaitai.
en: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
text:
REV 14:16
Thadou: Hiti chun meibol lah'a toupa chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampan in, chule leiset pumpi chu akiat chaitai.
English: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

tcz: Hiche jou chun, van Hou-in a kon chun vantil chom khat ahungin, chule ama jong chun koite hemtah khat aneiye.
en: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.
text:
REV 14:17
Thadou: Hiche jou chun, van Hou-in a kon chun vantil chom khat ahungin, chule ama jong chun koite hemtah khat aneiye.
English: Another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chomkhat, meiya kon'a suhmang theina thaneina neipa chu maicham'a konin ahunge. Ama chun koite hemtah choi vantil chu ahinsamin, “Na koite chu tun kilap pan in lang leiset lengpiga aboh a konin khom khomtan, ijeh ham itileh athutan dinga min'a ahitai,” ati.
en: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”
text:
REV 14:18
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil chomkhat, meiya kon'a suhmang theina thaneina neipa chu maicham'a konin ahunge. Ama chun koite hemtah choi vantil chu ahinsamin, “Na koite chu tun kilap pan in lang leiset lengpiga aboh a konin khom khomtan, ijeh ham itileh athutan dinga min'a ahitai,” ati.
English: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

tcz: Hiti chun vantil chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampanin, chule lengpiga chu Pathen lunghanna lengpiga hehna a chun asepluttan ahi.
en: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.
text:
REV 14:19
Thadou: Hiti chun vantil chun akoite chu leiset chunga chun alampanin, chule lengpiga chu Pathen lunghanna lengpiga hehna a chun asepluttan ahi.
English: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of God.

tcz: Lengpithei gaho chu khopi pamlam'a lengpiga hehna a akichillut tan, chule lengpiga hehna a kon chun thisan chu vacha hunglongdoh bangin; mile jakhat le somget saovin twilon in alongin, chule sakol kamdal chan ahung geidoh in ahi.
en: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
text:
REV 14:20
Thadou: Lengpithei gaho chu khopi pamlam'a lengpiga hehna a akichillut tan, chule lengpiga hehna a kon chun thisan chu vacha hunglongdoh bangin; mile jakhat le somget saovin twilon in alongin, chule sakol kamdal chan ahung geidoh in ahi.
English: The wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

tcz: Chutah in keiman datmo umtah thilsoh kidang khat vana kamun ahi. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise achaina sagi ho chu akhut uva achoiyun, hichun Pathen lunghanna chu asuhbulhit ding ahi.
en: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.
text:
REV 15:1
Thadou: Chutah in keiman datmo umtah thilsoh kidang khat vana kamun ahi. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise achaina sagi ho chu akhut uva achoiyun, hichun Pathen lunghanna chu asuhbulhit ding ahi.
English: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

tcz: Keiman kamasanga chun phatvet twikhanglen meitoh kihal chu kamui. Chule achunga chun sahem le alim chule anumber ama thalhenga kimang, chunga galjou miho jouse adin-u chu kamun ahi. Amaho chun abonchauvin akhut'uva Pathen in apeh-u selangdah akichoicheh uvin ahi.
en: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.
text:
REV 15:2
Thadou: Keiman kamasanga chun phatvet twikhanglen meitoh kihal chu kamui. Chule achunga chun sahem le alim chule anumber ama thalhenga kimang, chunga galjou miho jouse adin-u chu kamun ahi. Amaho chun abonchauvin akhut'uva Pathen in apeh-u selangdah akichoicheh uvin ahi.
English: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

tcz: Chule amaho chun, Pathen sohpa Mose la le Kelngoinou la chu asauvin: “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, nathilbol ho akidangin chule Aloupi lhehjenge. Vo namtin Lengpa, nalamlhah ho dihtah le kitah tah ahi.
en: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.
text:
REV 15:3
Thadou: Chule amaho chun, Pathen sohpa Mose la le Kelngoinou la chu asauvin: “Vo Hatchungnung Pakai Pathen, nathilbol ho akidangin chule Aloupi lhehjenge. Vo namtin Lengpa, nalamlhah ho dihtah le kitah tah ahi.
English: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

tcz: Vo Pakai, koiham nangma naging'a chule loupina napelou dinga! Ajeh chu nangma bou athenga nahi. Namtin vaipi hung intin nangma masang'a nahung hou diu ahi, ajeh iham itileh nathilpha bol ho chu hung kiphongdoh'a ahitai.”
en: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”
text:
REV 15:4
Thadou: Vo Pakai, koiham nangma naging'a chule loupina napelou dinga! Ajeh chu nangma bou athenga nahi. Namtin vaipi hung intin nangma masang'a nahung hou diu ahi, ajeh iham itileh nathilpha bol ho chu hung kiphongdoh'a ahitai.”
English: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

tcz: Chuphat in keiman kaven ahileh vana Houin chu kamun, Pathen Houna kong chu ahung ki hongdoh jenge.
en: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
text:
REV 15:5
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman kaven ahileh vana Houin chu kamun, Pathen Houna kong chu ahung ki hongdoh jenge.
English: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

tcz: Vantil sagi ho, gamna hoise sagi choi ho chu Houin a kon ahungdoh un ahi. Amaho chun ponbang vamleh nolnabei sana jem chu alengkouva akibandoh un ahi.
en: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
text:
REV 15:6
Thadou: Vantil sagi ho, gamna hoise sagi choi ho chu Houin a kon ahungdoh un ahi. Amaho chun ponbang vamleh nolnabei sana jem chu alengkouva akibandoh un ahi.
English: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.

tcz: Chuphat in Hinna nei li ho lah'a khat chun Pathen tonsot tonsot'a hingjing, lunghanna dimset sana khon chu vantil sagi ho chu khatcheh apen ahi.
en: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.
text:
REV 15:7
Thadou: Chuphat in Hinna nei li ho lah'a khat chun Pathen tonsot tonsot'a hingjing, lunghanna dimset sana khon chu vantil sagi ho chu khatcheh apen ahi.
English: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

tcz: Hou-in sung chu Pathen loupina le thaneina meikhu chun adip dimset jenge. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise sagi chu asunlhah chai masangse chun koima Hou-in sunga chun aluttheipon ahi.
en: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
text:
REV 15:8
Thadou: Hou-in sung chu Pathen loupina le thaneina meikhu chun adip dimset jenge. Vantil sagi ho chun gamna hoise sagi chu asunlhah chai masangse chun koima Hou-in sunga chun aluttheipon ahi.
English: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

tcz: Chuphat in keiman Hou'in sunga kon'a vantil sagi ho jah'a aw kithongleuva thu kisei kajah chun, “Gacheuvin lang Pathen lunghanna sumlheng sagi ho chu leiset chunga gasung lhatauvin,” ati.
en: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”
text:
REV 16:1
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman Hou'in sunga kon'a vantil sagi ho jah'a aw kithongleuva thu kisei kajah chun, “Gacheuvin lang Pathen lunghanna sumlheng sagi ho chu leiset chunga gasung lhatauvin,” ati.
English: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

tcz: Hiti chun vantil khatna chun Hou'in chu adalhan chuin asumlheng chu leiset chunga asunlhah'a ahileh, sahem melchihna kilah ho ahilouleh sahem houho jouse chunga chun hoisetah'a tipom'a natna tina-maha ahung umdohtai.
en: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
text:
REV 16:2
Thadou: Hiti chun vantil khatna chun Hou'in chu adalhan chuin asumlheng chu leiset chunga asunlhah'a ahileh, sahem melchihna kilah ho ahilouleh sahem houho jouse chunga chun hoisetah'a tipom'a natna tina-maha ahung umdohtai.
English: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil nina chun asumlheng chu twikhanglen'a asunlhah'a ahileh, twi chu mithisa thisan tobang ahijenge. Chuin twikhanglen'a umjouse athigamtai.
en: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.
text:
REV 16:3
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil nina chun asumlheng chu twikhanglen'a asunlhah'a ahileh, twi chu mithisa thisan tobang ahijenge. Chuin twikhanglen'a umjouse athigamtai.
English: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

tcz: Chuin vantil thumna chun asumlheng chu vadung le twinah'a asunlhah'a ahileh, thisan asohgamtai.
en: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
text:
REV 16:4
Thadou: Chuin vantil thumna chun asumlheng chu vadung le twinah'a asunlhah'a ahileh, thisan asohgamtai.
English: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

tcz: Chule twi chung jousea thunei vantil chun asei kajah chu, “Vo Athengpa, nangman hiche thutanna hi naneitah jeh in, adihtah a anaum jingsa nahi.
en: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.
text:
REV 16:5
Thadou: Chule twi chung jousea thunei vantil chun asei kajah chu, “Vo Athengpa, nangman hiche thutanna hi naneitah jeh in, adihtah a anaum jingsa nahi.
English: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, O Holy One, because you have judged these things.

tcz: Amahon namithengte le na themgao ho thisan asotah jeh uvin, nangman amaho chandinga kilom'a nagel thisan chu dondinga napeh ahitai” ati.
en: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
text:
REV 16:6
Thadou: Amahon namithengte le na themgao ho thisan asotah jeh uvin, nangman amaho chandinga kilom'a nagel thisan chu dondinga napeh ahitai” ati.
English: For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

tcz: Chule keiman maicham'a konin aw khat kajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Ahinai Pakai Pathen, Hatchungnung pen, nathutanna ho hi adih in chule akitah e,” ati.
en: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”
text:
REV 16:7
Thadou: Chule keiman maicham'a konin aw khat kajah chun hitin aseiyin, “Ahinai Pakai Pathen, Hatchungnung pen, nathutanna ho hi adih in chule akitah e,” ati.
English: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

tcz: Chuphat in vantil li-na chun asumlheng chu nisa chunga asunglhan ahileh, amitin chu ameisa sat chun akatan ahi.
en: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
text:
REV 16:8
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil li-na chun asumlheng chu nisa chunga asunglhan ahileh, amitin chu ameisa sat chun akatan ahi.
English: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

tcz: Amitin meisat chun akatan, chule hiche gimna hoise hinsodoh'a Pathen min chu agaosap un ahi. Amaho chu achonsetnau lunggel akhel deh pouvin, chule Pathen lam'a lungheina aneipouvin, chule Ama loupina apenom pouvin ahi.
en: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.
text:
REV 16:9
Thadou: Amitin meisat chun akatan, chule hiche gimna hoise hinsodoh'a Pathen min chu agaosap un ahi. Amaho chu achonsetnau lunggel akhel deh pouvin, chule Pathen lam'a lungheina aneipouvin, chule Ama loupina apenom pouvin ahi.
English: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

tcz: Chuin vantil nga na chun asumlheng chu laltouna a tou sahem chunga chun asunglhan ahileh, alenggam chu muthim sunga aluttai. Amite chun lunghemin aha-u ageltauvin ahi.
en: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
text:
REV 16:10
Thadou: Chuin vantil nga na chun asumlheng chu laltouna a tou sahem chunga chun asunglhan ahileh, alenggam chu muthim sunga aluttai. Amite chun lunghemin aha-u ageltauvin ahi.
English: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

tcz: Chule amaho chun anat thoh ule anatnau maha jeh chun van Pathen chu agaosap uvin ahi. Hinlah amaho chu thilphalou abol-uva konin alunghei dehpouvin, chule Pathen'a ahung kiheideh pouve.
en: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.
text:
REV 16:11
Thadou: Chule amaho chun anat thoh ule anatnau maha jeh chun van Pathen chu agaosap uvin ahi. Hinlah amaho chu thilphalou abol-uva konin alunghei dehpouvin, chule Pathen'a ahung kiheideh pouve.
English: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They still didn’t repent of their works.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil gupna chun asumlheng chu Euphrates Vadung len'a chun asunglhan ahileh hichu akang jeng in, hiti chun solam lengho galmi, sepaite chu kisunoh phahna beihel in lhumlang ngan ahung kijotlut tauve.
en: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
text:
REV 16:12
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil gupna chun asumlheng chu Euphrates Vadung len'a chun asunglhan ahileh hichu akang jeng in, hiti chun solam lengho galmi, sepaite chu kisunoh phahna beihel in lhumlang ngan ahung kijotlut tauve.
English: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

tcz: Chule keiman lhagao gilou thum uphoh ho tobang jeng chu dragon, sahem chule themgao lhem kam'a konin ahung potdoh kamun ahi.
en: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

tcz: Amaho chu lhagaophalou thil kidangtah tah bol ahiuvin, Chule amaho chu vannoi vaipo ho jouse koma gachedoh uva; Pakai chu gal-a kidoupi dinga Hatchungnung Pathen thutanna niloupi hunglhung dinga chu akhop khom diu ahi.
en: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.
text:
REV 16:14
Thadou: Amaho chu lhagaophalou thil kidangtah tah bol ahiuvin, Chule amaho chu vannoi vaipo ho jouse koma gachedoh uva; Pakai chu gal-a kidoupi dinga Hatchungnung Pathen thutanna niloupi hunglhung dinga chu akhop khom diu ahi.
English: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God the Almighty.

tcz: “Ven, keima gucha tobanga gel loupet'a hung ding kahi! Keima eingah jinga, sagoh le jahcha a avale louna diuva aponsil-u gottupsa kikoi ho chu anunnom ahiuve.”
en: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”
text:
REV 16:15
Thadou: “Ven, keima gucha tobanga gel loupet'a hung ding kahi! Keima eingah jinga, sagoh le jahcha a avale louna diuva aponsil-u gottupsa kikoi ho chu anunnom ahiuve.”
English: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

tcz: Chule lhagao phalou ho chun vaipo ho jouse le galmi, sepai ho chu Hebrew paova Armageddon kiti mun'a chun akhom khomun ahi.
en: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.
text:
REV 16:16
Thadou: Chule lhagao phalou ho chun vaipo ho jouse le galmi, sepai ho chu Hebrew paova Armageddon kiti mun'a chun akhom khomun ahi.
English: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, “Harmagedon”.

tcz: Chuphat in vantil sagi na chun asumlheng chu vanlaijol-a asunglhan ahi. Chuin Hou'in sunga laltouna a kon chun aw sangtah'a kisam kajah chun, “Akichaitai!” ati.
en: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”
text:
REV 16:17
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil sagi na chun asumlheng chu vanlaijol-a asunglhan ahi. Chuin Hou'in sunga laltouna a kon chun aw sangtah'a kisam kajah chun, “Akichaitai!” ati.
English: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

tcz: Chuphat in van ahung gingpoh lah in chule agin chu akitol in, chule kol aphejap jap jenge. Chuin ling nasatah le hattah chu ahungkihot jenge, leiset chunga mihem achen'a pat chutobang sohkha loulai anahi!
en: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.
text:
REV 16:18
Thadou: Chuphat in van ahung gingpoh lah in chule agin chu akitol in, chule kol aphejap jap jenge. Chuin ling nasatah le hattah chu ahungkihot jenge, leiset chunga mihem achen'a pat chutobang sohkha loulai anahi!
English: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth—so great an earthquake and so mighty.

tcz: Babylon khopi lentah chu hopthum akiso jengin chule chitin namtin khopiho chu achim gamin, songbong kisekhomho asohgamtai. Hiti chun Pathen in Babylon chonsetna jouse chu ageldoh in, chule amanu hi alunghanna hoisetah chu khon-a kon amanu chu adonsahtai.
en: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
text:
REV 16:19
Thadou: Babylon khopi lentah chu hopthum akiso jengin chule chitin namtin khopiho chu achim gamin, songbong kisekhomho asohgamtai. Hiti chun Pathen in Babylon chonsetna jouse chu ageldoh in, chule amanu hi alunghanna hoisetah chu khon-a kon amanu chu adonsahtai.
English: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

tcz: Chule twikol ho jouse jong aum gamtapon, chule molho jouse jong akisucham sohtai.
en: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
text:
REV 16:20
Thadou: Chule twikol ho jouse jong aum gamtapon, chule molho jouse jong akisucham sohtai.
English: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

tcz: Gel nasatah alhan, chule gelsong talent khat toh kibanga gih chu vana konin noilama miho chunga ahunglhan ahi. Gel tijat umtah'a gamna ahunglhun jeh chun miho chun Pathen agaosap tauve.
en: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.
text:
REV 16:21
Thadou: Gel nasatah alhan, chule gelsong talent khat toh kibanga gih chu vana konin noilama miho chunga ahunglhan ahi. Gel tijat umtah'a gamna ahunglhun jeh chun miho chun Pathen agaosap tauve.
English: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.

tcz: Vantil sagi sumlheng choi ho lah'a khat chu kahenga ahungin, chuin eihouvin, “Neihin juiyin, chutileh keiman noti lentah, twi tamtah chunga vaihomnu chunga thutanna hunglhung ding chu navetsah inge.
en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
text:
REV 17:1
Thadou: Vantil sagi sumlheng choi ho lah'a khat chu kahenga ahungin, chuin eihouvin, “Neihin juiyin, chutileh keiman noti lentah, twi tamtah chunga vaihomnu chunga thutanna hunglhung ding chu navetsah inge.
English: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

tcz: Amanuto chun vannoi leiset lengho jonguva, chule hiche vannoi leiset mite chu jonthanhoiya akhamnau leh ju'a amanuto jonguva ahi,” ati.
en: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”
text:
REV 17:2
Thadou: Amanuto chun vannoi leiset lengho jonguva, chule hiche vannoi leiset mite chu jonthanhoiya akhamnau leh ju'a amanuto jonguva ahi,” ati.
English: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. Those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

tcz: Hiti chun vantil chun keima Lhagaova gamthip mun'a eipuiyin ahi. Keiman chuche mun'a numei khat chu sahem santhip, lu sagi neiya chule ki som nei, chule Pathen taitomna dimset kijihna chunga atou chu kamui.
en: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
text:
REV 17:3
Thadou: Hiti chun vantil chun keima Lhagaova gamthip mun'a eipuiyin ahi. Keiman chuche mun'a numei khat chu sahem santhip, lu sagi neiya chule ki som nei, chule Pathen taitomna dimset kijihna chunga atou chu kamui.
English: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

tcz: Numeinu chun ponsandup le asanthip akisilin chule ahoiya hoi, sana le khisong mantam chule twikohchanga akijem in ahi. Amanu hin sana a kisem jukhon, jamo thu kisun dimset chule ajonthanhoiya athenlounaho chu akhut'a akichoiyin ahi.
en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
text:
REV 17:4
Thadou: Numeinu chun ponsandup le asanthip akisilin chule ahoiya hoi, sana le khisong mantam chule twikohchanga akijem in ahi. Amanu hin sana a kisem jukhon, jamo thu kisun dimset chule ajonthanhoiya athenlounaho chu akhut'a akichoiyin ahi.
English: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

tcz: Chule achalpanga chun min kidang le datmo umtah kisun: “Babylon khopi lentah, vannoi leiset'a numei kijoh jouse le jamo thusei dimset nu,” akitin ahi.
en: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”
text:
REV 17:5
Thadou: Chule achalpanga chun min kidang le datmo umtah kisun: “Babylon khopi lentah, vannoi leiset'a numei kijoh jouse le jamo thusei dimset nu,” akitin ahi.
English: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

tcz: Keiman amanu akham'a Yeshua thu hettohsah'a pang ho Pathen mithengte thisan adonkham a aum pet chu kamun ahi. Kadatmo behseh in amanu chu kave vejeng in ahi.
en: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.
text:
REV 17:6
Thadou: Keiman amanu akham'a Yeshua thu hettohsah'a pang ho Pathen mithengte thisan adonkham a aum pet chu kamun ahi. Kadatmo behseh in amanu chu kave vejeng in ahi.
English: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

tcz: Vantil chun, “Ipi dinga nachuti datmo ham?” Keiman hiche numeinu le alu sagi chule aki som nei, sahem chunga atou thuguh khu naseipeh inge.
en: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
text:
REV 17:7
Thadou: Vantil chun, “Ipi dinga nachuti datmo ham?” Keiman hiche numeinu le alu sagi chule aki som nei, sahem chunga atou thuguh khu naseipeh inge.
English: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

tcz: Sahem namu chu phatkhatna ana-uma ahi, hinlah tua umtalou ahi. Ajeh chu amahi lei-ong amongbeiya kon'a hungpotdoh kitding, chule tonsot mahthahna a chelut ding ahi. Chule hiche vannoi leiset mite, vannoi leiset kisem masanga pat'a aminu Hinna Lekhabua kisunlou jouse chun, sahem thisa ahung hindoh kit chu adatmo lheh diu ahi.
en: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.
text:
REV 17:8
Thadou: Sahem namu chu phatkhatna ana-uma ahi, hinlah tua umtalou ahi. Ajeh chu amahi lei-ong amongbeiya kon'a hungpotdoh kitding, chule tonsot mahthahna a chelut ding ahi. Chule hiche vannoi leiset mite, vannoi leiset kisem masanga pat'a aminu Hinna Lekhabua kisunlou jouse chun, sahem thisa ahung hindoh kit chu adatmo lheh diu ahi.
English: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

tcz: Hichea hin hetkhenna lunggel nei angaina akimudoh-e: Sahem alu sagi chu numeinu vaipohna, mol sagi ho vaihomtu ahi. Amaho hi leng sagi jong vetsahna ahiuve.
en: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.
text:
REV 17:9
Thadou: Hichea hin hetkhenna lunggel nei angaina akimudoh-e: Sahem alu sagi chu numeinu vaipohna, mol sagi ho vaihomtu ahi. Amaho hi leng sagi jong vetsahna ahiuve.
English: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits.

tcz: Leng nga ho chu alhusa ahiuvin, agupna pa tua hi vaipo ahi, chule asagina chu hungnalai ding, hinlah avaipohna chomcha bou hiding ahi.
en: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.
text:
REV 17:10
Thadou: Leng nga ho chu alhusa ahiuvin, agupna pa tua hi vaipo ahi, chule asagina chu hungnalai ding, hinlah avaipohna chomcha bou hiding ahi.
English: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, and the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

tcz: Sahem asanthip anaumsa, ahia umjom talou chu leng aget channa ahi. Amahi sahem sagi tobangma ahin, chule ama jong mahthah nalam manoa ahi.
en: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.
text:
REV 17:11
Thadou: Sahem asanthip anaumsa, ahia umjom talou chu leng aget channa ahi. Amahi sahem sagi tobangma ahin, chule ama jong mahthah nalam manoa ahi.
English: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

tcz: Sahem aki som ho chu leng som athaneinau pan'a vaihomna neiloulai ahiuve. Amaho chu sahemtoh phat chomkhat vai ahom khom diu ahi.
en: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.
text:
REV 17:12
Thadou: Sahem aki som ho chu leng som athaneinau pan'a vaihomna neiloulai ahiuve. Amaho chu sahemtoh phat chomkhat vai ahom khom diu ahi.
English: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings with the beast for one hour.

tcz: Amaho hi abonchauva amachu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu ahi.
en: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
text:
REV 17:13
Thadou: Amaho hi abonchauva amachu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu ahi.
English: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

tcz: “Amaho kitho khomuva Kelngoinou chu kisatpi dinga kondoh diu, hinlah Kelngoinou chun amaho chu ajo ding ahi, ajeh chu Ama pakai jouse PAKAI le leng jouse LENGPA ahi. Chule Aman akouva, alhendoh'a chule tahsan umho chu Amatoh umkhom diu ahi,” ati.
en: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
text:
REV 17:14
Thadou: “Amaho kitho khomuva Kelngoinou chu kisatpi dinga kondoh diu, hinlah Kelngoinou chun amaho chu ajo ding ahi, ajeh chu Ama pakai jouse PAKAI le leng jouse LENGPA ahi. Chule Aman akouva, alhendoh'a chule tahsan umho chu Amatoh umkhom diu ahi,” ati.
English: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”

tcz: Chuphat in vantil chun kajah a, “Notinu vaipohna twi tamtah kiti hin chitin namtin le paotin'a kon mihonpi chu kiseina ahi.”
en: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.
text:
REV 17:15
Thadou: Chuphat in vantil chun kajah a, “Notinu vaipohna twi tamtah kiti hin chitin namtin le paotin'a kon mihonpi chu kiseina ahi.”
English: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

tcz: Sahem asanthip le aki som ho chun abonchauvin Notinu chu athetbol tauve. Amahon amanu hi sagoh keova alha diu, asa aneh diu, chule atibah aneh mohchengseu chu meiya ahalvam diu ahi.
en: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.
text:
REV 17:16
Thadou: Sahem asanthip le aki som ho chun abonchauvin Notinu chu athetbol tauve. Amahon amanu hi sagoh keova alha diu, asa aneh diu, chule atibah aneh mohchengseu chu meiya ahalvam diu ahi.
English: The ten horns which you saw, they and the beast will hate the prostitute, will make her desolate, will strip her naked, will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

tcz: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in alunggel uva tohgon, asuhbulhit thei dinghou akhumpeh ding ahi. Amaho chun sahem santhip chu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu, chule hitia chu Pathen Thu chu suhbulhit-a umding ahi.
en: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.
text:
REV 17:17
Thadou: Ajeh iham itileh Pathen in alunggel uva tohgon, asuhbulhit thei dinghou akhumpeh ding ahi. Amaho chun sahem santhip chu athaneinau pecheh dinga kinopto diu, chule hitia chu Pathen Thu chu suhbulhit-a umding ahi.
English: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

tcz: Chule hiche numeinu nangman gaova namu hi, vannoi lengho chunga vaipoa khopi chu ahi.
en: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”
text:
REV 17:18
Thadou: Chule hiche numeinu nangman gaova namu hi, vannoi lengho chunga vaipoa khopi chu ahi.
English: The woman whom you saw is the great city which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

tcz: Hicheng jouse nung chun keiman vantil chomkhat vana kon'a thuneitah'a ahung kum lhah kamun, chule leiset chu avah in asaljengin ahi.
en: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
text:
REV 18:1
Thadou: Hicheng jouse nung chun keiman vantil chomkhat vana kon'a thuneitah'a ahung kum lhah kamun, chule leiset chu avah in asaljengin ahi.
English: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

tcz: Ama chun aw gingtah in asam in: “Babylon chu achimtai, Khopi lentah chu achimtai! Ama lhagao phalou chenna ahung hitai. Ama lhagao namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin, muthong namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin chule anamse le kichat umsa-ho umna mun ahitai.
en: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!
text:
REV 18:2
Thadou: Ama chun aw gingtah in asam in: “Babylon chu achimtai, Khopi lentah chu achimtai! Ama lhagao phalou chenna ahung hitai. Ama lhagao namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin, muthong namse ho kiselna mun ahung hin chule anamse le kichat umsa-ho umna mun ahitai.
English: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hated bird!

tcz: Ajeh chu chitin namtin vaipi chu amanu jonthan hoina lung ngaichatnaa chonchatvaina ju'a alhutai. Vannoi lengho amanutoh ajong khomun ahi. Amanu nopsahval a kon'a vannoi leiset sumkol veiho haodoh gam'a ahitauve,” ati.
en: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
text:
REV 18:3
Thadou: Ajeh chu chitin namtin vaipi chu amanu jonthan hoina lung ngaichatnaa chonchatvaina ju'a alhutai. Vannoi lengho amanutoh ajong khomun ahi. Amanu nopsahval a kon'a vannoi leiset sumkol veiho haodoh gam'a ahitauve,” ati.
English: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

tcz: Chutah in keiman aw chomkhat vanna konin kajai, “Kamite, amanua konin hungdoh un, amanu chonsetnaho chu kikoppi hih un, achuti louva ahileh amanutoh gimbolna nathoh khom diu ahi.
en: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
text:
REV 18:4
Thadou: Chutah in keiman aw chomkhat vanna konin kajai, “Kamite, amanua konin hungdoh un, amanu chonsetnaho chu kikoppi hih un, achuti louva ahileh amanutoh gimbolna nathoh khom diu ahi.
English: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

tcz: Ajeh chu amanu chonsetna ho chu van sang in asangin, chule Pathen in amanu thilse bolho chu ageldoh in ahi.
en: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
text:
REV 18:5
Thadou: Ajeh chu amanu chonsetna ho chu van sang in asangin, chule Pathen in amanu thilse bolho chu ageldoh in ahi.
English: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

tcz: Amanun michunga abolna tobang'in achunga boluvin, athilse bolho jeh in ajatnin lethuh un. Aman midang dingin kichatna ju'a kisem chol jaona chu khon-a ahaltai, hiti chun amadingin chan-ni akisemben ahi.
en: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
text:
REV 18:6
Thadou: Amanun michunga abolna tobang'in achunga boluvin, athilse bolho jeh in ajatnin lethuh un. Aman midang dingin kichatna ju'a kisem chol jaona chu khon-a ahaltai, hiti chun amadingin chan-ni akisemben ahi.
English: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

tcz: Ama akichoi sanga chule kinom sahtah'a hinkho amanjeh chun, tun atotoh dingin gimthohsahna le lunghemna lhutpeh un. Amanu hin alungsunga kithang atna neitah in, keima kalaltouna a lengnu kahi, keima hi panpibei meithai kahihih in, hitia chu keima kalunghemna ding aumpoi, ati.
en: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
text:
REV 18:7
Thadou: Ama akichoi sanga chule kinom sahtah'a hinkho amanjeh chun, tun atotoh dingin gimthohsahna le lunghemna lhutpeh un. Amanu hin alungsunga kithang atna neitah in, keima kalaltouna a lengnu kahi, keima hi panpibei meithai kahihih in, hitia chu keima kalunghemna ding aumpoi, ati.
English: However much she glorified herself and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

tcz: Hijeh a chu hiche gamna hoise ho hin, nikhat sunga ahinphah ding–thina le lunghemna chule kel'in ahinphah ding ahi. Amanu hi meiyin akahvamhel ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh Pakai Pathen amanu thutanpa chu hatchungnung ahi,” ati.
en: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
text:
REV 18:8
Thadou: Hijeh a chu hiche gamna hoise ho hin, nikhat sunga ahinphah ding–thina le lunghemna chule kel'in ahinphah ding ahi. Amanu hi meiyin akahvamhel ding ahi, ijeh ham itileh Pakai Pathen amanu thutanpa chu hatchungnung ahi,” ati.
English: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

tcz: Chule vannoi lengho amanu jonpiho le ama kinomsahna thanoppi ho chun amanu kigona meikhu kitungdoh chu amu tenguleh alung hempi diu ahi.
en: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
text:
REV 18:9
Thadou: Chule vannoi lengho amanu jonpiho le ama kinomsahna thanoppi ho chun amanu kigona meikhu kitungdoh chu amu tenguleh alung hempi diu ahi.
English: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

tcz: Amaho chu gamlatah a ding'uva amanu thohgim chu tijatah'a avet diu ahi. Amaho chun ahinsapdoh uva, “Iti gimneiya nagimnei hitam! Vo Babylon, khopi lentah nu! Phat khatsung sehseh in Pathen thutanna nachunga alhung jenge,” ati diu ahi.
en: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
text:
REV 18:10
Thadou: Amaho chu gamlatah a ding'uva amanu thohgim chu tijatah'a avet diu ahi. Amaho chun ahinsapdoh uva, “Iti gimneiya nagimnei hitam! Vo Babylon, khopi lentah nu! Phat khatsung sehseh in Pathen thutanna nachunga alhung jenge,” ati diu ahi.
English: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

tcz: Vannoiya kiveimiho chu hungkap uva chule alunghem pidiu ahi, ijeh ham itileh athilhou chodinga koima akidalha aumtapoi.
en: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:
text:
REV 18:11
Thadou: Vannoiya kiveimiho chu hungkap uva chule alunghem pidiu ahi, ijeh ham itileh athilhou chodinga koima akidalha aumtapoi.
English: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more:

tcz: Amanu hin sana, dangka, khisong mantam, twikoh chang, tupatponnem, ponsandup, lungpon, chule ponsanthip, thinga kisem gimnamtwi, saihaa kisem thil ho, thingmantam'a kisem thilho, sum eng, thih, chule songval-a kisem kong le bel hicheng hohi atam'a tam ana choh ahi.
en: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

tcz: Amanu hin thingthal, amui-al, thingnai, thao anamtui, bego, lengpitwi, olive thao, changbong, suhlouchang, bong le kelngoi, sakol le sakol kangtalai, chule mihem soh'a kivul ho chengse jong hi anachohdoh ahi.
en: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
text:
REV 18:13
Thadou: Amanu hin thingthal, amui-al, thingnai, thao anamtui, bego, lengpitwi, olive thao, changbong, suhlouchang, bong le kelngoi, sakol le sakol kangtalai, chule mihem soh'a kivul ho chengse jong hi anachohdoh ahi.
English: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

tcz: “Thil mantam nangman nangailut lheh jengho jong chu amangthah in, na kinomsah na le na loupina ho jong a-itih'a din amangthah tai,” tia asap diu ahi.
en: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.
text:
REV 18:14
Thadou: “Thil mantam nangman nangailut lheh jengho jong chu amangthah in, na kinomsah na le na loupina ho jong a-itih'a din amangthah tai,” tia asap diu ahi.
English: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you. All things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

tcz: Kivei miho, amanu koma hicheng thil joh ho chu gamlatah a ding diu, athohgimna khoh chungnung chu atijat pilheh jeng diu ahi. Amaho kap uvintin chule ahin sapdoh diu,
en: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
text:
REV 18:15
Thadou: Kivei miho, amanu koma hicheng thil joh ho chu gamlatah a ding diu, athohgimna khoh chungnung chu atijat pilheh jeng diu ahi. Amaho kap uvintin chule ahin sapdoh diu,
English: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,

tcz: “Chuche khopi lenchungnung dinga tijat iti um hitam! Amanu hin ponsandup le ponsanthip tonjih ponnem hoipen pen akisila, hitia chu sana le songmantama, chule twikohchanga kijem'a ahi.”
en: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
text:
REV 18:16
Thadou: “Chuche khopi lenchungnung dinga tijat iti um hitam! Amanu hin ponsandup le ponsanthip tonjih ponnem hoipen pen akisila, hitia chu sana le songmantama, chule twikohchanga kijem'a ahi.”
English: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

tcz: “Mitphet kahlouvin khopi haona jouse chu amahthah jenge!” Chule kiveina konglen tol lamkaiho le asunga touho jouse chule atol-a panghole avesuiya pang jouse chu gamlatah a dingdiu ahi.
en: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,
text:
REV 18:17
Thadou: “Mitphet kahlouvin khopi haona jouse chu amahthah jenge!” Chule kiveina konglen tol lamkaiho le asunga touho jouse chule atol-a panghole avesuiya pang jouse chu gamlatah a dingdiu ahi.
English: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

tcz: Amahon avetvetpet uva Meikhu ahung kitundoh phattengleh amahon, “Hiche khopi tobang khopi len chungnung achom dang khat hoiya uma hitam!” ati diu ahi.
en: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
text:
REV 18:18
Thadou: Amahon avetvetpet uva Meikhu ahung kitundoh phattengleh amahon, “Hiche khopi tobang khopi len chungnung achom dang khat hoiya uma hitam!” ati diu ahi.
English: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

tcz: Chutia amaho kap diu chule alunghemnau vetsahna a aluchunguva vutvai atheuva, chule hung pengdoh jeng diu, “Chuche khopi lenchungnung dinga itobang tah a tijat um hitam! Konglen neiho chu ahaona thil ho twikhanglen'a polea apanjeh uva hung haodoh uva ahin, tun mitphet kahlouvin amahthah jenge,” atiuvin ahi.
en: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.
text:
REV 18:19
Thadou: Chutia amaho kap diu chule alunghemnau vetsahna a aluchunguva vutvai atheuva, chule hung pengdoh jeng diu, “Chuche khopi lenchungnung dinga itobang tah a tijat um hitam! Konglen neiho chu ahaona thil ho twikhanglen'a polea apanjeh uva hung haodoh uva ahin, tun mitphet kahlouvin amahthah jenge,” atiuvin ahi.
English: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.

tcz: Amanu chan chunga khun kipah uvin, Vanin, Pathen miten, solchah hole themgao ho chengsen. Ijeh inem itileh nangho jal in, anunung penah Pathen in amanu chungthu atantai.
en: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”
text:
REV 18:20
Thadou: Amanu chan chunga khun kipah uvin, Vanin, Pathen miten, solchah hole themgao ho chengsen. Ijeh inem itileh nangho jal in, anunung penah Pathen in amanu chungthu atantai.
English: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets, for God has judged your judgment on her.”

tcz: Chujouchun vantil hattah khat chun songtum khat sumhei tebep alan, hichu twikhanglen'a alehlut in chuin ahinsamin, “Hiche tobang banga hi Babylon khopi chungnung chu hoisetah'a suhchim hung hiding chule kimukit talou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
text:
REV 18:21
Thadou: Chujouchun vantil hattah khat chun songtum khat sumhei tebep alan, hichu twikhanglen'a alehlut in chuin ahinsamin, “Hiche tobang banga hi Babylon khopi chungnung chu hoisetah'a suhchim hung hiding chule kimukit talou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

tcz: Selangdah kitumgin, lasaho awgin, theilegin, chule sumkon gin hohi nangmaa kon'a kijadoh kit talouhel ding ahitai. Khut them thilbol hole kiveiho nangmaa kimudoh kit talouhel diu ahi. Sumhei changsuh gin nangmaa kijadohkit talou helding ahitai.
en: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
text:
REV 18:22
Thadou: Selangdah kitumgin, lasaho awgin, theilegin, chule sumkon gin hohi nangmaa kon'a kijadoh kit talouhel ding ahitai. Khut them thilbol hole kiveiho nangmaa kimudoh kit talouhel diu ahi. Sumhei changsuh gin nangmaa kijadohkit talou helding ahitai.
English: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman of whatever craft will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

tcz: Thaomeivah nangmaa kon'a hungvah doh kit talou helding ahitai. Akicheng ding moulang le mounu kipa awgin kijadoh kit talouhel ding ahi. Ijeh ham itileh akivei miho hi vannoiya athupipen ahitauvin, chule nangman chitin namtin chu doihoa nalheplhah gam ahitai.
en: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
text:
REV 18:23
Thadou: Thaomeivah nangmaa kon'a hungvah doh kit talou helding ahitai. Akicheng ding moulang le mounu kipa awgin kijadoh kit talouhel ding ahi. Ijeh ham itileh akivei miho hi vannoiya athupipen ahitauvin, chule nangman chitin namtin chu doihoa nalheplhah gam ahitai.
English: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you, for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

tcz: Nalamlen lhongpiu ho'ah themgaoho le Pathen mithengte thisan alongin, chule miho kithana thisan chu vannoi muntin'a alonglhan ahi.
en: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
text:
REV 18:24
Thadou: Nalamlen lhongpiu ho'ah themgaoho le Pathen mithengte thisan alongin, chule miho kithana thisan chu vannoi muntin'a alonglhan ahi.
English: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

tcz: Hichengjou chun, vana mipi atam'a tam awgin tobang kisamging chun, “Pakai chu vahchoiyun, Huhhingna le loupina chule thahat-thilbol theina chu IPathen uva ahi.
en: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God;

tcz: Athutan naho adih in chule akitah e. Aman numei kijoh minthangnu, ajon thanhoinaa leiset subohnu chu gimbolna apetai. Asohte that'a pangnu chunga aman phuba alatai.”
en: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”
text:
REV 19:2
Thadou: Athutan naho adih in chule akitah e. Aman numei kijoh minthangnu, ajon thanhoinaa leiset subohnu chu gimbolna apetai. Asohte that'a pangnu chunga aman phuba alatai.”
English: for his judgments are true and righteous. For he has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

tcz: Chule amaho awgin chu ahung kithongdoh in, “Pakai chu vahchoiyun! Chuche khopia konin ameikhu chu tonsot atonsot a dingin akaltoutai,” ati.
en: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
text:
REV 19:3
Thadou: Chule amaho awgin chu ahung kithongdoh in, “Pakai chu vahchoiyun! Chuche khopia konin ameikhu chu tonsot atonsot a dingin akaltoutai,” ati.
English: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

tcz: Chujouchun Upa somni le li leh Hinnanei li ho chu abohkhup un chuin Laltouna a toupa Pathen chu ahou un ahi. Amaho chun asam'un, “Hihen, Pakai chu vahchoiyun,” atiuve.
en: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
text:
REV 19:4
Thadou: Chujouchun Upa somni le li leh Hinnanei li ho chu abohkhup un chuin Laltouna a toupa Pathen chu ahou un ahi. Amaho chun asam'un, “Hihen, Pakai chu vahchoiyun,” atiuve.
English: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

tcz: Chule laltouna a kon chun aw khat in, “I Pathen-u chu Asohte jousen, Ama ging jousen, aneopena pat alenpen geiyin, vahchoiyun,” atiuve.
en: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”
text:
REV 19:5
Thadou: Chule laltouna a kon chun aw khat in, “I Pathen-u chu Asohte jousen, Ama ging jousen, aneopena pat alenpen geiyin, vahchoiyun,” atiuve.
English: A voice came from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

tcz: Chuphat in keiman mihonpi khosap aw tobang kajan, twikhanglen kinong ginngeitah tobang'in, vang in kithong gin tobang chun, “Pakai chu vahchoiyun, Ajeh chu Pakai IPathenu, Hatchungnung chun vai apotai.
en: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!
text:
REV 19:6
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman mihonpi khosap aw tobang kajan, twikhanglen kinong ginngeitah tobang'in, vang in kithong gin tobang chun, “Pakai chu vahchoiyun, Ajeh chu Pakai IPathenu, Hatchungnung chun vai apotai.
English: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

tcz: Eiho kipah-uhitin, chule thanopna neiyuhite, chule Ama jabolna peuhite. Ajeh chu aphat, Kelngoinou moupui golvah ankong umkhomna ding chu phat hunglhunga ahitai, chule Aji dingnu jong kigosademin aumtai.
en: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”
text:
REV 19:7
Thadou: Eiho kipah-uhitin, chule thanopna neiyuhite, chule Ama jabolna peuhite. Ajeh chu aphat, Kelngoinou moupui golvah ankong umkhomna ding chu phat hunglhunga ahitai, chule Aji dingnu jong kigosademin aumtai.
English: Let’s rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let’s give the glory to him. For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

tcz: Amanu chu tupat ponnem hoipen tah athengsel bangleh chu akipetai,” tin aseiye. Ijeh ham itileh tonjih ponnem hoitah chun avetsah chu Pathen mithengte thilphabol chu ahi.
en: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.
text:
REV 19:8
Thadou: Amanu chu tupat ponnem hoipen tah athengsel bangleh chu akipetai,” tin aseiye. Ijeh ham itileh tonjih ponnem hoitah chun avetsah chu Pathen mithengte thilphabol chu ahi.
English: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

tcz: Chule vantil chun kajah a, “Hiche hi jihdoh in: Kelngoinou moupui golvah an nedia akikou ho chu anunnom ahiuve,” tin aseiye. Chuin aman aseiben, “Hicheho hi Pathena hungkon Thutahbeh chu ahi,” ati.
en: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”
text:
REV 19:9
Thadou: Chule vantil chun kajah a, “Hiche hi jihdoh in: Kelngoinou moupui golvah an nedia akikou ho chu anunnom ahiuve,” tin aseiye. Chuin aman aseiben, “Hicheho hi Pathena hungkon Thutahbeh chu ahi,” ati.
English: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

tcz: Chuphat in keima kabohkhup in ama chu hou kagotai, hinlah amachun, “Ahipoi, keima neihou hih in. Keima nangma tobangbep nasopite lah'a Yeshua tahsan'a ahettohsah'a pang Pathen sohkhat kahi. Pathen bou houvin. Ajeh chu themgao thusei lona jeh chu, Yeshua thu kichentah'a hettohsah'a pan hi ahi,” ati.
en: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”
text:
REV 19:10
Thadou: Chuphat in keima kabohkhup in ama chu hou kagotai, hinlah amachun, “Ahipoi, keima neihou hih in. Keima nangma tobangbep nasopite lah'a Yeshua tahsan'a ahettohsah'a pang Pathen sohkhat kahi. Pathen bou houvin. Ajeh chu themgao thusei lona jeh chu, Yeshua thu kichentah'a hettohsah'a pan hi ahi,” ati.
English: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

tcz: Chujouchun keiman van akihonna chule sakol kang khat chuche muna adin chu kamun ahi. Achunga toupa chu Tahsan umtah le Adih ahi, ajeh chu Aman dihtah'a thu atan ahin, chule chonphatnaa gal asat ji ahi.
en: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.
text:
REV 19:11
Thadou: Chujouchun keiman van akihonna chule sakol kang khat chuche muna adin chu kamun ahi. Achunga toupa chu Tahsan umtah le Adih ahi, ajeh chu Aman dihtah'a thu atan ahin, chule chonphatnaa gal asat ji ahi.
English: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

tcz: Amit teni chu meikou tobang ahin, chule aluchunga lallukhuh tampi aumin ahi. Achunga min khat akijih in, hichu Ama tailou koima dangin ahechenpoi.
en: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.
text:
REV 19:12
Thadou: Amit teni chu meikou tobang ahin, chule aluchunga lallukhuh tampi aumin ahi. Achunga min khat akijih in, hichu Ama tailou koima dangin ahechenpoi.
English: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

tcz: Aman ponsil khat thisan'a kidelut chu akisilin, chule aminput chu Pathen Thu akiti.
en: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”
text:
REV 19:13
Thadou: Aman ponsil khat thisan'a kidelut chu akisilin, chule aminput chu Pathen Thu akiti.
English: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

tcz: Van sepaite, tupat ponnem bangleh hoipen tah le thengsel in akivonun, sakol ho chunga atou un ahi.
en: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.
text:
REV 19:14
Thadou: Van sepaite, tupat ponnem bangleh hoipen tah le thengsel in akivonun, sakol ho chunga atou un ahi.
English: The armies which are in heaven, clothed in white, pure, fine linen, followed him on white horses.

tcz: Akama konin chemjam hemtah ahung potdoh'in chitin namtin asatchap gamin ahi. Aman amaho chu thihtengol-a vai apoh ding ahi. Aman Hatchungnung Pathen lunghanna nasatah chu lengpi hehna a kon'a lengpitwi hunglongdoh banga ahinlhadoh ding ahi.
en: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.
text:
REV 19:15
Thadou: Akama konin chemjam hemtah ahung potdoh'in chitin namtin asatchap gamin ahi. Aman amaho chu thihtengol-a vai apoh ding ahi. Aman Hatchungnung Pathen lunghanna nasatah chu lengpi hehna a kon'a lengpitwi hunglongdoh banga ahinlhadoh ding ahi.
English: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the wine press of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

tcz: Aponsil le amal bul-a hiche: “Lengho Lengpa le pakaiho Pakaipa” thuhi akijih in ahi.
en: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”
text:
REV 19:16
Thadou: Aponsil le amal bul-a hiche: “Lengho Lengpa le pakaiho Pakaipa” thuhi akijih in ahi.
English: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

tcz: Chujou chun keiman vantil khat nisanoiya adin kamun, muthong lengleho henga asamin, “Hunguvin! Pathen in agonsa golvah loupitah'a hin hung kikhomuvin.
en: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,
text:
REV 19:17
Thadou: Chujou chun keiman vantil khat nisanoiya adin kamun, muthong lengleho henga asamin, “Hunguvin! Pathen in agonsa golvah loupitah'a hin hung kikhomuvin.
English: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

tcz: Hungun lang lengho le agal lamkaiteu chule gal hat ho, chuban a asakol hou le achunga touho; chule mi jouse chamlhat le soh ho, alen le aneoho tahsaphe hung neuvin,” ati.
en: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”
text:
REV 19:18
Thadou: Hungun lang lengho le agal lamkaiteu chule gal hat ho, chuban a asakol hou le achunga touho; chule mi jouse chamlhat le soh ho, alen le aneoho tahsaphe hung neuvin,” ati.
English: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, small and great.”

tcz: Chuphat in keiman sahem le vannoi lengho chule asepaiteu chu sakol chunga toupa le galmanchah choite ho chu douding in akikhop khom-u kamun ahi.
en: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.
text:
REV 19:19
Thadou: Chuphat in keiman sahem le vannoi lengho chule asepaiteu chu sakol chunga toupa le galmanchah choite ho chu douding in akikhop khom-u kamun ahi.
English: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

tcz: Chuin sahem chu amantauve, chule amatoh chun themgaolhem, sahem thalhenga thil kidangtah tah bolpa–hiche thilkidang chu sahem melchihna kilah ho le alim houho jouse lheplhahna a kimang chu ahi. Chuin Sahem le athemgao lhempa chu anilhonin mei-al lenglung meikou sunga chun alehlut tauve.
en: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
text:
REV 19:20
Thadou: Chuin sahem chu amantauve, chule amatoh chun themgaolhem, sahem thalhenga thil kidangtah tah bolpa–hiche thilkidang chu sahem melchihna kilah ho le alim houho jouse lheplhahna a kimang chu ahi. Chuin Sahem le athemgao lhempa chu anilhonin mei-al lenglung meikou sunga chun alehlut tauve.
English: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

tcz: A sepai hou jouse chu sakol kang chunga toupa kamsung'a kon'a chemjam hemtah chun asatlih gam tauve. Chule muthongho chu mithiho tahsa lungna chimset in anetauvin ahi.
en: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.
text:
REV 19:21
Thadou: A sepai hou jouse chu sakol kang chunga toupa kamsung'a kon'a chemjam hemtah chun asatlih gam tauve. Chule muthongho chu mithiho tahsa lungna chimset in anetauvin ahi.
English: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came out of his mouth. So all the birds were filled with their flesh.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman vantil khat vana kon hungkum lha a amongbei leiko kot heh kichoi, chule akhut'a kot heh khao jong kichoi chu kamun ahi.
en: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
text:
REV 20:1
Thadou: Chujou chun keiman vantil khat vana kon hungkum lha a amongbei leiko kot heh kichoi, chule akhut'a kot heh khao jong kichoi chu kamun ahi.
English: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

tcz: Aman dragon–hiche gullui, diabol kiti Satan chu amanin chule thihkhaova chun kum sangkhat a din ahentai.
en: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,
text:
REV 20:2
Thadou: Aman dragon–hiche gullui, diabol kiti Satan chu amanin chule thihkhaova chun kum sangkhat a din ahentai.
English: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, who is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

tcz: Vantil ama chu amongbei kohom'ah alehlut in, chule kum sangkhat kichai masangsea koima alheplhah louna din Satan chu akhah chah in, akam khum tan ahi. Chujouleh chomkhat adia ama chu kilhadoh ding ahi.
en: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.
text:
REV 20:3
Thadou: Vantil ama chu amongbei kohom'ah alehlut in, chule kum sangkhat kichai masangsea koima alheplhah louna din Satan chu akhah chah in, akam khum tan ahi. Chujouleh chomkhat adia ama chu kilhadoh ding ahi.
English: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

tcz: Chujou chun keiman laltouna ho chule achunga tou miho chu thutan theina thuneina kipeuva ahi kamudoh in ahi. Chule keiman Yeshua thu hettohsah'a panjeh le Pathen Thu seiphongna jeh'a alol kitan ho lhagao chu kamun ahi. Amaho hin sahem ahilouleh alim chu ahoupouvin, chuleh achalpanga ahilouleh akhut uva kibeh ding nomlou ahiuve. Amaho tahsaa hung hingdoh kit ahiuvin, chule amahon Christa to kum sangkhat lengvai ahomkhom diu ahi.
en: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
text:
REV 20:4
Thadou: Chujou chun keiman laltouna ho chule achunga tou miho chu thutan theina thuneina kipeuva ahi kamudoh in ahi. Chule keiman Yeshua thu hettohsah'a panjeh le Pathen Thu seiphongna jeh'a alol kitan ho lhagao chu kamun ahi. Amaho hin sahem ahilouleh alim chu ahoupouvin, chuleh achalpanga ahilouleh akhut uva kibeh ding nomlou ahiuve. Amaho tahsaa hung hingdoh kit ahiuvin, chule amahon Christa to kum sangkhat lengvai ahomkhom diu ahi.
English: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

tcz: Hiche hi thokitna masa ahi. (Mithiho adangse vang kum sangkhat kichai kah sen ahung thoudoh pouve.)
en: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
text:
REV 20:5
Thadou: Hiche hi thokitna masa ahi. (Mithiho adangse vang kum sangkhat kichai kah sen ahung thoudoh pouve.)
English: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

tcz: Thokitna masa a chan neijouse anunnom chule atheng ahiuve. Thi ninan amaho chungah thuneina anei tapoi, amavang amaho Pathen le Christa thempu a pang uva chule amatoh kum sangkhat vai ahomkhom diu ahi.
en: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.
text:
REV 20:6
Thadou: Thokitna masa a chan neijouse anunnom chule atheng ahiuve. Thi ninan amaho chungah thuneina anei tapoi, amavang amaho Pathen le Christa thempu a pang uva chule amatoh kum sangkhat vai ahomkhom diu ahi.
English: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

tcz: Kum sangkhat chu ahung kichai tengleh, Satan chu asohchanna a kon puidoh hiding ahi.
en: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison
text:
REV 20:7
