Thadou: Kum sangkhat chu ahung kichai tengleh, Satan chu asohchanna a kon puidoh hiding ahi.
English: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison

tcz: Ama chitin namtin ho lhemlha dinga kipatdoh ding, Gog le Magog kitia chu leiset kolkimvel'a akhopkhom ding ahi. Aman amaho chu galsatna a dinga akhopkhom ding, galmi hattah, twikhanglen panga simjoulou neldi jat hiding ahi.
en: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
text:
REV 20:8
Thadou: Ama chitin namtin ho lhemlha dinga kipatdoh ding, Gog le Magog kitia chu leiset kolkimvel'a akhopkhom ding ahi. Aman amaho chu galsatna a dinga akhopkhom ding, galmi hattah, twikhanglen panga simjoulou neldi jat hiding ahi.
English: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.

tcz: Chuin keiman amaho chu leiset phaicham pheng pumpi hop'a akaltou-u kamun, chule Pathen mite le khopi theng chu ahin umkimvel tauve. Hinlah vana konin mei ahung lenglhan mi nokhum galmiho chunga achun chule amaho chu ahalvamtai.
en: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
text:
REV 20:9
Thadou: Chuin keiman amaho chu leiset phaicham pheng pumpi hop'a akaltou-u kamun, chule Pathen mite le khopi theng chu ahin umkimvel tauve. Hinlah vana konin mei ahung lenglhan mi nokhum galmiho chunga achun chule amaho chu ahalvamtai.
English: They went up over the width of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.

tcz: Chuphat in diabol, amaho lhemlhapa chu, meisa al-lenglung sunga chun akilehlut tai, sahem le themgao lhem jong chu aleh luttha tauve. Chua chun amaho chu sunle jan a-itih a gimbol hesohna athoh jing diu ahitai.
en: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
text:
REV 20:10
Thadou: Chuphat in diabol, amaho lhemlhapa chu, meisa al-lenglung sunga chun akilehlut tai, sahem le themgao lhem jong chu aleh luttha tauve. Chua chun amaho chu sunle jan a-itih a gimbol hesohna athoh jing diu ahitai.
English: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

tcz: Chuin keiman laltouna kang le achunga toupa kamun ahi. Leiset le van'a-angsunga konin ajammangin, hinlah kiselna ding mun aneitapoi.
en: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.
text:
REV 20:11
Thadou: Chuin keiman laltouna kang le achunga toupa kamun ahi. Leiset le van'a-angsunga konin ajammangin, hinlah kiselna ding mun aneitapoi.
English: I saw a great white throne and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.

tcz: Keiman athisaho, alen le aneo Pathen laltouna maiya adin'u kamun ahi. Chule lekhabuho aphongun, Hinna Lekhabu jong aphoh thauvin ahi. Chule athisa ho chu lekhabuhoa kisun dung juiyin achungthu-u chu akitantai.
en: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.
text:
REV 20:12
Thadou: Keiman athisaho, alen le aneo Pathen laltouna maiya adin'u kamun ahi. Chule lekhabuho aphongun, Hinna Lekhabu jong aphoh thauvin ahi. Chule athisa ho chu lekhabuhoa kisun dung juiyin achungthu-u chu akitantai.
English: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

tcz: Twikhanglenin amithisa chu ahinlehdoh in, chule thina le lhankhuh in jong amithisa ahinlehdoh in ahi. Chuin abonchauvin atoh dung juiyun achungthu'u akitan chaitai.
en: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.
text:
REV 20:13
Thadou: Twikhanglenin amithisa chu ahinlehdoh in, chule thina le lhankhuh in jong amithisa ahinlehdoh in ahi. Chuin abonchauvin atoh dung juiyun achungthu'u akitan chaitai.
English: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

tcz: Chuphat in thina le lhankhuh chu Tonsot meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve. Hiche Tonsot Meidil chu Thinina ahi.
en: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
text:
REV 20:14
Thadou: Chuphat in thina le lhankhuh chu Tonsot meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve. Hiche Tonsot Meidil chu Thinina ahi.
English: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

tcz: Chule koi hijongleh Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kimulou tapou chu Tonsot Meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve.
en: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.
text:
REV 20:15
Thadou: Chule koi hijongleh Hinna Lekhabua amin-u kimulou tapou chu Tonsot Meidil sunga chun alehlut tauve.
English: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

tcz: Chujouvin keiman Van thah le leithah kamui, ijeh inem itileh vanlui le leilui chu manga ahitai. Chule twikhanglen jong chu chemanga ahitai.
en: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.
text:
REV 21:1
Thadou: Chujouvin keiman Van thah le leithah kamui, ijeh inem itileh vanlui le leilui chu manga ahitai. Chule twikhanglen jong chu chemanga ahitai.
English: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

tcz: Chule keiman khopi theng Jerusalem thah chu van Pathena kon'a mou aji dingpa hoitah'a akivon'a ahung kumlhah kamun ahi.
en: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
text:
REV 21:2
Thadou: Chule keiman khopi theng Jerusalem thah chu van Pathena kon'a mou aji dingpa hoitah'a akivon'a ahung kumlhah kamun ahi.
English: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

tcz: Keiman laltouna a kon'a aw hung kisam gin kajan, aseiyin, “Ven, Pathen chenna in chu mihemlah ahung hitai! Ama amahotoh chengkhom intin, chule amaho chu Ama mite hiding ahiuve. Pathen Amatah chun amaho aumpi diu ahi.
en: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.
text:
REV 21:3
Thadou: Keiman laltouna a kon'a aw hung kisam gin kajan, aseiyin, “Ven, Pathen chenna in chu mihemlah ahung hitai! Ama amahotoh chengkhom intin, chule amaho chu Ama mite hiding ahiuve. Pathen Amatah chun amaho aumpi diu ahi.
English: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people; and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

tcz: Aman amit uva kon'a amitlhiu atheh ngimpeh ding, chule thina jong umkit talou ding ahilouleh lungkhamna ahilouleh kana ahilouleh natna umtalou ding ahi. Hicheng jouse hi a-itih a umtalou ding ahitai,” ati.
en: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”
text:
REV 21:4
Thadou: Aman amit uva kon'a amitlhiu atheh ngimpeh ding, chule thina jong umkit talou ding ahilouleh lungkhamna ahilouleh kana ahilouleh natna umtalou ding ahi. Hicheng jouse hi a-itih a umtalou ding ahitai,” ati.
English: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain any more. The first things have passed away.”

tcz: Chule laltouna a toupa chun aseiyin, “Ven, keiman ijakai kathah semtai, ati. Chule ajouchun aman kajah a, Hiche hi jihdoh in, ijeh ham itileh keiman najah'a kasei hi tahsan umtah le adih ahi,” ati.
en: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
text:
REV 21:5
Thadou: Chule laltouna a toupa chun aseiyin, “Ven, keiman ijakai kathah semtai, ati. Chule ajouchun aman kajah a, Hiche hi jihdoh in, ijeh ham itileh keiman najah'a kasei hi tahsan umtah le adih ahi,” ati.
English: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

tcz: Chule amachun hiti hin aseiyin, “Akichaiya ahitai! Keima Alpha le Omega kahi, Akipatna le akichaina chu! Adangchah jouse chu keiman Hinna twi nah'a kon'a twi chu manbeiyin penge.”
en: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.
text:
REV 21:6
Thadou: Chule amachun hiti hin aseiyin, “Akichaiya ahitai! Keima Alpha le Omega kahi, Akipatna le akichaina chu! Adangchah jouse chu keiman Hinna twi nah'a kon'a twi chu manbeiyin penge.”
English: He said to me, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

tcz: Jona neiho chu hiche phattheinaho hi chang diu ahi, chule keima Amaho din Apau hing ting chule amaho kachate hiding ahiuve.
en: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.
text:
REV 21:7
Thadou: Jona neiho chu hiche phattheinaho hi chang diu ahi, chule keima Amaho din Apau hing ting chule amaho kachate hiding ahiuve.
English: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

tcz: Hinlah akichaseho, atahsanlouho, akisubohho, tolthat ho, jonbol ho, doichoiho, milim houho chule mijouho, amaho jouse chan ding chu meidil al-lenglung meikou mittheilou lhummei chu hiding ahi. Hiche hi thi nina ahi.
en: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”
text:
REV 21:8
Thadou: Hinlah akichaseho, atahsanlouho, akisubohho, tolthat ho, jonbol ho, doichoiho, milim houho chule mijouho, amaho jouse chan ding chu meidil al-lenglung meikou mittheilou lhummei chu hiding ahi. Hiche hi thi nina ahi.
English: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

tcz: Chuphat in sumlheng sagi gamna hoise sagi nunungpen choi vantil sagi ho lah'a khat chu ahungin, chule kajah'a aseiyin, “Hungin keito che hite! Keiman kelngoinou jidingnu, Mounu chu navetsah inge,” eiti.
en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”
text:
REV 21:9
Thadou: Chuphat in sumlheng sagi gamna hoise sagi nunungpen choi vantil sagi ho lah'a khat chu ahungin, chule kajah'a aseiyin, “Hungin keito che hite! Keiman kelngoinou jidingnu, Mounu chu navetsah inge,” eiti.
English: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls which were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.”

tcz: Hiti chun aman Lhagaovin keima molsang alentah khat mun'a eipuiyin, chule aman khopi theng, Jerusalem chu Pathen'a kon'a vana pat ahung kumlhah eivetsah in ahi.
en: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
text:
REV 21:10
Thadou: Hiti chun aman Lhagaovin keima molsang alentah khat mun'a eipuiyin, chule aman khopi theng, Jerusalem chu Pathen'a kon'a vana pat ahung kumlhah eivetsah in ahi.
English: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

tcz: Hichu Pathen loupina toh ahungvah doh in chule songmantam tobang'in aemsel in jasper songmantam crystal thenin athengselin ahi.
en: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

tcz: Khopi kulpi bang chu alenin chule asangin, kelkot som le ni aum in, vantil som le ni ho chun angau ahi. Chule Israel phungsom le ni ho min chu akelkot a chun akisunin ahi.
en: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
text:
REV 21:12
Thadou: Khopi kulpi bang chu alenin chule asangin, kelkot som le ni aum in, vantil som le ni ho chun angau ahi. Chule Israel phungsom le ni ho min chu akelkot a chun akisunin ahi.
English: having a great and high wall with twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

tcz: Khopi solam, sahlam, lhanglam chule lhumlam jousea chun kelkot thum cheh aumin ahi.
en: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
text:
REV 21:13
Thadou: Khopi solam, sahlam, lhanglam chule lhumlam jousea chun kelkot thum cheh aumin ahi.
English: On the east were three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.

tcz: Khopi kulpi-pal chun khombul som le ni aneiyin, chule achunga chun Kelngoinou solchah som le ni ho min akisunin ahi.
en: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
text:
REV 21:14
Thadou: Khopi kulpi-pal chun khombul som le ni aneiyin, chule achunga chun Kelngoinou solchah som le ni ho min akisunin ahi.
English: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

tcz: Vantil kahenga thuseiya chun khopi le akelkot ho, chule abang chu tena ding in akhut'ah sana a kisem thiltena mollhon achoiyin ahi.
en: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
text:
REV 21:15
Thadou: Vantil kahenga thuseiya chun khopi le akelkot ho, chule abang chu tena ding in akhut'ah sana a kisem thiltena mollhon achoiyin ahi.
English: He who spoke with me had for a measure a golden reed to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

tcz: Aman atetoh jouvin khopi chu aningli ahin, chule aletdan chu asanchanma ahi. Chule khopi chu adungle avai chule atun kibang ahin, mile sang khat le jali cheh ahi.
en: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.
text:
REV 21:16
Thadou: Aman atetoh jouvin khopi chu aningli ahin, chule aletdan chu asanchanma ahi. Chule khopi chu adungle avai chule atun kibang ahin, mile sang khat le jali cheh ahi.
English: The city is square. Its length is as great as its width. He measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, width, and height are equal.

tcz: Chujouvin aman kulpi bang chu atetoh'a ahileh feet jani le som le gup in asan ahi (hichu mihem tetohna dungjuia vantil atetoh ahi).
en: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
text:
REV 21:17
Thadou: Chujouvin aman kulpi bang chu atetoh'a ahileh feet jani le som le gup in asan ahi (hichu mihem tetohna dungjuia vantil atetoh ahi).
English: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

tcz: Kulpi bang chu jasper songa kisem ahin, chule khopi chu sana theng haithengsel then'a theng ahi.
en: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.
text:
REV 21:18
Thadou: Kulpi bang chu jasper songa kisem ahin, chule khopi chu sana theng haithengsel then'a theng ahi.
English: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

tcz: Khopi kulpi bang chu khombul songa songmantam som le nia kisem ahin, khatna Jasper ahin, ani na Sapphire, athum na agate, ali na emerald,
en: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire; the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
text:
REV 21:19
Thadou: Khopi kulpi bang chu khombul songa songmantam som le nia kisem ahin, khatna Jasper ahin, ani na Sapphire, athum na agate, ali na emerald,
English: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire; the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

tcz: anga na Onyx, agup na Carnelian, asagi na Quartz, aget na Beryl, ako na Topaz, asom na Chrysoprase, asom le khatna Jacinth, asom le nina amethyst, hichengse hi aboncha khi song jeng ahi.
en: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
text:
REV 21:20
Thadou: anga na Onyx, agup na Carnelian, asagi na Quartz, aget na Beryl, ako na Topaz, asom na Chrysoprase, asom le khatna Jacinth, asom le nina amethyst, hichengse hi aboncha khi song jeng ahi.
English: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

tcz: Kot som le ni ho chu twikohchanga kisem ahin, kot khat cheh chu twikoh chang khat cheh a kon ahi! Chule alamlen chu sana thengsel ahin, haithengsel then-a thengsel ahi.
en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
text:
REV 21:21
Thadou: Kot som le ni ho chu twikohchanga kisem ahin, kot khat cheh chu twikoh chang khat cheh a kon ahi! Chule alamlen chu sana thengsel ahin, haithengsel then-a thengsel ahi.
English: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

tcz: Keiman khopia chun Hou'in kamupoi, ajeh chu Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung chule Kelngoinou chu a Hou'in hiya ahi.
en: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
text:
REV 21:22
Thadou: Keiman khopia chun Hou'in kamupoi, ajeh chu Pakai Pathen Hatchungnung chule Kelngoinou chu a Hou'in hiya ahi.
English: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

tcz: Chule khopi chun nisavah ahilouleh lhavah jong angaitapoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen loupina chun khopi chu asalvah jenga chule Kelngoinou chu vah'a pang jeng ahi.
en: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.
text:
REV 21:23
Thadou: Chule khopi chun nisavah ahilouleh lhavah jong angaitapoi, ijeh ham itileh Pathen loupina chun khopi chu asalvah jenga chule Kelngoinou chu vah'a pang jeng ahi.
English: The city has no need for the sun or moon to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it and its lamp is the Lamb.

tcz: Chitin namtin chu avah noiya vahle ding, chule vannoi leiset lengho khopi sunga chu aloupinau pum'a lutdiu ahi.
en: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.
text:
REV 21:24
Thadou: Chitin namtin chu avah noiya vahle ding, chule vannoi leiset lengho khopi sunga chu aloupinau pum'a lutdiu ahi.
English: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

tcz: Akelkot hou chu kikhatih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh jan umlou ding ahitai.
en: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),
text:
REV 21:25
Thadou: Akelkot hou chu kikhatih umlou ding ahitai, ijeh inem itileh jan umlou ding ahitai.
English: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

tcz: Chule chitin namtin ho chun aloupinau le jabol achannau chu khopi sunga chu ahinpoh lut diu ahi.
en: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.
text:
REV 21:26
Thadou: Chule chitin namtin ho chun aloupinau le jabol achannau chu khopi sunga chu ahinpoh lut diu ahi.
English: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

tcz: Chuche mun'a chu imacha aphalouva, jachat umtah milim houna le lungthen louna ho imacha luttalou ding, Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua kisunho chengse bou chu lutding ahi.
en: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
text:
REV 21:27
Thadou: Chuche mun'a chu imacha aphalouva, jachat umtah milim houna le lungthen louna ho imacha luttalou ding, Kelngoinou Hinna Lekhabua kisunho chengse bou chu lutding ahi.
English: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

tcz: Chujouvin Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna a kon'a hunglongdoh vadung khat Hin-twi, crystal then'a thengsel vantil chun eivetsah in ahi.
en: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,
text:
REV 22:1
Thadou: Chujouvin Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna a kon'a hunglongdoh vadung khat Hin-twi, crystal then'a thengsel vantil chun eivetsah in ahi.
English: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

tcz: Hichu lamlhong pipena konin ahung long lhan ahi. Vadung alangto gel a chun hinthing akeh in, aga jatchom chom som le ni agan, alha seh'a ga jinga ahi. Athing doho jong namtin damna dinga loule-aiya pang ahi.
en: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
text:
REV 22:2
Thadou: Hichu lamlhong pipena konin ahung long lhan ahi. Vadung alangto gel a chun hinthing akeh in, aga jatchom chom som le ni agan, alha seh'a ga jinga ahi. Athing doho jong namtin damna dinga loule-aiya pang ahi.
English: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

tcz: Sapsetna kiti umta louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna chumun'a um ding, chule asohten Ama ahou diu ahi.
en: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.
text:
REV 22:3
Thadou: Sapsetna kiti umta louhel ding ahi. Ajeh chu Pathen le Kelngoinou laltouna chumun'a um ding, chule asohten Ama ahou diu ahi.
English: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will serve him.

tcz: Chule amahon amai amu diu, Ama min chu achalpanguva kijih ding ahi.
en: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
text:
REV 22:4
Thadou: Chule amahon amai amu diu, Ama min chu achalpanguva kijih ding ahi.
English: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

tcz: Chumun'a jan umta louhel ding, thaomeivah le nisa vah jong ngaitalou hel ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Pakai Pathen achunguva vahding, chule amaho chun tonsot atonsot-a vai ahom diu ahi.
en: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.
text:
REV 22:5
Thadou: Chumun'a jan umta louhel ding, thaomeivah le nisa vah jong ngaitalou hel ding ahi. Ijeh inem itileh Pakai Pathen achunguva vahding, chule amaho chun tonsot atonsot-a vai ahom diu ahi.
English: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light or sun light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

tcz: Chujouvin vantil chun kajah a, “Nangman najah chengse le namu chengse hi tahsan umtah le thutah jeng ahi. Pakai Pathen, athemgao ho tilkhounaa chu avantil asol-a asohte thil hunglhungvah ding ho aseipeh ahi.”
en: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”
text:
REV 22:6
Thadou: Chujouvin vantil chun kajah a, “Nangman najah chengse le namu chengse hi tahsan umtah le thutah jeng ahi. Pakai Pathen, athemgao ho tilkhounaa chu avantil asol-a asohte thil hunglhungvah ding ho aseipeh ahi.”
English: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

tcz: “Ven, Keima kahungloi jeng ding ahi! Hiche lekhabua themgao ho thusei kijihdoh ho ngaiya chu anunnom ahi.”
en: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
text:
REV 22:7
Thadou: “Ven, Keima kahungloi jeng ding ahi! Hiche lekhabua themgao ho thusei kijihdoh ho ngaiya chu anunnom ahi.”
English: “Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

tcz: Keima John hi, hichengse ja'a chule mua chu kahi. Chule hicheng keiman kajah'a kamu phat chun, keiman ama chu Pathen houva houna dingin kakigotan ahi.
en: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
text:
REV 22:8
Thadou: Keima John hi, hichengse ja'a chule mua chu kahi. Chule hicheng keiman kajah'a kamu phat chun, keiman ama chu Pathen houva houna dingin kakigotan ahi.
English: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

tcz: Hinlah aman aseiyin, “Ahipoi, keima neihou hih in. Keima nangma le nasopite themgaoho lah'a khat tobanga, Pathen sohpa khat hiche lekhabua thu kisun juiya chu kahi. Pathen bou houvin,” eiti.
en: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”
text:
REV 22:9
Thadou: Hinlah aman aseiyin, “Ahipoi, keima neihou hih in. Keima nangma le nasopite themgaoho lah'a khat tobanga, Pathen sohpa khat hiche lekhabua thu kisun juiya chu kahi. Pathen bou houvin,” eiti.
English: He said to me, “You must not do that! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

tcz: Chujouvin aman eihilin, “Hiche lekhabua themgao thuseidoh hohi mohor namkhum hih in, ijeh inem itileh aphat chu anaitai.
en: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
text:
REV 22:10
Thadou: Chujouvin aman eihilin, “Hiche lekhabua themgao thuseidoh hohi mohor namkhum hih in, ijeh inem itileh aphat chu anaitai.
English: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

tcz: Phatlouna thilbol chun aphalou boljom hen, asea chu setna boljom hen; midih chun adih boljinghen, athenga chu thengjom jing hen,” ati.
en: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”
text:
REV 22:11
Thadou: Phatlouna thilbol chun aphalou boljom hen, asea chu setna boljom hen; midih chun adih boljinghen, athenga chu thengjom jing hen,” ati.
English: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

tcz: “Ven, keima kahung vahding, keiman mi jouse athilbol dung juicheh uva lethuhna kapeh cheh diu ahi.
en: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
text:
REV 22:12
Thadou: “Ven, keima kahung vahding, keiman mi jouse athilbol dung juicheh uva lethuhna kapeh cheh diu ahi.
English: “Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

tcz: Keima Alpha chule Omega chu kahi, Amasapen le Anunungpen, a-Patna le akichaina chu kahi,” ati.
en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
text:
REV 22:13
Thadou: Keima Alpha chule Omega chu kahi, Amasapen le Anunungpen, a-Patna le akichaina chu kahi,” ati.
English: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

tcz: Aponsil kisop theng hochu anunnom ahiuve. Amaho chu khopi lutna kot hoa chu lutdinga kiphalpeh diu chule Hinthing ga chu aneh diu kiphalpeh ding ahiuve.
en: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.
text:
REV 22:14
Thadou: Aponsil kisop theng hochu anunnom ahiuve. Amaho chu khopi lutna kot hoa chu lutdinga kiphalpeh diu chule Hinthing ga chu aneh diu kiphalpeh ding ahiuve.
English: Blessed are those who do his commandments, that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

tcz: Khopi pamlam'a chun–uicha ho, doichoiho, jonthanhoi bolho, tolthat a pangho, limsemthu hou ho, chule jouva hingnom ho jouse aum uve.
en: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
text:
REV 22:15
Thadou: Khopi pamlam'a chun–uicha ho, doichoiho, jonthanhoi bolho, tolthat a pangho, limsemthu hou ho, chule jouva hingnom ho jouse aum uve.
English: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

tcz: “Yeshua Keiman, hiche thuhi Hobungho henga galhut dinga ka vantil kasol ahitai. Keima David dinga ahungkonna le alaltouna lodingpa chu kahi. Keima jingvalpa vahtah chu kahi,” ati.
en: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”
text:
REV 22:16
Thadou: “Yeshua Keiman, hiche thuhi Hobungho henga galhut dinga ka vantil kasol ahitai. Keima David dinga ahungkonna le alaltouna lodingpa chu kahi. Keima jingvalpa vahtah chu kahi,” ati.
English: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David, the Bright and Morning Star.”

tcz: Lhagao le Mou chun asei lhonin, “Hungin,” ati. Hiche thusei ngaiho chu, “Hunguhen,” ati. Koipen hijongleh adangchah'a chu hunghen. Koipen hijongleh angaicha chanin hintwi chu manbeiyin donhen.
en: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.
text:
REV 22:17
Thadou: Lhagao le Mou chun asei lhonin, “Hungin,” ati. Hiche thusei ngaiho chu, “Hunguhen,” ati. Koipen hijongleh adangchah'a chu hunghen. Koipen hijongleh angaicha chanin hintwi chu manbeiyin donhen.
English: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

tcz: Chule keiman hiche lekhabua themgao thusei kijih jaho jah'a phongtah'a kasei ahi: Hichea thu kisun koiham khattouvin koibe aneiya ahileh ama chunga chu Pathen in asunga kisun gamna hoise hi akoipehbe ding ahi.
en: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.
text:
REV 22:18
Thadou: Chule keiman hiche lekhabua themgao thusei kijih jaho jah'a phongtah'a kasei ahi: Hichea thu kisun koiham khattouvin koibe aneiya ahileh ama chunga chu Pathen in asunga kisun gamna hoise hi akoipehbe ding ahi.
English: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

tcz: Chule koihileh hiche themgao lekhabua thu kisun athuchengho khattou aladoh aumleh, Pathen in amachu Hinthinga kon le khopi thenga kon'a achanding hiche lekhabua kisun chu alahmang ding ahi.
en: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.
text:
REV 22:19
Thadou: Chule koihileh hiche themgao lekhabua thu kisun athuchengho khattou aladoh aumleh, Pathen in amachu Hinthinga kon le khopi thenga kon'a achanding hiche lekhabua kisun chu alahmang ding ahi.
English: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

tcz: Hicheho jouse chunga tahsan umtah hettohsah'a panga chun aseiyin, “Henge, Keima hungvah ding kahi!” ati. Amen! Hungin, Pakai Yeshua!
en: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!
text:
REV 22:20
Thadou: Hicheho jouse chunga tahsan umtah hettohsah'a panga chun aseiyin, “Henge, Keima hungvah ding kahi!” ati. Amen! Hungin, Pakai Yeshua!
English: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I am coming soon.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus!

tcz: Pakai Yeshua lungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiu hen.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
text:
REV 22:21
Thadou: Pakai Yeshua lungsetna chun nabonchauvin naumpiu hen.
English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
